001.name: Spinarak
001.evolves: Evolves into Ariados or Dark Ariados
001.attacksText: { G } → Gooey Thread : 10 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
001.flavorText: It spins a web using fine yet durable thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

002.name: Ariados
002.attacksText: { G } → Poison Ring : 50 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.
002.flavorText: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It's hard to tell which end is which.

003.name: Shaymin
003.attacksText: { G } → Send Flowers Search your deck for an Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched { G } Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. { G } → Leaf Step : 30
003.flavorText: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

004.name: Snivy
004.attacksText: { G } → Reckless Charge : 30 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
004.flavorText: It prefers to avoid groups. In its day-to-day life, it dexterously controls its vines to compensate for its short arms.

005.name: Servine
005.evolves: Evolves from Snivy and into Serperior or Serperior ex
005.attacksText: { G } → Solar Cutter : 40
005.flavorText: Servine's one weakness is its inflated sense of pride. It takes a while for Servine to be able to cooperate with other Pokémon.

006.name: Serperior
006.attacksText: { G } → Regal Command : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play. { G } { G } { G } → Solar Coiling : 100+ If Rosa's Encouragement is in your discard pile, this attack does 150 more damage.
006.flavorText: An intimidating gaze and majestic appearance have caused this Pokémon to be known as the Lord of the Forest.

007.name: Scatterbug
007.attacksText: { G } → Gnaw : 20
007.flavorText: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

008.name: Spewpa
008.evolves: Evolves from Scatterbug and into Vivillon
008.attacksText: { G } → Hide Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
008.flavorText: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

009.name: Vivillon
009.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Grand Wing Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Your opponent shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If they put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, they draw 4 cards. { G } → Blow Through : 60+ If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 60 more damage.
009.flavorText: The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from lands where flowers bloom.

010.name: Rowlet
010.attacksText: { G } → Find a Friend Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. { C } { C } { C } → Tackle : 30
010.flavorText: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to nestle into its Trainer's bag or the front of their jacket.

011.name: Dartrix
011.evolves: Evolves from Rowlet and into Decidueye , Decidueye ex , or Hisuian Decidueye
011.attacksText: { G } → Leafage : 20 { C } { C } { C } → Feather Shot Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
011.flavorText: It throws sharp feathers called blade quills at enemies or prey. It seldom misses.

012.name: Decidueye ex
012.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sniper's Eye If your opponent has exactly 4 cards in their hand, ignore all { C } Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon. { G } { C } { C } { C } → Crushing Arrow : 240 Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

013.name: Fletchinder
013.evolves: Evolves from Fletchling and into Talonflame
013.attacksText: { R } { R } → Flare : 60
013.flavorText: The hotter the flame sac in its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.

014.name: Talonflame
014.evolves: Evolves from Fletchinder and into Talonflame BREAK
014.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sky Hunt Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand. { R } { R } → Fire Wing : 110
014.flavorText: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers as it flies.

015.name: Salandit
015.evolves: Evolves into Salazzle , Salazzle- GX , or Salazzle ex
015.attacksText: { R } → Fire Claws : 20
015.flavorText: Only female Salandit can produce gas laden with pheromones. Males entranced by this gas will do whatever the females tell them.

016.name: Salazzle ex

017.name: Turtonator
017.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Shell Spikes If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , discard an Energy from the Attacking Pokémon. { R } { R } { C } → Heat Breath : 80+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 80 more damage.
017.flavorText: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

018.name: Seel
018.attacksText: { W } → Rain Splash : 10 { W } { W } → Wave Splash : 30
018.flavorText: The colder it gets, the better it feels. It joyfully swims around oceans so cold that they are filled with floating ice.

019.name: Dewgong
019.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Wash Out As often as you like during your turn, you may use this Ability. Move a { W } Energy from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon. { W } { W } → Wave Splash : 60
019.flavorText: It stores thermal energy in its body to fend off the cold. It swims at eight knots even in frigid waters.

020.name: Staryu
020.evolves: Evolves into Starmie or Mega Starmie ex
020.attacksText: { W } → Water Gun : 20
020.flavorText: Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.

021.name: Mega Starmie ex
021.attacksText: { W } → Jetting Blow : 120 This attack also does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) { C } { C } { C } → Nebula Beam : 210 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

022.attacksText: { W } → Hydro Turn : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each { W } Energy attached to this Pokémon. Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. { W } { W } { W } → Surf : 140

023.name: Amaura
023.evolves: Evolves from Antique Sail Fossil and into Aurorus
023.attacksText: { W } { C } → Icy Wind : 50 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
023.flavorText: This ancient Pokémon was restored from a part of its body that had been frozen in ice for 100 million years.

024.name: Aurorus
024.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Tundra Wall All of your Pokémon that have any { W } Energy attached take 50 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . The effect of Tundra Wall doesn't stack. { W } { W } { C } → Freezing Chill : 150 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.

025.attacksText: { W } { C } → Strength : 50 { W } { W } { C } → Powerful Steam : 90× Flip a coin for each { W } Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.

026.attacksText: { L } → Double Scratch : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

028.name: Luxray

032.attacksText: { P } { C } → Double Eater : 60× Discard up to 2 Energy cards from your hand, and this attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

033.name: Espurr
033.attacksText: { C } → Nap Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon. { P } → Stampede : 10

034.name: Meowstic
034.attacksText: { P } → Perplex Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. { P } → Psychic : 30+ This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
034.flavorText: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

035.name: Spritzee
035.attacksText: { C } → Sweet Scent Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. { P } → Ram : 10
035.flavorText: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

036.name: Aromatisse
036.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Scent Collection Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for up to 2 Basic { P } Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. { P } { C } → Draining Kiss : 50 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
036.flavorText: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless they happen to really enjoy the smell, Trainers will have a hard time walking alongside it.

037.name: Nosepass
037.attacksText: { F } { F } → Rolling Rocks : 40
037.flavorText: When endangered, it may protect itself by increasing its magnetism and drawing nearby iron objects to its body.

038.name: Probopass
038.attacksText: { F } { F } → Rolling Rocks : 60 { F } { F } { F } { C } → Obliterating Nose : 260 Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.
038.flavorText: Probopass radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances are rendered useless while it's around.

039.name: Hippopotas
039.evolves: Evolves into Hippowdon
039.attacksText: { F } → Sand Attack : 10 During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen. { F } { C } { C } → Bite : 60
039.flavorText: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

040.name: Hippowdon
040.attacksText: { F } { F } { C } → Twister Spewing : 80 If you played Tarragon from your hand during this turn, discard the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck. { F } { F } { C } { C } → Heavy Impact : 130

041.name: Landorus
041.attacksText: { F } { F } → Rock Tumble : 50 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance. { F } { F } { C } → Screw Knuckle : 120 Put an Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.
041.flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

042.attacksText: { F } → Double Draw Draw 2 cards. { F } { F } → Scratch : 30
042.flavorText: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

043.name: Barbaracle
043.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Stone Arms Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic { F } Energy card from your hand to 1 of your { F } Pokémon. { F } { F } { C } → Hammer In : 80
043.flavorText: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

044.name: Tyrunt
044.evolves: Evolves from Antique Jaw Fossil and into Tyrantrum
044.attacksText: { F } { C } → Get Angry : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
044.flavorText: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

045.name: Tyrantrum
045.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Tyrannically Gutsy If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, it gets +150 HP. { F } { C } → Wreak Havoc : 160 Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.
045.flavorText: This Pokémon behaved like a king 100 million years ago. Nothing could stop it.

046.name: Hawlucha
046.attacksText: { F } → Vengeful Kick : 30+ If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 60 more damage.
046.flavorText: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

047.name: Mega Zygarde ex
047.attacksText: { F } { F } { F } → Gaia Wave : 200 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . { F } { F } { F } { F } { F } → Nullifying Zero For each of your opponent's Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 150 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

048.name: Gastly
048.evolves: Evolves into Haunter or Dark Haunter
048.attacksText: { D } → Surprise Attack : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
048.flavorText: It's born from gases. Anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

049.name: Haunter
049.evolves: Evolves from Gastly and into Gengar , Mega Gengar ex , or Gengar ex
049.attacksText: { D } → Haunt Place 3 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
049.flavorText: It licks with its gaseous tongue to steal its victim's life force. It lurks in darkness, waiting for prey.

050.name: Gengar
050.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Infinite Shadow If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, put it into your hand instead of the discard pile. (Discard all attached cards.) { D } → Mind Jack : 10+ This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
050.flavorText: It hides in shadows. It is said that in rooms where Gengar is hiding, the temperature drops by nearly 10 degrees Fahrenheit.

051.name: Skorupi
051.evolves: Evolves into Drapion
051.attacksText: { D } { D } → Poison Jab : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
051.flavorText: After burrowing into the sand, it waits patiently for prey to come near. This Pokémon and Sizzlipede share common descent.

052.name: Drapion
052.attacksText: { D } { D } → Wrack Down : 60 { D } { D } { D } → Hazardous Tail : 100 This Pokémon also does 70 damage to itself. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.
052.flavorText: Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.

053.name: Yveltal ex
053.attacksText: { D } { D } { C } → Soul Destroyer Knock Out each of your opponent's Pokémon that has 50 HP or less remaining. { D } { D } { C } → Dark Strike : 210 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Dark Strike.

054.name: Chien-Pao
054.attacksText: { D } → Strafe : 20 You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. { D } { D } { C } → Rising Blade : 80+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 80 more damage.
054.flavorText: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

055.name: Mega Skarmory ex
055.attacksText: { M } { M } { C } → Sonic Ripper Shuffle all Energy attached to this Pokémon into your deck, and this attack does 220 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

056.name: Honedge
056.attacksText: { C } → Cut : 10
056.flavorText: Apparently Honedge was born when a departed spirit began inhabiting an ancient sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

057.name: Doublade
057.evolves: Evolves from Honedge and into Aegislash
057.attacksText: { C } { C } → Weaponized Swords : 60× Reveal any number of Honedge, Doublade, and Aegislash from your hand, and this attack does 60 damage for each card you revealed in this way.
057.flavorText: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords that cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

058.name: Aegislash
058.evolves: Evolves from Doublade
058.attacksText: { C } { C } { C } → Slash : 80 { M } { C } { C } { C } → Metal Slash : 230 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.
058.flavorText: This stance is dedicated to offense. It can cleave any oppenent with the strength and weight of its steel blade.

059.attacksText: { M } → Memory Lock : 30 Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack.
059.flavorText: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

060.name: Rattata
060.evolves: Evolves into Raticate or Dark Raticate
060.attacksText: { C } → Take Down : 30 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
060.flavorText: Its incisors grow continuously throughout its life. If its incisors get too long, this Pokémon becomes unable to eat, and it starves to death.

061.name: Raticate
061.evolves: Evolves from Rattata
061.attacksText: { C } → Scrape Off : 20 Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon. { C } → Retaliatory Incisors : 40× This attack does 40 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Rattata.
061.flavorText: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.

062.name: Meowth ex
062.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Last-Ditch Catch Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Ability that has “Last-Ditch” in its name each turn. { C } { C } { C } → Tuck Tail : 60 Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

063.name: Snorlax
063.attacksText: { C } → Gormandizer Flip a coin until you get tails. Search your deck for an amount of Basic Energy up to the number of heads and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. { C } { C } { C } { C } → Collapse : 160 This Pokémon is now Asleep.
063.flavorText: Its stomach's digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. Eating things off the ground doesn't bother it at all.

064.name: Bunnelby
064.evolves: Evolves into Diggersby
064.attacksText: { C } → Smash Kick : 10
064.flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through without rest.

065.name: Diggersby
065.attacksText: { C } → Earthquake : 140 This attack also does 30 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) { C } { C } { C } → Whap Down : 100
065.flavorText: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

066.name: Fletchling
066.attacksText: { C } → Chirp Search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon with { F } Resistance, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. { C } { C } → Peck : 20
066.flavorText: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

067.name: Furfrou
067.attacksText: { C } → Hand Trim Discard random cards from your opponent's hand until they have 5 cards in their hand. { C } → Headbutt : 30
067.flavorText: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.

068.name: Antique Jaw Fossil
068.attacksText: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic { C } Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play. Ability ⇢ Intimidating Jaw As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .

069.name: Antique Sail Fossil
069.attacksText: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic { C } Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play. Ability ⇢ Protective Sail Whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to this Pokémon.

070.name: Core Memory
070.attacksText: The Mega Zygarde ex this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.) { F } { F } { F } { F } → Geobuster : 350 Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

071.name: Crushing Hammer
071.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

072.name: Energy Search
072.attacksText: Search your deck for a Basic Energy card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

073.name: Energy Swatter
073.attacksText: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you choose an Energy card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck.

074.name: Hole-Digging Shovel
074.attacksText: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

075.name: Jacinthe
075.attacksText: Heal 150 damage from 1 of your { P } Pokémon.

076.name: Judge
076.attacksText: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.

077.name: Lumiose City
077.attacksText: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto their Bench. Then, that player shuffles their deck. If a player searches their deck in this way, their turn ends.

078.name: Lumiose Galette
078.attacksText: Heal 20 damage and remove a Special Condition from your Active Pokémon.

079.name: Naveen
079.attacksText: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. Before drawing cards, you may discard any number of cards from your hand. (If you can't draw any cards in this way, you can't use this card.)

080.name: Poké Ball
080.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

081.name: Poké Pad
081.attacksText: Search your deck for a Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

082.name: Pokémon Catcher
082.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

083.name: Potion
083.attacksText: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

084.name: Rosa's Encouragement
084.attacksText: You can use this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent. Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Stage 2 Pokémon.

085.name: Tarragon
085.attacksText: Put up to 4 in any combination of { F } Pokémon and Basic { F } Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

086.name: Growing {G} Energy
086.attacksText: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides { G } Energy. The { G } Pokémon this card is attached to gets +20 HP.

087.name: Rocky {F} Energy
087.attacksText: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides { F } Energy. Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to the { F } Pokémon this card is attached to. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)

088.name: Telepathic {P} Energy
088.attacksText: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides { P } Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to a { P } Pokémon, search your deck for up to 2 Basic { P } Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

089.name: Spewpa
089.evolves: Evolves from Scatterbug and into Vivillon
089.attacksText: { G } → Hide Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
089.flavorText: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

090.name: Rowlet
090.attacksText: { G } → Find a Friend Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. { C } { C } { C } → Tackle : 30
090.flavorText: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to nestle into its Trainer's bag or the front of their jacket.

091.name: Talonflame
091.evolves: Evolves from Fletchinder and into Talonflame BREAK
091.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sky Hunt Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand. { R } { R } → Fire Wing : 110
091.flavorText: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers as it flies.

092.name: Aurorus
092.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Tundra Wall All of your Pokémon that have any { W } Energy attached take 50 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . The effect of Tundra Wall doesn't stack. { W } { W } { C } → Freezing Chill : 150 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.
092.flavorText: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

093.name: Dedenne
093.attacksText: { L } → Tail Generator Choose Basic { L } Energy cards from your discard pile up to the amount of Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon and attach them to your { L } Pokémon in any way you like. { L } { C } → Thunder Shock : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
093.flavorText: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

094.name: Clefairy
094.evolves: Evolves into Clefable , Mega Clefable ex , or Clefable ex
094.attacksText: { P } → Follow Me Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. { P } { P } → Flop : 30
094.flavorText: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

095.name: Espurr
095.attacksText: { C } → Nap Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon. { P } → Stampede : 10
095.flavorText: It keeps its intense psychic power from leaking out by using its ears to cover the organs emitting that power.

096.name: Probopass
096.attacksText: { F } { F } → Rolling Rocks : 60 { F } { F } { F } { C } → Obliterating Nose : 260 Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.
096.flavorText: Probopass radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances are rendered useless while it's around.

097.name: Drapion
097.attacksText: { D } { D } → Wrack Down : 60 { D } { D } { D } → Hazardous Tail : 100 This Pokémon also does 70 damage to itself. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.
097.flavorText: Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.

098.name: Doublade
098.evolves: Evolves from Honedge and into Aegislash
098.attacksText: { C } { C } → Weaponized Swords : 60× Reveal any number of Honedge, Doublade, and Aegislash from your hand, and this attack does 60 damage for each card you revealed in this way.
098.flavorText: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords that cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

099.name: Raticate
099.attacksText: { C } → Scrape Off : 20 Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon. { C } → Retaliatory Incisors : 40× This attack does 40 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Rattata.
099.flavorText: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.

100.name: Team Rocket's Diglett
100.attacksText: {F} → Relentless Burrowing Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.
100.flavorText: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

101.name: Team Rocket's Dugtrio
101.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Holes Whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon moves to the Bench during their turn, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. {F}{C} → Mud Shot : 50
101.flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

102.name: Hitmontop
102.attacksText: {C} → Spin and Draw Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. {F}{C} → Low Kick : 50
102.flavorText: It spins on its horn while dealing out elegant kicks. Its horn grows continuously through its lifetime.

103.name: Meditite
103.evolves: Evolves into Medicham or Medicham ex
103.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {F} → Gentle Slap : 10
103.flavorText: It meditates in order to build up its mental energy. It eats just one berry a day.

104.name: Medicham
104.attacksText: {F} → Seventh Kick : 150 If you don't have exactly 7 cards in your hand, this attack does nothing.
104.flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's movements.

105.name: Lunatone
105.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Lunar Cycle Once during your turn, if you have Solrock in play, you may discard a Basic {F} Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Lunar Cycle Ability each turn. {F}{F} → Power Gem : 50
105.flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

106.name: Solrock
106.attacksText: {F} → Cosmic Beam : 70 If you don't have Lunatone on your Bench, this attack does nothing. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
106.flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

107.name: Regirock ex
107.attacksText: {C} → Regi Charge Attach up to 2 Basic {F} Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Giant Rock : 140+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Stage 2 Pokémon, this attack does 140 more damage. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

108.name: Groudon
108.attacksText: {F}{F}{C} → Hammer In : 80 {F}{F}{C}{C} → Megaton Fall : 150 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
108.flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

109.name: Cynthia's Gible
109.attacksText: {F} → Rock Hurl : 20 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
109.flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

110.name: Cynthia's Gabite
110.evolves: Evolves from Cynthia's Gible and into Cynthia's Garchomp ex
110.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Champion's Call Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Cynthia's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {F} → Dragonslice : 40
110.flavorText: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

111.name: Cynthia's Garchomp ex
111.attacksText: {F} → Corkscrew Dive : 100 You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. {F}{F} → Draconic Buster : 260 Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

112.name: Riolu
112.evolves: Evolves into Mega Lucario ex , Lucario- GX , or Lucario ex
112.attacksText: {F} → Accelerating Stab : 30 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Accelerating Stab.
112.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

113.name: Mega Lucario ex
113.attacksText: {F} → Aura Jab : 130 Attach up to 3 Basic {F} Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. {F}{F} → Mega Brave : 270 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Mega Brave. · The Mega-Evolved form of Lucario

114.name: Stunfisk ex
114.attacksText: {F} → Big Bite : 30 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. {F}{C}{C} → Flopping Trap : 100+ If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 100 more damage. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

115.name: Pancham
115.attacksText: {C} → Reckless Charge : 20 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
115.flavorText: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can't help grinning if anyone pats its head.

116.name: Mega Hawlucha ex
116.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Tenacious Body If this Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10. {F}{F}{C} → Somersault Dive : 120+ If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 140 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium. · The Mega-Evolved form of Hawlucha

117.name: Carbink
117.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Double Type As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is {F} and {P} type. {F}{F}{C} → Counter Jewel : 70+ If your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 100 more damage.
117.flavorText: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it releases energy from the stone in its head.

118.name: Rolycoly
118.attacksText: {F} → Mud-Slap : 20
118.flavorText: Chunks of the surface of this Pokémon's body that have grown old and flaked off have long been used for fuel as an alternative to coal.

119.name: Carkol
119.evolves: Evolves from Rolycoly and into Coalossal
119.attacksText: {F} → Guard Press : 20 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{C}{C} → Power Gem : 60
119.flavorText: Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of coal on Carkol's back never falls apart, even when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds.

120.name: Coalossal
120.attacksText: {F} → Tar Cannon This attack does 140 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you don't have 10 or more Basic {F} Energy cards in your discard pile, this attack does nothing. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{C}{C}{C} → Bulky Bump : 220 Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.
120.flavorText: It's gentle usually but fearsome when angered. With a body that burns at over 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit, it crushes foes and turns them to ash.

121.name: Koraidon ex
121.attacksText: {F}{C} → Orichalcum Fang : 50+ If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 120 more damage. {F}{F}{C} → Impact Blow : 200 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Impact Blow. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

122.name: Okidogi
122.attacksText: {F} → Light Punch : 20 {F}{F}{C} → Settle the Score : 80+ This attack does 60 more damage for each Prize card your opponent took during their last turn.
122.flavorText: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

123.name: Gastly
123.evolves: Evolves into Haunter or Dark Haunter
123.attacksText: {D} → Petty Grudge : 10
123.flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

124.name: Haunter
124.evolves: Evolves from Gastly and into Gengar , Mega Gengar ex , or Gengar ex
124.attacksText: {D} → Spooky Shot : 40
124.flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

125.name: Mega Gengar ex
125.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Shadowy Concealment If 1 of your {D} Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ex, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card. The effect of Shadowy Concealment doesn't stack. {D}{D} → Void Gale : 230 Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. · The Mega-Evolved form of Gengar

126.name: Team Rocket's Murkrow
126.attacksText: {C} → Deceit Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {D}{C} → Torment : 30 Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack.
126.flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

127.name: Team Rocket's Honchkrow
127.attacksText: {C}{C} → Rocket Feathers : 60× You may discard any number of Supporter cards that have “Team Rocket” in their name from your hand, and this attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way. {D}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 100
127.flavorText: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than 100 of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

128.name: Poochyena
128.evolves: Evolves into Mightyena or Mightyena ex
128.attacksText: {D}{C} → Gnaw Off : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
128.flavorText: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

129.name: Mightyena
129.attacksText: {D}{C} → Kick Away : 50 Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.) {D}{D}{C} → Sharp Fang : 130
129.flavorText: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

130.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
130.attacksText: {D} → Gnaw : 10
130.flavorText: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

131.name: Galarian Linoone
131.evolves: Evolves from Galarian Zigzagoon and into Galarian Obstagoon
131.attacksText: {D} → Gnaw : 20 {D}{C} → Claw Slash : 50
131.flavorText: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

132.name: Galarian Obstagoon
132.attacksText: {D}{C} → Scarring Shout : 70× This attack does 70 damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon. {D}{C}{C} → Punk Smash : 160 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
132.flavorText: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

133.name: Cynthia's Spiritomb
133.attacksText: {C} → Raging Curse : 10× This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Cynthia's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.
133.flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

134.name: Scraggy
134.evolves: Evolves into Scrafty or Mega Scrafty ex
134.attacksText: {D}{C} → Knock Off : 20 Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.
134.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

135.name: Mega Scrafty ex
135.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Counterattacking Crest If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , place 5 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. {D}{D}{C} → Outlaw Leg : 160 Discard a random card from your opponent's hand. Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. · The Mega-Evolved form of Scrafty

136.name: N's Zorua
136.attacksText: {D} → Scratch : 20
136.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

137.name: N's Zoroark ex
137.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Trade You must discard a card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards. {D}{D} → Night Joker Choose 1 of your Benched N's Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

138.name: Vullaby
138.evolves: Evolves into Mandibuzz or Mandibuzz ex
138.attacksText: {C}{C} → Flap : 20
138.flavorText: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

139.name: Mandibuzz ex
139.attacksText: {C}{C} → Bone Shot This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {D}{C}{C} → Vulture Claw : 160 Discard a random card from your opponent's hand. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

140.name: Pangoro
140.attacksText: {D} → Corkscrew Punch : 40 {D}{D}{C} → Master's Punch : 80+ If any of your Benched Pancham have any damage counters on them, this attack does 120 more damage.
140.flavorText: Although it has a violent temperament, it won't put up with those who bully the weak. It senses foes' movements with its leaf.

141.name: Hoopa
141.attacksText: {C} → Filch Draw 2 cards. {D}{D}{C} → Knuckle Impact : 130 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.
141.flavorText: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

142.name: Fezandipiti ex
142.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Flip the Script Once during your turn, if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Flip the Script Ability each turn. {C}{C}{C} → Cruel Arrow This attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

143.name: Pecharunt
143.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Final Chain If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {D} → Mochi Rush : 20 During your next turn, this Pokémon's Mochi Rush attack does 50 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .
143.flavorText: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

144.name: Mawile
144.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {M}{C}{C} → Bite : 90
144.flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

145.name: Registeel ex
145.attacksText: {C} → Regi Charge Attach up to 2 Basic {M} Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {M}{C}{C}{C} → Protecting Steel : 140 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 50 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

146.name: Pawniard
146.attacksText: {M} → Push Down : 10 Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
146.flavorText: Any chips in its blades would prove fatal for it. After each battle, it diligently maintains its blades using its favorite sharpening stone.

147.name: Bisharp
147.evolves: Evolves from Pawniard and into Kingambit
147.attacksText: {M} → Rapid Draw : 50 Draw 2 cards.
147.flavorText: Bisharp mercilessly cuts its opponents to pieces with the sharp blades covering its body. It will do anything to win.

148.name: Kingambit
148.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Supreme Overlord Attacks used by this Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon for each Prize card your opponent has taken (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M}{M} → Double-Edged Slash : 180 This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.
148.flavorText: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it's not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

149.name: Togedemaru ex
149.attacksText: {M} → Stun Needle : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {M}{C} → Spiky Rolling : 80+ If this Pokémon used Spiky Rolling during your last turn, this attack does 80 more damage. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

150.name: Dratini
150.evolves: Evolves into Dragonair , Dark Dragonair , or Light Dragonair
150.attacksText: {W}{L} → Headbutt : 30
150.flavorText: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

151.name: Dragonair
151.evolves: Evolves from Dratini and into Dragonite , Dragonite- GX , Mega Dragonite ex , or Dragonite ex
151.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Evolutionary Guidance Once during your turn, if this Pokémon has any Energy attached, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {W}{L} → Tail Snap : 60
151.flavorText: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

152.name: Mega Dragonite ex
152.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sky Transport Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {W}{L}{L} → Ryuno Glide : 330 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. · The Mega-Evolved form of Dragonite

153.name: Rayquaza
153.attacksText: {L}{C} → Breakthrough Assault : 20+ If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 90 more damage. {R}{L}{C} → Dragon Claw : 130
153.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

154.name: N's Reshiram
154.attacksText: {R}{L} → Powerful Rage : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. {R}{R}{L}{C} → Virtuous Flame : 170
154.flavorText: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

155.name: N's Zekrom
155.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Shred : 70 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. {R}{L}{L}{C} → Rampaging Thunder : 250 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.
155.flavorText: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

156.name: Noibat
156.evolves: Evolves into Noivern , Noivern ex , or Noivern- GX
156.attacksText: {C} → Knickknack Carrying Search your deck for a Pokémon Tool card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {P}{D} → Bite : 30
156.flavorText: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

157.name: Noivern
157.attacksText: {C}{C} → Agility : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon. {P}{D} → Enhanced Blade : 70+ If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 70 more damage.
157.flavorText: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

158.name: Dreepy
158.attacksText: {P} → Petty Grudge : 10 {R}{P} → Bite : 40
158.flavorText: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn't feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

159.name: Drakloak
159.evolves: Evolves from Dreepy and into Dragapult or Dragapult ex
159.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Recon Directive Once during your turn, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck. {R}{P} → Dragon Headbutt : 70
159.flavorText: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they're all grown up.

160.name: Dragapult ex
160.attacksText: {C} → Jet Headbutt : 70 {R}{P} → Phantom Dive : 200 Put 6 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

161.name: Team Rocket's Meowth
161.evolves: Evolves into Team Rocket's Persian ex
161.attacksText: {C} → Paw-cket Pilfer Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck. {C}{C} → Fury Swipes : 20× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
161.flavorText: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

162.name: Team Rocket's Kangaskhan ex
162.attacksText: {C}{C} → Comet Punch : 30× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads. {C}{C}{C} → Wicked Impact : 120+ If you played a Supporter card that has “Team Rocket” in its name from your hand during this turn, this attack does 100 more damage. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

163.name: Larry's Dunsparce
163.attacksText: {C} → Rising Lunge : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
163.flavorText: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can float just slightly using its wings.

164.name: Larry's Dudunsparce ex
164.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Work Rush : 80× Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage for each heads. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

165.name: Skitty
165.evolves: Evolves into Delcatty or Delcatty ex
165.attacksText: {C} → Cat Kick : 20
165.flavorText: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

166.name: Delcatty
166.attacksText: {C} → Cat Kick : 40 {C}{C} → Energy Crush : 40× This attack does 40 damage for each Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.
166.flavorText: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

167.name: Zangoose ex
167.attacksText: {C} → Spike Draw : 20 Draw 2 cards. {C}{C}{C} → Wild Scissors : 180 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

168.name: Larry's Starly
168.attacksText: {C} → Minor Errand-Running Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C} → Glide : 10
168.flavorText: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

169.name: Larry's Staravia
169.evolves: Evolves from Larry's Starly and into Larry's Staraptor
169.attacksText: {C} → Flap : 20 {C}{C} → Razor Wing : 50
169.flavorText: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

170.name: Larry's Staraptor
170.attacksText: {C} → Facade : 60+ If this Pokémon is Burned or Poisoned, this attack does 100 more damage. {C}{C}{C} → Feathery Strike : 150 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack also does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
170.flavorText: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

171.name: Fan Rotom
171.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Fan Call Once during your first turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 {C} Pokémon with 100 HP or less, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Fan Call Ability during your turn. {C} → Assault Landing : 70 If there is no Stadium in play, this attack does nothing.
171.flavorText: There are several appliances that Rotom can inspirit, but the first one to be developed was the electric fan.

172.name: Mega Audino ex
172.attacksText: {C} → Kaleidowaltz Flip 3 coins. For each heads, search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C}{C} → Ear Force : 20+ This attack does 80 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. · The Mega-Evolved form of Audino

173.name: Larry's Rufflet
173.attacksText: {C}{C} → Peck the Wound : 20+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 80 more damage.
173.flavorText: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it's a carnivore at heart.

174.name: Larry's Braviary
174.attacksText: {C}{C} → Clutch : 50 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. {C}{C}{C} → Brave Bird : 120 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
174.flavorText: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

175.name: Larry's Komala
175.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Lethargic Charge Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may use this Ability. Attach an Energy card from your hand to your Active Larry's Pokémon. {C} → Dozing Draw This Pokémon is now Asleep. Draw 2 cards.
175.flavorText: A potent anesthetic can be made by diluting Komala's drool. This anesthetic was used for surgeries in the past.

176.name: Drampa
176.attacksText: {C}{C} → Gentle Slap : 50 {C}{C}{C} → Dragon Strike : 120 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Dragon Strike.
176.flavorText: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

177.name: Hop's Cramorant
177.attacksText: {C} → Fickle Spitting : 120 If your opponent doesn't have exactly 3 or 4 Prize cards remaining, this attack does nothing.
177.flavorText: Cramorant instinctively swallow everything whole. They're at their most formidable when they're struggling to swallow overly large prey.

178.name: Terapagos
178.attacksText: {C} → Prism Charge Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards of different types and attach them to your Tera Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C}{C} → Hard Tackle : 100
178.flavorText: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move's energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

218.name: Erika's Tangela
218.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Gathering of Blossoms Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for an Erika's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {G}{C} → Bind : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
218.flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

219.name: Beautifly
219.attacksText: {G} → Stun Spore : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {G} → Energy Straw : 80× Your opponent reveals their hand, and this attack does 80 damage for each Energy card you find there.
219.flavorText: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.

220.name: Dustox

220.flavorText: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

221.name: Budew
221.attacksText: {@} → Itchy Pollen : 10 During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.
221.flavorText: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison's toxicity is increased.

222.name: Ethan's Magcargo
222.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Melt Away If this Pokémon has no Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost. {R}{R}{R} → Lava Burst : 70× Discard up to 5 {R} Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 70 damage for each card you discarded in this way.
222.flavorText: This Pokémon lives near the craters of volcanoes. It stores fire energy in its shell of cooled and hardened magma.

223.name: Numel
223.evolves: Evolves into Camerupt or Mega Camerupt ex
223.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Incandescent Body If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , the Attacking Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{C} → Combustion : 20
223.flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

224.name: Salazzle
224.attacksText: {C}{C} → Sudden Scorching Your opponent discards a card from their hand. If this Pokémon evolved from Salandit during this turn, your opponent discards 2 more cards. {R}{C}{C} → Flamethrower : 130 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
224.flavorText: When two Salazzle meet, they will use their pheromone gas to fight over the males in each other's group.

225.name: Scorbunny
225.attacksText: {C} → Quick Attack : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.
225.flavorText: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny's footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

226.name: Psyduck
226.evolves: Evolves into Golduck or Dark Golduck
226.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Damp Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) lose any Ability that requires the Pokémon using it to Knock Out itself. {C}{C} → Ram : 20
226.flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

227.name: Snorunt
227.evolves: Evolves into Froslass , Glalie , Mega Froslass ex , or Froslass ex

228.name: Weavile
228.attacksText: {W} → Slash : 40 {W}{W} → Hail Claw : 70 Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
228.flavorText: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

229.name: Heliolisk

Search your deck for up to 2 Basic {L} Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {L}{C}{C} → Powerful Bolt : 70× Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.
229.flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

230.name: Vikavolt
230.attacksText: {L} → Volt Switch : 90 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched {L} Pokémon. {L}{L}{C}{C} → Sparking Strike : 240
230.flavorText: When carrying a Charjabug, Vikavolt can receive electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.

231.name: Iono's Wattrel
231.attacksText: {L} → Quick Attack : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
231.flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

232.name: Marill
232.evolves: Evolves into Azumarill , Light Azumarill , or Azumarill ex
232.attacksText: {C} → Hide Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon. {P}{C} → Flop : 20
232.flavorText: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it's fine even in rivers with strong currents.

233.name: Misdreavus
233.evolves: Evolves into Mismagius or Mismagius ex
233.attacksText: {P} → Ascension Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
233.flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

234.name: Banette
234.attacksText: {P} → Cursed Words Your opponent chooses 3 cards from their hand and shuffles those cards into their deck. {P}{C} → Spooky Shot : 70
234.flavorText: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

235.name: Togekiss
235.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Wonder Kiss When your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, take 1 more Prize card. The effect of Wonder Kiss doesn't stack. {C}{C}{C} → Speed Wing : 140
235.flavorText: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they've hardly been seen at all.

236.name: Slurpuff
236.flavorText: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

237.name: Hop's Trevenant
237.attacksText: {C} → Horrifying Revenge : 30+ If any of your Hop's Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 100 more damage. {P}{C}{C} → Corner : 90 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
237.flavorText: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It's kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

238.name: Team Rocket's Mimikyu
238.attacksText: {P}{C} → Gemstone Mimicry Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Tera Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.
238.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

239.name: Team Rocket's Dugtrio
239.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Holes Whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon moves to the Bench during their turn, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. {F}{C} → Mud Shot : 50
239.flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

240.name: Hitmontop
240.attacksText: {C} → Spin and Draw Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. {F}{C} → Low Kick : 50
240.flavorText: It spins on its horn while dealing out elegant kicks. Its horn grows continuously through its lifetime.

241.name: Medicham
241.attacksText: {F} → Seventh Kick : 150 If you don't have exactly 7 cards in your hand, this attack does nothing.
241.flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's movements.

242.name: Carbink
242.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Double Type As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is {F} and {P} type. {F}{F}{C} → Counter Jewel : 70+ If your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 100 more damage.
242.flavorText: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it releases energy from the stone in its head.

243.name: Mightyena
243.attacksText: {D}{C} → Kick Away : 50 Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.) {D}{D}{C} → Sharp Fang : 130
243.flavorText: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

244.name: Cynthia's Spiritomb
244.attacksText: {C} → Raging Curse : 10× This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Cynthia's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.
244.flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

245.name: Galarian Obstagoon
245.attacksText: {D}{C} → Scarring Shout : 70× This attack does 70 damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon. {D}{C}{C} → Punk Smash : 160 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
245.flavorText: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

246.name: Mawile
246.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {M}{C}{C} → Bite : 90
246.flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

247.name: Dreepy

082.flavorText: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

083.name: Buneary
083.evolves: Evolves into Lopunny or Mega Lopunny ex
083.attacksText: {C} → Run Around Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {C}{C} → Kick : 20
083.flavorText: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

084.name: Mega Lopunny ex
084.attacksText: {C} → Gale Thrust : 60+ If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 170 more damage. {C}{C} → Spiky Hopper : 160 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. · The Mega-Evolved form of Lopunny

085.attacksText: Prevent all damage counters from being placed on Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) by effects of attacks and Abilities from the opponent's Pokémon. (Damage from attacks is still taken.) · Stadium rule: You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

086.attacksText: You can use this card only if you discard a Basic {R} Energy card from your hand. Discard a Pokémon Tool or Special Energy card from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon, or discard a Stadium in play. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

087.attacksText: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, a Stage 1 Pokémon, and a Stage 2 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

088.attacksText: Confused Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) don't recover from that Special Condition when they evolve or devolve. · Stadium rule: You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

089.attacksText: Search your deck for up to 7 Basic {R} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

090.attacksText: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck and put a {D} Pokémon you find there onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards and put them on the bottom of your deck. You can't use this card during your first turn. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

091.attacksText: Heal 80 damage from your Active Pokémon that has 3 or more Energy attached. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

092.attacksText: If the {D} Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , place 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. · Pokémon Tool rule: You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

094.name: Wondrous Patch
094.attacksText: Attach a Basic {P} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched {P} Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

095.name: Ludicolo
095.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Excited Heal Once during your turn, if you have any {G} Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, you may use this Ability. Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. {G}{C} → Lunge Out : 120
095.flavorText: There are structures throughout its whole body that produce energy when hit by sound waves with a cheerful rhythm.

096.name: Nymble
096.attacksText: {G} → Flail Around : 10× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
096.flavorText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

097.name: Dewgong
097.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Thick Fat This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's {R} or {W} Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{C} → Slam : 70× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.
097.flavorText: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's colder.

098.name: Piplup
098.attacksText: {C} → Call for Support Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Tackle : 20
098.flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

099.name: Yamper
099.attacksText: {L}{C} → Play Rough : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
099.flavorText: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

100.name: Mega Latias ex
100.attacksText: {C} → Strafe : 40 You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {R}{P}{C} → Illusory Impulse : 300 Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. · The Mega-Evolved form of Latias

101.name: Latios
101.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Lustrous Assist Once during your turn, when your Mega Latias ex moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Move any amount of Energy from your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon. {W}{P}{C} → Dragon Claw : 130
101.flavorText: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

102.name: Spearow
102.attacksText: {C} → Pluck : 10 Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
102.flavorText: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

103.name: Fearow
103.attacksText: {C} → Repeating Drill : 30× Flip 5 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.
103.flavorText: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

106.flavorText: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

109.name: Yungoos
109.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {C}{C} → Gnaw : 20
