178.name: Mega Gardevoir ex
178.attacksText: {P} → Overflowing Wishes For each of your Benched Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic {P} Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {P} → Mega Symphonia : 50× This attack does 50 damage for each {P} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon. · The Mega-Evolved form of Gardevoir

179.name: Mega Lucario ex
179.attacksText: {F} → Aura Jab : 130 Attach up to 3 Basic {F} Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. {F}{F} → Mega Brave : 270 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Mega Brave. · The Mega-Evolved form of Lucario

180.name: Mega Absol ex
180.attacksText: {D}{C} → Terminal Period If your opponent's Active Pokémon has exactly 6 damage counters on it, that Pokémon is Knocked Out. {D}{D}{C} → Claw of Darkness : 200 Your opponent reveals their hand, and you discard a card you find there. · The Mega-Evolved form of Absol

181.name: Mega Latias ex
181.attacksText: {C} → Strafe : 40 You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {R}{P}{C} → Illusory Impulse : 300 Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. · The Mega-Evolved form of Latias

182.name: Mega Kangaskhan ex
182.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Run Errand Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Draw 2 cards. You can't use more than 1 Run Errand Ability each turn. {C}{C}{C} → Rapid-Fire Combo : 200+ Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads. · The Mega-Evolved form of Kangaskhan

183.name: Acerola's Mischief
183.attacksText: You can use this card only if your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining. Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play. During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to that Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon ex. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

184.name: Lillie's Determination
184.attacksText: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. If you have exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

185.name: Lt. Surge's Bargain
185.attacksText: Ask your opponent if each player may take a Prize card. If yes, each player takes a Prize card. If no, you draw 4 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

186.name: Wally's Compassion
186.attacksText: Heal all damage from 1 of your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex. If you healed any damage in this way, put all Energy attached to that Pokémon into your hand. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

187.name: Mega Gardevoir ex
187.attacksText: {P} → Overflowing Wishes For each of your Benched Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic {P} Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {P} → Mega Symphonia : 50× This attack does 50 damage for each {P} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon. · The Mega-Evolved form of Gardevoir

188.name: Mega Lucario ex
188.attacksText: {F} → Aura Jab : 130 Attach up to 3 Basic {F} Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. {F}{F} → Mega Brave : 270 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Mega Brave. · The Mega-Evolved form of Lucario

001.name: Bulbasaur
001.evolves: Evolves into Ivysaur or Dark Ivysaur
001.attacksText: {G} → Bind Down : 10 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
001.flavorText: For some time after its birth, it uses the nutrients that are packed into the seed on its back in order to grow.

002.name: Ivysaur
002.evolves: Evolves from Bulbasaur and into Venusaur , Venusaur ex , or Mega Venusaur ex
002.attacksText: {G}{G} → Razor Leaf : 60
002.flavorText: The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more strength wells up within it, allowing the bud on its back to grow larger.

003.name: Mega Venusaur ex
003.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Solar Transfer As often as you like during your turn, you may use this Ability. Move a Basic {G} Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. {G}{G}{G}{G} → Jungle Dump : 240 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. · The Mega-Evolved form of Venusaur

004.name: Exeggcute
004.evolves: Evolves into Exeggutor , Alolan Exeggutor , […] Alolan Exeggutor ex , Alolan Exeggutor- GX
004.attacksText: {C} → Jam-Packed Search your deck for a Basic {G} Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
004.flavorText: If you touch one of Exeggcute's heads, mistaking it for an egg, the other heads will quickly gather and attack you in a swarm.

005.name: Exeggutor
005.attacksText: {G} → Guard Press : 30 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C}{C} → Stomping Wood : 60+ This attack does 30 more damage for each {G} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
005.flavorText: It is called the Walking Jungle. Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.

006.name: Tangela
006.attacksText: {G} → Poison Powder Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. {G}{C}{C} → Hook : 30
006.flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

007.name: Tangrowth
007.attacksText: {G}{C} → Absorb : 30 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. {G}{G}{C}{C} → Pumped-Up Whip : 120+ If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra Energy attached (in addition to this attack's cost) , this attack does 140 more damage.
007.flavorText: Vine growth is accelerated for Tangrowth living in warm climates. If the vines grow long, Tangrowth shortens them by tearing parts of them off.

008.name: Chikorita
008.attacksText: {G} → Razor Leaf : 20
008.flavorText: It loves to bask in the sunlight. It uses the leaf on its head to seek out warm places.

009.name: Bayleef
009.evolves: Evolves from Chikorita and into Meganium , Mega Meganium ex , or Meganium ex
009.attacksText: {G}{C} → Push Down : 50 Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
009.flavorText: The spicy scent that wafts from around Bayleef's neck somehow makes those who smell it want to fight.

010.name: Meganium
010.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Wild Growth Each Basic {G} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon provides {G}{G} Energy. The effect of Wild Growth doesn't stack. {G}{G}{C}{C} → Solar Beam : 140
010.flavorText: Anyone who stands beside it becomes refreshed, just as if they were soaking in the soothing atmosphere of a forest.

011.name: Shuckle
011.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Fermented Juice Once during your turn, if this Pokémon has any {G} Energy attached, you may use this Ability. Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. {G}{C} → Rollout : 30
011.flavorText: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

012.name: Celebi
012.attacksText: {G} → Traverse Time Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of {G} Pokémon and Stadium cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {G} → Solar Cutter : 30
012.flavorText: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

013.name: Seedot
013.attacksText: {C} → Nap Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon. {G}{C} → Seed Bomb : 20
013.flavorText: To expand its habitat, it pretends to be a nut so that bird Pokémon will pick it up and carry it far away.

014.name: Nuzleaf
014.evolves: Evolves from Seedot and into Shiftry
014.attacksText: {G} → Pound : 30 {G}{C} → Low Kick : 50
014.flavorText: It leads a quiet life deep in the forest. If anything wanders into its territory, Nuzleaf will warn the intruder by sounding its grass flute.

015.name: Shiftry
015.attacksText: {G} → Reversing Gust Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Shuffle that Pokémon and all attached cards into their deck. {G}{C} → Perplex : 100 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
015.flavorText: It is said that when Shiftry flaps its leafy fans atop ancient trees, chilly winds blow and the season rolls into winter.

016.name: Nincada
016.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 20
016.flavorText: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

017.name: Ninjask
017.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Cast-Off Shell Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Shedinja and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {G}{C} → U-turn : 90 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
017.flavorText: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

018.name: Dhelmise
018.attacksText: {G}{C} → Earthen Power : 30+ If you have a Stadium in play, this attack does 50 more damage.
018.flavorText: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

019.name: Vulpix
019.attacksText: {C} → Stampede : 10 {R}{C} → Combustion : 20
019.flavorText: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

020.name: Ninetales
020.attacksText: {C} → Supernatural Shapeshifter Discard the top card of your deck, and if that card is a Supporter card, use the effect of that card as the effect of this attack. {R}{C} → Combustion : 60
020.flavorText: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

021.name: Numel
021.evolves: Evolves into Camerupt or Mega Camerupt ex
021.attacksText: {R} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {R}{C}{C} → Flare : 30
021.flavorText: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

022.name: Mega Camerupt ex
022.attacksText: {R} → Roasting Heat : 80+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Burned, this attack does 160 more damage. {R}{C}{C}{C} → Volcanic Meteor : 280 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. · The Mega-Evolved form of Camerupt

023.name: Litleo
023.attacksText: {R}{C} → Flare : 30
023.flavorText: When Litleo are young, female Pyroar will teach them how to hunt. Once the Litleo mature, they will leave the pride and set out on their own.

024.name: Pyroar
024.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Intimidating Fang As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {R}{C}{C} → Searing Flame : 70 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
024.flavorText: The mane of a male Pyroar heats up to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit during battle. Merely approaching it will cause severe burns.

025.name: Volcanion
025.attacksText: {R} → Singe Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{R}{C} → Backfire : 130 Put 2 {R} Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.
025.flavorText: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

026.name: Scorbunny
026.attacksText: {C} → Wild Kick : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
026.flavorText: Once its body has heated up, Scorbunny can use the full extent of its power. That's why it does warm-up exercises.

027.name: Raboot
027.evolves: Evolves from Scorbunny and into Cinderace or Cinderace ex
027.attacksText: {C} → Jumping Kick This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
027.flavorText: Thanks to its soft and fluffy fur, Raboot can easily heat up its fire energy and produce flames with more power.

028.name: Cinderace
028.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Explosiveness If this Pokémon is in your hand when you are setting up to play, you may put it face down in the Active Spot. {C} → Turbo Flare : 50 Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
028.flavorText: Although Cinderace loses its cool easily, it will battle flawlessly for a Trainer it trusts.

029.name: Sizzlipede
029.attacksText: {R} → Ram : 10 {R}{R}{C} → Combustion : 50
029.flavorText: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

030.name: Centiskorch
030.attacksText: {C}{C} → Coiling Crush : 50 Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {R}{R}{C}{C} → Heat Crawler : 140
030.flavorText: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

031.name: Chi-Yu
031.attacksText: {R} → Scorching Earth : 40 If your opponent has a Stadium in play, discard it. If you do, your opponent can't play any Stadium cards from their hand during their next turn.
031.flavorText: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

032.name: Mantine
032.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {W}{C} → Waterfall : 50
032.flavorText: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if Remoraid attach to it to scavenge for its leftovers.

033.name: Corphish
033.attacksText: {C} → Vise Grip : 10 {C}{C} → Take Down : 30 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
033.flavorText: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy creature that will quickly proliferate, even in polluted streams.

034.name: Kyogre
034.attacksText: {W} → Riptide : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each Basic {W} Energy card in your discard pile. Then, shuffle those cards into your deck. {W}{W}{C} → Swirling Waves : 130 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.
034.flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

035.name: Snover
035.evolves: Evolves into Abomasnow or Mega Abomasnow ex
035.attacksText: {W} → Beat : 10 {W}{W} → Icy Snow : 30
035.flavorText: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

036.name: Mega Abomasnow ex
036.attacksText: {W}{W} → Hammer-lanche : 100× Discard the top 6 cards of your deck, and this attack does 100 damage for each Basic {W} Energy card that you discarded in this way. {W}{W}{W} → Frost Barrier : 200 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . · The Mega-Evolved form of Abomasnow

037.name: Clauncher
037.attacksText: {W}{W} → Wave Splash : 50
037.flavorText: This Pokémon launches water by detonating gas inside its right claw. It snipes flying Pokémon.

038.name: Clawitzer
038.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Fall Back to Reload Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from the Active Spot to your Bench, you may use this Ability. Attach up to 2 Basic {W} Energy cards from your hand to this Pokémon. {W}{W}{W} → Aqua Launcher : 210 Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
038.flavorText: Clawitzer can move through the water at a speed of 60 knots by using gas inside its body to expel water from the back of its claw.

039.name: Sobble
039.evolves: Evolves into Drizzile
039.attacksText: {W} → Surprise Attack : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
039.flavorText: It gets berries to eat by shooting them down with bullets of water it spurts from its mouth. Its aim is perfect.

040.name: Drizzile
040.evolves: Evolves from Sobble and into Inteleon
040.attacksText: {W} → Double Stab : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.
040.flavorText: It extends its long, slimy tongue at blinding speeds and finishes off its prey with great skill.

041.name: Inteleon
041.evolves: Evolves from Drizzile
041.attacksText: {W} → Bring Down Choose a Pokémon in play (yours or your opponent's) that has the least HP remaining, except for this Pokémon, and it is Knocked Out. {W} → Water Shot : 110 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
041.flavorText: It uses special lenses in its eyes to sense things about its opponents—like their body heat—then attacks once it identifies a weak spot.

042.name: Snom
042.attacksText: {W} → Hide Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
042.flavorText: It eats snow that has accumulated on the ground. It prefers soft, freshly fallen snow, so it will eat its way up a mountain, aiming for the peak.

043.name: Frosmoth
043.attacksText: {W} → Chilling Wings This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
043.flavorText: Frosmoth senses air currents with its antennae. It sends its scales drifting on frigid air, making them fall like snow.

044.name: Eiscue
044.attacksText: {C} → Freezing Headbutt : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{C}{C} → Tackle : 90
044.flavorText: On hot days, these Pokémon press their ice cube heads together and pass the time cooling each other down.

045.name: Magnemite
045.attacksText: {L} → Beam : 10
045.flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

046.name: Magneton
046.evolves: Evolves from Magnemite and into Magnezone
046.attacksText: {L} → Thunder Shock : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
046.flavorText: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

047.name: Magnezone
047.evolves: Evolves from Magneton
047.attacksText: {L} → Upper Spark : 50+ If this Pokémon evolved from Magneton during this turn, this attack does 120 more damage. {L}{L} → Flashing Bolt : 160 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Flashing Bolt.
047.flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

048.name: Raikou
048.attacksText: {L}{L} → Electro Fall : 30+ If you have at least 4 {L} Energy in play, this attack does 90 more damage.
048.flavorText: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

049.name: Electrike
049.evolves: Evolves into Manectric or Mega Manectric ex
049.attacksText: {L} → Thunder Jolt : 30 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
049.flavorText: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

050.name: Mega Manectric ex
050.attacksText: {L}{L} → Flash Ray : 120 During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon. {L}{L}{L} → Riotous Blasting : 200+ You may discard all Energy from this Pokémon and have this attack do 130 more damage. · The Mega-Evolved form of Manectric

051.name: Pachirisu
051.attacksText: {L} → Electrified Incisors : 10 During your opponent's next turn, whenever they attach an Energy card from their hand to the Defending Pokémon, place 8 damage counters on that Pokémon.
051.flavorText: It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

052.name: Helioptile
052.attacksText: {C} → Double Scratch : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
052.flavorText: The sun powers this Pokémon's electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

053.name: Heliolisk
053.evolves: Evolves from Helioptile
053.attacksText: {C} → Dazzle Blast : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {L}{C} → Head Bolt : 70
053.flavorText: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

054.name: Abra
054.attacksText: {P} → Teleportation Attack : 10 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
054.flavorText: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

055.name: Kadabra
055.evolves: Evolves from Abra and into Alakazam
055.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Psychic Draw Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Draw 2 cards. {P} → Super Psy Bolt : 30
055.flavorText: This Pokémon's telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.

056.name: Alakazam
056.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Psychic Draw Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Draw 3 cards. {P} → Powerful Hand Place 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each card in your hand.
056.flavorText: Alakazam wields potent psychic powers. It's said that this Pokémon used these powers to create the spoons it holds.

057.name: Jynx
057.attacksText: {P}{P} → Psychic : 30+ This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
057.flavorText: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

058.name: Ralts
058.evolves: Evolves into Kirlia
058.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {P} → Headbutt : 10
058.flavorText: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

059.name: Kirlia
059.evolves: Evolves from Ralts and into Gardevoir , Gallade , […] Gardevoir ex , Mega Gardevoir ex
059.attacksText: {P} → Call Sign Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {P} → Psyshot : 30
059.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

060.name: Mega Gardevoir ex
060.attacksText: {P} → Overflowing Wishes For each of your Benched Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic {P} Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {P} → Mega Symphonia : 50× This attack does 50 damage for each {P} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon. · The Mega-Evolved form of Gardevoir

061.name: Shedinja
061.evolves: Evolves from Nincada
061.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Fragile Husk If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ex, your opponent can't take any Prize cards for it. {P} → Damage Beat : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
061.flavorText: A strange Pokémon–it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.

062.name: Spoink
062.evolves: Evolves into Grumpig
062.attacksText: {P} → Triple Spin : 10× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
062.flavorText: Spoink will die if it stops bouncing. The pearl on its head amplifies its psychic powers.

063.name: Grumpig
063.evolves: Evolves from Spoink
063.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Energized Steps Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and attach any number of Basic Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. {P}{C}{C} → Psychic Sphere : 60
063.flavorText: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

064.name: Xerneas
064.evolves: Evolves into Xerneas BREAK
064.attacksText: {P} → Geo Gate Search your deck for up to 3 Basic {P} Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {P}{P}{C} → Bright Horns : 120 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Bright Horns.
064.flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

065.name: Greavard
065.evolves: Evolves into Houndstone or Houndstone ex
065.attacksText: {P} → Stampede : 10 {P}{C} → Take Down : 40 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
065.flavorText: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

066.name: Houndstone
066.attacksText: {P} → Horrifying Bite : 30 Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals those cards and shuffles them into their deck. {P}{P}{C} → Hammer In : 130
066.flavorText: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

067.name: Gimmighoul
067.evolves: Evolves into Gholdengo ex or Gholdengo
067.attacksText: {C} → Slap : 10
067.flavorText: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

068.name: Sandshrew
068.attacksText: {C} → Dig Claws : 10 {F}{C} → Mud-Slap : 20
068.flavorText: It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger, it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.

069.name: Sandslash
069.attacksText: {C}{C} → Sand Attack : 50 During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen. {F}{C}{C} → Mud Shot : 100
069.flavorText: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.

070.name: Onix
070.evolves: Evolves into Steelix
070.attacksText: {C}{C} → Bind : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Strength : 100
070.flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

071.name: Tyrogue
071.attacksText: {@} → Pow-Pow Punching : 10+ Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.
071.flavorText: This earnest Pokémon battles all sorts of opponents, searching for the fighting style that suits it best.

072.name: Makuhita
072.evolves: Evolves into Hariyama or Hariyama ex
072.attacksText: {F} → Corkscrew Punch : 10 {F}{F} → Confront : 30
072.flavorText: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

073.name: Hariyama
073.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Heave-Ho Catcher Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. {F}{F}{F} → Wild Press : 210 This Pokémon also does 70 damage to itself.
073.flavorText: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

074.name: Lunatone
074.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Lunar Cycle Once during your turn, if you have Solrock in play, you may discard a Basic {F} Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Lunar Cycle Ability each turn. {F}{F} → Power Gem : 50
074.flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

075.name: Solrock
075.attacksText: {F} → Cosmic Beam : 70 If you don't have Lunatone on your Bench, this attack does nothing. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
075.flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

076.name: Riolu
076.evolves: Evolves into Lucario , Mega Lucario ex , Lucario- GX , or Lucario ex
076.attacksText: {F} → Accelerating Stab : 30 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Accelerating Stab.
076.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

077.attacksText: {F} → Aura Jab : 130 Attach up to 3 Basic {F} Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. {F}{F} → Mega Brave : 270 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Mega Brave. · The Mega-Evolved form of Lucario

078.name: Croagunk
078.attacksText: {F} → Smack : 20
078.flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

079.name: Toxicroak
079.attacksText: {F} → Reckless Charge : 70 This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.
079.flavorText: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

080.name: Marshadow
080.attacksText: {F}{F} → Shadowy Side Kick : 60 If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
080.flavorText: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.

081.name: Stonjourner
081.attacksText: {F} → Stony Kick : 20 This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{F}{C} → Boundless Power : 140 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.
081.flavorText: The elemental composition of the rocks that form its body were found to match the bedrock of a land far away from this Pokémon's habitat.

082.name: Nacli
082.attacksText: {C} → Ram : 10
082.flavorText: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

083.name: Naclstack
083.evolves: Evolves from Nacli and into Garganacl or Garganacl ex
083.attacksText: {F}{C} → Rock Hurl : 50 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
083.flavorText: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

084.name: Garganacl
084.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Powerful a-Salt Attacks used by your {F} Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{F}{C} → Hammer In : 130
084.flavorText: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

085.name: Crawdaunt
085.attacksText: {C} → Vise Grip : 30 {D}{D}{C} → Cutting Riposte : 130 If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack can be used for {D}.
085.flavorText: Loving to battle, this Pokémon pinches all Pokémon that enter its territory with its pincers and throws them out.

086.name: Mega Absol ex
086.attacksText: {D}{C} → Terminal Period If your opponent's Active Pokémon has exactly 6 damage counters on it, that Pokémon is Knocked Out. {D}{D}{C} → Claw of Darkness : 200 Your opponent reveals their hand, and you discard a card you find there. · The Mega-Evolved form of Absol

087.name: Spiritomb
087.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Spiteful Swirl If your Active {D} Pokémon is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if your Active {D} Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 1 damage counter on the Attacking Pokémon. {D} → Mountain Breaker : 10 Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.
087.flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

088.name: Yveltal
088.attacksText: {D} → Clutch : 20 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. {D}{D}{C} → Dark Feather : 110
088.flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

089.name: Nickit
089.attacksText: {D} → Darkness Fang : 20
089.flavorText: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

090.name: Thievul
090.attacksText: {C} → Greedy Hunt : 20 You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. {D}{C} → Pitch-Black Fangs : 60
090.flavorText: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

091.name: Shroodle
091.attacksText: {D}{C} → Poison Jab : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
091.flavorText: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

092.name: Grafaiai
092.attacksText: {D}{C} → Miraculous Paint : 90 Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Special Condition. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.
092.flavorText: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

093.name: Steelix
093.attacksText: {C}{C} → Welcoming Tail : 40+ If you have exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, this attack does 200 more damage. {M}{M}{C}{C} → Skull Bash : 140
093.flavorText: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

094.name: Mega Mawile ex
094.attacksText: {M}{M} → Gobble Down : 80× This attack does 80 damage for each Prize card you have taken. {M}{M}{C} → Huge Bite : 260 If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack's base damage is 30. · The Mega-Evolved form of Mawile

095.name: Dialga
095.attacksText: {M} → Beam : 30 {M}{M}{C} → Chrono Burst : 80+ You may shuffle all Energy attached to this Pokémon into your deck and have this attack do 80 more damage.
095.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

096.name: Tinkatink
096.attacksText: {M} → Beat : 20
096.flavorText: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

097.name: Tinkatuff
097.evolves: Evolves from Tinkatink and into Tinkaton
097.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Haphazard Hammer Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {M} → Light Punch : 30
097.flavorText: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

098.name: Tinkaton
098.attacksText: {M} → Windup Swing : 240- This attack does 60 less damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
098.flavorText: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

099.name: Gholdengo
099.attacksText: {C} → All-You-Can-Grab Flip a coin until you get tails. Search your deck for a number of cards up to the number of heads and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {M}{C}{C} → Speed Attack : 100
099.flavorText: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

001.name: Meganium
001.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Wild Growth Each Basic {G} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon provides {G}{G} Energy. The effect of Wild Growth doesn't stack. {G}{G}{C}{C} → Solar Beam : 140
001.flavorText: Anyone who stands beside it becomes refreshed, just as if they were soaking in the soothing atmosphere of a forest.

002.name: Inteleon
002.attacksText: {W} → Bring Down Choose a Pokémon in play (yours or your opponent's) that has the least HP remaining, except for this Pokémon, and it is Knocked Out. {W} → Water Shot : 110 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
002.flavorText: It uses special lenses in its eyes to sense things about its opponents—like their body heat—then attacks once it identifies a weak spot.

003.name: Alakazam
003.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Psychic Draw Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Draw 3 cards. {P} → Powerful Hand Place 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each card in your hand.
003.flavorText: Alakazam wields potent psychic powers. It's said that this Pokémon used these powers to create the spoons it holds.

004.name: Lunatone
004.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Lunar Cycle Once during your turn, if you have Solrock in play, you may discard a Basic {F} Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Lunar Cycle Ability each turn. {F}{F} → Power Gem : 50
004.flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

005.name: Drifloon
005.attacksText: {P} → Pull Flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
005.flavorText: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

006.name: Drifblim
006.attacksText: {P} → Creepy Wind Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {P}{P} → Balloon Return : 110 Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.
006.flavorText: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

007.name: Psyduck
007.evolves: Evolves into Golduck or Dark Golduck
007.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Damp Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) lose any Ability that requires the Pokémon using it to Knock Out itself. {C}{C} → Ram : 20
007.flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

008.name: Golduck
008.evolves: Evolves from Psyduck and into Golduck BREAK
008.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Damp Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) lose any Ability that requires the Pokémon using it to Knock Out itself. {C}{C}{C} → Hydro Pump : 60+ This attack does 20 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
008.flavorText: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

009.name: Alakazam

026.name: Meloetta
026.attacksText: {P} → Soothing Melody Heal 120 damage from 1 of your Benched {P} Pokémon. {P}{C} → Magical Shot : 50
026.flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

027.name: Haunter
027.evolves: Evolves from Gastly and into Gengar , Mega Gengar ex , or Gengar ex
027.attacksText: {D} → Spooky Shot : 40
027.flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

012.attacksText: {F} → Aura Jab : 130 Attach up to 3 Basic {F} Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. {F}{F} → Mega Brave : 270 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Mega Brave. · The Mega-Evolved form of Lucario

014.attacksText: {R} → Infernal Slash : 220 Discard 4 Basic {R} Energy cards from your hand. If you can't discard 4 cards in this way, this attack does nothing.

015.name: Zacian
015.attacksText: {P}{C} → Limit Break : 50+ If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.
015.flavorText: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

016.name: Flygon
016.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sandy Flapping Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. You may also use this Ability if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon. Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck. {F}{F} → Cutting Wind : 130
016.flavorText: Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

017.name: Toxtricity
017.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sinister Surge Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Basic {D} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched {D} Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. {D}{D}{C} → Gentle Slap : 100
017.flavorText: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

018.name: Cottonee
018.evolves: Evolves into Whimsicott , Whimsicott ex , or Whimsicott- GX
018.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card.
018.flavorText: Pillows and beds stuffed with cotton exhaled by Cottonee are soft and puffy, light and airy—altogether top quality.

019.name: Whimsicott
019.attacksText: {C} → Healing Fluff Heal all damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {P} → U-turn : 50 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
019.flavorText: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

020.name: Sneasel
020.evolves: Evolves into Weavile or Weavile- GX
020.attacksText: {D} → Dig Claws : 10 {D}{D} → Scratch : 30
020.flavorText: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

021.name: Weavile
021.attacksText: {D}{D} → Retaliatory Claw : 20+ If this Pokémon's remaining HP is 50 or less, this attack does 170 more damage. {D}{D} → Cut : 60
021.flavorText: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

022.name: Charcadet
022.evolves: Evolves into Ceruledge , Armarouge , Armarouge ex , or Ceruledge ex
022.attacksText: {R} → Gather Strength Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {R} → Chop : 10

Attach a Basic {R} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched {R} Pokémon. {R}{R}{C} → Fire Wing : 110 · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

013.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Solar Transfer As often as you like during your turn, you may use this Ability. Move a Basic {G} Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. {G}{G}{G}{G} → Jungle Dump : 240 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. · The Mega-Evolved form of Venusaur

029.name: Mega Charizard X ex
029.attacksText: {R}{R} → Inferno X : 90× Discard any amount of {R} Energy from among your Pokémon, and this attack does 90 damage for each card you discarded in this way. · The Mega-Evolved form of Charizard X

031.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Shred : 70 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. {R}{L}{L}{C} → Rampaging Thunder : 250 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

033.attacksText: {F} → Aura Jab : 130 Attach up to 3 Basic {F} Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. {F}{F} → Mega Brave : 270 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Mega Brave. · The Mega-Evolved form of Lucario

037.name: Bulbasaur
037.evolves: Evolves into Ivysaur or Dark Ivysaur
037.attacksText: {G} → Leech Seed : 10 Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
037.flavorText: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

038.name: Charmander
038.evolves: Evolves into Charmeleon or Dark Charmeleon
038.attacksText: {R} → Ember : 30 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
038.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

039.name: Squirtle
039.evolves: Evolves into Wartortle or Dark Wartortle
039.attacksText: {W} → Bubble : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
039.flavorText: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

040.name: Turtwig
040.attacksText: {G}{G}{C} → Razor Leaf : 60
040.flavorText: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

041.name: Chimchar
041.evolves: Evolves into Monferno
041.attacksText: {C}{C} → Fury Swipes : 20× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
041.flavorText: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

042.name: Piplup
042.attacksText: {W} → Peck : 20
042.flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

043.name: Rowlet
043.attacksText: {C}{C} → Tackle : 20
043.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

044.name: Litten
044.attacksText: {R}{R} → Fire Fang : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
044.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

045.name: Popplio
045.attacksText: {W}{W} → Disarming Voice : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
045.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

064.name: Serperior
064.evolves: Evolves from Servine
064.attacksText: {G} → Regal Command : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play. {G}{G}{G} → Solar Coiling : 100+ If Rosa's Encouragement is in your discard pile, this attack does 150 more damage.
064.flavorText: An intimidating gaze and majestic appearance have caused this Pokémon to be known as the Lord of the Forest.

065.name: Barbaracle
065.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Stone Arms Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic {F} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your {F} Pokémon. {F}{F}{C} → Hammer In : 80
065.flavorText: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

066.name: Tyrantrum
066.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Tyrannically Gutsy If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, it gets +150 HP. {F}{C} → Wreak Havoc : 160 Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.
066.flavorText: This Pokémon behaved like a king 100 million years ago. Nothing could stop it.

067.name: Doublade
067.evolves: Evolves from Honedge and into Aegislash
067.attacksText: {C}{C} → Weaponized Swords : 60× Reveal any number of Honedge, Doublade, and Aegislash from your hand, and this attack does 60 damage for each card you revealed in this way.
067.flavorText: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords that cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

068.name: Makuhita
068.evolves: Evolves into Hariyama or Hariyama ex
068.attacksText: {F} → Corkscrew Punch : 10 {F}{F} → Confront : 30
068.flavorText: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

069.name: Chikorita
069.attacksText: {G} → Razor Leaf : 20
069.flavorText: It loves to bask in the sunlight. It uses the leaf on its head to seek out warm places.

070.name: Tyrunt
070.evolves: Evolves from Antique Jaw Fossil and into Tyrantrum
070.attacksText: {F}{C} → Get Angry : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
070.flavorText: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

100.name: Simisear
100.attacksText: {C}{C} → Gentle Slap : 70
100.flavorText: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

101.name: Litwick
101.attacksText: {R} → Brighten and Burn Look at the top card of your deck. You may discard that card.
101.flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

102.name: Lampent
102.evolves: Evolves from Litwick and into Chandelure
102.attacksText: {R} → Fire Blast : 50 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
102.flavorText: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

103.name: Chandelure
103.attacksText: {R} → Incendiary Pillar : 50+ If you have 10 or more Basic {R} Energy cards in your discard pile, this attack does 100 more damage. {R}{R} → Burn It All Up : 180 Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
103.flavorText: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

104.name: Heatmor
104.attacksText: {R} → Licking Catch Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of {R} Pokémon and Basic {R} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {R}{R} → Fire Claws : 60
104.flavorText: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.

105.name: Oshawott
105.attacksText: {W} → Tackle : 10 {W}{W} → Water Gun : 30
105.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

106.name: Dewott
106.evolves: Evolves from Oshawott and into Samurott or Hisuian Samurott
106.attacksText: {W} → Energized Shell : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.
106.flavorText: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

107.name: Samurott
107.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Torrential Whirlpool Once during your turn, you may switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.) {W} → Energized Slash : 30+ This attack does 50 more damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.
107.flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

108.name: Basculin
108.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 10 {W} → Bared Fangs : 50 If your opponent's Active Pokémon has no damage counters on it before this attack does damage, this attack does nothing.
108.flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

109.name: Ducklett
109.attacksText: {C} → Firefighting Discard a {R} Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {C}{C} → Wing Attack : 20
109.flavorText: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food–peat moss.

110.name: Swanna
110.attacksText: {C} → Flap : 30 {C}{C}{C} → Air Slash : 120 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
110.flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

111.name: Vanillite
111.attacksText: {C} → Beat : 10 {W}{C} → Ice Edge : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
111.flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

112.name: Vanillish
112.evolves: Evolves from Vanillite and into Vanilluxe
112.attacksText: {C}{C} → Ram : 30 {W}{C}{C} → Ice Beam : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
112.flavorText: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

113.name: Vanilluxe
113.attacksText: {C}{C} → Ram : 60 {W}{C}{C} → Double Freeze : 90× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads. If either of them is heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
113.flavorText: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

114.name: Blitzle
114.attacksText: {C} → Smash Kick : 10 {L}{C} → Zap Kick : 30
114.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

115.name: Zebstrika
115.attacksText: {C} → Smash Kick : 30 {L}{L}{C} → Electrobullet : 100 This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
115.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

116.name: Joltik
116.evolves: Evolves into Galvantula or Galvantula ex
116.attacksText: {L} → Surprise Attack : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
116.flavorText: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

117.name: Galvantula
117.attacksText: {L} → Discharge : 50× Discard all {L} Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.
117.flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

118.name: Stunfisk
118.attacksText: {C} → Muddy Bolt : 20+ If this Pokémon has any {F} Energy attached, this attack does 20 more damage. {L}{C} → Flop : 50
118.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

119.name: Woobat
119.attacksText: {C} → Heart Stamp : 10
119.flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

120.name: Swoobat
120.attacksText: {C} → Happy Return Put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand. {C}{C} → Gust : 50
120.flavorText: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

121.name: Sigilyph
121.attacksText: {C} → Reflect During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 40 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {P}{C}{C} → Telekinesis This attack does 70 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
121.flavorText: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

122.name: Yamask
122.attacksText: {P}{C} → Focused Wish : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
122.flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

123.name: Cofagrigus
123.attacksText: {P}{C} → Extended Damagriiigus Move all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {P}{C}{C} → Perplex : 60 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
123.flavorText: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

124.name: Gothita
124.attacksText: {P} → Super Psy Bolt : 20
124.flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

125.name: Gothorita
125.evolves: Evolves from Gothita and into Gothitelle
125.attacksText: {P} → Fortunate Eye Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back in any order. {P}{C} → Psyshot : 40
125.flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

126.name: Frillish
126.attacksText: {P} → Oceanic Gloom : 20 During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.
126.flavorText: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

127.name: Roggenrola
127.attacksText: {F} → Harden During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks if that damage is 40 or less. {F}{F} → Rolling Rocks : 30
127.flavorText: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

128.name: Boldore
128.evolves: Evolves from Roggenrola and into Gigalith
128.attacksText: {F} → Smack Down : 30+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon has {F} Resistance, this attack does 50 more damage. {F}{F}{F} → Power Gem : 90
128.flavorText: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

129.name: Gigalith
129.attacksText: {F} → Vengeful Cannon : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched {F} Pokémon. {F}{F}{F} → Heavy Impact : 160
129.flavorText: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

130.name: Sawk
130.attacksText: {F} → Elbow Strike : 30 {F} → Rising Chop : 90 If your opponent's Active Pokémon isn't a Pokémon ex, this attack does nothing. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
130.flavorText: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

131.name: Archen
131.evolves: Evolves from Antique Plume Fossil and into Archeops
131.attacksText: {F}{C} → Acrobatics : 30+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.
131.flavorText: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

132.name: Archeops
132.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Ancient Wing Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may devolve 1 of your opponent's evolved Pokémon by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand. {F}{C} → Rock Throw : 100
132.flavorText: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

133.name: Mienfoo
133.evolves: Evolves into Mienshao
133.attacksText: {F} → Kick : 20
133.flavorText: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

134.name: Mienshao
134.attacksText: {F} → Low Sweep : 40 {F}{F} → Smash Uppercut : 80 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
134.flavorText: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

135.name: Terrakion
135.attacksText: {F}{C} → Retaliate : 50+ If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 80 more damage. {F}{F}{C} → Land Crush : 100
135.flavorText: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

136.name: Purrloin
136.attacksText: {D} → Invite Evil Search your deck for up to 3 {D} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
136.flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

137.name: Liepard
137.attacksText: {D} → Knock Off : 50 Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.
137.flavorText: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

138.name: Scraggy
138.evolves: Evolves into Scrafty or Mega Scrafty ex
138.attacksText: {D} → Headbutt : 10 {D}{D} → Invade : 30
138.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

139.name: Scrafty
139.attacksText: {D}{D} → Ruffians Attack : 60× Flip a coin for each {D} Pokémon you have in play. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.
139.flavorText: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

140.name: Trubbish
140.attacksText: {D} → Drool : 10 {D}{C} → Sludge Bomb : 20
140.flavorText: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

141.name: Garbodor
141.attacksText: {D} → Suffocating Gas : 40 {D}{D}{C} → Gunk Shot : 120 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
141.flavorText: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

142.name: Zorua
142.attacksText: {D} → Take Down : 30 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
142.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

143.name: Zoroark
143.attacksText: {D} → Mind Jack : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Foul Play Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.
143.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

144.name: Vullaby
144.evolves: Evolves into Mandibuzz or Mandibuzz ex
144.attacksText: {C} → Playful Kick : 10
144.flavorText: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

145.name: Mandibuzz
145.evolves: Evolves from Vullaby and into Mandibuzz BREAK
145.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Look for Prey Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Your opponent reveals their hand, and you put a Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less that you find there onto your opponent's Bench. {C}{C}{C} → Cutting Wind : 90
145.flavorText: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

146.name: Deino
146.attacksText: {C}{C} → Body Slam : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {D}{C}{C} → Darkness Fang : 50
146.flavorText: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

147.name: Zweilous
147.evolves: Evolves from Deino and into Hydreigon ex
147.attacksText: {C}{C} → Double Hit : 40× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads. {D}{D}{C}{C} → Pitch-Black Fangs : 100
147.flavorText: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

148.name: Ferroseed
148.attacksText: {M} → Zzzt : 10 {M}{C}{C} → Metal Claw : 40
148.flavorText: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

149.name: Ferrothorn
149.attacksText: {M} → Power Whip This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {M}{C}{C}{C} → Metal Claw : 130
149.flavorText: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

150.name: Durant
150.attacksText: {C} → Bite Together : 20+ If Durant is on your Bench, this attack does 20 more damage. {M}{C} → Vise Grip : 50
150.flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

151.name: Druddigon
151.attacksText: {C} → Shred : 40 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. {R}{W}{C} → Ambush : 90+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.
151.flavorText: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

152.name: Patrat
152.attacksText: {C} → Procurement Search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C} → Gnaw : 10
152.flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

153.name: Watchog
153.attacksText: {C} → Focus Energy During your next turn, this Pokémon's Hyper Fang attack's base damage is 240. {C} → Hyper Fang : 80 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
153.flavorText: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

154.name: Lillipup
154.attacksText: {C} → Play Rough : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
154.flavorText: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

155.name: Herdier
155.evolves: Evolves from Lillipup and into Stoutland
155.attacksText: {C} → Roar Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.) {C}{C}{C} → Lunge Out : 70
155.flavorText: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

156.name: Stoutland
156.attacksText: {C}{C} → Odor Sleuth Flip 3 coins. Put a number of cards up to the number of heads from your discard pile into your hand. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Special Fang : 100+ If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 100 more damage.
156.flavorText: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

157.name: Whimsicott ex
157.attacksText: {G} → Energy Gift Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. {G} → Wondrous Cotton : 50× Your opponent reveals their hand. This attack does 50 damage for each Trainer card you find there. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

159.attacksText: {W}{C} → Gale Thrust : 30+ If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 90 more damage. {W}{C}{C} → Sonic Edge : 120 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

161.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Greedy Eater If your opponent's Basic Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack used by this Pokémon, take 1 more Prize card. {D}{D}{D}{C}{C} → Dark Bite : 200 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

162.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Bouffer This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C}{C} → Gold Breaker : 100+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 100 more damage. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

163.name: Harlequin
163.attacksText: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, flip a coin. If heads, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards. If tails, you draw 3 cards, and your opponent draws 5 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

164.name: Hilda
164.attacksText: Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

Then, shuffle your deck. {G} → Wondrous Cotton : 50× Your opponent reveals their hand. This attack does 50 damage for each Trainer card you find there. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

166.attacksText: {C}{C} → Slash : 50 {R}{R}{C} → Blazing Burst : 130+ This attack does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken. Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

167.name: Keldeo ex
167.attacksText: {W}{C} → Gale Thrust : 30+ If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 90 more damage. {W}{C}{C} → Sonic Edge : 120 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
