169.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Greedy Eater If your opponent's Basic Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack used by this Pokémon, take 1 more Prize card. {D}{D}{D}{C}{C} → Dark Bite : 200 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

170.name: Bouffalant ex
170.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Bouffer This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C}{C} → Gold Breaker : 100+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 100 more damage. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

171.name: Hilda
171.attacksText: Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

172.name: Victini
172.attacksText: {R}{R} → V-Force : 120 If you have 4 or fewer Benched Pokémon, this attack does nothing.
172.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

173.name: Reshiram ex
173.attacksText: {C}{C} → Slash : 50 {R}{R}{C} → Blazing Burst : 130+ This attack does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken. Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

001.name: Sewaddle
001.attacksText: {G} → Bug Bite : 20
001.flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

002.name: Swadloon
002.evolves: Evolves from Sewaddle and into Leavanny
002.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Healing Leaves Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon. {G}{C} → Bug Buzz : 40
002.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

003.name: Leavanny
003.attacksText: {C} → Healing Wrapping Heal 100 damage from each of your Basic Pokémon. {G}{C} → X-Scissor : 90+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.
003.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

004.name: Cottonee
004.evolves: Evolves into Whimsicott , Whimsicott ex , or Whimsicott- GX
004.attacksText: {G} → Absorb : 10 Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
004.flavorText: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

005.name: Whimsicott ex
005.attacksText: {G} → Energy Gift Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. {G} → Wondrous Cotton : 50× Your opponent reveals their hand. This attack does 50 damage for each Trainer card you find there. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

006.name: Deerling
006.attacksText: {C}{C} → Rear Kick : 30
006.flavorText: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

007.name: Sawsbuck
007.attacksText: {C}{C} → Push Down : 50 Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.) {G}{C}{C} → Solar Beam : 100
007.flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

008.name: Shelmet
008.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Stimulated Evolution If you have Karrablast in play, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it. {C} → Headbutt Bounce : 10
008.flavorText: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

009.name: Accelgor
009.attacksText: {G} → Acid Spray : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
009.flavorText: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

010.name: Virizion
010.attacksText: {G} → Giga Drain : 30 Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon. {G}{G}{C} → Emerald Blade : 130 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.
010.flavorText: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

011.name: Tepig
011.attacksText: {R} → Tackle : 10 {R}{R} → Rollout : 30
011.flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

012.name: Pignite
012.evolves: Evolves from Tepig and into Emboar or Mega Emboar ex
012.attacksText: {R} → Combustion : 30 {R}{R}{C} → Heat Crash : 80
012.flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

013.name: Emboar
013.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Inferno Fandango As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic {R} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon. {R}{R}{R}{C} → Heat Crash : 120
013.flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

014.name: Pansear
014.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {C}{C} → Scratch : 30
014.flavorText: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

015.name: Simisear
015.attacksText: {C}{C} → Gentle Slap : 70
015.flavorText: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

016.name: Litwick
016.attacksText: {R} → Brighten and Burn Look at the top card of your deck. You may discard that card.
016.flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

017.name: Lampent
017.evolves: Evolves from Litwick and into Chandelure
017.attacksText: {R} → Fire Blast : 50 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
017.flavorText: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

018.name: Chandelure
018.attacksText: {R} → Incendiary Pillar : 50+ If you have 10 or more Basic {R} Energy cards in your discard pile, this attack does 100 more damage. {R}{R} → Burn It All Up : 180 Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
018.flavorText: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

019.name: Heatmor
019.attacksText: {R} → Licking Catch Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of {R} Pokémon and Basic {R} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {R}{R} → Fire Claws : 60
019.flavorText: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.

020.name: Reshiram ex
020.attacksText: {C}{C} → Slash : 50 {R}{R}{C} → Blazing Burst : 130+ This attack does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken. Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

021.name: Oshawott
021.attacksText: {W} → Tackle : 10 {W}{W} → Water Gun : 30
021.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

022.name: Dewott
022.evolves: Evolves from Oshawott and into Samurott or Hisuian Samurott
022.attacksText: {W} → Energized Shell : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.
022.flavorText: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

023.name: Samurott
023.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Torrential Whirlpool Once during your turn, you may switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.) {W} → Energized Slash : 30+ This attack does 50 more damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.
023.flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

024.name: Basculin
024.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 10 {W} → Bared Fangs : 50 If your opponent's Active Pokémon has no damage counters on it before this attack does damage, this attack does nothing.
024.flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

025.name: Ducklett
025.attacksText: {C} → Firefighting Discard a {R} Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {C}{C} → Wing Attack : 20
025.flavorText: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food–peat moss.

026.name: Swanna
026.attacksText: {C} → Flap : 30 {C}{C}{C} → Air Slash : 120 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
026.flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

027.name: Vanillite
027.attacksText: {C} → Beat : 10 {W}{C} → Ice Edge : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
027.flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

028.name: Vanillish
028.evolves: Evolves from Vanillite and into Vanilluxe
028.attacksText: {C}{C} → Ram : 30 {W}{C}{C} → Ice Beam : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
028.flavorText: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

029.name: Vanilluxe
029.attacksText: {C}{C} → Ram : 60 {W}{C}{C} → Double Freeze : 90× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads. If either of them is heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
029.flavorText: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

030.name: Keldeo ex
030.attacksText: {W}{C} → Gale Thrust : 30+ If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 90 more damage. {W}{C}{C} → Sonic Edge : 120 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

031.name: Blitzle
031.attacksText: {C} → Smash Kick : 10 {L}{C} → Zap Kick : 30
031.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

032.name: Zebstrika
032.attacksText: {C} → Smash Kick : 30 {L}{L}{C} → Electrobullet : 100 This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
032.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

033.name: Joltik
033.evolves: Evolves into Galvantula or Galvantula ex
033.attacksText: {L} → Surprise Attack : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
033.flavorText: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

034.name: Galvantula
034.attacksText: {L} → Discharge : 50× Discard all {L} Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.
034.flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

035.name: Stunfisk
035.attacksText: {C} → Muddy Bolt : 20+ If this Pokémon has any {F} Energy attached, this attack does 20 more damage. {L}{C} → Flop : 50
035.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

036.name: Woobat
036.attacksText: {C} → Heart Stamp : 10
036.flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

037.name: Swoobat
037.attacksText: {C} → Happy Return Put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand. {C}{C} → Gust : 50
037.flavorText: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

038.name: Sigilyph
038.attacksText: {C} → Reflect During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 40 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {P}{C}{C} → Telekinesis This attack does 70 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
038.flavorText: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

039.name: Yamask
039.evolves: Evolves into Cofagrigus
039.attacksText: {P}{C} → Focused Wish : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
039.flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

040.name: Cofagrigus
040.attacksText: {P}{C} → Extended Damagriiigus Move all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {P}{C}{C} → Perplex : 60 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
040.flavorText: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

041.name: Gothita
041.evolves: Evolves into Gothorita
041.attacksText: {P} → Super Psy Bolt : 20
041.flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

042.name: Gothorita
042.evolves: Evolves from Gothita and into Gothitelle
042.attacksText: {P} → Fortunate Eye Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back in any order. {P}{C} → Psyshot : 40
042.flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

043.name: Gothitelle
043.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Distorted Future Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may have your opponent shuffle their hand into their deck and draw 3 cards. {P}{C} → Synchro Shot : 90+ If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 90 more damage.
043.flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

044.name: Frillish
044.attacksText: {P} → Oceanic Gloom : 20 During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.
044.flavorText: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

045.name: Jellicent ex
045.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Oceanic Curse As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play any Item cards or Pokémon Tool cards from their hand. {P}{C} → Power Press : 80+ If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra Energy attached (in addition to this attack's cost) , this attack does 80 more damage. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

046.name: Roggenrola
046.evolves: Evolves into Boldore
046.attacksText: {F} → Harden During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks if that damage is 40 or less. {F}{F} → Rolling Rocks : 30
046.flavorText: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

047.name: Boldore
047.evolves: Evolves from Roggenrola and into Gigalith
047.attacksText: {F} → Smack Down : 30+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon has {F} Resistance, this attack does 50 more damage. {F}{F}{F} → Power Gem : 90
047.flavorText: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

048.name: Gigalith
048.attacksText: {F} → Vengeful Cannon : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched {F} Pokémon. {F}{F}{F} → Heavy Impact : 160
048.flavorText: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

049.name: Sawk
049.attacksText: {F} → Elbow Strike : 30 {F} → Rising Chop : 90 If your opponent's Active Pokémon isn't a Pokémon ex, this attack does nothing. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
049.flavorText: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

050.name: Archen
050.evolves: Evolves from Antique Plume Fossil and into Archeops
050.attacksText: {F}{C} → Acrobatics : 30+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.
050.flavorText: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

051.name: Archeops
051.evolves: Evolves from Archen
051.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Ancient Wing Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may devolve 1 of your opponent's evolved Pokémon by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand. {F}{C} → Rock Throw : 100
051.flavorText: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

052.name: Mienfoo
052.attacksText: {F} → Kick : 20
052.flavorText: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

053.name: Mienshao
053.evolves: Evolves from Mienfoo
053.attacksText: {F} → Low Sweep : 40 {F}{F} → Smash Uppercut : 80 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
053.flavorText: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

054.name: Terrakion
054.attacksText: {F}{C} → Retaliate : 50+ If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 80 more damage. {F}{F}{C} → Land Crush : 100
054.flavorText: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

055.name: Purrloin
055.evolves: Evolves into Liepard
055.attacksText: {D} → Invite Evil Search your deck for up to 3 {D} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
055.flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

056.name: Liepard
056.attacksText: {D} → Knock Off : 50 Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.
056.flavorText: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

057.name: Scraggy
057.evolves: Evolves into Scrafty or Mega Scrafty ex
057.attacksText: {D} → Headbutt : 10 {D}{D} → Invade : 30
057.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

058.name: Scrafty
058.evolves: Evolves from Scraggy
058.attacksText: {D}{D} → Ruffians Attack : 60× Flip a coin for each {D} Pokémon you have in play. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.
058.flavorText: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

059.name: Trubbish
059.attacksText: {D} → Drool : 10 {D}{C} → Sludge Bomb : 20
059.flavorText: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

060.name: Garbodor
060.attacksText: {D} → Suffocating Gas : 40 {D}{D}{C} → Gunk Shot : 120 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
060.flavorText: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

061.name: Zorua
061.evolves: Evolves into Zoroark
061.attacksText: {D} → Take Down : 30 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
061.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

062.name: Zoroark
062.evolves: Evolves from Zorua
062.attacksText: {D} → Mind Jack : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Foul Play Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.
062.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

063.name: Vullaby
063.evolves: Evolves into Mandibuzz or Mandibuzz ex
063.attacksText: {C} → Playful Kick : 10
063.flavorText: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

064.name: Mandibuzz
064.evolves: Evolves from Vullaby and into Mandibuzz BREAK
064.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Look for Prey Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Your opponent reveals their hand, and you put a Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less that you find there onto your opponent's Bench. {C}{C}{C} → Cutting Wind : 90
064.flavorText: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

065.name: Deino
065.attacksText: {C}{C} → Body Slam : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {D}{C}{C} → Darkness Fang : 50
065.flavorText: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

066.name: Zweilous
066.evolves: Evolves from Deino and into Hydreigon ex
066.attacksText: {C}{C} → Double Hit : 40× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads. {D}{D}{C}{C} → Pitch-Black Fangs : 100
066.flavorText: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

067.name: Hydreigon ex
067.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Greedy Eater If your opponent's Basic Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack used by this Pokémon, take 1 more Prize card. {D}{D}{D}{C}{C} → Dark Bite : 200 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

068.name: Ferroseed
068.attacksText: {M} → Zzzt : 10 {M}{C}{C} → Metal Claw : 40
068.flavorText: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

069.name: Ferrothorn
069.attacksText: {M} → Power Whip This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {M}{C}{C}{C} → Metal Claw : 130
069.flavorText: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

070.name: Durant
070.attacksText: {C} → Bite Together : 20+ If Durant is on your Bench, this attack does 20 more damage. {M}{C} → Vise Grip : 50
070.flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

071.name: Druddigon
071.attacksText: {C} → Shred : 40 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. {R}{W}{C} → Ambush : 90+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.
071.flavorText: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

072.name: Patrat
072.attacksText: {C} → Procurement Search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C} → Gnaw : 10
072.flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

073.name: Watchog
073.attacksText: {C} → Focus Energy During your next turn, this Pokémon's Hyper Fang attack's base damage is 240. {C} → Hyper Fang : 80 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
073.flavorText: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

074.name: Lillipup
074.attacksText: {C} → Play Rough : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
074.flavorText: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

075.name: Herdier
075.evolves: Evolves from Lillipup and into Stoutland
075.attacksText: {C} → Roar Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.) {C}{C}{C} → Lunge Out : 70
075.flavorText: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

076.name: Stoutland
076.attacksText: {C}{C} → Odor Sleuth Flip 3 coins. Put a number of cards up to the number of heads from your discard pile into your hand. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Special Fang : 100+ If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 100 more damage.
076.flavorText: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

077.name: Bouffalant ex
077.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Bouffer This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C}{C} → Gold Breaker : 100+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 100 more damage. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

078.name: Tornadus
078.attacksText: {C} → Wrapped in Wind Attach a Basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Hurricane : 100 Move a Basic Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
078.flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

079.name: Antique Plume Fossil
079.attacksText: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic {C} Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play. Ability ⇢ Plume Protection As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

080.name: Brave Bangle
080.attacksText: If the Pokémon this card is attached to doesn't have a Rule Box, the attacks it uses do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.) · Pokémon Tool rule: You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

081.name: Cheren
081.attacksText: Draw 3 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

082.name: Energy Retrieval
082.attacksText: Put up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

083.name: Harlequin
083.attacksText: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, flip a coin. If heads, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards. If tails, you draw 3 cards, and your opponent draws 5 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

084.name: Hilda
084.attacksText: Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

085.name: Tool Scrapper
085.attacksText: Choose up to 2 Pokémon Tools attached to Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) and discard them. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

086.name: Ignition Energy
086.attacksText: If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your turn. As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy. If this card is attached to an Evolution Pokémon, it provides {C}{C}{C} Energy instead.

087.name: Sewaddle
087.attacksText: {G} → Bug Bite : 20
087.flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

088.name: Swadloon
088.evolves: Evolves from Sewaddle and into Leavanny
088.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Healing Leaves Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon. {G}{C} → Bug Buzz : 40
088.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

089.name: Leavanny
089.attacksText: {C} → Healing Wrapping Heal 100 damage from each of your Basic Pokémon. {G}{C} → X-Scissor : 90+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.
089.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

090.name: Cottonee
090.evolves: Evolves into Whimsicott , Whimsicott ex , or Whimsicott- GX
090.attacksText: {G} → Absorb : 10 Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
090.flavorText: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

091.name: Deerling
091.attacksText: {C}{C} → Rear Kick : 30
091.flavorText: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

092.name: Sawsbuck
092.attacksText: {C}{C} → Push Down : 50 Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.) {G}{C}{C} → Solar Beam : 100
092.flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

093.name: Shelmet
093.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Stimulated Evolution If you have Karrablast in play, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it. {C} → Headbutt Bounce : 10
093.flavorText: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

094.name: Accelgor
094.attacksText: {G} → Acid Spray : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
094.flavorText: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

095.name: Virizion
095.attacksText: {G} → Giga Drain : 30 Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon. {G}{G}{C} → Emerald Blade : 130 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.
095.flavorText: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

096.name: Tepig
096.attacksText: {R} → Tackle : 10 {R}{R} → Rollout : 30
096.flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

097.name: Pignite
097.evolves: Evolves from Tepig and into Emboar or Mega Emboar ex
097.attacksText: {R} → Combustion : 30 {R}{R}{C} → Heat Crash : 80
097.flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

098.name: Emboar
098.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Inferno Fandango As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic {R} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon. {R}{R}{R}{C} → Heat Crash : 120
098.flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

099.name: Pansear
099.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {C}{C} → Scratch : 30
099.flavorText: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

100.name: Volcarona
100.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Torrid Scales You must discard a Basic {R} Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Burned. {R}{C}{C} → Fire Wing : 70
100.flavorText: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

101.name: Panpour
101.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {C}{C} → Scratch : 30
101.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

102.name: Simipour
102.attacksText: {C}{C} → Gentle Slap : 70
102.flavorText: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

103.name: Tympole
103.attacksText: {C}{C} → Round : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.
103.flavorText: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

104.name: Palpitoad
104.evolves: Evolves from Tympole and into Seismitoad
104.attacksText: {C}{C} → Round : 40× This attack does 40 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack. {W}{C}{C} → Wave Splash : 60
104.flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

105.name: Seismitoad
105.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Round : 70× This attack does 70 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack. {W}{C}{C}{C} → Hyper Voice : 160
105.flavorText: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

106.name: Tirtouga
106.evolves: Evolves from Antique Cover Fossil and into Carracosta
106.attacksText: {W} → Ancient Seaweed : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each Item card in your opponent's discard pile. {W}{C}{C} → Surf : 80
106.flavorText: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

107.name: Carracosta
107.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Mighty Shell Prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon that have any Special Energy attached. {W}{C}{C} → Big Bite : 150 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
107.flavorText: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

108.name: Alomomola
108.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Gentle Fin Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may put a Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less from your discard pile onto your Bench. {W}{C}{C} → Waterfall : 70
108.flavorText: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

109.name: Cubchoo
109.attacksText: {W} → Snotted Up : 10 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.
109.flavorText: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

110.name: Beartic
110.attacksText: {C} → Continuous Headbutt : 50× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage for each heads. {W}{W}{W}{C} → Sheer Cold : 150 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.
110.flavorText: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

111.name: Cryogonal
111.attacksText: {W} → Drag Off Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. This attack does 20 damage to the new Active Pokémon. {W} → Icicle : 30
111.flavorText: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

112.name: Emolga
112.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {L} → Static Shock : 20
112.flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

113.name: Tynamo
113.attacksText: {C} → Hold Still Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
113.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

114.name: Eelektrik
114.evolves: Evolves from Tynamo and into Eelektross or Mega Eelektross ex
114.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Dynamotor Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic {L} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {L}{L}{C} → Electric Ball : 50
114.flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

115.name: Eelektross
115.attacksText: {L} → Thunder Fang : 60 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {L}{L}{L}{C} → Buzz Flip : 100× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.
115.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

116.name: Munna
116.attacksText: {C} → Rest This Pokémon is now Asleep. Heal 30 damage from it. {P} → Mumble : 10
116.flavorText: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

117.name: Musharna
117.attacksText: {C} → Dream Calling You may search your deck for any number of Fennel cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {P} → Sleep Pulse : 50 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
117.flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

118.name: Solosis
118.attacksText: {C} → Rollout : 10
118.flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

119.name: Duosion
119.evolves: Evolves from Solosis and into Reuniclus
119.attacksText: {C} → Cellular Evolution Search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck. {C} → Spray Fluid : 30
119.flavorText: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

120.name: Elgyem
120.attacksText: {P} → Slight Shift Move an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of their Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Beam : 40
120.flavorText: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

121.name: Beheeyem
121.evolves: Evolves from Elgyem and into Beheeyem BREAK
121.attacksText: {P} → Calm Mind Heal 40 damage from this Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Psychic : 80+ This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
121.flavorText: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

122.name: Golett
122.attacksText: {C}{C} → Best Punch : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
122.flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

123.name: Golurk
123.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Double Smash : 80× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads. {P}{P}{C}{C}{C} → Golurk Hammer : 200
123.flavorText: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

124.name: Drilbur
124.evolves: Evolves into Excadrill or Excadrill ex
124.attacksText: {F} → Mud-Slap : 10 {F}{F} → Corkscrew Punch : 30
124.flavorText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

125.name: Timburr
125.attacksText: {F} → Low Kick : 10 {F}{C}{C} → Strength : 50
125.flavorText: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

126.name: Gurdurr
126.evolves: Evolves from Timburr and into Conkeldurr
126.attacksText: {F} → Low Kick : 30 {F}{C}{C} → Hammer Arm : 60 Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.
126.flavorText: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

127.name: Conkeldurr
127.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Craftsmanship This Pokémon gets +40 HP for each {F} Energy attached to it. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Swing Around : 100+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads.
127.flavorText: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

128.name: Throh
128.attacksText: {F}{C} → Shoulder Throw : 120- This attack does 30 less damage for each {C} in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.
128.flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

129.name: Dwebble
129.attacksText: {C} → Flail : 10× This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. {C}{C} → Dig Claws : 20
129.flavorText: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

130.name: Crustle
130.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sturdy If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10. {F}{C}{C} → Stone Edge : 80+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.
130.flavorText: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

131.name: Landorus
131.attacksText: {C} → Abundant Harvest Attach a Basic {F} Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {F}{C}{C} → Earthquake : 110 This attack also does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
131.flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

132.name: Venipede
132.attacksText: {C} → Poison Spray Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
132.flavorText: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

133.name: Whirlipede
133.evolves: Evolves from Venipede and into Scolipede
133.attacksText: {C} → Venoshock : 30+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 60 more damage.
133.flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

134.name: Scolipede
134.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Poison Point If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned. {D}{C} → Venoshock : 90+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 90 more damage.
134.flavorText: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

135.name: Sandile
135.attacksText: {D} → Tighten Up : 10 Your opponent discards a card from their hand.
135.flavorText: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

136.name: Krokorok
136.evolves: Evolves from Sandile and into Krookodile
136.attacksText: {D}{C} → Tighten Up : 40 Your opponent discards 2 cards from their hand.
136.flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

137.name: Krookodile
137.attacksText: {D}{C} → Tighten Up : 60 Your opponent discards 2 cards from their hand. {D}{D}{C} → Cursed Slug : 120+ If your opponent has 3 or fewer cards in their hand, this attack does 120 more damage.
137.flavorText: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

138.name: Escavalier
138.attacksText: {M} → Wild Lances : 90 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
138.flavorText: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

139.name: Klink
139.attacksText: {M} → Hard Gears : 10 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
139.flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

140.name: Klang
140.evolves: Evolves from Klink and into Klinklang
140.attacksText: {M}{C} → Hard Gears : 50 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
140.flavorText: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

141.name: Klinklang
141.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Gear Coating All of your Pokémon that have any {M} Energy attached take 20 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 120
141.flavorText: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

142.name: Pawniard
142.attacksText: {M} → Corner : 10 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
142.flavorText: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

143.name: Bisharp
143.evolves: Evolves from Pawniard and into Kingambit
143.attacksText: {M} → Cut Up : 40 {M}{C} → Finishing Blow : 60+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage.
143.flavorText: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

144.name: Cobalion
144.attacksText: {M} → Righteous Edge : 20 Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {M}{M}{C} → Metal Arms : 80+ If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 40 more damage.
144.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

145.name: Axew
145.attacksText: {C} → Gather Strength Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
145.flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

146.name: Fraxure
146.evolves: Evolves from Axew and into Haxorus
146.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 30 {F}{M} → Boundless Power : 90 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.
146.flavorText: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they've been fighting.

147.name: Haxorus
147.attacksText: {C}{C} → Cross-Cut : 80+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 80 more damage. {F}{M}{C} → Axe Blast If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it is Knocked Out.
147.flavorText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

148.name: Pidove
148.attacksText: {C} → Scout Your opponent reveals their hand. {C} → Stampede : 10
148.flavorText: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

149.name: Tranquill
149.evolves: Evolves from Pidove and into Unfezant
149.attacksText: {C} → Fly : 40 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
149.flavorText: It can return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance separating them.

150.name: Unfezant
150.attacksText: {C} → Add On Draw 4 cards. {C}{C} → Swift Flight : 120 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
150.flavorText: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.

151.name: Audino
151.attacksText: {C} → Return : 30 You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.
151.flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

152.name: Minccino
152.attacksText: {C} → Tail Slap : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
152.flavorText: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

153.name: Cinccino
153.attacksText: {C} → Do the Wave : 20+ This attack does 20 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.
153.flavorText: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

154.name: Rufflet
154.evolves: Evolves into Braviary or Hisuian Braviary
154.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 10 {C}{C} → Glide : 20
154.flavorText: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

155.name: Braviary
155.attacksText: {C} → Aerial Ace : 40+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Speed Wing : 130
155.flavorText: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

156.name: Serperior ex

Then, shuffle your deck. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
