170.name: N's Plan
170.attacksText: Move up to 2 Energy from your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

171.name: Victini
171.attacksText: {R}{R} → V-Force : 120 If you have 4 or fewer Benched Pokémon, this attack does nothing.
171.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

172.name: Zekrom ex
172.attacksText: {C}{C} → Slash : 50 {L}{L}{C} → Voltage Burst : 130+ This attack does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken. This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

001.name: Snivy
001.attacksText: {G} → Tackle : 10 {G}{G} → Vine Whip : 30
001.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

002.name: Servine
002.evolves: Evolves from Snivy and into Serperior or Serperior ex
002.attacksText: {G} → Wrap : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {G}{C}{C} → Vine Whip : 60
002.flavorText: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

003.name: Serperior ex
003.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Regal Cheer Attacks used by your Pokémon do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {G}{C}{C}{C} → Command the Grass : 150 You may search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

004.name: Pansage
004.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {C}{C} → Scratch : 30
004.flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

005.name: Simisage
005.attacksText: {C}{C} → Gentle Slap : 70
005.flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

006.name: Petilil
006.evolves: Evolves into Lilligant or Hisuian Lilligant
006.attacksText: {C} → Hide Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon. {G} → Leafage : 10
006.flavorText: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

007.name: Lilligant
007.attacksText: {G} → Bemusing Aroma : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {G}{C}{C} → Cut : 70
007.flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

008.name: Maractus
008.attacksText: {G} → Lively Needles : 20+ If this Pokémon was healed during this turn, this attack does 100 more damage. {G}{C} → Pierce : 50
008.flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

009.name: Karrablast
009.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Stimulated Evolution If you have Shelmet in play, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it. {C} → Horn Attack : 10
009.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

010.name: Foongus
010.evolves: Evolves into Amoonguss or Amoonguss ex
010.attacksText: {C} → Toxic Spore Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
010.flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

011.name: Amoonguss
011.attacksText: {C} → Dangerous Reaction : 30+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 120 more damage. {G}{C} → Seed Bomb : 60
011.flavorText: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

012.name: Victini
012.attacksText: {R}{R} → V-Force : 120 If you have 4 or fewer Benched Pokémon, this attack does nothing.
012.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

013.name: Darumaka
013.attacksText: {R}{C} → Will-O-Wisp : 30
013.flavorText: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

014.name: Darmanitan
014.attacksText: {R}{C} → Searing Flame : 50 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{C}{C}{C} → Smashing Headbutt : 180 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.
014.flavorText: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

015.name: Larvesta
015.attacksText: {C} → Peck Off : 10 Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
015.flavorText: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

016.name: Volcarona
016.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Torrid Scales You must discard a Basic {R} Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Burned. {R}{C}{C} → Fire Wing : 70
016.flavorText: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

017.name: Panpour
017.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {C}{C} → Scratch : 30
017.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

018.name: Simipour
018.attacksText: {C}{C} → Gentle Slap : 70
018.flavorText: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

019.name: Tympole
019.attacksText: {C}{C} → Round : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack.
019.flavorText: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

020.name: Palpitoad
020.evolves: Evolves from Tympole and into Seismitoad
020.attacksText: {C}{C} → Round : 40× This attack does 40 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack. {W}{C}{C} → Wave Splash : 60
020.flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

021.name: Seismitoad
021.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Round : 70× This attack does 70 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Round attack. {W}{C}{C}{C} → Hyper Voice : 160
021.flavorText: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

022.name: Tirtouga
022.evolves: Evolves from Antique Cover Fossil and into Carracosta
022.attacksText: {W} → Ancient Seaweed : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each Item card in your opponent's discard pile. {W}{C}{C} → Surf : 80
022.flavorText: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

023.name: Carracosta
023.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Mighty Shell Prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon that have any Special Energy attached. {W}{C}{C} → Big Bite : 150 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
023.flavorText: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

024.name: Alomomola
024.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Gentle Fin Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may put a Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less from your discard pile onto your Bench. {W}{C}{C} → Waterfall : 70
024.flavorText: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

025.name: Cubchoo
025.attacksText: {W} → Snotted Up : 10 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.
025.flavorText: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

026.name: Beartic
026.attacksText: {C} → Continuous Headbutt : 50× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage for each heads. {W}{W}{W}{C} → Sheer Cold : 150 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.
026.flavorText: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

027.name: Cryogonal
027.attacksText: {W} → Drag Off Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. This attack does 20 damage to the new Active Pokémon. {W} → Icicle : 30
027.flavorText: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

028.name: Kyurem ex
028.attacksText: {C}{C} → Slash : 50 {W}{W}{C} → Blizzard Burst : 130 This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon for each Prize card your opponent has taken. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

029.name: Emolga
029.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {L} → Static Shock : 20
029.flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

030.name: Tynamo
030.attacksText: {C} → Hold Still Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
030.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

031.name: Eelektrik
031.evolves: Evolves from Tynamo and into Eelektross or Mega Eelektross ex
031.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Dynamotor Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic {L} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {L}{L}{C} → Electric Ball : 50
031.flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

032.name: Eelektross
032.attacksText: {L} → Thunder Fang : 60 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {L}{L}{L}{C} → Buzz Flip : 100× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.
032.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

033.name: Thundurus
033.attacksText: {C} → Charge Search your deck for a Basic {L} Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {L}{C}{C} → Disaster Volt : 110 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
033.flavorText: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.

034.name: Zekrom ex
034.attacksText: {C}{C} → Slash : 50 {L}{L}{C} → Voltage Burst : 130+ This attack does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken. This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

035.name: Munna
035.attacksText: {C} → Rest This Pokémon is now Asleep. Heal 30 damage from it. {P} → Mumble : 10
035.flavorText: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

036.name: Musharna
036.attacksText: {C} → Dream Calling You may search your deck for any number of Fennel cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {P} → Sleep Pulse : 50 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
036.flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

037.name: Solosis
037.attacksText: {C} → Rollout : 10
037.flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

038.name: Duosion
038.evolves: Evolves from Solosis and into Reuniclus
038.attacksText: {C} → Cellular Evolution Search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck. {C} → Spray Fluid : 30
038.flavorText: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

039.name: Reuniclus
039.evolves: Evolves from Duosion
039.attacksText: {C} → Cellular Ascension For each of your Benched Pokémon, search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck. {C} → Evo-Lariat : 40+ This attack does 40 more damage for each of your Evolution Pokémon in play.
039.flavorText: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

040.name: Elgyem
040.attacksText: {P} → Slight Shift Move an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of their Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Beam : 40
040.flavorText: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

041.name: Beheeyem
041.evolves: Evolves from Elgyem and into Beheeyem BREAK
041.attacksText: {P} → Calm Mind Heal 40 damage from this Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Psychic : 80+ This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
041.flavorText: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

042.name: Golett
042.attacksText: {C}{C} → Best Punch : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
042.flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

043.name: Golurk
043.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Double Smash : 80× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads. {P}{P}{C}{C}{C} → Golurk Hammer : 200
043.flavorText: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

044.name: Meloetta ex
044.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Debut Performance If you go first, this Pokémon can use attacks during your first turn. {P} → Echoed Voice : 30 During your next turn, this Pokémon's Echoed Voice attack does 80 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

045.name: Drilbur
045.evolves: Evolves into Excadrill or Excadrill ex
045.attacksText: {F} → Mud-Slap : 10 {F}{F} → Corkscrew Punch : 30
045.flavorText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

046.name: Excadrill ex
046.evolves: Evolves from Drilbur
046.attacksText: {F}{F} → Piercing Drill : 60 This attack also does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{F}{F} → Rock Tumble : 200 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

047.name: Timburr
047.evolves: Evolves into Gurdurr
047.attacksText: {F} → Low Kick : 10 {F}{C}{C} → Strength : 50
047.flavorText: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

048.name: Gurdurr
048.evolves: Evolves from Timburr and into Conkeldurr
048.attacksText: {F} → Low Kick : 30 {F}{C}{C} → Hammer Arm : 60 Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.
048.flavorText: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

049.name: Conkeldurr
049.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Craftsmanship This Pokémon gets +40 HP for each {F} Energy attached to it. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Swing Around : 100+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads.
049.flavorText: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

050.name: Throh
050.attacksText: {F}{C} → Shoulder Throw : 120- This attack does 30 less damage for each {C} in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.
050.flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

051.name: Dwebble
051.evolves: Evolves into Crustle
051.attacksText: {C} → Flail : 10× This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. {C}{C} → Dig Claws : 20
051.flavorText: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

052.name: Crustle
052.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sturdy If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10. {F}{C}{C} → Stone Edge : 80+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.
052.flavorText: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

053.name: Landorus
053.attacksText: {C} → Abundant Harvest Attach a Basic {F} Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {F}{C}{C} → Earthquake : 110 This attack also does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
053.flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

054.name: Venipede
054.attacksText: {C} → Poison Spray Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
054.flavorText: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

055.name: Whirlipede
055.evolves: Evolves from Venipede and into Scolipede
055.attacksText: {C} → Venoshock : 30+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 60 more damage.
055.flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

056.name: Scolipede
056.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Poison Point If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned. {D}{C} → Venoshock : 90+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 90 more damage.
056.flavorText: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

057.name: Sandile
057.attacksText: {D} → Tighten Up : 10 Your opponent discards a card from their hand.
057.flavorText: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

058.name: Krokorok
058.evolves: Evolves from Sandile and into Krookodile
058.attacksText: {D}{C} → Tighten Up : 40 Your opponent discards 2 cards from their hand.
058.flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

059.name: Krookodile
059.attacksText: {D}{C} → Tighten Up : 60 Your opponent discards 2 cards from their hand. {D}{D}{C} → Cursed Slug : 120+ If your opponent has 3 or fewer cards in their hand, this attack does 120 more damage.
059.flavorText: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

060.name: Escavalier
060.attacksText: {M} → Wild Lances : 90 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
060.flavorText: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

061.name: Klink
061.evolves: Evolves into Klang
061.attacksText: {M} → Hard Gears : 10 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
061.flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

062.name: Klang
062.evolves: Evolves from Klink and into Klinklang
062.attacksText: {M}{C} → Hard Gears : 50 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
062.flavorText: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

063.name: Klinklang
063.evolves: Evolves from Klang
063.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Gear Coating All of your Pokémon that have any {M} Energy attached take 20 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 120
063.flavorText: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

064.name: Pawniard
064.evolves: Evolves into Bisharp
064.attacksText: {M} → Corner : 10 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
064.flavorText: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

065.name: Bisharp
065.evolves: Evolves from Pawniard and into Kingambit
065.attacksText: {M} → Cut Up : 40 {M}{C} → Finishing Blow : 60+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage.
065.flavorText: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

066.name: Cobalion
066.attacksText: {M} → Righteous Edge : 20 Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {M}{M}{C} → Metal Arms : 80+ If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 40 more damage.
066.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

067.name: Genesect ex
067.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Metallic Signal Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Evolution {M} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {M}{M}{C} → Protect Charge : 150 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

068.name: Axew
068.attacksText: {C} → Gather Strength Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
068.flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

069.name: Fraxure
069.evolves: Evolves from Axew and into Haxorus
069.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 30 {F}{M} → Boundless Power : 90 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.
069.flavorText: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they've been fighting.

070.name: Haxorus
070.evolves: Evolves from Fraxure
070.attacksText: {C}{C} → Cross-Cut : 80+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 80 more damage. {F}{M}{C} → Axe Blast If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it is Knocked Out.
070.flavorText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

071.name: Pidove
071.attacksText: {C} → Scout Your opponent reveals their hand. {C} → Stampede : 10
071.flavorText: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

072.name: Tranquill
072.evolves: Evolves from Pidove and into Unfezant
072.attacksText: {C} → Fly : 40 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
072.flavorText: It can return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance separating them.

073.name: Unfezant
073.attacksText: {C} → Add On Draw 4 cards. {C}{C} → Swift Flight : 120 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
073.flavorText: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.

074.name: Audino
074.attacksText: {C} → Return : 30 You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.
074.flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

075.name: Minccino
075.evolves: Evolves into Cinccino
075.attacksText: {C} → Tail Slap : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
075.flavorText: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

076.name: Cinccino
076.attacksText: {C} → Do the Wave : 20+ This attack does 20 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.
076.flavorText: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

077.name: Rufflet
077.evolves: Evolves into Braviary or Hisuian Braviary
077.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 10 {C}{C} → Glide : 20
077.flavorText: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

078.name: Braviary
078.attacksText: {C} → Aerial Ace : 40+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Speed Wing : 130
078.flavorText: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

079.name: Air Balloon
079.attacksText: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is {C}{C} less. · Pokémon Tool rule: You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

080.name: Antique Cover Fossil
080.attacksText: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic {C} Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play. Ability ⇢ Protective Cover Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.) · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

081.name: Energy Coin
081.attacksText: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, search your deck for a Basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

082.name: Fennel
082.attacksText: Heal 40 damage from each of your Pokémon. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

083.name: N's Plan
083.attacksText: Move up to 2 Energy from your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

084.name: Pokégear 3.0
084.attacksText: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Supporter card you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

085.name: Professor's Research
085.attacksText: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

086.name: Prism Energy
086.attacksText: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy. If this card is attached to a Basic Pokémon, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.

087.name: Snivy
087.attacksText: {G} → Tackle : 10 {G}{G} → Vine Whip : 30
087.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

088.name: Servine
088.evolves: Evolves from Snivy and into Serperior or Serperior ex
088.attacksText: {G} → Wrap : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {G}{C}{C} → Vine Whip : 60
088.flavorText: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

089.name: Pansage
089.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {C}{C} → Scratch : 30
089.flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

090.name: Simisage
090.attacksText: {C}{C} → Gentle Slap : 70
090.flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

091.name: Petilil
091.evolves: Evolves into Lilligant or Hisuian Lilligant
091.attacksText: {C} → Hide Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon. {G} → Leafage : 10
091.flavorText: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

092.name: Lilligant
092.attacksText: {G} → Bemusing Aroma : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {G}{C}{C} → Cut : 70
092.flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

093.name: Maractus
093.attacksText: {G} → Lively Needles : 20+ If this Pokémon was healed during this turn, this attack does 100 more damage. {G}{C} → Pierce : 50
093.flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

094.name: Karrablast
094.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Stimulated Evolution If you have Shelmet in play, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it. {C} → Horn Attack : 10
094.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

095.name: Foongus
095.evolves: Evolves into Amoonguss or Amoonguss ex
095.attacksText: {C} → Toxic Spore Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
095.flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

096.name: Amoonguss
096.attacksText: {C} → Dangerous Reaction : 30+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 120 more damage. {G}{C} → Seed Bomb : 60
096.flavorText: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

097.name: Darumaka
097.attacksText: {R}{C} → Will-O-Wisp : 30
097.flavorText: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

098.name: Darmanitan
098.attacksText: {R}{C} → Searing Flame : 50 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{C}{C}{C} → Smashing Headbutt : 180 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.
098.flavorText: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

099.name: Larvesta
099.attacksText: {C} → Peck Off : 10 Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
099.flavorText: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

100.name: Medicham
100.attacksText: {F} → Harmonious Spirit Palm : 50+ If this Pokémon and your opponent's Active Pokémon have the same amount of Energy attached, this attack does 120 more damage.
100.flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

101.name: Regirock ex
101.attacksText: {C} → Regi Charge Attach up to 2 Basic {F} Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Giant Rock : 140+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Stage 2 Pokémon, this attack does 140 more damage. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

102.name: Cynthia's Gible
102.attacksText: {F} → Rock Hurl : 20 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
102.flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

103.name: Cynthia's Gabite
103.evolves: Evolves from Cynthia's Gible and into Cynthia's Garchomp ex
103.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Champion's Call Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Cynthia's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {F} → Dragonslice : 40
103.flavorText: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

104.name: Cynthia's Garchomp ex
104.attacksText: {F} → Corkscrew Dive : 100 You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. {F}{F} → Draconic Buster : 260 Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

105.name: Hippopotas
105.attacksText: {F} → Push Down : 10 Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
105.flavorText: It shrouds itself in sand to ward off germs. It travels easily through the sands of the desert.

106.name: Hippowdon
106.attacksText: {F}{F} → Ram : 60 {F}{F}{C} → Super Sandstorm : 150 This attack also does 40 damage to each Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it (both yours and your opponent's) . (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
106.flavorText: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.

107.name: Mudbray
107.attacksText: {F}{C} → Running Charge : 40× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.
107.flavorText: This Pokémon covers itself in mud that it has regurgitated. The mud won't dry out even if it's exposed to the sun for a long time.

108.name: Mudsdale
108.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Mud Coat This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{F}{C} → Heavy Impact : 130
108.flavorText: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.

109.name: Arven's Toedscool
109.attacksText: {C} → Slight Intrusion : 30 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
109.flavorText: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

110.name: Arven's Toedscruel
110.attacksText: {C} → Pull Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. {C}{C}{C} → Reckless Charge : 120 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
110.flavorText: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

111.name: Cornerstone Mask Ogerpon
111.attacksText: {C} → Rock Kagura Search your deck for a Basic {F} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {F}{F}{C} → Mountain Ramming : 100 Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.
111.flavorText: This form has excellent defenses, absorbing impacts solidly like the cornerstones that support houses.

112.name: Team Rocket's Ekans
112.attacksText: {C} → Drag Down Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {D} → Gnaw : 10
112.flavorText: It can freely detach its jaw to swallow large prey whole. It can become too heavy to move, however.

113.name: Team Rocket's Arbok
113.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Potent Glare As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play any Pokémon that has an Ability from their hand, except for Team Rocket's Pokémon. {D}{D}{D} → Spinning Tail This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
113.flavorText: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

114.name: Team Rocket's Nidoran Female
114.attacksText: {D} → Surprise Attack : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
114.flavorText: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran's horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male's horn.

115.name: Team Rocket's Nidorina
115.evolves: Evolves from Team Rocket's NidoranFemale and into Team Rocket's Nidoqueen
115.attacksText: {D} → Dark Awakening Choose up to 2 of your {D} Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck. {D}{D} → Scratch : 50
115.flavorText: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.

116.name: Team Rocket's Nidoqueen
116.attacksText: {D} → Love Impact : 60+ If a Pokémon that has “Nidoking” in its name is on your Bench, this attack does 120 more damage. {D}{D} → Mega Kick : 130
116.flavorText: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.

117.name: Team Rocket's Nidoran Male
117.attacksText: {D} → Pierce : 10 {D}{C} → Hammer In : 30
117.flavorText: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it's friendly with.

118.name: Team Rocket's Nidorino
118.evolves: Evolves from Team Rocket's NidoranMale and into Team Rocket's Nidoking ex
118.attacksText: {D}{C} → Hammer In : 30 {D}{D}{C} → Horn Rend : 60+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage.
118.flavorText: It's nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.

119.name: Team Rocket's Nidoking ex
119.attacksText: {D}{D}{C} → Tainted Horn : 100 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During Pokémon Checkup, put 8 damage counters on that Pokémon instead of 1. {D}{D}{D}{C} → Kingly Impact : 240 · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

120.name: Team Rocket's Zubat
120.attacksText: {D} → Poison Spray Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
120.flavorText: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun's light won't reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.

121.name: Team Rocket's Golbat
121.evolves: Evolves from Team Rocket's Zubat and into Team Rocket's Crobat ex
121.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sneaky Bite When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {D} → Confuse Ray : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
121.flavorText: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully. It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its fangs and slurping up blood.

122.name: Team Rocket's Crobat ex
122.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Biting Spree When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon and put 2 damage counters on each of them. {D}{D} → Assassin's Return : 120 You may put this Pokémon into your hand. (Discard all cards attached to this Pokémon.) · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

123.name: Team Rocket's Grimer
123.attacksText: {D}{C} → Corrosive Sludge At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard the Defending Pokémon and all attached cards.
123.flavorText: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

124.name: Team Rocket's Muk
124.attacksText: {D}{C} → Gooped Up : 40 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat. {D}{D}{C} → Hazardous Venom : 100× This attack does 100 damage for each Special Condition affecting your opponent's Active Pokémon.
124.flavorText: It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

125.name: Team Rocket's Koffing
125.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Smog Signals If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon that have “Koffing” in their name and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {D}{C} → Leaking Gas : 30
125.flavorText: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.

126.name: Team Rocket's Weezing
126.attacksText: {D}{C} → Explode Together Now : 40× This attack does 40 damage for each Pokémon in play that has “Koffing” or “Weezing” in its name (both yours and your opponent's) .
126.flavorText: Top-grade perfume is made using its internal poison gases by diluting them to the highest level.

127.name: Team Rocket's Murkrow
127.attacksText: {C} → Deceit Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {D}{C} → Torment : 30 Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack.
127.flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

128.name: Team Rocket's Sneasel
128.attacksText: {D} → Scratch : 20 {D}{D} → Strike the Sleeper This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon for each damage counter on that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
128.flavorText: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

129.name: Cynthia's Spiritomb
129.attacksText: {C} → Raging Curse : 10× This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Cynthia's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.
129.flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

130.name: Marnie's Purrloin
130.attacksText: {D} → Pointy Nails : 20+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 40 more damage.
130.flavorText: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

131.name: Marnie's Liepard
131.attacksText: {D}{D} → Pointy Claws : 70+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 70 more damage.
131.flavorText: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

132.name: Marnie's Scraggy
132.attacksText: {D}{D}{C} → Crunch : 50 Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
132.flavorText: It stretches its saggy skin up to its neck to protect itself. Among Scraggy, individuals with saggier skin apparently garner more respect.

133.name: Marnie's Scrafty
133.evolves: Evolves from Marnie's Scraggy
133.attacksText: {D} → Rear Kick : 40 {D}{D}{C} → Wild Tackle : 160 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
133.flavorText: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

134.name: Marnie's Impidimp
134.attacksText: {C} → Filch Draw a card. {D} → Corkscrew Punch : 10
134.flavorText: The reason this Pokémon causes trouble for those it feels close to is because Impidimp itself gets irritable if it can't absorb negative emotions.

135.name: Marnie's Morgrem
135.evolves: Evolves from Marnie's Impidimp and into Marnie's Grimmsnarl ex
135.attacksText: {D}{D} → Corkscrew Punch : 60
135.flavorText: Morgrem prefers dirty tactics, like ambushing, because it doesn't have confidence in its brawn.

136.name: Marnie's Grimmsnarl ex
136.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Punk Up When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 5 Basic {D} Energy cards and attach them to your Marnie's Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. {D}{D} → Shadow Bullet : 180 This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

137.name: Marnie's Morpeko
137.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Spiky Wheel : 20+ This attack does 40 more damage for each {D} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
137.flavorText: Morpeko eats seeds constantly to keep its hunger at bay. If it's hungry for too long, it grows wild and brutish.

138.name: Arven's Maschiff
138.attacksText: {C} → Stampede : 10 {C}{C}{C} → Confront : 50
138.flavorText: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

139.name: Arven's Mabosstiff ex
139.attacksText: {C} → Vigorous Tackle : 30+ If this Pokémon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 120 more damage. {C}{C}{C} → Boss Headbutt : 210 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Boss Headbutt. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

140.name: Forretress
140.attacksText: {C} → Iron Shake-Up : 20 You may move any amount of {M} Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like. {M}{C}{C}{C} → Hurricane of Needles : 80× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.
140.flavorText: It's usually found hanging on to a fat tree trunk. It shoots out bits of its shell when it sees action.

141.name: Skarmory
141.attacksText: {C} → Roost Heal 50 damage from this Pokémon. During your next turn, this Pokémon can't retreat. {M}{C} → Metal Claw : 60
141.flavorText: Its sturdy, heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.

142.name: Steven's Skarmory
142.attacksText: {C}{C} → Razor Wing : 30 {M}{M}{C} → Sonic Double This attack does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
142.flavorText: Its sturdy, heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.

143.name: Steven's Beldum
143.flavorText: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground's natural magnetism, letting it float.

144.name: Steven's Metang
144.evolves: Evolves from Steven's Beldum and into Steven's Metagross ex
144.attacksText: {M}{C} → Metal Slash : 70 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
144.flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

145.name: Steven's Metagross ex
145.attacksText: Ability ⇢ X-Boot Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Basic {P} Energy card, a Basic {M} Energy card, or 1 of each and attach them to your {P} Pokémon and {M} Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. {M}{C}{C} → Metal Stomp : 200 · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

146.name: Zamazenta
146.attacksText: {M}{M}{C} → Strong Bash : 70 During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , put damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon equal to the damage done to this Pokémon.
146.flavorText: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

147.name: Team Rocket's Rattata
147.attacksText: {C} → Dangerous Incisors : 10 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
147.flavorText: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.

148.name: Team Rocket's Raticate
148.attacksText: {C} → Reckless Abandon : 90 Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this Pokémon also does 90 damage to itself.
148.flavorText: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

149.name: Team Rocket's Meowth
149.evolves: Evolves into Team Rocket's Persian ex
149.attacksText: {C} → Paw-cket Pilfer Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck. {C}{C} → Fury Swipes : 20× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
149.flavorText: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

150.name: Team Rocket's Persian ex
150.attacksText: {C}{C} → Haughty Order Reveal the top 10 cards of your opponent's deck. You may choose an attack from a Pokémon you find there and use it as this attack. Shuffle the revealed cards into your opponent's deck. {C}{C}{C} → Cruel Slash : 140 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

151.name: Kangaskhan
151.attacksText: {C}{C} → Gentle Slap : 50 {C}{C}{C} → Dizzy Punch : 90× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.
151.flavorText: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

152.name: Tauros
152.attacksText: {C} → Horn Attack : 30 {C}{C} → Clean Hit : 50+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.
152.flavorText: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

153.name: Team Rocket's Porygon
153.attacksText: {C} → Hacking Discard a card from your hand. If you do, your opponent discards a card from their hand.
153.flavorText: It is an artificial Pokémon. Since it doesn't breathe, people are excited by its potential to be useful in any environment.

154.name: Team Rocket's Porygon2
154.evolves: Evolves from Team Rocket's Porygon and into Team Rocket's Porygon-Z
154.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → R Command : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each Supporter card that has “Team Rocket” in its name in your discard pile.
154.flavorText: This artificial Pokémon evolved thanks to cutting- edge science. It sometimes displays behavior that is not in its programming.

155.name: Team Rocket's Porygon-Z
155.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Reconstitute You must discard 2 cards from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw a card. {C}{C} → R Command : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each Supporter card that has “Team Rocket” in its name in your discard pile.
155.flavorText: An additional program was installed to create a more advanced Pokémon, but it was apparently flawed. Porygon-Z moves oddly as a result.

156.name: Taillow
156.attacksText: {C} → Wing Attack : 20
156.flavorText: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

157.name: Swellow
157.attacksText: {C} → Add On Draw 3 cards. {C}{C} → Speed Wing : 70
157.flavorText: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

158.name: Arven's Skwovet
158.attacksText: {C} → Gnaw Through : 10 Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
158.flavorText: It stores berries in its cheeks. When there are no berries to be found, Skwovet will stuff pebbles into its cheeks to stave off its cravings.

159.name: Arven's Greedent
159.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Greedy Order When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put up to 2 Arven's Sandwich cards from your discard pile into your hand. {C}{C} → Rolling Tackle : 50
159.flavorText: If it spots a berry tree, it will immediately go to gather berries without a sideways glance—even if it's in the middle of a battle.

160.name: Squawkabilly
160.attacksText: {C} → Push Down : 20 You may switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
160.flavorText: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.

161.name: Arven's Sandwich
161.attacksText: Heal 30 damage from your Active Pokémon. If that Pokémon is an Arven's Pokémon, heal 100 damage from it instead. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

162.name: Cynthia's Power Weight
162.attacksText: The Cynthia's Pokémon this card is attached to gets +70 HP. · Pokémon Tool rule: You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

163.name: Emcee's Hype
163.attacksText: Draw 2 cards. If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, draw 2 more cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

164.name: Energy Recycler
164.attacksText: Shuffle up to 5 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

165.name: Ethan's Adventure
165.attacksText: Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of Ethan's Pokémon and Basic {R} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

166.name: Granite Cave
166.attacksText: Steven's Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) take 30 less damage from attacks from the opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . · Stadium rule: You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

167.name: Judge
167.attacksText: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

168.name: Sacred Ash
168.attacksText: Shuffle up to 5 Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

169.name: Spikemuth Gym
169.attacksText: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Marnie's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into their hand. Then, that player shuffles their deck. · Stadium rule: You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

170.name: Team Rocket's Archer
170.attacksText: You can use this card only if any of your Team Rocket's Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn. Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

171.name: Team Rocket's Ariana
171.attacksText: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. If all of your Pokémon in play are Team Rocket's Pokémon, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand instead. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

172.name: Team Rocket's Bother-Bot
172.attacksText: Turn 1 of your opponent's face-down Prize cards face up and choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card. You may have your opponent switch those cards. (That Prize card remains face up for the rest of the game.) · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

173.name: Team Rocket's Factory
173.attacksText: Once during each player's turn, if they played a Supporter card that has “Team Rocket” in its name from their hand this turn, they may draw 2 cards. · Stadium rule: You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

174.name: Team Rocket's Giovanni
174.attacksText: Switch your Active Team Rocket's Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Team Rocket's Pokémon. If you do, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

175.name: Team Rocket's Great Ball
175.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for an Evolution Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If tails, search your deck for a Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

176.name: Team Rocket's Petrel
176.attacksText: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

177.name: Team Rocket's Proton
177.attacksText: If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn. Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

178.name: Team Rocket's Transceiver
178.attacksText: Search your deck for a Supporter card that has “Team Rocket” in its name, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

179.name: Team Rocket's Venture Bomb
179.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, put 2 damage counters on your Active Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

180.name: Team Rocket's Watchtower
180.attacksText: {C} Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities. · Stadium rule: You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

181.name: TM Machine
181.attacksText: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon Tool cards that have “Technical Machine” in their name, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

182.name: Team Rocket's Energy
182.attacksText: This card can only be attached to a Team Rocket's Pokémon. If this card is attached to anything other than a Team Rocket's Pokémon, discard this card. As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides 2 in any combination of {P} Energy and {D} Energy.

183.name: Yanma
183.evolves: Evolves into Yanmega or Yanmega ex
183.attacksText: {C} → Whirlwind Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.) {G}{C} → Razor Wing : 30
183.flavorText: As Yanma surveys its territory, it periodically stops to hover in place by flapping its wings at high speeds.

184.name: Cynthia's Roserade
184.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Cheer On to Glory Attacks used by your Cynthia's Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {G}{C}{C} → Leaf Step : 80
184.flavorText: The poison in its right hand is quick acting. The poison in its left hand is slow acting. Both are life threatening.

185.name: Shaymin
185.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Flower Curtain Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.) {C}{C} → Smash Kick : 30
185.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

186.name: Crustle
186.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Mysterious Rock Inn Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex. {G}{C}{C} → Superb Scissors : 120 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
186.flavorText: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior's carapace.

187.name: Team Rocket's Spidops
187.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Charging Up Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {G}{C} → Rocket Rush : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each of your Team Rocket's Pokémon in play.
187.flavorText: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

188.name: Hydrapple
188.attacksText: {G} → Hydra Breath Discard 6 Basic {G} Energy cards from your hand, and Knock Out your opponent's Active Pokémon. If you can't discard 6 cards in this way, this attack does nothing. {G}{C}{C} → Whip Smash : 140
188.flavorText: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.

189.name: Rapidash
189.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Hurried Gait Once during your turn, you may draw a card. {R}{C} → Fire Mane : 60
189.flavorText: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd's pace and direction of travel.

190.name: Ethan's Typhlosion
190.attacksText: {R} → Buddy Blast : 40+ This attack does 60 more damage for each Ethan's Adventure card in your discard pile. {R}{R}{C} → Steam Artillery : 160
190.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur to cause huge explosions.

191.name: Team Rocket's Houndoom
191.attacksText: {R} → Cruel Coal Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused. {R}{C} → Scorching Fire : 120 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
191.flavorText: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

192.name: Blaziken
192.attacksText: {C}{C} → Heat Blast : 70 {R}{R}{C} → Inferno Kick Flurry : 120 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. This attack also does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
192.flavorText: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

193.name: Misty's Psyduck
193.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Flustered Leap Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may discard the bottom card of your deck. If you do, discard all cards from this Pokémon and put this Pokémon on top of your deck. {W} → Sprinkle Water : 30
193.flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

194.name: Misty's Lapras
194.attacksText: {W} → Swim Together Search your deck for up to 3 Misty's Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {W}{C} → Surf : 60
194.flavorText: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

195.name: Clamperl
195.attacksText: {W} → Shell Press : 10 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
195.flavorText: Clamperl's pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder's pearls.

196.name: Electrike
196.evolves: Evolves into Manectric or Mega Manectric ex
196.attacksText: {C} → Rear Kick : 10 {L}{C} → Tiny Bolt : 30
196.flavorText: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

197.attacksText: {L} → Astonish : 20 Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck. {C}{C} → Gadget Show : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each Pokémon Tool attached to all of your Pokémon.
197.flavorText: Its electricity-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

198.name: Team Rocket's Orbeetle
198.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Rocket Brain As often as you like during your turn, you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Team Rocket's Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. {P}{C}{C} → Psychic : 40+ This attack does 40 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
198.flavorText: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

001.name: Ethan's Pinsir
001.attacksText: {G} → Vise Grip : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Rallying Horn : 70+ If any of your Ethan's Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 100 more damage.
001.flavorText: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

002.name: Yanma
002.evolves: Evolves into Yanmega or Yanmega ex
002.attacksText: {C} → Whirlwind Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.) {G}{C} → Razor Wing : 30
002.flavorText: As Yanma surveys its territory, it periodically stops to hover in place by flapping its wings at high speeds.

003.name: Yanmega ex
003.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Buzzing Boost Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may search your deck for up to 3 Basic {G} Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. 004.name: Pineco
004.attacksText: {C} → Hang Down : 10
004.flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

005.name: Shroomish
005.attacksText: {C}{C} → Rolling Tackle : 30
005.flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

006.name: Breloom
006.attacksText: {C}{C} → Damage Rush : 30+ Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads. {G}{C}{C} → Mega Drain : 90 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
006.flavorText: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

007.name: Cynthia's Roselia
007.attacksText: {C} → Spike Sting : 20
007.flavorText: It uses the different poisons in each hand separately when it attacks. The stronger its aroma, the healthier it is.

008.name: Cynthia's Roserade
008.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Cheer On to Glory Attacks used by your Cynthia's Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {G}{C}{C} → Leaf Step : 80
008.flavorText: The poison in its right hand is quick acting. The poison in its left hand is slow acting. Both are life threatening.

009.name: Mow Rotom
009.attacksText: {G} → Trimming Mower : 20 Discard a Stadium in play. {C}{C} → Gadget Show : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each Pokémon Tool attached to all of your Pokémon.
009.flavorText: The lawn mower is one of the household appliances that led to the development of the Rotom Dex.

010.name: Shaymin
010.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Flower Curtain Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.) {C}{C} → Smash Kick : 30
010.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

011.name: Dwebble
011.attacksText: {C} → Ascension Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
011.flavorText: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

012.name: Crustle
012.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Mysterious Rock Inn Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex. {G}{C}{C} → Superb Scissors : 120 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
012.flavorText: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior's carapace.

013.name: Fomantis
013.attacksText: {G} → Cut Up : 20
013.flavorText: Fomantis hates having its naps interrupted. It fires off beams using energy it gathers by bathing in the sun.

014.name: Lurantis
014.attacksText: {C} → Razor Leaf : 30 {G} → Petal Blade Dance : 130 Discard 2 Basic {G} Energy cards from your hand. If you can't discard 2 cards in this way, this attack does nothing.
014.flavorText: By masquerading as a bug Pokémon, it lowers the guard of actual bug Pokémon lured in by a scent of sweet flowers. Its sickles bring them down.

015.name: Team Rocket's Blipbug
015.attacksText: {C} → Searching Eyes Look at 1 of your opponent's face-down Prize cards.
015.flavorText: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

016.name: Applin
016.evolves: Evolves into Flapple , Dipplin , or Appletun
016.attacksText: {G} → Mini Drain : 10 Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
016.flavorText: It grows by eating the flesh of an apple. Applin uses its own body fluid to strengthen the apple's skin and prevent it from rotting.

017.name: Dipplin
017.evolves: Evolves from Applin and into Hydrapple ex or Hydrapple
017.attacksText: {G} → Energy Loop : 50 Put an Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.
017.flavorText: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.

018.name: Hydrapple
018.attacksText: {G} → Hydra Breath Discard 6 Basic {G} Energy cards from your hand, and Knock Out your opponent's Active Pokémon. If you can't discard 6 cards in this way, this attack does nothing. {G}{C}{C} → Whip Smash : 140
018.flavorText: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.

019.name: Team Rocket's Tarountula
019.attacksText: {G} → Take Down : 30 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
019.flavorText: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

020.name: Team Rocket's Spidops
020.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Charging Up Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {G}{C} → Rocket Rush : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each of your Team Rocket's Pokémon in play.
020.flavorText: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

021.name: Smoliv
021.attacksText: {C} → Ram : 10
021.flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

022.name: Dolliv
022.evolves: Evolves from Smoliv and into Arboliva ex
022.attacksText: {G} → Nutrients Heal 40 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. {C}{C} → Tackle : 40
022.flavorText: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

023.name: Arboliva ex
023.attacksText: {G} → Oil Salvo Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon 6 times. (You can choose the same Pokémon more than once.) For each time you chose a Pokémon, do 20 damage to it. 024.name: Rellor
024.evolves: Evolves into Rabsca or Rabsca ex
024.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {G} → Rollout : 10
024.flavorText: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

025.name: Rabsca ex
025.attacksText: {C} → Upside-Down Draw Draw 3 cards from the bottom of your deck. {G}{C}{C} → Psychic : 20+ This attack does 90 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

026.name: Teal Mask Ogerpon
026.attacksText: {C} → Grass Kagura Search your deck for a Basic {G} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {G}{G}{C} → Ogre's Hammer : 120 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Ogre's Hammer.
026.flavorText: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

027.name: Growlithe
027.attacksText: {R} → Live Coal : 10 {C}{C} → Dig Claws : 20
027.flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

028.name: Arcanine
028.evolves: Evolves from Growlithe and into Arcanine BREAK
028.attacksText: {C}{C} → Flare : 50 {R}{C}{C} → Punishing Fang : 100+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {D} Pokémon, this attack does 100 more damage.
028.flavorText: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

029.name: Ponyta
029.attacksText: {C} → Double Headbutt : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
029.flavorText: If you've been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

030.name: Rapidash
030.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Hurried Gait Once during your turn, you may draw a card. {R}{C} → Fire Mane : 60
030.flavorText: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd's pace and direction of travel.

031.name: Team Rocket's Moltres ex
031.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Flame Screen : 110 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 50 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {R}{C}{C}{C} → Evil Incineration Discard a Team Rocket's Energy from this Pokémon.
