032.name: Ethan's Cyndaquil
032.attacksText: {R} → Ember : 30 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
032.flavorText: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

033.name: Ethan's Quilava
033.evolves: Evolves from Ethan's Cyndaquil and into Ethan's Typhlosion
033.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Bonded by the Journey Once during your turn, you may search your deck for an Ethan's Adventure card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {R} → Combustion : 40
033.flavorText: Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.

034.name: Ethan's Typhlosion
034.attacksText: {R} → Buddy Blast : 40+ This attack does 60 more damage for each Ethan's Adventure card in your discard pile. {R}{R}{C} → Steam Artillery : 160
034.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur to cause huge explosions.

035.name: Ethan's Slugma
035.attacksText: {R} → Steady Firebreathing : 20
035.flavorText: Its lava body can cool and chip away at times, but a magma bath will heal it right up.

036.name: Ethan's Magcargo
036.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Melt Away If this Pokémon has no Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost. {R}{R}{R} → Lava Burst : 70× Discard up to 5 {R} Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 70 damage for each card you discarded in this way.
036.flavorText: This Pokémon lives near the craters of volcanoes. It stores fire energy in its shell of cooled and hardened magma.

037.name: Team Rocket's Houndour
037.attacksText: {R} → Steady Firebreathing : 20
037.flavorText: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

038.name: Team Rocket's Houndoom
038.attacksText: {R} → Cruel Coal Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused. {R}{C} → Scorching Fire : 120 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
038.flavorText: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

039.name: Ethan's Ho-Oh ex
039.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Golden Flame Once during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Basic {R} Energy cards from your hand to 1 of your Benched Ethan's Pokémon. {R}{R}{R}{R} → Shining Feathers : 160 Heal 50 damage from each of your Pokémon. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

040.name: Torchic
040.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {R} → Combustion : 10
040.flavorText: Torchic feels toasty warm if you hug it. It has a flame sac inside its belly, and the flames burn continuously as long as Torchic has life in it.

041.name: Combusken
041.evolves: Evolves from Torchic and into Blaziken or Blaziken ex
041.attacksText: {C} → Combustion : 20 {R}{C} → Double Kick : 40× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.
041.flavorText: It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

042.name: Blaziken
042.attacksText: {C}{C} → Heat Blast : 70 {R}{R}{C} → Inferno Kick Flurry : 120 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. This attack also does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
042.flavorText: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

043.name: Heat Rotom
043.attacksText: {R} → Singe Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. {C}{C} → Gadget Show : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each Pokémon Tool attached to all of your Pokémon.
043.flavorText: If the convection microwave oven is not working properly, then the Rotom inhabiting it will become lethargic.

044.name: Hearthflame Mask Ogerpon
044.attacksText: {C} → Fire Kagura Search your deck for a Basic {R} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {R}{R}{C} → Searing Flame : 80 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
044.flavorText: This form is the most aggressive, bombarding enemies with the intensity of flames blazing within a hearth.

045.name: Misty's Psyduck
045.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Flustered Leap Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may discard the bottom card of your deck. If you do, discard all cards from this Pokémon and put this Pokémon on top of your deck. {W} → Sprinkle Water : 30
045.flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

046.name: Misty's Staryu
046.evolves: Evolves into Misty's Starmie
046.attacksText: {W} → Bubble Beam : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
046.flavorText: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn't bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

047.name: Misty's Starmie
047.evolves: Evolves from Misty's Staryu
047.attacksText: {W} → Abrupt Flash : 60+ If this Pokémon evolved from Misty's Staryu during this turn, this attack does 80 more damage.
047.flavorText: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

048.name: Misty's Magikarp
048.attacksText: Ability ⇢ So Submerged As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon. {W} → Splash : 10
048.flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

049.name: Misty's Gyarados
049.attacksText: {W} → Splashing Panic : 70× Discard the top 7 cards of your deck, and this attack does 70 damage for each Misty's Pokémon that you discarded in this way. {W}{W}{C} → Waterfall : 120
049.flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

050.name: Misty's Lapras
050.attacksText: {W} → Swim Together Search your deck for up to 3 Misty's Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {W}{C} → Surf : 60
050.flavorText: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

051.name: Team Rocket's Articuno
051.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Repelling Veil Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to your Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.) {W}{C}{C} → Dark Frost : 60+ If this Pokémon has any Team Rocket's Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.
051.flavorText: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

052.name: Cynthia's Feebas
052.attacksText: {C} → Undulate : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
052.flavorText: This tough Pokémon is perfectly fine even in dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby appearance, it isn't popular.

053.name: Cynthia's Milotic
053.evolves: Evolves from Cynthia's Feebas
053.attacksText: {W}{C} → Aqua Split : 60 This attack also does 30 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
053.flavorText: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

054.name: Clamperl
054.attacksText: {W} → Shell Press : 10 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
054.flavorText: Clamperl's pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder's pearls.

055.name: Huntail
055.evolves: Evolves from Clamperl
055.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Diver's Catch When 1 of your {W} Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, you may put all Basic {W} Energy attached to that Pokémon into your hand instead of the discard pile. {W}{C}{C} → Wave Splash : 80
055.flavorText: Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.

056.name: Gorebyss
056.attacksText: {W} → Crescendo Wave : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon. Before doing damage, you may attach any number of Basic {W} Energy cards from your hand to this Pokémon.
056.flavorText: It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.

057.name: Buizel
057.attacksText: {C} → Tail Whap : 10 {W}{C}{C} → Wave Splash : 30
057.flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

058.name: Floatzel
058.evolves: Evolves from Buizel
058.attacksText: {C}{C} → Whirlpool : 30 Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {W}{C}{C} → Aqua Slash : 140 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
058.flavorText: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

059.name: Snover
059.evolves: Evolves into Abomasnow or Mega Abomasnow ex
059.attacksText: {C}{C} → Light Punch : 20 {W}{C}{C} → Icicle : 50
059.flavorText: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

060.name: Abomasnow
060.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Lunge Out : 90 {W}{W}{W}{C} → Frozen Wood : 120+ If this Pokémon has 2 or more {G} Energy attached, this attack does 120 more damage.
060.flavorText: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

061.name: Wash Rotom
061.attacksText: {W} → Manual Wash : 20 Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon. {C}{C} → Gadget Show : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each Pokémon Tool attached to all of your Pokémon.
061.flavorText: This Rotom has entered a washing machine. It nods with satisfaction after it floods the surrounding area.

062.name: Arrokuda
062.evolves: Evolves into Barraskewda
062.attacksText: {W} → Reckless Charge : 30 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
062.flavorText: Arrokuda can swim quickly only in a straight line. The ones that become sluggish from overeating are the first to be targeted by flocks of Wattrel.

063.name: Barraskewda
063.evolves: Evolves from Arrokuda
063.attacksText: {W} → Sharp Fin : 40 {W}{W} → Dive : 60 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
063.flavorText: It spins its tail fins to leap from the water, then viciously bites down on Wingull flying close to the water's surface.

064.name: Cetoddle
064.evolves: Evolves into Cetitan or Cetitan ex
064.attacksText: {W}{C} → Gentle Slap : 30 {W}{W}{W}{C} → Frost Smash : 80
064.flavorText: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

065.name: Cetitan ex
065.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Snow Camouflage Whenever your opponent plays an Item or Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to this Pokémon. {W}{W}{W}{C} → Crushing Press : 140+ You may discard a Stadium in play. If you do, this attack does 140 more damage. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

066.name: Dondozo ex
066.attacksText: {W}{C} → Avenging Billow : 30+ This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. {W}{W}{C}{C} → Dynamic Dive : 120+ You may do 120 more damage. If you do, this Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

067.name: Wellspring Mask Ogerpon
067.attacksText: {C} → Water Kagura Search your deck for a Basic {W} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {W}{W}{C} → Bubble Drain : 100 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
067.flavorText: This form excels in both attack and defense. It ceaselessly unleashes moves like a spring gushes water.

068.name: Electabuzz
068.evolves: Evolves into Electivire or Electivire ex
068.attacksText: {L}{C} → Electroslug : 50
068.flavorText: Its body constantly discharges electricity. Getting close to it will make your hair stand on end.

069.name: Electivire ex
069.attacksText: {L}{C} → Dual Bolt This attack does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {L}{L}{C} → High-Voltage Press : 180+ If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra Energy attached (in addition to this attack's cost) , this attack does 100 more damage. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

070.name: Team Rocket's Zapdos
070.attacksText: {C}{C} → Jamming Wing : 30 You may move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon. {L}{C}{C} → Wicked Thunder : 60+ If this Pokémon has any Team Rocket's Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.
070.flavorText: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It's said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.

071.name: Ethan's Pichu
071.attacksText: {@} → Zapping Draw : 30 Draw a card.
071.flavorText: It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.

072.name: Team Rocket's Mareep
072.attacksText: {C} → Procurement Search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {L} → Tiny Bolt : 10
072.flavorText: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

073.name: Team Rocket's Flaaffy
073.evolves: Evolves from Team Rocket's Mareep and into Team Rocket's Ampharos
073.attacksText: {L}{C} → Thunder Shock : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
073.flavorText: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

074.name: Team Rocket's Ampharos
074.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Darkest Impulse Whenever your opponent plays a Pokémon from their hand to evolve 1 of their Pokémon, put 4 damage counters on that Pokémon. The effect of Darkest Impulse doesn't stack. {L}{C}{C} → Head Bolt : 140
074.flavorText: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

075.name: Electrike
075.evolves: Evolves into Manectric or Mega Manectric ex
075.attacksText: {C} → Rear Kick : 10 {L}{C} → Tiny Bolt : 30
075.flavorText: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

076.name: Manectric
076.attacksText: {C} → Zap Kick : 30 {L}{C} → Flash Impact : 120 This attack also does 40 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
076.flavorText: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

077.name: Rotom
077.attacksText: {L} → Astonish : 20 Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck. {C}{C} → Gadget Show : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each Pokémon Tool attached to all of your Pokémon.
077.flavorText: Its electricity-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

078.name: Zeraora
078.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 20 {L}{L}{L} → Thunder Raid Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 210 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon ex. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
078.flavorText: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.

079.name: Team Rocket's Drowzee
079.attacksText: {P} → Hypnotic Ray : 10 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
079.flavorText: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.

080.name: Team Rocket's Hypno
080.attacksText: {P} → Psyshot : 40 {P}{P}{P} → Bench Manipulation : 80× Your opponent flips a coin for each of their Benched Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon for each tails. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
080.flavorText: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

081.name: Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex
081.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Power Saver This Pokémon can't attack unless you have 4 or more Team Rocket's Pokémon in play. {P}{P}{C} → Erasure Ball : 160+ You may discard up to 2 Energy from your Benched Pokémon. This attack does 60 more damage for each card you discarded in this way. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

082.name: Team Rocket's Wobbuffet
082.attacksText: {P}{C} → Rocket Mirror Move all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Team Rocket's Pokémon to your opponent's Active Pokémon. {P}{C}{C} → Headbutt Bounce : 70
082.flavorText: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

083.name: Steven's Baltoy
083.attacksText: {C} → Summoning Sign Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Steven's Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {P} → Psychic Sphere : 20
083.flavorText: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

084.name: Steven's Claydol
084.attacksText: {P} → Eerie Light : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {P}{P}{C} → Clay Blast : 220 Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
084.flavorText: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

085.name: Team Rocket's Chingling
085.attacksText: {@} → Chiming Commotion Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.
085.flavorText: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

086.name: Steven's Carbink
086.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Stone Palace As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, all of your Steven's Pokémon take 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . The effect of Stone Palace doesn't stack. {P}{C}{C} → Magical Shot : 80
086.flavorText: It has slept underground for hundreds of millions of years since its birth. It's occasionally found during the excavation of caves.

087.name: Team Rocket's Mimikyu
087.attacksText: {P}{C} → Gemstone Mimicry Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Tera Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.
087.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

088.name: Team Rocket's Dottler
088.evolves: Evolves from Team Rocket's Blipbug and into Team Rocket's Orbeetle
088.attacksText: {C} → Disruptive Radar Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back in any order. {P}{C} → Super Psy Bolt : 30
088.flavorText: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

089.name: Team Rocket's Orbeetle
089.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Rocket Brain As often as you like during your turn, you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Team Rocket's Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. {P}{C}{C} → Psychic : 40+ This attack does 40 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
089.flavorText: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

090.name: Mankey
090.attacksText: {F} → Wild Kick : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
090.flavorText: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

091.name: Primeape
091.evolves: Evolves from Mankey and into Annihilape or Annihilape ex
091.attacksText: {F} → Drag Off Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. This attack does 30 damage to the new Active Pokémon.
091.flavorText: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

092.name: Annihilape
092.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Lose Cool If this Pokémon has 2 or more damage counters on it, attacks used by this Pokémon do 120 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{F} → Impact Blow : 160 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Impact Blow.
092.flavorText: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

093.name: Ethan's Sudowoodo
093.attacksText: {F} → Impound : 20 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. {C}{C} → Try to Imitate Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.
093.flavorText: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

094.name: Team Rocket's Larvitar
094.attacksText: {C} → Mountain Munch : 10 Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.
094.flavorText: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

095.name: Team Rocket's Pupitar
095.evolves: Evolves from Team Rocket's Larvitar and into Team Rocket's Tyranitar
095.attacksText: {C} → Explosive Ascension : 30 Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
095.flavorText: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

096.name: Team Rocket's Tyranitar
096.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sand Stream During Pokémon Checkup, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, put 2 damage counters on each of your opponent's Basic Pokémon. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Demolition Tackle : 180 Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
096.flavorText: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

097.name: Nosepass
097.attacksText: {F} → Headbutt : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Rock Throw : 40
097.flavorText: The magnet in Nosepass's nose provides an unerring compass, making this Pokémon an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.

098.name: Probopass
098.attacksText: {F} → Power Gem : 40 {C}{C}{C} → Mountain Drop : 70+ If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 70 more damage.
098.flavorText: It controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. With them, it can attack a foe from three directions.

099.name: Meditite
099.evolves: Evolves into Medicham or Medicham ex
099.attacksText: {F} → Steady Punch : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
099.flavorText: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

100.name: Lokix
100.attacksText: {D} → Low Sweep : 60
100.flavorText: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can't stay in this mode for long.

101.name: Bombirdier
101.attacksText: {C} → Glide : 20 {D}{D}{C} → Drop Shot Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
101.flavorText: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

102.name: Escavalier
102.attacksText: {C} → Pierce : 20 {M}{C} → Iron Buster : 120 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
102.flavorText: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch'd.

103.name: N's Klink
103.attacksText: {C} → Double Spin : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
103.flavorText: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

104.name: N's Klang
104.evolves: Evolves from N's Klink and into N's Klinklang
104.attacksText: {C} → Spinning Gears : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {M}{C} → Confront : 40
104.flavorText: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

105.name: N's Klinklang
105.attacksText: {C} → Magnetic Blast : 50 {M}{M}{C} → Triple Smash : 120× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 120 damage for each heads.
105.flavorText: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

106.name: Galarian Stunfisk
106.attacksText: {C}{C} → Mud-Slap : 40 {C}{C}{C} → Bounding Bite : 100 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
106.flavorText: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

107.name: Magearna
107.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Auto Heal As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, heal 90 damage from that Pokémon. {C} → Spike Draw : 20 Draw 2 cards.
107.flavorText: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

108.name: Hop's Corviknight
108.attacksText: {C} → Shoot Through : 50 This attack also does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {M}{M}{C} → Steel Wing : 150 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 60 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
108.flavorText: Although its wings have partly turned to steel and become heavy as a result, this Pokémon flies through the skies with ease.

109.name: Cufant
109.evolves: Evolves into Copperajah or Copperajah ex
109.attacksText: {M}{M}{C} → Rollout : 80
109.flavorText: Cufant can lift loads weighing five tons. In the mornings, it heads into caves with its herd, in search of the ore on which these Pokémon feed.

110.name: Copperajah
110.attacksText: {M}{M}{C} → Ram : 100 {M}{M}{C}{C} → Mega Impact : 160
110.flavorText: Copperajah are prideful, cantankerous Pokémon. Specimens with vibrant green skin command the respect of others of their kind.

111.name: Hop's Zacian ex
111.attacksText: {C} → Insta-Strike : 30 This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {M}{M}{M}{C} → Brave Slash : 240 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Brave Slash. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

112.name: Bagon
112.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 10 {R}{W} → Reckless Charge : 50 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
112.flavorText: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders. It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly.

113.name: Shelgon
113.evolves: Evolves from Bagon and into Salamence ex
113.attacksText: {C}{C} → Guard Press : 30 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {R}{W}{C} → Heavy Impact : 80
113.flavorText: The cells within its shell transform with explosive speed, preparing it for evolution.

114.name: Salamence ex
114.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Wide Blast This attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {R}{W}{C}{C} → Dragon Impact : 300 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

115.name: Druddigon
115.attacksText: {C} → Dragon's Fury : 20 Attach a Basic {R} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your {N} Pokémon. {R}{W}{C} → Slashing Claw : 120
115.flavorText: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

116.name: N's Reshiram
116.attacksText: {R}{L} → Powerful Rage : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. {R}{R}{L}{C} → Virtuous Flame : 170
116.flavorText: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

117.name: Hop's Snorlax
117.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Extra Helpings Attacks used by your Hop's Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . The effect of Extra Helpings doesn't stack. {C}{C}{C} → Dynamic Press : 140 This Pokémon also does 80 damage to itself.
117.flavorText: This gluttonous Pokémon eats constantly, apart from when it's asleep. It devours nearly 900 pounds of food per day.

118.name: Sentret
118.attacksText: {C} → Smack : 20
118.flavorText: This Pokémon is extremely cautious. Its supple tail is well muscled and firm to the touch.

119.name: Furret
119.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 40 {C}{C} → Jet Headbutt : 70
119.flavorText: It raises its offspring inside a long, narrow nest. Once they're old enough, it takes them outside the nest to prepare them for independence.

120.name: Dunsparce
120.evolves: Evolves into Dudunsparce or Dudunsparce ex
120.attacksText: {C} → Trading Places Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {C}{C} → Ram : 20
120.flavorText: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

121.name: Dudunsparce ex
121.attacksText: {C} → Tenacious Tail : 60× This attack does 60 damage for each of your opponent's Pokémon ex in play. {C}{C}{C} → Destructive Drill : 150 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

122.name: Kecleon
122.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Stealth Attack : 80 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
122.flavorText: It changes its hue to blend into its surroundings. If no one takes notice of it for too long, it will pout and never reveal itself.

123.name: Tropius
123.attacksText: {C} → Fruit Bearing Discard a card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards. {C}{C} → Gust : 50
123.flavorText: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

124.name: Audino
124.attacksText: {C} → Beckon Put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand. {C}{C}{C} → Zen Headbutt : 70
124.flavorText: Audino's sense of hearing is superb. Not even a pebble rolling along over a mile away will escape Audino's ears.

125.name: Minccino
125.attacksText: {C} → Slap : 20
125.flavorText: These Pokémon like things neat and tidy. They are always sweeping and dusting their habitat, using their tails as brooms.

126.name: Cinccino
126.attacksText: {C} → Tail Smack : 50
126.flavorText: The oil that seeps from its body is really smooth. For people troubled by bad skin, this oil is an effective treatment.

127.name: Noibat
127.evolves: Evolves into Noivern , Noivern ex , or Noivern- GX
127.attacksText: {C} → Rapid Draw : 10 Draw a card.
127.flavorText: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

128.name: Noivern
128.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Tuning Echo If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, ignore all Energy in the cost of Frightening Howl used by this Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Frightening Howl : 110 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
128.flavorText: Ultrasonic waves emitted by a Noivern can pulverize a large boulder. This Pokémon has a cruel disposition.

129.name: Komala
129.attacksText: {C} → Slumbering Smack : 30 Both Active Pokémon are now Asleep. During your next turn, attacks used by this Pokémon do 100 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .
129.flavorText: Komala spends its entire life sleeping. It feeds on leaves that contain a potent poison only Komala can break down.

130.name: Drampa
130.attacksText: {C} → Ram : 30 {C}{C} → Dragon Claw : 50
130.flavorText: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

131.name: Skwovet
131.evolves: Evolves into Greedent or Greedent ex
131.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {C}{C} → Gnaw : 20
131.flavorText: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

132.name: Greedent
132.attacksText: {C}{C} → Gluttonous Tail : 60 Draw 2 cards.
132.flavorText: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

133.name: Hop's Rookidee
133.evolves: Evolves into Hop's Corvisquire
133.attacksText: {C} → Intimidating Stare During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C} → Peck : 20
133.flavorText: The females are fussier than the males. If another creature dirties a female Rookidee's wings, it'll peck the offender relentlessly in a burning rage.

134.name: Hop's Corvisquire
134.evolves: Evolves from Hop's Rookidee and into Hop's Corviknight
134.attacksText: {C} → Speed Dive : 30 {C}{C}{C} → Razor Wing : 80
134.flavorText: This intelligent Pokémon will quickly learn how to use any tool it can hold in its beak or its talons.

135.name: Hop's Wooloo
135.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Smash Kick : 50
135.flavorText: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

136.name: Hop's Dubwool
136.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Defiant Horn When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. {C}{C}{C} → Headbutt : 80
136.flavorText: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

137.name: Cramorant
137.attacksText: {C}{C} → Ceaseless Spitting : 50× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.
137.flavorText: It's an incredibly poor learner because it uses the bare minimum amount of energy for its brain. It focuses on battling instead.

138.name: Hop's Cramorant
138.attacksText: {C} → Fickle Spitting : 120 If your opponent doesn't have exactly 3 or 4 Prize cards remaining, this attack does nothing.
138.flavorText: Cramorant instinctively swallow everything whole. They're at their most formidable when they're struggling to swallow overly large prey.

139.name: Lechonk
139.evolves: Evolves into Oinkologne or Oinkologne ex
139.attacksText: {C} → Ram : 10
139.flavorText: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

140.name: Oinkologne
140.attacksText: {C}{C} → Aromatic Stomps : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack. {C}{C}{C} → Headbutt Bounce : 120
140.flavorText: This is a meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep things tidy. It shrouds itself in a floral aroma that soothes the Pokémon around it.

141.name: Squawkabilly
141.attacksText: {C} → Add On Draw 2 cards. {C}{C} → Hyper Voice : 40
141.flavorText: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

151.attacksText: If the Lillie's Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card. · Pokémon Tool rule: You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. 156.attacksText: Count your Prize cards, shuffle them, and put them on the bottom of your deck. Then, take that many cards from the top of your deck and put them face down as your Prize cards. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

157.attacksText: Discard a Pokémon Tool and a Special Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

160.name: Maractus
160.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Exploding Needles If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, put 6 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. {C} → Corner : 20 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
160.flavorText: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They're jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

161.name: Articuno
161.attacksText: {C} → Frigid Fluttering Search your deck for up to 2 Basic {W} Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {W}{W}{C} → Ice Blast : 110
161.flavorText: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

162.name: Wailord
162.attacksText: {C}{C}{C}{C} → Hydro Pump : 10+ This attack does 50 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
162.flavorText: Its immense size is the reason for its popularity. Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing activity in various parts of the world.

163.name: Iono's Kilowattrel
163.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Flashing Draw You must discard a Basic {L} Energy from this Pokémon in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. {L}{C}{C} → Mach Bolt : 70
163.flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

164.name: Lillie's Ribombee
164.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Inviting Wink When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may have your opponent reveal their hand and you put any number of Basic Pokémon you find there onto their Bench. {P} → Magical Shot : 50
164.flavorText: Ribombee can sense when people or Pokémon are feeling down, and it will cheer them up with handmade pollen puffs.

165.name: Swinub
165.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {F} → Lunge Out : 10
165.flavorText: It searches for food by digging into the ground with its snout. Even frozen ground doesn't give it any trouble.

166.name: Lycanroc
166.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Spike-Clad When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Spiky Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Clamping Fangs : 40+ This attack does 40 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
166.flavorText: Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.

167.name: N's Reshiram
167.attacksText: {R}{L} → Powerful Rage : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. {R}{R}{L}{C} → Virtuous Flame : 170
167.flavorText: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

168.name: Furret
168.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 40 {C}{C} → Jet Headbutt : 70
168.flavorText: It raises its offspring inside a long, narrow nest. Once they're old enough, it takes them outside the nest to prepare them for independence.

169.name: Noibat
169.evolves: Evolves into Noivern , Noivern ex , or Noivern- GX
169.attacksText: {C} → Rapid Draw : 10 Draw a card.
169.flavorText: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

001.name: Caterpie
001.attacksText: {G} → Bug Bite : 20
001.flavorText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

002.name: Metapod
002.evolves: Evolves from Caterpie and into Butterfree
002.attacksText: {G} → Harden During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks if that damage is 60 or less.
002.flavorText: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

003.name: Butterfree
003.attacksText: {G} → Scale Hurricane : 60× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads. If at least 2 of them are heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
003.flavorText: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

004.name: Paras
004.attacksText: {G} → Leech Life : 10 Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
004.flavorText: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

005.name: Parasect
005.attacksText: {C} → Spore Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {G}{C} → Scissor Swing : 60+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.
005.flavorText: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

006.name: Petilil
006.evolves: Evolves into Lilligant or Hisuian Lilligant
006.attacksText: {G}{C} → Leaf Step : 30
006.flavorText: If the leaves on its head are pruned with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape.

007.name: Lilligant
007.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sunny Day Attacks used by your {G} Pokémon and {R} Pokémon do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {G}{C}{C} → Spinning Attack : 60
007.flavorText: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.

008.name: Maractus
008.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Exploding Needles If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, put 6 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. {C} → Corner : 20 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
008.flavorText: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They're jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

009.name: Karrablast
009.attacksText: {C} → Push Down : 10 Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
009.flavorText: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet's shell. Karrablast doesn't eat the shell—it eats only the contents.

010.name: Foongus
010.evolves: Evolves into Amoonguss or Amoonguss ex
010.attacksText: {G} → Spore Ball : 10 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
010.flavorText: This Pokémon prefers damp places. It spurts out poison spores to repel approaching enemies.

011.name: Amoonguss ex
011.attacksText: {G} → Spore Ball : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {G}{C} → Champignon's Swing : 100+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 80 more damage. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

012.name: Shelmet
012.attacksText: {G}{C} → Shell Smack : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.
012.flavorText: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

013.name: Accelgor
013.attacksText: {G}{C} → Poisonous Ploy : 70 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned. Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
013.flavorText: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

014.name: Durant
014.attacksText: {G}{C} → Crunch : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
014.flavorText: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

015.name: Virizion
015.attacksText: {G}{C} → Leaf Drain : 30 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. {G}{C}{C} → Slicing Blade : 100
015.flavorText: A legend tells of this Pokémon working together with Cobalion and Terrakion to protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.

016.name: Sprigatito
016.attacksText: {C} → Tons of Treading : 10× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
016.flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

017.name: Floragato
017.evolves: Evolves from Sprigatito and into Meowscarada ex or Meowscarada
017.attacksText: {C}{C} → Magical Leaf : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage, and heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
017.flavorText: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

018.name: Meowscarada
018.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Showtime Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon. {C}{C} → Rising Bloom : 90+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 90 more damage.
018.flavorText: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

019.name: Nymble
019.attacksText: {C} → Rear Kick : 20
019.flavorText: It's highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

020.name: Magmar
020.attacksText: {R}{C} → Searing Flame : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
020.flavorText: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

021.name: Magmortar
021.evolves: Evolves from Magmar and into Magmortar LV. X
021.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Magma Surge During Pokémon Checkup, put 3 more damage counters on your opponent's Burned Pokémon. {R}{R}{C} → Searing Flame : 90 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
021.flavorText: When shooting 3,600 degree Fahrenheit fireballs from its arms, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.

022.name: Torchic
022.attacksText: {R}{C} → Scratch : 30
022.flavorText: In its belly, it has a sac filled with burning fire, meaning that Torchic feels as warm as a hot-water bottle if you hug it.

023.name: Combusken
023.evolves: Evolves from Torchic and into Blaziken or Blaziken ex
023.attacksText: {R}{C} → Slash : 50
023.flavorText: When it enters battle, the flame inside its body burns stronger. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

024.name: Blaziken ex
024.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Seething Spirit Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon. {R}{C} → Smolder-sault : 200 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

025.name: Torkoal
025.attacksText: {R} → Live Coal : 20 {R}{R}{C} → Heat Blast : 110
025.flavorText: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.

026.name: N's Darumaka
026.attacksText: {C}{C} → Rolling Tackle : 20 {R}{R}{C} → Flare : 50
026.flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

027.name: N's Darmanitan
027.attacksText: {C}{C} → Back Draft : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each Basic Energy card in your opponent's discard pile. {R}{R}{C} → Flamebody Cannon : 90 Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack also does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
027.flavorText: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

028.name: Larvesta
028.attacksText: {C} → Will-O-Wisp : 10
028.flavorText: In ancient times, Larvesta was worshiped as the emissary of the sun. However, it was also viewed as a burden since it often caused forest fires.

029.name: Volcarona
029.attacksText: {R}{C} → Smoldering Scales : 80
029.flavorText: This Pokémon scatters burning scales. Most of the danger of these scales is not in their heat—it's in the way they rob the surrounding air of oxygen.

035.flavorText: The leaf on its head is naturally dirt repellent and will stay clean even after transporting Pokémon that are covered in mud.

036.name: Lombre
036.evolves: Evolves from Lotad and into Ludicolo
036.attacksText: {W}{W} → Aqua Slash : 70 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
036.flavorText: Old folklore in Kitakami tells of a mischievous child who was reborn as a Pokémon.

037.name: Ludicolo
037.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Vibrant Dance All of your Pokémon in play get +40 HP. The effect of Vibrant Dance doesn't stack. {W}{W}{C} → Hydro Splash : 130
037.flavorText: There are structures throughout its whole body that produce energy when hit by sound waves with a cheerful rhythm.

038.name: Wingull
038.attacksText: {C} → Flap : 20
038.flavorText: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

039.name: Pelipper
039.evolves: Evolves from Wingull
039.attacksText: {C} → Spit Up : 30 {W}{C} → Speed Dive : 70
039.flavorText: It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm.

040.name: Wailmer
040.evolves: Evolves into Wailord or Wailord ex
040.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Surf : 60
040.flavorText: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

041.name: Wailord
041.evolves: Evolves from Wailmer
041.attacksText: {C}{C}{C}{C} → Hydro Pump : 10+ This attack does 50 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
041.flavorText: Its immense size is the reason for its popularity. Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing activity in various parts of the world.

042.name: Regice
042.attacksText: {W}{C} → Icicle : 30 {W}{C}{C} → Blizzard : 90 This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
042.flavorText: With cold air that can reach temperatures as low as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly freezes any creature that approaches it.

043.name: Veluza ex
043.attacksText: {W} → Razor Fin : 30 {W}{W}{C} → Purging Strike : 120+ You may discard your hand. If you discarded any cards in this way, this attack does 120 more damage. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

044.name: Alolan Geodude
044.attacksText: {C} → Knuckle Punch : 10 {L}{C} → Tiny Charge : 30
044.flavorText: If you step on a Geodude sleeping on the ground, you'll hear a zapping sound and feel a tingling shock throughout your entire body.

045.name: Alolan Graveler
045.evolves: Evolves from Alolan Geodude and into Alolan Golem
045.attacksText: {C} → Rolling Tackle : 30 {L}{C} → Electric Punch : 50
045.flavorText: Graveler's entire body is electrically charged due to the stones it likes to eat. It is a very quick-tempered Pokémon.

046.name: Alolan Golem
046.evolves: Evolves from Alolan Graveler
046.attacksText: {L} → Electromagnetic Catapult : 70× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 70 damage for each heads. {L}{C} → Megaton Fall : 160 This Pokémon also does 40 damage to itself.
046.flavorText: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn't fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

047.name: Iono's Voltorb
047.evolves: Evolves into Iono's Electrode
047.attacksText: {C}{C} → Voltaic Chain : 20+ This attack does 20 more damage for each {L} Energy attached to all of your Iono's Pokémon.
047.flavorText: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

048.name: Iono's Electrode
048.attacksText: {L}{L} → Thump-Thump Boom This Pokémon does 100 damage to itself. Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out. {L}{L}{C} → Electric Ball : 100
048.flavorText: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

049.name: N's Joltik
049.attacksText: {C}{C} → Zapping Short : 30 Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon. If you discarded a Pokémon Tool in this way, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

050.name: Togedemaru
050.attacksText: {L}{C} → Toge Spark : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
050.flavorText: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

051.name: Tapu Koko ex
051.attacksText: {L}{C} → Linked Lightning : 60+ This attack does 20 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

052.name: Iono's Tadbulb
052.attacksText: {L}{C} → Tiny Charge : 30
052.flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

053.name: Iono's Bellibolt ex
053.evolves: Evolves from Iono's Tadbulb
053.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Electric Streamer As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic {L} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Iono's Pokémon. {L}{L}{L}{C} → Thunderous Bolt : 230 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

054.name: Iono's Wattrel
054.attacksText: {L} → Quick Attack : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
054.flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

055.name: Iono's Kilowattrel
055.evolves: Evolves from Iono's Wattrel
055.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Flashing Draw You must discard a Basic {L} Energy from this Pokémon in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. {L}{C}{C} → Mach Bolt : 70

056.name: Lillie's Clefairy ex
056.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Fairy Zone The Weakness of each of your opponent's {N} Pokémon in play is now {P}. (Apply Weakness as ×2.) {P}{C} → Full Moon Rondo : 20+ This attack does 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) . · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

057.name: Alolan Marowak

058.name: Mr. Mime
058.attacksText: {P} → Mimic Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw a card for each card in your opponent's hand. {P}{C} → Psy Bolt : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

059.name: Shuppet
059.evolves: Evolves into Banette , Banette- GX , or Banette ex
059.attacksText: {P} → Spooky Shot : 20
059.flavorText: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

060.name: Banette
060.attacksText: {P} → Cursed Words Your opponent chooses 3 cards from their hand and shuffles those cards into their deck. {P}{C} → Spooky Shot : 70
060.flavorText: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

061.name: Beldum
061.evolves: Evolves into Metang
061.attacksText: {P} → Spinning Attack : 10 {P}{P} → Beam : 30
061.flavorText: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground's natural magnetism, letting it float.

062.name: Metang
062.evolves: Evolves from Beldum and into Metagross
062.attacksText: {P} → Psypunch : 30 {P}{P} → Zen Headbutt : 50
062.flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

063.name: Metagross
063.evolves: Evolves from Metang
063.attacksText: {P} → Wrack Down : 60 {P}{P} → Conjoined Beams : 130+ If Beldum and Metang are on your Bench, this attack does 150 more damage.
063.flavorText: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

064.name: N's Sigilyph
064.attacksText: {P} → Psychic Sphere : 20 {P}{C}{C} → Victory Symbol If you use this attack when you have exactly 1 Prize card remaining, you win this game.
064.flavorText: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

065.name: Oricorio
065.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {P} → Spooky Shot : 20
065.flavorText: This form of Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. It uses ethereal dance steps to call forth the spirits of the dead.

066.name: Lillie's Cutiefly
066.attacksText: {P} → Hold Still Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
066.flavorText: When it senses the auras of people or Pokémon who are having fun, it will draw close and give them a painful poke with its long proboscis.

067.name: Lillie's Ribombee
067.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Inviting Wink When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may have your opponent reveal their hand and you put any number of Basic Pokémon you find there onto their Bench. {P} → Magical Shot : 50
067.flavorText: Ribombee can sense when people or Pokémon are feeling down, and it will cheer them up with handmade pollen puffs.

068.name: Lillie's Comfey
068.attacksText: {C} → Inviting Flowers You may search your deck for any number of Basic Lillie's Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {P} → Fade Out : 30 Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.
068.flavorText: It uses its vine to pick flowers. The flowers that Comfey attaches to itself develop healing properties.

069.name: Mimikyu ex
069.attacksText: {P}{C} → Mischievous Hands Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon and put 3 damage counters on each of them. {P}{P}{C} → Ghostly Trip : 120 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

070.name: Dhelmise
070.attacksText: {P}{C}{C} → Bind Down : 60 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. {P}{P}{C}{C} → Anchor Smash : 130
070.flavorText: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

071.name: Impidimp
071.attacksText: {P} → Gentle Slap : 20
071.flavorText: They live in groups, pestering and playing pranks on each other to polish their troublemaking skills.

072.name: Morgrem

072.attacksText: {P} → Light Punch : 30 {P}{C} → Smash Kick : 50
072.flavorText: This Pokémon absorbs negative emotions and turns them into energy. It's popular with people who tend to think gloomy thoughts.

073.name: Grimmsnarl
073.attacksText: {P} → Shadowy Knot : 50× This attack does 50 damage for each {C} in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost. {P}{C} → Mega Punch : 120
073.flavorText: It lives deep within the forest. Even after evolving into this splendid form, it hasn't given up on its petty misdeeds and pranks.

074.name: Milcery
074.evolves: Evolves into Alcremie or Alcremie ex
074.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 20
074.flavorText: When attacked, it tackles its foe and covers them in cream. With its foe either blinded or astonished by deliciousness, Milcery flees.

075.name: Alcremie ex
075.evolves: Evolves from Milcery
075.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Confectionary Gift Once during your turn, you may heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. {P}{C}{C} → Whipped Shot : 160 · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

076.name: Cubone
076.evolves: Evolves into Marowak or Alolan Marowak
076.attacksText: {C} → Stampede : 10 {C}{C} → Light Punch : 20

077.name: Swinub
077.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {F} → Lunge Out : 10
077.flavorText: It searches for food by digging into the ground with its snout. Even frozen ground doesn't give it any trouble.

078.name: Piloswine
078.evolves: Evolves from Swinub and into Mamoswine or Mamoswine ex
078.attacksText: {C} → Strength : 20 {F}{F} → Impaling Tusk : 50
078.flavorText: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is resistant to the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.

079.name: Mamoswine ex

Then, shuffle your deck. {F}{F} → Rumbling March : 180+ This attack does 40 more damage for each Stage 2 Pokémon on your Bench. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

080.name: Larvitar
080.evolves: Evolves into Pupitar or Dark Pupitar
080.attacksText: {C}{C} → Crunch : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
080.flavorText: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

081.name: Pupitar
081.evolves: Evolves from Larvitar and into Tyranitar or Tyranitar ex
081.attacksText: {C}{C} → Take Down : 60 This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.
081.flavorText: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

082.name: Regirock
082.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Rock Armor If this Pokémon has any Energy attached, it takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{F}{F} → Breaching Lariat : 120 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

083.attacksText: {C} → Corkscrew Punch : 10 {C}{C}{C} → Focus Fist : 50 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

084.evolves: Evolves into Lycanroc or Lycanroc ex

085.name: Lycanroc
085.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Spike-Clad When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Spiky Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Clamping Fangs : 40+ This attack does 40 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

087.name: Hop's Sandaconda

092.name: Weezing

093.name: Paldean Wooper

094.name: Paldean Clodsire ex

096.attacksText: {D}{C} → Thieving Swipe : 30 Your opponent reveals their hand, and you choose a card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck.

097.name: N's Zorua
