043.flavorText: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

044.name: Rapid Strike Urshifu
044.attacksText: {C} → Slashing Claw : 40 {W}{C} → Rapid-Fisted Rush : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each of your Rapid Strike Pokémon in play.
044.flavorText: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in defeating foes by raining many blows down on them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.

045.name: Ice Rider Calyrex V
045.evolves: Evolves into Ice Rider Calyrex VMAX
045.attacksText: {W} → Pierce : 40 {W}{W}{C} → Glacial Lance : 200 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

046.name: Ice Rider Calyrex VMAX
046.evolves: Evolves from Ice Rider Calyrex V
046.attacksText: {C}{C} → Ride of the High King : 10+ This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. {W}{W} → Max Lance : 10+ You may discard up to 2 Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 120 more damage for each card you discarded in this way. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

047.name: Mareep
047.evolves: Evolves into Flaaffy or Dark Flaaffy
047.attacksText: {C} → Growl During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {L}{C} → Static Shock : 20
047.flavorText: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

048.name: Flaaffy
048.evolves: Evolves from Mareep and into Ampharos , Ampharos- GX , or Ampharos ex
048.attacksText: {L}{C} → Electro Ball : 50
048.flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

049.name: Ampharos
049.attacksText: {L} → Thunder Shock : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {L}{C} → Searchlight Tail : 90+ Your opponent reveals their hand. If you find any Energy cards there, this attack does 90 more damage.
049.flavorText: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

050.name: Blitzle
050.attacksText: {L} → Thunder Spear This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
050.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

051.name: Zebstrika
051.evolves: Evolves from Blitzle
051.attacksText: {C} → Coordinated Bolt : 30+ If 1 of your other Rapid Strike Pokémon used an attack during your last turn, this attack does 90 more damage. {L}{C}{C} → Spark Rush : 90× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.
051.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

052.name: Thundurus
052.attacksText: {L} → Assisting Spark : 30 You may attach a {L} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {L}{L}{C} → Thunder : 130 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
052.flavorText: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

053.name: Zeraora V
053.evolves: Evolves into Zeraora VMAX or Zeraora VSTAR
053.attacksText: {L}{C}{C} → Cross Fist : 100 If 1 of your other Rapid Strike Pokémon used an attack during your last turn, this attack also does 160 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

054.name: Galarian Slowpoke
054.evolves: Evolves into Galarian Slowbro or Galarian Slowking
054.attacksText: {C} → Sharpness : 10 {C}{C} → Headbutt : 20
054.flavorText: Because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.

055.name: Gastly
055.evolves: Evolves into Haunter or Dark Haunter
055.attacksText: {P} → Sleep Pulse : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
055.flavorText: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.

056.name: Haunter
056.evolves: Evolves from Gastly and into Gengar , Mega Gengar ex , or Gengar ex
056.attacksText: {P} → Will-O-Wisp : 30
056.flavorText: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.

057.name: Gengar
057.evolves: Evolves from Haunter and into Gengar LV. X
057.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Last Gift If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C}{C} → Pain Burst : 10+ This attack does 40 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
057.flavorText: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

058.name: Galarian Articuno V
058.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Reconstitute You must discard 2 cards from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw a card. {P}{C}{C} → Psyray : 110 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

059.name: Ralts
059.attacksText: {P} → Confuse Ray Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
059.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

060.name: Kirlia
060.evolves: Evolves from Ralts and into Gardevoir , Gallade , […] Gardevoir ex , Mega Gardevoir ex
060.attacksText: {P} → Mirage Step Search your deck for up to 3 Kirlia and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
060.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

061.name: Gardevoir
061.evolves: Evolves from Kirlia and into Gardevoir LV. X
061.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Shining Arcana Once during your turn, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and attach any number of basic Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Put the other cards into your hand. {C}{C}{C} → Brainwave : 60+ This attack does 30 more damage for each {P} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
061.flavorText: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

062.name: Shuppet
062.evolves: Evolves into Banette , Banette- GX , or Banette ex
062.attacksText: {P} → Will-O-Wisp : 20
062.flavorText: There's a proverb that says, “Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk.”

063.name: Banette
063.evolves: Evolves from Shuppet
063.attacksText: {P} → Resolute Spite : 20× Put up to 7 damage counters on this Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter you placed in this way. {P}{C} → Eerie Light : 50 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
063.flavorText: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

064.name: Cresselia
064.evolves: Evolves into Cresselia LV. X
064.attacksText: {P} → Crescent Glow Search your deck for a {P} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. If you go second and it's your first turn, instead search for up to 3 {P} Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {P}{P} → Photon Laser : 30+ If you have at least 5 Energy in play, this attack does 90 more damage.
064.flavorText: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

065.name: Golett
065.attacksText: {P} → Pound : 10 {P}{C} → Punch : 30
065.flavorText: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

066.name: Golurk
066.attacksText: {P}{C}{C} → Reinforced Punch : 60+ If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 90 more damage. {P}{P}{C}{C} → Megaton Fall : 190 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
066.flavorText: There's a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn't been proven.

067.name: Swirlix
067.attacksText: {C}{C} → Draining Kiss : 20 Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
067.flavorText: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix's fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

068.name: Slurpuff
068.attacksText: {C}{C} → Follow the Scent Flip 3 coins. Put a number of cards up to the number of heads from your discard pile into your hand. {C}{C}{C} → Fairy Wind : 80
068.flavorText: Slurpuff's fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.

069.name: Inkay
069.attacksText: {P} → Spinning Attack : 20
069.flavorText: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

070.name: Malamar
070.evolves: Evolves from Inkay
070.attacksText: {P} → Rapid Strike Tentacles : 40× Reveal any number of Rapid Strike cards from your hand. This attack does 40 damage for each card you revealed in this way. Then, shuffle those cards into your deck.
070.flavorText: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

071.name: Hatenna
071.attacksText: {P} → Psyshot : 20
071.flavorText: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

072.name: Hattrem
072.evolves: Evolves from Hatenna and into Hatterene
072.attacksText: {P} → Spiral Drain : 30 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
072.flavorText: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

073.name: Hatterene
073.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Witch Rondo Once during your turn, you may switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. {C}{C} → Psychic : 30+ This attack does 50 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
073.flavorText: If you're too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

074.name: Shadow Rider Calyrex V
074.evolves: Evolves into Shadow Rider Calyrex VMAX
074.attacksText: {P} → Shadow Mist : 10 During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Special Energy or Stadium cards from their hand. {C}{C}{C} → Astral Barrage Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon and put 5 damage counters on each of them. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

075.name: Shadow Rider Calyrex VMAX
075.evolves: Evolves from Shadow Rider Calyrex V
075.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Underworld Door Once during your turn, you may attach a {P} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched {P} Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, draw 2 cards. {C}{C}{C} → Max Geist : 10+ This attack does 30 more damage for each {P} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

076.name: Diglett
076.evolves: Evolves into Dugtrio or Dark Dugtrio
076.attacksText: {F} → Dig : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
076.flavorText: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

077.name: Dugtrio
077.attacksText: {F}{C} → Triple Heads : 60× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads. If all of them are heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
077.flavorText: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.

078.name: Galarian Farfetch'd
078.attacksText: {F} → Puncture : 20 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
078.flavorText: The stalks of leeks are thicker and longer in the Galar region. Farfetch'd that adapted to these stalks took on a unique form.

079.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
079.attacksText: {F} → Peck : 40 {F}{C}{C} → Leek Strike : 70+ If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 90 more damage, and this attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
079.flavorText: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

080.name: Galarian Zapdos V
080.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Fighting Instinct This Pokémon's attacks cost {C} less for each of your opponent's Pokémon V in play. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Thunderous Kick : 170 Before doing damage, discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

081.name: Gallade
081.attacksText: {P} → Feint : 60 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance. {C}{C} → Dynablade : 60× This attack does 60 damage for each of your opponent's Pokémon V in play.
081.flavorText: Sharply attuned to others' wishes for help, this Pokémon seeks out those in need and aids them in battle.

082.name: Galarian Yamask
082.attacksText: {C}{C} → Brutal Swing : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
082.flavorText: It's said that this Pokémon was formed when an ancient clay tablet was drawn to a vengeful spirit.

083.name: Galarian Runerigus
083.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Spiteful Slate If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon VMAX (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , put damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon equal to the damage done to this Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Energy Press : 60+ This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
083.flavorText: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

084.name: Crabrawler
084.attacksText: {F} → Light Punch : 20 {F}{C} → Double Lariat : 40× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.
084.flavorText: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

085.name: Crabominable
085.attacksText: {F}{C}{C} → Double Lariat : 90× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Crabhammer : 130
085.flavorText: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

086.name: Rockruff
086.evolves: Evolves into Lycanroc , Lycanroc- GX , or Lycanroc ex
086.attacksText: {F}{F} → Crunch : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
086.flavorText: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

087.name: Lycanroc
087.attacksText: {F}{F} → Rogue Fangs : 80+ This attack does 10 more damage for each Single Strike Pokémon in your discard pile.
087.flavorText: They live alone without forming packs. They will only listen to orders from Trainers who can draw out their true power.

088.name: Passimian
088.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Throwing Coach Your Rapid Strike Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Benched Pokémon V and Benched Pokémon- GX (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . You can't apply more than 1 Throwing Coach Ability at a time. {F} → Fling This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
088.flavorText: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

089.name: Sandaconda V
089.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Wall of Sand This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{F}{C} → Land Crush : 140 · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

090.name: Sandaconda VMAX
090.attacksText: {F} → Sand Pulse : 60 This attack also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{F}{C} → G-Max Cyclone : 180 Move any amount of Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

091.name: Clobbopus
091.attacksText: {C}{C} → Beat : 30
091.flavorText: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

092.name: Grapploct
092.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Stranglehold Master As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is {C}{C} more. {F}{C}{C} → Synchro Buster : 80+ If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 80 more damage.
092.flavorText: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

093.name: Kubfu
093.evolves: Evolves into Rapid Strike Urshifu or Single Strike Urshifu
093.attacksText: {C} → Training Search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C}{C} → Elbow Strike : 60
093.flavorText: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

094.name: Koffing
094.evolves: Evolves into Weezing , Galarian Weezing , or Dark Weezing
094.attacksText: {D}{C} → Smog : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
094.flavorText: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

095.name: Weezing
095.attacksText: {D} → Mixin' Toxin Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. Attach a {D} Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {D}{C} → Smog Burst : 20+ This attack does 20 more damage for each {D} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.
095.flavorText: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

096.name: Galarian Weezing
096.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Energy Factory Each basic {D} Energy attached to your Pokémon that have “Weezing” in their name provides {D}{D} Energy. You can't apply more than 1 Energy Factory Ability at a time. {D}{C} → Suffocating Gas : 50
096.flavorText: Long ago, during a time when droves of factories fouled the air with pollution, Weezing changed into this form for some reason.

097.name: Galarian Moltres V
097.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Direflame Wings Once during your turn, you may attach a {D} Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. You can't use more than 1 Direflame Wings Ability each turn. {D}{D}{C} → Aura Burn : 190 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

098.name: Galarian Slowking
098.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Mysterious Potion Once during your turn, you may choose 1 of your Pokémon and flip a coin. If heads, heal 90 damage from that Pokémon. If tails, put 3 damage counters on that Pokémon. {D}{C}{C} → Spray Fluid : 90
098.flavorText: While chanting strange spells, this Pokémon combines its internal toxins with what it's eaten, creating strange potions.

099.name: Galarian Slowking V
099.attacksText: {C} → Concoction Discard a card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards. {D}{C} → Word of Ruin At the end of your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon will be Knocked Out. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

100.name: Mawile
100.attacksText: {M} → Powerful Vise : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {C}{C}{C} → Piercing Strike : 100 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
100.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

101.name: Bronzor
101.flavorText: Polishing Bronzor to a shine makes its surface reflect the truth, according to common lore. Be that as it may, Bronzor hates being polished.

102.name: Bronzong
102.evolves: Evolves from Bronzor and into Bronzong BREAK
102.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Metal Transfer As often as you like during your turn, you may move a {M} Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. {M}{C}{C} → Zen Headbutt : 70
102.flavorText: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

103.name: Pawniard
103.attacksText: {C} → Swords Dance During your next turn, this Pokémon's Slash attack does 70 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M} → Slash : 10
103.flavorText: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

104.name: Bisharp
104.evolves: Evolves from Pawniard and into Kingambit
104.attacksText: {C} → Slash : 30 {M}{C}{C} → Steel Slice : 90+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {M} Pokémon, this attack does 90 more damage.
104.flavorText: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

105.name: Honedge
105.attacksText: {M} → Ambush : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
105.flavorText: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.

106.name: Doublade
106.evolves: Evolves from Honedge and into Aegislash or Aegislash ex
106.attacksText: {M}{C} → Cut Down : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
106.flavorText: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

107.name: Aegislash
107.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Stance Change Once during your turn, you may switch this Pokémon with an Aegislash in your hand. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon. {M}{M}{C} → Full Metal Blade : 210 Discard 2 {M} Energy from this Pokémon.
107.flavorText: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

108.name: Aegislash
108.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Stance Change Once during your turn, you may switch this Pokémon with an Aegislash in your hand. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon. {M}{C} → Gigaton Bash : 70 During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Pokémon VMAX.
108.flavorText: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

109.name: Corviknight V
109.attacksText: {M} → Clutch : 30 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. {M}{M}{C} → Sky Hurricane : 190 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Sky Hurricane. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

110.name: Corviknight VMAX
110.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Lustrous Body Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's Abilities done to this Pokémon. {M}{M}{C} → G-Max Hurricane : 240 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use G-Max Hurricane. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

111.name: Spearow
111.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 20
111.flavorText: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

112.name: Fearow
112.attacksText: {C} → Drill Peck : 70
112.flavorText: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

113.name: Lickitung
113.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Tongue Slap : 50 {C}{C}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 80
113.flavorText: It licks filth clean with its tongue. Whatever it licks always stinks afterward, so whether it's really clean is…questionable.

114.name: Lickilicky
114.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Selickt Your opponent chooses to discard the top 3 cards of their deck or to discard 3 cards from their hand. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Pitch : 100 Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.
114.flavorText: It uses its tongue much more skillfully than its hands or its feet. It can deftly pick up a single small bean with its tongue.

115.name: Glameow
115.attacksText: {C} → Cat Kick : 10 {C}{C}{C} → Claw Slash : 40
115.flavorText: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

116.name: Purugly
116.attacksText: {C} → Caturday Draw 3 cards. If you do, this Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Claw Slash : 120
116.flavorText: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

117.name: Stoutland V
117.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Double Dip Fangs : 40 If your opponent's Basic Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 1 more Prize card. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Wild Tackle : 200 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

118.name: Bouffalant
118.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sap Sipper This Pokémon's attacks do 60 more damage to your opponent's {G} Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C}{C} → Head Charge : 120 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
118.flavorText: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

119.name: Drampa
119.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Spiral Rush : 30+ Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.
119.flavorText: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

120.name: Indeedee
120.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw 2 cards. {C}{C} → Hand Kinesis : 10× This attack does 10 damage for each card in your hand.
120.flavorText: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

121.name: Bruno
121.attacksText: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, draw 7 cards instead. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

122.name: Camping Gear
122.attacksText: Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. Your turn ends. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

123.name: Cheryl
123.attacksText: Heal all damage from each of your Evolution Pokémon. If you do, discard all Energy from the Pokémon that were healed in this way. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

124.name: Energy Recycler
124.attacksText: Shuffle up to 5 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

125.name: Escape Rope
125.attacksText: Each player switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. Your opponent switches first. (If a player does not have a Benched Pokémon, they don't switch Pokémon.) · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

126.name: Exp. Share

033.flavorText: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

034.name: Galarian Mr. Mime
034.attacksText: {W} → Pound : 10 {C}{C} → Find It Search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
034.flavorText: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It'll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a frozen floor.

035.name: Galarian Mr. Rime
035.attacksText: {C}{C} → Ball Juggling : 10+ Discard any number of Item cards that have the word “Ball” in their name from your hand. This attack does 40 more damage for each card you discarded in this way. {W}{C}{C} → Frost Smash : 80
035.flavorText: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

036.name: Remoraid
036.evolves: Evolves into Octillery or Dark Octillery
036.attacksText: {W} → Water Gun : 10 {C}{C} → Sharp Fin : 20
036.flavorText: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

037.name: Octillery
037.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Rapid Strike Search Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Rapid Strike card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Rapid Strike Search Ability each turn. {W}{C}{C} → Waterfall : 50
037.flavorText: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

038.name: Corphish
038.evolves: Evolves into Crawdaunt or Crawdaunt ex
038.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Bubble Beam : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
038.flavorText: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

039.name: Crawdaunt
039.evolves: Evolves from Corphish
039.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Knock Off : 60 Discard a random card from your opponent's hand. {W}{W}{C}{C} → Crabhammer : 140
039.flavorText: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

040.name: Empoleon V
040.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Emperor's Eyes As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Basic Pokémon in play have no Abilities, except for Pokémon with a Rule Box (Pokémon V, Pokémon- GX , etc. have Rule Boxes) . {W}{C}{C} → Swirling Slice : 130 Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

041.name: Frillish
041.evolves: Evolves into Jellicent or Jellicent ex
041.attacksText: {C} → Recover Discard an Energy from this Pokémon and heal all damage from it. {W} → Rain Splash : 10
041.flavorText: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

042.name: Jellicent
042.attacksText: {W}{W} → Sediment Sink : 10× This attack does 10 damage for each {W} Energy card in your discard pile.
042.flavorText: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

043.name: Bruxish
043.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 20 {W}{W}{C} → Surf : 110
043.flavorText: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie's spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

044.name: Electabuzz
044.evolves: Evolves into Electivire or Electivire ex
044.attacksText: {L} → Haymaker : 30 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Haymaker.
044.flavorText: While it's often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.

045.name: Electivire
045.evolves: Evolves from Electabuzz and into Electivire LV. X
045.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Tumbling Attack : 60+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage. {L}{L}{L}{C} → Lightning Slam : 180 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Lightning Slam.
045.flavorText: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

046.name: Shinx
046.evolves: Evolves into Luxio
046.attacksText: {L} → Rear Kick : 20
046.flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

047.name: Luxio
047.evolves: Evolves from Shinx and into Luxray or Luxray ex
047.attacksText: {L} → Jumping Kick This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {L}{C} → Head Bolt : 50
047.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

048.name: Luxray
048.evolves: Evolves from Luxio and into Luxray BREAK
048.attacksText: {L} → Electrostep This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {L}{C} → Scar Strikes : 100+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 100 more damage.
048.flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

049.name: Pachirisu
049.attacksText: {C} → Find a Friend Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Gnaw : 30
049.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

050.name: Tapu Koko V
050.attacksText: {L} → Electro Ball : 40 {L}{L}{C} → Spiral Thunder : 20+ This attack does 40 more damage for each Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

051.name: Tapu Koko VMAX
051.evolves: Evolves from Tapu Koko V
051.attacksText: {L}{L}{C} → Max Shock : 180 If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, their Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

052.name: Yamper
052.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Ball Search When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may put a Poké Ball card, a Great Ball card, or 1 of each from your discard pile into your hand. {C}{C} → Flop : 20
052.flavorText: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

053.name: Boltund
053.evolves: Evolves from Yamper
053.attacksText: {L} → Corner : 30 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. {L}{L}{C} → Defiant Spark : 130 If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack can be used for {L}.
053.flavorText: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

054.name: Galarian Slowpoke
054.evolves: Evolves into Galarian Slowbro or Galarian Slowking
054.attacksText: {C} → Tantailizing Flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.
054.flavorText: Because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.

055.name: Spoink
055.evolves: Evolves into Grumpig
055.attacksText: {P} → Headbutt Bounce : 10 {P}{C} → Power Gem : 30
055.flavorText: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

056.name: Grumpig
056.attacksText: {P}{C} → Dazzle Dance : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {P}{P}{C} → Power Gem : 120
056.flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

057.name: Baltoy
057.evolves: Evolves into Claydol or Claydol ex
057.attacksText: {P}{C} → Self-Destruct : 60 This Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.
057.flavorText: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

058.name: Claydol
058.evolves: Evolves from Baltoy
058.attacksText: {C} → Power Split Attach {P} Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like until your Pokémon and your opponent's Pokémon have the same total amount of Energy attached. {P}{P}{C} → Psyshot : 100
058.flavorText: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

059.name: Chimecho
059.attacksText: {C} → Minor Errand-Running Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C} → Pleasant Tone : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
059.flavorText: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

060.name: Espurr
060.attacksText: {P}{C} → Focused Wish : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
060.flavorText: There's enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can't be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

061.name: Meowstic
061.evolves: Evolves from Espurr
061.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Ear Moves Once during your turn, you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {P}{C} → Psychic Sphere : 50
061.flavorText: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

062.name: Mimikyu V
062.evolves: Evolves into Mimikyu VMAX
062.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Dummy Doll When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may prevent all damage done to this Mimikyu V by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon until the end of your opponent's next turn. {P} → Jealous Eyes Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each Prize card your opponent has taken. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

063.name: Necrozma V
063.attacksText: {P} → Prismatic Ray : 20 This attack also does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {P}{P}{C} → Special Laser : 100+ If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 120 more damage. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

064.name: Dottler
064.evolves: Evolves from Blipbug and into Orbeetle
064.attacksText: {P} → Radar Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put them back in any order. {C}{C} → Ram : 20
064.flavorText: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

065.name: Orbeetle
065.attacksText: {C} → Evomancy For each Energy attached to this Pokémon, search your deck for a Stage 2 Pokémon, except Orbeetle, and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {P}{C}{C} → Zen Headbutt : 120
065.flavorText: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

066.name: Mankey
066.evolves: Evolves into Primeape or Dark Primeape
066.attacksText: {F}{C} → Focus Fist : 50 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
066.flavorText: If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.

067.name: Primeape
067.evolves: Evolves from Mankey and into Annihilape or Annihilape ex
067.attacksText: {C} → Field Crush : 20 If your opponent has a Stadium in play, discard it. {F}{F} → Steamin' Mad Strike : 50× This attack does 50 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.
067.flavorText: The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.

068.name: Onix
068.evolves: Evolves into Steelix , Dark Steelix , or Steelix ex
068.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Rock Throw : 60 {F}{C}{C}{C}{C} → Rocky Tackle : 170 This Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.
068.flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

069.name: Cubone
069.evolves: Evolves into Marowak , Alolan Marowak , Alolan Marowak- GX , or Dark Marowak
069.attacksText: {F} → Beat : 10 {F}{C} → Headbutt : 30
069.flavorText: It wears its mother's skull on its head, so no one knows what its bare face looks like. However, it's clear that it's always crying.

070.name: Marowak
070.evolves: Evolves from Cubone and into Marowak BREAK
070.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Battle Armor This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{C} → Bonemerang : 90× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.
070.flavorText: They thump their bones rhythmically to communicate among themselves. There are nearly 50 different rhythmic patterns.

071.name: Gligar
071.attacksText: {C}{C} → Slash : 30
071.flavorText: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

072.name: Gliscor
072.evolves: Evolves from Gligar and into Gliscor LV. X
072.attacksText: {C}{C} → Acrobatics : 20+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads. {F}{C}{C} → Guillotine : 90
072.flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

073.name: Timburr
073.attacksText: {C}{C} → Pound : 20
073.flavorText: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

074.name: Gurdurr
074.evolves: Evolves from Timburr and into Conkeldurr
074.attacksText: {C}{C} → Pound : 30 {F}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 60
074.flavorText: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there's skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

075.name: Conkeldurr
075.evolves: Evolves from Gurdurr
075.attacksText: {F}{C}{C} → Hammer Pressure : 90 If the Defending Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn. {F}{F}{C}{C} → Mega Punch : 150
075.flavorText: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

076.name: Mienfoo
076.attacksText: {F}{C} → Double Stab : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.
076.flavorText: They seclude themselves in the mountains and devote themselves to training. The form of their kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.

077.name: Mienshao
077.attacksText: {C} → Pound : 20 {F}{C} → Spinning Whip : 90 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.
077.flavorText: When Mienshao lets out a bizarre wail, you're in danger. A flurry of kicks and chops too fast to see is about to be unleashed!

078.name: Rolycoly
078.attacksText: {F} → Reckless Charge : 30 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
078.flavorText: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

079.name: Carkol
079.evolves: Evolves from Rolycoly and into Coalossal
079.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Tackle : 50 {F}{C}{C}{C} → Wild Tackle : 100 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
079.flavorText: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

080.name: Coalossal
080.attacksText: {C} → Coal Cannon : 90× Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage for each heads. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Wild Tackle : 200 This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.
080.flavorText: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

081.name: Silicobra
081.attacksText: {F} → Tail Whap : 10 {F}{F}{C} → Mud Shot : 60
081.flavorText: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

082.name: Sandaconda
082.attacksText: {F} → Big Sand Cannon : 60× Discard the top 6 cards of your deck. This attack does 60 damage for each {F} Energy card you discarded in this way. {F}{F}{C} → Skull Bash : 120
082.flavorText: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

083.name: Falinks
083.attacksText: {F}{C} → Rapid Strike Squad : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each of your Rapid Strike Pokémon in play.
083.flavorText: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

084.name: Stonjourner
084.attacksText: {F}{C} → Land's Pulse : 30+ If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 30 more damage. {F}{F}{C} → Giga Hammer : 120 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Giga Hammer.
084.flavorText: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

085.name: Single Strike Urshifu V
085.evolves: Evolves into Single Strike Urshifu VMAX
085.attacksText: {F} → Laser Focus Search your deck for up to 2 {F} Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {F}{F}{C} → Impact Blow : 180 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Impact Blow. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

086.name: Single Strike Urshifu VMAX
086.evolves: Evolves from Single Strike Urshifu V
086.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Beatdown : 100 {F}{F}{F}{C} → G-Max One Blow : 270 Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

087.name: Rapid Strike Urshifu V
087.evolves: Evolves into Rapid Strike Urshifu VMAX
087.attacksText: {F} → Strafe : 30 You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {F}{F}{C} → Hundred Furious Blows : 150 · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

088.name: Rapid Strike Urshifu VMAX
088.evolves: Evolves from Rapid Strike Urshifu V
088.attacksText: {F} → Gale Thrust : 30+ If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 120 more damage. {F}{F}{C} → G-Max Rapid Flow Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

089.name: Zubat
089.evolves: Evolves into Golbat or Dark Golbat
089.attacksText: {C} → Hide in Shadows Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {C}{C} → Speed Dive : 20
089.flavorText: Their skin is so thin that they'll be burned if sunlight hits them. When it gets cold out, they gather together to warm one another's bodies.

090.name: Golbat
090.evolves: Evolves from Zubat and into Crobat or Crobat ex
090.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Discreet Draw When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may draw 2 cards. {C}{C} → Air Slash : 50 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
090.flavorText: They can suck down over 10 ounces of blood in one go. They have been known to drink so much blood that they can no longer fly.

091.name: Crobat
091.evolves: Evolves from Golbat and into Crobat BREAK
091.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Drastic Draw When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may draw 3 cards. {C}{C} → Wing Attack : 100
091.flavorText: It feeds on the blood of living people and Pokémon. If it can't drink any blood for even a short while, it becomes weak and unable to fly.

092.name: Galarian Slowbro
092.attacksText: {D} → Splattering Poison Both Active Pokémon are now Poisoned. {D}{C}{C} → Unhinged Hammer : 100+ If this Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 120 more damage.
092.flavorText: If this Pokémon squeezes the tongue of the Shellder biting it, the Shellder will launch a toxic liquid from the tip of its shell.

093.name: Murkrow
093.evolves: Evolves into Honchkrow or Honchkrow- GX
093.attacksText: {C} → Scout Your opponent reveals their hand. {D}{C} → Peck : 20
093.flavorText: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

094.name: Honchkrow
094.evolves: Evolves from Murkrow and into Honchkrow LV. X
094.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Insomnia This Pokémon can't be Asleep. {D}{C}{C} → Voltage Dive : 80+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 80 more damage.
094.flavorText: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

095.name: Houndour
095.evolves: Evolves into Houndoom , Dark Houndoom , or Houndoom ex
095.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 20
095.flavorText: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

096.name: Houndoom
096.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Single Strike Roar Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Single Strike Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Single Strike Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. {D}{C} → Darkness Fang : 50
096.flavorText: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

097.name: Tyranitar V
097.attacksText: {D}{C}{C} → Cragalanche : 60 Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck. {D}{D}{C}{C} → Single Strike Crush : 240 Discard the top 4 cards of your deck. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

098.name: Morpeko
098.attacksText: {C} → Gather Food Put an Item card from your discard pile into your hand. {D} → Hangry Tackle : 20+ If you have no cards in your hand, this attack does 90 more damage.
098.flavorText: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

099.name: Steelix
099.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Steel Swing : 80× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads. {M}{M}{M}{C}{C} → Heavy Impact : 200
099.flavorText: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

001.name: Yanma
001.evolves: Evolves into Yanmega or Yanmega ex
001.attacksText: {G} → Tackle : 10 {G}{C} → Wing Attack : 30
001.flavorText: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

002.name: Yanmega
002.evolves: Evolves from Yanma and into Yanmega BREAK
002.attacksText: {G} → Bug Bite : 30 {G}{C} → Nosedive : 120 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
002.flavorText: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

003.name: Celebi
003.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Woodland Stroll Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may look at the top 6 cards of your deck, reveal an Energy card you find there, and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. {G}{C}{C} → Leaf Step : 40
003.flavorText: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

004.name: Cacnea
004.evolves: Evolves into Cacturne or Cacturne ex
004.attacksText: {G}{G} → Pierce : 50
004.flavorText: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

005.name: Tropius
005.attacksText: {C} → Attach Leaves Attach up to 2 {G} Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. {G}{C} → Gust : 30
005.flavorText: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

006.name: Rowlet
006.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sky Circus If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs. {C}{C}{C} → Wind Shard This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
006.flavorText: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

007.name: Dartrix
007.evolves: Evolves from Rowlet and into Decidueye , Decidueye- GX , Decidueye ex , or Hisuian Decidueye
007.attacksText: {G} → Razor Leaf : 40
007.flavorText: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

008.name: Decidueye
008.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Deep Forest Camo Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon V and Pokémon- GX . {G}{C} → Splitting Arrow : 90 This attack also does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
008.flavorText: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

009.name: Dhelmise V
009.attacksText: {G} → Anchor Anger : 30+ If any of your {G} Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during their last turn, this attack does 90 more damage. {G}{G}{C} → Giga Hammer : 200 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Giga Hammer. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

010.name: Dhelmise VMAX
010.attacksText: {G} → Swinging Chain This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each {G} Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {G}{G}{C} → Max Anchor : 240 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Max Anchor. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

011.name: Grookey
011.attacksText: {C} → Fury Swipes : 10× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
011.flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

012.name: Thwackey
012.evolves: Evolves from Grookey and into Rillaboom
012.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Lay of the Land If you have a Stadium in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost. {G} → Branch Poke : 20
012.flavorText: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

013.name: Rillaboom
013.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Voltage Beat Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 {G} Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {G}{G}{G}{C} → Hammer In : 140
013.flavorText: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

014.name: Gossifleur
014.attacksText: {C} → Leafage : 10
