SV028.flavorText: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

SV029.name: Drednaw
SV029.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Vise Bite : 60+ This attack does 30 more damage for each {C} in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost. {W}{C}{C}{C} → Jaw Lock : 130 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
SV029.flavorText: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

SV030.name: Cramorant
SV030.attacksText: {W} → Dive : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Hydro Pump : 50+ This attack does 20 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
SV030.flavorText: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

SV031.name: Arrokuda
SV031.flavorText: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

SV032.name: Barraskewda
SV032.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 30 {W} → Spiral Jet : 130 Discard 2 {W} Energy cards from your hand. If you don't, this attack does nothing.
SV032.flavorText: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

SV033.name: Snom
SV033.attacksText: {W} → Call for Family Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
SV033.flavorText: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

SV034.name: Frosmoth
SV034.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Ice Dance As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a {W} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched {W} Pokémon. {W}{C} → Aurora Beam : 30
SV034.flavorText: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

SV035.name: Eiscue
SV035.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Ice Face If this Pokémon has full HP, it takes 60 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{C}{C} → Blizzard : 70 This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
SV035.flavorText: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

SV036.name: Dracovish
SV036.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Primal Law As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play any Pokémon from their hand to evolve their Pokémon. {W}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 120
SV036.flavorText: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

SV037.name: Arctovish
SV037.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Hard Face : 90 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 60 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{C}{C}{C} → Cold Breath : 130 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
SV037.flavorText: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

SV038.name: Rotom
SV038.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Roto Choice When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Item cards that have the word “Rotom” in their name, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {L}{C} → Thunder Shock : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
SV038.flavorText: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

SV039.name: Yamper
SV039.attacksText: {C} → Roar Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. {L} → Static Shock : 10
SV039.flavorText: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

SV040.name: Boltund
SV040.attacksText: {C}{C} → Big Bite : 50 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. {L}{C}{C} → Fighting Fangs : 90+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon V or Pokémon- GX , this attack does 90 more damage.
SV040.flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

SV041.name: Toxel
SV041.evolves: Evolves into Toxtricity , Toxtricity ex , or Light Toxtricity
SV041.flavorText: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

SV042.name: Toxtricity
SV042.attacksText: {C}{C} → Risk Taker Flip a coin. If heads, discard the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck. If tails, discard the top 5 cards of your deck. {L}{L}{C} → Thunder Jolt : 160 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
SV042.flavorText: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

SV043.name: Pincurchin
SV043.attacksText: {L}{L} → Shocking Needles : 30× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads. If at least 2 of them are heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
SV043.flavorText: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

SV044.name: Morpeko
SV044.attacksText: {C} → Torment : 20 Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack. {L}{C} → Spark : 50 This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
SV044.flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

SV045.name: Dracozolt
SV045.attacksText: {L} → Amping Up : 30 During your next turn, this Pokémon's Amping Up attack does 90 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C}{C}{C} → Giga Impact : 200 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
SV045.flavorText: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

SV046.name: Arctozolt
SV046.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Biting Whirlpool Whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. {L}{C} → Electro Ball : 70
SV046.flavorText: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

SV047.name: Galarian Ponyta
SV047.attacksText: {P} → Psy Bolt : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
SV047.flavorText: This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.

SV048.name: Galarian Rapidash
SV048.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Pastel Veil Your Pokémon recover from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions. {P}{C} → Psychic : 30+ This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
SV048.flavorText: Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.

SV049.name: Galarian Corsola
SV049.attacksText: {P} → Cursed Drop Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.
SV049.flavorText: Watch your step when wandering areas oceans once covered. What looks like a stone could be this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.

SV050.name: Galarian Cursola
SV050.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Perish Body If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, the Attacking Pokémon is Knocked Out. {P}{C} → Corner : 60 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
SV050.flavorText: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

SV051.name: Dedenne
SV051.attacksText: {P}{C}{C} → Mad Party : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.
SV051.flavorText: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

SV052.name: Sinistea
SV052.attacksText: {C} → Furtive Drop Put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
SV052.flavorText: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

SV053.name: Polteageist
SV053.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Tea Break You must discard a Pokémon that has the Mad Party attack from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards. {C}{C} → Mad Party : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.
SV053.flavorText: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

SV054.name: Hatenna
SV054.attacksText: {C} → Find a Friend Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Psyshot : 20
SV054.flavorText: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

SV055.name: Hattrem
SV055.evolves: Evolves from Hatenna and into Hatterene
SV055.attacksText: {C} → Calm Mind Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. {C}{C} → Brutal Swing : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
SV055.flavorText: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

SV056.name: Hatterene
SV056.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Mind Hat Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Each player discards a card from their hand. (Your opponent discards first.) {P} → Dripping Grudge Put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each Pokémon in your discard pile.
SV056.flavorText: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

SV057.name: Milcery
SV057.evolves: Evolves into Alcremie or Alcremie ex
SV057.attacksText: {C} → Aromatherapy Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon. {P}{C} → Tackle : 20
SV057.flavorText: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

SV058.name: Alcremie
SV058.attacksText: {C} → Decorate Attach any number of basic Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like. {P}{C} → Draining Kiss : 50 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
SV058.flavorText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

SV059.name: Indeedee
SV059.attacksText: {C} → Replenish Time Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon. {P}{C} → Psybeam : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
SV059.flavorText: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

SV060.name: Dreepy
SV060.attacksText: {P} → Quick Attack : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.
SV060.flavorText: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

SV061.name: Drakloak
SV061.evolves: Evolves from Dreepy and into Dragapult ex or Dragapult
SV061.attacksText: {C} → Summon Search your deck for a Dreepy and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {P}{P} → Bite : 40
SV061.flavorText: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

SV062.name: Dragapult
SV062.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Infiltrator If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage. {P}{P} → Phantom Force : 120 Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like.
SV062.flavorText: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

SV063.name: Galarian Farfetch'd
SV063.attacksText: {F} → Rock Smash : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage. {C}{C} → Pierce : 30
SV063.flavorText: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

SV064.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
SV064.attacksText: {F} → Pierce : 40 {F}{C}{C} → Meteor Assault : 180 This Pokémon can't use Meteor Assault again until it leaves the Active Spot.
SV064.flavorText: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

SV065.name: Galarian Yamask
SV065.attacksText: {C}{C} → Reckless Charge : 50 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
SV065.flavorText: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

SV066.name: Galarian Runerigus
SV066.attacksText: {C}{C} → Spreading Spite For each damage counter on this Galarian Runerigus, put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like. {F}{C}{C} → Mad Hammer : 120 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
SV066.flavorText: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

SV067.name: Rolycoly
SV067.flavorText: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

SV068.name: Carkol
SV068.evolves: Evolves from Rolycoly and into Coalossal
SV068.flavorText: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

SV069.name: Coalossal
SV069.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Tar Generator Once during your turn, you may attach a {R} Energy card, a {F} Energy card, or 1 of each from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Flaming Avalanche : 130
SV069.flavorText: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

SV070.name: Silicobra
SV070.attacksText: {C} → Sand Attack During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.
SV070.flavorText: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

SV071.name: Sandaconda
SV071.attacksText: {C} → Coil : 10 During your next turn, this Pokémon's attacks do 120 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{C}{C} → Skull Bash : 100
SV071.flavorText: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

SV072.name: Clobbopus
SV072.attacksText: {F} → Bind : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
SV072.flavorText: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

SV073.name: Grapploct
SV073.attacksText: {F}{F} → Octolock Until this Grapploct leaves the Active Spot, the Defending Pokémon's attacks cost {C}{C} more, and the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. This effect can't be applied more than once. {F}{F}{C} → Tough Swing : 130 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
SV073.flavorText: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

SV074.name: Falinks
SV074.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Team Attack : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has “Falinks” in its name.
SV074.flavorText: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

SV075.name: Stonjourner
SV075.attacksText: {F}{C}{C} → Mega Kick : 80 {F}{C}{C}{C} → Power Press : 120+ If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached (in addition to this attack's cost) , this attack does 60 more damage.
SV075.flavorText: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

SV076.name: Koffing
SV076.evolves: Evolves into Weezing , Galarian Weezing , or Dark Weezing
SV076.attacksText: {D} → Ascension Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
SV076.flavorText: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

SV077.name: Galarian Weezing
SV077.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Neutralizing Gas As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Pokémon in play have no Abilities, except for Neutralizing Gas. {D} → Severe Poison Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 4 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon during Pokémon Checkup.
SV077.flavorText: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

SV078.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
SV078.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Headbutt Tantrum When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {D}{C} → Surprise Attack : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
SV078.flavorText: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

SV079.name: Galarian Linoone
SV079.evolves: Evolves from Galarian Zigzagoon and into Galarian Obstagoon
SV079.attacksText: {D} → Night Slash : 20 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {D}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 70
SV079.flavorText: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

SV080.name: Galarian Obstagoon
SV080.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Untamed Shout When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {D}{C} → Obstruct : 90 During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.
SV080.flavorText: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

SV081.name: Nickit
SV081.attacksText: {D} → Instigate Your opponent shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If they put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, they draw 3 cards.
SV081.flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

SV082.name: Thievul
SV082.attacksText: {D} → Thief : 20 Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose a card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck. {D}{C}{C} → Darkness Fang : 90
SV082.flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

SV083.name: Impidimp
SV083.flavorText: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

SV084.name: Morgrem
SV084.evolves: Evolves from Impidimp and into Grimmsnarl
SV084.attacksText: {D} → Bite : 30 {D}{C}{C} → False Surrender : 60 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
SV084.flavorText: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

SV085.name: Grimmsnarl
SV085.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Dark Oath As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks cost {C} more. {D}{C}{C} → Energy Press : 100+ This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
SV085.flavorText: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

SV086.name: Galarian Meowth
SV086.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Evolution Roar You must discard 2 cards from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Galarian Perrserker, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {M}{C} → Scratch : 20
SV086.flavorText: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

SV087.name: Galarian Perrserker
SV087.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Steely Spirit Your {M} Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M}{M}{C} → Metal Claw : 70
SV087.flavorText: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

SV088.name: Galarian Stunfisk
SV088.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Snap Trap If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if it is Knocked Out) , discard an Energy from the Attacking Pokémon. {M}{C} → Damage Rush : 30+ Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.
SV088.flavorText: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

SV089.name: Corviknight
SV089.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 50 {M}{C}{C} → Iron Wings : 130 You may discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, during your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 100 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
SV089.flavorText: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

SV090.name: Cufant
SV090.evolves: Evolves into Copperajah or Copperajah ex
SV090.flavorText: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

SV091.name: Copperajah
SV091.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Antibacterial Skin This Pokémon can't be affected by any Special Conditions. {M}{M}{C}{C} → Vengeful Stomp : 120+ If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 120 more damage.
SV091.flavorText: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

SV092.name: Duraludon
SV092.evolves: Evolves into Archaludon or Archaludon ex
SV092.attacksText: {C} → Metal Sharpener : 30 Attach a {M} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon. {M}{M}{C} → Power Beam : 110
SV092.flavorText: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

SV093.name: Minccino
SV093.attacksText: {C} → Glance Look at the top card of your opponent's deck. {C}{C} → Tail Slap : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
SV093.flavorText: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

SV094.name: Cinccino
SV094.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Make Do You must discard a card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards. {C} → Energy Assist : 40 Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
SV094.flavorText: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

SV095.name: Ducklett
SV095.flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

SV096.name: Swanna
SV096.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sky Circus If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs. {C}{C}{C} → Feather Slice : 70+ You may discard a card from your hand. If you do, this attack does 70 more damage.
SV096.flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

SV097.name: Bunnelby
SV097.attacksText: {C}{C} → Mad Party : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.
SV097.flavorText: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

SV098.name: Oranguru
SV098.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Primate Wisdom Once during your turn, you may switch a card from your hand with the top card of your deck. {C}{C}{C} → Whap Down : 70
SV098.flavorText: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

SV099.name: Skwovet
SV099.evolves: Evolves into Greedent or Greedent ex
SV099.flavorText: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

SV100.name: Greedent
SV100.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Greedy Tail Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Pokémon Tool card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C}{C} → Tail Smack : 80
SV100.flavorText: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

SV101.name: Rookidee
SV101.flavorText: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

SV102.name: Corvisquire
SV102.evolves: Evolves from Rookidee and into Corviknight
SV102.attacksText: {C} → Pluck : 20 Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {C}{C} → Drill Peck : 50
SV102.flavorText: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

SV103.name: Wooloo
SV103.attacksText: {C}{C} → Expand : 30 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
SV103.flavorText: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

SV104.name: Dubwool
SV104.attacksText: {C} → Cotton Guard : 30 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C}{C} → Double-Edge : 120 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
SV104.flavorText: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

SV105.name: Rillaboom V
SV105.attacksText: {G} → Forest Feast Search your deck for up to 2 Basic {G} Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {G}{G}{G}{C} → Wood Hammer : 220 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

SV106.name: Rillaboom VMAX
SV106.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 50 {G}{G}{G}{C} → Max Beating : 130+ You may discard up to 3 {G} Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 50 more damage for each card you discarded in this way. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

SV107.name: Charizard VMAX
SV107.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Claw Slash : 100 {R}{R}{R}{C}{C} → G-Max Wildfire : 300 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

SV108.name: Centiskorch V
SV108.attacksText: {R} → Radiating Heat : 20 You may discard an Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {R}{R}{R}{R} → Burning Train : 180 · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

SV109.name: Centiskorch VMAX
SV109.attacksText: {C}{C} → G-Max Centiferno : 40+ This attack does 40 more damage for each {R} Energy attached to this Pokémon. 001.name: Weedle
001.attacksText: {G} → Bug Hunch Search your deck for up to 2 {G} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
001.flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

002.name: Kakuna
002.evolves: Evolves from Weedle and into Beedrill
002.attacksText: {C} → Shed Skin Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. {G} → Bug Bite : 20
002.flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

003.name: Beedrill
003.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Elusive Master Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is the last card in your hand, you may play it onto your Bench. If you do, draw 3 cards. {G}{C} → Sharp Sting : 120
003.flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

004.name: Exeggcute
004.evolves: Evolves into Exeggutor , Alolan Exeggutor , […] Alolan Exeggutor ex , Alolan Exeggutor- GX
004.attacksText: {G} → Seed Bomb : 10
004.flavorText: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

005.name: Exeggutor
005.attacksText: {G} → Head Crack : 30 Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack. {G}{C}{C} → Solar Beam : 90
005.flavorText: Each of its three heads has its own thoughts. When they want to go in different directions, Exeggutor becomes unable to move.

006.name: Yanma
006.evolves: Evolves into Yanmega or Yanmega ex
006.attacksText: {C} → U-turn : 10 You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Cutting Wind : 60
006.flavorText: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

007.name: Yanmega
007.evolves: Evolves from Yanma and into Yanmega BREAK
007.attacksText: {C}{C} → U-turn : 50 You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Cutting Wind : 130
007.flavorText: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

008.name: Pineco
008.evolves: Evolves into Forretress , Forretress ex , or Dark Forretress
008.attacksText: {C} → Ram : 10 {C}{C} → Iron Defense Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.
008.flavorText: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.

009.name: Celebi
009.attacksText: {G} → Energy Press : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. {L}{P} → Amazing Bloom For each of your Benched Pokémon, search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
009.flavorText: This Pokémon has the ability to move through time. Records describing it as a forest deity can be found from many different eras.

010.name: Seedot
010.attacksText: {G} → Ram : 10
010.flavorText: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.

011.name: Nuzleaf
011.evolves: Evolves from Seedot and into Shiftry , Shiftry- GX , or Shiftry ex
011.attacksText: {G} → Razor Leaf : 40
011.flavorText: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

012.name: Shiftry
012.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Shifty Substitution As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, each Supporter card in your opponent's hand has the effect “Draw 3 cards.” (This happens instead of the card's usual effect.) {G}{C} → Fan Tornado : 110 You may have your opponent switch their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.
012.flavorText: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

013.name: Nincada
013.attacksText: {G} → Absorb : 10 Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
013.flavorText: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

014.name: Ninjask
014.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Cast-Off Shell When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for a Shedinja and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {G} → Absorb : 30 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
014.flavorText: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.

015.name: Shaymin
015.attacksText: {G} → Leech Seed : 20 Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon. {G}{C} → Flower Bearing Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent shuffles their Active Pokémon and all attached cards and puts them on the bottom of their deck.
015.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

016.name: Genesect
016.attacksText: {G}{C} → Linear Attack This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {G}{G}{C} → Techno Blast : 120 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
016.flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

017.name: Skiddo
017.attacksText: {G} → Synthesis Search your deck for a {G} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {G}{G}{C} → Razor Leaf : 50
017.flavorText: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

018.name: Gogoat
018.attacksText: {G}{C} → Razor Leaf : 50 {G}{G}{C} → Take Down : 160 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
018.flavorText: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

019.name: Dhelmise
019.attacksText: {C} → Hook : 20 {G}{C}{C} → Special Anchor : 60+ If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.
019.flavorText: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, heal all damage from that Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

023.name: Charmander
023.evolves: Evolves into Charmeleon or Dark Charmeleon
023.attacksText: {R} → Collect Draw a card. {R}{R} → Flare : 30
023.flavorText: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

024.name: Charmeleon
024.evolves: Evolves from Charmander and into Charizard , Charizard ex , […] Charizard- GX , Mega Charizard X ex , Mega Charizard Y ex
024.attacksText: {R} → Slash : 20 {R}{R} → Raging Flames : 60 Discard the top 3 cards of your deck.

025.name: Charizard
025.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Battle Sense Once during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Discard the other cards. {R}{R} → Royal Blaze : 100+ This attack does 50 more damage for each Leon card in your discard pile.

026.name: Flareon

027.name: Slugma
027.evolves: Evolves into Magcargo , Magcargo ex , Magcargo- GX , or Dark Magcargo
027.attacksText: {C} → Yawn Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {R}{C}{C} → Flare : 30
027.flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

028.name: Magcargo
028.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Heat Blast : 60 {R}{R}{C}{C} → Bright Flame : 180 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.
028.flavorText: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

029.name: Talonflame V
029.attacksText: {C} → Fast Flight If you go first, you can use this attack during your first turn. Discard your hand and draw 6 cards. {R}{R}{C} → Bright Wing : 160 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

030.name: Vaporeon
030.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Torrential Awakening If this Pokémon has a Memory Capsule attached, {R} Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities. {W}{C} → Aurora Beam : 70
030.flavorText: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

031.name: Wailmer
031.evolves: Evolves into Wailord or Wailord ex
031.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Hydro Pump : 10+ This attack does 20 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
031.flavorText: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

032.name: Wailord
032.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Water Veil Whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, it recovers from all Special Conditions. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Hydro Pump : 10+ This attack does 40 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
032.flavorText: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

033.name: Oshawott
033.attacksText: {W} → Water Gun : 10 {W}{C} → Seashell Attack : 20
033.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

034.name: Dewott
034.evolves: Evolves from Oshawott and into Samurott or Hisuian Samurott
034.attacksText: {W} → Water Gun : 20 {W}{C}{C} → Aqua Wash : 50 You may put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.
034.flavorText: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.

035.name: Samurott
035.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Shell Armor This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{C}{C} → Aqua Wash : 120 You may put 2 Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.
035.flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

036.name: Galarian Darmanitan V
036.attacksText: {W}{C} → Freezing Headbutt : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{W}{C} → Frozen Slice : 190 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

037.attacksText: {W}{W}{W}{W} → Max Whiteout : 200 This attack also does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

038.name: Chewtle
038.attacksText: {W}{C} → Jaw Lock : 40 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
038.flavorText: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

039.name: Drednaw
039.evolves: Evolves from Chewtle
039.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Vise Wave : 80 If you played Nessa from your hand during this turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{W}{C}{C} → Surf : 140
039.flavorText: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

040.name: Cramorant
040.attacksText: {C}{C} → Continuous Gulp Missile : 60× Discard any number of Arrokuda from your Bench. This attack does 60 damage for each Arrokuda you discarded in this way.
040.flavorText: Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.

041.name: Arrokuda
041.evolves: Evolves into Barraskewda
041.attacksText: {C} → Flock Search your deck for up to 2 Arrokuda and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {W}{C} → Peck : 20
041.flavorText: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

042.name: Barraskewda
042.attacksText: {W} → Targeted Skewer This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon for each damage counter on that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{C} → Jet Headbutt : 60
042.flavorText: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

043.name: Pikachu V
043.attacksText: {L} → Charge Search your deck for up to 2 {L} Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {L}{L}{C} → Thunderbolt : 200 Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

044.name: Pikachu VMAX
044.attacksText: {L}{L}{L} → G-Max Volt Tackle : 120+ You may discard all Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 150 more damage. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

045.name: Voltorb
045.evolves: Evolves into Electrode , Electrode- GX , Dark Electrode , or Electrode ex
045.attacksText: {L}{L} → Electro Ball : 40
045.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

046.name: Electrode
046.evolves: Evolves from Voltorb
046.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Buzzap Generator Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may search your deck for up to 2 {L} Energy cards and attach them to your {L} Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. If you searched your deck in this way, this Pokémon is Knocked Out. {L}{L}{C} → Electric Ball : 100
046.flavorText: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

047.name: Jolteon
047.evolves: Evolves from Eevee
047.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Thunderous Awakening If this Pokémon has a Memory Capsule attached, {W} Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities. {L}{C}{C} → Electric Ball : 90
047.flavorText: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

048.name: Zapdos
048.attacksText: {C} → Drill Peck : 20 {L}{L}{C} → Thunder Snipe Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 160 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon V or Pokémon- GX . (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
048.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

049.name: Ampharos V
049.attacksText: {L}{C} → Dazzle Blast : 50 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {L}{L}{C} → Damaging Spark : 120 This attack also does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

050.name: Raikou
050.attacksText: {G}{L}{M} → Amazing Shot : 120 This attack also does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
050.flavorText: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

051.name: Electrike
051.evolves: Evolves into Manectric , Mega Manectric ex , or Manectric ex
051.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {L}{C} → Bite : 20
051.flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

052.name: Manectric
052.attacksText: Ability ⇢ High Speed When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may draw 3 cards. {L}{C}{C} → Electric Ball : 100
052.flavorText: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

053.name: Blitzle
053.evolves: Evolves into Zebstrika
053.attacksText: {L} → Zap Kick : 20
053.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

054.name: Zebstrika
054.attacksText: {L} → Low Kick : 30 {L}{C} → Zap Kick : 70
054.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

055.name: Joltik
055.evolves: Evolves into Galvantula or Galvantula ex
055.attacksText: {L} → Bug Bite : 20
055.flavorText: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It's soaking up static electricity because it can't produce a charge on its own.

056.name: Galvantula
056.attacksText: {L} → Stun Needle : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {L}{C} → Shocking Pursuit : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
056.flavorText: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

057.name: Tynamo
057.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Levitate If this Pokémon has any Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost. {L} → Tiny Charge : 10
057.flavorText: One alone can emit only trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

058.name: Eelektrik
058.evolves: Evolves from Tynamo and into Eelektross or Mega Eelektross ex
058.attacksText: {L} → Shocking Smash Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {L}{C}{C} → Head Bolt : 60
058.flavorText: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

059.name: Eelektross
059.attacksText: {L} → Electrified Bite Mark : 60 During your opponent's next turn, if they attach an Energy card from their hand to the Defending Pokémon, put 6 damage counters on that Pokémon. {L}{C}{C} → Electro Sprinkler : 120 This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon and 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
059.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

060.name: Zekrom
060.attacksText: {C}{C} → Slash : 30 {L}{L}{C} → Wild Shock : 130 This Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
060.flavorText: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

061.name: Zeraora
061.attacksText: {L}{C} → Fighting Lightning : 30+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon V or Pokémon- GX , this attack does 80 more damage.
061.flavorText: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

062.name: Pincurchin
062.attacksText: {L} → Spinning Fan This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {L}{C} → Peck : 30
062.flavorText: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

063.name: Clefairy
063.evolves: Evolves into Clefable , Mega Clefable ex , or Clefable ex
063.attacksText: {P} → Pound : 10 {C}{C} → Mini-Metronome Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.
063.flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

064.name: Clefable
064.evolves: Evolves from Clefairy
064.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Lunar Blessing Once during your turn, if your Active Pokémon has any {P} Energy attached, you may heal 20 damage from it, and it recovers from a Special Condition. {P}{C}{C} → Magical Shot : 80
064.flavorText: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

065.name: Girafarig
065.evolves: Evolves into Farigiraf or Farigiraf ex
065.attacksText: {P} → Psypower Put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like. {P}{C} → Commanding Tail : 30 You may have your opponent shuffle their hand into their deck. If you do, your opponent draws 4 cards.
065.flavorText: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

066.name: Shedinja
066.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Shell Survival Put this Pokémon into play only with the effect of Ninjask's Cast-Off Shell Ability. (When you are setting up to play, you cannot put it face down as your Active Pokémon or on your Bench.) {C}{C}{C} → Life Squeeze Put damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is 10.
066.flavorText: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

067.name: Shuppet
067.evolves: Evolves into Banette , Banette- GX , or Banette ex
067.attacksText: {P} → Haunt Put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
067.flavorText: There's a proverb that says, “Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk.”

068.name: Banette
068.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Curse of Devolution When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may devolve 1 of your opponent's Benched evolved Pokémon by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand. {P}{C} → Spooky Shot : 40
068.flavorText: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

069.name: Duskull
069.evolves: Evolves into Dusclops or Dusclops ex
069.attacksText: {C} → Future Sight Look at the top 4 cards of either player's deck and put them back in any order.
069.flavorText: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

070.name: Dusclops
070.evolves: Evolves from Duskull and into Dusknoir
070.attacksText: {C} → Confuse Ray Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {P}{C}{C} → Psypunch : 60
070.flavorText: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

071.name: Dusknoir
071.evolves: Evolves from Dusclops and into Dusknoir LV. X
071.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Spectral Breach All Special Energy attached to Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) provide {C} Energy and have no other effect. {P}{C}{C} → Spooky Shot : 120
071.flavorText: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

072.name: Chimecho
072.attacksText: {C} → Auspicious Tone Search your deck for a Pokémon and a Supporter card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {P}{C} → Hypnoblast : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
072.flavorText: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

073.name: Woobat
073.attacksText: {P} → Unamplified Soundwave This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If you have any cards in your hand, this attack does nothing.
073.flavorText: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it's evidence that Woobat live there.

074.name: Swoobat
074.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Unaware Prevent all effects of attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.) {P}{C} → Heart Stamp : 70
074.flavorText: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won't be able to fly for a little while.

075.name: Cottonee
075.evolves: Evolves into Whimsicott , Whimsicott ex , or Whimsicott- GX
075.attacksText: {P} → Rolling Tackle : 10
075.flavorText: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

076.name: Whimsicott
076.attacksText: {C} → Triple Draw Draw 3 cards. {P} → Flying Fury : 10+ Before doing damage, you may discard any number of Pokémon Tools from your Pokémon. This attack does 40 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.
076.flavorText: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it'll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

077.name: Dedenne
077.attacksText: {P} → Tail Trickery : 10 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
077.flavorText: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

078.name: Xerneas
078.attacksText: {P} → Geo Hunt Put a card from your discard pile into your hand. {P}{P}{C} → Aurora Gain : 100 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
078.flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven different colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

079.name: Diancie
079.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sparkle Veil As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your Pokémon take 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {P}{C}{C} → Sensitive Ray : 50+ If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 70 more damage.
079.flavorText: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

080.name: Milcery
080.evolves: Evolves into Alcremie or Alcremie ex
080.attacksText: {P} → Sweet Scent Heal 20 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. {C} → Tackle : 10
080.flavorText: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

081.name: Alcremie
081.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sharing Sweets When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may have each player draw a card. {P}{C}{C} → Wonder Shine : 60 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
081.flavorText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

082.name: Zacian
082.attacksText: {C} → Metal Armament : 30 Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {G}{P}{M} → Amazing Sword : 150+ If your opponent has any Pokémon VMAX in play, this attack does 150 more damage.
082.flavorText: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

083.name: Wooper
083.attacksText: {F} → Mud Shot : 10 {C}{C} → Beat : 20
083.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

084.name: Quagsire
084.attacksText: {C}{C} → Beat : 30 {F}{C}{C} → Fickle Impact : 180 If you have exactly 2, 4, or 6 Prize cards remaining, this attack does nothing.
084.flavorText: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

085.name: Shuckle
085.attacksText: {F} → Deck Distiller Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard the top card of your opponent's deck. {F}{C} → Rock Throw : 50
085.flavorText: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

086.name: Phanpy
086.evolves: Evolves into Donphan or Dark Donphan
086.attacksText: {F} → Stampede : 10 {F}{C} → Strike Back : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
086.flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

087.name: Donphan
087.attacksText: {F} → Earthquake : 120 This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{C}{C} → Heavy Impact : 90
087.flavorText: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

088.name: Hitmontop
088.attacksText: {C} → Cycle Draw Discard a card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards. {F}{C}{C} → Tornado Kick : 50+ If you played Bea from your hand during this turn, this attack does 80 more damage.
088.flavorText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

089.name: Regirock
089.attacksText: {F}{C} → Rock Tumble : 40 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance. {F}{F}{C} → Megaton Fall : 130 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
089.flavorText: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.

090.name: Riolu
090.evolves: Evolves into Lucario , Mega Lucario ex , Lucario- GX , or Lucario ex
090.attacksText: {C} → Best Punch : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
090.flavorText: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

091.name: Drilbur
091.evolves: Evolves into Excadrill or Excadrill ex
091.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 10 {C}{C} → Focus Fist : 50 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
091.flavorText: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

092.name: Terrakion
092.attacksText: {F}{C} → Guard Press : 30 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{F}{C} → Earthen Power : 80+ If you have a Stadium in play, this attack does 80 more damage.
092.flavorText: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

093.name: Zygarde
093.attacksText: {F} → Beam : 30 {F}{C}{C} → Core Avenger : 80+ If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, this attack does 80 more damage.
093.flavorText: Born when all of Zygarde's cells have been gathered together, it uses force to neutralize those who harm the ecosystem.

094.name: Rockruff
094.evolves: Evolves into Lycanroc , Lycanroc- GX , or Lycanroc ex
094.attacksText: {F} → Tackle : 10 {F}{C} → Rear Kick : 20
094.flavorText: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

095.name: Lycanroc
095.attacksText: {F} → Rock Throw : 40 {F}{C} → Sharp Mane : 70
095.flavorText: They live alone without forming packs. They will only listen to orders from Trainers who can draw out their true power.

096.name: Mudbray
096.attacksText: {C} → Ram : 10 {F}{F}{C} → Rear Kick : 60
096.flavorText: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon. It's skilled at making use of mud.

097.name: Mudsdale
097.attacksText: {F}{C} → Mud Bomb : 50 {F}{F}{C} → Heavy Slam : 180- This attack does 30 less damage for each {C} in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.
097.flavorText: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale's legs sets harder than stone. It's so hard that it allows this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.

098.name: Coalossal V
098.attacksText: {F}{F}{C} → Searing Flame : 90 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. {F}{F}{F}{C} → Boulder Crush : 180 · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

099.name: Coalossal VMAX
099.attacksText: {F} → Eruption Shot : 40+ Discard the top card of your deck. If that card is an Energy card, this attack does 90 more damage, and attach that card to this Pokémon. {F}{F}{F}{C} → G-Max Boulder : 240 · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

001.name: Venusaur V
001.attacksText: {G}{G}{C} → Pollen Bomb : 80 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned. {G}{G}{G}{C} → Solar Typhoon : 220 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Solar Typhoon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

002.name: Weedle
002.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
002.flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

003.name: Kakuna
003.evolves: Evolves from Weedle and into Beedrill
003.attacksText: {G} → Bug Bite : 30
003.flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

004.name: Beedrill
004.attacksText: {G} → Poison Jab : 80 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
004.flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

005.name: Eldegoss V
005.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Happy Match When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand. {C}{C} → Float Up : 50 You may shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

006.name: Vulpix
006.evolves: Evolves into Ninetales , Ninetales ex , or Light Ninetales
006.attacksText: {C} → Gnaw : 10 {R}{C} → Singe Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
006.flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

007.name: Victini
007.attacksText: {C} → Quick Draw Draw a card. {R}{C} → Combustion : 30
007.flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

008.name: Incineroar V
008.attacksText: {R}{R}{C} → Grand Flame : 90 Attach up to 2 {R} Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {R}{R}{R}{C} → Flare Blitzer : 220 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

009.name: Sizzlipede
009.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 10 {R}{C}{C} → Combustion : 50
009.flavorText: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

010.name: Centiskorch
010.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Searing Flame : 50 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{R}{C}{C} → Heat Crawler : 140
010.flavorText: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

011.name: Carvanha
011.evolves: Evolves into Sharpedo , Mega Sharpedo ex , or Sharpedo ex
011.attacksText: {W} → Bite : 10
011.flavorText: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

012.name: Sharpedo
012.attacksText: {W} → Aqua Jet : 50 This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
012.flavorText: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

013.name: Wailord V
013.attacksText: {W} → Draw Up Attach up to 3 {W} Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {W}{W}{W}{W} → Ocean Waves : 120× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 120 damage for each heads. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

014.name: Drednaw V
014.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Solid Shell This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{W}{C} → Powerful Bite : 130 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

015.name: Drednaw VMAX
015.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Solid Shell This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{W}{C} → G-Max Headbutt : 160+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 80 more damage. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

016.name: Gardevoir V
016.attacksText: {P} → Magical Shot : 30 {P}{P}{C} → Swelling Pulse : 120+ If this Pokémon was healed during this turn, this attack does 80 more damage. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

017.name: Gardevoir VMAX
017.attacksText: {P}{P}{C} → Max Cure : 180 Heal 50 damage from this Pokémon. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

018.name: Hatenna
018.attacksText: {P} → Stampede : 10 {P}{C} → Magical Shot : 30
018.flavorText: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

019.name: Hattrem
019.evolves: Evolves from Hatenna and into Hatterene
019.attacksText: {P} → Beat : 20 {P}{C} → Super Psy Bolt : 40
019.flavorText: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

020.name: Hatterene
020.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Hazard Sensor If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , the Attacking Pokémon is now Confused. {P}{C} → Life Sucker : 100 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
020.flavorText: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

021.name: Galarian Cursola V
021.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Gnawing Aura As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Pokémon, put 3 damage counters on that Pokémon. {P}{C} → Hollow Missile : 60 Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

022.name: Alcremie V
022.attacksText: {P} → Sugary Sprinkles Heal 30 damage from each of your Benched Pokémon. {P}{C}{C} → Sweet Splash : 100 If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

023.name: Alcremie VMAX
023.attacksText: {C} → Adornment For each of your Benched Pokémon, search your deck for a {P} Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {P}{P} → G-Max Whisk : 60× Discard any amount of Energy from your Pokémon. This attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

024.name: Machop
024.evolves: Evolves into Machoke , Dark Machoke , or Light Machoke
024.attacksText: {F} → Low Kick : 10 {F}{C} → Steady Punch : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.
024.flavorText: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

025.name: Machoke
025.evolves: Evolves from Machop and into Machamp or Machamp- GX
025.attacksText: {F} → Low Kick : 30 {F}{F}{C} → Pummel : 50+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 70 more damage.
025.flavorText: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

026.name: Machamp
026.evolves: Evolves from Machoke and into Machamp BREAK or Machamp LV. X
026.attacksText: {F}{C} → Macho Revenge : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each {F} Pokémon in your discard pile. {F}{F}{C} → Dynamite Punch : 200 This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.
026.flavorText: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

027.name: Lucario V
027.attacksText: {F} → Aura Sphere : 40 This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{F}{C} → Beatdown Smash : 180 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Beatdown Smash. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

028.name: Zygarde
028.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 30 {F}{F}{C}{C} → Power Blast : 130 Discard a {F} Energy from this Pokémon.
028.flavorText: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

029.name: Rockruff
029.evolves: Evolves into Lycanroc , Lycanroc- GX , or Lycanroc ex
029.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {F}{C} → Bite : 20
029.flavorText: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

030.name: Lycanroc
030.attacksText: {C} → Rock Throw : 30 {F}{F}{C} → Slashing Strike : 150 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Slashing Strike.
030.flavorText: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.

031.name: Rolycoly
031.attacksText: {C} → Ram : 10
031.flavorText: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

032.name: Grapploct V
032.attacksText: {F} → Tie Up : 20 If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn. {F}{F}{C} → Moonsault Press : 120+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 100 more damage. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

033.name: Ekans
033.evolves: Evolves into Arbok , Dark Arbok , or Arbok ex
033.attacksText: {C} → Ram : 10 {D}{C} → Tail Snap : 30
033.flavorText: The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and Ekans faints.

034.name: Arbok
034.attacksText: {C} → Sharp Fang : 30 {D}{C} → Tail Snap : 70
034.flavorText: After stunning its opponents with the pattern on its stomach, it quickly wraps them up in its body and waits for them to stop moving.

035.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
035.attacksText: {C} → Pin Missile : 10× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
035.flavorText: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

036.name: Galarian Linoone
036.evolves: Evolves from Galarian Zigzagoon and into Galarian Obstagoon
036.attacksText: {C}{C} → Double-Edge : 60 This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.
036.flavorText: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

037.name: Galarian Obstagoon
037.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Wicked Ruler Once during your turn, you may have your opponent discard cards from their hand until they have 4 cards in their hand. {C}{C}{C} → Knuckle Impact : 180 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
037.flavorText: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

038.name: Absol
038.attacksText: {D}{D} → Dark Cutter : 70
038.flavorText: The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.

039.name: Purrloin
039.evolves: Evolves into Liepard
039.attacksText: {D} → Dig Claws : 10 {C}{C} → Fake Out : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
039.flavorText: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

040.name: Liepard
040.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Limber This Pokémon can't be Paralyzed. {D}{C}{C} → Slashing Claw : 90
040.flavorText: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

041.name: Scraggy
041.evolves: Evolves into Scrafty or Mega Scrafty ex
041.attacksText: {C} → Stampede : 10 {D}{C} → Ram : 20
041.flavorText: If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokémon.

042.name: Scrafty
042.attacksText: {D} → Corner : 30 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. {D}{C}{C} → Bad Brawl : 90+ If you played Piers from your hand during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.
042.flavorText: As halfhearted as this Pokémon's kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr's concrete pillars.

043.name: Trubbish
043.attacksText: {C}{C} → Venoshock : 20+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 50 more damage.
043.flavorText: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

044.name: Inkay
044.attacksText: {D} → Tackle : 10 {C}{C} → Attack from Behind : 20+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Confused, this attack does 50 more damage.
044.flavorText: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

045.name: Malamar
045.attacksText: {D}{C} → Eerie Wave : 50 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {D}{D}{C} → Random Peck : 80+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.
045.flavorText: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar's control.

046.name: Nickit
046.evolves: Evolves into Thievul
046.attacksText: {C} → Filch Draw a card. {D}{C} → Tail Smack : 30
046.flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

047.name: Duraludon V
047.evolves: Evolves into Duraludon VMAX
047.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Hard Coat This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C}{C} → Gatling Slug : 10+ This attack does 40 more damage for each {M} Energy attached to this Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

048.name: Swablu
048.evolves: Evolves into Altaria , Altaria ex , or Altaria- GX
048.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 20
048.flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

049.name: Altaria
049.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Miraculous Charm Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon V and Pokémon- GX . {C}{C} → Speed Dive : 60
049.flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

053.name: Hop
053.attacksText: Draw 3 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

055.name: Kabu
055.attacksText: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If your Active Pokémon is your only Pokémon in play, draw 8 cards instead. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

056.name: Marnie
056.attacksText: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 4 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

057.name: Milo
057.attacksText: Discard up to 2 cards from your hand, and draw 2 cards for each card you discarded in this way. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

058.name: Piers
058.attacksText: Search your deck for an Energy card and a {D} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

059.name: Poké Ball
059.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

060.name: Pokémon Center Lady
060.attacksText: Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon, and it recovers from all Special Conditions. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

061.name: Potion
061.attacksText: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

062.name: Professor's Research
062.attacksText: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
062.flavorText: Professor's Research (Magnolia)

063.name: Rotom Bike
063.attacksText: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. Your turn ends. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

064.name: Rotom Phone
064.attacksText: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and shuffle the other cards back into your deck. Then, put the card you chose on top of your deck. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

065.name: Sonia
065.attacksText: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon or up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

066.name: Suspicious Food Tin
066.attacksText: Heal 80 damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has at least 1 {P} Energy attached. If you healed any damage in this way, discard a {P} Energy from it. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

067.name: Team Yell Grunt
067.attacksText: Put an Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon into their hand. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

068.name: Turffield Stadium
068.attacksText: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for an Evolution {G} Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into their hand. Then, that player shuffles their deck. · Stadium rule: This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

069.name: Drednaw V
069.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Solid Shell This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{W}{C} → Powerful Bite : 130 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

071.name: Galarian Cursola V

If heads, this attack does 100 more damage. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

079.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Claw Slash : 80 {R}{R}{C}{C} → Fire Spin : 220 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
