080.attacksText: Heal 80 damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has at least 1 {P} Energy attached. If you healed any damage in this way, discard a {P} Energy from it. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

100.name: Grimer
100.evolves: Evolves into Muk , Dark Muk , or Muk ex
100.attacksText: {D} → Stomp Off Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. {D}{C}{C} → Sludge Whirlpool : 50
100.flavorText: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They're said to be on the verge of extinction.

101.name: Muk
101.attacksText: {D} → Triple Poison Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During Pokémon Checkup, put 3 damage counters on that Pokémon instead of 1. {D}{C}{C}{C} → Sludge Whirlpool : 120
101.flavorText: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they've long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.

102.name: Spinarak
102.evolves: Evolves into Ariados or Dark Ariados
102.attacksText: {D} → Hang Down : 10 {D}{C} → Sting : 20
102.flavorText: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

103.name: Ariados
103.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Spider Net When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Evolution Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. {D}{C} → Poison Sting : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
103.flavorText: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

104.name: Crobat V
104.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Dark Asset When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. You can't use more than 1 Dark Asset Ability each turn. {D}{C} → Venomous Fang : 70 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

105.name: Darkrai
105.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Darkness Guard If this Pokémon has any {D} Energy attached, it takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C}{C} → Vortex of Darkness : 60+ This attack does 20 more damage for each {D} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
105.flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

106.name: Purrloin
106.attacksText: {D} → Dig Claws : 10 {C}{C} → Fake Out : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
106.flavorText: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

107.name: Liepard
107.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Limber This Pokémon can't be Paralyzed. {D}{C}{C} → Slashing Claw : 90
107.flavorText: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

108.name: Deino
108.attacksText: {C} → Ram : 10
108.flavorText: When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.

109.name: Zweilous
109.evolves: Evolves from Deino and into Hydreigon or Hydreigon ex
109.attacksText: {D}{C} → Corkscrew Punch : 30 {D}{D}{C} → Darkness Fang : 70
109.flavorText: While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders its territory, its two heads often bickering over which way to go.

110.name: Hydreigon
110.evolves: Evolves from Zweilous and into Hydreigon BREAK
110.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Dark Squall As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a {D} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon. {D}{D}{C} → Pitch-Black Fangs : 130
110.flavorText: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.

111.name: Hoopa
111.attacksText: {D} → Assault Gate : 90 If this Pokémon didn't move from the Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does nothing. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.
111.flavorText: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

112.name: Nickit
112.attacksText: {D} → Tail Whip Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.
112.flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

113.name: Thievul
113.attacksText: {D} → Nasty Plot Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {D}{D} → Sharp Fang : 70
113.flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

114.name: Grimmsnarl V
114.attacksText: {D} → Bite : 40 {D}{D}{D} → Spiky Knuckle : 200 Put 2 {D} Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

115.name: Grimmsnarl VMAX
115.attacksText: {D}{D}{D} → G-Max Drill : 170+ This attack does 50 more damage for each extra {D} Energy attached to this Pokémon (in addition to this attack's cost) . You can't add more than 100 damage in this way. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

116.name: Eternatus V
116.attacksText: {C} → Power Accelerator : 30 You may attach a {D} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {D}{C}{C}{C} → Dynamax Cannon : 120+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon VMAX, this attack does 120 more damage. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

117.name: Eternatus VMAX
117.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Eternal Zone If all of your Pokémon in play are {D} type, you can have up to 8 Pokémon on your Bench, and you can't put non-{D} Pokémon into play. (If this Ability stops working, discard Pokémon from your Bench until you have 5.) {D}{C} → Dread End : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each of your {D} Pokémon in play. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

118.name: Scizor V
118.attacksText: {M} → Hack Off : 30 Discard a Pokémon Tool and a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {M}{M}{C} → Slashing Claw : 140 · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

119.name: Scizor VMAX
119.attacksText: {M}{C} → Hard Scissors : 90 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M}{M}{C} → Max Steelspike : 190 · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

120.name: Skarmory
120.attacksText: {M} → Metal Arms : 10+ If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 40 more damage. {M}{C}{C} → Cutting Wind : 80
120.flavorText: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!

121.name: Aron
121.attacksText: {C} → Ram : 10 {M}{C} → Headbutt : 20
121.flavorText: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

122.name: Lairon
122.evolves: Evolves from Aron and into Aggron or Aggron ex
122.attacksText: {C}{C} → Knock Away : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage. {M}{C}{C} → Lunge Out : 50
122.flavorText: It habitually shows off its strength with the sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

123.name: Aggron
123.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sturdy If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10. {M}{C}{C}{C} → Gigaton Stomp : 160
123.flavorText: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

124.name: Escavalier
124.attacksText: {M} → Fury Cutter : 10+ Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 70 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 140 more damage. {M}{C} → Seashell Attack : 60
124.flavorText: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

125.name: Klink
125.attacksText: {M} → Call for Backup Search your deck for a {M} Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
125.flavorText: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

126.name: Klang
126.evolves: Evolves from Klink and into Klinklang
126.attacksText: {M} → Call for Backup Search your deck for a {M} Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {M}{C}{C} → Spinning Attack : 60
126.flavorText: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

127.name: Klinklang
127.attacksText: {C}{C} → Beam : 60 {M}{C}{C} → Clockwork : 200 If you don't have Klink and Klang on your Bench, this attack does nothing.
127.flavorText: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

128.name: Galarian Stunfisk V
128.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Metal Skin This Pokémon gets +20 HP for each {M} Energy attached to it. {C}{C} → Trapping Bite : 60 During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if it is Knocked Out) , put 12 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

129.name: Meltan
129.evolves: Evolves into Melmetal , Melmetal ex , or Melmetal- GX
129.attacksText: {C} → Headbutt : 10 {M}{C} → Beam : 20
129.flavorText: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

130.name: Melmetal
130.attacksText: {M} → Energy Link : 30 Attach an Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {M}{C}{C}{C} → Heavy Impact : 130
130.flavorText: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

131.name: Cufant
131.evolves: Evolves into Copperajah or Copperajah ex
131.attacksText: {M}{C}{C} → Strength : 60
131.flavorText: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

132.name: Copperajah
132.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Antibacterial Skin This Pokémon can't be affected by any Special Conditions. {M}{M}{C}{C} → Vengeful Stomp : 120+ If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 120 more damage.
132.flavorText: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

133.name: Kangaskhan
133.attacksText: {C}{C} → Rally Back : 30+ If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon during their last turn, this attack does 90 more damage. {C}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 100
133.flavorText: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.

134.name: Tauros
134.attacksText: {C}{C} → Horn Attack : 60
134.flavorText: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

135.name: Sentret
135.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
135.flavorText: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

136.name: Furret
136.attacksText: {C} → Feelin' Fine Draw 3 cards. {C} → Tail Smash : 90 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
136.flavorText: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

137.name: Dunsparce
137.evolves: Evolves into Dudunsparce or Dudunsparce ex
137.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Final Dig If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck. {C} → Ram : 20
137.flavorText: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

138.name: Teddiursa
138.evolves: Evolves into Ursaring or Dark Ursaring
138.attacksText: {C} → Baby-Doll Eyes During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. {C}{C} → Dig Claws : 20
138.flavorText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

139.name: Ursaring
139.evolves: Evolves from Teddiursa and into Ursaluna
139.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Hammer Arm : 70 Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Claw Slash : 120
139.flavorText: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

140.name: Lugia
140.attacksText: {C} → Gust : 30 {C}{C}{C} → Energy Loop : 120 Put an Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.
140.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

141.name: Skitty
141.evolves: Evolves into Delcatty or Delcatty ex
141.attacksText: {C} → Drawup Power Search your deck for an Energy card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Cat Kick : 20
141.flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

142.name: Delcatty
142.attacksText: {C} → Captivating Tail Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. The new Active Pokémon is now Confused. {C}{C}{C} → Moon Impact : 90
142.flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

143.name: Salamence V
143.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Swoop Across This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {C}{C}{C}{C} → Heavy Storm : 160 · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

144.name: Salamence VMAX
144.evolves: Evolves from Salamence V
144.attacksText: {C} → Sonic Double This attack does 40 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {C}{C}{C}{C} → Max Wings : 240 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Max Wings. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

145.name: Starly
145.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sky Circus If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs. {C}{C} → Keen Eye Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
145.flavorText: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

146.name: Staravia
146.evolves: Evolves from Starly and into Staraptor
146.attacksText: {C} → Ambush : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage. {C}{C} → Wing Attack : 40
146.flavorText: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

147.name: Staraptor
147.attacksText: {C} → Hurricane Blender : 70 Move any amount of Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like. {C}{C}{C} → Brave Bird : 170 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
147.flavorText: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

148.name: Ducklett
148.attacksText: {C} → Flap : 20
148.flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

149.name: Swanna
149.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sky Circus If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs. {C}{C}{C} → Feather Slice : 70+ You may discard a card from your hand. If you do, this attack does 70 more damage.
149.flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

150.name: Bunnelby
150.attacksText: {C}{C} → Mad Party : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.
150.flavorText: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

151.name: Fletchling
151.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 20
151.flavorText: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

152.name: Skwovet
152.evolves: Evolves into Greedent or Greedent ex
152.attacksText: {C} → Whimsy Tackle : 40 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
152.flavorText: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

153.name: Greedent
153.attacksText: {C} → Scrape Off : 20 Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {C}{C} → Smack and Run : 100 Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.
153.flavorText: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

154.name: Rookidee
154.attacksText: {C} → Pluck : 10 Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
154.flavorText: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

155.name: Corvisquire
155.evolves: Evolves from Rookidee and into Corviknight
155.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 30 {C}{C}{C} → Fury Attack : 40× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.
155.flavorText: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

156.name: Corviknight
156.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Flying Taxi When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 1 of your Pokémon, except any Corviknight, and all attached cards into your hand. {C}{C}{C} → Blasting Wind : 120
156.flavorText: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

157.name: Big Parasol
157.attacksText: As long as the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, prevent all effects of attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to all of your Pokémon. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.) · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

158.name: Billowing Smoke
158.attacksText: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, that player discards any Prize cards they would take for that Knock Out instead of putting those cards into their hand. · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

159.name: Bird Keeper
159.attacksText: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, draw 3 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

160.name: Cape of Toughness
160.attacksText: The Basic Pokémon this card is attached to gets +50 HP, except Pokémon- GX . · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

161.name: Familiar Bell
161.attacksText: Search your deck for a Pokémon with the same name as a Pokémon in your discard pile, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

162.name: Glimwood Tangle
162.attacksText: Once during each player's turn, after that player flips any coins for an attack, they may ignore all results of those coin flips and begin flipping those coins again. · Stadium rule: This Stadium stays in play when you play it. 198.name: Coalossal

(Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.) · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

002.attacksText: {G}{G}{C} → G-Max Toxbreeze : 150 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

003.name: Paras
003.attacksText: {G} → Scratch : 20
003.flavorText: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

004.name: Parasect
004.attacksText: {G} → Mushroom Tackle : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {G}{G}{C} → Solar Beam : 110
004.flavorText: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

005.name: Carnivine
005.attacksText: {C} → Return : 20 You may draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. {G}{C} → Giga Drain : 40 Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
005.flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

006.name: Pansage
006.attacksText: {G} → Seed Bomb : 10 {C}{C} → Bite : 20
006.flavorText: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

007.name: Simisage
007.attacksText: {G} → Seed Bomb : 30 {C}{C}{C} → Giga Impact : 110 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
007.flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

008.name: Karrablast
008.attacksText: {C} → Continuous Headbutt : 20× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
008.flavorText: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

009.name: Shelmet
009.attacksText: {C} → Spray Fluid : 10
009.flavorText: When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell. This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast, however, because they can still get into the shell.

010.name: Accelgor
010.attacksText: {C}{C} → Jet Headbutt : 70
010.flavorText: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.

011.name: Rowlet
011.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sky Circus If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs. {C}{C}{C} → Wind Shard This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
011.flavorText: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

012.name: Dartrix
012.evolves: Evolves from Rowlet and into Decidueye , Decidueye- GX , Decidueye ex , or Hisuian Decidueye
012.attacksText: {G} → Razor Leaf : 40
012.flavorText: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

013.name: Decidueye
013.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Deep Forest Camo Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon V and Pokémon- GX . {G}{C} → Splitting Arrow : 90 This attack also does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
013.flavorText: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

014.name: Bounsweet
014.attacksText: {C} → Synthesis Search your deck for a {G} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {G}{C} → Flop : 20
014.flavorText: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.

015.name: Steenee
015.evolves: Evolves from Bounsweet and into Tsareena , Tsareena ex , or Tsareena- GX
015.attacksText: {C} → Captivate Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. {G}{C} → Smack : 40
015.flavorText: As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will feel a surge of happiness.

016.name: Tsareena
016.attacksText: {C} → Power Whip This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {G}{C} → Time Out Kick : 100 You may put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.
016.flavorText: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

017.name: Wimpod
017.evolves: Evolves into Golisopod , Golisopod- GX , or Golisopod ex
017.attacksText: {G} → Gnaw and Run : 10 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
017.flavorText: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

018.name: Golisopod
018.attacksText: {C}{C} → Hard Times Slash : 30+ This attack does 50 more damage for each of your opponent's Pokémon V and Pokémon- GX in play. {G}{C}{C} → Smash Turn : 70 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
018.flavorText: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

019.name: Charizard V
019.evolves: Evolves into Charizard VMAX or Charizard VSTAR
019.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Claw Slash : 80 {R}{R}{C}{C} → Fire Spin : 220 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

020.name: Charizard VMAX
020.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Claw Slash : 100 {R}{R}{R}{C}{C} → G-Max Wildfire : 300 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

022.name: Torchic
022.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {R} → Live Coal : 10
022.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

023.name: Combusken
023.evolves: Evolves from Torchic and into Blaziken , Blaziken ex , or Blaziken- GX
023.attacksText: {R} → Smash Kick : 20 {R}{C}{C} → Heat Beak : 40 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
023.flavorText: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

024.name: Blaziken
024.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Double Type As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is {R} and {F} type. {R}{C}{C} → Turbo Drive : 130 Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
024.flavorText: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

025.name: Heatran
025.attacksText: {R}{C} → Fire Fang : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{R}{C} → Raging Flare : 80+ This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
025.flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

026.name: Pansear
026.attacksText: {R} → Live Coal : 10 {C}{C} → Bite : 20
026.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

027.name: Simisear
027.attacksText: {R} → Flare : 30 {C}{C}{C} → Giga Impact : 110 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
027.flavorText: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

028.name: Galarian Darmanitan
028.attacksText: {C} → Headbutt : 40 {W}{W}{C} → Frozen Heat : 110+ You may discard all {W} Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 60 more damage.
028.flavorText: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

029.name: Larvesta
029.evolves: Evolves into Volcarona or Volcarona- GX
029.attacksText: {R} → Singe Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
029.flavorText: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.

030.name: Volcarona
030.attacksText: {R} → Cauterize : 80 If your opponent's Active Pokémon has no damage counters on it before this attack does damage, this attack does nothing. {R}{R}{C} → Fire Wing : 110
030.flavorText: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.

031.name: Fletchinder
031.evolves: Evolves from Fletchling and into Talonflame
031.attacksText: {C} → Searing Flame : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
031.flavorText: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

032.name: Talonflame
032.evolves: Evolves from Fletchinder and into Talonflame BREAK
032.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Scorching Feathers If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , the Attacking Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{C}{C} → Mach Flight : 120 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
032.flavorText: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

033.name: Centiskorch V
033.attacksText: {R} → Radiating Heat : 20 You may discard an Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {R}{R}{R}{R} → Burning Train : 180 · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

034.name: Centiskorch VMAX
034.attacksText: {C}{C} → G-Max Centiferno : 40+ This attack does 40 more damage for each {R} Energy attached to this Pokémon. If you did any damage with this attack, you may attach a {R} Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

035.name: Galarian Mr. Mime
035.attacksText: {W} → Reflect During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C} → Icy Snow : 30
035.flavorText: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

036.name: Galarian Mr. Rime
036.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Shuffle Dance Once during your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's face-down Prize cards with the top card of their deck. (The cards stay face down.) {W}{C}{C} → Mad Party : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.
036.flavorText: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

037.name: Suicune
037.attacksText: {W} → Wave Splash : 20 {W}{W}{C} → Aurora Loop : 130 Put 2 {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.
037.flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

038.name: Feebas
038.evolves: Evolves into Milotic or Milotic ex
038.attacksText: {C} → Nap Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.
038.flavorText: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

039.name: Milotic
039.evolves: Evolves from Feebas
039.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Bright Heal Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon. {W}{C}{C} → Surf : 80
039.flavorText: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

040.name: Relicanth
040.attacksText: {C} → Fossil Search Search your deck for up to 2 Rare Fossil cards and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {W}{C} → Surf : 40
040.flavorText: The reason it hasn't changed at all in a hundred million years is that it's apparently already a perfect life-form.

041.name: Panpour
041.evolves: Evolves into Simipour
041.attacksText: {W} → Water Gun : 10 {C}{C} → Bite : 20
041.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

042.name: Simipour
042.attacksText: {W} → Water Gun : 30 {C}{C}{C} → Giga Impact : 110 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
042.flavorText: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

043.name: Galarian Darumaka
043.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {W}{C} → Headbutt : 20
043.flavorText: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

044.name: Galarian Darmanitan
044.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Blizzard : 80 This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{W}{C}{C} → Crushing Headbutt : 170 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Crushing Headbutt.
044.flavorText: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

045.name: Vanillite
045.attacksText: {W} → Ice Over : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
045.flavorText: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

046.name: Vanillish
046.evolves: Evolves from Vanillite and into Vanilluxe
046.attacksText: {W} → Freezing Headbutt : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
046.flavorText: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.

047.name: Vanilluxe
047.evolves: Evolves from Vanillish
047.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Bitter Cold Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{C} → Frost Smash : 90
047.flavorText: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

048.name: Cubchoo
048.attacksText: {C} → Chop : 10 {W}{C} → Icicle : 30
048.flavorText: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.

049.name: Beartic
049.attacksText: {C}{C} → Slash : 40 {W}{C}{C} → Frozen Slice : 150 This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.
049.flavorText: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

050.name: Wishiwashi
050.attacksText: {C} → Deep Sea Swirl Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 8 cards. {W} → Wave Splash : 20
050.flavorText: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

051.name: Mareanie
051.evolves: Evolves into Toxapex or Toxapex- GX
051.attacksText: {C} → Regeneration Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. {W}{C} → Poison Tentacles : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
051.flavorText: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

052.name: Toxapex
052.attacksText: {C} → Recover Discard an Energy from this Pokémon and heal all damage from it. {W}{C}{C} → Poisonous Whip : 80 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
052.flavorText: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

053.name: Dracovish
053.evolves: Evolves from Rare Fossil
053.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Primal Law As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play any Pokémon from their hand to evolve their Pokémon. {W}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 120
053.flavorText: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

054.name: Arctovish
054.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Hard Face : 90 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 60 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{C}{C}{C} → Cold Breath : 130 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
054.flavorText: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

055.name: Mareep
055.evolves: Evolves into Flaaffy or Dark Flaaffy
055.attacksText: {L} → Static Shock : 20
055.flavorText: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

056.name: Flaaffy
056.evolves: Evolves from Mareep and into Ampharos , Ampharos- GX , or Ampharos ex
056.attacksText: {L} → Static Shock : 40
056.flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

057.name: Ampharos
057.attacksText: {L} → Dazzle Blast : 50 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {L}{L} → Electric Ball : 130
057.flavorText: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

058.name: Electrike
058.evolves: Evolves into Manectric , Mega Manectric ex , or Manectric ex
058.attacksText: {L}{C} → Thunderbolt : 50 Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
058.flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

059.name: Manectric
059.attacksText: {L} → Strafe : 30 You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {L}{L}{C} → Flash Impact : 150 This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
059.flavorText: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

060.name: Vikavolt V
060.attacksText: {L}{C} → Paralyzing Bolt : 50 During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand. {L}{L}{C} → Super Zap Cannon : 190 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

061.name: Tapu Koko
061.attacksText: {C} → Allure Draw 2 cards. {L}{L}{C} → Electric Ball : 110
061.flavorText: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

062.name: Toxel
062.evolves: Evolves into Toxtricity , Toxtricity ex , or Light Toxtricity
062.attacksText: {C} → Slap : 10 {L}{C} → Static Shock : 20
062.flavorText: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

063.name: Toxtricity
063.evolves: Evolves from Toxel
063.attacksText: {C}{C} → Risk Taker Flip a coin. If heads, discard the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck. If tails, discard the top 5 cards of your deck. {L}{L}{C} → Thunder Jolt : 160 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
063.flavorText: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.

064.name: Pincurchin
064.attacksText: {L} → Double Draw Draw 2 cards. {L}{C}{C} → Zing Zap : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
064.flavorText: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

065.name: Dracozolt
065.attacksText: {L} → Amping Up : 30 During your next turn, this Pokémon's Amping Up attack does 90 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C}{C}{C} → Giga Impact : 200 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
065.flavorText: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

066.name: Arctozolt
066.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Biting Whirlpool Whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. {L}{C} → Electro Ball : 70
066.flavorText: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

067.name: Jigglypuff
067.evolves: Evolves into Wigglytuff , Wigglytuff ex , […] Dark Wigglytuff , Light Wigglytuff
067.attacksText: {C} → Mumble : 10 {P}{C} → Moon Kick : 20
067.flavorText: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!

068.name: Wigglytuff
068.attacksText: {P} → Sleep Pulse : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C}{C} → Double Smash : 90× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.
068.flavorText: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!

069.name: Mew V
069.attacksText: {P}{P} → X Ball : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each Energy attached to both Active Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

070.name: Snubbull
070.evolves: Evolves into Granbull
070.attacksText: {P}{C} → Sharp Fang : 30
070.flavorText: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

071.name: Granbull
071.attacksText: {P}{C} → Jaw Lock : 50 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. {P}{P}{C} → Headbutt Bounce : 130
071.flavorText: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

072.name: Lunatone
072.attacksText: {C} → Future Sight Look at the top 4 cards of either player's deck and put them back in any order. {P}{C} → Psychic : 20+ This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
072.flavorText: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

073.name: Gothita
073.attacksText: {P} → Fortunate Eye Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back in any order. {P}{C} → Gentle Slap : 30
073.flavorText: Though they're still only babies, there's psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.

074.name: Gothorita
074.evolves: Evolves from Gothita and into Gothitelle
074.attacksText: {P} → Whiny Voice Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck. {P}{C} → Double Spin : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.
074.flavorText: It's said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.

075.name: Gothitelle
075.evolves: Evolves from Gothorita
075.attacksText: {P} → Mind Bend : 40 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {P}{C} → Bend : 90 Choose 2 random cards from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals those cards and shuffles them into their deck.
075.flavorText: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It's also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.

076.name: Golett
076.attacksText: {P}{C} → Rollout : 30 {P}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 50
076.flavorText: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

077.name: Golurk
077.attacksText: {P}{C}{C} → Dynamic Chop : 80 {P}{C}{C}{C}{C} → Golurk Hammer : 180
077.flavorText: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

078.name: Dedenne
078.attacksText: {P}{C}{C} → Mad Party : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.
078.flavorText: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

079.name: Morelull
079.attacksText: {C} → Spore Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {P}{C} → Flop : 20
079.flavorText: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull's head. The caps regrow overnight.

080.name: Shiinotic
080.attacksText: {C} → Flickering Light : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack. {P}{C} → Fear the Forest : 60+ If Glimwood Tangle is in play, this attack does 60 more damage.
080.flavorText: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

081.name: Mimikyu
081.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Heal Jamming Your opponent's Benched Pokémon can't be healed. {P}{C} → Claw Slash : 30
081.flavorText: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

082.name: Sinistea
082.attacksText: {C} → Furtive Drop Put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
082.flavorText: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

083.name: Polteageist
083.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Tea Break You must discard a Pokémon that has the Mad Party attack from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards. {C}{C} → Mad Party : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.
083.flavorText: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

084.name: Diglett
084.evolves: Evolves into Dugtrio or Dark Dugtrio
084.attacksText: {F} → Scratch : 20
084.flavorText: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

085.name: Dugtrio
085.attacksText: {F} → Dig : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon. {F}{C} → Mud Bomb : 70
085.flavorText: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

086.name: Larvitar
086.evolves: Evolves into Pupitar or Dark Pupitar
086.attacksText: {F} → Sand Spray : 10 {C}{C} → Pierce : 20
086.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

087.name: Pupitar
087.evolves: Evolves from Larvitar and into Tyranitar , Tyranitar ex , or Tyranitar- GX
087.attacksText: {F} → Sand Spray : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Rocket Evolution : 40 Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
087.flavorText: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

088.name: Tyranitar
088.attacksText: {F}{C}{C} → Bedrock Breaker : 120 Discard a Stadium in play. {F}{F}{C}{C} → Mountain Swing : 250 Discard the top 5 cards of your deck.
088.flavorText: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

089.name: Trapinch
089.attacksText: {F} → Land's Pulse : 10+ If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 10 more damage.
089.flavorText: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

090.name: Vibrava
090.evolves: Evolves from Trapinch and into Flygon , Flygon ex , or Flygon- GX
090.attacksText: {F} → Sand Pulse : 20 This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
090.flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

091.name: Flygon
091.evolves: Evolves from Vibrava and into Flygon LV. X
091.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Labyrinth of Sand As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Active Pokémon can't retreat. {F}{C}{C} → Desert Geyser : 130 If your opponent has a Stadium in play, discard it. If you discarded a Stadium in this way, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
091.flavorText: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

092.name: Solrock
092.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Resistance Shade If you have Lunatone in play, your opponent's Pokémon in play have no Resistance. {F}{C} → Rock Throw : 30
092.flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

093.name: Hippopotas
093.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {F}{F}{F}{C} → Double Stomp : 70+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.
093.flavorText: It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.

094.name: Hippowdon
094.evolves: Evolves from Hippopotas and into Hippowdon LV. X
094.attacksText: {F}{F}{C} → Triple Smash : 80× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads. {F}{F}{F}{C} → Land Crush : 150
094.flavorText: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

095.name: Rhyperior V
095.attacksText: {F}{C}{C} → Drill Run : 80 Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Heavy Rock Artillery : 210 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Heavy Rock Artillery. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

096.name: Diggersby
096.attacksText: {F}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 90 {F}{F}{C}{C} → Land Crush : 140
096.flavorText: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

097.name: Passimian
097.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {F}{C}{C} → Rock Hurl : 70 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
097.flavorText: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.

098.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
098.attacksText: {F} → Pierce : 40 {F}{C}{C} → Meteor Assault : 180 This Pokémon can't use Meteor Assault again until it leaves the Active Spot.
098.flavorText: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

099.name: Galarian Slowbro V
099.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Rapid-Fire Poison Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Poisoned. {D}{D}{C} → Tripping Shot : 130 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

100.name: Whiscash
100.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Submerge As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's) . {F}{F} → Earthquake : 140 This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
100.flavorText: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

101.name: Galarian Yamask
101.attacksText: {C}{C} → Reckless Charge : 50 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
101.flavorText: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

102.name: Galarian Runerigus
102.attacksText: {C}{C} → Spreading Spite For each damage counter on this Galarian Runerigus, put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like. {F}{C}{C} → Mad Hammer : 120 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
102.flavorText: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

103.name: Binacle
103.attacksText: {F}{C}{C} → Dual Chop : 50× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.
103.flavorText: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

104.name: Barbaracle
104.attacksText: {F}{C} → Rock Hurl : 50 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance. {F}{C}{C} → Hand Press : 80+ If you have more cards in your hand than your opponent, this attack does 80 more damage.
104.flavorText: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

105.name: Rolycoly
105.attacksText: {C} → Ram : 10
105.flavorText: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

106.name: Carkol
106.evolves: Evolves from Rolycoly and into Coalossal
106.attacksText: {C}{C} → Ram : 30 {F}{C}{C} → Heat Crash : 60
106.flavorText: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

107.name: Coalossal
107.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Tar Generator Once during your turn, you may attach a {R} Energy card, a {F} Energy card, or 1 of each from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Flaming Avalanche : 130
107.flavorText: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

108.name: Sandaconda V
108.attacksText: {F} → Sand Eater : 30 Attach a {F} Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {F}{F}{C} → Sand Breath : 220 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

109.name: Falinks
109.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Team Attack : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has “Falinks” in its name.
109.flavorText: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

110.name: Falinks V
110.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Iron Defense Formation All of your Pokémon that have “Falinks” in their name take 20 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{F}{C} → Giga Impact : 210 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

111.name: Stonjourner
111.attacksText: {F}{C}{C} → Mega Kick : 80 {F}{C}{C}{C} → Power Press : 120+ If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached (in addition to this attack's cost) , this attack does 60 more damage.
111.flavorText: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

112.name: Koffing
112.evolves: Evolves into Weezing , Galarian Weezing , or Dark Weezing
112.attacksText: {D} → Suffocating Gas : 10
112.flavorText: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

113.name: Galarian Weezing
113.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Neutralizing Gas As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Pokémon in play have no Abilities, except for Neutralizing Gas. {D} → Severe Poison Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 4 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon during Pokémon Checkup.
113.flavorText: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

114.name: Stunky
114.attacksText: {C}{C} → Poison Gas : 10 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
114.flavorText: From its rear, it sprays a foul-smelling liquid at opponents. It aims for their faces, and it can hit them from over 16 feet away.

115.name: Skuntank
115.attacksText: {C}{C} → Slash : 50 {D}{C}{C} → Poison Ring : 80 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
115.flavorText: In its belly, it reserves stinky fluid that it shoots from its tail during battle. As this Pokémon's diet varies, so does the stench of its fluid.

116.name: Spiritomb
116.attacksText: {D} → Splitting Spite Discard the top card of each player's deck. {D}{C} → Dripping Grudge Put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each Pokémon in your discard pile.
116.flavorText: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

117.name: Trubbish
117.attacksText: {C}{C} → Venoshock : 20+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 50 more damage.
117.flavorText: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

118.name: Garbodor
118.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Poisonous Puddle Once during your turn, if a Stadium is in play, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Poisoned. {D}{C}{C} → Sludge Bomb : 80
118.flavorText: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

119.name: Vullaby
119.evolves: Evolves into Mandibuzz or Mandibuzz ex
119.attacksText: {C} → Pluck : 10 Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
119.flavorText: It wears a bone to protect its rear. It often squabbles with others of its kind over particularly comfy bones.

120.name: Mandibuzz
120.evolves: Evolves from Vullaby and into Mandibuzz BREAK
120.attacksText: {D} → Bone Rush : 30× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads. {D}{D} → Blindside This attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
120.flavorText: Although it's a bit of a ruffian, this Pokémon will take lost Vullaby under its wing and care for them till they're ready to leave the nest.

121.name: Malamar V
121.attacksText: {D}{C} → Drag Off Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to the new Active Pokémon. {D}{D}{C} → Brain Shake : 130 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

122.name: Malamar VMAX
122.attacksText: {D}{D}{C} → Max Jammer : 180 Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose a card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

123.name: Impidimp
123.attacksText: {D} → Beat : 10 {D}{C} → Stampede : 20
123.flavorText: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

124.name: Morgrem
124.evolves: Evolves from Impidimp and into Grimmsnarl
124.attacksText: {D} → Bite : 30 {D}{C}{C} → False Surrender : 60 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
124.flavorText: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

125.name: Grimmsnarl
125.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Dark Oath As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks cost {C} more. {D}{C}{C} → Energy Press : 100+ This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
125.flavorText: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

126.name: Galarian Meowth
126.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Evolution Roar You must discard 2 cards from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Galarian Perrserker, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {M}{C} → Scratch : 20
126.flavorText: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

127.name: Galarian Perrserker
127.attacksText: {M}{C} → Slash : 50 {M}{M}{C} → Claw Dagger : 80× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.
127.flavorText: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

128.name: Scizor
128.attacksText: {M} → Raid : 30+ If this Pokémon evolved from Scyther during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage. {M}{C}{C} → Guard Claw : 90 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
128.flavorText: Once it has identified something as an enemy, it will continue beating them with its steel-hard pincers until there's nothing left but scraps.

129.name: Bronzor
129.attacksText: {M} → Ram : 10 {M}{C} → Speed Dive : 20
129.flavorText: It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on its body doesn't come from any culture in the Galar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.

130.name: Bronzong
130.evolves: Evolves from Bronzor and into Bronzong BREAK
130.attacksText: {M} → Smack : 30 {M}{C}{C} → Gyro Ball : 70 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.
130.flavorText: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.

131.name: Probopass
131.attacksText: {M} → Gravitational Drop : 10+ This attack does 30 more damage for each {C} in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost. {M}{M}{C} → Heavy Impact : 120
131.flavorText: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.

132.name: Durant
132.attacksText: {C} → Gathering Food For each Energy attached to this Pokémon, search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {M}{C}{C} → Metal Claw : 80
132.flavorText: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

133.name: Honedge
133.evolves: Evolves into Doublade
133.attacksText: {M}{C} → Slicing Blade : 30
133.flavorText: Honedge's soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up Honedge's body.

134.name: Doublade
134.evolves: Evolves from Honedge and into Aegislash or Aegislash ex
134.attacksText: {M}{C} → Slash : 30 {M}{M}{C} → Double Slash : 80× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.
134.flavorText: Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades rub together to emit a metallic sound that unnerves opponents.

135.name: Aegislash
135.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Big Shield All of your Pokémon take 30 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . You can't apply more than 1 Big Shield Ability at a time. {M}{M}{C} → Power Edge : 130
135.flavorText: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

136.name: Copperajah V
