022.name: Flapple
022.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Apple Drop Once during your turn, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you placed any damage counters in this way, shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck. {C}{C} → Acid Spray : 60 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
022.flavorText: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

023.name: Appletun
023.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Delicious Aroma Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Basic Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. {G}{C} → Solar Beam : 70
023.flavorText: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

024.name: Vulpix
024.evolves: Evolves into Ninetales , Ninetales ex , or Light Ninetales
024.attacksText: {R} → Confuse Ray Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {C}{C} → Smash Kick : 20
024.flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

025.name: Ninetales
025.evolves: Evolves from Vulpix and into Ninetales BREAK
025.attacksText: {R} → Hex : 30+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 90 more damage. {R}{C}{C} → Flickering Flames : 90 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
025.flavorText: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

026.name: Ninetales V
026.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Nine-Tailed Shapeshifter Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack. {R}{C}{C}{C} → Flamethrower : 180 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

027.name: Growlithe
027.evolves: Evolves into Arcanine , Arcanine ex , or Light Arcanine
027.attacksText: {C} → Odor Sleuth Flip a coin. If heads, put a card from your discard pile into your hand. {R}{R}{C} → Fire Claws : 60
027.flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

028.name: Arcanine
028.evolves: Evolves from Growlithe and into Arcanine BREAK
028.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Warming Up If this Pokémon has a Burning Scarf attached, it gets +100 HP. {R}{R}{C} → Fire Mane : 130
028.flavorText: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

029.name: Magmar
029.attacksText: {C} → Punch : 10 {R}{C} → Heat Breath : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
029.flavorText: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

030.name: Magmortar
030.evolves: Evolves from Magmar and into Magmortar LV. X
030.attacksText: {R}{C} → Burst Punch : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{R}{C} → Ground Burn : 80+ Each player discards the top card of their deck. This attack does 100 more damage for each Energy card discarded in this way.
030.flavorText: Magmortar takes down its enemies by shooting fireballs, which burn them to a blackened crisp. It avoids this method when hunting prey.

031.name: Litwick
031.attacksText: {R} → Scorch Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
031.flavorText: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

032.name: Lampent
032.evolves: Evolves from Litwick and into Chandelure
032.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Top Entry Once during your turn, if you drew this Pokémon from your deck at the beginning of your turn and your Bench isn't full, before you put it into your hand, you may put it onto your Bench. {R} → Reignite : 20 Attach a {R} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.
032.flavorText: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

033.name: Chandelure
033.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Protective Glow All of your Pokémon that have Energy attached have no Weakness. {R}{C} → Mirage Flare : 110 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
033.flavorText: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

034.name: Heatmor
034.attacksText: {C} → Lick : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {R}{R}{C} → Flamethrower : 120 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
034.flavorText: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

035.name: Cinderace V
035.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Field Runner If a Stadium is in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost. {R}{R}{C} → Crimson Legs : 140 · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

036.name: Cinderace VMAX
036.attacksText: {R}{C} → Counter : 30+ If this Pokémon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does that much more damage. {R}{R}{C} → Max Pyro Ball : 170 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

037.name: Galarian Mr. Mime
037.attacksText: {C} → Icy Wind : 10 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {W}{C} → Triple Spin : 20× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
037.flavorText: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

038.name: Galarian Mr. Rime
038.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Screen Cleaner Prevent all effects of your opponent's attacks, except damage, done to all of your Pokémon that have Energy attached. (Existing effects are not removed.) {W}{C} → Triple Spin : 50× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.
038.flavorText: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

039.name: Magikarp
039.evolves: Evolves into Gyarados , Gyarados- GX , Dark Gyarados , or Gyarados ex
039.attacksText: {C} → Leap Out Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
039.flavorText: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

040.name: Gyarados
040.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Wrack Down : 90 {W}{W}{C}{C}{C} → Big Storm : 200 Discard any Stadium in play.
040.flavorText: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

041.name: Wingull
041.evolves: Evolves into Pelipper
041.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {W}{C} → Wave Splash : 20
041.flavorText: It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.

042.name: Pelipper
042.attacksText: {C}{C} → Wing Attack : 50 {W}{C}{C} → Power Cyclone : 110 Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
042.flavorText: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

043.name: Milotic V
043.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Aqua Impact : 10+ This attack does 50 more damage for each {C} in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost. {W}{C}{C}{C} → Hypno Splash : 150 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

044.name: Tympole
044.attacksText: {C} → Spiral Attack Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
044.flavorText: Graceful ripples running across the water's surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.

045.name: Palpitoad
045.evolves: Evolves from Tympole and into Seismitoad
045.attacksText: {C}{C} → Twirling Sign : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
045.flavorText: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.

046.name: Seismitoad
046.evolves: Evolves from Palpitoad
046.attacksText: {W} → Split Spiral Punch : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {W}{C}{C}{C} → Resonance : 120+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Confused, this attack does 120 more damage.
046.flavorText: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

047.name: Galarian Darumaka
047.evolves: Evolves into Galarian Darmanitan
047.attacksText: {W}{C} → Ice Punch : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
047.flavorText: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

048.name: Galarian Darmanitan
048.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Blizzard : 80 This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{W}{C}{C} → Crushing Headbutt : 170 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Crushing Headbutt.
048.flavorText: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

049.name: Inteleon V
049.attacksText: {W} → Snipe Shot This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{W}{C} → Aqua Report : 130 Your opponent reveals their hand. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

050.name: Inteleon VMAX
050.attacksText: {W} → Hydro Snipe : 60 You may put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand. {W}{W}{C} → Max Bullet : 160 This attack also does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

051.name: Cramorant
051.attacksText: {W} → Dive : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Hydro Pump : 50+ This attack does 20 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
051.flavorText: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

052.name: Arrokuda
052.attacksText: {W} → Rain Splash : 20
052.flavorText: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

053.name: Barraskewda
053.evolves: Evolves from Arrokuda
053.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 30 {W} → Spiral Jet : 130 Discard 2 {W} Energy cards from your hand. If you don't, this attack does nothing.
053.flavorText: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

054.name: Eiscue
054.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Ice Face If this Pokémon has full HP, it takes 60 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{C}{C} → Blizzard : 70 This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
054.flavorText: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

055.name: Eiscue V
055.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Cold Absorption Whenever you attach a {W} Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon during your turn, heal 30 damage from it. {W}{W}{C} → Blizzard : 120 This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

056.name: Voltorb
056.evolves: Evolves into Electrode , Electrode- GX , Dark Electrode , or Electrode ex
056.attacksText: {C} → Continuous Tumble : 20× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
056.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

057.name: Electrode
057.attacksText: {C} → Orb Collector Search your deck for up to 3 Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {L}{C} → Rolling Attack : 70
057.flavorText: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

058.name: Electabuzz
058.evolves: Evolves into Electivire or Electivire ex
058.attacksText: {C} → Knuckle Punch : 10 {L}{L}{C} → Electroslug : 70
058.flavorText: While it's often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.

059.name: Electivire
059.evolves: Evolves from Electabuzz and into Electivire LV. X
059.attacksText: {L}{C} → Thunder Shock : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {L}{L}{C} → Electrified Bolt : 90+ If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 90 more damage.
059.flavorText: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

060.name: Shinx
060.attacksText: {L} → Under Pressure : 10+ If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 50 more damage.
060.flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

061.name: Luxio
061.evolves: Evolves from Shinx and into Luxray or Luxray ex
061.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Top Entry Once during your turn, if you drew this Pokémon from your deck at the beginning of your turn and your Bench isn't full, before you put it into your hand, you may put it onto your Bench. {L} → Zap Kick : 30
061.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

062.name: Luxray
062.evolves: Evolves from Luxio and into Luxray BREAK
062.attacksText: {L} → Raid : 60+ If this Pokémon evolved from Luxio during this turn, this attack does 100 more damage. {L}{C} → Head Bolt : 120
062.flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

063.name: Helioptile
063.evolves: Evolves into Heliolisk
063.attacksText: {L} → Thunder Jolt : 30 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
063.flavorText: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

064.name: Heliolisk
064.evolves: Evolves from Helioptile
064.attacksText: {L} → Eerie Impulse Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {L}{C} → Thunder : 120 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
064.flavorText: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

065.name: Charjabug
065.evolves: Evolves from Grubbin and into Vikavolt or Vikavolt- GX
065.attacksText: {C} → Charge Search your deck for up to 2 {L} Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {L}{L}{C} → Lightning Ball : 70
065.flavorText: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

066.name: Vikavolt
066.attacksText: {L}{C}{C} → Powerful Storm : 60+ This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to all of your Pokémon. {L}{C}{C}{C} → Thunder Jolt Beam : 170 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
066.flavorText: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

067.name: Boltund V
067.attacksText: {L} → Electrify Search your deck for up to 2 {L} Energy cards and attach them to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. {L}{C} → Bolt Storm : 10+ This attack does 30 more damage for each {L} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

068.name: Toxel
068.evolves: Evolves into Toxtricity , Toxtricity ex , or Light Toxtricity
068.attacksText: {L} → Tight Jaw : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
068.flavorText: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

069.name: Toxtricity
069.attacksText: {L} → Poison Shout This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. {L}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 90
069.flavorText: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

070.name: Toxtricity V
070.evolves: Evolves into Toxtricity VMAX
070.attacksText: {L} → Poison Jab : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. {L}{L}{C} → Electric Riot : 90+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 90 more damage. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

071.name: Toxtricity VMAX
071.attacksText: {L}{L}{C} → G-Max Riot : 160+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 80 more damage. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

072.name: Pincurchin V
072.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Counterattack Kerzap If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if it is Knocked Out) , flip 3 coins. For each heads, put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. {L}{L}{C} → Sparking Strike : 120 · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

073.name: Morpeko
073.attacksText: {C} → Torment : 20 Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack. {L}{C} → Spark : 50 This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
073.flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

074.name: Clefairy
074.evolves: Evolves into Clefable , Mega Clefable ex , or Clefable ex
074.attacksText: {C} → Shining Fingers Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {P} → Magical Shot : 10
074.flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

075.name: Clefable
075.evolves: Evolves from Clefairy
075.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Prankish When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon on top of their deck. {P}{C} → Moon Kick : 60
075.flavorText: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

076.name: Natu
076.attacksText: {C} → Me First Draw a card.
076.flavorText: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

077.name: Xatu
077.attacksText: {C} → Energy Warp Move an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to their Active Pokémon. {P} → Psychic : 10+ This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
077.flavorText: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

078.name: Galarian Corsola
078.attacksText: {P} → Cursed Drop Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.
078.flavorText: Watch your step when wandering areas oceans once covered. What looks like a stone could be this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.

079.name: Galarian Cursola
079.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Perish Body If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, the Attacking Pokémon is Knocked Out. {P}{C} → Corner : 60 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
079.flavorText: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

080.name: Sigilyph
080.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Counterattack If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if it is Knocked Out) , put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. {P}{C} → Psychic Assault : 30+ This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
080.flavorText: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

081.name: Sandygast
081.evolves: Evolves into Palossand , Palossand ex , or Palossand- GX
081.attacksText: {P} → Sneaky Placement Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
081.flavorText: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

082.name: Palossand
082.attacksText: {C}{C} → Sand Sink Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. If this Pokémon has a Cursed Shovel attached, discard 2 more cards from the top of your opponent's deck. {P}{C}{C} → Super Absorption : 90 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
082.flavorText: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

083.name: Hatenna
083.attacksText: {C} → Find a Friend Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Psyshot : 20
083.flavorText: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

084.name: Hattrem
084.evolves: Evolves from Hatenna and into Hatterene
084.attacksText: {C} → Calm Mind Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. {C}{C} → Brutal Swing : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
084.flavorText: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

085.name: Hatterene
085.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Mind Hat Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Each player discards a card from their hand. (Your opponent discards first.) {P} → Dripping Grudge Put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each Pokémon in your discard pile.
085.flavorText: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

086.name: Milcery
086.evolves: Evolves into Alcremie or Alcremie ex
086.attacksText: {C} → Aromatherapy Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon. {P}{C} → Tackle : 20
086.flavorText: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

087.name: Alcremie
087.attacksText: {C} → Decorate Attach any number of basic Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like. {P}{C} → Draining Kiss : 50 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
087.flavorText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

088.name: Indeedee
088.attacksText: {C} → Replenish Time Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon. {P}{C} → Psybeam : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
088.flavorText: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

089.name: Dreepy
089.attacksText: {P} → Quick Attack : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.
089.flavorText: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

090.name: Drakloak
090.evolves: Evolves from Dreepy and into Dragapult or Dragapult ex
090.attacksText: {C} → Summon Search your deck for a Dreepy and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {P}{P} → Bite : 40
090.flavorText: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

091.name: Dragapult
091.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Infiltrator If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage. {P}{P} → Phantom Force : 120 Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like.
091.flavorText: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

092.name: Dragapult V
092.attacksText: {P} → Bite : 30 {P}{P} → Jet Assault : 60+ If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 80 more damage. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

093.name: Dragapult VMAX
093.attacksText: {P} → Shred : 60 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. {P}{P} → Max Phantom : 130 Put 5 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

094.name: Galarian Farfetch'd
094.attacksText: {F} → Rock Smash : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage. {C}{C} → Pierce : 30
094.flavorText: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

095.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
095.attacksText: {F} → Pierce : 40 {F}{C}{C} → Meteor Assault : 180 This Pokémon can't use Meteor Assault again until it leaves the Active Spot.
095.flavorText: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

096.name: Nosepass
096.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {C}{C}{C} → Rolling Tackle : 50
096.flavorText: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

097.name: Meditite
097.evolves: Evolves into Medicham or Medicham ex
097.attacksText: {C} → Yoga Shock : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
097.flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

098.name: Medicham
098.attacksText: {F} → Yoga Kick : 40 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. {C}{C}{C} → Psychic : 60+ This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
098.flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

099.name: Barboach
099.attacksText: {F} → Razor Fin : 10
099.flavorText: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

100.name: Sudowoodo
100.attacksText: {C} → Double Draw Draw 2 cards. {C} → Flail : 10× This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
100.flavorText: If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it's a Sudowoodo, not a tree. It hides from the rain.

101.name: Baltoy
101.evolves: Evolves into Claydol or Claydol ex
101.attacksText: {C} → Beam : 10 {F}{F} → Sand Spray : 30
101.flavorText: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

102.name: Baltoy
102.evolves: Evolves into Claydol or Claydol ex
102.attacksText: {F} → Spinning Attack : 20
102.flavorText: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

103.name: Claydol
103.attacksText: {C} → Psybeam : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {F}{F} → Explosion : 200 This Pokémon also does 120 damage to itself.
103.flavorText: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

104.name: Regirock V
104.attacksText: {F}{C} → Raging Hammer : 30+ This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. {F}{F}{C} → Rocky Tackle : 190 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

105.name: Mudbray
105.attacksText: {C} → Stampede : 10 {F}{C} → Rear Kick : 30
105.flavorText: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon. It's skilled at making use of mud.

106.name: Mudsdale
106.attacksText: {F}{F}{F} → Double Impact : 120× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 120 damage for each heads.
106.flavorText: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale's legs sets harder than stone. It's so hard that it allows this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.

107.name: Silicobra
107.attacksText: {C} → Sand Attack During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.
107.flavorText: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

108.name: Silicobra
108.attacksText: {C} → Headbutt : 10 {F}{C} → Tail Whap : 20
108.flavorText: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

109.name: Sandaconda
109.attacksText: {C} → Coil : 10 During your next turn, this Pokémon's attacks do 120 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{C}{C} → Skull Bash : 100
109.flavorText: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

110.name: Sandaconda
110.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sand Sac This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{F} → Power Press : 60+ If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra {F} Energy attached (in addition to this attack's cost) , this attack does 70 more damage.
110.flavorText: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

111.name: Clobbopus
111.attacksText: {F} → Bind : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
111.flavorText: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

112.name: Clobbopus
112.attacksText: {F}{F} → Punch : 50
112.flavorText: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

113.name: Grapploct
113.attacksText: {F}{F} → Octolock Until this Grapploct leaves the Active Spot, the Defending Pokémon's attacks cost {C}{C} more, and the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. This effect can't be applied more than once. {F}{F}{C} → Tough Swing : 130 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
113.flavorText: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

114.name: Stonjourner
114.attacksText: {F}{F} → Wild Tackle : 70 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
114.flavorText: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

115.name: Stonjourner V
115.attacksText: {F} → Guard Press : 40 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{F}{F} → Mega Kick : 150 · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

116.name: Stonjourner VMAX
116.attacksText: {F} → Stone Gift Attach a {F} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon. If you do, heal 120 damage from that Pokémon. {F}{F}{F} → Max Rockfall : 200 · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

117.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
117.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Headbutt Tantrum When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {D}{C} → Surprise Attack : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
117.flavorText: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

118.name: Galarian Linoone
118.evolves: Evolves from Galarian Zigzagoon and into Galarian Obstagoon
118.attacksText: {D} → Night Slash : 20 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {D}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 70
118.flavorText: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

119.name: Galarian Obstagoon
119.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Untamed Shout When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {D}{C} → Obstruct : 90 During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.
119.flavorText: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

120.name: Sableye V
120.attacksText: {D} → Lode Search Put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand. {D}{D} → Crazy Claws : 10+ This attack does 60 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

121.name: Skorupi
121.attacksText: {D} → Poison Sting Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. {D}{C}{C} → Slashing Claw : 50
121.flavorText: It attacks using the claws on its tail. Once locked in its grip, its prey is unable to move as this Pokémon's poison seeps in.

122.name: Drapion
122.evolves: Evolves from Skorupi and into Drapion LV. X
122.attacksText: {D}{C}{C} → Hard Press : 80 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {D}{D}{C}{C} → Toxic Strike : 130 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
122.flavorText: It's so vicious that it's called the Sand Demon. Yet when confronted by Hippowdon, Drapion keeps a low profile and will never pick a fight.

123.name: Croagunk
123.evolves: Evolves into Toxicroak or Toxicroak ex
123.attacksText: {C} → Stampede : 10 {D}{C} → Lunge Out : 30
123.flavorText: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.

124.name: Toxicroak
124.attacksText: Ability ⇢ More Poison Put 2 more damage counters on your opponent's Poisoned Pokémon during Pokémon Checkup. {D}{C}{C} → Poison Claws : 70 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
124.flavorText: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.

125.name: Nickit
125.attacksText: {D} → Instigate Your opponent shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If they put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, they draw 3 cards.
125.flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

126.name: Thievul
126.attacksText: {D} → Thief : 20 Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose a card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck. {D}{C}{C} → Darkness Fang : 90
126.flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

127.name: Galarian Meowth
127.attacksText: {C} → Hone Claws During your next turn, this Pokémon's Slash attack does 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M}{C} → Slash : 30
127.flavorText: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

128.name: Galarian Perrserker
128.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Steely Spirit Your {M} Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M}{M}{C} → Metal Claw : 70
128.flavorText: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

129.name: Mawile
129.attacksText: {C} → Find a Friend Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {M}{C} → Crunch : 40 Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
129.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

130.name: Ferroseed
130.attacksText: {C} → Rollout : 10
130.flavorText: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

131.name: Ferrothorn
131.attacksText: {C} → Triple Smash : 30× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads. {M}{M}{C} → Energy Slap : 100 You may move all Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
131.flavorText: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

132.name: Galarian Stunfisk
132.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Snap Trap If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if it is Knocked Out) , discard an Energy from the Attacking Pokémon. {M}{C} → Damage Rush : 30+ Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.
132.flavorText: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

133.name: Pawniard
133.evolves: Evolves into Bisharp
133.attacksText: {C} → Cut Up : 10 {M}{C} → Metal Claw : 20
133.flavorText: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

134.name: Bisharp
134.evolves: Evolves from Pawniard and into Kingambit
134.attacksText: {C} → Charge Order : 30+ This attack does 30 more damage for each of your Benched Pawniard. {M}{C} → Slicing Blade : 60
134.flavorText: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

135.name: Corviknight
135.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 50 {M}{C}{C} → Iron Wings : 130 You may discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, during your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 100 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
135.flavorText: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

136.name: Cufant
136.evolves: Evolves into Copperajah or Copperajah ex
136.attacksText: {M}{M} → Stomp : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
136.flavorText: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

137.name: Copperajah
137.attacksText: {M}{M} → Dig Drain : 60 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. {M}{M}{M} → Muscular Nose : 220 If this Pokémon has 8 or more damage counters on it, this attack does nothing.
137.flavorText: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

Put the other cards into your hand. If you use this Ability, your turn ends. {M}{M}{M} → Brave Blade : 230 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

139.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Dauntless Shield Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon VMAX. {M}{M}{C} → Assault Tackle : 130 Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

140.name: Snorlax
140.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Rolling Tackle : 80 {C}{C}{C}{C} → Heavy Impact : 130

141.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Swallow : 60 Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Falling Down : 170 This Pokémon is now Asleep. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

142.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → G-Max Fall : 60+ This attack does 30 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon. · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

143.name: Hoothoot
143.attacksText: {C} → Send Back Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. {C}{C} → Wing Attack : 20
143.flavorText: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.

144.name: Noctowl
144.evolves: Evolves from Hoothoot and into Noctowl BREAK
144.attacksText: {C}{C} → Wing Attack : 40 {C}{C}{C} → Carry Off Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. They shuffle that Pokémon and all attached cards into their deck. Then, shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.
144.flavorText: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

145.name: Minccino
145.attacksText: {C} → Glance Look at the top card of your opponent's deck. {C}{C} → Tail Slap : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
145.flavorText: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

146.name: Minccino
146.attacksText: {C} → Tail Whap : 30
146.flavorText: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

147.name: Cinccino
147.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Make Do You must discard a card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards. {C} → Energy Assist : 40 Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
147.flavorText: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

148.name: Oranguru
148.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Primate Wisdom Once during your turn, you may switch a card from your hand with the top card of your deck. {C}{C}{C} → Whap Down : 70
148.flavorText: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

149.name: Drampa
149.attacksText: {C}{C} → Dragon Pulse : 80 Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.
149.flavorText: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

150.name: Rookidee
150.attacksText: {C} → Flap : 10 {C}{C} → Glide : 30
150.flavorText: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

151.name: Corvisquire
151.evolves: Evolves from Rookidee and into Corviknight
151.attacksText: {C} → Pluck : 20 Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {C}{C} → Drill Peck : 50
151.flavorText: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

152.name: Wooloo
152.attacksText: {C}{C} → Expand : 30 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
152.flavorText: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

153.name: Wooloo
153.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {C}{C}{C} → Headbutt : 50
153.flavorText: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

154.name: Dubwool
154.attacksText: {C} → Cotton Guard : 30 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C}{C} → Double-Edge : 120 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

073.attacksText: {C} → Roar Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. {L} → Static Shock : 10
073.flavorText: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

074.name: Yamper
074.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 10 {L}{C} → Zap Kick : 20
074.flavorText: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

075.name: Boltund
075.evolves: Evolves from Yamper
075.attacksText: {C}{C} → Big Bite : 50 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. {L}{C}{C} → Fighting Fangs : 90+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon V or Pokémon- GX , this attack does 90 more damage.
075.flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

076.name: Boltund
076.attacksText: {C}{C} → Bite : 50 {L}{L}{C} → Electrodash : 160 During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
076.flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

077.name: Pincurchin
077.attacksText: {L}{L} → Shocking Needles : 30× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads. If at least 2 of them are heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
077.flavorText: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

078.name: Morpeko
078.attacksText: {L} → Attack the Wound : 10+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 50 more damage.
078.flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

079.name: Morpeko V
079.attacksText: {C} → Spark : 20 This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {L}{L}{C} → Electro Wheel : 150 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, switch it with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

080.name: Morpeko VMAX
080.attacksText: {L}{L}{C} → Max Discharge : 180 This attack also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · VMAX rule : When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

081.name: Galarian Ponyta
081.attacksText: {P} → Psy Bolt : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
081.flavorText: This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.

082.name: Galarian Rapidash
082.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Pastel Veil Your Pokémon recover from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions. {P}{C} → Psychic : 30+ This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
082.flavorText: Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.

083.name: Gastly
083.evolves: Evolves into Haunter or Dark Haunter
083.attacksText: {P} → Fade Out : 20 Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.
083.flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

084.name: Haunter
084.evolves: Evolves from Gastly and into Gengar , Mega Gengar ex , or Gengar ex
084.attacksText: {C} → Nightmare : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {P}{C} → Spooky Shot : 40
084.flavorText: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.

085.name: Gengar
085.evolves: Evolves from Haunter and into Gengar LV. X
085.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Life Shaker As often as you like during your turn, you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your {P} Pokémon to another of your {P} Pokémon. {P}{P}{C} → Hypnoblast : 90 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
085.flavorText: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.

086.name: Wobbuffet V
086.attacksText: {C}{C} → Gritty Comeback Switch all damage counters on this Pokémon with those on your opponent's Active Pokémon. {P}{P} → Shadow Bind : 70 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

087.name: Munna
087.attacksText: {C} → Moonlight Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. {P}{C} → Psychic Sphere : 30
087.flavorText: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it's eating a good dream, and black when it's eating a nightmare.

088.name: Musharna
088.attacksText: {C} → Sleepy Pulse Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. During Pokémon Checkup, your opponent flips 2 coins instead of 1. If either of them is tails, that Pokémon is still Asleep. {P}{C} → Super Hypnoblast : 10+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Asleep, this attack does 120 more damage.
088.flavorText: It drowses and dreams all the time. It's best to leave it be if it's just woken up, as it's a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

089.name: Sinistea
089.attacksText: {C} → Teatime Each player draws 2 cards.
089.flavorText: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

090.name: Polteageist
090.attacksText: {C} → Teatime Each player draws 2 cards. {P}{C} → Poltergeist : 50× Your opponent reveals their hand. This attack does 50 damage for each Trainer card you find there.
090.flavorText: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

091.name: Indeedee V
091.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Watch Over Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon. {P}{C}{C} → Psychic : 10+ This attack does 60 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. · V rule : When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

092.name: Diglett
092.evolves: Evolves into Dugtrio or Dark Dugtrio
092.attacksText: {F} → Scratch : 10
092.flavorText: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

093.name: Dugtrio
093.attacksText: {F} → Mud Bomb : 60
093.flavorText: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

094.name: Hitmonlee
094.attacksText: {C}{C} → Low Sweep : 40 {F}{F}{C} → Coordinated Strike : 80+ If Hitmonchan is on your Bench, this attack does 80 more damage.
094.flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

095.name: Hitmonchan
095.attacksText: {F} → Coordinated Beatdown : 20+ If Hitmonlee is on your Bench, this attack does 20 more damage. {F}{F} → Mach Cross : 60
095.flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

096.name: Rhyhorn
096.attacksText: {C} → Horn Attack : 10 {F}{C} → Hammer In : 30
096.flavorText: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.

097.name: Rhyhorn
097.attacksText: {F}{C} → Stomp Off Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck. {F}{F}{C} → Land Crush : 70
097.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.

098.name: Rhydon
098.evolves: Evolves from Rhyhorn and into Rhyperior
098.attacksText: {F}{C}{C} → Horn Drill : 50 {F}{F}{C}{C} → Rock Slide : 100 This attack also does 10 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
098.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

099.name: Rhyperior
099.evolves: Evolves from Rhydon and into Rhyperior LV. X
099.attacksText: {F}{C}{C} → Rock Tumble : 90 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance. {F}{F}{C}{C} → Bedrock Shake : 120 This attack also does 60 damage to each Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it (both yours and your opponent's) . (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
099.flavorText: It relies on its carapace to deflect incoming attacks and throw its enemy off balance. As soon as that happens, it drives its drill into the foe.

001.name: Pikachu on the Ball
001.attacksText: {C} → Tail Whap : 10 {L}{L}{C} → Lightning Shot : 120 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
001.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

002.name: Eevee on the Ball
002.attacksText: {C} → Make the Assist Attach a basic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {C}{C} → Tackle : 20
002.flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

003.name: Grookey on the Ball
003.attacksText: {G} → Tenacious Defense During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. {G}{G}{C} → Razor Leaf : 50
003.flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

004.name: Scorbunny on the Ball
004.attacksText: {R} → Fiery Dribbling : 20× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads. {R}{C} → Reckless Charge : 30 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
004.flavorText: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

005.name: Sobble on the Ball
005.attacksText: {W} → Spectacular Save Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon. {W}{C} → Rain Splash : 20
005.flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

100.name: Cosmog
100.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Unaware Prevent all effects of your opponent's attacks, except damage, done to this Pokémon. {C} → Surprise Attack : 10 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
100.flavorText: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

101.name: Cosmoem
101.evolves: Evolves from Cosmog and into Lunala- GX , Solgaleo- GX , Lunala , or Solgaleo
101.attacksText: {C} → Stiffen During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 40 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
101.flavorText: The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the “cocoon of the stars” and built an altar to worship it.

102.name: Lunala
102.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Blessing of the Moone Once during your turn (before your attack) , if you have Solgaleo in play, you may search your deck for up to 2 Energy cards and attach them to your Solgaleo or Lunala in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. {P}{P}{C} → Lunar Blast : 130
102.flavorText: Records of it exist in writings from long, long ago, where it was known by the name “the beast that calls the moon.”

103.name: Marshadow
103.attacksText: {P}{C}{C} → Shadow Imitation Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's non- GX attacks and use it as this attack.
103.flavorText: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

104.name: Blacephalon
104.attacksText: {P}{C} → Fireworks Bomb Put 4 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like. If your opponent has exactly 3 Prize cards remaining, put 12 damage counters on them instead.
104.flavorText: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

105.name: Onix
105.evolves: Evolves into Steelix , Dark Steelix , or Steelix ex
105.attacksText: {C} → Dig Deep Put an Energy card from your discard pile into your hand. {C}{C}{C} → Tail Smash : 100 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
105.flavorText: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

106.name: Nosepass
106.attacksText: {C}{C} → Draw Toward Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Zap Cannon : 50 This Pokémon can't use Zap Cannon during your next turn.
106.flavorText: It moves less than an inch a year, but when it's in a jam, it will spin and drill down into the ground in a split second.

107.name: Trapinch
107.attacksText: {C} → Nest Building Search your deck for a Stadium card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {F} → Sand Spray : 10
107.flavorText: Its jaws are strong enough to crush rocks but so heavy that it can't get up if it flips over. Sandile seize those moments as their chance.

108.name: Trapinch
108.attacksText: {F}{C} → Dig : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.
108.flavorText: Its jaws are strong enough to crush rocks but so heavy that it can't get up if it flips over. Sandile seize those moments as their chance.

109.name: Vibrava
109.evolves: Evolves from Trapinch and into Flygon , Flygon ex , or Flygon- GX
109.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Obnoxious Whirring Whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to this Pokémon. {F}{C} → Flap : 40
109.flavorText: It vibrates its wings to generate ultrasonic waves, causing its prey to faint. Then it buries the prey alive in the sand to preserve it.

110.name: Flygon-GX
110.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Dusty Defense As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, all of your Pokémon take 30 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{F}{F} → Desert Hurricane : 120+ If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 120 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium card. {F}{F}{F} → Sonic Edge- GX : 220 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

111.name: Anorith
111.evolves: Evolves from Unidentified Fossil and into Armaldo or Armaldo ex
111.attacksText: {C}{C} → Bug Bite : 40 {F}{C}{C} → Claw Slash : 80
111.flavorText: When restored Anorith are released into the ocean, they don't thrive, because the water composition has changed since their era.

112.name: Armaldo
112.attacksText: {C}{C} → Ancient Blast : 20+ This attack does 50 more damage for each Unidentified Fossil card in your discard pile. {F}{C}{C} → Mach Claw : 100 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
112.flavorText: It lived on land and went out into the sea to hunt for prey. Its sharp claws were its greatest weapon.

113.name: Groudon
113.attacksText: {C} → Drought Attach up to 2 {F} Energy cards from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon. {F}{F}{C} → Trembling Ground : 130 This Pokémon can't use Trembling Ground during your next turn.
113.flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

114.name: Drilbur
114.evolves: Evolves into Excadrill or Excadrill ex
114.attacksText: {C} → Rototiller Shuffle a card from your discard pile into your deck. {F} → Mud-Slap : 10
114.flavorText: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

115.name: Excadrill
115.attacksText: {F} → Eleventh Hour Tackle : 30+ If there are 3 or fewer cards in your deck, this attack does 150 more damage. {F} → Drill Bazooka : 120 Discard the top 4 cards of your deck.
115.flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

116.name: Palpitoad
116.evolves: Evolves from Tympole and into Seismitoad
116.attacksText: {F} → Mini Earthquake : 60 This attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
116.flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

117.name: Seismitoad
117.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Bulldoze Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may search your deck for a card, shuffle your deck, then put that card on top of it. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Tremulous Fist : 80+ This attack does 30 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.
117.flavorText: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

118.name: Throh
118.attacksText: {F}{C} → Reverse Shoulder Throw : 30+ If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 90 more damage.
118.flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

119.name: Pancham
119.attacksText: {C} → Punch : 10
119.flavorText: It follows Pangoro around like a henchman. When Pancham makes a big mistake, its leaf gets taken away.

120.name: Pangoro
120.attacksText: {C} → Light Punch : 40 {C}{C}{C} → Magnum Punch : 90
120.flavorText: This rowdy Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.

121.name: Crabrawler
121.attacksText: {C} → Jab : 10 {F}{C} → Confront : 30
121.flavorText: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

122.name: Crabominable
122.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Solid Shell This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{F}{C} → Freezing Punch : 80+ If this Pokémon has any {W} Energy attached to it, this attack does 80 more damage.
122.flavorText: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

123.name: Rockruff
123.evolves: Evolves into Lycanroc , Lycanroc- GX , or Lycanroc ex
123.attacksText: {C} → Roar Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. {F}{C}{C} → Rock Throw : 40
123.flavorText: As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.

124.name: Lycanroc
124.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Boiling Blood If your opponent has any Pokémon- GX or Pokémon- EX in play, this Pokémon's attacks cost {C}{C}{C} less. {C}{C}{C} → Voltage Claw : 60+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any Special Energy attached to it, this attack does 70 more damage.
124.flavorText: It has no problem ignoring orders it doesn't like. It doesn't seem to mind getting hurt at all—as long as it can finish off its opponent.

125.name: Passimian
125.attacksText: {F} → Spike Draw : 20 Draw 2 cards. {F}{C}{C} → Seismic Toss : 70
125.flavorText: They use their saliva to stick leaves to their shoulders. You can tell what troop they belong to from the position of the leaves.

126.name: Sandygast
126.evolves: Evolves into Palossand , Palossand ex , or Palossand- GX
126.attacksText: {F} → Astonish : 10 Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck. {C}{C} → Hook : 20
126.flavorText: It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.

127.name: Palossand
127.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Guard Press : 80 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{C}{C}{C} → Earthquake : 150 This attack does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
127.flavorText: Each of its grains of sand has its own will. Palossand eats small Pokémon and siphons away their vital essence while they're still alive.

128.name: Alolan Meowth
128.evolves: Evolves into Alolan Persian- GX or Alolan Persian
128.attacksText: {D} → Swagger Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {C}{C} → Hook : 20
128.flavorText: It's impulsive, selfish, and fickle. It's very popular with some Trainers who like giving it the attention it needs.

129.name: Alolan Persian-GX
129.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Smug Face Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's TAG TEAM Pokémon and Ultra Beasts, and by your opponent's Pokémon that have any Special Energy attached to them. {D}{C}{C} → Claw Slash : 120 {D}{C}{C} → Stalking Claws- GX This attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on that Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

130.name: Alolan Grimer
130.evolves: Evolves into Alolan Muk or Alolan Muk- GX
130.attacksText: {C} → Melt : 10 {D}{C} → Nasty Goo : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
130.flavorText: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

131.name: Alolan Muk
131.attacksText: {D}{C} → Panic Poison : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned, Confused, and Poisoned. {D}{D}{C} → Sludge Bomb : 110
131.flavorText: There are over a hundred kinds of poison inside its body. Chemical reactions between different poisons are the source of its vitality.

132.name: Carvanha
132.evolves: Evolves into Sharpedo , Mega Sharpedo ex , or Sharpedo ex
132.attacksText: {D} → Agility : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.
132.flavorText: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

133.name: Absol
133.attacksText: {C} → Ominous News Discard a Special Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {D}{C} → Dirty Throw : 70 Discard a card from your hand. If you can't discard a card, this attack does nothing.
133.flavorText: The only thing unlucky about Absol is its appearance. It protects fields and warns people of disaster, so one ought to be grateful for it.

134.name: Pawniard
134.attacksText: {C} → Bag Slash Your opponent reveals their hand. Discard an Item card you find there. {D}{C} → Sting : 20
134.flavorText: After shredding its prey, it sharpens its blades on a stone by the river. Each Pawniard has its own favorite sharpening stone.

135.name: Bisharp
135.evolves: Evolves from Pawniard and into Kingambit
135.attacksText: {C} → Corner : 30 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. {D}{C} → Slashing Strike : 80 This Pokémon can't use Slashing Strike during your next turn.
135.flavorText: No matter how strong the Bisharp, it's said that if the blade on its head is chipped, it will retire from its position as the boss.

136.name: Guzzlord
136.attacksText: {D} → Mountain Munch Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. {D}{D}{C}{C} → Red Banquet : 120 If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 1 more Prize card.
136.flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

137.name: Alolan Sandshrew
137.evolves: Evolves into Alolan Sandslash or Alolan Sandslash- GX
137.attacksText: {@} → Run Around Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {C}{C} → Metal Claw : 20
137.flavorText: After fleeing a volcanic eruption, it ended up moving to an area of snowy mountains. Its ice shell is as hard as steel.

138.name: Alolan Sandslash
138.attacksText: {@} → Curve Strike : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn. {M}{C}{C} → Reinforced Needle : 60+ If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 60 more damage.
138.flavorText: It runs across snow-covered plains at high speeds. It developed thick, sharp claws to plow through the snow.

139.name: Steelix
139.attacksText: {C}{C} → Thumping Fall : 50× Discard any number of Pokémon with a Retreat Cost of exactly 4 from your hand. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way. {M}{C}{C}{C} → Iron Tail : 100× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.
139.flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

140.name: Mawile
140.attacksText: {C} → Dual Calling Search your deck for up to 2 TAG TEAM cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C} → Dark Clamp : 20 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
140.flavorText: A cunning and terrifying Pokémon, its cuteness makes opponents let down their guard—and then it swallows them whole with its huge jaws.

141.name: Probopass
141.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Hard Press : 60 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {M}{C}{C}{C} → Triple Nose : 80+ Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.
141.flavorText: Although it can control its units known as Mini-Noses, they sometimes get lost and don't come back.

142.name: Solgaleo
142.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Armor of the Sunne If you have Lunala in play, your Solgaleo and Lunala take 50 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . You can't apply more than 1 Armor of the Sunne Ability at a time. {M}{M}{C}{C} → Sol Fangs : 180 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.
142.flavorText: Sometimes the result of its opening an Ultra Wormhole is that energy and life-forms from other worlds are called here to this world.

143.name: Togepi & Cleffa & Igglybuff-GX
143.attacksText: {Y}{Y}{C} → Rolling Panic : 120+ Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads. {Y}{Y}{+} → Supreme Puff- GX Take another turn after this one. (Skip the between-turns step.) If this Pokémon has at least 14 extra {Y} Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost) , your opponent shuffles all of their Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to them into their deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · TAG TEAM rule : When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

144.name: Clefairy
144.evolves: Evolves into Clefable , Mega Clefable ex , or Clefable ex
144.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Doll Swap : 60 Put this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your hand. If you do, you may play Lillie's Poké Doll from your hand as your new Active Pokémon.
144.flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

145.name: Alolan Ninetales
145.attacksText: {@} → Rubbish Blizzard : 10× This attack does 10 damage for each Pokémon Tool card in your discard pile.

256.attacksText: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard a card from their hand. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

257.name: Recycle Energy
257.attacksText: This card provides {C} Energy. If this card is discarded from play, put it into your hand instead of the discard pile.

001.name: Rowlet & Alolan Exeggutor-GX
001.attacksText: {@} → Super Growth Search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your {G} Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it.
