(You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · TAG TEAM rule : When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

002.name: Yanma
002.evolves: Evolves into Yanmega or Yanmega ex
002.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {C}{C} → Cutting Wind : 20
002.flavorText: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

003.name: Yanmega
003.evolves: Evolves from Yanma and into Yanmega BREAK
003.attacksText: {C}{C} → Tackle : 50 {C}{C}{C} → Air Slash : 100 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
003.flavorText: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

004.name: Celebi
004.attacksText: {G} → Time Spiral Devolve 1 of your opponent's evolved Pokémon by removing the highest Stage Evolution card from it. Your opponent shuffles that card into their deck. {G} → Mind Bend : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
004.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

005.name: Shroomish
005.attacksText: {G} → Poison Powder Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
005.flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

006.name: Sewaddle
006.attacksText: {C} → Multiply Search your deck for up to 2 Sewaddle and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {C} → Gnaw : 10
006.flavorText: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

007.name: Sewaddle
007.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Swaddling Leaves This Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {G} → Surprise Attack : 20 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
007.flavorText: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

008.name: Swadloon
008.evolves: Evolves from Sewaddle and into Leavanny
008.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Swaddling Leaves This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C} → Bug Bite : 10
008.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

009.name: Leavanny
009.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Blanket Weaver Your {G} Pokémon take 40 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . You can't apply more than 1 Blanket Weaver Ability at a time. {G}{C} → Razor Leaf : 70
009.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

010.name: Dwebble
010.attacksText: {C} → Dig Claws : 10
010.flavorText: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

011.name: Crustle
011.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Shell Armor This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {G}{C}{C} → Fury Cutter : 50+ Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 40 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 80 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 150 more damage.
011.flavorText: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

012.name: Karrablast
012.attacksText: {C} → Take Down : 20 This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.
012.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

013.name: Foongus
013.evolves: Evolves into Amoonguss or Amoonguss ex
013.attacksText: {C} → Spore Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
013.flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

014.name: Amoonguss
014.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Bursting Spores Whenever you play a Pokémon that has the Spore attack from your hand during your turn, you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Asleep and Poisoned. {C}{C} → Venoshock : 20+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 70 more damage.
014.flavorText: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

015.name: Fomantis
015.evolves: Evolves into Lurantis or Lurantis- GX
015.attacksText: {C} → Sweet Scent Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. {G} → Leafage : 10
015.flavorText: When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.

016.name: Lurantis
016.attacksText: {C} → Petal Blizzard This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {G} → Sol Slice : 50+ If this Pokémon has any {R} Energy attached to it, this attack does 50 more damage.
016.flavorText: For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.

017.name: Bounsweet
017.attacksText: {G} → Splash : 10 {C}{C} → Spinning Attack : 20
017.flavorText: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it's not intelligent enough to care.

018.name: Steenee
018.evolves: Evolves from Bounsweet and into Tsareena , Tsareena ex , or Tsareena- GX
018.attacksText: {C}{C} → Double Slap : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads. {G}{C}{C} → Leaf Step : 60
018.flavorText: It's protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn't care.

019.name: Tsareena
019.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Queenly Reward Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may attach a {G} Energy card from your discard pile to your Active Pokémon. {G}{C}{C} → High Jump Kick : 90
019.flavorText: A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.

020.name: Dhelmise
020.attacksText: {C} → Sea Creeper Net Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {G}{C} → Spinning Attack : 40
020.flavorText: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.

021.name: Magmar
021.attacksText: {R} → Smoke Bomb : 10 If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.
021.flavorText: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

022.name: Magmortar
022.evolves: Evolves from Magmar and into Magmortar LV. X
022.attacksText: {C}{C} → Smoke Bomb : 50 If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen. {R}{C}{C} → Flamethrower : 120 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
022.flavorText: There are still quite a few factories that rely on the flames provided by Magmortar to process metals.

023.name: Numel
023.evolves: Evolves into Camerupt , Mega Camerupt ex , or Camerupt ex
023.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {R}{C}{C}{C} → Flamethrower : 80 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
023.flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

024.name: Camerupt
024.attacksText: {C}{C} → Tackle : 50 {R}{C}{C}{C} → Strong Flare : 150 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.
024.flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

025.name: Heatran-GX
025.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Burning Road Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to become your Active Pokémon, you may move any number of {R} Energy from your other Pokémon to it. {R}{R}{C} → Steaming Stomp : 130 {R} → Hot Burn- GX : 50× This attack does 50 damage times the amount of {R} Energy attached to this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

026.name: Victini
026.attacksText: {R} → Victory Sign Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards of different types and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. {R} → Flare : 20
026.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

027.name: Litwick
027.attacksText: {R} → Find a Friend Search your deck for a {R} Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
027.flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

028.name: Litwick
028.attacksText: {R} → Find a Friend Search your deck for a {R} Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
028.flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

029.name: Lampent
029.evolves: Evolves from Litwick and into Chandelure
029.attacksText: {R} → Fireworks : 40 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
029.flavorText: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

030.name: Chandelure
030.attacksText: {R} → Spirit Burner : 10+ Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. This attack does 60 more damage for each Pokémon you discarded in this way. Then, put any number of {R} Pokémon you discarded in this way onto your Bench.
030.flavorText: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

031.name: Fletchinder
031.evolves: Evolves from Fletchling and into Talonflame
031.attacksText: {R} → Flame Charge : 20 Search your deck for a {R} Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
031.flavorText: It scatters embers in the tall grass. Then bug Pokémon, frightened by the flames, come flying out, and Fletchinder gobbles them up.

032.name: Talonflame
032.evolves: Evolves from Fletchinder and into Talonflame BREAK
032.attacksText: {R} → Heat Wave : 40 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{C} → Flare Raid : 100 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
032.flavorText: Its tough wings don't allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters' outfits were made from Talonflame wings.

033.name: Salandit
033.evolves: Evolves into Salazzle , Salazzle- GX , or Salazzle ex
033.attacksText: {R} → Live Coal : 10
033.flavorText: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

034.name: Salazzle
034.attacksText: {R}{R} → Fire Claws : 70
034.flavorText: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

035.name: Slowpoke & Psyduck-GX
035.attacksText: {W}{W} → Ditch and Splash : 40× Discard any number of Supporter cards from your hand. This attack does 40 damage for each card you discarded in this way. {W}{W}{+} → Thrilling Times- GX : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 100 more damage. If this Pokémon has at least 6 extra {W} Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost) , flip 10 coins instead, and this attack does 100 more damage for each heads. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · TAG TEAM rule : When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

036.name: Lapras
036.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Mermaid's Call Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put a Misty's Favor card from your discard pile into your hand. {W}{W}{C} → Surf : 90
036.flavorText: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

037.name: Snorunt
037.evolves: Evolves into Froslass , Glalie , Mega Froslass ex , or Froslass ex
037.attacksText: {W} → Icicle : 20
037.flavorText: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.

038.name: Froslass
038.attacksText: {W} → Spiteful Sigh : 20× Put up to 7 damage counters on this Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter you placed in this way. {W} → Icy Wind : 40 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
038.flavorText: It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. It only goes after men it thinks are handsome.

039.name: Finneon
039.evolves: Evolves into Lumineon
039.attacksText: {C} → Gust : 10
039.flavorText: When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They're popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.

040.name: Lumineon
040.attacksText: {C}{C} → Neon Trickery : 50 You may move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.
040.flavorText: Deep down at the bottom of the ocean, prey is scarce. Lumineon get into fierce disputes with Lanturn over food.

041.name: Snover
041.evolves: Evolves into Abomasnow or Mega Abomasnow ex
041.attacksText: {W} → Powder Snow : 10 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
041.flavorText: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

042.name: Abomasnow
042.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Quick Freeze : 70 If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any {W} Energy attached to it, it is now Paralyzed. {W}{W}{C}{C} → Wild Tackle : 140 This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.
042.flavorText: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”

043.name: Basculin
043.attacksText: {C} → Swarming Bites This attack does 20 damage for each Basculin you have in play to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {C} → Tackle : 20
043.flavorText: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.

044.name: Tirtouga
044.evolves: Evolves from Unidentified Fossil and into Carracosta or Carracosta- GX
044.attacksText: {F} → Shell Attack : 20 {F}{C}{C} → Boulder Crush : 60
044.flavorText: It was restored from an ancient fossil. Tirtouga lived in the sea but came up onto the land to search for prey.

045.name: Carracosta

114.name: Sandile
114.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Grandiose Fangs : 30 If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, this Pokémon's attacks do 120 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon during your next turn (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .

117.flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

118.name: Inkay
118.attacksText: {D} → Perplex Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
118.flavorText: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles and holds them in place.

119.name: Malamar
119.attacksText: {D} → Hypnotic Reign Your opponent reveals their hand. You may discard a Pokémon you find there and use one of that Pokémon's non- GX attacks as this attack. {D}{C}{C} → Dark Pressure : 80 Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.
119.flavorText: When it comes to strong hypnosis, there's an endless number of people who utilize Malamar for their nefarious deeds.

120.name: Lucario & Melmetal-GX
120.attacksText: {C}{C} → Steel Fist : 50 Search your deck for a {M} Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {M}{M}{C}{C} → Heavy Impact : 150 {C}{+} → Full Metal Wall- GX For the rest of this game, your {M} Pokémon take 30 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost) , discard all Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · TAG TEAM rule : When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

121.name: Alolan Diglett
121.flavorText: Although it's powerful enough to dig right through volcanic rock, it doesn't allow itself to be seen very often.

122.name: Alolan Dugtrio
122.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Hair Wall Your {M} Pokémon take 10 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M}{C} → Hammer In : 40
122.flavorText: Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so it's not very fast, but it has the power to dig through bedrock.

123.name: Aron
123.attacksText: {M} → Rigidify During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M}{C} → Metal Claw : 20
123.flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

124.name: Lairon
124.evolves: Evolves from Aron and into Aggron or Aggron ex
124.attacksText: {M} → Rigidify During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M}{M}{C} → Headbutt : 70
124.flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

125.name: Aggron
125.attacksText: {M}{C}{C} → Extra-Tight Press : 80 During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , put 8 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. {M}{C}{C}{C} → Giga Impact : 160 This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.
125.flavorText: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

126.name: Lucario
126.evolves: Evolves from Riolu and into Lucario LV. X
126.attacksText: {C} → Low Sweep : 40 {M}{M} → Rush Up : 60+ If you attached a Pokémon Tool card from your hand to this Pokémon during this turn, this attack does 70 more damage.
126.flavorText: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.

127.name: Genesect
127.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Fast-Flight Configuration If your opponent has any Pokémon- GX or Pokémon- EX in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost. {M}{C}{C} → Splitting Beam : 30 This attack does 30 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

129.name: Melmetal
129.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Metal Eater Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may discard a {M} Pokémon from your hand. If you do, heal 100 damage from this Pokémon. {M}{C}{C}{C} → Heavy Impact : 130

132.name: Clefairy
132.evolves: Evolves into Clefable , Mega Clefable ex , or Clefable ex
132.attacksText: {C} → Double Slap : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

133.attacksText: {C} → Moon-Watching Dance : 10+ This attack does 30 more damage for each of your Pokémon that has any {Y} Energy attached to it.
133.flavorText: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.

134.name: Jigglypuff
134.evolves: Evolves into Wigglytuff , Wigglytuff ex , […] Dark Wigglytuff , Light Wigglytuff
134.attacksText: {C}{C} → Ball Roll : 20× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
134.flavorText: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

135.attacksText: {C} → Orb Polish Put 3 Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand. {C}{C}{C} → Sleepy Ball : 80 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
135.flavorText: Thanks to its bouncy body and fine fur, this Pokémon is sought after. Holding one in your arms while you sleep feels great.

136.name: Togepi

136.attacksText: {C} → Daunt : 10 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .

137.attacksText: {C} → Energy Present Attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {Y}{C} → Magical Shot : 30

139.evolves: Evolves into Whimsicott , Whimsicott ex , or Whimsicott- GX

145.attacksText: {C} → Glide : 10 {C}{C} → Speed Dive : 20

146.attacksText: {C}{C} → Drill Run Double : 70 Flip a coin. If heads, discard 2 Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

147.evolves: Evolves into Persian , Dark Persian , or Persian- GX

155.name: Porygon

155.attacksText: {C} → Quick Draw Draw a card. {C}{C} → Ram : 20
155.flavorText: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.

156.evolves: Evolves from Porygon and into Porygon-Z or Porygon-Z- GX
156.attacksText: {C} → Double Draw Draw 2 cards. {C}{C} → Spinning Attack : 30

157.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Crazy Code As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may attach a Special Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Tantrum : 120 This Pokémon is now Confused.

018.attacksText: {C} → Electrical Signal Search your deck for up to 2 {L} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C}{C} → Corkscrew Punch : 30
018.flavorText: If you find its nest, you shouldn't stick your hand inside. You'll get bitten by an irritated Grubbin.

019.name: Kartana
019.attacksText: {G} → Big Cut : 10+ If you have exactly 4 Prize cards remaining, this attack does 120 more damage. {G}{C}{C} → False Swipe Flip a coin. If heads, put damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is 10.
019.flavorText: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

020.name: Reshiram & Charizard-GX
020.attacksText: {R}{C} → Outrage : 30+ This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. {R}{R}{R}{C} → Flare Strike : 230 This Pokémon can't use Flare Strike during your next turn. {R}{R}{R}{+} → Double Blaze- GX : 200+ If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {R} Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost) , this attack does 100 more damage, and this attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · TAG TEAM rule : When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

021.name: Growlithe
021.evolves: Evolves into Arcanine , Arcanine ex , or Light Arcanine
021.attacksText: {R} → Live Coal : 10 {R}{R} → Combustion : 30
021.flavorText: While it's quite friendly toward humans once it's grown used to them, in the wild it must be quite fierce to defend its territory from Rockruff.

022.name: Arcanine
022.evolves: Evolves from Growlithe and into Arcanine BREAK
022.attacksText: {R}{R}{R} → Grand Flame : 120 Attach 2 {R} Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {R}{R}{R}{R} → Heat Tackle : 190 This Pokémon does 50 damage to itself.
022.flavorText: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.

023.name: Darumaka
023.attacksText: {C} → Flame Charge : 10 Search your deck for a {R} Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Flop : 20
023.flavorText: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

024.name: Darmanitan
024.attacksText: {C} → Find Wildfire Search your deck for up to 3 {R} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {R}{R} → Flare Blitz : 110 Discard all {R} Energy from this Pokémon.
024.flavorText: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.

025.name: Volcanion
025.attacksText: {R} → Flare Starter Search your deck for a {R} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. If you go second and it's your first turn, instead search for up to 3 {R} Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. {R}{R} → High-Heat Blast : 50+ If you have at least 4 {R} Energy in play, this attack does 60 more damage.
025.flavorText: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

026.name: Litten
026.attacksText: {R} → Singe Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
026.flavorText: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

027.name: Litten
027.attacksText: {C} → Caturday Draw a card. If you do, this Pokémon is now Asleep. {R}{C}{C} → Big Bite : 60 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
027.flavorText: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

028.name: Torracat
028.evolves: Evolves from Litten and into Incineroar- GX , Incineroar , or Incineroar ex
028.attacksText: {R} → Fire Fang : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
028.flavorText: It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. A powerful Pokémon, its sharp claws can leave its Trainer's whole body covered in scratches.

029.name: Incineroar
029.evolves: Evolves from Torracat and into Incineroar
029.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Strong Cheer Your Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . You can't apply more than 1 Strong Cheer Ability at a time. {R}{C} → Flamethrower : 90 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
029.flavorText: Although it's rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.

030.name: Salandit
030.evolves: Evolves into Salazzle , Salazzle- GX , or Salazzle ex
030.attacksText: {R} → Grass Fire : 10 Discard a {G} Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
030.flavorText: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

031.name: Salazzle
031.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Roast Reveal Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may discard a {R} Energy card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards. {R}{C} → Combustion : 60
031.flavorText: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

032.name: Blacephalon
032.attacksText: {R} → Blazer : 10+ Turn 1 of your face-down Prize cards face up. If it's a {R} Energy card, this attack does 50 more damage. (That Prize card remains face up for the rest of the game.) {R}{R}{R} → Fireball Circus : 50× Discard any number of {R} Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.
032.flavorText: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

033.name: Squirtle
033.evolves: Evolves into Wartortle or Dark Wartortle
033.attacksText: {W} → Bubble : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
033.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

034.name: Wartortle
034.evolves: Evolves from Squirtle and into Blastoise , Blastoise ex , or Blastoise- GX
034.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Solid Shell This Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{W} → Aqua Slash : 60 This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.
034.flavorText: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

035.name: Blastoise-GX
035.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Solid Shell This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{W} → Rocket Splash : 60× Shuffle any amount of {W} Energy from your Pokémon into your deck. This attack does 60 damage for each card you shuffled into your deck in this way. {W} → Giant Geyser- GX Attach any number of {W} Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

036.name: Poliwag
036.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Round ‘n' Round You can use this Ability only if you go second. Once during your first turn (before your attack) , you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Confused. {W} → Watering : 10
036.flavorText: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.

037.name: Poliwag
037.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
037.flavorText: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.

038.name: Poliwhirl
038.evolves: Evolves from Poliwag and into Poliwrath , Politoed , or Politoed ex
038.attacksText: {W} → Bubble : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {C}{C} → Knuckle Punch : 40
038.flavorText: Although it has become capable of living on land, it spends its time in the water, where its prey, fish Pokémon, are plentiful.

039.name: Poliwrath
039.evolves: Evolves from Poliwhirl
039.attacksText: {C}{C} → Knuckle Punch : 50 {W}{C}{C} → Swirly Rush : 90+ If Poliwag and Poliwhirl are on your Bench, this attack does 90 more damage.
039.flavorText: It's quite a gifted swimmer, even among Water-type Pokémon, but it normally spends its time on land.

040.name: Tentacool
040.attacksText: {C} → Bubble Jutsu : 10+ If you played Janine from your hand during this turn, this attack does 50 more damage.
040.flavorText: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.

041.name: Tentacruel
041.evolves: Evolves from Tentacool
041.attacksText: {C} → Wicked Tentacles Move an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of their Pokémon. If you do, put 3 damage counters on the Pokémon you moved the Energy to. {C}{C}{C} → Wrap : 60 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
041.flavorText: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

042.name: Slowpoke
042.evolves: Evolves into Slowking , Slowbro , […] Dark Slowbro , Slowking ex , Dark Slowking
042.attacksText: {W} → Growl During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C} → Tail Whap : 20
042.flavorText: There are some places where Slowpoke is worshiped because of a long-standing belief that whenever Slowpoke yawns, it rains.

043.name: Slowbro
043.attacksText: {W} → Yawn Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {W}{C}{C} → Three Strikes : 100× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads. If all of them are tails, you lose this game.
043.flavorText: Spacing out is basically all it does. It turns back into Slowpoke if its tail, along with Shellder, breaks off.

044.name: Seel
044.evolves: Evolves into Dewgong or Light Dewgong
044.attacksText: {C}{C} → Horn Attack : 30
044.flavorText: It has always been supposed that Seel live only in cold seas. Their having shown up in Alola is a mystery.

045.name: Dewgong
045.attacksText: {C}{C} → Tail Whap : 60 {C}{C}{C} → Dual Blizzard Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 60 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
045.flavorText: It swims through the ocean at a speed of eight knots, searching for Pokémon that will become its prey. It's especially fond of Wishiwashi.

046.name: Krabby
046.evolves: Evolves into Kingler
046.attacksText: {C} → Stampede : 10 {W}{C} → Vice Grip : 20
046.flavorText: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

047.name: Kingler
047.evolves: Evolves from Krabby
047.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Bubble Beam : 80 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{C}{C}{C} → Massive Rend : 130
047.flavorText: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

048.name: Goldeen
048.attacksText: {W} → Elegant Swim : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.
048.flavorText: Although known for their splendid tail fins, Goldeen apparently compete among themselves to see whose horn is thickest and sharpest.

049.name: Seaking
049.attacksText: {W} → Enhanced Horn : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads. If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, flip 6 coins instead.
049.flavorText: Its horn spins like a drill to steadily hollow out rocks—even harder ones. The coloration of the male is more vivid.

050.name: Kyurem
050.attacksText: {C} → Call Forth Cold Search your deck for a {W} Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {W}{W}{C} → Hail Prison : 110 Discard 2 {W} Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
050.flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

051.name: Froakie
051.evolves: Evolves into Frogadier
051.attacksText: {C} → Quick Attack : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
051.flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

052.name: Frogadier
052.evolves: Evolves from Froakie and into Greninja , Greninja ex , or Greninja- GX
052.attacksText: {C} → Afterimage Strike : 20 If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.
052.flavorText: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

053.name: Pyukumuku
053.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {W}{C}{C} → Surprise Fist : 60+ You and your opponent play Rock-Paper-Scissors. If you win, this attack does 60 more damage.
053.flavorText: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

054.name: Pikachu
054.evolves: Evolves into Raichu , Alolan Raichu , […] Raichu- GX , Dark Raichu
054.attacksText: {L}{C} → Pika Ball : 30
054.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

055.name: Raichu
055.evolves: Evolves from Pikachu and into Raichu BREAK or Raichu LV. X
055.attacksText: {C} → Never Give Up You can use this attack only if you have at least 3 more Prize cards remaining than your opponent. Attach all {L} Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like. {L}{L}{C} → Head Bolt : 110
055.flavorText: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.

056.name: Stunfisk
056.attacksText: {C} → Raging Thunder : 30 This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {C}{C} → Electric Trap : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each of your Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.
056.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

057.name: Dedenne-GX
057.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Dedechange When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 6 cards. You can't use more than 1 Dedechange Ability each turn. {L}{C} → Static Shock : 50 {L}{C} → Tingly Return- GX : 50 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. Put this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your hand. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

058.name: Charjabug
058.evolves: Evolves from Grubbin and into Vikavolt or Vikavolt- GX
058.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Battery Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Vikavolt or Vikavolt- GX as a Special Energy card. This card provides 2 {L} Energy only while it's attached to a Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Pierce : 60
058.flavorText: It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you'll get a shock!

059.name: Vikavolt
059.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Stealthy Body If there is any Stadium card in play, this Pokémon has no Weakness. {L}{L}{L}{C} → Electricannon : 120+ You may discard all {L} Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 100 more damage.
059.flavorText: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.

060.name: Zeraora
060.attacksText: {L} → Crushing Claw : 20 Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {L}{C}{C} → Discharge : 50× Discard all {L} Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.
060.flavorText: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

061.name: Muk & Alolan Muk-GX
061.attacksText: {P}{C}{C} → Severe Poison Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 8 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns. {P}{C}{C}{C} → Poison Absorption : 120 If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, heal 100 damage from this Pokémon. {@}{+} → Nasty Goo Mix- GX Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned. If this Pokémon has at least 4 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost) , put 15 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · TAG TEAM rule : When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

062.name: Ekans
062.evolves: Evolves into Arbok , Dark Arbok , or Arbok ex
062.attacksText: {C} → Glare Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {P}{C} → Tail Smack : 20
062.flavorText: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

063.name: Arbok
063.evolves: Evolves from Ekans
063.attacksText: {C} → Wrap : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {P}{C} → Heavy Choke : 50+ If this Pokémon used Wrap during your last turn, this attack does 120 more damage.
063.flavorText: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

064.name: Zubat
064.evolves: Evolves into Golbat or Dark Golbat
064.attacksText: {P} → Bite : 10 {C}{C} → Venoshock : 20+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 50 more damage.
064.flavorText: It has no eyeballs, so it can't see. It checks its surroundings via the ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

065.name: Golbat
065.evolves: Evolves from Zubat and into Crobat or Crobat ex
065.attacksText: {P} → Bite : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Leech Life : 40 Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
065.flavorText: Every once in a while, you'll see a Golbat that's missing some fangs. This happens when hunger drives it to try biting a Steel-type Pokémon.

066.name: Crobat
066.evolves: Evolves from Golbat and into Crobat BREAK
066.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sound Veil When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may prevent all effects of your opponent's attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon until the end of your opponent's next turn. {C}{C}{C} → Severe Poison : 60 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 4 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.
066.flavorText: Its fangs are so sharp, if it bites you in the dark and sucks your blood, you won't notice any pain or realize you've been bitten.

067.name: Gastly
067.evolves: Evolves into Haunter or Dark Haunter
067.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Swelling Spite When this Pokémon is Knocked Out, search your deck for up to 2 Haunter and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Will-O-Wisp : 20
067.flavorText: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.

068.name: Gastly
068.evolves: Evolves into Haunter or Dark Haunter
068.attacksText: {P} → Smog Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
068.flavorText: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.

069.name: Haunter
069.evolves: Evolves from Gastly and into Gengar , Mega Gengar ex , or Gengar ex
069.attacksText: {P} → Sinister Fog Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
069.flavorText: On moonless nights, Haunter searches for someone to curse, so it's best not to go out walking around.

070.name: Gengar
070.evolves: Evolves from Haunter and into Gengar LV. X
070.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Shadow Pain When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 6 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon- GX and Pokémon- EX in any way you like. {C}{C}{C} → Twilight Poison : 70 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.
070.flavorText: You can hear tales told all over the world about how Gengar will pay a visit to children who are naughty.

071.name: Drowzee
071.evolves: Evolves into Hypno or Dark Hypno
071.attacksText: {P} → Hypnosis Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {P}{C}{C} → Psypunch : 30
071.flavorText: It can be spotted near recreational facilities, intending to eat the pleasant dreams of children who enjoyed themselves there that day.

072.name: Hypno
072.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Hypnotic Pendulum When your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, choose which of your opponent's Benched Pokémon becomes their new Active Pokémon. {P}{C}{C} → Stir the Brain : 30+ This attack does 10 more damage for each card in your opponent's hand.
072.flavorText: In Alola, Komala is Hypno's main target. It rarely harms people.

073.name: Koffing
073.evolves: Evolves into Weezing , Galarian Weezing , or Dark Weezing
073.attacksText: {C} → Foul Odor Both Active Pokémon are now Confused.
073.flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

074.name: Weezing
074.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Detention Gas As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Basic Pokémon between turns. {C}{C} → Splattering Sludge : 40 This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
074.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

075.name: Mewtwo
075.evolves: Evolves into Mewtwo LV. X
075.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Mind Report When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may put a Supporter card from your discard pile on top of your deck. {P}{C}{C} → Psyshock : 70 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
075.flavorText: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

076.name: Mew
076.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Bench Barrier Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by your opponent's attacks. {C} → Psypower Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.
076.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

077.name: Misdreavus
077.evolves: Evolves into Mismagius or Mismagius ex
077.attacksText: {P} → Ominous Eyes Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
077.flavorText: What gives meaning to its life is surprising others. If you set your ear against the red orbs around its neck, you can hear shrieking.

078.name: Mismagius
078.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Mysterious Message Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand. If you drew any cards in this way, this Pokémon is Knocked Out. {P}{C}{C} → Hypnoblast : 70 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
078.flavorText: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.

079.name: Espurr
079.attacksText: {C} → Caturday Draw a card. If you do, this Pokémon is now Asleep. {P}{C}{C} → Ear Kinesis This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon for each damage counter on that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
079.flavorText: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

080.name: Meowstic
080.attacksText: {C} → Caturday Draw 3 cards. If you do, this Pokémon is now Asleep. {P}{C}{C} → Perplexing Eyes : 70 The Defending Pokémon's Weakness is now {P} until the end of your next turn. (The amount of Weakness doesn't change.)
080.flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

081.name: Marshadow
081.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Resetting Hole Once during your turn (before your attack) , if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may discard any Stadium card in play. If you do, discard this Pokémon and all cards attached to it. {C} → Red Knuckles : 10+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Ultra Beast, this attack does 60 more damage.
081.flavorText: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

082.name: Marshadow & Machamp-GX
082.attacksText: {F}{C} → Revenge : 30+ If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during their last turn, this attack does 90 more damage. {F}{F}{C} → Hundred-Blows Impact : 160 {F}{F}{C}{+} → Acme of Heroism- GX : 200 If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost) , and if it would be Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during their next turn, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · TAG TEAM rule : When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

083.name: Sandshrew
083.evolves: Evolves into Sandslash or Dark Sandslash
083.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {F}{C}{C} → Rolling Tackle : 30
083.flavorText: It lives in areas of limited rainfall. When danger approaches, it curls up into a ball to protect its soft stomach.

084.name: Sandslash
084.attacksText: {C} → Continuous Scratch : 30× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads. {F}{C}{C} → Sand Tomb : 90 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
084.flavorText: Its claws and horns often break off. The broken claws and horns can be used to carve plows for tilling farm fields.

085.name: Diglett
085.evolves: Evolves into Dugtrio or Dark Dugtrio
085.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Underground Work If you discard this Pokémon with the effect of Giovanni's Exile, discard the top card of your opponent's deck. {F} → Hook : 10
085.flavorText: It travels through tunnels that it digs underground. It hates sunlight, so it comes out only after the sun goes down.

086.name: Dugtrio
086.attacksText: {F} → Home Ground : 30+ If you have any Stadium card in play, this attack does 60 more damage.
086.flavorText: While the three of them normally get along splendidly, on rare occasions a huge fight will break out over which head gets to eat first.

087.name: Geodude
087.attacksText: {F} → Defense Curl Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C}{C} → Rock Throw : 40
087.flavorText: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

088.name: Graveler
088.evolves: Evolves from Geodude and into Golem or Golem ex
088.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Rolling Rocks : 50 {F}{C}{C}{C} → Double-Edge : 90 This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.
088.flavorText: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

089.name: Golem
089.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Steamroller : 100 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Heavy Slam : 180- This attack does 20 less damage for each {C} in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.
089.flavorText: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

090.name: Cubone
090.evolves: Evolves into Marowak , Alolan Marowak , Alolan Marowak- GX , or Dark Marowak
090.attacksText: {C} → Focus Energy During your next turn, this Pokémon's Beat attack's base damage is 80. {C} → Beat : 10
090.flavorText: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.

091.name: Marowak
091.evolves: Evolves from Cubone and into Marowak BREAK
091.attacksText: {F} → Bone Rush : 50× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage for each heads. {C}{C}{C} → Assault Boom : 70+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 70 more damage.
091.flavorText: It throws bones at Mandibuzz to knock it down. It's thought that Marowak is trying to avenge its parent.

092.name: Rhyhorn
092.attacksText: {F} → Push Down : 20 Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.
092.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

093.name: Rhyhorn
093.attacksText: {C}{C} → Horn Attack : 30 {F}{C}{C}{C} → Boulder Crush : 80
093.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

094.name: Rhydon
094.evolves: Evolves from Rhyhorn and into Rhyperior
094.attacksText: {C}{C} → Dirty Work Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. If you played Giovanni's Exile from your hand during this turn, discard the top 5 cards instead. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Horn Attack : 90
094.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degress Fahrenheit.

095.name: Rhyperior
095.evolves: Evolves from Rhydon and into Rhyperior LV. X
095.attacksText: {F}{C}{C} → Hefty Cannon : 90 If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Break Ground : 160 This attack does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
095.flavorText: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

096.name: Wooper
096.attacksText: {W}{W} → Mud Bomb : 30
096.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

097.name: Quagsire
097.attacksText: {W} → Water Gun : 20 {W}{W}{W} → Surf : 120
097.flavorText: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

098.name: Gligar
098.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Free Flight If this Pokémon has no Energy attached to it, it has no Retreat Cost. {C}{C}{C} → Shinobi Strike : 30+ If you played Janine from your hand during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.
098.flavorText: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

099.name: Gliscor
099.evolves: Evolves from Gligar and into Gliscor LV. X
099.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw 3 cards. {C}{C}{C} → Poison Jab : 70 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
099.flavorText: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

002.flavorText: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

003.name: Morelull
003.attacksText: {G} → Sleep Spore : 10 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
003.flavorText: It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they're dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.

004.name: Charmander
004.evolves: Evolves into Charmeleon or Dark Charmeleon
004.attacksText: {C} → Reckless Charge : 20 This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.
004.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

005.name: Charizard
005.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Slash : 70 {R}{C}{C}{C} → Wild Tackle : 180 This Pokémon does 50 damage to itself.
005.flavorText: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

006.name: Arcanine
006.evolves: Evolves from Growlithe and into Arcanine BREAK
006.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Security Guard As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, all of your Pokémon take 30 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {R}{C}{C} → Sharp Fang : 90

007.name: Psyduck
007.evolves: Evolves into Golduck , Dark Golduck , or Light Golduck
007.attacksText: {W} → Panic : 10 This Pokémon is now Confused.
007.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

008.name: Magikarp
008.evolves: Evolves into Gyarados , Gyarados- GX , Dark Gyarados , or Gyarados ex
008.attacksText: {W} → Hold Still Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
008.flavorText: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

009.name: Greninja
009.evolves: Evolves from Frogadier and into Greninja BREAK
009.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Evasion Jutsu If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage. {W}{W} → Furious Shurikens This attack does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
009.flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

010.attacksText: {L} → Scout Your opponent reveals their hand. {C}{C}{C} → Surprise Attack : 80 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
010.flavorText: He loves to show off his vast knowledge. This expressive Pikachu is like a middle-aged man.

011.name: Mr. Mime
011.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Pantomime When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may switch 1 of your face-down Prize cards with the top card of your deck. {P}{C} → Juggling : 20× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
011.flavorText: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

012.name: Mewtwo
012.attacksText: {P}{C} → Psyjack : 30 Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn. {P}{P}{C} → Break Burn : 130 Discard 2 {P} Energy from this Pokémon.

013.name: Machamp
013.evolves: Evolves from Machoke and into Machamp BREAK or Machamp LV. X

014.name: Jigglypuff
014.evolves: Evolves into Wigglytuff , Wigglytuff ex , […] Dark Wigglytuff , Light Wigglytuff
014.attacksText: {Y} → Healing Melody Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.
014.flavorText: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

015.name: Snubbull
015.attacksText: {C}{C} → Play Rough : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
015.flavorText: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

016.name: Lickitung
016.attacksText: {C}{C} → Continuous Lick : 20× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

017.name: Ditto

018.attacksText: {C}{C}{C}{C} → Pitch : 150 Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

101.name: Bronzong
101.evolves: Evolves from Bronzor and into Bronzong BREAK
101.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Heatproof Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's {R} Pokémon. {M}{C}{C} → Shady Stamp : 70 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

102.attacksText: {M} → Continuous Tumble : 20× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

111.name: Alolan Ninetales

125.evolves: Evolves into Persian , Dark Persian , or Persian- GX
125.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 10 {C}{C} → Bite : 20

128.name: Kangaskhan
128.attacksText: {C} → Fast Evolution Search your deck for up to 2 Evolution Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C}{C} → Mega Punch : 80
128.flavorText: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

129.name: Tauros
129.attacksText: {C}{C} → Raging Herd : 10+ This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on all of your Tauros and Tauros- GX .
129.flavorText: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

130.name: Aerodactyl
130.attacksText: {C} → Supersonic Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {C}{C}{C} → Fossil Fangs : 90+ If you don't have any Pokémon- GX or Pokémon- EX on your Bench, this attack does 90 more damage.
130.flavorText: Restored from DNA found in amber, this Pokémon exhibited ferocity that was greater than expected. Some casualties resulted.

131.name: Lugia
131.attacksText: {C} → Power Charger : 30 Search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Blasting Wind : 110
131.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.
