022.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

023.name: Squirtle
023.evolves: Evolves into Wartortle or Dark Wartortle
023.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {W}{C} → Rain Splash : 20
023.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

024.name: Wartortle
024.evolves: Evolves from Squirtle and into Blastoise , Blastoise ex , or Blastoise- GX
024.attacksText: {C}{C} → Tackle : 30 {W}{W}{C} → Waterfall : 70
024.flavorText: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

025.name: Blastoise
025.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Powerful Squall Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach any number of {W} Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. {W}{W}{W} → Hydro Tackle : 150 This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.
025.flavorText: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

026.name: Psyduck
026.evolves: Evolves into Golduck , Dark Golduck , or Light Golduck
026.attacksText: {C} → Headache : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Trainer cards from their hand during their next turn.
026.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

027.name: Golduck
027.evolves: Evolves from Psyduck and into Golduck BREAK
027.attacksText: {W} → Amnesia : 20 Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C}{C} → Swim : 90 If any of your opponent's Pokémon have any {W} Energy attached to them, you may do 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon instead of their Active Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
027.flavorText: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.

028.name: Staryu
028.evolves: Evolves into Starmie , Mega Starmie ex , or Starmie- GX
028.attacksText: {C} → Numbing Water : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
028.flavorText: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.

029.name: Magikarp
029.evolves: Evolves into Gyarados , Gyarados- GX , Dark Gyarados , or Gyarados ex
029.attacksText: {W} → Enter the Dragon Flip a coin. If heads, put a card that evolves from this Pokémon from your discard pile onto this Pokémon to evolve it.
029.flavorText: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

030.name: Gyarados
030.attacksText: {W} → Distilled Blast : 30+ Reveal the top 7 cards of your deck. This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of {W} Energy you find there. Then, shuffle those Energy cards back into your deck and discard the other cards. {W}{W}{W} → Hyper Beam : 100 Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
030.flavorText: It fires hyper beams in all directions, burning the surrounding area to ash. There are some regions where it's called “the deity of destruction.”

031.name: Lapras
031.attacksText: {W} → Confuse Ray Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {C} → Hydro Pump : 10+ This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
031.flavorText: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

032.name: Articuno
032.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Blizzard Veil As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to your Benched {W} Pokémon. {W}{W} → Cold Cyclone : 70 Move 2 {W} Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
032.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

033.name: Pikachu & Zekrom-GX
033.attacksText: {L}{L}{L} → Full Blitz : 150 Search your deck for up to 3 {L} Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {L}{L}{L}{+} → Tag Bolt- GX : 200 If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {L} Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost) , this attack does 170 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · TAG TEAM rule : When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

034.name: Alolan Geodude
034.attacksText: {L}{C} → Self-Destruct : 60 This Pokémon does 60 damage to itself.
034.flavorText: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

035.name: Alolan Geodude
035.attacksText: {@} → Charge Search your deck for up to 2 {L} Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {L}{C}{C} → Smash Bomb : 50 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
035.flavorText: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

036.name: Alolan Graveler
036.evolves: Evolves from Alolan Geodude and into Alolan Golem or Alolan Golem- GX
036.attacksText: {@} → Rollout : 30 {L}{C}{C}{C} → Electroslug : 100
036.flavorText: When two Graveler fight each other, it fills the surroundings with flashes of light and sound. People call it the “fireworks of the earth.”

037.name: Alolan Golem
037.attacksText: {@} → Electromagnetic Bomb : 20× Move any number of {L} Energy from your Benched Pokémon to this Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage for each Energy card you moved in this way. {L}{C}{C}{C}{C} → Super Zap Cannon : 190 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.
037.flavorText: It's grumpy and stubborn. If you upset it, it discharges electricity from the surface of its body and growls with a voice like thunder.

038.name: Voltorb
038.evolves: Evolves into Electrode , Electrode- GX , Dark Electrode , or Electrode ex
038.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 20
038.flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

039.name: Electrode
039.evolves: Evolves from Voltorb
039.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Electro Shaker When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may move any number of {L} Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like. {L}{C} → Speed Ball : 50
039.flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”

040.name: Zapdos
040.attacksText: {L} → Thunderous Assault : 10+ If this Pokémon was on the Bench and became your Active Pokémon this turn, this attack does 70 more damage. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.
040.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

041.name: Mareep
041.evolves: Evolves into Flaaffy or Dark Flaaffy
041.attacksText: {L} → Shock Bolt : 30 Discard all {L} Energy from this Pokémon.
041.flavorText: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

042.name: Flaaffy
042.evolves: Evolves from Mareep and into Ampharos , Ampharos- GX , or Ampharos ex
042.attacksText: {L} → Electric Punch : 30 {L}{L} → Shock Bolt : 60 Discard all {L} Energy from this Pokémon.
042.flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

043.name: Ampharos-GX
043.attacksText: {L} → Power Recharge : 30 Put all Electropower cards from your discard pile into your hand. {L}{L} → Impact Bolt : 150 Discard all {L} Energy from this Pokémon. {L} → Electrical- GX Search your deck for up to 7 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

044.name: Blitzle
044.attacksText: {L} → Delivery Dash Search your deck for up to 2 Electropower cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {L}{C} → Zap Kick : 20
044.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

045.name: Zebstrika
045.attacksText: {L}{C} → Raid : 30+ If this Pokémon evolved from Blitzle during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage. {L}{L}{C} → Mach Bolt : 100
045.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

046.name: Emolga
046.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Nuzzly Gathering Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may search your deck for a Pokémon that has the Nuzzle attack, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {L} → Nuzzle Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
046.flavorText: It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks and makes a meal of them. It usually nests in the holes gouged in trees by Pikipek.

047.name: Joltik
047.evolves: Evolves into Galvantula or Galvantula ex
047.attacksText: {L} → Leech Life : 10 Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
047.flavorText: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

048.name: Galvantula
048.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Unnerve Whenever your opponent plays an Item or Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to this Pokémon. {L} → Spider Thread : 40 Put a card from your discard pile into your hand.
048.flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

049.name: Helioptile
049.attacksText: {C} → Pound : 10 {L}{C}{C} → Static Shock : 40
049.flavorText: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

050.name: Heliolisk
050.attacksText: {L} → Random Spark This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {L}{C}{C} → Volt Switch : 90 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched {L} Pokémon.
050.flavorText: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

051.name: Tapu Koko Prism Star
051.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Dance of the Ancients Once during your turn (before your attack) , if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may choose 2 of your Benched Pokémon and attach a {L} Energy card from your discard pile to each of them. If you do, discard all cards from this Pokémon and put it in the Lost Zone. {L}{L}{C} → Mach Bolt : 120 · {*} (Prism Star) rule : You can't have more than 1 {*} card with the same name in your deck. If a {*} card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.
051.flavorText: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

052.name: Zeraora
052.attacksText: {C} → Slash : 20 {L}{L}{C} → Wild Charge : 120 This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.
052.flavorText: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

053.name: Gengar & Mimikyu-GX
053.attacksText: {P}{P} → Poltergeist : 50× Your opponent reveals their hand. This attack does 50 damage for each Trainer card you find there. {P}{+} → Horror House- GX Your opponent can't play any cards from their hand during their next turn. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra {P} Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost) , each player draws cards until they have 7 cards in their hand. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · TAG TEAM rule : When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

054.name: Nidoran Female
054.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Scratch : 20
054.flavorText: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

055.name: Nidorina
055.evolves: Evolves from Nidoran Female and into Nidoqueen
055.attacksText: {C} → Family Rescue Shuffle 5 {P} Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck. {C}{C} → Bite : 30
055.flavorText: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

056.name: Nidoqueen
056.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Queen's Call Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may search your deck for a Pokémon that isn't a Pokémon- GX or Pokémon- EX , reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C}{C} → Power Lariat : 10+ This attack does 50 more damage for each Evolution Pokémon on your Bench.
056.flavorText: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

057.name: Nidoran Male
057.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 10 {P}{C} → Horn Attack : 20
057.flavorText: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

058.name: Nidorino
058.evolves: Evolves from Nidoran Male and into Nidoking
058.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 20 {P}{C}{C} → Horn Drill : 60
058.flavorText: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.

059.name: Nidoking
059.evolves: Evolves from Nidorino and into Nidoking BREAK
059.attacksText: {C}{C} → Drag Off Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage to the new Active Pokémon. {P}{C}{C} → King's Drum : 100+ If Nidoqueen is on your Bench, this attack does 100 more damage.
059.flavorText: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn, as it contains venom.

060.name: Tentacool
060.attacksText: {C} → Wrap : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
060.flavorText: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.

061.name: Tentacruel
061.evolves: Evolves from Tentacool
061.attacksText: {C} → Void Tentacles Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned. {P}{C}{C} → Paranormal : 70 During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Ultra Beasts.
061.flavorText: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

062.name: Grimer
062.evolves: Evolves into Muk , Dark Muk , or Muk ex
062.attacksText: {C} → Pound : 10
062.flavorText: It was born from sludge on the ocean floor. In a sterile environment, the germs within its body can't multiply, and it dies.

063.name: Muk
063.evolves: Evolves from Grimer
063.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Poison Sacs The Special Condition Poisoned is not removed when your opponent's Pokémon evolve or devolve. {P} → Toxic Secretion : 40 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.
063.flavorText: Their food sources have decreased, and their numbers have declined sharply. Sludge ponds are being built to prevent their extinction.

064.name: Alolan Marowak
064.evolves: Evolves from Cubone
064.attacksText: {@} → Limbo Limbo Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Alolan Club : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has Alolan in its name.
064.flavorText: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

065.name: Starmie
065.evolves: Evolves from Staryu and into Starmie BREAK
065.attacksText: {C} → Strange Wave : 40 Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of {W} and {P} Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
065.flavorText: Its sparkling core is called “the gem of the sea.” This core can be made into high-priced accessories that are traded in secret.

066.name: Mr. Mime
066.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Scoop-Up Block Your opponent's Pokémon that have any damage counters on them, and any cards attached to those Pokémon, can't be put into your opponent's hand. {C}{C} → Psy Bolt : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
066.flavorText: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

067.name: Mr. Mime-GX
067.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Magic Odds Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by your opponent's attacks if that damage is exactly 10, 30, 50, 70, 90, 110, 130, 150, 170, 190, 210, 230, or 250. {P}{C} → Breakdown For each card in your opponent's hand, put 1 damage counter on their Active Pokémon. {C} → Life Trick- GX Heal all damage from this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

068.name: Jynx
068.attacksText: {C} → Dazzle Dance Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {P}{C} → Mysterious Dance For each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.
068.flavorText: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

069.name: Cosmog
069.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Cosmic Guard As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's) . {C} → Mumble : 10
069.flavorText: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It's said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.

070.name: Cosmoem
070.evolves: Evolves from Cosmog and into Lunala- GX , Solgaleo- GX , Lunala , or Solgaleo
070.attacksText: {C} → Nap Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.
070.flavorText: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.

071.name: Mankey
071.evolves: Evolves into Primeape or Dark Primeape
071.attacksText: {C} → Scout Your opponent reveals their hand. {F}{C} → Low Kick : 30
071.flavorText: The smallest of things could cause it to lose its temper. Because it doesn't hold in its stress, this Pokémon can live a long time.

072.name: Primeape
072.evolves: Evolves from Mankey and into Annihilape or Annihilape ex
072.attacksText: {F} → Low Kick : 30 {F}{C}{C} → Wreck : 80+ If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 80 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium card.
072.flavorText: It will never forgive opponents who have angered it. Even after it has beaten them down until they can't move, it never ever forgives.

073.name: Hitmonlee
073.attacksText: {F} → Special Combo You can use this attack only if your Hitmonchan used Hit and Run during your last turn. This attack does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{F}{C} → Mega Kick : 90
073.flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

074.name: Hitmonchan
074.attacksText: {F} → Hit and Run : 30 You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {F}{C}{C} → Magnum Punch : 70
074.flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

075.name: Omanyte
075.evolves: Evolves from Unidentified Fossil and into Omastar
075.attacksText: {C} → Tickle : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
075.flavorText: Omanyte lived in the seas of antiquity. Its fossils have been found bearing bite marks from Archeops, so apparently Archeops preyed on it.

076.name: Omastar
076.evolves: Evolves from Omanyte and into Omastar BREAK
076.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Fossil Bind As long as you have fewer Pokémon in play than your opponent, they can't play any Item cards from their hand. {F}{C} → Bite : 60
076.flavorText: Its heavy shell is thought to be the reason this ancient Pokémon died out. It's apparently a distant ancestor of Octillery.

077.name: Kabuto
077.evolves: Evolves from Unidentified Fossil and into Kabutops or Kabutops ex
077.attacksText: {F} → Ramming Shell : 40 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
077.flavorText: This Pokémon thrived 300 million years ago. It's said that living specimens can still be seen in a certain region—a rare sight.

078.name: Kabutops
078.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Fossilized Memories As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent can't play any Supporter cards from their hand. {F}{C}{C} → Rock Slide : 80 This attack does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
078.flavorText: Its body had begun to change so it could function on land. But it didn't adapt in time and went extinct.

079.name: Larvitar
079.evolves: Evolves into Pupitar or Dark Pupitar
079.attacksText: {C}{C} → Chip Away : 30 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
079.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

080.name: Pupitar
080.evolves: Evolves from Larvitar and into Tyranitar , Tyranitar ex , or Tyranitar- GX
080.attacksText: {C}{C} → Payback : 30+ If your opponent has exactly 1 Prize card remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.
080.flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

081.name: Pancham
081.attacksText: {C}{C} → Arm Thrust : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. If tails, this attack does nothing.
081.flavorText: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

082.name: Lycanroc-GX
082.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Twilight Eyes When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. {F}{C}{C} → Accelerock : 120 {F} → Splintered Shards- GX : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each Energy card in your opponent's discard pile. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

083.name: Alolan Grimer
083.evolves: Evolves into Alolan Muk or Alolan Muk- GX
083.attacksText: {C}{C} → Chemical Breath : 20+ This attack does 50 more damage for each Special Condition affecting your opponent's Active Pokémon.
083.flavorText: The crystals on Grimer's body are lumps of toxins. If one falls off, lethal poisons leak out.

084.name: Alolan Muk
084.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Adventurous Appetite When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may look at the top 6 cards of your opponent's deck and discard any number of Item cards you find there. Your opponent shuffles the other cards back into their deck. {D}{C}{C} → Gunk Shot : 80 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
084.flavorText: While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it's not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its Trainer's furnishings and eat up the fragments.

085.name: Tyranitar
085.attacksText: {D}{C}{C} → Spinning Tail This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {D}{C}{C}{C} → Bite Off : 130+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon- GX or a Pokémon- EX , this attack does 100 more damage.
085.flavorText: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

086.name: Poochyena
086.evolves: Evolves into Mightyena or Mightyena ex
086.attacksText: {C} → Howl in the Dark Search your deck for up to 2 {D} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {D} → Bite : 10
086.flavorText: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

087.name: Mightyena
087.attacksText: {D} → Bite : 30 {C}{C} → Dark Fang : 50 Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.
087.flavorText: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

088.name: Absol
088.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Dark Ambition If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, its Retreat Cost is {C} more. {D}{C}{C} → Shadow Seeker : 30+ This attack does 30 more damage for each {C} in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.
088.flavorText: Although it's said to bring disaster, in actuality, this Pokémon possesses a calm disposition and warns people of any crises that loom.

089.name: Spiritomb
089.attacksText: {C} → Spirit Compressor Search your deck for up to 4 Pokémon and discard them. Then, shuffle your deck. {C} → Spooky Shot : 20
089.flavorText: It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago

090.name: Zorua
090.evolves: Evolves into Zoroark or Zoroark- GX
090.attacksText: {D} → Hide in Shadows Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
090.flavorText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

091.name: Zoroark
091.evolves: Evolves from Zorua and into Zoroark BREAK
091.attacksText: {D} → Taunt Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. {D}{C}{C} → Night Punishment : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile. You can't do more than 200 damage in this way.
091.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

092.name: Vullaby
092.evolves: Evolves into Mandibuzz or Mandibuzz ex
092.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {D} → Corkscrew Punch : 10
092.flavorText: It can't fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. Since it's still at a playful age, it hops around friskily.

093.name: Mandibuzz
093.evolves: Evolves from Vullaby and into Mandibuzz BREAK
093.attacksText: {D} → Trash Crash Discard an Item card from your hand. If you do, this attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. {D}{C}{C} → Brave Bird : 120 This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.
093.flavorText: It circles in the sky, keeping a keen eye out for Pokémon in a weakened state. Its choicest food is Cubone.

094.name: Pangoro
094.attacksText: {D}{C}{C} → Tighten Up : 60 Your opponent discards 2 cards from their hand. {D}{D}{C}{C} → Tantrum : 170 This Pokémon is now Confused.
094.flavorText: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent's movements. It's eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.

095.name: Yveltal
095.attacksText: {D} → Derail : 30 Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {D}{D} → Clutch : 60 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
095.flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

096.name: Hoopa-GX
096.attacksText: {D} → Rogue Ring Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {D}{D}{D} → Dark Strike : 160 This Pokémon can't use Dark Strike during your next turn. {D}{D}{D} → Devilish Hands- GX Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon- GX or Pokémon- EX 6 times. (You can choose the same Pokémon more than once.) For each time you chose a Pokémon, do 30 damage to it. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

097.name: Incineroar-GX
097.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Scar Charge Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put 3 damage counters on this Pokémon. If you do, search your deck for up to 3 {D} Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C}{C} → Crushing Punch : 130 Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Darkest Tornado- GX : 10+ This attack does 50 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

098.name: Skarmory
098.attacksText: {M}{C} → Calm Strike : 20+ If you have used your GX attack, this attack does 70 more damage. {M}{M}{C} → Steel Wing : 90 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
098.flavorText: Its metal body is sturdy, but it does rust rather easily. So on rainy days, this Pokémon prefers to stay put in its nest.

099.name: Jirachi
099.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Stellar Wish Once during your turn (before your attack) , if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may look at the top 5 cards of your deck, reveal a Trainer card you find there, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle the other cards back into your deck, and this Pokémon is now Asleep. {M}{C} → Slap : 30
099.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

SV67.name: Lycanroc-GX
SV67.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Twilight Eyes When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. {F}{C}{C} → Accelerock : 120 {F} → Splintered Shards- GX : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each Energy card in your opponent's discard pile. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

152A.name: Pokémon Communication
152A.attacksText: Reveal a Pokémon from your hand and put it into your deck. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

152B.name: Pokémon Communication
152B.attacksText: Reveal a Pokémon from your hand and put it into your deck. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

100.name: Cofagrigus
100.attacksText: {P}{C} → Spirit Juggling : 10+ Discard any number of your Benched Pokémon. This attack does 30 more damage for each Benched Pokémon you discarded in this way.
100.flavorText: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

101.name: Litwick
101.attacksText: {P} → Haunt Put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
101.flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

102.name: Lampent
102.evolves: Evolves from Litwick and into Chandelure
102.attacksText: {P} → Haunt Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
102.flavorText: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

103.name: Chandelure
103.attacksText: {P} → Cursed Drop Put 4 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like. {P}{P} → Vortex of Pain : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on all of your opponent's Pokémon.
103.flavorText: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

104.name: Meloetta
104.attacksText: {C} → Sing Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {P}{C}{C} → Miracle Harmony Flip a coin for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Sing attack. This attack does 10 damage for each heads to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
104.flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feels of those who hear it.

105.name: Mareanie
105.evolves: Evolves into Toxapex or Toxapex- GX
105.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 10 {P}{C} → Pin Missile : 10× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
105.flavorText: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

106.name: Nihilego
106.attacksText: {P} → Nightcap You can use this attack only if your opponent has exactly 2 Prize cards remaining. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack. {P} → Void Tentacles Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.
106.flavorText: One of the Ultra Beasts, it's unclear whether or not this Pokémon is sentient, but sometimes it can be observed behaving like a young girl.

107.name: Poipole
107.evolves: Evolves into Naganadel- GX or Naganadel
107.attacksText: {C} → Eye Opener Look at your face-down Prize cards. {C}{C} → Peck : 20
107.flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

108.name: Naganadel
108.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Charging Up Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Turning Point : 80+ If you have exactly 3 Prize cards remaining, this attack does 80 more damage.
108.flavorText: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

109.name: Onix
109.evolves: Evolves into Steelix , Dark Steelix , or Steelix ex
109.attacksText: {C}{C}{C}{C} → Land Crush : 120
109.flavorText: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

110.name: Sudowoodo
110.attacksText: {F} → Reply Strongly : 20+ If this Pokémon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn while it was your Active Pokémon, this attack does 80 more damage.
110.flavorText: Apparently, the larger the green parts of this Pokémon, the more collectors value it. It's a particular favorite among elderly people.

111.name: Phanpy
111.evolves: Evolves into Donphan or Dark Donphan
111.attacksText: {F}{C} → Last Resort : 50 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
111.flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

112.name: Donphan
112.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sturdy If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10. {F}{C}{C} → Rolling Spin : 70 During your next turn, this Pokémon's Rolling Spin attack does 70 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .
112.flavorText: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

113.name: Hitmontop
113.attacksText: {F} → Rapid Spin : 30 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Triple Kick : 40× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.
113.flavorText: If you are enchanted by its smooth, dance-like kicks, you may get a closer experience with one than you'd like.

114.name: Larvitar
114.evolves: Evolves into Pupitar or Dark Pupitar
114.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Submerge As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's) . {C} → Bite : 10
114.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

115.name: Larvitar
115.evolves: Evolves into Pupitar or Dark Pupitar
115.attacksText: {C}{C} → Second Strike : 10+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has 3 or more damage counters on it, this attack does 70 more damage.
115.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

116.name: Pupitar
116.evolves: Evolves from Larvitar and into Tyranitar , Tyranitar ex , or Tyranitar- GX
116.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Hard Shell Evolution When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by your opponent's attacks until the end of your opponent's next turn. {C}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 30
116.flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

117.name: Carbink
117.attacksText: {F} → Diamond Gate Search your deck for a Supporter card and a Stadium card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {F}{F}{C} → Guard Press : 60 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
117.flavorText: Although this Pokémon is not especially rare, its glittering, jewel-draped body draws attention from people.

118.name: Alolan Meowth
118.evolves: Evolves into Alolan Persian- GX or Alolan Persian
118.attacksText: {@} → Spoil the Fun : 10+ If you go second, this attack does 60 more damage during your first turn.
118.flavorText: When its delicate pride is wounded, or when the gold coin on its forehead is dirtied, it flies into a hysterical rage.

119.name: Alolan Persian
119.attacksText: {@} → Empty Threat : 90- This attack does 30 less damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
119.flavorText: It looks down on everyone other than itself. Its preferred tactics are sucker punches and blindside attacks.

120.name: Umbreon
120.attacksText: {D} → Retaliate : 30+ If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during their last turn, this attack does 90 more damage. {D}{C} → Dark Cutter : 60
120.flavorText: With its black fur, it blends into the darkness. It bides its time, and when prey appears, this Pokémon goes for its threat, and then eats it.

121.name: Tyranitar-GX
121.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Lost Out If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this Pokémon's attacks, put that Pokémon and all cards attached to it in the Lost Zone instead of the discard pile. {D}{D}{C} → Dusty Ruckus : 130 This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Basic Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {D}{D}{C} → Lay the Smackdown- GX : 220 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

122.name: Alolan Diglett
122.attacksText: {@} → Call for Family Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
122.flavorText: Its golden hairs function as sensors. It pokes them out of its burrow to monitor its surroundings.

123.name: Alolan Dugtrio
123.attacksText: {@} → Digging Dash : 60 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
123.flavorText: These Pokémon are cherished in the Alola region, where they are thought to be feminine deities of the land incarnate.

124.name: Forretress
124.attacksText: {M} → Thorny Eruption Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {M}{M}{C} → Lost Blast : 190 Put this Pokémon and all cards attached to it in the Lost Zone.
124.flavorText: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters piece of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

125.name: Steelix
125.attacksText: {M}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 90 {M}{C}{C}{C} → Iron Tackle : 170 This Pokémon does 50 damage to itself.
125.flavorText: It chews its way through boulders with its sturdy jaws. Its eyes can see in the darkness underground.

126.name: Scizor
126.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Exoskeleton This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M}{C} → Special Blow : 60+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any Special Energy attached to it, this attack does 70 more damage.
126.flavorText: Once it has identified an enemy, this Pokémon smashes it mercilessly with pinces hard as steel.

127.name: Dialga
127.attacksText: {M}{C}{C} → Turn Back Time : 60 If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an evolved Pokémon, devolve it by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand. {M}{M}{C}{C} → Power Blast : 130 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
127.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

128.name: Durant
128.attacksText: {C} → Knock Over : 20 You may discard any Stadium card in play. {C}{C} → Mountain Munch Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.
128.flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

129.name: Cobalion
129.attacksText: {M}{C} → Guard Press : 30 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M}{M}{C} → Metal Arms : 80+ If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 40 more damage.
129.flavorText: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

130.name: Genesect-GX
130.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Double Drive This Pokémon may have up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards attached to it. If it loses this Ability, discard Pokémon Tool cards from it until only 1 remains. {M}{M}{C} → Burst Shot : 130 {M}{M}{C} → Break Buster- GX : 190 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

131.name: Magearna
131.attacksText: {C} → Minor Errand-Running Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {M}{C} → Energy Press : 30+ This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
131.flavorText: Its mechanized body is merely a vessel. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.

132.name: Alolan Ninetales-GX
132.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Mysterious Guidance When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Item cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {Y}{C} → Snowy Wind : 70 This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {Y}{C} → Sublimation- GX If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Ultra Beast, it is Knocked Out. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

133.name: Jigglypuff
133.evolves: Evolves into Wigglytuff , Wigglytuff ex , […] Wigglytuff- GX , Dark Wigglytuff
133.attacksText: {Y} → Pound : 10 {C}{C} → Sing Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
133.flavorText: Jigglypuff posses a vocal range that exceeds 12 octaves, but each individual's singing skill depends on its own effort.

134.name: Wigglytuff
134.attacksText: {C}{C} → Expand : 30 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {Y}{C}{C} → Charmed Slap : 70+ If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card that has “Fairy Charm” in its name attached to it, this attack does 70 more damage.
134.flavorText: As it inhales, it expands…and expands…and expands. Wigglytuff compete to see which one can inflate itself the most.

135.name: Marill
135.evolves: Evolves into Azumarill , Azumarill ex , or Light Azumarill
135.attacksText: {Y}{C} → Magical Shot : 30
135.flavorText: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

136.name: Azumarill
136.attacksText: {Y} → Polka-Dot Search Look at the top 8 cards of your deck and attach any number of Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. {Y}{C}{C} → Play Rough : 60+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
136.flavorText: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

137.name: Snubbull
137.attacksText: {Y} → Make a Mess : 20× Discard up to 2 Trainer cards from your hand. This attack does 20 damage for each card you discarded in this way.
137.flavorText: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

138.name: Granbull
138.attacksText: {Y} → All Out : 30+ If you have no cards in your hand, this attack does 130 more damage. {Y}{Y}{Y} → Giant Fangs : 110
138.flavorText: More timid than Snubbull, this Pokémon is doted on by young people amused at the contrast between its looks and its attitude.

139.name: Ralts
139.attacksText: {Y} → Beckon Put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand. {C}{C} → Beat : 20
139.flavorText: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

140.name: Kirlia
140.evolves: Evolves from Ralts and into Gardevoir , Gallade , […] Gardevoir ex , Mega Gardevoir ex
140.attacksText: {C}{C} → Beat : 20 {Y}{C}{C} → Disarming Voice : 50 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
140.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enabled it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

141.name: Gardevoir
141.evolves: Evolves from Kirlia and into Gardevoir LV. X
141.attacksText: {Y} → Brilliant Search Search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {Y}{C}{C} → Sensitive Ray : 70+ If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.
141.flavorText: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

142.name: Dedenne
142.attacksText: {Y} → Zzzap Touch : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
142.flavorText: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

143.name: Carbink
143.attacksText: {C}{C} → Wonder Ray : 30 During your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by any Pokémon that has an Ability. {Y}{C}{C} → Power Gem : 60
143.flavorText: Although this Pokémon is not especially rare, its glittering, jewel-draped body draws attention from people.

144.name: Xerneas Prism Star
144.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Path of Life Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to become your Active Pokémon, you may move any number of Energy from your other Pokémon to it. {Y}{Y}{Y} → Bright Horns : 160 This Pokémon can't use Bright Horns during your next turn. · {*} (Prism Star) rule : You can't have more than 1 {*} card with the same name in your deck. If a {*} card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.
144.flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

145.name: Cutiefly
145.attacksText: {C} → Sweet Scent Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
145.flavorText: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers.

146.name: Ribombee
146.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Mysterious Buzz As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to your {Y} Pokémon in play. {Y} → Stampede : 20
146.flavorText: Some of Ribombee's pollen puffs are highly nutritious. They are sometimes sold as supplements.

147.name: Morelull
147.attacksText: {Y} → Perplex Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
147.flavorText: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

148.name: Shiinotic
148.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Effect Spore If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , the Attacking Pokémon is now Asleep. {Y}{Y} → Dream's Touch : 50 If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Asleep, your opponent shuffles all Energy from it into their deck.
148.flavorText: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

149.name: Mimikyu-GX
149.attacksText: {Y} → Perplex Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {Y}{C} → Let's Snuggle & Fall : 10+ This attack does 30 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon. {Y} → Dream Fear- GX Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Your opponent shuffles that Pokémon and all cards attached to it into their deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

150.name: Tapu Lele
150.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Charmed Charm Whenever you attach a Pokémon Tool card that has “Fairy Charm” in its name from your hand to this Pokémon during your turn, you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Confused. {Y}{C}{C} → Magical Shot : 70
150.flavorText: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

151.name: Tapu Fini
151.attacksText: {Y}{C} → Dream Away Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent shuffles their Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into their deck. {Y}{Y}{C} → Wonder Shine : 100 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
151.flavorText: The guardian deity of Poni, it can control water. People say it can create pure water that will wash away any uncleanness.

152.name: Chansey
152.evolves: Evolves into Blissey or Blissey ex
152.attacksText: {C} → Healing Pirouette Heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Sympathetic Slap : 100 If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it before this attack does damage, this attack does nothing.
152.flavorText: Not only are these Pokémon fast runners, they're also few in number, so anyone who finds one must be lucky indeed.

153.name: Blissey
153.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Happiness Supplement Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may remove a Special Condition from your Active Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Powerful Slap : 80× Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.
153.flavorText: Its fluffy fur coat acts as a sensor, enabling it to read the feelings of people and Pokémon.

154.name: Ditto Prism Star
154.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Almighty Evolution Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put any Stage 1 card from your hand onto this Pokémon to evolve it. You can't use this Ability during your first turn or the turn this Pokémon was put into play. · {*} (Prism Star) rule : You can't have more than 1 {*} card with the same name in your deck. If a {*} card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.
154.flavorText: With its astonishing capacity for metamorphosis, it can get along with anything. It does not get along well with its fellow Ditto.

155.name: Eevee
155.evolves: Evolves into Jolteon , Flareon , […] Vaporeon , Umbreon , Espeon , Leafeon , Glaceon , Sylveon , Glaceon- GX , Sylveon- GX , Umbreon- GX , Espeon- GX , Leafeon- GX , Umbreon ex , Espeon ex , Sylveon ex , Jolteon ex , Vaporeon ex , Flareon ex , Glaceon ex , Dark Vaporeon , Leafeon ex , Flareon- GX , Light Jolteon , Light Vaporeon , Dark Espeon , Dark Flareon , Dark Jolteon , Jolteon- GX , Light Flareon
155.attacksText: {C} → Gnaw : 20
155.flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

156.name: Stantler
156.attacksText: {C} → Mystifying Horns Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {C}{C} → Enhanced Horns : 20+ If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 60 more damage.
156.flavorText: The curved antlers change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

157.name: Smeargle
157.attacksText: {C} → Stunning Likeness Your opponent reveals their hand. You may use the effect of a Supporter card you find there as the effect of this attack. {C} → Tail Smash : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
157.flavorText: It draws symbols all over the place to mark its territory. In towns with many Smeargle, the walls are covered in graffiti.

158.name: Miltank
158.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Milk Cannon : 60× Reveal any number of Moomoo Milk cards in your hand. This attack does 60 damage for each card you revealed in this way.
158.flavorText: Most people raise it for its milk, but it's quite tough and strong, so it's also well suited for battle.

159.name: Lugia-GX
159.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Psychic : 30+ This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Pelagic Blade : 170 This Pokémon can't use Pelagic Blade during your next turn. {C}{C}{C} → Lost Purge- GX Put your opponent's Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it in the Lost Zone. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

160.name: Ho-Oh
160.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Rainbow Burn : 30+ This attack does 30 more damage for each type of basic Energy attached to this Pokémon.
160.flavorText: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

161.name: Kecleon
161.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Unit Color 1 As long as this Pokémon has Unit Energy {G}{R}{W} attached to it, it is a {G}, {R}, and {W} Pokémon. {C} → Tongue Smack : 10+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.
161.flavorText: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

162.name: Kecleon
162.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Unit Color 3 As long as this Pokémon has Unit Energy {F}{D}{Y} attached to it, it is a {F}, {D}, and {Y} Pokémon. {C}{C} → Gentle Slap : 60
162.flavorText: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

163.name: Pikipek
163.attacksText: {C} → Peck Off : 10 Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tool cards from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
163.flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for attacks it fires off from its mouth.

164.name: Pikipek
164.attacksText: {C} → Send Back Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. {C}{C} → Peck : 20
164.flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for attacks it fires off from its mouth.

165.name: Trumbeak
165.evolves: Evolves from Pikipek and into Toucannon
165.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Mountain Pass Once during your turn (before your attack) , if this Pokémon is in your hand, you may reveal it. If you do, look at the top card of your opponent's deck and put this Pokémon in the Lost Zone. If that card is a Supporter card, you may put it in the Lost Zone. If your opponent has no cards in their deck, you can't use this Ability. {C}{C} → Peck : 30

030.flavorText: This Oricorio has sipped red nectar. Its passionate dance moves cause its enemies to combust in both body and mind.

(You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

025.name: Clauncher
025.attacksText: {W} → Water Gun : 10
025.flavorText: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can shatter rock.

026.name: Clawitzer
026.evolves: Evolves from Clauncher and into Clawitzer BREAK
026.attacksText: {W} → Standing By During your next turn, this Pokémon's Sharpshooting attack does 120 damage instead of 40. {W} → Sharpshooting This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
026.flavorText: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

027.name: Amaura
027.evolves: Evolves from Unidentified Fossil and into Aurorus
027.attacksText: {W}{C} → Powder Snow : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {W}{W}{C} → Aurora Beam : 60
027.flavorText: This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land where there were no violent predators like Tyrantrum.

028.name: Aurorus
028.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Frost Wall : 50 During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Evolution Pokémon. {W}{W}{C}{C} → Blizzard Burn : 150 This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.
028.flavorText: Using its diamond-shaped crystals, it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent's attack.

029.name: Bergmite
029.evolves: Evolves into Avalugg or Hisuian Avalugg
029.attacksText: {W} → Break Open : 10 If your opponent has a Stadium card in play, discard it. If you do, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
029.flavorText: Using air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit, they freeze opponents solid. They live in herds above the snow line on mountains.

030.name: Avalugg
030.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Frozen Ground : 80 Your opponent can't play any Stadium cards from their hand during their next turn. {W}{C}{C}{C} → Skull Bash : 100
030.flavorText: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back makes it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.

031.name: Volcanion Prism Star
031.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Jet Geyser Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may discard a {W} Energy card from your hand. If you do, your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. {W}{W}{W} → Sauna Blast : 100 This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · {*} (Prism Star) rule : You can't have more than 1 {*} card with the same name in your deck. If a {*} card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.
031.flavorText: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

032.name: Dewpider
032.attacksText: {C} → Gnaw : 10 {W} → Spider Web The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
032.flavorText: When it comes across enemies or potential prey, this Pokémon smashes its water-bubble-covered head into them.

033.name: Araquanid
033.attacksText: {W} → Bubble : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {C}{C} → Bubble Trap : 40+ If 1 of your Pokémon used Bubble during your last turn, this attack does 80 more damage.
033.flavorText: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable, weak Pokémon, it protectively brings them into its water bubble.

034.name: Magnemite
034.evolves: Evolves into Magneton or Dark Magneton
034.attacksText: {C} → Searching Magnet Search your deck for up to 3 {L} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {L} → Tackle : 10
034.flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

035.name: Magneton
035.evolves: Evolves from Magnemite and into Magnezone or Magnezone ex
035.attacksText: {L} → Ram : 20 {L}{L}{C} → Zap Cannon : 80 This Pokémon can't use Zap Cannon during your next turn.
035.flavorText: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

036.name: Magnezone
036.evolves: Evolves from Magneton and into Magnezone LV. X
036.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Magnetic Circuit As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may attach a {L} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon. {L}{L}{L}{C} → Zap Cannon : 130 This Pokémon can't use Zap Cannon during your next turn.
036.flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

037.name: Helioptile
037.attacksText: {C} → Gnaw : 10 {C}{C} → Tail Whap : 20
037.flavorText: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

038.name: Heliolisk
038.attacksText: {C} → Gnaw : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Volt Wave : 80 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
038.flavorText: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

039.name: Xurkitree
039.attacksText: {L} → Dazzle Blast : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {L}{L}{C} → Cablegram : 100 If you have exactly 3 Prize cards remaining, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
039.flavorText: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.

040.name: Rotom
040.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Roto Motor If you have 9 or more Pokémon Tool cards in your discard pile, ignore all Energy in the attack cost of each of this Pokémon's attacks. {P}{P}{P} → Plasma Slice : 120 This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.
040.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

041.name: Uxie
041.evolves: Evolves into Uxie LV. X
041.attacksText: {P} → Memory Skip : 30 Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.
041.flavorText: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

042.name: Mesprit
042.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Silent Waves If you have Azelf in play, your opponent's Pokémon in play have no Resistance. {C}{C} → Mind Splash : 20+ If Uxie is on your Bench, this attack does 50 more damage.
042.flavorText: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake's surface.

043.name: Azelf
043.attacksText: {C} → Psychic Abduction You can use this attack only if you go second, and only on your first turn. Shuffle 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to it into their deck. {C} → Hypnoblast : 10 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
043.flavorText: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf all came from the same egg.

044.name: Espurr
044.attacksText: {P} → Energy Teaser Move an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to another of their Pokémon.
044.flavorText: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.

045.name: Meowstic
045.attacksText: {P} → Teleportation Burst : 20 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {P}{C} → Psychic : 30+ This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
045.flavorText: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

046.name: Honedge
046.evolves: Evolves into Doublade
046.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Final Hour If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {P}{P}{P} → Slash : 50
046.flavorText: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

047.name: Honedge
047.evolves: Evolves into Doublade
047.attacksText: {P} → Metal Sound Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
047.flavorText: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

048.name: Doublade
048.evolves: Evolves from Honedge and into Aegislash or Aegislash ex
048.attacksText: {P} → Curse of the Blade Put 3 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon that has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it.
048.flavorText: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

049.name: Aegislash
049.attacksText: {C} → Ticking Knock Out During your next turn, if the Defending Pokémon is damaged by an attack, it will be Knocked Out. {P}{P}{P} → Draining Blade : 90 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
049.flavorText: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

050.name: Inkay
050.attacksText: {P} → Hypnosis Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
050.flavorText: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

051.name: Malamar
051.evolves: Evolves from Inkay
051.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Psychic Recharge Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may attach a {P} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {P}{P}{C} → Psychic Sphere : 60
051.flavorText: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

052.name: Skrelp
052.attacksText: {P} → Hook : 10
052.flavorText: It looks just like rotten kelp. It hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution.

053.name: Dragalge
053.evolves: Evolves from Skrelp
053.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Poison Point If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned. {P}{C} → Twister : 60 Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing.
053.flavorText: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

054.name: Hoopa
054.attacksText: {P} → Hyperspace Ring Search your deck for up to 2 Item cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {P} → Psy Bolt : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
054.flavorText: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

055.name: Poipole
055.evolves: Evolves into Naganadel- GX or Naganadel
055.attacksText: {C} → Spit Poison Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. {P}{C} → Knockout Reviver During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is Knocked Out, your opponent can't take any Prize cards for it.
055.flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

056.name: Naganadel-GX
056.attacksText: {C} → Beast Raid : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each of your Ultra Beasts in play. {P}{C}{C} → Jet Needle : 110 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. {C}{C}{C} → Stinger- GX Both players shuffle their Prize cards into their decks. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

057.evolves: Evolves into Marowak , Alolan Marowak , Alolan Marowak- GX , or Dark Marowak
057.attacksText: {C}{C} → Burdensome Bone : 40 This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.
057.flavorText: The skull it wears on its head is that of its dead mother. According to some, it will evolve when it comes to terms with the pain of her death.

058.name: Torterra
058.evolves: Evolves from Grotle and into Torterra LV. X
058.attacksText: {F}{F}{C} → Giga Drain : 50 Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon. {F}{F}{F}{C} → Earthquake : 180 This attack does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

059.evolves: Evolves from Monferno and into Infernape LV. X

060.name: Gible
060.attacksText: {F} → Ascension Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
060.flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

061.name: Gabite
061.evolves: Evolves from Gible and into Garchomp or Garchomp ex
061.attacksText: {F} → Ascension Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Slash : 40
061.flavorText: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

062.name: Garchomp
062.evolves: Evolves from Gabite and into Garchomp LV. X
062.attacksText: {C}{C} → Quick Dive This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{C}{C} → Royal Blades : 100+ If you played Cynthia from your hand during this turn, this attack does 100 more damage.
062.flavorText: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

063.name: Croagunk
063.evolves: Evolves into Toxicroak or Toxicroak ex
063.attacksText: {F} → Swagger : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

064.name: Toxicroak
064.evolves: Evolves from Croagunk
064.attacksText: {F} → Poison Jab : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. {C}{C} → Exact Revenge : 50+ If any of your {P} Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during their last turn, this attack does 70 more damage.
064.flavorText: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

065.name: Pancham
065.attacksText: {F} → Act Tough : 10+ If this Pokémon has any {D} Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 more damage.
065.flavorText: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

066.name: Binacle
066.attacksText: {F} → Allotment : 10 Draw a card.
066.flavorText: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

067.name: Barbaracle
067.attacksText: {F}{C} → Seven Shock : 30 If you have exactly 7 cards in your hand, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {F}{C}{C} → Claw Slash : 90
067.flavorText: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

068.name: Tyrunt
068.evolves: Evolves from Unidentified Fossil and into Tyrantrum
068.attacksText: {F} → Crunch : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {F}{C} → Hammer In : 40
068.flavorText: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up an automobile. It lived 100 million years ago.

069.name: Tyrantrum
069.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Tyrannical Heart As long as you don't have more Pokémon in play than your opponent, this Pokémon's attacks do 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) , and it takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{F}{C} → Crunch : 100 Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
069.flavorText: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.

070.name: Hawlucha
070.attacksText: {F} → High Jump Kick : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Sky Drop : 80- This attack does 20 less damage for each {C} in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.
070.flavorText: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

071.name: Zygarde
071.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Earthen Aura Damage from this Pokémon's attacks isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. {F} → Peace Maker : 30+ If your opponent has an Ultra Beast in play, this attack does 30 more damage.
071.flavorText: This is Zygarde's form when about 10% of its cells have been gathered. It runs across the land at speeds greater than 60 mph.

072.name: Zygarde
072.attacksText: {C}{C} → Glare : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {F}{C}{C} → Calm Strike : 60+ If you have used your GX attack, this attack does 60 more damage.
072.flavorText: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.

073.name: Zygarde-GX
073.attacksText: {C}{C} → Cell Connector : 50 Attach 2 {F} Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {F}{F}{C}{C} → Land's Wrath : 130 {F}{F}{C}{C} → Verdict- GX : 150 Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Pokémon- GX and Pokémon- EX during your opponent's next turn. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
