If a {*} card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.
074.flavorText: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

075.name: Rockruff
075.evolves: Evolves into Lycanroc , Lycanroc- GX , or Lycanroc ex
075.attacksText: {F}{C} → Surprise Attack : 50 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
075.flavorText: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

076.name: Lycanroc
076.attacksText: {F}{C} → Dangerous Rogue : 20+ This attack does 20 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. {F}{F}{C} → Accelerock : 100
076.flavorText: Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.

077.name: Buzzwole
077.attacksText: {F} → Sledgehammer : 30+ If your opponent has exactly 4 Prize cards remaining, this attack does 90 more damage. {F}{F}{C} → Swing Around : 80+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.
077.flavorText: A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast. Witnesses saw it pulverize a dump truck with a single punch.

078.name: Pangoro
078.attacksText: {D}{C} → Untamed Punch : 50+ If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 50 more damage, and both Active Pokémon are now Confused. {D}{D}{C} → Double Stomp : 80+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.
078.flavorText: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent's movements. It's eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.

079.name: Yveltal-GX
079.attacksText: {D} → Absorb Vitality : 20 Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Sonic Evil : 100 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. {D} → Doom Count- GX If your opponent's Active Pokémon has exactly 4 damage counters on it, that Pokémon is Knocked Out. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

080.name: Guzzlord
080.attacksText: {D}{D}{D}{D} → Lord's Valley : 160 If you have exactly 2, 4, or 6 Prize cards remaining, discard the top 10 cards of your deck.
080.flavorText: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.

081.name: Empoleon
081.evolves: Evolves from Prinplup and into Empoleon LV. X or Empoleon BREAK
081.attacksText: {M}{C} → Total Command : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) . {M}{M}{C} → Whirlpool : 90 Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
081.flavorText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

082.name: Dialga-GX
082.attacksText: {M} → Overclock Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. {M}{C}{C} → Shred : 80 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. {M}{M}{M}{C}{C} → Timeless- GX : 150 Take another turn after this one. (Skip the between-turns step.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

083.name: Flabébé
083.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Evolutionary Advantage If you go second, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn. {Y} → Tackle : 10
083.flavorText: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

084.name: Flabébé
084.attacksText: {Y} → Secret Blessings Shuffle 3 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
084.flavorText: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

085.name: Floette
085.evolves: Evolves from Flabébé and into Florges
085.attacksText: {Y} → Swirling Petals Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. If you do, switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
085.flavorText: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.

086.name: Florges
086.evolves: Evolves from Floette and into Florges BREAK
086.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Wondrous Gift Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may flip a coin. If heads, put an Item card from your discard pile on top of your deck. {Y}{Y}{C} → Mist Guard : 70 Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from {N} Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.
086.flavorText: In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.

087.name: Sylveon
087.attacksText: {C} → Wink Wink Your opponent reveals their hand. You may discard a Supporter card you find there and use the effect of that card as the effect of this attack. {Y}{C} → Magical Shot : 40
087.flavorText: When this Pokémon sights its prey, it swirls its ribbonlike feelers as a distraction. A moment later, it pounces.

088.name: Dedenne
088.attacksText: {Y} → Find a Friend Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Electrichain : 30+ If you have any {L} Pokémon on your Bench, this attack does 30 more damage.
088.flavorText: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

089.name: Klefki
089.attacksText: {C} → Metal Sound Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {C} → Fairy Lock : 20 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
089.flavorText: It inserts its horn into chinks in metal, absorbing metal ions. For some reason, it collects keys.

090.name: Xerneas-GX
090.attacksText: {C} → Overrun : 20 This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {Y}{Y}{C} → Aurora Horns : 120 {Y}{Y}{C} → Sanctuary- GX Move all damage counters from each of your Pokémon to your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

091.name: Goomy
091.evolves: Evolves into Sliggoo or Hisuian Sliggoo
091.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sticky Membrane As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Pokémon's attacks cost {C} more. {Y} → Ram : 10
091.flavorText: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it needs some thorough hand-washing.

092.name: Goomy
092.evolves: Evolves into Sliggoo or Hisuian Sliggoo
092.attacksText: {W} → Rain Splash : 10 {C}{C} → Flail : 10× This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
092.flavorText: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it needs some thorough hand-washing.

093.name: Sliggoo
093.evolves: Evolves from Goomy and into Goodra
093.attacksText: {W}{C} → Absorb : 30 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. {W}{Y}{C} → Hammer In : 50
093.flavorText: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved, it slurps them up.

094.name: Goodra
094.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Hydration Whenever you attach a {W} Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, heal 20 damage from it. {W}{Y}{C} → Soaking Horn : 80+ If this Pokémon was healed during this turn, this attack does 80 more damage.
094.flavorText: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

095.name: Ultra Necrozma-GX
095.attacksText: {P}{M} → Photon Geyser : 20+ Discard all basic {P} Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 80 more damage for each card you discarded in this way. {P}{M} → Sky-Scorching Light- GX You can use this attack only if the total of both players' remaining Prize cards is 6 or less. Put 6 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

096.name: Arceus Prism Star

Then, shuffle your deck. · {*} (Prism Star) rule : You can't have more than 1 {*} card with the same name in your deck. If a {*} card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

111.attacksText: Search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon- GX , reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

112.name: Gyarados-GX
112.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Waterfall : 70 {W}{C}{C}{C}{C} → Draconic Disaster : 100+ If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 100 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium card. {W} → Dread Storm- GX Discard an Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

113.name: Alolan Golem-GX
113.attacksText: {L}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 80 {L}{L}{C}{C} → Super Electromagnetic Tackle : 200 This Pokémon does 50 damage to itself. {L}{L}{C}{C} → Heavy Rock- GX : 100 Your opponent can't play any cards from their hand during their next turn. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

114.name: Nihilego-GX
114.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Empty Light When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may leave both Active Pokémon Confused and Poisoned. {P}{P}{P} → Lock Up : 120 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. {P}{P}{P} → Symbiont- GX Add the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck to their Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

115.name: Buzzwole-GX
115.attacksText: {F} → Jet Punch : 30 This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{F}{F} → Knuckle Impact : 160 This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn. {F}{F}{F} → Absorption- GX : 40× This attack does 40 damage for each of your remaining Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

116.name: Guzzlord-GX

If any of those cards are Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon. {D}{D}{D}{C}{C} → Tyrannical Hole : 180 {D}{D}{D}{D}{D} → Glutton- GX : 100 If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 2 more Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

117.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Slice Off When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Special Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {M}{C}{C} → Gale Blade : 70 You may shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck. {M} → Blade- GX Take a Prize card. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

118.attacksText: {G} → Tropical Head This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to this Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {G}{C}{C}{C} → Dragon Hammer : 120 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {G}{C}{C}{C} → Tower-Go-Round- GX : 180 Move any number of Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

119.name: Silvally-GX
119.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Gyro Unit Your Basic Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost. {C}{C}{C} → Turbo Drive : 120 Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Rebel- GX : 50× This attack does 50 damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

120.name: Counter Catcher
120.attacksText: You can play this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent. Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

121.name: Wishful Baton
121.attacksText: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is your Active Pokémon and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, move up to 3 basic Energy cards from that Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

122.name: Counter Energy
122.attacksText: This card provides {C} Energy. If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, and if this card is attached to a Pokémon that isn't a Pokémon- GX or Pokémon- EX , this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 2 Energy at a time.

123.name: Warp Energy
123.attacksText: This card provides {C} Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to your Active Pokémon, switch that Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

001.name: Weedle
001.attacksText: {G} → Poison Sting Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
001.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

002.name: Kakuna
002.evolves: Evolves from Weedle and into Beedrill
002.attacksText: {G} → Multiply Search your deck for up to 3 Kakuna and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
002.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

003.name: Beedrill
003.attacksText: {G} → Sudden Sting : 10 If this Pokémon evolved from Kakuna during this turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned. {G} → Sharp Sting : 60
003.flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

004.name: Exeggcute
004.evolves: Evolves into Exeggutor , Alolan Exeggutor , […] Alolan Exeggutor ex , Alolan Exeggutor- GX
004.attacksText: {C} → Hypnosis Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {G} → Ram : 10
004.flavorText: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.

005.name: Cacnea
005.evolves: Evolves into Cacturne or Cacturne ex
005.attacksText: {G} → Sucker Punch : 10+ If this Pokémon has any {D} Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 more damage.
005.flavorText: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

006.name: Cacturne
006.attacksText: {G} → Spike Rend : 30+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage. {G}{C} → Hunt Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to the new Active Pokémon.
006.flavorText: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

007.name: Karrablast
007.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Shell On Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may discard a Shelmet from your hand. If you do, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C}{C} → Peck : 30
007.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

008.name: Shelmet
008.attacksText: {G} → Absorb : 10 Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
008.flavorText: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

009.name: Accelgor
009.attacksText: {C} → Recover Discard an Energy from this Pokémon and heal all damage from it. {G}{C} → Speed Attack : 70
009.flavorText: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

010.name: Skiddo
010.attacksText: {C}{C} → Seed Bomb : 20
010.flavorText: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

011.name: Gogoat
011.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sap Sipper This Pokémon's attacks do 80 more damage to your opponent's {G} Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {G}{C}{C} → Horn Leech : 80 Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.
011.flavorText: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being.

012.name: Alolan Marowak
012.attacksText: {@} → Dance of Flames For each Energy attached to your opponent's Pokémon, attach a {R} Energy card from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like. {R}{R}{C} → Burning Bonemerang : 70× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads. If either of them is heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
012.flavorText: The bones it possesses were once its mother's. Its mother's regrets have become like a vengeful spirit protecting this Pokémon.

013.name: Numel
013.evolves: Evolves into Camerupt , Mega Camerupt ex , or Camerupt ex
013.attacksText: {R}{C} → Continuous Headbutt : 30× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.
013.flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

014.name: Camerupt
014.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Continuous Headbutt : 80× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 80 damage for each heads. {R}{R}{C}{C} → Searing Flame : 120 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
014.flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

015.name: Staryu
015.evolves: Evolves into Starmie , Mega Starmie ex , or Starmie- GX
015.attacksText: {C} → Spinning Attack : 10
015.flavorText: Large numbers of these Pokémon make their home at the seaside. At night, a strange red glow radiates from the center of their bodies.

016.name: Starmie
016.evolves: Evolves from Staryu and into Starmie BREAK
016.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Escape Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck. {C} → Spinning Attack : 40
016.flavorText: Its shining core is thought to receive and transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.

017.name: Magikarp
017.evolves: Evolves into Gyarados , Gyarados- GX , Dark Gyarados , or Gyarados ex
017.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Submerge As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's) . {W}{C}{C} → Waterfall Evolution Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
017.flavorText: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

018.name: Gyarados-GX
018.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Waterfall : 70 {W}{C}{C}{C}{C} → Draconic Disaster : 100+ If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 100 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium card. {W} → Dread Storm- GX Discard an Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

019.name: Swinub
019.evolves: Evolves into Piloswine or Light Piloswine
019.attacksText: {C}{C} → Gnaw : 30
019.flavorText: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

020.name: Piloswine
020.evolves: Evolves from Swinub and into Mamoswine or Mamoswine ex
020.attacksText: {W} → Stampede : 20 {C}{C}{C}{C} → Rest This Pokémon is now Asleep. Heal 90 damage from it.
020.flavorText: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.

021.name: Mamoswine
021.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Double Stomp : 60+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads. {W}{W}{C}{C} → Forceful Tackle : 90+ You may put up to 9 damage counters on this Pokémon. This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter you placed in this way.
021.flavorText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

022.name: Remoraid
022.evolves: Evolves into Octillery or Dark Octillery
022.attacksText: {W}{C} → Water Gun : 30
022.flavorText: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

023.name: Octillery
023.attacksText: {C} → Ink Spit If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. {W}{C} → Special Artillery : 40+ You may discard a Special Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 80 more damage.
023.flavorText: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.

024.name: Corphish
024.evolves: Evolves into Crawdaunt or Crawdaunt ex
024.attacksText: {W}{W} → Crabhammer : 30
024.flavorText: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

025.name: Crawdaunt
025.attacksText: {W}{W}{W}{C} → Double Claws : 80 Discard 2 Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
025.flavorText: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

026.name: Feebas
026.evolves: Evolves into Milotic or Milotic ex
026.attacksText: {W} → Splashing Dodge : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.
026.flavorText: A tough Pokémon that is perfectly fine even in dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby appearance, it isn't popular.

027.name: Milotic
027.attacksText: {W} → TLC Shuffle 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it and all cards attached to it into their deck. {W}{W}{C}{C} → Ocean Cyclone : 80 This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
027.flavorText: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

028.name: Regice
028.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Iceberg Shield If you have Regirock in play, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Stage 2 Pokémon. {W}{C}{C} → Frost Smash : 70
028.flavorText: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can't be melted, even by magma.

029.name: Shellos
029.attacksText: {C} → Regeneration Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. {C} → Mud-Slap : 10
029.flavorText: For the most part, it makes its home along the seashore. Its color and form differ according to its habitat and the quality of its food.

030.name: Pikachu
030.evolves: Evolves into Raichu , Alolan Raichu , […] Raichu- GX , Dark Raichu
030.attacksText: {C} → Pika Draw Draw a card. {C}{C} → Quick Attack : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
030.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

031.name: Alolan Raichu
031.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Surge Surfer If there is any Stadium card in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost. {C}{C}{C} → Psychic : 70+ This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
031.flavorText: It only evolves to this form in the Alola region. According to researchers, its diet is one of the causes of this change.

032.name: Alolan Geodude
032.attacksText: {@} → Defense Curl Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C} → Tackle : 20
032.flavorText: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

033.name: Alolan Graveler
033.evolves: Evolves from Alolan Geodude and into Alolan Golem or Alolan Golem- GX
033.attacksText: {C}{C} → Corkscrew Punch : 30 {L}{L}{C} → Self-Destruct : 100 This Pokémon does 100 damage to itself.
033.flavorText: Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon, rising to the surface of part of its body.

034.name: Alolan Golem-GX
034.attacksText: {L}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 80 {L}{L}{C}{C} → Super Electromagnetic Tackle : 200 This Pokémon does 50 damage to itself. {L}{L}{C}{C} → Heavy Rock- GX : 100 Your opponent can't play any cards from their hand during their next turn. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

035.name: Emolga
035.attacksText: {C} → Energy Catch Put 3 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand. {L} → Volt Switch : 30 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched {L} Pokémon.
035.flavorText: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.

036.name: Gastly
036.evolves: Evolves into Haunter or Dark Haunter
036.attacksText: {P} → Ominous Eyes Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
036.flavorText: Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.

037.name: Haunter
037.evolves: Evolves from Gastly and into Gengar , Mega Gengar ex , or Gengar ex
037.attacksText: {P} → Pain Amplifier Put 2 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.
037.flavorText: It strikes at humans from total darkness. Those licked by its cold tongue grow weaker with each passing day until they die.

038.name: Gengar
038.evolves: Evolves from Haunter and into Gengar LV. X
038.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Gnawing Curse Whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. {P}{C}{C} → Fade to Black : 70 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
038.flavorText: Should you feel yourself attacked by a sudden chill, it is evidence of an approaching Gengar. There is no escaping it. Give up.

039.name: Misdreavus
039.evolves: Evolves into Mismagius or Mismagius ex
039.attacksText: {P} → Confuse Ray Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
039.flavorText: It will use any means necessary to frighten people and absorb their life energy. It practices constantly to hone its skill in causing fear.

040.name: Mismagius
040.attacksText: {P} → Chaos Wheel : 30 Your opponent can't play any Pokémon Tool, Special Energy, or Stadium cards from their hand during their next turn. {P}{C}{C} → Dark Arts : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each card in your opponent's hand.
040.flavorText: It appears as if from nowhere—muttering incantations, placing curses, and giving people terrifying visions.

041.name: Spoink
041.evolves: Evolves into Grumpig
041.attacksText: {C} → Splash : 10
041.flavorText: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

042.name: Grumpig
042.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Own Tempo This Pokémon can't be Confused. {P}{C}{C} → Psych Up : 60 During your next turn, this Pokémon's Psych Up attack does 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .
042.flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

043.name: Chimecho
043.attacksText: {P} → Bell of Silence : 10 Your opponent can't play any Pokémon that has an Ability from their hand during their next turn.
043.flavorText: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.

044.name: Pumpkaboo
044.attacksText: {P} → Astonish Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.
044.flavorText: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

045.name: Gourgeist
045.attacksText: {P} → Confuse Ray Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {C}{C} → Pumpkin Bomb : 10+ Before doing damage, you may discard any number of Pokémon Tool cards from your Pokémon. This attack does 40 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.
045.flavorText: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

046.name: Salandit
046.evolves: Evolves into Salazzle , Salazzle- GX , or Salazzle ex
046.attacksText: {P} → Singe Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
046.flavorText: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

047.name: Salazzle
047.evolves: Evolves from Salandit
047.attacksText: {P} → Nasty Plot Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {P} → Severe Poison Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 4 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.
047.flavorText: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

048.name: Oranguru
048.attacksText: {P} → Fixer of the Forest Put 3 Pokémon Tool cards from your discard pile into your hand. {P}{C}{C} → Zen Headbutt : 70
048.flavorText: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it's best suited to veteran Trainers.

049.name: Nihilego-GX
049.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Empty Light When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may leave both Active Pokémon Confused and Poisoned. {P}{P}{P} → Lock Up : 120 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. {P}{P}{P} → Symbiont- GX Add the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck to their Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

050.name: Mankey
050.evolves: Evolves into Primeape or Dark Primeape
050.attacksText: {F} → Three-Step Strike : 10× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
050.flavorText: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

051.name: Primeape
051.evolves: Evolves from Mankey and into Annihilape or Annihilape ex
051.attacksText: {C}{C} → Low Kick : 30 {F}{F} → Lucha Fight : 90 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .
051.flavorText: It has been known to become so angry that it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in death, however.

052.name: Cubone
052.evolves: Evolves into Marowak , Alolan Marowak , Alolan Marowak- GX , or Dark Marowak
052.attacksText: {C} → Leer Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {C}{C} → Headbutt : 20
052.flavorText: When it thinks of its deceased mother, it weeps loudly. Mandibuzz that hear its cries will attack it from the air.

053.name: Regirock
053.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Rock Peak Growl Your Registeel's attacks do 10 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{F}{C} → Tough Swing : 110 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
053.flavorText: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

054.name: Gastrodon
054.attacksText: {F}{C} → Eerie Fluid : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {F}{F}{C} → Earthquake : 120 This attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
054.flavorText: It has strong regenerative capabilities. Even if parts of it are bitten off by fish Pokémon, it will return to normal within a few hours.

055.name: Stufful
055.evolves: Evolves into Bewear or Bewear- GX
055.attacksText: {C}{C} → Flop : 30
055.flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

056.name: Bewear
056.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Fluffy This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from the attacks of your opponent's non-{R} Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{C}{C} → Cross-Cut : 60+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.
056.flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

057.name: Buzzwole-GX
057.attacksText: {F} → Jet Punch : 30 This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{F}{F} → Knuckle Impact : 160 This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn. {F}{F}{F} → Absorption- GX : 40× This attack does 40 damage for each of your remaining Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

058.name: Houndour
058.evolves: Evolves into Houndoom , Dark Houndoom , or Houndoom ex
058.attacksText: {D} → Rear Kick : 10 {D}{C} → Darkness Fang : 20
058.flavorText: Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.

059.name: Houndoom
059.attacksText: {D}{C} → Fire Fang : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. {D}{C}{C} → Puncturing Fangs : 90 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
059.flavorText: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

060.name: Deino
060.attacksText: {D}{C} → Headbutt : 20 {D}{D}{C} → Surprise Attack : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
060.flavorText: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

061.name: Zweilous
061.evolves: Evolves from Deino and into Hydreigon or Hydreigon ex
061.attacksText: {D}{C} → Headbutt : 30 {D}{D}{C} → Double Hit : 60× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.
061.flavorText: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

062.name: Hydreigon
062.evolves: Evolves from Zweilous and into Hydreigon BREAK
062.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Weed Out Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may choose 3 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, discard your other Benched Pokémon. {D}{D}{C} → Dark Destruction : 120 You may discard an Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
062.flavorText: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

063.name: Guzzlord-GX
063.attacksText: {D} → Eat Sloppily Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon. {D}{D}{D}{C}{C} → Tyrannical Hole : 180 {D}{D}{D}{D}{D} → Glutton- GX : 100 If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 2 more Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

064.name: Mawile

036.name: Ekans
036.evolves: Evolves into Arbok , Dark Arbok , or Arbok ex
036.attacksText: {C} → Poison Sting : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
036.flavorText: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

037.name: Arbok
037.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Intimidating Pattern As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {P}{C}{C} → Venomous Fang : 70 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
037.flavorText: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

038.name: Jynx
038.attacksText: {P} → Whiny Voice Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck. {C}{C} → Feverish Kiss : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
038.flavorText: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

039.name: Mewtwo-GX
039.attacksText: {P} → Full Burst : 30× This attack does 30 damage times the amount of Energy attached to this Pokémon. {P}{C} → Super Absorption : 60 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. {P}{P}{P} → Psystrike- GX : 200 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

040.name: Shining Mew
040.attacksText: {P} → Legendary Guidance Search your deck for up to 2 Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. {P} → Beam : 10
040.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

041.name: Latios
041.attacksText: {C}{C} → Break Through : 30 This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {P}{C}{C} → Lagoon Flight : 70
041.flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

042.name: Shining Jirachi
042.attacksText: {P} → Stellar Reign : 10 If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an evolved Pokémon, devolve it by putting all of the Evolution cards on it into your opponent's hand.
042.flavorText: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

043.name: Golett
043.attacksText: {P}{C}{C} → Mega Punch : 60
043.flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

044.name: Golurk
044.attacksText: {P}{C}{C} → Triple Smash : 10+ Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 more damage for each heads. {P}{C}{C}{C} → Golurk Hammer : 120
044.flavorText: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

045.name: Marshadow
045.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Let Loose When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may have each player shuffle their hand into their deck and draw 4 cards. {P}{C} → Shadow Punch : 30 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
045.flavorText: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

046.name: Stunfisk
046.attacksText: {L}{C} → Thunder Shock : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {L}{C}{C} → Head Bolt : 70
046.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

047.name: Spiritomb
047.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Cursed Whirlpool As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Active Pokémon can't retreat. {D}{C} → Cursed Drop Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.
047.flavorText: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

048.name: Purrloin
048.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 10 {D}{C} → Tail Rap : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
048.flavorText: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

049.name: Liepard
049.attacksText: {D} → Torment : 30 Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn. {D}{C} → Slash : 60
049.flavorText: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

050.name: Scraggy
050.evolves: Evolves into Scrafty or Mega Scrafty ex
050.attacksText: {D} → Call for Family Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Headbutt : 20
050.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

051.name: Scrafty
051.evolves: Evolves from Scraggy
051.attacksText: {C}{C} → Dangerous Head : 20+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage. {D}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 90
051.flavorText: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

052.name: Zorua
052.evolves: Evolves into Zoroark or Zoroark- GX
052.attacksText: {D} → Stampede : 10 {C}{C} → Ram : 20
052.flavorText: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

053.name: Zoroark-GX

053.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Trade Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may discard a card from your hand. If you do, draw 2 cards. {C}{C} → Riotous Beating : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play. {D}{D} → Trickster- GX Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

054.attacksText: {C}{C} → Strafe : 30 You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {D}{C}{C} → Oblivion Wing : 90 Attach a {D} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
054.flavorText: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

055.name: Hoopa
055.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Scoundrel Guard Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon- GX or Pokémon- EX . {D}{C}{C} → Super Psy Bolt : 80
055.flavorText: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.

056.name: Shining Rayquaza
056.attacksText: {L} → Dragon Pulse : 40 Discard the top 2 cards of your deck. {R}{L}{L}{C} → Sky Judgment : 190 Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.
056.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

057.name: Shining Arceus
057.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Fabled Defense As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by your opponent's attacks. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Ultimate Arrow This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
057.flavorText: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.

100.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Land Crush : 80 {D}{Y}{C}{C} → Core Enforcer : 150 Discard a {D} Energy and a {Y} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
100.flavorText: This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.

101.name: Meowth
101.evolves: Evolves into Persian , Dark Persian , or Persian- GX
101.attacksText: {C} → Fake Out : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
101.flavorText: It lies around all day, becoming active near dusk. At night, it wanders the city in search of loose change.

102.name: Persian
102.attacksText: {C} → Screech During your next turn, the Defending Pokémon takes 60 more damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C} → Slash : 40
102.flavorText: It has a violent temperament. It will attack anything that looks it in the eye. Its sharp claws inflict deep wounds.

103.name: Porygon
103.evolves: Evolves into Porygon2 or Dark Porygon2
103.attacksText: {C} → Code Check Look at 1 of your opponent's face-down Prize cards. {C} → Beam : 10
103.flavorText: Roughly 20 years ago, it was artificially created, utilizing the latest technology of the time.

104.name: Porygon2
104.evolves: Evolves from Porygon and into Porygon-Z or Porygon-Z- GX
104.attacksText: {C} → Calculate Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and put them back in any order. {C}{C}{C} → Beam : 40

105.name: Porygon-Z
105.evolves: Evolves from Porygon2 and into Porygon-Z LV. X
105.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Initialize When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may devolve each of your opponent's evolved Pokémon by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand. {C}{C}{C} → Zap Cannon : 80 This Pokémon can't use Zap Cannon during your next turn.
105.flavorText: In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that makes it move oddly.

106.name: Hoothoot
106.attacksText: {C} → See Through Your opponent reveals their hand. {C}{C} → Peck : 20

107.name: Noctowl
107.evolves: Evolves from Hoothoot and into Noctowl BREAK
107.attacksText: {C} → Hypnoblast : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C}{C} → Night Raid : 70 Your opponent reveals their hand. Discard a Pokémon from it.
107.flavorText: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

108.name: Bouffalant
108.attacksText: {C}{C} → Bouffant Head : 30 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C}{C} → Knock Over : 80 You may discard any Stadium card in play.

109.evolves: Evolves into Noivern , Noivern ex , or Noivern- GX
109.attacksText: {C} → Agility : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

002.flavorText: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

(You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

019.name: Alolan Sandshrew
019.evolves: Evolves into Alolan Sandslash or Alolan Sandslash- GX
019.attacksText: {@} → Defense Curl Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn. {W}{C}{C} → Ice Ball : 30
019.flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel shell is very hard—so much so, it can't roll its body up into a ball.

020.name: Alolan Sandslash
020.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Slush Rush Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may draw a card. {W}{C}{C} → Smash Turn : 50 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
020.flavorText: Fleeing a volcanic eruption, it settled on a snowy mountain. As it races through the snowfields, it sends up a spray of snow.

021.name: Alolan Vulpix
021.evolves: Evolves into Alolan Ninetales- GX or Alolan Ninetales
021.attacksText: {@} → Beacon Search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Icy Snow : 20
021.flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

022.name: Alolan Ninetales-GX
022.attacksText: {C}{C} → Ice Blade This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{W}{C} → Blizzard Edge : 160 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. {C}{C} → Ice Path- GX Move all damage counters from this Pokémon to your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

023.name: Tentacool
023.attacksText: {C} → Sludge Shock : 10 The Defending Pokémon can't be healed during your opponent's next turn.
023.flavorText: They can be found lying dehydrated on beaches, but they are often still alive. When soaked in water, they will revive.

024.name: Tentacruel
024.attacksText: {C}{C} → Poison Sting : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. {C}{C}{C} → Seething Tentacles : 40+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
024.flavorText: Normally, it has 80 poisonous tentacles. The longer one has been alive, the fewer tentacles it will have.

025.name: Politoed
025.attacksText: {W} → Roll Call Search your deck for a Poliwag, a Poliwhirl, and a Poliwrath, and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {W}{C}{C} → Hyper Jump : 100 You may shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck.
025.flavorText: They gather on moonlit nights to form a large chorus. Their cries sound angry and not at all pleasant, but they are certainly distinctive.

026.name: Delibird
026.attacksText: {C} → All the Presents Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, you may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {W} → Surprise Attack : 40 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
026.flavorText: Although it naturally prefers colder locales, Delibird in Alola seem able to withstand the heat to a certain extent.

027.name: Carvanha
027.evolves: Evolves into Sharpedo , Mega Sharpedo ex , or Sharpedo ex
027.attacksText: {W} → Bite : 10
027.flavorText: Each school has its own territory. Any intruders are mercilessly attacked with fangs bared.

028.name: Sharpedo
028.attacksText: {W}{C} → Jet Headbutt : 70
028.flavorText: It pursues its prey at speeds of 75 mph and finishes them off with fangs that can crush iron. It is known as the bully of the sea.

029.name: Wailmer
029.evolves: Evolves into Wailord or Wailord ex
029.attacksText: {W}{C} → Splash : 20 {W}{W}{W}{C} → Surf : 70
029.flavorText: It loves to startle people. It fills itself up with seawater and plays by bouncing around like a ball.

030.name: Wailord
030.attacksText: {W}{W}{C} → Dive : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. {W}{W}{W}{C} → Open Sea : 80 Heal 30 damage from each of your {W} Pokémon.
030.flavorText: Wailord pursue their prey in pods. With their large mouths, they can swallow entire schools of Wishiwashi whole.

031.name: Snorunt
031.evolves: Evolves into Froslass , Glalie , Mega Froslass ex , or Froslass ex
031.attacksText: {W} → Chilly : 10 {W}{W} → Frost Breath : 20
031.flavorText: Their numbers seem to have rapidly increased in Alola. Custom has it that houses where Snorunt live will be prosperous for generations to come.

032.name: Glalie
032.attacksText: {W}{W} → Crunch : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {W}{W}{W} → Raging Floe : 70+ If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 80 more damage.
032.flavorText: Legend says a boulder on an icy mountain absorbed the distress and regrets of a stranded mountaineer, giving rise to Glalie.

033.name: Vanillite
033.attacksText: {W} → Triple Spin : 10× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
033.flavorText: Born of an icicle, this Pokémon uses its frosty breath to make ice crystals, causing snow to fall.

034.name: Vanillish
034.evolves: Evolves from Vanillite and into Vanilluxe
034.attacksText: {W} → Ice Shard : 30+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {F} Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.
034.flavorText: Hot days cause its body to melt. It can be restored by refreezing it, but the process leaves its body slightly warped.

035.name: Vanilluxe
035.attacksText: {W} → Hail This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{W}{W} → Frozen Breath : 80 You may discard 2 {W} Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
035.flavorText: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard.

036.name: Alomomola
036.attacksText: {C} → Borne Ashore Put a Basic Pokémon from either player's discard pile onto its owner's Bench. {W}{C}{C} → Hydro Splash : 60
036.flavorText: It uses its special mucus to close the wounds of injured Pokémon. The reason for this behavior remains unknown.

037.name: Wishiwashi
037.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Schooling Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may switch this Pokémon with a Wishiwashi- GX in your hand. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon. {W} → Sharpshooting This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
037.flavorText: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

038.name: Wishiwashi-GX
038.attacksText: {W} → Water Gun : 20 {W}{W}{W}{C}{C} → Torrential Vortex : 120 Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {W}{W}{W}{C}{C} → Blue Surge- GX : 220 Move all Energy from this Pokémon to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

039.name: Mareanie
039.evolves: Evolves into Toxapex or Toxapex- GX
039.attacksText: {C} → Bail Out Put a Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand. {W} → Rain Splash : 10
039.flavorText: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

040.name: Alolan Geodude
040.attacksText: {@} → Rock Polish During your next turn, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost. {L}{C}{C} → Rollout : 40
040.flavorText: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

041.name: Alolan Graveler
041.evolves: Evolves from Alolan Geodude and into Alolan Golem or Alolan Golem- GX
041.attacksText: {L}{C}{C} → Thunder Punch : 50+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself. {L}{L}{L}{C} → Electrobullet : 80 This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
041.flavorText: Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon, rising to the surface of part of its body.

042.name: Alolan Golem
042.attacksText: {L}{C}{C} → Electromagnetic Rock Wrecker : 80× Flip a coin for each {L} Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage for each heads. {L}{C}{C}{C} → Heavy Slam : 200- This attack does 30 less damage for each {C} in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.
042.flavorText: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn't fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

043.name: Helioptile
043.attacksText: {L} → Thunder Shock : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
043.flavorText: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

044.name: Heliolisk
044.attacksText: {C} → Quick Attack : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage. {L}{C}{C} → Raging Thunder : 120 This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
044.flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

045.name: Vikavolt-GX
045.attacksText: {L} → Charge Beam : 50 Attach an Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {L}{C}{C}{C} → Super Zap Cannon : 180 Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. {L}{C}{C}{C} → Gigatron- GX This attack does 60 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

046.name: Oricorio
046.attacksText: {L} → Feather Dance During your next turn, this Pokémon's Pom-Pom Punch attack's base damage is 100 (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {L} → Pom-Pom Punch : 20
046.flavorText: This Oricorio has sipped bright yellow nectar. Its bright, cheerful dance melts the hearts of its enemies.

047.name: Tapu Koko-GX
047.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Aero Trail When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may move any number of {L} Energy from your other Pokémon to this Pokémon. If you do, switch this Pokémon with your Active Pokémon. {L}{L}{C} → Sky-High Claws : 130 {L}{L}{C} → Tapu Thunder- GX : 50× This attack does 50 damage times the amount of Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

048.name: Slowpoke
048.evolves: Evolves into Slowking , Slowbro , […] Dark Slowbro , Dark Slowking , Slowking ex
048.attacksText: {C} → Headbutt : 10 {P}{C}{C} → Whimsy Tackle : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
048.flavorText: Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn't really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn't particularly bothered.

049.name: Slowbro
049.attacksText: {C} → Amnesia : 20 Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn. {P}{C}{C} → Facade : 50+ If this Pokémon is Burned or Poisoned, this attack does 80 more damage.
049.flavorText: It spaces out while gazing at the sea. With Shellder's poison flowing through its body, it becomes even spacier.

050.name: Trubbish
050.attacksText: {P} → Stomp Off Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. {P}{C}{C} → Drool : 30
050.flavorText: Unsanitary places are what they like best. They can be spotted in Alola, often with Grimer in hot pursuit.

051.name: Garbodor
051.evolves: Evolves from Trubbish
051.attacksText: {P} → Trashalanche : 20× This attack does 20 damage for each Item card in your opponent's discard pile. {P}{C}{C} → Acid Spray : 70 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
051.flavorText: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.

052.name: Gothita
052.attacksText: {P} → Blown Kiss Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
052.flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

053.name: Gothorita
053.evolves: Evolves from Gothita and into Gothitelle
053.attacksText: {P} → Slap : 20 {P}{C} → Psybeam : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
053.flavorText: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

054.name: Gothitelle
054.attacksText: {P} → Tractorbeam Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to the new Active Pokémon. {P}{C} → Link Blast : 50+ If this Pokémon and your opponent's Active Pokémon have the same amount of Energy attached to them, this attack does 80 more damage.
054.flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

055.name: Oricorio
055.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Vital Dance When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {P}{C} → Casual Slap : 30
055.flavorText: This Oricorio relaxes by swaying gently. This increases its psychic energy, which it then fires at its enemies.

056.name: Oricorio
056.attacksText: {C} → Supernatural Dance For each Pokémon in your opponent's discard pile, put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like. {C} → Revelation Dance : 30 If there is no Stadium card in play, this attack does nothing.
056.flavorText: This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Its elegant, attractive dance will send the minds and hearts of its enemies to another world.

057.name: Toxapex-GX
057.attacksText: {P} → Spike Cannon : 30× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads. {P}{P}{P} → Super Intense Poison Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 10 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns. {P}{P}{P} → Total Shelter- GX : 150 Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

058.name: Mimikyu
058.attacksText: {C} → Filch Draw 2 cards. {P}{C} → Copycat If your opponent's Pokémon used an attack that isn't a GX attack during their last turn, use it as this attack.
058.flavorText: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by horror and died of the shock.

059.name: Dhelmise
059.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Steelworker Your {M} Pokémon's attacks do 10 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {P}{C}{C} → Anchor Shot : 70 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
059.flavorText: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

060.name: Tapu Lele-GX
060.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Wonder Tag When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C} → Energy Drive : 20× This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to both Active Pokémon. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. {P} → Tapu Cure- GX Heal all damage from 2 of your Benched Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

061.name: Lunala
061.evolves: Evolves from Cosmoem
061.attacksText: {P} → Shatter Shot : 40× This attack does 40 damage times the amount of {P} Energy attached to this Pokémon. {P}{P}{P} → Wings of the Moone : 130 Move all Energy from this Pokémon to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.
061.flavorText: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

062.name: Machop
062.evolves: Evolves into Machoke , Dark Machoke , or Light Machoke
062.attacksText: {F}{F} → Dual Chop : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.
062.flavorText: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

063.name: Machop
063.evolves: Evolves into Machoke , Dark Machoke , or Light Machoke
063.attacksText: {F}{C} → Dynamic Chop : 50
063.flavorText: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

064.name: Machoke
064.evolves: Evolves from Machop and into Machamp or Machamp- GX
064.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Daunting Pose Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by your opponent's attacks. Your opponent's attacks and Abilities can't place damage counters on your Benched Pokémon. {F}{F} → Cross Chop : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
064.flavorText: As a result of its continual workouts, it has developed tremendous power. It uses that power to help people with their work.

065.name: Machamp
065.evolves: Evolves from Machoke and into Machamp BREAK or Machamp LV. X
065.attacksText: {F}{F} → Settle the Score : 20+ This attack does 80 more damage for each Prize card your opponent took on their last turn. {F}{F}{F} → Submission : 150 This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.
065.flavorText: It unleashes megaton-level punches that send opponents flying clear over the horizon.

066.name: Sudowoodo
066.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Roadblock Your opponent can't have more than 4 Benched Pokémon. If they have 5 or more Benched Pokémon, they discard Benched Pokémon until they have 4 Pokémon on the Bench. If more than one effect changes the number of Benched Pokémon allowed, use the smaller number. {F}{C} → Rock Throw : 40
066.flavorText: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.

067.name: Gligar
067.attacksText: {F} → Double Shot This attack does 10 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
067.flavorText: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

068.name: Gliscor
068.evolves: Evolves from Gligar and into Gliscor LV. X
068.attacksText: {F} → Finishing Stinger : 70 If your opponent's Active Pokémon has no damage counters on it before this attack does damage, this attack does nothing. {F}{C}{C} → Guillotine : 90
068.flavorText: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

069.name: Nosepass
069.attacksText: {C}{C} → Ram : 20 {F}{C}{C} → Rising Lunge : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
069.flavorText: The magnet in Nosepass's nose provides an unerring compass, making it an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.

070.name: Barboach
070.evolves: Evolves into Whiscash
070.attacksText: {C} → Hook : 10 {F}{C} → Mud-Slap : 20
070.flavorText: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

071.name: Whiscash
071.attacksText: {F}{C}{C} → Water Pulse : 60 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Landslip : 100× Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. This attack does 100 damage for each Energy card you discarded in this way.
071.flavorText: A glutton that devours anything that moves, it quietly lurks at the bottom of swamps, lying in wait for prey.

072.name: Pancham
072.attacksText: {F}{F} → Karate Chop : 60- This attack does 10 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
072.flavorText: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.

073.name: Rockruff
073.evolves: Evolves into Lycanroc , Lycanroc- GX , or Lycanroc ex
073.attacksText: {F} → Corner The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C} → Wild Kick : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
073.flavorText: It's considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

074.name: Lycanroc-GX
074.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Bloodthirsty Eyes When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. {F}{C}{C} → Claw Slash : 110 {F}{C} → Dangerous Rogue- GX : 50× This attack does 50 damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

075.name: Mudbray
075.evolves: Evolves into Mudsdale
075.attacksText: {F}{F} → Double Kick : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.
075.flavorText: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

076.name: Mudsdale
076.attacksText: {F}{F}{C} → Enhanced Stomp : 60+ If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 60 more damage. {F}{F}{F}{C} → High Horsepower : 180 This Pokémon does 40 damage to itself.
076.flavorText: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

077.name: Minior
077.attacksText: {C} → Swift : 20 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. {F}{F}{F} → Cosmicsplosion : 190 This Pokémon is Knocked Out.
077.flavorText: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.

078.name: Murkrow
078.evolves: Evolves into Honchkrow or Honchkrow- GX
078.attacksText: {D} → Whirlwind : 10 Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.
078.flavorText: They awaken at dusk and take wing in the twilight, leading to the expression, “Get home before the Murkrow fly.”

079.name: Honchkrow
079.evolves: Evolves from Murkrow and into Honchkrow LV. X
079.attacksText: {D} → Feint Attack This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on that Pokémon. {C}{C} → Raven's Claw : 10+ This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on all of your opponent's Pokémon.
079.flavorText: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than a hundred of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

080.name: Sableye
080.attacksText: {D} → Limitation Your opponent can't play any Supporter cards from their hand during their next turn. {C} → Scratch : 20
080.flavorText: It's a fiend for gemstones, so it stalks Carbink. Unfortunately, Gabite almost always grabs them first.

081.name: Absol
081.attacksText: {D} → Future Sight Look at the top 4 cards of either player's deck and put them back in any order. {D}{C} → Doom News Put all Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand. At the end of your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon will be Knocked Out.
081.flavorText: Long ago, superstitions were spread about it, saying it brought disaster. This fed a hatred of it, and it was driven deep into the mountains.

082.name: Pangoro
082.attacksText: {D}{C}{C} → Sky Uppercut : 70 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance. {D}{C}{C}{C} → Magnum Punch : 130
082.flavorText: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro's Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.

083.name: Beldum
083.attacksText: {M} → Core Beam : 20 Discard a {M} Energy from this Pokémon.
083.flavorText: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.

084.name: Metang
084.evolves: Evolves from Beldum and into Metagross , Metagross- GX , or Metagross ex
084.attacksText: {C} → Ram : 20 {M}{M}{C} → Core Beam : 80 Discard a {M} Energy from this Pokémon.
084.flavorText: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.

085.name: Metagross-GX
085.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Geotech System Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may attach a {P} or {M} Energy card from your discard pile to your Active Pokémon. {M}{M}{C} → Giga Hammer : 150 This Pokémon can't use Giga Hammer during your next turn. {C} → Algorithm- GX Search your deck for up to 5 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

086.name: Probopass
086.attacksText: {M} → Energy Link : 30 Attach an Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Power Gem : 120
086.flavorText: It radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances become unusable.

087.name: Solgaleo
087.attacksText: {M}{C} → Shining Arrow This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {M}{M}{C} → Fangs of the Sunne : 170 This Pokémon can't use Fangs of the Sunne during your next turn.
087.flavorText: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

088.name: Clefairy
088.evolves: Evolves into Clefable , Mega Clefable ex , or Clefable ex
088.attacksText: {Y} → Slap : 10 {C}{C} → Follow Me Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.
088.flavorText: Its adorable behavior and appearance make it popular with men and women, young and old. Its numbers are few, however.

089.name: Clefable
089.attacksText: {C} → Lullaby : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {Y}{C}{C} → Meteor Mash : 60 During your next turn, this Pokémon's Meteor Mash attack does 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .
089.flavorText: They don't like to reveal themselves in front of people. They live quietly in packs deep in the mountains.

090.name: Cottonee
090.evolves: Evolves into Whimsicott , Whimsicott ex , or Whimsicott- GX
090.attacksText: {C} → Continuous Tumble : 10× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
