118.attacksText: When your Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, you may move 1 basic Energy card from that Pokémon to the Pokémon this card is attached to. · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

119.name: Great Ball
119.attacksText: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

120.name: Hau
120.attacksText: Draw 3 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

121.name: Ilima
121.attacksText: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and flips a coin. If heads, that player draws 6 cards. If tails, they draw 3 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

122.name: Lillie
122.attacksText: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. If it's your first turn, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

123.name: Nest Ball
123.attacksText: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

124.name: Poison Barb
124.attacksText: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned. · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

125.name: Poké Ball
125.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

126.name: Pokémon Catcher
126.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

127.name: Potion
127.attacksText: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

128.name: Professor Kukui
128.attacksText: Draw 2 cards. During this turn, your Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

129.name: Rare Candy
129.attacksText: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

130.name: Repel
130.attacksText: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

131.name: Rotom Dex
131.attacksText: After counting your Prize cards, shuffle them into your deck. Then, take that many cards from the top of your deck and put them face down as your Prize cards. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

132.name: Switch
132.attacksText: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

133.name: Team Skull Grunt
133.attacksText: Your opponent reveals their hand. Discard 2 Energy cards from it. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

134.name: Timer Ball
134.attacksText: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

135.name: Ultra Ball
135.attacksText: Discard 2 cards from your hand. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

136.name: Double Colorless Energy
136.attacksText: Double Colorless Energy provides {C}{C} Energy.

137.name: Rainbow Energy
137.attacksText: This card provides {C} Energy. While in play, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon.

138.name: Lurantis-GX
138.attacksText: {G} → Flower Supply : 40 Attach 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like. {G}{G}{C} → Solar Blade : 120 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. {G} → Chloroscythe- GX : 50× This attack does 50 damage times the amount of {G} Energy attached to this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

139.name: Lapras-GX
139.attacksText: {W} → Collect Draw 3 cards. {W}{W}{W} → Blizzard Burn : 160 This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn. {W}{W}{C} → Ice Beam- GX : 100 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

140.name: Espeon-GX
140.attacksText: {P} → Psybeam : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {P}{C}{C} → Psychic : 60+ This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. {P}{C}{C} → Divide- GX Put 10 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

141.name: Lunala-GX
141.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Psychic Transfer As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may move a {P} Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. {P}{P}{P}{P} → Moongeist Beam : 120 The Defending Pokémon can't be healed during your opponent's next turn. {P}{P}{P} → Lunar Fall- GX Knock Out 1 of your opponent's Basic Pokémon that isn't a Pokémon- GX . (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

142.name: Umbreon-GX
142.attacksText: {D} → Strafe : 30 You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {D}{C}{C} → Shadow Bullet : 90 This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {D}{C} → Dark Call- GX Discard 2 Energy from your opponent's Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

143.name: Solgaleo-GX
143.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Ultra Road Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {M}{M}{C} → Sunsteel Strike : 230 Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. {M} → Sol Burst- GX Search your deck for up to 5 Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

144.name: Tauros-GX
144.attacksText: {C}{C} → Rage : 20+ This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. {C}{C} → Horn Attack : 60 {C}{C} → Mad Bull- GX : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

161.attacksText: Discard 2 cards from your hand. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

001.name: Caterpie
001.attacksText: {C} → Nap Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon. {C}{C} → Gnaw : 20
001.flavorText: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

002.name: Metapod
002.evolves: Evolves from Caterpie and into Butterfree
002.attacksText: {C} → Iron Defense Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C}{C} → Bug Bite : 40
002.flavorText: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

003.name: Butterfree
003.attacksText: {C} → Psy Bolt : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {C}{C}{C} → Whirlwind : 80 Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.
003.flavorText: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

004.name: Paras
004.attacksText: {G}{C} → Scratch : 30
004.flavorText: No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms growing on its back steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.

005.name: Parasect
005.attacksText: {C}{C} → Fury Cutter : 10+ Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 60 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 120 damage. {G}{G}{C} → Mushroom Drain : 70 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
005.flavorText: The large mushroom on its back controls it. It often fights over territory with Shiinotic.

006.name: Pinsir
006.attacksText: {C}{C} → Roof Fling Flip a coin. If heads, put your opponent's Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your opponent's hand. {G}{G} → Guillotine : 50
006.flavorText: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.

007.name: Surskit
007.attacksText: {C} → Quick Attack : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.
007.flavorText: When this Pokémon senses danger, a sweet fluid oozes from the tip of its heads. The taste of it disgusts bird Pokémon.

008.name: Masquerain
008.attacksText: {C} → Struggle Bug : 30 Move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.
008.flavorText: Its wings and antennae don't cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.

009.name: Rowlet
009.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {G}{C} → Leafage : 20
009.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

010.name: Dartrix
010.evolves: Evolves from Rowlet and into Decidueye , Decidueye- GX , Decidueye ex , or Hisuian Decidueye
010.attacksText: {C} → Sharp Blade Quill This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {G}{C}{C} → Leaf Blade : 50+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
010.flavorText: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

011.name: Decidueye
011.attacksText: {G} → Leaf Blade : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage. {G}{C}{C} → Brave Bird : 120 This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.
011.flavorText: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

012.name: Decidueye-GX
012.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Feather Arrow Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {G}{C}{C} → Razor Leaf : 90 {G} → Hollow Hunt- GX Put 3 cards from your discard pile into your hand. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

013.name: Grubbin
013.attacksText: {C}{C} → Vice Grip : 20
013.flavorText: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

014.name: Fomantis
014.evolves: Evolves into Lurantis or Lurantis- GX
014.attacksText: {G} → Synthesis Search your deck for a {G} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. {G}{C} → Leafage : 20
014.flavorText: They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.

015.name: Lurantis-GX
015.attacksText: {G} → Flower Supply : 40 Attach 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like. {G}{G}{C} → Solar Blade : 120 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. {G} → Chloroscythe- GX : 50× This attack does 50 damage times the amount of {G} Energy attached to this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

016.name: Morelull
016.attacksText: {C} → Flickering Spores Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {G} → Ram : 10
016.flavorText: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

017.name: Shiinotic
017.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Illuminate Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may search your deck for a {G} Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {G}{C} → Flickering Spores : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
017.flavorText: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

018.name: Bounsweet
018.attacksText: {G} → Sweet Scent Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. {C} → Splash : 10
018.flavorText: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

019.name: Steenee
019.evolves: Evolves from Bounsweet and into Tsareena , Tsareena ex , or Tsareena- GX
019.attacksText: {G} → Sweet Scent Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. {C}{C} → Stomp : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
019.flavorText: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

020.name: Tsareena
020.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Queenly Majesty When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may have your opponent reveal their hand. Then, discard a card from it. {G}{C}{C} → Trop Kick : 80 Heal 20 damage and remove all Special Conditions from this Pokémon.
020.flavorText: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

021.name: Growlithe
021.evolves: Evolves into Arcanine , Arcanine ex , or Light Arcanine
021.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Take Down : 60 This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.
021.flavorText: It's both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.

022.name: Arcanine
022.evolves: Evolves from Growlithe and into Arcanine BREAK
022.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Searing Flame : 60 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{R}{R}{C} → Firestorm : 190 Discard 3 {R} Energy from this Pokémon.
022.flavorText: Overflowing with beauty and majesty, this strong Pokémon appears in ancient Eastern folklore.

023.name: Torkoal
023.attacksText: {R} → Singe Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{C} → Body Slam : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
023.flavorText: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mounts where they live.

024.name: Litten
024.attacksText: {R} → Bite : 10 {R}{C} → Flare : 20
024.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

025.name: Torracat
025.evolves: Evolves from Litten and into Incineroar- GX , Incineroar , or Incineroar ex
025.attacksText: {R} → Fury Swipes : 20× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads. {R}{R}{C} → Flamethrower : 90 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
025.flavorText: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

026.name: Incineroar
026.evolves: Evolves from Incineroar and into Incineroar
026.attacksText: {R}{C} → Fire Fang : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{R}{C} → Darkest Lariat : 100× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.
026.flavorText: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

027.name: Incineroar-GX
027.attacksText: {R} → Hustling Strike : 10+ This attack does 20 more damage for each of your Benched {R} Pokémon. {R}{R}{C} → Tiger Swing : 80+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads. {R}{R}{C} → Burning Slam- GX : 200 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

028.name: Psyduck
028.evolves: Evolves into Golduck , Dark Golduck , or Light Golduck
028.attacksText: {C} → Confusion Wave Both Active Pokémon are now Confused.
028.flavorText: As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.

029.name: Golduck
029.evolves: Evolves from Psyduck and into Golduck BREAK
029.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 20 {W} → Double Jet : 60× Discard up to 2 {W} Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.
029.flavorText: It is said that the red part of its forehead grants supernatural powers to those who posses one, so it was over-hunted in the past.

030.name: Poliwag
030.attacksText: {W} → Water Gun : 10 {C}{C}{C} → Hydro Pump : 30+ This attack does more damage times the amount of {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
030.flavorText: It's still not very good at walking. Its Trainers should train this Pokémon to walk every day.

031.name: Poliwhirl
031.evolves: Evolves from Poliwag and into Poliwrath , Politoed , or Politoed ex
031.attacksText: {C}{C} → Double Slap : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads. {W}{C}{C} → Wave Splash : 60
031.flavorText: It marches over the land in search of bug Pokémon to eat. Then it takes them underwater so it can dine on them where it's safe.

032.name: Poliwrath
032.attacksText: {W} → Split Spiral Punch : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {W}{C}{C} → Wake-Up Slap : 80+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 80 more damage. Then, remove all Special Conditions from that Pokémon.
032.flavorText: Its percentage of body fat is nearly zero. Its body is entirely muscle, which makes it heavy and forces its swimming prowess to develop.

033.name: Shellder
033.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10
033.flavorText: The hardness of its shell surpasses the hardness of a diamond. In days gone by, people used the shells to make shields.

034.name: Cloyster
034.attacksText: {W}{C} → Headlock : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{W}{C} → Guard Press : 80 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
034.flavorText: Its hard shell cannot be shattered—not even by a bomb. The contents of the shell remain unknown.

035.name: Lapras-GX
035.attacksText: {W} → Collect Draw 3 cards. {W}{W}{W} → Blizzard Burn : 160 This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn. {W}{W}{C} → Ice Beam- GX : 100 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.) · Pokémon-GX rule : When your Pokémon- GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

036.name: Corsola
036.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {W}{C}{C} → Surf : 60
036.flavorText: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.

037.name: Wingull
037.attacksText: {C} → Roost Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. It can't retreat during your next turn.
037.flavorText: Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the sky, because wherever they're circling, the ocean sure to be is teeming with fish Pokémon.

038.name: Pelipper
038.attacksText: {C}{C} → Courier Put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your hand. {W}{C}{C} → Fly : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.
038.flavorText: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

039.name: Popplio
039.evolves: Evolves into Brionne
039.attacksText: {W} → Pound : 10 {W}{C} → Water Gun : 20

050.name: Chandelure
050.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sinister Selection Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Discard the other card. {P}{C} → Past Friends : 10+ This attack does 10 more damage for each Supporter card in your discard pile.
050.flavorText: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

051.name: Hoopa
051.attacksText: {C} → Hyperspace Punch This attack does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {P}{P}{P} → Portal Strike : 130 This Pokémon can't use Portal Strike during your next turn.
051.flavorText: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

052.name: Mankey
052.evolves: Evolves into Primeape or Dark Primeape
052.attacksText: {C} → Focus Energy During your next turn, this Pokémon's Flop attack's base damage is 50. {F} → Flop : 10
052.flavorText: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

053.name: Primeape
053.evolves: Evolves from Mankey and into Annihilape or Annihilape ex
053.attacksText: {C} → Swagger : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. {F}{F} → Spirited Throw : 30+ If, before doing damage, your opponent's Active Pokémon has more remaining HP than this Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.
053.flavorText: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.

054.name: Nosepass
054.attacksText: {C} → Thunder Wave Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {F}{C}{C} → Rolling Tackle : 40
054.flavorText: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check Nosepass to get their bearings.

055.name: Probopass
055.evolves: Evolves from Nosepass
055.attacksText: {F} → Bounce Back : 40 Your opponent switches his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {F}{C}{C} → Rock Tomb : 80 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
055.flavorText: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

056.name: Anorith
056.evolves: Evolves from Claw Fossil Anorith and into Armaldo or Armaldo ex
056.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Restored Barrier Each of your Restored Pokémon has no Weakness. {C} → X-Scissor : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
056.flavorText: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

057.name: Armaldo
057.attacksText: {C} → Rushing Water : 40 Move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {F}{C}{C} → Guard Claw : 100 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
057.flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.

058.name: Croagunk
058.evolves: Evolves into Toxicroak or Toxicroak ex
058.attacksText: {C} → Poison Up If the Defending Pokémon is Poisoned, put 3 more damage counters on that Pokémon between turns. This effect can be applied more than once.
058.flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

059.name: Toxicroak
059.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Poison Enzyme Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Poisoned Pokémon. {F}{C} → Poison Jab : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
059.flavorText: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

060.name: Sneasel
060.evolves: Evolves into Weavile or Weavile- GX
060.attacksText: {D} → Nyan Roll : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.
060.flavorText: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

061.name: Weavile
061.evolves: Evolves from Sneasel
061.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Tear Away As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may put a Pokémon Tool card attached to 1 of your Pokémon into your hand. {D}{C} → Slash : 40
061.flavorText: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

062.name: Spiritomb
062.attacksText: {D} → Nightmare : 10 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {D}{C} → Damage Play Move as many damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon as you like to any of your opponent's other Pokémon in any way you like.
062.flavorText: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

063.name: Pawniard
063.evolves: Evolves into Bisharp
063.attacksText: {C} → Charge Order : 10× This attack does 10 damage times the number of your Pawniard.
063.flavorText: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

064.name: Bisharp
064.evolves: Evolves from Pawniard and into Kingambit
064.attacksText: {C} → Retaliate : 30+ If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during his or her last turn, this attack does 60 more damage. {D}{C} → Mach Claw : 60 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
064.flavorText: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

065.name: Yveltal
065.attacksText: {D} → Oblivion Wing : 30 Attach a {D} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {D}{D}{C} → Darkness Blade : 100 Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.
065.flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

066.name: Yveltal BREAK
066.attacksText: {D}{D}{D} → Baleful Night : 120 This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · BREAK Evolution rule : Yveltal BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

067.name: Steelix-EX
067.attacksText: {M}{C}{C}{C} → Wild Edge : 80+ You may do 50 more damage. If you do, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself. {M}{C}{C}{C}{C} → Iron Tail : 100× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 100 damage times the number of heads. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

068.name: M Steelix-EX
068.attacksText: {M}{C}{C}{C}{C} → Canyon Axe : 160 This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

069.name: Shieldon
069.evolves: Evolves from Armor Fossil Shieldon and into Bastiodon
069.attacksText: {C}{C} → Rock Head : 20 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 60
069.flavorText: It was generated from a fossil dug out of a layer of clay that was older than anyone knows. It has a sturdy face.

070.name: Bastiodon
070.evolves: Evolves from Shieldon
070.attacksText: {C}{C} → Counter Head During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , put damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon equal to the damage done to this Pokémon. {M}{M}{C}{C} → Fortress of Rage : 100+ This attack does 10 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.
070.flavorText: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

071.name: Klink
071.attacksText: {M} → Disorderly Flip : 10× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
071.flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

072.name: Klang
072.evolves: Evolves from Klink and into Klinklang
072.attacksText: {M}{C} → Vice Grip : 30 {M}{M}{C} → Disorderly Flip : 30× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
072.flavorText: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. If the minigear it launches at a foe doesn't return, it will die.

073.name: Klinklang
073.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Heavy Bumper Any damage done to this Pokémon by an opponent's attack is reduced by 10 for each {C} in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M}{M}{C} → Gear Spinner : 70 During your next turn, this Pokémon's Gear Spinner attack does 70 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .
073.flavorText: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

074.name: Cobalion
074.attacksText: {M} → Quick Guard Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. This Pokémon can't use Quick Guard during your next turn. {M}{M} → Revenge Blast : 30+ This attack does 30 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.
074.flavorText: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

075.name: Magearna-EX
075.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Mystic Heart Prevent all effects of your opponent's attacks, except damage, done to each of your Pokémon that has any {M} Energy attached to it. (Existing effects are not removed.) {M}{C}{C} → Soul Blaster : 120 During your next turn, this Pokémon's Soul Blaster attack's base damage is 60. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

076.name: Marill
076.evolves: Evolves into Azumarill , Light Azumarill , or Azumarill ex
076.attacksText: {Y} → Bubble Drain : 10 Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
076.flavorText: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

077.name: Azumarill
077.attacksText: {C}{C} → Play Rough : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage. {Y}{Y}{C} → Bubble Drain : 80 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
077.flavorText: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

078.name: Gardevoir-EX
078.attacksText: {Y}{C} → Link Blast : 30+ If this Pokémon and your opponent's Active Pokémon have the same amount of Energy attached to them, this attack does 70 more damage. {Y}{Y}{C} → Luminous Blade : 120 Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

079.name: M Gardevoir-EX
079.attacksText: {Y}{C} → Despair Ray : 110+ Discard as many of your Benched Pokémon as you like. This attack does 10 more damage for each Benched Pokémon you discarded in this way. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

080.name: Klefki
080.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Wonder Lock Once during your turn (before your attack) , if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may discard all cards attached to this Pokémon and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon as a Pokémon Tool card. Prevent any damage done to the Pokémon this card is attached to by attacks from your opponent's Mega Evolution Pokémon. If this card is attached to a Pokémon, discard this card at the end of your opponent's turn. {Y}{C} → Fairy Wind : 30
080.flavorText: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

081.name: Xerneas
081.attacksText: {Y} → Geomancy Choose 2 of your Benched Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a {Y} Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward. {Y}{Y}{C} → Rainbow Spear : 100 Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.
081.flavorText: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

082.name: Xerneas BREAK
082.attacksText: {Y}{Y} → Life Stream : 20× This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to all of your Pokémon. · BREAK Evolution rule : Xerneas BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

083.name: Druddigon
083.attacksText: {C}{C} → Proud Fang : 20+ If your opponent has any Pokémon BREAK in play, this attack does 60 more damage. {R}{W}{C} → Giga Claw : 100 Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing.
083.flavorText: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

084.name: Deino
084.attacksText: {C} → Roar Your opponent switches his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {P}{D} → Headbutt Bounce : 20
084.flavorText: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.

085.name: Zweilous
085.evolves: Evolves from Deino and into Hydreigon or Hydreigon ex
085.attacksText: {C} → Double Hit : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. {P}{D}{C} → Power Breath : 80 Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.
085.flavorText: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

086.name: Hydreigon
086.evolves: Evolves from Zweilous and into Hydreigon BREAK
086.attacksText: {C}{C} → Cruel Fang : 40 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 40 (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {P}{D}{C} → Dark Burn : 50× Discard as many {D} Energy attached to your Pokémon as you like. This attack does 50 damage times the amount of {D} Energy you discarded in this way.
086.flavorText: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

087.name: Hydreigon BREAK
087.attacksText: {P}{D}{D}{C} → Calamity Blast : 150 Discard 3 Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · BREAK Evolution rule : Hydreigon BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

088.name: Meowth
088.evolves: Evolves into Persian , Dark Persian , or Persian- GX
088.attacksText: {C} → Stall You can use this attack only if you go second, and only on your first turn. Discard an Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {C}{C} → Scratch : 20
088.flavorText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

089.name: Persian
089.attacksText: {C} → Raid : 30+ If this Pokémon evolved from Meowth during this turn, this attack does 30 more damage. {C}{C} → Fury Swipes : 30× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
089.flavorText: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

090.name: Aipom
090.attacksText: {C} → Fiddle Around Look at the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back in any order. {C}{C} → Tail Jab : 20
090.flavorText: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

091.name: Ambipom
091.attacksText: {C} → Furry Chance : 20+ Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. If that card is an Energy card, this attack does 60 more damage. {C}{C}{C} → Double Hit : 50× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.
091.flavorText: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

092.name: Rufflet
092.evolves: Evolves into Braviary or Hisuian Braviary
092.attacksText: {C} → Reckless Charge : 20 This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.
092.flavorText: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

093.name: Braviary
093.attacksText: {C}{C} → Ambush : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 more damage. {C}{C}{C} → Sky Drop : 120- This attack does 120 damage minus 20 damage for each {C} in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.
093.flavorText: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

094.name: Fletchling
094.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 20
094.flavorText: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

095.name: Fletchinder
095.evolves: Evolves from Fletchling and into Talonflame
095.attacksText: {C} → Glide : 30
095.flavorText: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.

096.name: Talonflame
096.evolves: Evolves from Fletchinder and into Talonflame BREAK
096.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Gale Wings If this Pokémon is in your hand when you are setting up to play, you may put it face down as your Active Pokémon. {C} → Aero Blitz : 40 Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
096.flavorText: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

097.name: Hawlucha
097.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sudden Cyclone When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may have your opponent switch his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {C}{C} → Acrobatics : 20+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.
097.flavorText: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

098.name: Armor Fossil Shieldon
098.attacksText: Look at the bottom 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Shieldon you find there and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

099.name: Captivating Poké Puff
099.attacksText: Your opponent reveals his or her hand. Put any number of Basic Pokémon you find there onto your opponent's Bench. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

100.name: Fairy Garden
100.attacksText: Each Pokémon that has any {Y} Energy attached to it (both yours and your opponent's) has no Retreat Cost. · Stadium rule: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

101.name: Fossil Excavation Kit
101.attacksText: Put 2 in any combination of Helix Fossil Omanyte, Dome Fossil Kabuto, or Old Amber Aerodactyl cards from your discard pile into your hand. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

102.name: Helix Fossil Omanyte
102.attacksText: Look at the bottom 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal an Omanyte you find there and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

103.name: Lass's Special
103.attacksText: Draw a card for each of your opponent's Benched Basic Pokémon. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

104.name: Mega Catcher
104.attacksText: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Mega Evolution Pokémon with his or her Active Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

105.name: N
105.attacksText: Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck. Then, each player draws a card for each of his or her remaining Prize cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

106.name: Old Amber Aerodactyl
106.attacksText: Look at the bottom 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal an Aerodactyl you find there and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

107.name: Pokémon Fan Club
107.attacksText: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

108.name: Power Memory
108.attacksText: The Zygarde- EX this card is attached to can also use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.) {F}{F}{C} → All Cells Burn : 200 Discard 3 Energy attached to this Pokémon. · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

109.name: Random Receiver
109.attacksText: Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal a Supporter card. Put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

110.name: Scorched Earth
110.attacksText: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard a {R} or {F} Energy card from his or her hand. If that player does so, he or she draws 2 cards. · Stadium rule: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

111.name: Shauna
111.attacksText: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 5 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

112.name: Team Rocket's Handiwork
112.attacksText: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard 2 cards from the top of your opponent's deck. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

113.name: Ultra Ball
113.attacksText: Discard 2 cards from your hand. (If you can't discard 2 cards, you can't play this card.) Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

114.name: Double Colorless Energy
114.attacksText: Double Colorless Energy provides {C}{C} Energy.

115.name: Strong Energy
115.attacksText: This card can only be attached to {F} Pokémon. This card provides {F} Energy only while this card is attached to a {F} Pokémon. The attacks of the {F} Pokémon this card is attached to do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . (If this card is attached to anything other than a {F} Pokémon, discard this card.)

116.name: Glaceon-EX
116.attacksText: {W}{C} → Second Bite : 20+ This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon. {W}{C}{C} → Crystal Ray : 70 During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Evolution Pokémon. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

117.name: Alakazam-EX
117.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Kinesis When you play M Alakazam- EX from your hand to evolve this Pokémon, before it evolves, you may put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon and 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. {P}{C} → Suppression Put 3 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any Energy attached to it. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

118.name: M Alakazam-EX
118.attacksText: {P}{C} → Zen Force : 10+ This attack does 30 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

119.name: Umbreon-EX
119.attacksText: {C} → Veil of Darkness : 20 Discard as many cards as you like from your hand. Then, draw that many cards. {D}{C}{C} → Endgame : 70 If your opponent's Mega Evolution Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 2 more Prize cards. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

120.name: Genesect-EX
120.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Drive Change Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may return a Pokémon Tool card attached to this Pokémon to your hand. {M}{M}{M} → Rapid Blaster : 100+ Discard as many {M} Energy attached to this Pokémon as you like. This attack does 20 more damage for each {M} Energy you discarded. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

121.name: M Altaria-EX
121.attacksText: {Y}{C}{C} → Mist Purge : 100+ If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 more damage and heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

122.name: Kingdra-EX
122.attacksText: {C} → Big Storm : 20 Discard any Stadium card in play. {W}{C}{C}{C} → Dragon Trail : 60+ This attack does 30 more damage for each basic {L} Energy attached to this Pokémon. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

123.name: Altaria-EX
123.attacksText: {C}{C} → Powerful Gain : 30+ If this Pokémon was healed during this turn, this attack does 60 more damage and heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Shining Wind : 80 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon has no Weakness. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

124.name: Team Rocket's Handiwork
124.attacksText: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard 2 cards from the top of your opponent's deck. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

125.name: Alakazam-EX
125.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Kinesis When you play M Alakazam- EX from your hand to evolve this Pokémon, before it evolves, you may put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon and 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. {P}{C} → Suppression Put 3 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any Energy attached to it. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

001.name: Shuckle
001.attacksText: {C} → Hide a Berry Draw 2 cards. Then, put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. {C}{C} → Wrap : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
001.flavorText: It stores Berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

002.name: Burmy
002.attacksText: {C} → Hang Down : 10
002.flavorText: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

003.name: Wormadam
003.attacksText: {G} → Solar Ray : 20 Heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon. {G}{C}{C} → Leaf Cutter : 60+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
003.flavorText: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

004.name: Mothim
004.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Wormadam First As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Wormadam to another of your Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Gust : 60
004.flavorText: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.

005.name: Snivy
005.attacksText: {G} → Blot : 10 Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
005.flavorText: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

006.name: Servine
006.evolves: Evolves from Snivy and into Serperior or Serperior ex
006.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Serpentine Strangle When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {G} → Vine Whip : 20
006.flavorText: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

007.name: Serperior
007.attacksText: {C} → Coil : 40 During your next turn, this Pokémon's attacks do 60 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {G} → Slashing Strike : 80 This Pokémon can't use Slashing Strike during your next turn.

008.attacksText: {G} → Boo-Hoo : 20 If your opponent attaches an Energy card from his or her hand to the Defending Pokémon during his or her next turn, that Pokémon will be Asleep. {C}{C} → Leaf Slice : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

010.evolves: Evolves into Arcanine , Arcanine ex , or Light Arcanine
010.attacksText: {C}{C} → Bite : 20
010.flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

011.evolves: Evolves from Growlithe and into Arcanine BREAK
011.attacksText: {C} → Flop : 30 {R}{R}{C} → Flamethrower : 90 Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.
011.flavorText: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can't help but grovel before it.

012.evolves: Evolves into Camerupt , Mega Camerupt ex , or Camerupt ex
012.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {R}{R}{C} → Combustion : 40
012.flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

015.attacksText: {R} → Reinforced Flame : 20+ If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 20 more damage. {R}{C}{C} → Heat Blast : 70
015.flavorText: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.

016.evolves: Evolves into Golduck , Dark Golduck , or Light Golduck
016.attacksText: {C}{C} → Stampede : 20
016.flavorText: It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

017.evolves: Evolves from Psyduck and into Golduck BREAK
017.attacksText: {W} → Derail : 20 Discard a Special Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. {W}{C}{C} → Hydro Splash : 70
017.flavorText: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

018.name: Golduck BREAK
018.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Hyper Transfer As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may move a basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. · BREAK Evolution rule : Golduck BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

019.evolves: Evolves into Slowking , Slowbro , […] Dark Slowbro , Dark Slowking , Slowking ex
019.attacksText: {C} → Headbutt : 10 {C}{C} → Tail Lure Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

020.name: Slowbro
020.attacksText: {W} → Careless Head : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 more damage. {C}{C}{C} → Walk-Off Homer If you use this attack when you have only 1 Prize card left, you win this game.

021.name: Slowking
021.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Royal Flash Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may flip a coin. If heads, move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {W}{C} → Psych Up : 40 During your next turn, this Pokémon's Psych Up attack does 40 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .

022.attacksText: {W} → Razor Shell : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.
022.flavorText: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.

023.attacksText: {W}{C} → Clamp : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, this attack does nothing.

024.attacksText: {W} → Sudden Grip : 10 If this Pokémon evolved from Shellder during this turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{C}{C} → Surf : 70

025.evolves: Evolves into Starmie , Mega Starmie ex , or Starmie- GX
025.attacksText: {W} → Smack : 20
025.flavorText: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

(Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

100.attacksText: {C} → Take Down : 30 This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself. {C}{C}{C} → Seething Anger : 30× Flip a coin for each damage counter on this Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
100.flavorText: After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.

101.name: Dunsparce
101.evolves: Evolves into Dudunsparce or Dudunsparce ex
101.attacksText: {C} → Glare Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {C}{C} → Second Bite : 10+ Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
101.flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backwards by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

102.name: Taillow
102.attacksText: {C}{C} → Aerial Ace : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
102.flavorText: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

103.name: Swellow
103.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Drive Off Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may have your opponent switch his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Wing Attack : 60
103.flavorText: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

104.name: Skitty
104.evolves: Evolves into Delcatty or Delcatty ex
104.attacksText: {C} → Heal Bell Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon. {C} → Tail Whap : 10
104.flavorText: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

105.name: Delcatty
105.attacksText: {C} → Energy Salon Search your deck for up to 3 different types of basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C} → Fake Out : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
105.flavorText: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

106.name: Bidoof
106.attacksText: {C}{C} → Hyper Fang : 40 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
106.flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

107.name: Bibarel
107.attacksText: {C}{C} → Double Headbutt : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads. {C}{C}{C} → Hypno Headbutt : 60+ You may do 30 more damage. If you do, this Pokémon is now Asleep.
107.flavorText: It busily makes its nest withs stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

108.name: Lillipup
108.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {C}{C} → Bite : 20
108.flavorText: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

109.name: Herdier
109.evolves: Evolves from Lillipup and into Stoutland
109.attacksText: {C}{C} → Bite : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Jump On : 50+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
109.flavorText: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

110.name: Stoutland
110.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Bite Off : 60+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon- EX , this attack does 60 more damage. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Wild Barking : 80 Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
110.flavorText: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

111.name: Bunnelby
111.attacksText: {C}{C} → Dig : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.
111.flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

112.name: Diggersby
112.attacksText: {C}{C} → Pickup Put 2 Item cards from your discard pile into your hand. {C}{C}{C} → Dig : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.
112.flavorText: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

113.name: Fletchling
113.attacksText: {C} → Me First Draw a card. {C}{C} → Peck : 20
113.flavorText: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

114.name: Furfrou
114.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Fur Coat Any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C}{C} → Energy Cutoff : 80 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
114.flavorText: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

115.name: Cassius

You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Pokémon that was put into play this turn. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

122.attacksText: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

124.attacksText: Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws 4 cards. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

129.name: Team Flare Grunt
129.attacksText: Discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

130.attacksText: Double Colorless Energy provides {C}{C} Energy.

131.name: Rainbow Energy
131.attacksText: This card provides {C} Energy. While in play, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon.

141.name: Venusaur-EX
141.attacksText: {G}{C}{C} → Poison Powder : 60 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. {G}{G}{C}{C} → Jungle Hammer : 90 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

142.attacksText: {C}{C} → Rapid Spin : 30 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. 143.attacksText: {C} → Energy Glide Search your deck for a {L} Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward. 145.attacksText: {C}{C} → Joust : 30 Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tool cards attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. {M}{M}{C} → Tailspin Piledriver : 80+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 40 more damage. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

146.name: Xerneas-EX
146.attacksText: {Y}{C}{C} → Break Through : 60 This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {Y}{Y}{C}{C} → X Blast : 140 This Pokémon can't use X Blast during your next turn. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

001.name: Venusaur-EX
001.attacksText: {G}{C}{C} → Poison Powder : 60 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. {G}{G}{C}{C} → Jungle Hammer : 90 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

002.name: M Venusaur-EX
002.attacksText: {G}{G}{G}{C} → Crisis Vine : 120 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

003.name: Weedle
003.attacksText: {G} → Leaf Munch : 10+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {G} Pokémon, this attack does 20 more damage.
003.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

004.name: Kakuna
004.evolves: Evolves from Weedle and into Beedrill
004.attacksText: {G} → Harden During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon would be damaged by an attack, prevent that attack's damage done to this Pokémon if that damage is 60 or less.
004.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

005.name: Beedrill
005.attacksText: {G} → Poison Jab : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. {G}{G} → Flash Needle : 40× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads. If all of them are heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.
005.flavorText: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

006.name: Ledyba
006.evolves: Evolves into Ledian or Light Ledian
006.attacksText: {G}{G} → Spinning Attack : 30
006.flavorText: When the weather turns cold, lots of Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

007.name: Ledian
007.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 30 {G}{G} → Mach Punch : 50 This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
007.flavorText: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

008.name: Volbeat
008.attacksText: {G} → Luring Glow Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with your opponent's Active Pokémon. {G}{C} → Signal Beam : 30 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
008.flavorText: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise's sweet aroma.

009.name: Illumise
009.attacksText: {G} → Pheromotion Search your deck for a {G} Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {G}{C} → Quick Attack : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
009.flavorText: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.

010.name: Pansage
010.attacksText: {G} → Vine Whip : 10 {G}{C} → Leech Seed : 20 Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
010.flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

011.name: Simisage
011.attacksText: {C} → Torment : 20 Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn. {G}{G}{C} → Solar Beam : 70
011.flavorText: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

012.name: Chespin
012.attacksText: {G} → Pin Missile : 10× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
012.flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

013.name: Quilladin
013.evolves: Evolves from Chespin and into Chesnaught
013.attacksText: {C} → Scrunch Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn. {G}{G}{C} → Wood Hammer : 70 This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.
013.flavorText: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators' attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

014.name: Chesnaught
014.evolves: Evolves from Quilladin and into Chesnaught BREAK
014.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Spiky Shield If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. {G}{G}{C}{C} → Touchdown : 90 Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.
014.flavorText: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

015.name: Scatterbug
015.attacksText: {C} → Bug Bite : 10
015.flavorText: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

016.name: Spewpa
016.evolves: Evolves from Scatterbug and into Vivillon
016.attacksText: {C} → Bug Bite : 10 {G}{C}{C} → Stun Spore : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
016.flavorText: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

017.name: Vivillon
017.attacksText: {G} → Conversion Powder Choose either Asleep or Poisoned. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition. {C}{C}{C} → Colorful Wind : 30+ This attack does 30 more damage for each different type of basic Energy attached to this Pokémon.
017.flavorText: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

018.name: Skiddo
018.attacksText: {C} → Lead Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {G}{C}{C} → Tackle : 40
018.flavorText: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

019.name: Gogoat
019.attacksText: {C} → Lead Search your deck for up to 2 Supporter cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {G}{C}{C} → Charge Dash : 70+ You may do 20 more damage. If you do, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.
019.flavorText: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being.

020.name: Slugma
020.evolves: Evolves into Magcargo , Magcargo ex , Magcargo- GX , or Dark Magcargo
020.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Flamethrower : 50 Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.
020.flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

021.name: Magcargo
021.attacksText: {R}{C} → Magma Mantle : 30+ You may discard the top card of your deck. If that card is a {R} Energy card, this attack does 50 more damage. {R}{R}{C} → Heat Blast : 80
021.flavorText: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

022.name: Pansear
022.attacksText: {R} → Live Coal : 10 {R}{C} → Fireworks : 30 Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.
022.flavorText: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

023.name: Simisear
023.attacksText: {C} → Yawn Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {R}{C}{C} → Flamethrower : 90 Discard a {R} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
023.flavorText: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

024.name: Fennekin
024.attacksText: {R} → Will-O-Wisp : 20
024.flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

025.name: Braixen
025.evolves: Evolves from Fennekin and into Delphox
025.attacksText: {C} → Clairvoyant Eye Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back on top of your deck in any order. {R}{C} → Fire Tail Slap : 40 Discard a {R} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
025.flavorText: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

026.name: Delphox
026.evolves: Evolves from Braixen and into Delphox BREAK
026.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Mystical Fire Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. {C}{C}{C} → Blaze Ball : 50+ This attack does 20 more damage for each {R} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
026.flavorText: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

027.name: Fletchinder
027.evolves: Evolves from Fletchling and into Talonflame
027.attacksText: {C} → Flame Charge Search your deck for a {R} Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward. {R}{C} → Fire Wing : 30
027.flavorText: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

028.name: Talonflame
028.evolves: Evolves from Fletchinder and into Talonflame BREAK
028.attacksText: {C} → Devastating Wind Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws 4 cards. {R}{R} → Flare Blitz : 100 Discard all {R} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
028.flavorText: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

029.name: Blastoise-EX
029.attacksText: {C}{C} → Rapid Spin : 30 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, your opponent switches his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {W}{W}{W} → Splash Bomb : 120 Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 30 damage to itself. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

030.name: M Blastoise-EX
030.attacksText: {W}{W}{W} → Hydro Bombard : 120 This attack does 30 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

031.name: Shellder
031.attacksText: {W}{C} → Rain Splash : 20
031.flavorText: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

032.name: Cloyster
032.attacksText: {W}{C} → Clamp Crush : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and discard an Energy attached to that Pokémon. {W}{W}{C} → Spike Cannon : 30× Flip 5 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
032.flavorText: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

033.name: Staryu
033.evolves: Evolves into Starmie , Mega Starmie ex , or Starmie- GX
033.attacksText: {W}{C} → Reckless Charge : 30 This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.
033.flavorText: Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.

034.name: Starmie
034.evolves: Evolves from Staryu and into Starmie BREAK
034.attacksText: {W} → Recover Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon and heal all damage from it. {W}{C}{C} → Core Splash : 60+ If this Pokémon has any {P} Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 more damage.
034.flavorText: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

035.name: Lapras
035.attacksText: {W} → Seafaring Flip 3 coins. For each heads, attach a {W} Energy card from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. {C}{C} → Hydro Pump : 10+ This attack does 20 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
035.flavorText: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

036.name: Corsola
036.attacksText: {C} → Refresh Heal 30 damage and remove all Special Conditions from this Pokémon. {W}{C} → Spiny Rush : 20+ Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.
036.flavorText: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

037.name: Panpour
037.attacksText: {W} → Wave Splash : 10 {W}{C} → Water Splash : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
037.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

038.name: Simipour
038.attacksText: {C} → Recycle Put a card from your discard pile on top of your deck. {W}{W}{C} → Surf : 70
038.flavorText: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

039.name: Froakie
039.evolves: Evolves into Frogadier
039.attacksText: {W} → Bounce : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
039.flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

040.name: Frogadier
040.evolves: Evolves from Froakie and into Greninja , Greninja ex , or Greninja- GX
040.attacksText: {W}{C} → Lick : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
040.flavorText: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

041.name: Greninja
041.evolves: Evolves from Frogadier and into Greninja BREAK
041.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Water Shuriken Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may discard a {W} Energy card from your hand. If you do, put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {W} → Mist Slash : 50 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
041.flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

042.name: Pikachu
042.evolves: Evolves into Raichu , Alolan Raichu , […] Raichu- GX , Dark Raichu
042.attacksText: {C} → Nuzzle Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {C}{C} → Quick Attack : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.
042.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

043.name: Raichu
043.evolves: Evolves from Pikachu and into Raichu BREAK or Raichu LV. X
043.attacksText: {C}{C} → Circle Circuit : 20× This attack does 20 damage times the number of your Benched Pokémon. {L}{L}{C} → Thunderbolt : 100 Discard all Energy attached to this Pokémon.
043.flavorText: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

044.name: Voltorb
044.evolves: Evolves into Electrode , Electrode- GX , Dark Electrode , or Electrode ex
044.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Destiny Burst If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, put 5 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. {C} → Rollout : 10
044.flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

045.name: Electrode
045.attacksText: {L} → Eerie Impulse Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {C}{C} → Rollout : 40
045.flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”

046.name: Emolga-EX
046.attacksText: {C} → Energy Glide Search your deck for a {L} Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward. If you attached Energy in this way, switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {L}{C}{C} → Electron Crush : 60+ You may discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 30 more damage. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

047.name: Ekans
047.evolves: Evolves into Arbok , Dark Arbok , or Arbok ex
047.attacksText: {C}{C} → Bite : 20
047.flavorText: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

048.name: Arbok
048.attacksText: {C} → Gastro Acid : 20 The Defending Pokémon has no Abilities until the end of your next turn. {P}{C}{C} → Poison Jab : 50 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
048.flavorText: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

049.name: Spoink
049.attacksText: {P} → Splash : 10
049.flavorText: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

011.attacksText: {G} → Tackle : 20 {C}{C} → String Shot : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

You can't use more than 1 Victory Star Ability each turn. {R}{C} → Stored Power : 30 Move all Energy attached to this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

094.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {W}{F} → Gnaw : 20

095.evolves: Evolves from Gible and into Garchomp or Garchomp ex
095.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 20 {W}{F} → Shred : 40 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on the Defending Pokémon.

098.name: Zweilous
