098.attacksText: {C}{C} → Crunch : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. {P}{D}{D} → Dragon Claw : 80
098.flavorText: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

099.name: Hydreigon
099.evolves: Evolves from Zweilous and into Hydreigon BREAK
099.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Dark Trance As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may move a {D} Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. {P}{D}{D}{C} → Dragonblast : 140 Discard 2 {D} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
099.flavorText: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

RC1.name: Snivy
RC1.attacksText: {C} → Growth Attach a {G} Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon. {G}{C}{C} → Razor Leaf : 30
RC1.flavorText: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.

RC2.name: Servine
RC2.evolves: Evolves from Snivy and into Serperior or Serperior ex
RC2.attacksText: {C} → Leaf Blade : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage. {G}{C}{C} → Vine Whip : 40
RC2.flavorText: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

RC3.name: Serperior
RC3.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Royal Garden If this Pokémon has any {G} Energy attached to it, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost. {G}{C}{C} → Solar Beam : 80
RC3.flavorText: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior's noble eyes.

RC4.name: Growlithe
RC4.evolves: Evolves into Arcanine , Arcanine ex , or Light Arcanine
RC4.attacksText: {C}{C} → Rest Heal all damage from this Pokémon. This Pokémon is now Asleep. {R}{C}{C} → Lunge : 40 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
RC4.flavorText: Extremely loyal to its Trainer, it will bark at those who approach the Trainer unexpectedly and run them out of town.

RC5.name: Torchic
RC5.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

RC6.name: Piplup
RC6.attacksText: {C} → Charm During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{C} → Peck : 20
RC6.flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

RC7.name: Pikachu
RC7.evolves: Evolves into Raichu , Alolan Raichu , […] Raichu- GX , Dark Raichu
RC7.attacksText: {L} → Thundershock : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {C}{C} → Tail Whap : 20
RC7.flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

RC8.name: Ralts
RC8.attacksText: {P} → Hypnotic Gaze The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {P}{C} → Pound : 20
RC8.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

RC9.name: Kirlia
RC9.evolves: Evolves from Ralts and into Gardevoir , Gallade , […] Gardevoir ex , Mega Gardevoir ex
RC9.attacksText: {P} → Tiptoe Step Draw a card for each {P} Energy attached to this Pokémon. {P}{C} → Double Slap : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
RC9.flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

RC10.name: Gardevoir
RC10.evolves: Evolves from Kirlia and into Gardevoir LV. X
RC10.attacksText: {P}{C} → Psybeam : 40 The Defending Pokémon is now Confused. {P}{P} → Eternal Radiance Move all damage counters from this Pokémon to the Defending Pokémon. This Pokémon can't use Eternal Radiance during your next turn.
RC10.flavorText: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

RC12.attacksText: {F} → Attract If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. {F}{F}{C} → Mud-Slap : 70

RC13.name: Purrloin
RC13.attacksText: {D} → Captivate Flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with the Defending Pokémon.
RC13.flavorText: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.

RC14.name: Eevee

RC14.attacksText: {C} → Surprise Attack : 20 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
RC14.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

RC16.name: Ursaring
RC16.evolves: Evolves from Teddiursa and into Ursaluna
RC16.attacksText: {C}{C} → Picnic Weather Put a Teddiursa from your discard pile onto your Bench. Then, attach an Energy card from your discard pile to that Pokémon. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Fury Swipes : 50× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.
RC16.flavorText: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

RC17.name: Audino
RC17.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Relaxed Roll : 30× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number heads.
RC17.flavorText: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

RC18.name: Minccino
RC18.attacksText: {C} → Tail Slap : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
RC18.flavorText: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.

RC19.name: Cinccino
RC19.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Smooth Coat If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage. {C}{C}{C} → Echoed Voice : 50 During your next turn, this Pokémon's Echoed Voice attack does 50 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .
RC19.flavorText: Cinccino's body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.

001.name: Surskit
001.attacksText: {G} → Sweet Scent Heal 20 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
001.flavorText: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

011.name: Genesect-EX
011.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Red Signal When you attach a Plasma Energy from your hand to this Pokémon, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with his or her Active Pokémon. {G}{G}{C} → Megalo Cannon : 100 Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

018.attacksText: {W}{W} → Bubble Beam : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

(Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

108.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Transform During your turn (before your attack) , you may put a Basic Pokémon from your hand on top of this Pokémon. (This does not count as playing that Pokémon or evolving.) This Pokémon is now that Pokémon. (Any cards attached to this Pokémon, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon.)
108.flavorText: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

109.name: Snorlax
109.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Double Lariat : 40× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Rollout : 60
109.flavorText: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.

110.name: Togepi
110.evolves: Evolves into Togetic or Light Togetic
110.attacksText: {C} → Attract Smack : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
110.flavorText: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.

111.name: Dunsparce
111.evolves: Evolves into Dudunsparce or Dudunsparce ex
111.attacksText: {C} → Double Draw Draw 2 cards. {C} → Dig : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.
111.flavorText: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

112.name: Taillow
112.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 10
112.flavorText: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

113.name: Skitty
113.evolves: Evolves into Delcatty or Delcatty ex
113.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {C}{C} → Double Slap : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
113.flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

114.name: Delcatty
114.attacksText: {C} → Gather Energy : 30 Search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C} → Double Slap : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
114.flavorText: The reason it does not have a nest is that it simply searches for a clean, comfortable place then sleeps there.

115.name: Spinda
115.attacksText: {C}{C} → Whimsy Tackle : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
115.flavorText: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

116.name: Buneary
116.evolves: Evolves into Lopunny or Mega Lopunny ex
116.attacksText: {C} → Pound : 10 {C}{C} → Smash Kick : 20
116.flavorText: By extending its rolled up ears and striking the ground, it can bound so high it surprises itself.

117.name: Lopunny
117.attacksText: {C} → Healing Melody Flip a coin. If heads, heal 60 damage from each of your Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Kick Away : 60 Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.
117.flavorText: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.

118.name: Patrat
118.attacksText: {C} → Patrol Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back on top of your deck in any order.
118.flavorText: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.

119.name: Watchog
119.attacksText: {C} → Hypnoblast : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C} → Psych Up : 30 During your next turn, this Pokémon's Psych Up attack does 30 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .
119.flavorText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

120.name: Lillipup
120.attacksText: {C} → Roar Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {C}{C} → Bite : 20
120.flavorText: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it's also smart enough to check its foe's strength and avoid battle.

121.name: Herdier
121.evolves: Evolves from Lillipup and into Stoutland
121.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Take Down : 60 This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.
121.flavorText: This very loyal Pokémon helps trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

122.name: Stoutland
122.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sentinel As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent can't play any Supporter cards from his or her hand. {C}{C}{C} → Wild Tackle : 90 Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.
122.flavorText: Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain.

123.name: Pidove
123.attacksText: {C}{C} → Razor Wind : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
123.flavorText: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.

124.name: Tranquill
124.evolves: Evolves from Pidove and into Unfezant
124.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Air Slash : 60 Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.
124.flavorText: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets seperated from its Trainer.

125.name: Unfezant
125.attacksText: {C}{C} → Wing Flick : 40 Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Air Slash : 80 Flip a coin. If tails, discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.
125.flavorText: Males swing the plumage on their heads to threaten others, but females are better at flying.

126.name: Audino
126.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Busybody Once during your turn (before your attack) , if this Pokémon is in your hand, you may reveal it. If you do, heal 10 damage and remove a Special Condition from your Active Pokémon. Then, discard this Pokémon. {C}{C} → Hip Bump : 30 If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.
126.flavorText: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

127.name: Aspertia City Gym
127.attacksText: Each {C} Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) gets +20 HP. · Stadium rule: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

128.name: Energy Search
128.attacksText: Search your deck for a basic Energy card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

129.name: Great Ball
129.attacksText: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

130.name: Hugh
130.attacksText: Each player either draws or discard cards until he or she has 5 cards in his or her hand. (Your opponent does this first.) · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

131.name: Poké Ball
131.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

132.name: Potion
132.attacksText: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

133.name: Rocky Helmet
133.attacksText: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is your Active Pokémon and is damage by an opponent's attack (even if that Pokémon is Knocked Out) , put 2 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

134.name: Skyla
134.attacksText: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

135.name: Switch
135.attacksText: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

136.name: Town Map
136.attacksText: Turn all of your Prize cards face up. (Those Prize cards remain face up for the rest of the game.) · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

137.name: Computer Search
137.attacksText: Discard 2 cards from your hand. (If you can't discard 2 cards, you can't play this card.) Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

138.name: Crystal Edge
138.attacksText: If this card is attached to White Kyurem- EX , each of its attacks does 50 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

139.name: Crystal Wall
139.attacksText: If this card is attached to Black Kyurem- EX , its maximum HP is 300. · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

140.name: Gold Potion
140.attacksText: Heal 90 damage from your Active Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

141.name: Celebi-EX
141.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Time Recall Each of your evolved Pokémon can use any attack from its previous Evolutions. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.) {G}{C}{C} → Wind Whisk : 60 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

142.name: Keldeo-EX
142.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Rush In Once during your turn (before your attack) , if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may switch this Pokémon with your Active Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Secret Sword : 50+ Does 20 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

143.name: Cresselia-EX
143.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Sparkling Particles At any time between turns, heal 10 damage from this Pokémon. {P}{C}{C}{C} → Psychic Protection : 90 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon has no Weakness. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

144.name: Landorus-EX
144.attacksText: {F} → Hammerhead : 30 Does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{F}{C} → Land's Judgment : 80+ You may discard all {F} Energy attached to this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 70 more damage. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

145.name: Black Kyurem-EX
145.attacksText: {L}{C}{C} → Dragon Fang : 60 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{L}{L}{C} → Freeze Shock : 150 This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

146.name: White Kyurem-EX
146.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Dragon Stream : 60 Flip a coin. If heads, attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {R}{R}{W}{C} → Ice Burn : 150 Discard 2 {R} Energy attached to this Pokémon. The Defending Pokémon is now Burned. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

147.name: Bianca
147.attacksText: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

148.name: Cheren
148.attacksText: Draw 3 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

149.name: Skyla
149.attacksText: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

150.name: Golurk
150.attacksText: {P}{C}{C} → Devolution Punch : 60 Devolve the Defending Pokémon and put the highest Stage evolution card on it into your opponent's hand. {P}{P}{C}{C} → Ghost Hammer : 90 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon has no Weakness.
150.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

151.name: Terrakion
151.attacksText: {F}{C} → Retaliate : 30+ If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during his or her last turn, this attack does 60 more damage. {F}{F}{C} → Land Crush : 90
151.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

152.name: Altaria
152.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Fight Song Your {N} Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{M}{C} → Glide : 40
152.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

153.name: Rocky Helmet
153.attacksText: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if that Pokémon is Knocked Out) , put 2 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

001.name: Oddish
001.evolves: Evolves into Gloom or Dark Gloom
001.attacksText: {G} → Absorb : 10 Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon. {C}{C} → Acid : 20
001.flavorText: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

002.name: Gloom
002.evolves: Evolves from Oddish and into Vileplume , Bellossom , Vileplume- GX , or Vileplume ex
002.attacksText: {C}{C} → Foul Odor Both this Pokémon and the Defending Pokémon are now Confused. {G}{C}{C} → Poison Powder : 40 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
002.flavorText: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

003.name: Vileplume
003.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Allergy Panic Apply Weakness for each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) as ×4 instead. {G}{C}{C}{C} → Pollen Spray : 50 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.
003.flavorText: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.

004.name: Bellossom
004.attacksText: {G} → Grass Knot : 10+ Does 20 more damage for each {C} in the Defending Pokémon's Retreat Cost. {G}{C}{C} → Petal Dance : 50× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads. This Pokémon is now Confused.
004.flavorText: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

005.name: Tangela
005.attacksText: {G} → Nap Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. {G}{C}{C} → Vine Whip : 50
005.flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

006.name: Tangrowth
006.evolves: Evolves from Tangela and into Tangrowth LV. X
006.attacksText: {G} → Hundred Furious Lashes : 30× Does 30 damage times the amount of {G} Energy attached to this Pokémon. This Pokémon can't use Hundred Furious Lashes during your next turn. {G}{C}{C}{C} → Mega Drain : 70 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
006.flavorText: Even if one of its arms is eaten, it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.

007.name: Scyther
007.evolves: Evolves into Scizor , Scizor- GX , […] Kleavor , Scizor ex
007.attacksText: {C} → Slash : 10 {C}{C} → Sharp Scythe : 20
007.flavorText: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

008.name: Heracross
008.attacksText: {G} → Horn Attack : 20 {G}{G}{C} → Giga Horn : 80 Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing.
008.flavorText: No matter how heavy its opponents, it flings them far away with its prized horn.

009.name: Celebi-EX
009.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Time Recall Each of your evolved Pokémon can use any attack from its previous Evolutions. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.) {G}{C}{C} → Wind Whisk : 60 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

010.name: Shaymin
010.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. {G}{G} → Leaf Drain : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
010.flavorText: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

011.name: Snivy
011.attacksText: {G} → Vine Whip : 10 {G}{C} → Cut : 20
011.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

012.name: Servine
012.evolves: Evolves from Snivy and into Serperior or Serperior ex
012.attacksText: {G} → Vine Whip : 20 {G}{C}{C} → Double Slash : 40× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.
012.flavorText: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

013.name: Serperior
013.attacksText: {G}{C} → Double Slash : 50× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads. {G}{C}{C} → Mega Drain : 70 Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
013.flavorText: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

014.name: Cottonee
014.evolves: Evolves into Whimsicott , Whimsicott ex , or Whimsicott- GX
014.attacksText: {C} → Ram : 10
014.flavorText: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

015.name: Whimsicott
015.attacksText: {C} → Fluffy Tag Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. During your next turn, the attacks of that Pokémon do 40 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {G} → Stun Spore : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
015.flavorText: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.

016.name: Petilil
016.evolves: Evolves into Lilligant or Hisuian Lilligant
016.attacksText: {G} → Sleep Powder : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
016.flavorText: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

017.name: Lilligant
017.attacksText: {C} → Return : 20 Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. {G}{C}{C} → Magical Leaf : 50+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage and heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
017.flavorText: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

018.name: Charmander
018.evolves: Evolves into Charmeleon or Dark Charmeleon
018.attacksText: {R} → Draw In Attach 2 {R} Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {R}{C} → Flare : 20
018.flavorText: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

019.name: Charmeleon
019.evolves: Evolves from Charmander and into Charizard , Charizard ex , […] Charizard- GX , Mega Charizard X ex , Mega Charizard Y ex
019.attacksText: {R} → Flare : 20 {R}{C}{C} → Raging Claws : 50+ Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
019.flavorText: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

020.name: Charizard
020.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Split Bomb This attack does 40 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {R}{C}{C}{C}{C} → Scorching Fire : 150 Discard a {R} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
020.flavorText: It is said that Charizard's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

021.name: Numel
021.evolves: Evolves into Camerupt , Mega Camerupt ex , or Camerupt ex
021.attacksText: {R}{C} → Flamethrower : 60 Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.
021.flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees F. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

022.name: Camerupt
022.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Fire Shard : 60 The Defending Pokémon is now Burned. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is also Paralyzed. {R}{R}{C}{C} → Flamethrower : 80 Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.
022.flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years–or whenever it becomes really angry.

023.name: Victini
023.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {R}{C} → Relentless Flames : 30× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
023.flavorText: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

024.name: Tepig
024.attacksText: {R} → Flare : 10 {R}{C} → Rollout : 20
024.flavorText: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

025.name: Pignite
025.evolves: Evolves from Tepig and into Emboar or Mega Emboar ex
025.attacksText: {R}{C} → Rollout : 20 {R}{C}{C} → Firebreathing : 40+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
025.flavorText: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

026.name: Emboar
026.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Firebreathing : 40+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage. {R}{R}{C}{C} → Fire Blast : 120 Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.
026.flavorText: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

027.name: Darumaka
027.attacksText: {R}{C} → Reckless Charge : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.
027.flavorText: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 F.

028.name: Darmanitan
028.attacksText: {C} → Continuous Tumble : 20× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. {R}{C}{C} → Damage Counterpunch : 60+ If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage.
028.flavorText: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.

029.name: Squirtle
029.evolves: Evolves into Wartortle or Dark Wartortle
029.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Shell Shield As along as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's) . {W}{C} → Water Splash : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
029.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

030.name: Wartortle
030.evolves: Evolves from Squirtle and into Blastoise , Blastoise ex , or Blastoise- GX
030.attacksText: {C} → Withdraw Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn. {W}{W}{C} → Waterfall : 60
030.flavorText: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

031.name: Blastoise
031.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Deluge As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may attach a {W} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Hydro Pump : 60+ Does 10 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
031.flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

032.name: Psyduck
032.evolves: Evolves into Golduck , Dark Golduck , or Light Golduck
032.attacksText: {C} → Dazzle Dance Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
032.flavorText: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

033.name: Psyduck
033.evolves: Evolves into Golduck , Dark Golduck , or Light Golduck
033.attacksText: {W} → Firefighting Discard a {R} Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.
033.flavorText: When headaches stimulate its brain cells, which are usually inactive, it can use a mysterious power.

034.name: Golduck
034.evolves: Evolves from Psyduck and into Golduck BREAK
034.attacksText: {C} → Confuse Ray The Defending Pokémon is now Confused. {W}{C} → Water Gun : 30
034.flavorText: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

035.name: Golduck
035.evolves: Evolves from Psyduck and into Golduck BREAK
035.attacksText: {C} → Amnesia : 20 Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. The Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn. {W}{W} → Aquafall : 90 Discard all Energy attached to this Pokémon.
035.flavorText: When its forehead shines mysteriously, Golduck can use the full extent of its power.

036.name: Marill
036.evolves: Evolves into Azumarill , Azumarill ex , or Light Azumarill
036.attacksText: {C}{C} → Rollout : 20 {W}{C}{C} → Water Gun : 30
036.flavorText: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it's fine even in rivers with strong currents.

037.name: Azumarill
037.attacksText: {C}{C} → Deep Dive Flip 2 coins. For each heads, heal 40 damage from this Pokémon. {W}{W}{C} → Aqua Sonic : 70 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
037.flavorText: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

038.name: Delibird
038.attacksText: {C} → Present Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {W}{C} → Icy Wind : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
038.flavorText: It carries food all day long. When someone is lost in the mountains, it shares that food.

039.name: Oshawott
039.evolves: Evolves into Dewott
039.attacksText: {W} → Rain Splash : 10 {W}{C} → Seashell Attack : 20
039.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

040.name: Dewott
040.evolves: Evolves from Oshawott and into Samurott or Hisuian Samurott
040.attacksText: {W} → Rain Splash : 20 {W}{W}{C} → Waterfall : 50
040.flavorText: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

041.name: Samurott
041.evolves: Evolves from Dewott
041.attacksText: {W}{C} → Waterfall : 50 {W}{W}{C}{C} → Destructive Whirlpool : 80 Discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.
041.flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

042.name: Ducklett
042.attacksText: {W}{C} → Rain Splash : 20
042.flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

043.name: Swanna

076.flavorText: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

077.attacksText: {M}{C} → Self Destruct : 60 This Pokémon does 60 damage to itself.
077.flavorText: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

078.name: Jigglypuff
078.evolves: Evolves into Wigglytuff , Wigglytuff ex , […] Dark Wigglytuff , Light Wigglytuff
078.attacksText: {C} → Sing The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C} → Double Slap : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
078.flavorText: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

079.name: Wigglytuff
079.attacksText: {C}{C} → Round : 20× Does 20 damage times the number of your Pokémon that have the Round attack. {C}{C}{C} → Hypnoblast : 60 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
079.flavorText: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.

080.name: Meowth
080.evolves: Evolves into Persian , Dark Persian , or Persian- GX
080.attacksText: {C} → Double Scratch : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads. {C}{C} → Cat Kick : 20
080.flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

081.name: Persian
081.attacksText: {C} → Nasty Plot Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C} → Shadow Claw : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.
081.flavorText: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

082.name: Regigigas-EX
082.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Giga Power : 60+ You may do 20 more damage. If you do, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Raging Hammer : 50+ Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. · Pokémon-EX rule : When a Pokémon- EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

083.name: Pidove
083.attacksText: {C} → Scout Your opponent reveals his or her hand. {C}{C} → Gust : 20
083.flavorText: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

084.name: Minccino
084.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C} → Tail Smack : 20
084.flavorText: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

085.name: Cinccino
085.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Smooth Coat If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage. {C}{C}{C} → Echoed Voice : 50 During your next turn, this Pokémon's Echoed Voice attack does 50 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .
085.flavorText: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

086.name: Cilan
086.attacksText: Search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

088.name: Heavy Ball
088.attacksText: Search your deck for a Pokémon with a Retreat Cost of 3 or more, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

089.name: Level Ball

090.attacksText: Once during each player's turn, that player may heal 20 damage from 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. · Stadium rule: This card stays in play when you play it. 099.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Giga Power : 60+ You may do 20 more damage. 100.name: Cobalion
100.attacksText: {M}{C} → Energy Press : 20+ Does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. {M}{M}{C} → Iron Breaker : 80 The Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.
100.flavorText: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

101.name: N
101.attacksText: Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck. Then, each player draws a card for each of his or her remaining Prize cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

102.name: Meowth
102.evolves: Evolves into Persian , Dark Persian , or Persian- GX
102.attacksText: {C} → Fury Swipes : 10× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads. {C}{C} → Pay Day : 20 Draw a card.
102.flavorText: This is an extremely rare Meowth card. Maybe good fortune will come to you if you hold this card!

001.name: Sewaddle
001.attacksText: {G}{C} → Leaf Boomerang : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
001.flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

002.name: Swadloon
002.evolves: Evolves from Sewaddle and into Leavanny
002.attacksText: {G} → Tackle : 20 {C}{C} → String Shot : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
002.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

003.name: Leavanny
003.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Leaf Tailor Each of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached to it has no Weakness. {G}{C}{C} → Cutting Arm : 40+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.
003.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

004.name: Petilil
004.evolves: Evolves into Lilligant or Hisuian Lilligant
004.attacksText: {C} → Ram : 10 {G}{C} → Absorb : 10 Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
004.flavorText: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

005.name: Lilligant
005.attacksText: {G} → Aromax Heal all damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {G}{C} → Windmill : 30 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
005.flavorText: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

006.name: Dwebble
006.attacksText: {C} → Withdraw Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn. {G}{C} → Slash : 20
006.flavorText: The Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

007.name: Crustle
007.attacksText: {G}{C} → X-Scissor : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 more damage. {G}{C}{C} → Reckless Charge : 80 This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.
007.flavorText: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

008.name: Karrablast
008.attacksText: {C} → Mysterious Evolution If Shelmet is in play, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon. (This counts as evolving this Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C} → Fury Attack : 10× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
008.flavorText: When they feel threatened, they spit acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.

009.name: Foongus
009.evolves: Evolves into Amoonguss or Amoonguss ex
009.attacksText: {G} → Rollout : 20
009.flavorText: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

010.name: Amoonguss
010.attacksText: {G} → Toxic The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns. {C}{C} → Body Slam : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
010.flavorText: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

011.name: Shelmet
011.attacksText: {C} → Mysterious Evolution If Karrablast is in play, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon. (This counts as evolving this Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward. {G} → Ram : 10
011.flavorText: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.

012.name: Accelgor
012.attacksText: {C} → Acid Spray : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. {G} → Slashing Strike : 60 This Pokémon can't use Slashing Strike during your next turn.
012.flavorText: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

013.name: Virizion
013.attacksText: {C} → Double Draw Draw 2 cards. {G}{C} → Leaf Wallop : 40 During your next turn, this Pokémon's Leaf Wallop attack does 40 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .
013.flavorText: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

014.name: Victini
014.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Victory Star Once during your turn, after you flip any coins for an attack, you may ignore all effects of those coin flips and begin flipping those coins again. You can't use more than 1 Victory Star Ability each turn. {R}{C} → Stored Power : 30 Move all Energy attached to this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
014.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

015.name: Victini
015.attacksText: {R}{C} → V-create : 100 If you have 4 or fewer Benched Pokémon, this attack does nothing.
015.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

016.name: Pansear
016.attacksText: {C} → Beat : 10 {R}{C}{C} → Lunge : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
016.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600° F.

017.name: Simisear
017.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 20 {R}{R}{C} → Double Fire : 80× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage times the number of heads.
017.flavorText: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

018.name: Heatmor
018.attacksText: {R} → Singe The Defending Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{C} → Incinerate : 30 Before doing damage, discard a Pokémon Tool card attached to the Defending Pokémon.
018.flavorText: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

019.name: Larvesta
019.evolves: Evolves into Volcarona or Volcarona- GX
019.attacksText: {R} → Ember : 20 Flip a coin. If tails, discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.
019.flavorText: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

020.name: Larvesta
020.evolves: Evolves into Volcarona or Volcarona- GX
020.attacksText: {C}{C} → Take Down : 30 This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.
020.flavorText: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

021.name: Volcarona
021.attacksText: {R} → Fiery Dance : 30 Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon. {R}{C}{C} → Heat Wave : 60 The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.
021.flavorText: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

022.name: Tympole
022.attacksText: {C} → Vibration : 10 {W}{C} → Mud Shot : 20
022.flavorText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

023.name: Palpitoad
023.evolves: Evolves from Tympole and into Seismitoad
023.attacksText: {W} → Mud Shot : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Round : 20× Does 20 damage times the number of your Pokémon that have the Round attack.
023.flavorText: It lives in water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

024.name: Seismitoad
024.attacksText: {C}{C} → Round : 30× Does 30 damage times the number of your Pokémon that have the Round attack. {W}{W}{C} → Hyper Voice : 70
024.flavorText: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

025.name: Tirtouga
025.evolves: Evolves from Cover Fossil and into Carracosta or Carracosta- GX
025.attacksText: {W}{C} → Water Gun : 30 {W}{C}{C} → Surf : 60
025.flavorText: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

026.name: Carracosta
026.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Solid Rock If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, reduce that damage by 50 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{W}{C}{C} → Crunch : 80 Discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.
026.flavorText: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

027.name: Vanillite
027.attacksText: {W} → Icicle Barb : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.
027.flavorText: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

028.name: Vanillish
028.evolves: Evolves from Vanillite and into Vanilluxe
028.attacksText: {W}{C} → Ice Beam : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{W} → Frost Breath : 40
028.flavorText: It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.

029.name: Vanilluxe
029.attacksText: {W}{C} → Double Freeze : 40× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads. If either of them is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{W} → Frost Breath : 60
029.flavorText: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

030.name: Frillish
030.evolves: Evolves into Jellicent or Jellicent ex
030.attacksText: {C}{C} → Rain Splash : 20
030.flavorText: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

031.name: Jellicent
031.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Cursed Body If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , the Attacking Pokémon is now Confused. {C}{C} → Hydro Pump : 10+ Does 20 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
031.flavorText: The fate of ships and crew that wander into Jellicent's habitats: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

032.name: Cryogonal
032.attacksText: {W} → Icy Wind The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {W}{C} → Ice Shard : 30+ If the Defending Pokémon is a {F} Pokémon, this attack does 40 more damage.
032.flavorText: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

033.name: Cryogonal
033.attacksText: {W} → Ice Chain Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. {W}{W} → Frost Vanish : 40 You may return this Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.
033.flavorText: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

034.name: Kyurem
034.attacksText: {C}{C} → Outrage : 20+ Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. {W}{W}{C} → Glaciate This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
034.flavorText: It generates powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

035.name: Blitzle
035.attacksText: {L} → Agility : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.
035.flavorText: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

036.name: Zebstrika
036.attacksText: {C} → Quick Attack : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage. {L}{L}{C} → Shock Bolt : 90 Flip a coin. If tails, discard all {L} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
036.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

037.name: Emolga
037.attacksText: {L} → Electrichain : 10+ Does 20 more damage if you have any {L} Pokémon on your Bench.
037.flavorText: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

038.name: Tynamo
038.attacksText: {L} → Thunder Wave : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
038.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

039.name: Tynamo
039.evolves: Evolves into Eelektrik
039.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10
039.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

040.name: Eelektrik
040.evolves: Evolves from Tynamo and into Eelektross or Mega Eelektross ex
040.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Dynamotor Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may attach a {L} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {L}{L}{C} → Electric Ball : 50
040.flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

041.name: Eelektross
041.evolves: Evolves from Eelektrik
041.attacksText: {C}{C} → Acid : 30 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. {L}{L}{C} → Wild Charge : 90 This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.
041.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

042.name: Stunfisk
042.attacksText: {C}{C} → Mud Shot : 20 {L}{C}{C} → Thunder : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.
042.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

043.name: Victini
043.attacksText: {P} → V-blast : 120 Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.
043.flavorText: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

044.name: Yamask
044.evolves: Evolves into Cofagrigus or Cofagrigus ex
044.attacksText: {P} → Perplex : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
044.flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

045.name: Yamask
045.evolves: Evolves into Cofagrigus or Cofagrigus ex
045.attacksText: {C} → Ambush : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.
045.flavorText: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.

046.name: Cofagrigus
046.evolves: Evolves from Yamask
046.attacksText: {P}{C} → Damagriiigus Move all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to the Defending Pokémon. {P}{C}{C} → Perplex : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
046.flavorText: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

047.name: Cofagrigus
047.evolves: Evolves from Yamask
047.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Durable Body If this Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP becomes 10 instead. {P}{C} → Ambush : 40+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
047.flavorText: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

048.name: Trubbish
048.attacksText: {C} → Garbage Collection Put a card from your discard pile on top of your deck. {P}{C} → Sludge Bomb : 20
048.flavorText: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

049.name: Garbodor
049.attacksText: {P}{C} → Gentle Wrap : 30 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. {P}{P}{C} → Gunk Shot : 60 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
049.flavorText: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.

050.name: Solosis
050.attacksText: {C} → Rollout : 10
050.flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

051.name: Duosion
051.evolves: Evolves from Solosis and into Reuniclus
051.attacksText: {C} → Rollout : 20
051.flavorText: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

052.name: Reuniclus
052.attacksText: {C} → Future Sight Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and put them back on top of your deck in any order. {P} → Net Force : 40× Does 40 damage times the number of Reuniclus you have in play.
052.flavorText: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

053.name: Reuniclus
053.evolves: Evolves from Duosion
053.attacksText: {P} → Dizzy Punch : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {P}{C}{C} → Mind Bend : 60 The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
053.flavorText: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

054.name: Elgyem
054.attacksText: {C} → Headbutt : 10 {P} → Calm Mind Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
054.flavorText: This Pokémon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.

055.name: Elgyem
055.evolves: Evolves into Beheeyem
055.attacksText: {C} → First Contact Search your deck for 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. {P}{C} → Headbutt : 20
055.flavorText: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

056.name: Beheeyem
056.evolves: Evolves from Elgyem and into Beheeyem BREAK
056.attacksText: {P} → Synchronoise : 20 Does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that shares a type with the Defending Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {P}{C} → Psyshot : 40
056.flavorText: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.

057.name: Litwick
057.attacksText: {C}{C} → Searing Flame : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.
057.flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel it burns.

058.name: Litwick
058.evolves: Evolves into Lampent
058.attacksText: {P} → Teleportation Burst : 10 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
058.flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leaches off the life force of any who follow it.

059.name: Lampent
059.evolves: Evolves from Litwick and into Chandelure
059.attacksText: {C} → Luring Light Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. {P}{C} → Will-O-Wisp : 30
059.flavorText: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

060.name: Chandelure
060.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Cursed Shadow Once during your turn (before your attack) , if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like. {P}{P}{C} → Eerie Glow : 50 The Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.
060.flavorText: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

061.name: Gigalith
061.evolves: Evolves from Boldore
061.attacksText: {F} → Core Cannon This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each {F} Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{C}{C}{C} → Power Gem : 90
061.flavorText: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

062.name: Timburr
