025.flavorText: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.

026.name: Ducklett
026.attacksText: {C} → Roost Heal 40 damage from this Pokémon. This Pokémon can't retreat during your next turn. {W}{W} → Rain Splash : 20
026.flavorText: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

027.name: Swanna
027.attacksText: {C}{C} → Wing Dance : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. {W}{C}{C} → Air Slash : 70 Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.
027.flavorText: It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.

028.name: Cubchoo
028.attacksText: {W} → Powder Snow : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C} → Rest Heal 60 damage from this Pokémon. This Pokémon is now Asleep.
028.flavorText: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

029.name: Cubchoo
029.attacksText: {W}{W} → Icicle Punch : 30
029.flavorText: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

030.name: Beartic
030.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Sheer Cold : 50 The Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn. {W}{W}{C}{C} → Icicle Crash : 80 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
030.flavorText: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

031.name: Beartic
031.attacksText: {W} → Icy Wind : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {W}{W}{C} → Superpower : 60+ You may do 20 more damage. If you do, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.
031.flavorText: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

032.name: Emolga
032.attacksText: {L} → Thundershock : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {C}{C} → Acrobatics : 10+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.
032.flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membranes and released while it is gliding.

033.name: Joltik
033.evolves: Evolves into Galvantula or Galvantula ex
033.attacksText: {C} → Gnaw : 10
033.flavorText: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

034.name: Galvantula
034.attacksText: {C} → Gnaw : 20 {L}{C} → Stun Needle : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
034.flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

035.name: Thundurus
035.attacksText: {C} → Charge Search your deck for a {L} Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward. {L}{L}{C} → Disaster Volt : 80 Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.
035.flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

036.name: Woobat
036.attacksText: {P}{C} → Psy Bolt : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
036.flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

037.name: Swoobat
037.attacksText: {P} → Psyshot : 30 {P}{C} → Phat Sound Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
037.flavorText: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

038.name: Venipede
038.attacksText: {P} → Poison Sting Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. {C}{C} → Tackle : 20
038.flavorText: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

039.name: Whirlipede
039.evolves: Evolves from Venipede and into Scolipede
039.attacksText: {P} → Venoshock : 10+ If the Defending Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 60 more damage. {C}{C}{C} → Steamroller : 40 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
039.flavorText: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

040.name: Scolipede
040.attacksText: {P}{C} → Toxic Claws : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns. {P}{C}{C} → Wild Horn : 50+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.
040.flavorText: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

041.name: Sigilyph
041.attacksText: {P} → Reflect During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {P}{C}{C} → Telekinesis Does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
041.flavorText: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

042.name: Sigilyph
042.attacksText: {P} → Quick Turn : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads. {C}{C}{C} → Psychic Assault : 40+ Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.
042.flavorText: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

043.name: Gothita
043.attacksText: {C} → Hypnotic Gaze The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C} → Double Slap : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
043.flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

044.name: Gothita
044.attacksText: {C}{C} → Smack : 20
044.flavorText: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

045.name: Gothorita
045.evolves: Evolves from Gothita and into Gothitelle
045.attacksText: {C} → Double Slap : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. {P}{C} → Psybeam : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
045.flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

046.name: Gothorita
046.evolves: Evolves from Gothita and into Gothitelle
046.attacksText: {P} → Deleting Glare Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {P}{C}{C} → Super Psy Bolt : 50
046.flavorText: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

047.name: Gothitelle
047.evolves: Evolves from Gothorita
047.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Magic Room As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent can't play any Item cards from his or her hand. {C}{C}{C} → Madkinesis : 30+ Does 20 more damage for each {P} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
047.flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

048.name: Gothitelle
048.attacksText: {P} → Smack : 30 {P}{C}{C} → Mental Shock : 60 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.
048.flavorText: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers' life spans.

049.name: Roggenrola
049.attacksText: {C} → Harden During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon would be damaged by an attack, prevent that attack's damage done to this Pokémon if that damage is 40 or less. {F}{C}{C} → Headbutt : 40
049.flavorText: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

050.name: Roggenrola
050.attacksText: {C} → Headbutt : 10 {F}{C} → Reckless Charge : 30 This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.
050.flavorText: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

051.name: Boldore
051.evolves: Evolves from Roggenrola and into Gigalith
051.attacksText: {F}{C} → Smack Down : 20+ If the Defending Pokémon has {F} Resistance, this attack does 60 more damage. {F}{F}{C}{C} → Power Gem : 80
051.flavorText: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

052.name: Boldore
052.evolves: Evolves from Roggenrola and into Gigalith
052.attacksText: {C}{C} → Headbutt : 30 {F}{C}{C} → Hard Crash : 60+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.
052.flavorText: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

053.name: Gigalith
053.evolves: Evolves from Boldore
053.attacksText: {F} → Shear Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are {F} Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Rock Bullet : 40+ Does 20 more damage for each {F} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
053.flavorText: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.

054.name: Drilbur
054.evolves: Evolves into Excadrill or Excadrill ex
054.attacksText: {C} → Hone Claws During your next turn, each of this Pokémon's attacks does 30 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F} → Scratch : 10
054.flavorText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

055.name: Drilbur
055.evolves: Evolves into Excadrill or Excadrill ex
055.attacksText: {F}{F}{C} → Mud-Slap : 40
055.flavorText: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

056.name: Excadrill
056.attacksText: {C} → Metal Claw : 30 {F}{F}{F} → Drill Run : 80 Discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.
056.flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

057.name: Excadrill
057.attacksText: {F}{C} → Dig : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. {F}{C}{C} → Earthquake : 70 Does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
057.flavorText: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

058.name: Throh
058.attacksText: {F}{C} → Scarf Hold : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.
058.flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

059.name: Sawk
059.attacksText: {F}{C} → Five Fierce Chops : 20× Flip 5 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.
059.flavorText: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

060.name: Sandile
060.attacksText: {F}{C} → Bite : 20
060.flavorText: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

061.name: Krokorok
061.evolves: Evolves from Sandile and into Krookodile
061.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 20 {F}{C}{C} → Crunch : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.
061.flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

062.name: Krookodile
062.evolves: Evolves from Krokorok
062.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Black Eyes Once during your turn (before your attack) , if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. {F}{F}{C} → Thrash : 70+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.
062.flavorText: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

063.name: Terrakion
063.attacksText: {F}{C} → Boulder Crush : 40 {F}{F}{C} → Sacred Sword : 100 This Pokémon can't use Sacred Sword during your next turn.
063.flavorText: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

064.name: Purrloin
064.evolves: Evolves into Liepard
064.attacksText: {D}{C} → Knock Off : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.
064.flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

065.name: Liepard
065.attacksText: {D} → Feint Attack Does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on that Pokémon. {D}{C}{C} → Claw Rend : 50+ If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 30 more damage.
065.flavorText: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

066.name: Zorua
066.evolves: Evolves into Zoroark or Zoroark- GX
066.attacksText: {D} → Ram : 10 {D}{C} → Rising Lunge : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.
066.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

067.name: Zoroark
067.evolves: Evolves from Zorua and into Zoroark BREAK
067.attacksText: {D} → Fury Swipes : 20× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. {D}{C}{C} → Night Daze : 80
067.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

068.name: Vullaby
068.evolves: Evolves into Mandibuzz or Mandibuzz ex
068.attacksText: {D} → Rear Guard During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {D}{C} → Gust : 20
068.flavorText: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

069.name: Mandibuzz
069.evolves: Evolves from Vullaby and into Mandibuzz BREAK
069.attacksText: {D} → Bone Rush : 30× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {C}{C} → Dark Pulse : 20+ Does 10 more damage for each {D} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.
069.flavorText: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

070.name: Ferroseed
070.evolves: Evolves into Ferrothorn
070.attacksText: {M}{C} → Pin Missile : 10× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
070.flavorText: They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.

071.name: Ferroseed
071.attacksText: {M}{M} → Pierce : 20
071.flavorText: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

072.name: Ferrothorn
072.attacksText: {M} → Steel Feelers : 30× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {M}{C}{C} → Gyro Ball : 60 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.
072.flavorText: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

073.name: Ferrothorn
073.attacksText: {M} → Iron Defense Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C} → Power Whip Does 10 damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
073.flavorText: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

074.name: Klink
074.attacksText: {C} → Spinning Attack : 10 {M}{C}{C} → Gear Grind : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
074.flavorText: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

075.name: Klang
075.evolves: Evolves from Klink and into Klinklang
075.attacksText: {C} → Metal Sound The Defending Pokémon is now Confused. {M}{M}{C} → Guard Press : 60 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
075.flavorText: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

076.name: Klinklang
076.attacksText: {M} → Charge Beam : 30 Attach an Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {M}{C}{C} → Zap Cannon : 80 Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon can't use Zap Cannon during your next turn.
076.flavorText: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

077.name: Cobalion
077.attacksText: {M}{C} → Metal Horns : 30 Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {M}{M}{C} → Sacred Sword : 100 This Pokémon can't use Sacred Sword during your next turn.
077.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

078.name: Patrat
078.attacksText: {C} → Hyper Fang : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
078.flavorText: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

079.name: Watchog
079.attacksText: {C} → Watcheck Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back on top of his or her deck in any order. {C}{C} → Quick Tail Smash : 20+ Before doing damage, you may flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage. If tails, this attack does nothing.
079.flavorText: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

080.name: Pidove
080.attacksText: {C}{C} → Gust : 20
080.flavorText: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

081.name: Tranquill
081.evolves: Evolves from Pidove and into Unfezant
081.attacksText: {C} → Claw : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. {C}{C}{C} → Wing Attack : 50
081.flavorText: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

082.name: Unfezant
082.attacksText: {C} → Tailwind Attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Feather Strike : 40+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage. If tails, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.
082.flavorText: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves fell close to anyone other than their Trainers.

083.name: Audino
083.attacksText: {C} → Powerful Slap : 40× Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads. {C}{C}{C} → Heal Pulse Heal 50 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
083.flavorText: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radar-like ability to understand its surrounding through slight sounds.

084.name: Minccino
084.attacksText: {C} → Last Resort : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
084.flavorText: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

085.name: Cinccino
085.attacksText: {C} → Captivate Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. {C}{C} → Fluffy Tail : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
085.flavorText: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

086.name: Rufflet
086.evolves: Evolves into Braviary or Hisuian Braviary
086.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 10 {C}{C} → Slash : 20
086.flavorText: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

087.name: Rufflet
087.evolves: Evolves into Braviary or Hisuian Braviary
087.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 10 {C}{C} → Claw : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
087.flavorText: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

088.name: Braviary
088.attacksText: {C}{C} → Wing Attack : 40 {C}{C}{C} → Brave Bird : 90 This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.
088.flavorText: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

089.name: Tornadus
089.attacksText: {C} → Energy Wheel Move an Energy from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to this Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Hurricane : 80 Move a basic Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
089.flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

090.name: Bianca
090.attacksText: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

091.name: Cheren
091.attacksText: Draw 3 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

092.name: Crushing Hammer
092.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

093.name: Great Ball
093.attacksText: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

094.name: Max Potion
094.attacksText: Heal all damage from 1 of your Pokémon. Then, discard all Energy attached to that Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

095.name: Pokémon Catcher
095.attacksText: Switch your opponent's Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

096.name: Recycle
096.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, put a card from your discard pile on top of your deck. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

097.name: Thundurus
097.attacksText: {C} → Charge Search your deck for a {L} Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward. {L}{L}{C} → Disaster Volt : 80 Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.
097.flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

098.name: Tornadus
098.attacksText: {C} → Energy Wheel Move an Energy from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to this Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Hurricane : 80 Move a basic Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
098.flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

001.name: Snivy
001.attacksText: {G}{C} → Slam : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
001.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

002.name: Maractus
002.attacksText: {G} → Mega Drain : 20 Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon. {G}{G}{C} → Pin Missile : 20× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
002.flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

003.name: Tepig
003.attacksText: {R}{C} → Ember : 30 Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.
003.flavorText: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

004.name: Oshawott
004.attacksText: {W}{C} → Water Pulse : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
004.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

005.name: Alomomola
005.attacksText: {C}{C} → Pound : 20 {W}{W}{C}{C} → Wave Splash : 60
005.flavorText: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

006.name: Blitzle
006.attacksText: {L}{C} → Quick Attack : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
006.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

007.name: Munna
007.attacksText: {P} → Yawn The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
007.flavorText: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

008.name: Sandile
008.attacksText: {F}{C}{C} → Sand Tomb : 30 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
008.flavorText: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

009.name: Zorua
009.evolves: Evolves into Zoroark or Zoroark- GX
009.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 10 {D}{C} → Fury Swipes : 10× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
009.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

010.name: Klink
010.attacksText: {M} → Charge Beam : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, attach an Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. {M}{C} → Irongrip : 20
010.flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

011.name: Pidove
011.attacksText: {C} → Growl During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C} → Gust : 10
011.flavorText: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

012.name: Audino
012.attacksText: {C}{C} → Double Slap : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
012.flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

100.name: Potion
100.attacksText: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

101.name: Professor Juniper
101.attacksText: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack) .

102.name: Revive
102.attacksText: Put a Basic Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

103.name: Super Scoop Up
103.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your hand. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

104.name: Switch
104.attacksText: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack) .

113.name: Reshiram
113.attacksText: {C}{C} → Outrage : 20+ Does 10 more for each damage counter on this Pokémon. {R}{R}{C} → Blue Flare : 120 Discard 2 {R} Energy attached to this Pokémon.
113.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.
