044.name: Flareon
044.attacksText: {C} → Flame Tail : 30 {R}{R}{C} → Flamethrower : 90 Discard an Energy attached to Flareon.
044.flavorText: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

045.name: Jolteon
045.attacksText: {C} → Agility : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Jolteon during your opponent's next turn. {L}{L}{C} → Mach Bolt : 70
045.flavorText: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

046.name: Magby
046.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Sweet Sleeping Face As long as Magby is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Magby by attacks. {@} → Play with Fire The Defending Pokémon is now Burned. Magby is now Asleep.
046.flavorText: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

047.name: Mime Jr.
047.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Sweet Sleeping Face As long as Mime Jr. is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Mime Jr. by attacks. {@} → Sleepy Lost Put the top card of your opponent's deck in the Lost Zone. Mime Jr. is now Asleep.
047.flavorText: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

048.name: Pidgeotto
048.evolves: Evolves from Pidgey and into Pidgeot or Pidgeot ex
048.attacksText: {C}{C} → Gust : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Twister : 30 Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing. For each heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.
048.flavorText: It renders its prey immobile using well-developed claws, then carries the prey more than 60 miles to its nest.

049.name: Quilava
049.evolves: Evolves from Cyndaquil and into Typhlosion , Typhlosion ex , or Hisuian Typhlosion
049.attacksText: {R}{C} → Flare : 30 {R}{C}{C} → Flamethrower : 60 Discard an Energy attached to Quilava.
049.flavorText: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

050.name: Riolu
050.evolves: Evolves into Lucario , Mega Lucario ex , Lucario- GX , or Lucario ex
050.attacksText: {F} → Tumble Over : 20 Riolu can't attack during your next turn.
050.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

051.name: Seviper
051.attacksText: {C} → Poison Buildup Seviper is now Poisoned. {P}{C} → Poison Effect : 20+ If Seviper is Poisoned, this attack does 20 damage plus 60 more damage and remove the Special Condition Poisoned from Seviper.
051.flavorText: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

052.name: Vaporeon
052.attacksText: {C} → Spiral Drain : 20 Remove 2 damage counters from Vaporeon. {W}{W}{C} → Dual Splash Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
052.flavorText: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

053.name: Chikorita
053.evolves: Evolves into Bayleef
053.attacksText: {C} → Nap Remove 1 damage counter from Chikorita. {G}{C} → Reckless Charge : 30 Chikorita does 10 damage to itself.
053.flavorText: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sunrays.

054.name: Clefairy
054.evolves: Evolves into Clefable , Mega Clefable ex , or Clefable ex
054.attacksText: {C} → Minimize During your opponent's next turn ,any damage done to Clefairy by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C} → Slap : 10
054.flavorText: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

055.name: Cyndaquil
055.evolves: Evolves into Quilava or Dark Quilava
055.attacksText: {R} → Fireworks : 20 Flip a coin. If tails, discard a {R} Energy attached to Cyndaquil.
055.flavorText: It is timid, and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

056.name: Eevee
056.evolves: Evolves into Jolteon , Flareon , […] Vaporeon , Umbreon , Espeon , Leafeon , Glaceon , Sylveon , Sylveon- GX , Umbreon- GX , Espeon- GX , Leafeon- GX , Glaceon- GX , Umbreon ex , Espeon ex , Jolteon ex , Vaporeon ex , Flareon ex , Sylveon ex , Dark Vaporeon , Leafeon ex , Glaceon ex , Jolteon- GX , Light Flareon , Vaporeon- GX , Flareon- GX , Light Jolteon , Light Vaporeon , Dark Espeon , Dark Flareon
056.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {C}{C} → Bite : 20
056.flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

057.name: Hitmonchan
057.attacksText: {C} → Detect Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Hitmonchan during your opponent's next turn. {F}{C} → Sky Uppercut : 30 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
057.flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

058.name: Hitmonlee
058.attacksText: {F} → Kick : 20 {F}{F}{C} → High Jump Kick : 60
058.flavorText: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

059.name: Houndour
059.evolves: Evolves into Houndoom , Dark Houndoom , or Houndoom ex
059.attacksText: {D} → Jump On : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.
059.flavorText: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

060.name: Koffing
060.evolves: Evolves into Weezing , Galarian Weezing , or Dark Weezing
060.attacksText: {C} → Smokescreen : 10 If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. {C}{C} → Suffocating Gas : 20
060.flavorText: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.

061.name: Magikarp
061.evolves: Evolves into Gyarados , Gyarados- GX , Dark Gyarados , or Gyarados ex
061.attacksText: {C} → Splash : 10
061.flavorText: For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like Pidgeotto to catch it mid-jump.

062.name: Magmar
062.evolves: Evolves into Magmortar
062.attacksText: {R} → Live Coal : 10 {R}{C} → Magma Punch : 20
062.flavorText: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

063.name: Mareep
063.evolves: Evolves into Flaaffy or Dark Flaaffy
063.attacksText: {L} → Static Shock : 10
063.flavorText: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

064.name: Mawile
064.attacksText: {C} → Selfish Draw Look at the top card of your deck. You may put it into your hand. If not, discard it and draw a card. {M}{C}{C} → Destructive Jaw : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.
064.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

065.name: Misdreavus
065.evolves: Evolves into Mismagius or Mismagius ex
065.attacksText: {C} → Mumble : 10 {P} → Dual Draw Each player draws 3 cards.
065.flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

066.name: Phanpy
066.evolves: Evolves into Donphan or Dark Donphan
066.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Ultra-Thick Skin As long as Phanpy has Energy attached to it, any damage done to Phanpy by attacks is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{C} → Rock Smash : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.
066.flavorText: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

067.name: Pidgey
067.attacksText: {C} → Messenger Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle Pidgey and all cards attached to it back into your deck. {C} → Glide : 10
067.flavorText: Common in grassy areas and forests, it is very docile and will chase off enemies by flapping up sand.

068.name: Pineco
068.evolves: Evolves into Forretress , Forretress ex , or Dark Forretress
068.attacksText: {C} → Focus Energy During your next turn, Pineco's Surprise Attack attack's base damage is 80. {G}{C} → Surprise Attack : 40 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
068.flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

069.name: Relicanth
069.attacksText: {C} → Prehistoric Wisdom Choose a card from your hand and put it in the Lost Zone. Then, draw 3 cards. {W}{C}{C} → Granite Head : 30 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Relicanth by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
069.flavorText: Discovered by chance during deep-sea explorations, it has not changed since ancient times.

070.name: Slowpoke
070.evolves: Evolves into Slowking , Slowbro , […] Dark Slowbro , Dark Slowking , Slowking ex
070.attacksText: {C} → Whismy Tackle : 20 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
070.flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

071.name: Snubbull
071.attacksText: {C} → Roar Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {C}{C} → Sharp Fang : 20
071.flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

072.name: Tangela
072.attacksText: {G} → Nutritional Support Search your deck for a {G} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward. {G}{C}{C} → Poisonpowder : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
072.flavorText: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

073.name: Teddiursa
073.evolves: Evolves into Ursaring or Dark Ursaring
073.attacksText: {C} → Fake Tears Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Trainer cards from his or her hand during your opponent's next turn, and any damage done to Teddiursa by attack is reduced by 30 (after applying weakness and resistance).
073.flavorText: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

074.name: Totodile
074.evolves: Evolves into Croconaw or Dark Croconaw
074.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Aqua Tail : 30+ Flip a coin for each {W} Energy attached to Totodile. This attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.
074.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

075.name: Vulpix
075.evolves: Evolves into Ninetales , Ninetales ex , or Light Ninetales
075.attacksText: {R} → Singe Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{C} → Ember : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, discard a {R} Energy attached to Vulpix.
075.flavorText: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

076.name: Cheerleader's Cheer
076.attacksText: Draw 3 cards. Your opponent may draw a card. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

077.name: Copycat
077.attacksText: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw a number of cards equal to the number of cards in your opponent's hand. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

078.name: Dual Ball
078.attacksText: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. If you do, shuffle your deck afterward.

079.name: Interviewer's Questions
079.attacksText: Look at the top 8 cards of your deck. Choose as many Energy cards as you like, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

080.name: Lost Remover
080.attacksText: Put 1 Special Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon in the Lost Zone.

081.name: Lost World
081.attacksText: Once during each player's turn, if that player's opponent has 6 or more Pokémon in the Lost Zone, the player may choose to win the game. · Stadium rule: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

082.name: Professor Elm's Training Method
082.attacksText: Search your deck for an Evolution card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

083.name: Professor Oak's New Theory
083.attacksText: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

084.name: Research Record
084.attacksText: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put as many of them as you like back on top of your deck in any order. Then, put the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.

085.name: Sage's Training
085.attacksText: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Choose any 2 cards you find there and put them into your hand. Discard the other cards. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

086.name: Darkness Energy
086.attacksText: If the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . Ignore this Effect if the Pokémon that Darkness Energy is attached to isn't {D}. Darkness Energy provides {D} Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

087.name: Metal Energy
087.attacksText: Damage done by attacks to the Pokémon that Metal Energy attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to isn't {M}. Metal Energy provides {M} Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

SL1.name: Deoxys
SL1.attacksText: {P}{P}{P} → Cell Storm : 60 Discard 2 {P} Energy attached to Deoxys and remove 6 damage counters from Deoxys.
SL1.flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

SL2.name: Dialga
SL2.attacksText: {M}{M}{M}{M} → Time Rewind : 70 Shuffle your hand into your deck.
SL2.flavorText: This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

SL3.name: Entei
SL3.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Extreme Speed Entei's Retreat Cost is {C} Energy less for each {R} Energy attached to Entei. {R}{R}{C} → Wild Blaze : 70 Discard the top 3 cards of your deck.
SL3.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

SL4.name: Groudon
SL4.attacksText: {F}{F}{F}{F} → Volcano Stomp : 80 Flip a coin. If heads, discard the top 4 cards of your opponent's deck. If tails, discard the top 4 cards of your deck.
SL4.flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

SL5.name: Ho-Oh
SL5.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Combustion : 50 {R}{R}{R}{C}{C} → Scorching Wing : 100 Flip a coin. If tails, discard all {R} Energy attached to Ho-Oh.
SL5.flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven-colored wings.

SL6.name: Kyogre
SL6.attacksText: {W}{W}{W}{W} → Destructive Tsunami Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, this attack does 40 damage to each of your Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
SL6.flavorText: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

SL7.name: Lugia
SL7.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Linear Attack Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{W}{W}{C}{C} → Hydro Splash : 80
SL7.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

SL8.name: Palkia
SL8.attacksText: {W}{W}{W}{W} → Wormhole : 60 Switch Palkia with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.
SL8.flavorText: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.

SL9.name: Raikou
SL9.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Extreme Speed Raikou's Retreat Cost is {C} less for each {L} Energy attached to Raikou. {L}{L}{C} → Raging Thunder : 70 Does 20 damage to 1 of your Pokémon and don't apply Weakness and Resistance to this damage.
SL9.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

SL10.name: Rayquaza
SL10.attacksText: {R}{R}{L}{L} → Inferno Spear : 100 Discard a {R} Energy and a {L} Energy attached to Rayquaza.
SL10.flavorText: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

SL11.name: Suicune
SL11.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Extreme Speed Suicune's Retreat Cost is {C} less for each {W} Energy attached to Suicune. {W}{W}{C} → Tsunami This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
SL11.flavorText: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

100.name: Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND
100.attacksText: {D}{D}{C}{C} → Lost Crisis : 100 Choose 2 Energy attached to Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND and put them in the Lost Zone. If any of your opponent's Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from this attack, put that Pokémon and all cards attached to it in the Lost Zone instead of discarding it. {P} → Moon's Invite Move as many damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon as you like to any of your opponent's other Pokémon in any way you like. · LEGEND rule: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND.

101.name: Palkia & Dialga LEGEND
101.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Sudden Delete Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Put that Pokémon and all cards attached to it back to your opponent's hand. {M}{M}{C} → Time Control Discard all {M} Energy attached to Palkia & Dialga LEGEND. Add the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck to his or her Prize cards. · LEGEND rule: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Palkia & Dialga LEGEND.

102.name: Palkia & Dialga LEGEND
102.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Sudden Delete Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Put that Pokémon and all cards attached to it back to your opponent's hand. {M}{M}{C} → Time Control Discard all {M} Energy attached to Palkia & Dialga LEGEND. Add the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck to his or her Prize cards. · LEGEND rule: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Palkia & Dialga LEGEND.

001.name: Aggron
001.attacksText: {M}{M}{C} → Second Strike : 40 If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage. {M}{M}{C}{C} → Guard Claw : 60 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Aggron by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
001.flavorText: You can tell its age by the length of its iron horns. It claims an entire mountain as its territory.

002.name: Altaria
002.attacksText: {C} → Midnight Eyes : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C}{C} → Stadium Power : 40+ If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage.
002.flavorText: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.

003.name: Celebi
003.attacksText: {P} → Future Sight Look at the top 5 cards of either player's deck and put them back on top of that player's deck in any order. {G}{C} → Leaf Bind : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
003.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

004.name: Drapion
004.evolves: Evolves from Skorupi and into Drapion LV. X
004.attacksText: {D}{C}{C} → Toxic Fang : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns. {D}{D}{C}{C} → Land Crush : 80
004.flavorText: It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.

005.name: Mamoswine
005.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Icy Wind : 40 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {W}{W}{C}{C} → Snowstorm : 70 Does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
005.flavorText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

006.name: Nidoking
006.evolves: Evolves from Nidorino and into Nidoking BREAK
006.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Pheromone Stamina Nidoking gets +20 HP for each Nidoqueen you have in play. {F}{F}{C}{C} → Venomous Horn : 80 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
006.flavorText: Its tail is thick and powerful. If it binds an enemy, it can render the victim helpless quite easily.

007.name: Porygon-Z
007.evolves: Evolves from Porygon2 and into Porygon-Z LV. X
007.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Dimensional Transfer Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck. This power can't be used if Porygon-Z is affected by a Special Condition. {C}{C}{C} → Suspicious Beam Beta : 80 If Porygon-Z has no Rainbow Energy attached to it, Porygon-Z does 20 damage to itself and Porygon-Z is now Confused.
007.flavorText: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error…

008.name: Rapidash
008.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Fiery Spirit Rapidash can't be Confused. {R}{C}{C} → Ring of Fire : 50 The Defending Pokémon is now Burned and can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
008.flavorText: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredibly fast.

009.name: Solrock
009.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Heal Block If you have Lunatone in play, damage counters can't be removed from any Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) . (Damage counters can still be moved.) {F} → Sun Flash : 20 If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.
009.flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

010.name: Spiritomb
010.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Spooky Whirlpool Once during your turn, when you put Spiritomb from your hand onto your Bench, you may use this power. Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws 6 cards. {P} → Color Tag Choose {G}{R}{W}{L}{P}{F}{D}{M} or {C} type. Put 1 damage counter on each Pokémon your opponent has in play of the type you chose.
010.flavorText: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

011.name: Venomoth
011.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Poison Moth Wind Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. If tails, your Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. This power can't be used if Venomoth is affected by a Special Condition. {G}{C} → Stun Spore : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
011.flavorText: The powder on its wings is poisonous if it is dark in hue. If it is light in hue, it causes paralysis.

012.name: Victreebel
012.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Tangling Tendrils As long as Victreebel is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is {C}{C} more. {G}{C} → Acidic Drain : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Poisoned. Remove 3 damage counters from Victreebel.
012.flavorText: Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.

013.name: Ambipom
013.attacksText: {C}{C} → Astonish : 20 Choose 2 cards from your opponent's hand without looking. Look at the cards you chose, then have your opponent shuffle those cards into his or her deck. {C}{C} → Tail Spank : 60 Discard 2 cards from your hand. (If you can't discard 2 cards from your hand, this attack does nothing.)
013.flavorText: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

014.name: Banette
014.attacksText: {P} → Lost Crush Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and put it in the Lost Zone. {P}{C}{C} → Breakdown Count the number of cards in your opponent's hand. Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.
014.flavorText: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

015.name: Bronzong
015.evolves: Evolves from Bronzor and into Bronzong BREAK
015.attacksText: {C} → Legend Ceremony Search your deck for both halves of a Pokémon LEGEND, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C} → Reflect Energy : 30 Move an Energy card attached to Bronzong to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
015.flavorText: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

016.name: Carnivine
016.attacksText: {C} → Saliva Lure Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. {G}{G}{C} → Stick and Absorb : 30 Remove 3 damage counters from Carnivine. The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
016.flavorText: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

017.name: Ditto
017.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Dittobolic The number of Benched Pokémon your opponent can have is now 4. If your opponent has 5 Benched Pokémon, your opponent must discard 1 of them and all cards attached to it. {C}{C} → Sharp Point : 20
017.flavorText: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

018.name: Dragonite
018.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Calming Wind : 50 Remove all Special Conditions from Dragonite. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Dragon Stamp : 80 Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing. If both of them are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
018.flavorText: This marine Pokémon has an impressive build that lets it freely fly over raging seas without trouble.

019.name: Dugtrio
019.attacksText: {F} → Dig : 30 {C}{C}{C} → Sand Impact : 50+ Flip a coin for each {F} Energy attached to Dugtrio. This attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.
019.flavorText: Extremely powerful, they can dig through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.

020.name: Electivire
020.evolves: Evolves from Electabuzz and into Electivire LV. X
020.attacksText: {L} → Plasma : 30 Search your discard pile for a {L} Energy card and attach it to Electivire. {L}{L}{L} → Thunder Shot This attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any Energy cards attached to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
020.flavorText: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

021.name: Elekid
021.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Sweet Sleeping Face As long as Elekid is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Elekid by attacks. {@} → Sparking Ball Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. Elekid is now Asleep.
021.flavorText: Even in the most vicious storm, this Pokémon plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

022.name: Golduck
022.evolves: Evolves from Psyduck and into Golduck BREAK
022.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Natural Remedy Whenever you attach a {W} Energy card from your hand to Golduck, remove 2 damage counters from Golduck. {W}{C} → Powerful Splash : 30+ Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.
022.flavorText: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

023.name: Grumpig
023.attacksText: {P}{C} → Psychic Lock : 20 Your opponent can't use any Poké-Powers on his or her Pokémon during his or her next turn. {P}{C}{C} → Bench Manipulation : 40× Your opponent flips a coin for each of his or her Benched Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage times the number of tails. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
023.flavorText: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

024.name: Kricketune
024.attacksText: {G}{C} → Entrancing Melody : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. {G}{G}{C} → Fury Cutter : 20+ Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 40 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 100 more damage.
024.flavorText: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.

025.name: Lunatone
025.attacksText: {F} → Lunar Blast : 20 {F}{C} → Selfdestruct : 60 Does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) . (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Lunatone does 60 damage to itself.
025.flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

026.name: Machamp
026.evolves: Evolves from Machoke and into Machamp BREAK or Machamp LV. X
026.attacksText: {F} → Vital Throw : 40+ You may do 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If you do, Machamp does 20 damage to itself. {C}{C}{C} → Hundred Furious Punches : 60+ Does 60 damage plus 10 more damage for each {F} Energy attached to Machamp.
026.flavorText: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

027.name: Magmortar
027.evolves: Evolves from Magmar and into Magmortar LV. X
027.attacksText: {R} → Top Burner For each {R} Energy attached to Magmortar, discard the top card from your opponent's deck. Then, flip a coin. If tail, discard all {R} Energy attached to Magmortar. {R}{R}{C} → Burst Punch : 60 The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.
027.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

028.name: Nidoqueen
028.attacksText: {C} → Return : 30 Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. {P}{C}{C} → Prize Count : 50+ If you have more Prize cards left than your opponent, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.
028.flavorText: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

029.name: Pidgeot
029.attacksText: {C}{C} → Headwind : 20 During your opponent's next turn, the attack cost of each of the Defending Pokémon's attacks is {C}{C} more. {C}{C}{C} → Quick Attack : 40+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage.
029.flavorText: It spreads its beautiful wings wide to frighten its enemies. It can fly at Mach 2 speed.

030.name: Sharpedo
030.attacksText: {D} → Strip Bare : 20 Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, your opponent discards all card from his or her hand. {D}{C}{C} → Rage : 50+ Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Sharpedo.
030.flavorText: It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting seawater through its body. It is the bandit of the sea.

031.name: Wailord
031.attacksText: {C}{C} → Underwater Dive Flip 2 coins damage. For each heads, remove 3 damage counters from Wailord. {W}{W}{W}{C} → Swallow Up : 50+ Before doing damage, count the remaining HP of the Defending Pokémon and Wailord. If the Defending Pokémon has fewer remaining HP than Wailord, this attack does 50 damage plus 50 more damage.
031.flavorText: It is the largest of all identified Pokémon. They jump as a pack to herd their prey.

032.name: Dragonair
032.evolves: Evolves from Dratini and into Dragonite , Dragonite- GX , Mega Dragonite ex , or Dragonite ex
032.attacksText: {C}{C} → Search and Invite Search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C}{C} → Slam : 40× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.
032.flavorText: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

033.name: Electabuzz
033.evolves: Evolves into Electivire or Electivire ex
033.attacksText: {C} → Light Punch : 10 {L}{L}{C} → Shock Bolt : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, discard all {L} Energy attached to Electabuzz.
033.flavorText: Its body constantly discharges electricity. Getting close to it will make your hair stand on end.

034.name: Electrode
034.attacksText: {C} → Rollout : 20 {L}{L}{C} → Lightning Strike : 40+ You may do 40 damage plus 60 more damage. If you do, discard all {L} Energy attached to Electrode.
034.flavorText: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.

035.name: Haunter
035.evolves: Evolves from Gastly and into Gengar , Mega Gengar ex , or Gengar ex
035.attacksText: {P} → Sneaky Placement Put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {C}{C} → Sleep Poison The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.
035.flavorText: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.

036.name: Kangaskhan
036.attacksText: {C}{C} → Split Spiral Punch : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Confused. {C}{C}{C} → Dizzy Punch : 50× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.
036.flavorText: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.

037.name: Lairon
037.evolves: Evolves from Aron and into Aggron or Aggron ex
037.attacksText: {M}{M}{C} → Take Down : 80 Lairon does 20 damage to itself.
037.flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

038.name: Lickilicky
038.attacksText: {C} → Licking Shot Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon for each Energy attached to Lickilicky. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {C}{C}{C} → Stick and Absorb : 50 Remove 2 damage counters from Lickilicky. The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
038.flavorText: It has space in its throat to store saliva. It can also roll up its tongue and store it in the same spot.

039.name: Luvdisc
039.attacksText: {C} → Rendezvous Draw Each player draws and reveals the top card of his or her deck. {W} → Distorted Wave : 30 Before doing damage, remove 1 damage counter from the Defending Pokémon.
039.flavorText: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a Luvdisc to someone you love.

040.name: Machoke
040.evolves: Evolves from Machop and into Machamp or Machamp- GX
040.attacksText: {F} → Knuckle Down : 30 This attack's damage isn't affected by Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon. {F}{F}{C} → Strength : 60
040.flavorText: It always goes at its full power, but this very tough and durable Pokémon never gets tired.

041.name: Magby
041.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Sweet Sleeping Face As long as Magby is Asleep, prevents all damage done to Magby by attacks. {@} → Play with Fire The Defending Pokémon is now Burned. Magby is now Asleep.
041.flavorText: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

042.name: Magmar
042.attacksText: {R} → Eruption : 20× Each player discards the top card of his or her deck. This attack does 20 damage times the number of Energy cards discarded in this way. {R}{C}{C} → Combustion : 30
042.flavorText: The fiery surface of its body gives off a wavering, rippling glare that is similar to the sun.

043.name: Magneton
043.evolves: Evolves from Magnemite and into Magnezone or Magnezone ex
043.attacksText: {L} → Speed Ball : 20 {C}{C} → Tri Attack : 20× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
043.flavorText: The Magnemite are united by a magnetism so powerful, it dries all moisture in its vicinity.

044.name: Marowak
044.evolves: Evolves from Cubone and into Marowak BREAK
044.attacksText: {C}{C} → Bonemerang : 60× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 60 damage times the number of heads. {F}{F} → Bone Impact : 20+ If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 20 damage plus 60 more damage. Discard that Stadium card.
044.flavorText: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.

045.name: Nidorina
045.evolves: Evolves from Nidoran Female and into Nidoqueen
045.attacksText: {C} → Quick Blow : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage. {P}{C}{C} → Tail Slap : 50
045.flavorText: It has a calm and caring nature. Because its horn grows slowly, it prefers not to fight.

046.name: Nidorino
046.evolves: Evolves from Nidoran Male and into Nidoking
046.attacksText: {C}{C} → Horn Attack : 30 {P}{C}{C} → Lunge : 80 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
046.flavorText: Quick to anger, it stabs enemies with its horn to inject a powerful poison when it becomes agitated.

047.name: Pidgeotto
047.evolves: Evolves from Pidgey and into Pidgeot or Pidgeot ex
047.attacksText: {C}{C} → Gust : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Twister : 30 Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing. For each heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.
047.flavorText: It renders its prey immobile using well-developed claws, then carries the prey more than 60 miles to its nest.

048.name: Piloswine
048.evolves: Evolves from Swinub and into Mamoswine or Mamoswine ex
048.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Blizzard : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{C}{C}{C} → Hammer In : 60
048.flavorText: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

049.name: Porygon2
049.evolves: Evolves from Porygon and into Porygon-Z or Porygon-Z- GX
049.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Mapping Once during your turn, when you play Porygon2 from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may search your deck for a Stadium card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C} → 3-D Attack : 20× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
049.flavorText: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

050.name: Tentacruel
050.attacksText: {W} → Tentavolve : 20 If Tentacruel evolved from Tentacool during this turn, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned. {C}{C}{C} → Hyper Beam : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.
050.flavorText: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its opponent inside a poisonous net.

051.name: Unown
051.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ CURE Once during your turn, when you put Unown from your hand onto your Bench, remove all Special Conditions from your Active Pokémon. {P} → Hidden Power : 10
051.flavorText: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

052.name: Wailmer
052.evolves: Evolves into Wailord or Wailord ex
052.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Double Attack Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{C}{C}{C} → Surf : 50
052.flavorText: It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.

053.name: Weepinbell
053.evolves: Evolves from Bellsprout and into Victreebel
053.attacksText: {C} → Poisonpowder The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. {G}{C} → Corrode Target : 10 Filp a coin. If heads, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and discard it.
053.flavorText: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.

054.name: Yanmega
054.evolves: Evolves from Yanma and into Yanmega BREAK
054.attacksText: {G} → Shoot Through : 20 Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {G}{C}{C} → U-turn : 50 Switch Yanmega with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
054.flavorText: The beat of its wings is so powerful that it accidentally dislodges full-grown trees when it takes off in flight.

055.name: Aipom
055.evolves: Evolves into Ambipom
055.attacksText: {C} → Imitate Draw cards until you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent. {C} → Tail Punch : 10
055.flavorText: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

056.name: Aron
056.attacksText: {C} → Mountain Eater Discard the top card of your deck. Then, remove 2 damage counters from Aron. {M}{C}{C} → Confront : 30
056.flavorText: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

057.name: Bellsprout
057.attacksText: {C} → Inviting Scent Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. {G} → Careless Tackle : 20 Bellsprout does 10 damage to itself.
057.flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

058.name: Bronzor
058.evolves: Evolves into Bronzong
058.attacksText: {C} → Iron Defense Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Bronzor during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C} → Tackle : 20
058.flavorText: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

059.name: Carvanha
059.evolves: Evolves into Sharpedo , Mega Sharpedo ex , or Sharpedo ex
059.attacksText: {C} → Focus Energy During your next turn, Carvanha's Bite attack's base damage is 40. {D} → Bite : 10
059.flavorText: They form packs to attack boats and rip out their hulls to sink them. They live in rivers in the jungle.

060.name: Cubone
060.evolves: Evolves into Marowak , Alolan Marowak , Alolan Marowak- GX , or Dark Marowak
060.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Lonely Bone Any damage done to Cubone by your opponent's attacks is reduced by 20 for each Marowak in your discard pile (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C} → Bone Rush : 20× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
060.flavorText: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes and emits a plaintive and mournful sound.

061.name: Diglett
061.evolves: Evolves into Dugtrio or Dark Dugtrio
061.attacksText: {C} → Sand Veil Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Diglett during your opponent's next turn. {F}{C} → Mini Earthquake : 40 Does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
061.flavorText: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

062.name: Dratini
062.evolves: Evolves into Dragonair , Dark Dragonair , or Light Dragonair
062.attacksText: {C} → Gentle Wrap : 10 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C} → Ram : 20
062.flavorText: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

063.name: Gastly
063.evolves: Evolves into Haunter or Dark Haunter
063.attacksText: {P} → Sneaky Placement Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
063.flavorText: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

064.name: Illumise
064.attacksText: {C} → Sweet Scent Remove 3 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon. {G} → Vulcan Beat : 30× Flip a coin for each Volbeat you have in play. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
064.flavorText: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.

065.name: Kricketot
065.attacksText: {G}{C} → Beat : 30
065.flavorText: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

066.name: Lickitung
066.attacksText: {C} → Beat : 10 {C}{C}{C} → Tongue Whip Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
066.flavorText: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.

067.name: Machop
067.evolves: Evolves into Machoke , Dark Machoke , or Light Machoke
067.attacksText: {F} → Steady Punch : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage. {F}{F}{F} → Mach Cross : 50
067.flavorText: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

068.name: Magnemite
068.evolves: Evolves into Magneton or Dark Magneton
068.attacksText: {C} → Magnetic Switch Switch Magnemite with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {L}{C} → Thundershock : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
068.flavorText: The units at the sides of its body generate antigravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.

069.name: Nidoran Female
069.attacksText: {C} → Friend Search Look at the top 5 cards of your deck, choose 1 Pokémon you find there, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. {P}{C} → Double Kick : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
069.flavorText: Although not very combative, it will torment its foes with poison spikes if it is threatened in any way.

070.name: Nidoran Male
070.evolves: Evolves into Nidorino
070.attacksText: {C} → Pheromone Poison : 10 If Nidoran Female is on your Bench, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. {C}{C} → Horn Attack : 20
070.flavorText: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. It will strike first if it senses any danger.

071.name: Pidgey
071.attacksText: {C} → Messenger Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle Pidgey and all cards attached to it back into your deck. {C} → Glide : 10
071.flavorText: Common in grassy areas and forests, it is very docile and will chase off enemies by flapping up sand.

072.name: Ponyta
072.evolves: Evolves into Rapidash or Dark Rapidash
072.attacksText: {C} → Rear Kick : 10 {R}{C} → Flare : 20
072.flavorText: It is a weak runner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.

073.name: Porygon
073.evolves: Evolves into Porygon2 or Dark Porygon2
073.attacksText: {C} → Sharpen : 10 {C}{C} → Recover Discard an Energy attached to Porygon and remove 4 damage counters from Porygon.
073.flavorText: A manmade Pokémon that came about as a result of research. It is programmed with only basic motions.

074.name: Psyduck
074.evolves: Evolves into Golduck , Dark Golduck , or Light Golduck
074.attacksText: {W} → Tripping Headbutt Filp a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, this attack does 30 damage to 1 of your Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
074.flavorText: It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

075.name: Shuppet
075.evolves: Evolves into Banette , Banette- GX , or Banette ex
075.attacksText: {C} → Disable Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn. {P} → Haunt Put 1 damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.
075.flavorText: It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice, or so it's said. It's very active at night.

076.name: Skorupi
076.attacksText: {C}{C} → Paralyzing Clamp : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
076.flavorText: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

077.name: Spoink
077.attacksText: {P} → Sleep Pearl The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. Switch Spoink with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
077.flavorText: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

078.name: Swablu
078.evolves: Evolves into Altaria , Altaria ex , or Altaria- GX
078.attacksText: {C} → Wing Flick : 10 Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.
078.flavorText: Its wings bring cottony clouds to mind. It grooms with springwater and loves to sit on heads.

079.name: Swinub
079.evolves: Evolves into Piloswine or Light Piloswine
079.attacksText: {W} → Headbutt : 10 {C}{C} → Ice Ball : 20
079.flavorText: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

080.name: Tentacool
080.attacksText: {W} → Gentle Wrap : 10 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
080.flavorText: It drifts aimlessly in waves. Very difficult to see in water, it may not be noticed until it stings.

081.name: Venonat
081.evolves: Evolves into Venomoth , Venomoth- GX , or Light Venomoth
081.attacksText: {G} → Leech Life : 10 Remove from Venonat the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon. {C}{C} → Tackle : 20
081.flavorText: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches and eats small bugs at night that are attracted by light.

082.name: Volbeat
082.attacksText: {G} → Illumisile If you don't have Illumise in play, this attack does nothing. Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {G}{C}{C} → Firefly Light : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.
082.flavorText: It emits light from its tail to communicate. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

083.name: Voltorb
083.evolves: Evolves into Electrode , Electrode- GX , Dark Electrode , or Electrode ex
083.attacksText: {L} → Magnetic Bomb : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, Voltorb does 10 damage to itself.
083.flavorText: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

084.name: Yanma
084.evolves: Evolves into Yanmega or Yanmega ex
084.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Free Flight If Yanma has no Energy attached to it, Yanma's Retreat Cost is 0. {G}{C} → Dive : 20
084.flavorText: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.

085.name: Black Belt
085.attacksText: You may use this card only if you have more Prize cards left than your opponent. During this turn, each of your Active Pokémon's attacks does 40 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

086.name: Indigo Plateau
086.attacksText: Each Pokémon LEGEND in play (both yours and your opponent's) gets +30 HP. · Stadium rule: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

087.name: Junk Arm
087.attacksText: Discard 2 cards from your hand. Search your discard pile for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. You can't choose Junk Arm with the effect of this card.

088.name: Seeker
088.attacksText: Each player returns 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to it to his or her hand. (You return your Pokémon first.) · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

089.name: Twins
089.attacksText: You may use this card only if you have more Prize cards left than your opponent. Search your deck for any 2 cards and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

090.name: Rescue Energy
090.attacksText: Rescue Energy provides {C} Energy. If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack, put that Pokémon back into your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that Pokémon.)

091.name: Absol
091.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Eye of Disaster As long as Absol is your Active Pokémon, whenever your opponent puts a Basic Pokémon from his or her hand onto his or her Bench, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. {D}{C} → Vicious Claw : 70 Choose 1 Pokémon from your hand and put it in the Lost Zone. (If you can't put a Pokémon in the Lost Zone, this attack does nothing.)

092.name: Celebi
092.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Forest Breath Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Celebi is your Active Pokémon, you may attach a {G} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Celebi is affected by a Special Condition. {G}{P}{C} → Time Circle : 30 During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to Celebi by attacks from your opponent's Stage 1 or Stage 2 Pokémon.

093.name: Electrode
