061.attacksText: {C} → Slam : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
061.flavorText: This intelligent Pokémon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.

062.name: Pineco
062.evolves: Evolves into Forretress , Forretress ex , or Dark Forretress
062.attacksText: {C} → Rollout : 10
062.flavorText: It hangs and waits for flying insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.

063.name: Pineco
063.evolves: Evolves into Forretress , Forretress ex , or Dark Forretress
063.attacksText: {C} → Focus Energy During your next turn, Pineco's Surprise Attack attack's base damage is 80. {G}{C} → Surprise Attack : 40 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
063.flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

064.name: Rattata
064.evolves: Evolves into Raticate or Dark Raticate
064.attacksText: {C} → Gnaw : 20
064.flavorText: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.

065.name: Scyther
065.evolves: Evolves into Scizor , Scizor- GX , […] Kleavor , Scizor ex
065.attacksText: {C}{C} → Cut : 20 {G}{C}{C} → Slashing Strike : 50 During your next turn, Scyther can't use Slashing Strike.
065.flavorText: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

066.name: Slowpoke
066.evolves: Evolves into Slowking , Slowbro , […] Dark Slowbro , Dark Slowking , Slowking ex
066.attacksText: {C} → Rambunctious Party Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Choose as many Basic Pokémon as you like and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. {W}{C} → Rain Splash : 20
066.flavorText: A sweet sap leaks from its tail's tip. Although not nutritious, the tail is pleasant to chew on.

067.name: Slugma
067.evolves: Evolves into Magcargo , Magcargo ex , Magcargo- GX , or Dark Magcargo
067.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Active Volcano Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may discard the top card of your deck. If that card is a {R} Energy card, attach it to Slugma. This power can't be used if Slugma is affected by a Special Condition. {R}{R}{C} → Combustion : 40
067.flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

068.name: Sneasel
068.evolves: Evolves into Weavile or Weavile- GX
068.attacksText: {C} → Fury Swipes : 10× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads. {D}{D} → Beat Up : 20× Flip a coin for each of your Pokémon in play. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
068.flavorText: Vicious in nature, it drives Pidgey from their nests and scavenges any leftovers it can find.

069.name: Stunky
069.attacksText: {C} → Double Scratch : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
069.flavorText: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

070.name: Togepi
070.evolves: Evolves into Togetic or Light Togetic
070.attacksText: {C} → Plead Ask your opponent if you may draw 2 cards. If yes, draw 2 cards. If no, this attack does 20 damage to the Defending Pokémon.
070.flavorText: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

071.name: Burned Tower
071.attacksText: Once during each player's turn, that player may flip a coin. If heads, the player searches his or her discard pile for a basic Energy card, shows it to his or her opponent, and put it into his or her hand. · Stadium rule: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

072.name: Defender
072.attacksText: Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of your opponent's next turn. Any damage done to the Pokémon Defender is attached to by an opponent's attack is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .

073.name: Energy Exchanger
073.attacksText: Choose an Energy card from your hand, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck. Search your deck for an Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

074.name: Flower Shop Lady
074.attacksText: Search your discard pile for 3 Pokémon and 3 basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

075.name: Legend Box
075.attacksText: Reveal the top 10 cards of your deck. If you reveal both halves of a Pokémon LEGEND, put those cards onto your Bench and attach all revealed Energy cards to that Pokémon LEGEND. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. (You can play only 1 Pokémon LEGEND in this way.)

076.name: Ruins of Alph
076.attacksText: Each Pokémon in play has no Resistance. · Stadium rule: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

077.name: Sage's Training
077.attacksText: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Choose any 2 cards you find there and put them into your hand. Discard the other cards. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

078.name: Team Rocket's Trickery
078.attacksText: Draw 2 cards. Then, your opponent discards a card from his or her hand. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

079.name: Darkness Energy
079.attacksText: If the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Darkness Energy is attached to isn't {D}. Darkness Energy provides {D} Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

080.name: Metal Energy
080.attacksText: Damage done by attacks to the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to isn't {M} Metal Energy provides {M} Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

081.name: Espeon
081.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Evolution Memories Espeon can use the attacks of all Pokémon you have in play that evolve from Eevee as its own. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.) {P}{C} → Solar Ray : 30 Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon.

082.name: Houndoom
082.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Fire Breath Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned. This power can't be used if Houndoom is affected by a Special Condition. {D}{D}{C} → Dark Clamp : 70 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

083.name: Raichu
083.evolves: Evolves from Pikachu and into Raichu BREAK or Raichu LV. X
083.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Voltage Increase As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may move a {L} Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to Raichu. This power can't be used if Raichu is affected by a Special Condition. {L}{L}{C} → Mega Thunderbolt : 120 Discard all Energy attached to Raichu.

084.name: Scizor
084.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Red Armor Prevent all damage done to Scizor by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have any Special Energy cards attached to them. {M}{C} → Metal Scissors : 30+ Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each {M} Energy attached to Scizor.

085.name: Slowking
085.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Opponent's Choice Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may reveal the top 2 cards of your deck and your opponent chooses 1 of them. Put that card into your hand and the other card on the bottom of your deck. This power can't be used if Slowking is affected by a Special Condition. {P}{C}{C} → Super Psy Bolt : 60

086.name: Umbreon
086.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Cloud-Covered Moon Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Umbreon is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, return Umbreon and all cards attached to it to your hand. This power can't be used if Umbreon is affected by a Special Condition. {D}{C}{C} → Evoblast : 50+ Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each of your Pokémon in play that evolves from Eevee.

087.name: Kyogre & Groudon LEGEND
087.attacksText: {W}{W}{C}{C} → Mega Tidal Wave Discard the top 5 cards from your opponent's deck. This attack does 30 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{F}{C}{C} → Massive Eruption : 100× Discard the top 5 cards from your deck. This attack does 100 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded. · LEGEND rule: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Kyogre & Groudon LEGEND.

088.name: Kyogre & Groudon LEGEND
088.attacksText: {W}{W}{C}{C} → Mega Tidal Wave Discard the top 5 cards from your opponent's deck. This attack does 30 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{F}{C}{C} → Massive Eruption : 100× Discard the top 5 cards from your deck. This attack does 100 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded. · LEGEND rule: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Kyogre & Groudon LEGEND.

089.name: Rayquaza & Deoxys LEGEND
089.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Space Virus If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack of Rayquaza & Deoxys LEGEND, take 1 more Prize card. {R}{R}{L}{C} → Ozone Buster : 150 Discard all {R} Energy attached to Rayquaza & Deoxys LEGEND. · LEGEND rule: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Rayquaza & Deoxys LEGEND.

090.name: Rayquaza & Deoxys LEGEND
090.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Space Virus If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack of Rayquaza & Deoxys LEGEND, take 1 more Prize card. {R}{R}{L}{C} → Ozone Buster : 150 Discard all {R} Energy attached to Rayquaza & Deoxys LEGEND. · LEGEND rule: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Rayquaza & Deoxys LEGEND.

THREE.name: Alph Lithograph
THREE.attacksText: RETURN ANY STADIUM CARD IN PLAY TO ITS PLAYERS HAND!

001.name: Jirachi
001.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Stardust Song Once during your turn, when you put Jirachi from your hand onto your Bench, you may flip 3 coins. For each heads, search your discard pile for a {P} Energy card and attach it to Jirachi. {P} → Time Hollow Choose a number of your opponent's Stage 1 or Stage 2 Evolved Pokémon up to the amount of Energy attached to Jirachi. Remove the highest Stage Evolution card from each of those Pokémon and put those cards back into your opponent's hand.
001.flavorText: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

002.name: Magmortar
002.evolves: Evolves from Magmar and into Magmortar LV. X
002.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Hard Crush : 50× Discard the top 3 cards from your deck. This attack does 50 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded. {R}{R}{C}{C} → Mantle Bazooka : 100 Discard 2 {R} Energy attached to Magmortar.
002.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

003.name: Manaphy
003.attacksText: {C} → Deep Sea Swirl Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 5 cards. {W} → Wave Splash : 20
003.flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

004.name: Metagross
004.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Psychic Float If you have any {P} Energy attached to your Active Pokémon, the Retreat Cost for that Pokémon is 0. {C}{C} → Pulse Blast : 60 {P}{P}{P} → Double Leg Hammer Choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

005.name: Mismagius
005.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Magical Trans Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may move a {P} Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Mismagius is affected by a Special Condition. {P} → Psychic Pulse : 30 Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
005.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

006.name: Octillery
006.attacksText: {W} → Switch Cannon Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Switch Octillery with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {W}{C}{C} → Ink Bomb : 50 If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.
006.flavorText: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

007.name: Politoed
007.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Leap Frog Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may choose a {W} Pokémon on your Bench and switch it with your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Politoed is affected by a Special Condition. {W}{C}{C} → Big Chorus : 30× Flip a coin for each {W} Pokémon you have in play. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
007.flavorText: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

008.name: Shaymin
008.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Celebration Wind Once during your turn, when you put Shaymin from your hand onto your Bench, you may move as many Energy cards attached to your Pokémon as you like to any of your other Pokémon. {G}{C} → Energy Bloom : 30 Remove 3 damage counters from each of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached to it.
008.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

009.name: Sudowoodo
009.attacksText: {F} → Push Over : 20× Does 20 damage times the amount of {F} Energy attached to Sudowoodo. {C}{C}{C} → Rumble : 40 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
009.flavorText: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

010.name: Torterra
010.evolves: Evolves from Grotle and into Torterra LV. X
010.attacksText: {G}{C}{C} → Giga Drain : 40 Remove from Torterra the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon. {G}{C}{C}{C} → Land Crush : 80
010.flavorText: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

011.name: Xatu
011.attacksText: {P} → Psywave : 20× Does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. {P}{C}{C} → Confuse Ray : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
011.flavorText: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

012.name: Beedrill
012.attacksText: {G} → Twineedle : 50× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads. {G}{C} → Paralyze Poison : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is also Paralyzed.
012.flavorText: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.

013.name: Blastoise
013.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Wash Out As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may move a {W} Energy attached to 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Blastoise is affected by a Special Condition. {W}{W}{C}{C} → Hydro Launcher Return 2 {W} Energy attached to Blastoise to your hand. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 100 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
013.flavorText: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

014.name: Crobat
014.evolves: Evolves from Golbat and into Crobat BREAK
014.attacksText: {P} → Supersonic : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Confused. {P}{C}{C} → Hurricane Wing : 30× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
014.flavorText: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

015.name: Fearow
015.attacksText: {C}{C} → Wing Attack : 30 {C}{C}{C} → Repeating Drill : 20× Flip 5 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
015.flavorText: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.

016.name: Floatzel
016.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Water Acceleration Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may attach a {W} Energy card from your hand to Floatzel. This power can't be used if Floatzel is affected by a Special Condition. {W}{W}{C} → Waterfall : 60
016.flavorText: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

017.name: Kingdra
017.attacksText: {W} → Water Arrow Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{C}{C} → Stream Pump : 50+ You may do 50 damage plus 30 more damage. If you do, return an Energy card attached to Kingdra to your hand.
017.flavorText: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

018.name: Lanturn
018.attacksText: {L} → Confuse Ray : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. {L}{C}{C} → Reflect Energy : 60 Move an Energy card attached to Lanturn to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
018.flavorText: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

019.name: Lucario
019.evolves: Evolves from Riolu and into Lucario LV. X
019.attacksText: {C} → Bulk Up : 30 During your next turn, each of Lucario's attacks does 30 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{F} → Magnum Punch : 50
019.flavorText: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras, even foes it could not otherwise see.

020.name: Ninetales
020.evolves: Evolves from Vulpix and into Ninetales BREAK
020.attacksText: {R} → Heat Acceleration Search your discard pile for up to 3 {R} Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. {R}{C} → Searing Flame : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.
020.flavorText: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

021.name: Poliwrath
021.attacksText: {W}{C} → Steamroll : 40 Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{C}{C} → Dynamic Punch : 60+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 damage plus 40 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
021.flavorText: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.

022.name: Primeape
022.evolves: Evolves from Mankey and into Annihilape or Annihilape ex
022.attacksText: {C}{C} → Low Kick : 30 {F}{F} → Bebop Punch Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
022.flavorText: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

023.name: Roserade
023.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Energy Signal When you attach a {G} Energy card or {P} Energy card from your hand to Roserade during your turn, you may use this power. If you attach a {G} Energy card, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If you attach a {P} Energy card, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. This power can't be used if Roserade is affected by a Special Condition. {G}{C} → Power Blow : 20× Does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to Roserade.
023.flavorText: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.

024.name: Steelix
024.attacksText: {M}{C}{C} → Guard Press : 40 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Steelix by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M}{M}{C}{C} → Steel Swing : 80× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage times the number of heads.
024.flavorText: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

025.name: Torkoal
025.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Hot Snort Once during your turn, when you put Torkoal from your hand onto your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{C} → Flare : 30
025.flavorText: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

026.name: Tyranitar
026.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Tail Crush : 40+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage. {D}{D}{C}{C} → Hyper Beam : 80 Discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.
026.flavorText: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It has an insolent nature that makes it not care about others.

027.name: Ursaring
027.evolves: Evolves from Teddiursa and into Ursaluna
027.attacksText: {C} → Confront : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Cross Chop : 50+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.
027.flavorText: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailing finds all food buried deep underground.

028.name: Cherrim
028.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Sunny Heal Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may remove 1 damage counter from your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Cherrim is affected by a Special Condition. {G} → Seed Bomb : 30
028.flavorText: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

029.name: Dunsparce
029.evolves: Evolves into Dudunsparce or Dudunsparce ex
029.attacksText: {C} → Return : 10 Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.
029.flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

030.name: Golbat
030.evolves: Evolves from Zubat and into Crobat or Crobat ex
030.attacksText: {P} → Mean Look : 20 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
030.flavorText: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

031.name: Grotle
031.evolves: Evolves from Turtwig and into Torterra or Torterra ex
031.attacksText: {G}{C} → Razor Leaf : 30 {G}{C}{C} → Sleep Powder : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
031.flavorText: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

032.name: Kakuna
032.evolves: Evolves from Weedle and into Beedrill
032.attacksText: {C} → Speed Evolution Search your deck for a card that evolves from Kakuna and put it onto Kakuna. (This counts as evolving Kakuna.) Shuffle your deck afterward. {G} → Poison Sting The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
032.flavorText: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

033.name: Metang
033.evolves: Evolves from Beldum and into Metagross , Metagross- GX , or Metagross ex
033.attacksText: {P} → Energy Crane Search your discard pile for up to 2 {P} Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. {P}{C}{C} → Psypunch : 50
033.flavorText: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

034.name: Minun
034.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. {L} → Tag Team Boost : 10+ If Plusle is on your Bench, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.
034.flavorText: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

035.name: Numel
035.evolves: Evolves into Camerupt , Mega Camerupt ex , or Camerupt ex
035.attacksText: {C} → Flare Bonus Discard a {R} Energy card from your hand. Then, draw 3 cards. {R}{R}{C} → Combustion : 40
035.flavorText: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.

036.name: Plusle
036.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw 2 cards. {L} → Thunder Jolt : 20 Flip a coin. If tails, Plusle does 10 damage to itself.
036.flavorText: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

037.name: Poliwhirl
037.evolves: Evolves from Poliwag and into Poliwrath , Politoed , or Politoed ex
037.attacksText: {W} → Hypnoblast : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C} → Light Punch : 30
037.flavorText: The skin on most of its body is moist. However, the skin on its belly spiral feels smooth.

038.name: Pupitar
038.evolves: Evolves from Larvitar and into Tyranitar , Tyranitar ex , or Tyranitar- GX
038.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Boost Gas If Pupitar has any Energy attached to it, the Retreat Cost of Pupitar is 0. {C}{C} → Rage : 20+ Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Pupitar.
038.flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

039.name: Pupitar
039.evolves: Evolves from Larvitar and into Tyranitar , Tyranitar ex , or Tyranitar- GX
039.attacksText: {F}{C} → Hammer In : 30 {F}{C}{C} → Speed Attack : 50
039.flavorText: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

040.name: Seadra
040.evolves: Evolves from Horsea and into Kingdra , Kingdra ex , or Kingdra- GX
040.attacksText: {W} → Muddy Water : 20 Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{C}{C} → Razor Fin : 50
040.flavorText: Its fin tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.

041.name: Tauros
041.attacksText: {C}{C} → Smash Kick : 20 {C}{C} → Crimson Bull : 30× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. Tauros is now Confused.
041.flavorText: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.

042.name: Wartortle
042.evolves: Evolves from Squirtle and into Blastoise , Blastoise ex , or Blastoise- GX
042.attacksText: {W} → Water Arrow Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{C}{C} → Surf : 50
042.flavorText: It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

043.name: Aipom
043.attacksText: {C} → Tail Code Move an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon. {C}{C} → Tail Smash : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
043.flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

044.name: Beldum

015.name: Ariados
015.attacksText: {G}{C} → Leech Life : 30 Remove from Ariados the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon. {G}{C}{C} → Poisonous Saliva : 50 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
015.flavorText: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It's hard to tell which end is which.

016.name: Butterfree
016.attacksText: {G} → Cure Powder Remove 3 damage counters from each of your Pokémon. {G}{C}{C} → Whirlwind : 60 Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.
016.flavorText: Water-repellent powder on its wings enables it to collect honey, even in the heaviest of rains.

017.name: Cleffa
017.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Sweet Sleeping Face As long as Cleffa is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Cleffa by attacks. {@} → Eeeeeeek Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 6 cards. Cleffa is now Asleep.
017.flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

018.name: Exeggutor
018.attacksText: {C} → Energy Absorption Search your discard pile for up to 2 Energy cards and attach them to Exeggutor. {P} → Big Eggsplosion : 40× Flip a coin for each Energy attached to Exeggutor. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.
018.flavorText: If a head drops off, it emits a telepathic call in search of others to form an Exeggcute cluster.

019.name: Farfetch'd
019.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw 2 cards. {C} → Spin Turn : 20 Switch Farfetch'd with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
019.flavorText: If it eats the plant stalk it carries as emergency rations, it runs off in search of a new stalk.

020.name: Feraligatr
020.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Spinning Tail This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{W}{C}{C} → Surf : 80
020.flavorText: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

021.name: Furret
021.attacksText: {C} → Find a Friend Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C} → Quick Blow : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage.
021.flavorText: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

022.name: Granbull
022.attacksText: {C}{C} → Timid Tackle : 50 Granbull does 20 damage to itself. Switch Granbull with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Chomp : 40+ Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Granbull.
022.flavorText: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its bite is powerful.

023.name: Hypno
023.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Sleep Pendulum Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. This power can't be used if Hypno is affected by a Special Condition. {P}{C}{C} → Psychic Shot : 30 Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
023.flavorText: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

024.name: Lapras
024.attacksText: {C}{C} → Ice Beam : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{W} → Ice Blade Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
024.flavorText: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

025.name: Ledian
025.attacksText: {G} → Quick Draw : 10 Draw 3 cards. {C}{C} → Swift : 40 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.
025.flavorText: The spot patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

026.name: Meganium
026.attacksText: {G} → Sleep Powder : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {G}{C}{C} → Giant Bloom : 60 Remove 2 damage counters from Meganium.
026.flavorText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

027.name: Persian
027.attacksText: {C} → Sharpen Claws Flip 3 coins. For each heads, discard a card from your opponent's hand without looking. {C}{C} → Sneaky Attack : 30+ If Persian has any {D} Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.
027.flavorText: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

028.name: Pichu
028.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Sweet Sleeping Face As long as Pichu is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Pichu by attacks. {@} → Playground Each player may search his or her deck for as many Basic Pokémon as he or she likes, put them onto his or her Bench, and shuffle his or her deck afterward. (You put your Pokémon on the Bench first.) Pichu is now Asleep.
028.flavorText: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

029.name: Sandslash
029.attacksText: {F}{C} → Poison Sting : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. {F}{C}{C} → Fury Swipes : 30× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
029.flavorText: If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spike and claws. They grow back in a day.

030.name: Smoochum
030.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Sweet Sleeping Face As long as Smoochum is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Smoochum by attacks. {@} → Energy Antics Move an Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon. Smoochum is now Asleep.
030.flavorText: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

031.name: Sunflora
031.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Sunshine Grace Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may search your deck for a {G} Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Sunflora is affected by a Special Condition. {G}{G}{C} → Blade Arms : 40
031.flavorText: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

032.name: Typhlosion
032.attacksText: {R}{C} → Magma Punch : 50 {R}{R}{C} → Fire Spin : 120 Discard 2 Energy attached to Typhlosion.
032.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

033.name: Tyrogue
033.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Sweet Sleeping Face As long as Tyrogue is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Tyrogue by attacks. {@} → Mischievous Punch : 30 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. Tyrogue is now Asleep.
033.flavorText: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

034.name: Weezing
034.attacksText: {P} → Super Poison Breath The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. {C}{C} → Super Explosion : 90 Weezing does 90 damage to itself, and don't apply Weakness to this damage.
034.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

035.name: Bayleef
035.evolves: Evolves from Chikorita and into Meganium , Mega Meganium ex , or Meganium ex
035.attacksText: {C} → Hammer In : 20 {G}{C}{C} → Razor Leaf : 50
035.flavorText: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

036.name: Blissey
036.attacksText: {C} → Energy Link : 10 Search your discard pile for an Energy card and attach it to Blissey. {C}{C}{C} → Double-edge : 80 Blissey does 40 damage to itself.
036.flavorText: Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

037.name: Corsola
037.attacksText: {W} → Recover Discard a {W} Energy attached to Corsola and remove all damage counters from Corsola. {W}{C} → Hyper Cannon : 20+ Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 50 more damage.
037.flavorText: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

038.name: Croconaw
038.evolves: Evolves from Totodile and into Feraligatr , Mega Feraligatr ex , or Feraligatr ex
038.attacksText: {W}{C} → Wave Splash : 30 {W}{C}{C} → Big Bite : 50 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
038.flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

039.name: Delibird
039.attacksText: {W} → Snowy Present Draw a card for each {W} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon. {W}{C} → Hail This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
039.flavorText: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

040.name: Donphan
040.attacksText: {F}{C}{C} → Rock Hurl : 50 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance. {F}{F}{C}{C} → Double Spin : 70× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage times the number of heads.
040.flavorText: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

041.name: Dunsparce
041.evolves: Evolves into Dudunsparce or Dudunsparce ex
041.attacksText: {C} → Glare Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {C} → Fade Out : 20 Return Dunsparce and all cards attached to it to your hand.
041.flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

042.name: Flaaffy
042.evolves: Evolves from Mareep and into Ampharos , Ampharos- GX , or Ampharos ex
042.attacksText: {L} → Thunder Spear Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {L}{C}{C} → Thundershock : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
042.flavorText: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

043.name: Heracross
043.attacksText: {G}{C} → Green Draw Draw a card for each of your {G} Pokémon in play. {G}{C}{C} → Double Headbutt : 30+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.
043.flavorText: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

044.name: Igglybuff
044.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Sweet Sleeping Face As long as Igglybuff is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Igglybuff by attacks. {@} → Graffiti Igglybuff is now Asleep. During your opponent's next turn, the attack cost of each of the Defending Pokémon's attacks is {C} more.
044.flavorText: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously—anytime, anywhere.

045.name: Mantine
045.attacksText: {W} → Group Swim Search your deck for a {W} Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {W}{W} → Aqua Slash : 40 Mantine can't attack during your next turn.
045.flavorText: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if Remoraid attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

046.name: Metapod
046.evolves: Evolves from Caterpie and into Butterfree
046.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Green Shield Each of your {G} Pokémon has no Weakness. {C}{C} → Sharpen : 20
046.flavorText: It prepares for evolution by hardening its shell as much as possible to protect its soft body.

047.name: Miltank
047.attacksText: {C} → Moomoo Squeeze Search your deck for a Moomoo Milk card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C}{C} → Body Slam : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
047.flavorText: If it is around babies, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

048.name: Parasect
048.attacksText: {G} → Sleep Drain The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. Remove 4 damage counters from Parasect. {G}{G}{C} → Slash : 60
048.flavorText: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

049.name: Quilava
049.evolves: Evolves from and into Typhlosion , Typhlosion ex , or Hisuian Typhlosion
049.attacksText: {R}{C} → Flare : 30 {R}{C}{C} → Flamethrower : 60 Discard an Energy attached to Quilava.
049.flavorText: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

050.name: Qwilfish
050.attacksText: {W}{W} → Offensive Needle : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
050.flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

051.name: Skiploom
051.evolves: Evolves from Hoppip and into Jumpluff
051.attacksText: {G} → Knock Away : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.
051.flavorText: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

052.name: Slowbro
052.attacksText: {W} → Big Yawn : 30 Both Slowbro and the Defending Pokémon are now Asleep. {C}{C}{C} → Madkinesis : 30+ Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each {P} Energy attached to Slowbro.
052.flavorText: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

053.name: Starmie
053.evolves: Evolves from Staryu and into Starmie BREAK
053.attacksText: {W} → Cosmic Cyclone : 20× Choose as many {W} Energy attached to your Pokémon as you like. This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Energy you chose. Shuffle those cards back into your deck.
053.flavorText: The middle section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

054.name: Unown
054.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ RETURN Once during your turn, when you put Unown from your hand onto your Bench, you may return all Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to your hand. {P} → Hidden Power : 10
054.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

055.name: Unown
055.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ FLASH Once during your turn, when you put Unown from your hand onto your Bench, you may look at the top 5 cards of your deck and put them back on top of your deck in any order. {P} → Hidden Power : 10
055.flavorText: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

056.name: Wigglytuff
056.attacksText: {C}{C} → Double Slap : 40× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads. {C}{C}{C} → Expand : 50 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Wigglytuff by attacks is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
056.flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a Body Slam.

057.name: Caterpie
057.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 20
057.flavorText: Its feet have suction cups designed to stick to any surface. It tenaciously climbs trees to forage.

058.name: Chansey
058.evolves: Evolves into Blissey or Blissey ex
058.attacksText: {C}{C} → Pound : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Happy Punch : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, remove 3 damage counters from Chansey.
058.flavorText: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

059.name: Chikorita
059.attacksText: {G} → Tackle : 10 {G}{C} → Razor Leaf : 20
059.flavorText: Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

060.name: Clefairy
060.evolves: Evolves into Clefable , Mega Clefable ex , or Clefable ex
060.attacksText: {C} → Minimize During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Clefairy by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C} → Slap : 10
060.flavorText: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

061.name: Cyndaquil
061.evolves: Evolves into Quilava or Dark Quilava
061.attacksText: {R} → Beat : 10 {R}{C} → Flare : 20
061.flavorText: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

062.name: Drowzee
062.evolves: Evolves into Hypno or Dark Hypno
062.attacksText: {P} → Sleep Inducer Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C} → Gentle Slap : 20
062.flavorText: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.

063.name: Exeggcute
063.evolves: Evolves into Exeggutor , Alolan Exeggutor , […] Alolan Exeggutor ex , Alolan Exeggutor- GX
063.attacksText: {C} → Continuous Eggsplosion : 10× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
063.flavorText: Using telepathy only they can employ, they always form a cluster of six Exeggcute.

064.name: Girafarig
064.evolves: Evolves into Farigiraf or Farigiraf ex
064.attacksText: {C} → Show Off Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C} → Psyshot : 20
064.flavorText: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

065.name: Growlithe
065.evolves: Evolves into Arcanine , Arcanine ex , or Light Arcanine
065.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 10 {R}{C}{C} → Combustion : 40
065.flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

066.name: Hoothoot
066.attacksText: {C} → Hypnosis The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C} → Tackle : 20
066.flavorText: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

067.name: Hoppip
067.attacksText: {G} → Bounce : 10 You may switch Hoppip with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
067.flavorText: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. But they do enjoy gentle breezes.

068.name: Jigglypuff
068.evolves: Evolves into Wigglytuff , Wigglytuff ex , […] Dark Wigglytuff , Light Wigglytuff
068.attacksText: {C}{C} → Hypnoblast : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
068.flavorText: Looking into its cute, round eyes causes it to sing a relaxing melody, inducing its enemies to sleep.

069.name: Jynx
069.attacksText: {C} → Mimic Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw a number of cards equal to the number of cards in your opponent's hand. {P}{C} → Lick : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
069.flavorText: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

070.name: Koffing
070.evolves: Evolves into Weezing , Galarian Weezing , or Dark Weezing
070.attacksText: {C} → Smokescreen : 10 If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. {C}{C} → Suffocating Gas : 20
070.flavorText: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.

071.name: Ledyba
071.evolves: Evolves into Ledian or Light Ledian
071.attacksText: {G} → Ram : 10 {C}{C} → Comet Punch : 10× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
071.flavorText: When the weather turns cold, lots of Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

072.name: Magikarp
072.evolves: Evolves into Gyarados , Gyarados- GX , Dark Gyarados , or Gyarados ex
072.attacksText: {C} → Splash : 10
072.flavorText: For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like Pidgeotto to catch it mid-jump.

073.name: Mareep
073.evolves: Evolves into Flaaffy or Dark Flaaffy
073.attacksText: {C} → Static Electricity Search your deck for a number of {L} Energy cards up to the number of Mareep in play (both yours and your opponent's) and attach them to Mareep. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C} → Ram : 20
073.flavorText: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

074.name: Marill
074.evolves: Evolves into Azumarill , Azumarill ex , or Light Azumarill
074.attacksText: {W} → Water Splash : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage. {W}{C}{C} → Tail Slap : 30
074.flavorText: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

075.name: Meowth
075.evolves: Evolves into Persian , Dark Persian , or Persian- GX
075.attacksText: {C} → Pay Day : 10 Draw a card. {C}{C} → Dig Claws : 20
075.flavorText: It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and secretly hoards.

076.name: Paras
076.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 10 {G}{C} → Double-edge Claw : 30 Paras does 10 damage to itself.
076.flavorText: As its body grows, large mushrooms named tochukaso start sprouting out of its back.

077.name: Phanpy
077.evolves: Evolves into Donphan or Dark Donphan
077.attacksText: {C} → Flail : 10× Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Phanpy.
077.flavorText: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

078.name: Pikachu
078.evolves: Evolves into Raichu , Alolan Raichu , […] Raichu- GX , Raichu ex
078.attacksText: {C} → Tail Slap : 10 {L}{C} → Quick Attack : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.
078.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

079.name: Sandshrew
079.evolves: Evolves into Sandslash or Dark Sandslash
079.attacksText: {C} → Defense Curl Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Sandshrew by attacks during your opponent's next turn. {F} → Rollout : 10
079.flavorText: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.

080.name: Sentret
080.attacksText: {C} → Scout Look at your opponent's hand. {C} → Scratch : 10
080.flavorText: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

081.name: Slowpoke
081.evolves: Evolves into Slowking , Slowbro , […] Dark Slowbro , Dark Slowking , Slowking ex
081.attacksText: {C} → Whimsy Tackle : 20 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
081.flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

082.name: Snubbull
082.attacksText: {C} → Roar Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {C}{C} → Sharp Fang : 20
082.flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

083.name: Spinarak
083.evolves: Evolves into Ariados or Dark Ariados
083.attacksText: {C} → Hang Down : 10 {G} → Spider Web The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
083.flavorText: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

084.name: Staryu
084.evolves: Evolves into Starmie , Mega Starmie ex , or Starmie- GX
084.attacksText: {W} → Spinning Attack : 20
084.flavorText: At night, the center of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.

085.name: Sunkern
085.evolves: Evolves into Sunflora or Light Sunflora
085.attacksText: {C} → Cure Kernels Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon. {G}{C} → Seed Bomb : 20
085.flavorText: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.

086.name: Totodile
086.evolves: Evolves into Croconaw or Dark Croconaw
086.attacksText: {W} → Gnaw : 10 {W}{C} → Wave Splash : 20
086.flavorText: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.

087.name: Vulpix
087.evolves: Evolves into Ninetales , Ninetales ex , or Light Ninetales
087.attacksText: {R} → Singe Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{C} → Ember : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, discard a {R} Energy attached to Vulpix.
087.flavorText: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

088.name: Wooper
088.attacksText: {C} → Tail Whip Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn. {W} → Watering : 10
088.flavorText: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

089.name: Bill
089.attacksText: Draw 2 cards. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

090.name: Copycat
090.attacksText: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw a number of cards equal to the number of cards in your opponent's hand. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

091.name: Energy Switch
091.attacksText: Move a basic Energy card attached 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

092.name: Fisherman
092.attacksText: Search your discard pile for 4 basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

093.name: Full Heal
093.attacksText: Remove all Special Conditions from your Active Pokémon.

094.name: Moomoo Milk
094.attacksText: Choose 1 of your Pokémon. Flip 2 coins. For each heads, remove 3 damage counters from that Pokémon.

095.name: Poké Ball
095.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

096.name: Pokégear 3.0
096.attacksText: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. Choose a Supporter card you find there, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

097.name: Pokémon Collector
097.attacksText: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

098.name: Pokémon Communication
098.attacksText: Choose 1 Pokémon in your hand, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

099.name: Pokémon Reversal
