(Ignore this effect if you don't have any Benched Pokémon.) · Level-Up rule: Put this card onto your Active Palkia. Palkia LV. X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

001.name: Blaziken
001.attacksText: {C} → Fire Dance : 30 Search your discard pile for a {R} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. {R}{R}{C} → Flame Kick Discard 2 {R} Energy attached to Blaziken. This attack does 80 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
001.flavorText: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.

002.name: Cresselia
002.attacksText: {C} → Moon Twinkle : 10 If there is any Stadium card in play, remove 2 damage counters from Cresselia. {P}{P}{C} → Lunar Dance : 50 You may discard 2 Energy attached to Cresselia. If you do, remove all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
002.flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

003.name: Darkrai
003.attacksText: {@} → Reach Over Search your deck for an Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {D}{D}{D} → Darkness Pursuit : 50 If the Defending Pokémon is Cresselia, this attack's base damage is 100.
003.flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

004.name: Darkrai
004.attacksText: {C} → Darkness Roar : 10 You may have your opponent switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 or his or her Benched Pokémon. {D}{D}{C} → Sleep Hole : 40+ If the Defending Pokémon is Asleep, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage. If the Defending Pokémon is not Asleep, that Pokémon is now Asleep.
004.flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

005.name: Pachirisu
005.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C} → Smash Short : 10+ If the Defending Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage. Discard that Pokémon Tool card, look at your opponent's hand, and discard any Pokémon Tool cards of the same name you find there.
005.flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

006.name: Porygon-Z
006.evolves: Evolves from Porygon2 and into Porygon-Z LV. X
006.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Conversion Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may discard a basic Energy card from your hand. Porygon-Z is the same type as that Energy Card until the end of your turn. This power can't be used if Porygon-Z is affected by a Special Condition. {C}{C} → Tri Attack : 40× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.
006.flavorText: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.

007.name: Rotom
007.attacksText: {C}{C} → Astonish : 20 Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking. Look at that card you chose, then have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck. {L}{L} → Telebeam : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
007.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

008.name: Sceptile
008.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Wild Growth Each basic {G} Energy card attached to your {G} Pokémon provides {G}{G} Energy instead. You can't use more than 1 Wild Growth Poké-Body each turn. {G}{G}{C}{C} → Leaf Blade : 50+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage.
008.flavorText: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

009.name: Swampert
009.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Wash Out As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may move a {W} or {F} Energy attached to 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Swampert is affected by a Special Condition. {W}{W}{C}{C} → Hammer Arm : 80 Discard the top card from your opponent's deck.
009.flavorText: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

010.name: Tangrowth
010.evolves: Evolves from Tangela and into Tangrowth LV. X
010.attacksText: {G} → Power Whip Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage for each basic Energy card attached to Tangrowth to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {G}{G}{C}{C} → Stick and Absorb : 60 Remove 3 damage counters from Tangrowth. The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
010.flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

011.name: Togekiss
011.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Serene Grace Once during your turn, when you play Togekiss from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may look at the top 10 cards of your deck, choose as many basic Energy cards as you like, and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Put the other cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C}{C} → Air Scroll : 40+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage. If tails, remove 3 damage counters from Togekiss.
011.flavorText: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.

012.name: Altaria
012.attacksText: {C} → Dragonbreath : 40 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {C}{C}{C} → Cotton Cloud : 60 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Altaria by attacks from your opponent's Evolved Pokémon is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
012.flavorText: It looks like a fluffy cloud when it is in flight. It hums with its soprano voice.

013.name: Beedrill
013.attacksText: {G} → Band Attack : 30× Does 30 damage times the number of Beedrill you have in play. {C}{C}{C} → Twineedle : 50× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.
013.flavorText: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

014.name: Butterfree
014.attacksText: {G} → Parallel Drain : 30 After your attack, remove from 1 of your Pokémon the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon. {G}{G}{C} → Dozing Scales : 60 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
014.flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

015.name: Claydol
015.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Cosmic Power Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may choose up to 2 cards from your hand and put them on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you do, draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. This power can't be used if Claydol is affected by a Special Condition. {F}{C} → Spinning Attack : 40
015.flavorText: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

016.name: Dialga
016.attacksText: {M} → Time Bellow : 10 Draw a card. {M}{M}{C} → Flash Cannon : 40 You may return all Energy cards attached to Dialga to your hand. If you do, remove the highest Stage Evolution card from the Defending Pokémon and shuffle that card into your opponent's deck.
016.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

017.name: Exploud
017.attacksText: {C}{C} → Ambient Noise Flip 2 coins. If the first coin is heads, this attack does 50 damage to the Defending Pokémon. If the first coin is tails, this attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If the second coin is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If the second coin is tails, your opponent can't play any Trainer, Supporter, or Stadium cards from his or her hand during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Hyper Voice : 70
017.flavorText: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

018.name: Houndoom
018.attacksText: {D} → Dark Fang : 20 Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it. {R}{C} → Black Fire : 40+ You may discard a {R} or {D} Energy attached to Houndoom. If you discard a {R} Energy, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned. If you discard a {D} Energy, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage.
018.flavorText: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

019.name: Hypno
019.attacksText: {C}{C} → Dream Catcher If the Defending Pokémon is Asleep, move all damage counters from Hypno to the Defending Pokémon. {P}{P}{C} → Hypnoblast : 60 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
019.flavorText: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.

020.name: Kingler
020.attacksText: {C}{C} → Crabhammer : 30 {W}{W}{C} → Scissor Blow : 80 If the Defending Pokémon would be be Knocked Out by this attack, Kingler does 30 damage to itself.
020.flavorText: The larger pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.

021.name: Lapras
021.attacksText: {W} → Carry In Search your deck for a Pokémon Tool Card, a Supporter card, and a basic Energy card, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {W}{C} → Wave Splash : 20
021.flavorText: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

022.name: Latias
022.attacksText: {C} → Miraculous Light : 10 Remove 2 damage counters and all Special Conditions from Latias. {R}{W}{C} → Mist Ball : 80 Discard a {R} Energy and a {W} Energy attached to Latias.
022.flavorText: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

023.name: Latios
023.attacksText: {C} → Energy Draw : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to Latios. Shuffle your deck afterward. {G}{L}{C}{C} → Luster Purge : 120 Discard 3 Energy attached to Latios.
023.flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

024.name: Mawile
024.attacksText: {@} → Pick Out Choose 1 face-down Prize card (yours or your opponent's) and put it face up. If that card is a Supporter card, use the effect of that card as the effect of this attack. (That card remains face up for the rest of the game.) {M}{C} → Jaw Bite : 20 During your next turn, if an attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , that attack does 20 more damage.
024.flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

025.name: Milotic
025.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Marvel Scale Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Milotic by your opponent's Pokémon LV. X . {W}{C}{C} → Twister : 50 Flip 2 coins. If both are tails, this attack does nothing. For each heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.
025.flavorText: When people bicker, it is said to arise from the depths of lakes to becalm violent hearts.

026.name: Palkia
026.attacksText: {W} → Spacial Rend : 10 Search your deck for a Stadium card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If there is any Stadium card in play, discard it. {W}{W}{C} → Transback : 40 You may flip a coin. If heads, discard all Energy attached to Palkia and put the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it on top of your opponent's deck. Your opponent shuffles his or her deck afterward.
026.flavorText: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

027.name: Primeape
027.evolves: Evolves from Mankey and into Annihilape or Annihilape ex
027.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Anger Point If Primeape has any damage counters on it, Primeape's attacks do 40 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {F}{C}{C} → Whump : 50 Primeape is now Confused. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.
027.flavorText: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

028.name: Slowking
028.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Trump Card Once during your turn (before your attack) , if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, search your deck for any 1 card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Slowking is affected by a Special Condition. {P}{C} → Psych Up : 30 During your next turn, Slowking's Psych Up attack's base damage is 60.
028.flavorText: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.

029.name: Unown H
029.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ HEAL Once during your turn (before your attack) , if you have Unown H, Unown E, Unown A, and Unown L on your Bench, you may remove all Special Conditions from 1 of your Active Pokémon. {P} → Hidden Power : 30 Discard a card from your hand. (If you can't discard a card from your hand, this attack does nothing.)
029.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

030.name: Wailord
030.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Sleeping Pulse As long as Wailord remains Asleep between turns, remove 1 damage counter from Wailord. {W}{W}{W}{C} → Sink Deep : 60 If Wailord has any damage counters on it, Wailord is now Asleep.
030.flavorText: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

031.name: Weezing
031.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Toxic Virus At any time between turns, each player puts 1 more damage counter on his or her Poisoned Pokémon. {P}{C} → Offensive Gas : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.
031.flavorText: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.

032.name: Wigglytuff
032.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Good Night Melody Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may use this power. Each Active Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) is now Asleep. This power can't be used if Wigglytuff is affected by a Special Condition. {C}{C} → Ballon Attack : 40+ If Igglybuff is anywhere under Wigglytuff, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage.
032.flavorText: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.

033.name: Arbok
033.attacksText: {P} → Deadly Poison : 10+ If the Defending Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 10 damage plus 40 more damage. If the Defending Pokémon is not Poisoned, that Pokémon is now Poisoned. {C}{C}{C} → Wrap : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
033.flavorText: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.

034.name: Cacturne
034.attacksText: {C}{C} → Pin Missile : 20× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. {D}{C}{C} → Needle Arm : 50+ If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage.
034.flavorText: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

035.name: Combusken
035.evolves: Evolves from Torchic and into Blaziken , Blaziken ex , or Blaziken- GX
035.attacksText: {R} → Bulk Up : 30 During your next turn, each of Combusken's attacks does 30 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {R}{C}{C} → Double Kick : 50× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.
035.flavorText: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

036.name: Delibird
036.attacksText: {@} → Present Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for any 1 card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {W} → Ice Ball : 20
036.flavorText: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.

037.name: Floatzel
037.attacksText: {C}{C} → Agility : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Floatzel during your opponent's next turn. {W}{W}{C} → Aqua Jet : 60 Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
037.flavorText: It floats using its well-developed floatation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

038.name: Gorebyss
038.attacksText: {@} → Sweet Temptation Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to the new Defending Pokémon. {W}{C} → Psychic Snap : 30+ If Gorebyss has any {P} Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
038.flavorText: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.

039.name: Granbull
039.evolves: Evolves from Snubbull
039.attacksText: {C}{C} → Daunt : 30 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C}{C}{C} → Rage : 40+ Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Granbull.
039.flavorText: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.

040.name: Grovyle
040.evolves: Evolves from Treecko and into Sceptile , Sceptile- GX , or Sceptile ex
040.attacksText: {@} → Greenness Search your deck for up to 2 {G} Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {G}{G} → Poison Breath : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
040.flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

041.name: Hariyama
041.evolves: Evolves from Makuhita
041.attacksText: {F}{C} → Palm Strike : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 40 more damage. {F}{F}{C} → Spirited Throw : 50 If Hariyama has fewer remaining HP than the Defending Pokémon, this attack's base damage is 80.
041.flavorText: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

042.name: Huntail
042.attacksText: {@} → Scary Face Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack or retreat during your opponent's next turn. {W}{C} → Threaten and Drop : 30+ If Huntail has any {D} Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage and discard a Special Energy card, if any, attached to the Defending Pokémon.
042.flavorText: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

043.name: Linoone
043.attacksText: {@} → Switcheroo Move a Pokémon Tool card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon (excluding Pokémon that already has a Pokémon Tool attached to it) . (If an effect of this attack is prevented, this attack does nothing.) {C}{C}{C} → Overrun : 30 Does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
043.flavorText: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.

044.name: Loudred
044.evolves: Evolves from Whismur and into Exploud or Exploud ex
044.attacksText: {C}{C} → Bass Control Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {C}{C}{C} → Stomp : 40+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage.
044.flavorText: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

045.name: Magcargo
045.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Magma Armor Magcargo can't be Asleep or Paralyzed. {R}{R}{C} → Lava Plume : 60 You may discard the top card of your deck. If you do, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.
045.flavorText: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.

046.name: Marshtomp
046.evolves: Evolves from Mudkip and into Swampert or Swampert ex
046.attacksText: {C}{C} → Pound : 20 {F}{C}{C} → Muddy Bomb Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon and 10 damage to each of your opponent's other Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
046.flavorText: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.

047.name: Metapod
047.evolves: Evolves from Caterpie and into Butterfree
047.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Emerge Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Metapod is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card that evolves from Metapod and put it onto Metapod. (This counts as evolving Metapod.) Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Metapod is affected by a Special Condition. {G}{C} → Ram : 30
047.flavorText: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

048.name: Pelipper
048.attacksText: {@} → Guzzle Choose up to 2 basic {W} Energy cards from your hand and attach them to Pelipper. Remove 2 damage counters for each Energy card attached in this way. {W}{C}{C} → Jet Return : 30× Does 30 times the number of Energy cards attached to Pelipper. Then, put all Energy cards attached to Pelipper on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.
048.flavorText: It dips its large bill in the sea, then scoops up numerous prey along with water.

049.name: Porygon2
049.evolves: Evolves from Porygon and into Porygon-Z or Porygon-Z- GX
049.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Download Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may discard a Supporter card from your hand and use the effect of that card as the effect of this power. This power can't be used if Porygon2 is affected by a Special Condition. {C}{C} → Speed Attack : 30
049.flavorText: With planetary development software installed, it became capable of working in space.

050.name: Purugly
050.attacksText: {C}{C} → Swagger : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Fury Swipes : 40× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.
050.flavorText: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.

051.name: Relicanth
051.attacksText: {@} → Primal Calling Search your deck for up to 3 Trainer Cards that have Fossil in their names, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C} → Sleep Swirl : 30 Both Relicanth and the Defending Pokémon are now Asleep.
051.flavorText: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

052.name: Seviper
052.attacksText: {P} → Tail Blade : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Trainer cards from his or her hand during your opponent's next turn. {P}{C}{C} → Poison Tail : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
052.flavorText: For many generations, it has feuded with ZANGOOSE. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.

053.name: Skarmory
053.attacksText: {M} → Air Crash : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. {M}{C}{C} → Steel Wing : 40 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Skarmory by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
053.flavorText: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.

054.name: Slowbro
054.attacksText: {C}{C} → Amnesia : 20 Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn. {P}{C}{C} → Zen Headbutt : 60
054.flavorText: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the SHELLDER on its tail bites down.

055.name: Togetic
055.evolves: Evolves from Togepi and into Togekiss
055.attacksText: {C}{C} → Speed Dive : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Sweet Kiss : 50 Your opponent may draw a card.
055.flavorText: It is said to appear in front of kindly people to scatter a glowing down called “joy dust.”

056.name: Unown F
056.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ FAKE Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Unown F is on your Bench, you may use this power. Put a coin next to your Active Pokémon without showing your opponent and cover it with your hand. Your opponent guesses if the coin is heads or tails. If he or she is wrong, draw a card. {P} → Hidden Power : 10 You may flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, this attack's base damage is 30.
056.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

057.name: Unown G
057.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ GUARD Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Unown G is on your Bench, you may discard all cards attached to Unown G and attach Unown G to 1 of your Pokémon as a Pokémon Tool card. As long as Unown G is attached to a Pokémon, prevent all effects of attacks, excluding damage, done to that Pokémon. {P}{C} → Hidden Power : 50 If Unown G has any damage counters on it, this attack's base damage is 10.
057.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

058.name: Wailmer
058.evolves: Evolves into Wailord or Wailord ex
058.attacksText: {W}{C} → Tsunami : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {C}{C}{C} → Ram : 30
058.flavorText: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

059.name: Zangoose
059.attacksText: {C} → Slash : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Cutting Claw : 40+ If your opponent has Seviper in play, this attack does 40 damage plus 50 more damage.
059.flavorText: It has feuded with SEVIPER for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.

060.name: Baltoy
060.evolves: Evolves into Claydol or Claydol ex
060.attacksText: {C} → Psychic Balance If you have less cards in your hand than your opponent, draw cards until you have the same number of cards as your opponent. (If you have more or the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does nothing.) {F}{C} → Spin Turn : 20 Switch Baltoy with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
060.flavorText: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

061.name: Buizel
061.evolves: Evolves into Floatzel
061.attacksText: {@} → Headbutt : 10 {W}{W} → Surf : 30
061.flavorText: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

062.name: Cacnea
062.evolves: Evolves into Cacturne or Cacturne ex
062.attacksText: {C} → Sand Attack If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. {G}{C} → Poison Sting : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
062.flavorText: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive 30 days without water.

063.name: Caterpie
063.evolves: Evolves into Metapod
063.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Pupate Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Caterpie is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card that evolves from Caterpie and put it onto Caterpie. (This counts as evolving Caterpie.) Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Caterpie is affected by a Special Condition. {G} → Tackle : 20
063.flavorText: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.

064.name: Clamperl
064.evolves: Evolves into Gorebyss or Huntail
064.attacksText: {C} → Clamp : 10 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{C} → Sparkling Pearl : 20
064.flavorText: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.

065.name: Drowzee
065.evolves: Evolves into Hypno or Dark Hypno
065.attacksText: {C} → Hypnosis The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {P}{C} → Headbutt : 20
065.flavorText: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

066.name: Ekans
066.evolves: Evolves into Arbok , Dark Arbok , or Arbok ex
066.attacksText: {C} → Shed Skin Remove 2 damage counters from Ekans. {P} → Poison Fang : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
066.flavorText: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.

067.name: Feebas
067.evolves: Evolves into Milotic or Milotic ex
067.attacksText: {C} → Splash : 10 {W} → Fast Evolution Search your deck for an Evolution card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
067.flavorText: It is famous for its shabby appearance. While populous, they tend to cluster in set locations.

068.name: Glameow
068.attacksText: {C} → Captivate Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. {C}{C} → Slash : 20
068.flavorText: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

069.name: Houndour
069.evolves: Evolves into Houndoom , Dark Houndoom , or Houndoom ex
069.attacksText: {R} → Ember : 20 Flip a coin. If tails, discard a {R} Energy attached to Houndour. {C}{C} → Smash Kick : 20
069.flavorText: It conveys its feelings using different cries. It works in a pack to cleverly take down prey.

070.name: Igglybuff
070.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Baby Evolution Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put Jigglypuff from your hand onto Igglybuff (this counts as evolving Igglybuff) and remove all damage counters from Igglybuff. {@} → Inquire Draw a card. If you didn't play any Supporter card from your hand during this turn, draw 2 more cards.
070.flavorText: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.

071.name: Illumise
071.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Scent Conduct Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a {G} Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Illumise is affected by a Special Condition. {G}{C} → Firefly Scent : 30 If the Defending Pokémon has any Poké-Bodies, that Pokémon is now Asleep.
071.flavorText: With its sweet aroma, it guides VOLBEAT to draw signs with light in the night sky.

072.name: Jigglypuff
072.evolves: Evolves into Wigglytuff , Wigglytuff ex , […] Wigglytuff- GX , Dark Wigglytuff
072.attacksText: {C} → Hypnotic Gaze The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C} → Expand : 20 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Jigglypuff by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
072.flavorText: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

073.name: Kakuna
073.evolves: Evolves from Weedle and into Beedrill
073.attacksText: {@} → Stiffen During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Kakuna by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {G} → Spit Poison : 10 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
073.flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

074.name: Koffing
074.evolves: Evolves into Weezing , Galarian Weezing , or Dark Weezing
074.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {P}{C} → Smogscreen : 10 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.
074.flavorText: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.

075.name: Krabby
075.evolves: Evolves into Kingler
075.attacksText: {C} → Irongrip : 10 {W}{C} → Guillotine : 30
075.flavorText: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.

076.name: Lunatone
076.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Gravity Change Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may discard a card from your hand. Then, if you have Solrock in play, draw a card. This power can't be used if Lunatone is affected by a Special Condition. {C} → Knock Over : 20 You may discard any Stadium card in play.
076.flavorText: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

077.name: Luvdisc
077.attacksText: {C} → Rendezvous Reveal the top card of your deck and put it into your hand. If that card is a Pokémon, draw 2 cards. {W} → Synchro Dance : 10+ If Luvdisc and the Defending Pokémon have the same amount of Energy attached to them, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.
077.flavorText: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

078.name: Makuhita
078.evolves: Evolves into Hariyama or Hariyama ex
078.attacksText: {C} → Punch : 10 {F}{C} → Arm Thrust : 40 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.
078.flavorText: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

079.name: Mankey
079.evolves: Evolves into Primeape or Dark Primeape
079.attacksText: {F} → Light Punch : 10 {C}{C} → Rage : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Mankey.
079.flavorText: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

080.name: Mudkip
080.attacksText: {C} → Mud Spatter : 10 {C}{C}{C} → Endeavor : 30+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.
080.flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

081.name: Porygon
081.evolves: Evolves into Porygon2 or Dark Porygon2
081.attacksText: {C} → Calculate Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back on top of your deck in any order. {C}{C} → Sharpen : 20
081.flavorText: The world's first artificially created Pokémon. It can travel through electronic space.

082.name: Slowpoke
082.evolves: Evolves into Slowking , Slowbro , […] Dark Slowbro , Dark Slowking , Slowking ex
082.attacksText: {C} → Rest Remove all Special Conditions and 3 damage counters from Slowpoke. Slowpoke is now Asleep. {W} → Tumble Over : 20 Slowpoke can't attack during your next turn.
082.flavorText: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

083.name: Slugma
083.evolves: Evolves into Magcargo , Magcargo- GX , Magcargo ex , or Dark Magcargo
083.attacksText: {R} → Steady Firebreathing : 10 {C}{C} → Body Slam : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
083.flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

084.name: Snubbull
084.attacksText: {C} → Roar Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Bite : 30
084.flavorText: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.

085.name: Solrock
085.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Sunlight If you have Lunatone in play, damage done to your opponent's Pokémon by your {P} or {F} Pokémon isn't affected by resistance. {F} → Sol Charge : 20 Search your discard pile for a basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
085.flavorText: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.

086.name: Swablu
086.evolves: Evolves into Altaria , Altaria ex , or Altaria- GX
086.attacksText: {C} → Super Speed Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Swablu during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C} → Shoot Through : 10 Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
086.flavorText: Its wings are like cotton tufts. If it perches on someone's head, it looks like a cotton hat.

087.name: Tangela
087.attacksText: {C} → Vine Invite Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. {G}{C} → Grass Knot : 20+ Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each {C} Energy in the Defending Pokémon's Retreat Cost (after applying effects to the Retreat Cost).
087.flavorText: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.

088.name: Togepi
088.evolves: Evolves into Togetic or Light Togetic
088.attacksText: {C} → Yawn The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C} → Find a Friend Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
088.flavorText: Its shell is said to be stuffed with happiness that it shares with kindhearted people.

089.name: Torchic
089.attacksText: {@} → Peck : 10 {R} → Singe The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.
089.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

090.name: Treecko
090.attacksText: {C} → Energy Ball : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to Treecko but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way. {G}{C} → Absorb : 20 Remove 1 damage counter from Treecko.
090.flavorText: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

091.name: Unown L
091.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ LINK Unown L can use any attack from any Unown in play (both yours and your opponent's) . (You still have to pay for that attack's Energy cost.) {P}{C} → Hidden Power Search either player's discard pile for up to any 2 cards, show them to your opponent, and put them on top of that player's deck in any order you like.
091.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

092.name: Volbeat
092.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Light Conduct Once during your turn (before your attack) , if you have Illumise in play, you may search your discard pile for a Supporter card, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck. This power can't be used if Volbeat is affected by a Special Condition. {G}{G} → Firefly Light : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
092.flavorText: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves ILLUMISE's sweet aroma.

093.name: Weedle
093.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. {G} → String Shot Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
093.flavorText: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

094.name: Whismur
094.attacksText: {@} → Mumble : 10 {C} → Uproar Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
094.flavorText: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

095.name: Wingull
095.attacksText: {W} → Water Drip : 10 {C}{C} → Wing Attack : 20
095.flavorText: It makes its nest on steep sea cliffs. Riding updrafts, it soars to great heights.

096.name: Zigzagoon
096.attacksText: {C} → Pull Out Search your discard pile for any 1 card, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck. {C} → Double Stab : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
096.flavorText: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.

097.name: Amulet Coin
097.attacksText: If the Pokémon Amulet Coin is attached to is your Active Pokémon at the end of your turn, draw a card. · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach Amulet Coin to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.

098.name: Felicity's Drawing
098.attacksText: Discard up to 2 cards from your hand. If you discard 1 card, draw 3 cards. If you discard 2 cards, draw 4 cards. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

099.name: Leftovers
099.attacksText: If the Pokémon Leftovers is attached to is your Active Pokémon at the end of your turn, remove 1 damage counter from the Pokémon. · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach Leftovers to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.

100.name: Psyduck
100.evolves: Evolves into Golduck , Dark Golduck , or Light Golduck
100.attacksText: {C} → Delusion If Psyduck is Confused, draw 2 cards. {C} → Migraine : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, Psyduck is now Confused.
100.flavorText: If its usual headache worsens, its starts exhibiting odd powers. It can't remember doing so, however.

101.name: Qwilfish
101.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Balloon Sting Once during your opponent's turn, if Qwilfish is your Active Pokémon and is damage by an attack (even if Qwilfish is Knocked Out) , you may flip a coin. If heads, the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns. {W}{W} → Nerve Shot : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
101.flavorText: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.

102.name: Ralts
102.attacksText: {C} → Smack : 10 {P} → Confuse Ray Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
102.flavorText: It uses the thorns on its head to sense human emotions. It is said to appear in front of cheerful people.

103.name: Rattata
103.evolves: Evolves into Raticate or Dark Raticate
103.attacksText: {C} → Tail Whip Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn. {C} → Bite : 20
103.flavorText: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

104.name: Sentret
104.attacksText: {C} → Grope Look at the top 2 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck. {C} → Scratch : 10
104.flavorText: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

105.name: Shellder
105.attacksText: {C} → Shell Rest Remove 2 damage counters from Shellder. {W}{C} → Tongue Slap : 20
105.flavorText: It swims backwards by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

106.name: Shellos East Sea
106.attacksText: {C} → Shell Hunting Search your deck for up to 2 in any combination of Shellos West Sea and Shellos East Sea and put them on your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. {W} → Sprinkle Water : 10
106.flavorText: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

107.name: Shellos West Sea
107.attacksText: {C} → Mud Spatter : 10 {W} → Recover Discard a {W} Energy attached to Shellos West Sea and remove all damage counters from Shellos West Sea.
107.flavorText: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

108.name: Shroomish
108.attacksText: {C} → Headbutt : 10 {G}{C} → Toxic Spore : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
108.flavorText: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

109.name: Shuckle
109.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Pot Shell Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Shuckle by your opponent's Pokémon that has any Special Energy cards attached to it. {G}{C} → Ferment Poison : 10 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. As long as the Defending Pokémon remains Poisoned by this attack, it can't use any Poké-Body.
109.flavorText: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.

110.name: Shuppet
110.evolves: Evolves into Banette , Banette- GX , or Banette ex
110.attacksText: {P} → Gossip Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {C}{C} → Hang Down : 20
110.flavorText: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

111.name: Spinda
111.attacksText: {C} → Dish Out Draw a card from the top and the bottom of your deck. {C} → Synchro Punch : 10+ If any basic Energy card attached to Spinda is the same type as any Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage.
111.flavorText: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

112.name: Squirtle
112.evolves: Evolves into Wartortle or Dark Wartortle
112.attacksText: {@} → Bubble Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{C} → Aqua Tail : 20+ Flip a coin for each {W} Energy attached to Squirtle. This attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.
112.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

113.name: Stantler
113.attacksText: {@} → Lead Search your deck for a Supporter card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C} → Frighten Horn : 20 If the Defending Pokémon isn't an Evolved Pokémon, that Pokémon is now Confused.
113.flavorText: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.

114.name: Sunkern
114.evolves: Evolves into Sunflora or Light Sunflora
114.attacksText: {C} → Sun Soak Flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from Sunkern, search your deck for an Evolution card that evolves from Sunkern, and put it onto Sunkern. (This counts as evolving Sunkern.) Shuffle your deck afterward. {G} → Seed Bomb : 20
114.flavorText: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.

115.name: Trapinch
115.attacksText: {C} → Inviting Trap Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. {F} → Sand Tomb : 10 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
115.flavorText: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

116.name: Venonat
116.evolves: Evolves into Venomoth , Venomoth- GX , or Light Venomoth
116.attacksText: {C} → Stun Spore Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {G} → Signal Beam : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
116.flavorText: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At nights, its kind is drawn by light.

117.name: Voltorb
117.evolves: Evolves into Electrode , Electrode- GX , Dark Electrode , or Electrode ex
117.attacksText: {L} → Speed Ball : 20 {L}{C} → Big Explosion : 50 Voltorb does 50 damage to itself.
117.flavorText: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

118.name: Wooper
118.attacksText: {C} → Yawn The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {W} → Splatter Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
118.flavorText: It lives in cold water, half burying itself in mud at the bottom to sleep.

119.name: Bebe's Search
119.attacksText: Choose a card from your hand and put it on top of your deck. Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.) · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

120.name: Night Maintenance
120.attacksText: Search your discard pile for up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

121.name: PlusPower
121.attacksText: Attach PlusPower to 1 of your Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of your turn. If the Pokémon PlusPower is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .

122.name: Professor Oak's Visit
122.attacksText: Draw 3 cards. Then, choose a card from your hand and put it on the bottom of your deck. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

123.name: Professor Rowan
123.attacksText: Choose 1 card in your hand and shuffle the rest of your cards into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.) · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

124.name: Rival
124.attacksText: Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Your opponent chooses 3 of those cards. Put those cards into your hand and put other 2 cards on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

125.name: Roseanne's Research
125.attacksText: Search your deck for up to 2 in any combination of Basic Pokémon and basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

126.name: Team Galactic's Mars
126.attacksText: Draw 2 cards. Then, choose a card from your opponent's hand without looking and put it on the bottom of his or her deck. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

127.name: Potion
127.attacksText: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon (remove 1 damage counter if that Pokémon has only 1).

128.name: Switch
128.attacksText: Switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

129.name: Darkness Energy
129.attacksText: If the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Darkness Energy is attached to isn't {D}. Darkness Energy provides {D} Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

130.name: Metal Energy
130.attacksText: Damage done by attacks to the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to isn't {M}. Metal Energy provides {M} Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

131.name: Gardevoir LV.X
131.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Teleportation Once during your turn (before your attack) , choose 1 of your Active Pokémon or 1 or your Benched Pokémon and switch Gardevoir with that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Gardevoir is affected by a Special Condition. {P}{P} → Bring Down Choose 1 Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) with the fewest remaining HP (excluding Gardevoir) and that Pokémon is now Knocked Out. · Level-Up rule: Put this card onto your Active Gardevoir. Gardevoir LV. X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

132.name: Honchkrow LV.X
132.attacksText: {C}{C} → Feint Attack Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on that Pokémon. {D}{D}{C} → Darkness Wing : 60 If the Defending Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from this attack, you may search your discard pile for any 1 card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. · Level-Up rule: Put this card onto your Active Honchkrow. Honchkrow LV. X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

001.name: Ampharos
001.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Jamming After your opponent plays a Supporter card from his or her hand, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon. You can't use more than 1 Jamming Poké-Body each turn. {L}{C}{C} → Cluster Bolt : 70 You may discard all {L} Energy attached to Ampharos. If you do, this attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any Energy cards attached to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
001.flavorText: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

002.name: Blastoise
002.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Waterlog Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may attach as many basic {W} Energy cards from your hand to any of your Pokémon in any way you like. If you do, your turn ends. This power can't be used if Blastoise is affected by a Special Condition. {W}{W}{C} → Hydro Pump : 50+ Does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way.
002.flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

003.name: Charizard
003.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Fury Blaze If your opponent has 3 or less Prize cards left, each of Charizard's attacks does 50 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {R}{R}{R}{C} → Blast Burn : 120 Flip a coin. If heads, discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard. If tails, discard 4 Energy cards attached to Charizard. (If you can't, this attack does nothing.)
003.flavorText: It is said that CHARIZARD's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

004.name: Entei
004.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Burning Coat Whenever 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from Entei's attacks, discard the top 3 cards from your opponent's deck. {R}{R}{R} → Blaze Roar : 60 Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Flip a coin. If tails, discard 2 {R} Energy attached to Entei.
004.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

005.name: Flygon
005.evolves: Evolves from Vibrava and into Flygon LV. X
005.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Irritating Buzz As long as Flygon is your Active Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Active Pokémon between turns, excluding {F} Pokémon. {F}{C}{C} → Sand Sonic : 60+ If you attach a {F} Energy card from your hand to Flygon during this turn, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage.
005.flavorText: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as “The Desert Spirit.”

006.name: Gallade
006.attacksText: {F}{C} → Sonic Blade Put damage counters on the Defending Pokémon until it is 50 HP away from being Knocked Out. If you do, your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {P}{C}{C} → Psychic Cut : 60+ You may choose as many of your face-down Prize cards as you like and put them face up. If you do, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage for each Prize card you chose. (These cards remain face up for the rest of the game.)
006.flavorText: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

007.name: Gardevoir
007.evolves: Evolves from Kirlia and into Gardevoir LV. X
007.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Telepass Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may search your opponent's discard pile for a Supporter card and use the effect of that card as the effect of this power. (The Supporter card remains in your opponent's discard pile.) You can't use more than 1 Telepass Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Gardevoir is affected by a Special Condition. {P}{C}{C} → Psychic Lock : 60 During your opponent's next turn, your opponent can't use any Poké-Powers on his or her Pokémon.
007.flavorText: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.

008.name: Gastrodon East Sea
008.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Osmotic Pressure Once during your turn (before your attack) , if you have Gastrodon West Sea in play, you may move up to 3 damage counters from Gastodon East Sea to 1 of your Gastrodon West Sea. {W}{C}{C} → Dwindling Wave : 80- Does 80 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Gastrodon East Sea.
008.flavorText: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

009.name: Gastrodon West Sea
009.attacksText: {F}{C} → Raging Flood : 20+ Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Gastrodon West Sea. Then, remove 2 damage counters from Gastrodon West Sea. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Wild Waves : 80 Put 1 damage counter on each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) .
009.flavorText: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

010.name: Ho-Oh
010.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Phoenix Turn Once during your opponent's turn, if Ho-Oh would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, you may flip a coin. If heads, Ho-Oh isn't discarded. Instead, remove all damage counters, Special Conditions, and other effects from Ho-Oh. Then, discard all cards attached to Ho-Oh (except for Energy cards). This counts as Ho-Oh being Knocked Out and your opponent takes a Prize card. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Rainbow Wing : 20× This attack does 20 damage times the number of different types of basic Energy cards attached to Ho-Oh.
010.flavorText: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

011.name: Jumpluff
011.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Cotton Spore Whenever Jumpluff would be damaged by your opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Jumpluff by that attack. {G}{G} → Cottonweed Punch Flip 2 coins. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. For each heads, this attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
011.flavorText: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

012.name: Lickilicky
012.attacksText: {C}{C} → Tongue Reel Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you choose a Benched Pokémon, switch the Defending Pokémon with that Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to the Pokémon you chose. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Boundless Power : 80 During your next turn, Lickilicky can't attack.
012.flavorText: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting to close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

013.name: Ludicolo
013.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Rain Dish At any time between turns, remove 1 damage counter from Ludicolo. {W}{W}{C} → Nature Power : 60+ If you have a Stadium Card in play, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage. If your opponent has a Stadium card in play, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
013.flavorText: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

014.name: Lugia
014.attacksText: {C} → Silver Wing : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, choose an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and return it to your opponent's hand. {P}{C}{C} → Psychic Destruction : 120 If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, this attack's base damage is 40 instead of 120.
014.flavorText: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

015.name: Mew
015.attacksText: {@} → Psychic Balance If you have less cards in your hand than your opponent, draw cards until you have the same number of cards as your opponent. (If you have more or the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does nothing.) {P}{C}{C} → Re-creation Choose an attack on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon in his or her discard pile. Re-creation copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else required for that attack.) Mew performs that attack.
015.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe MEW to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

016.name: Raikou
016.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Thunder Rumble Once during your turn (before your attack) , when you attach a {L} Energy card from your hand to Raikou, you may put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. {L}{L}{L} → Thunder Climb : 50+ Discard 3 cards from the top of your deck. This attack does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each {L} Energy card you discarded. Then, attach those {L} Energy cards to 1 of your Pokémon.
016.flavorText: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

017.name: Roserade
017.attacksText: {G} → Sleep Poison : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned. {G}{C}{C} → Magical Leaf : 40+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage and remove 3 damage counters from Roserade.
017.flavorText: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

018.name: Salamence
018.evolves: Evolves from Shelgon and into Salamence LV. X
018.attacksText: {C}{C} → Direct Hit : 50 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon. {R}{R}{W}{W} → Dragon Finish Discard 2 basic {R} Energy cards or 2 basic {W} Energy cards attached to Salamence. If you discarded 2 basic {R} Energy cards, this attack does 100 damage to the Defending Pokémon. If you discarded 2 Basic {W} Energy cards, this attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (If you can't discard cards, this attack does nothing.)
018.flavorText: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changes, and wings grew out.

019.name: Suicune
019.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Aqua Recover Once during your turn, when you put Suicune from your hand onto your Bench, you may search your discard pile for up to 3 {W} Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. {W}{W}{W} → Cure Stream : 60 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .
019.flavorText: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

020.name: Venusaur
020.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Miracle Aroma Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may flip a coin. If heads, choose either Asleep, Burned, or Poisoned. The Defending Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition. This power can't be used if Venusaur is affected by a Special Condition. {G}{G}{C} → Giant Bloom : 60 Flip a coin. If heads, remove 4 damage counters from Venusaur.
020.flavorText: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

021.name: Absol
021.attacksText: {C} → Baleful Wind Choose a card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it. If you discarded a Trainer, Supporter, or Stadium card, choose 1 more card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it. {D} → Raid : 10 If you played Absol from your hand during this turn, this attack's base damage is 40 instead of 10.
021.flavorText: It senses disasters coming and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.

022.name: Arcanine
022.evolves: Evolves from Growlithe and into Arcanine BREAK
022.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Flame Dash Once during your turn, when you play Arcanine from your hand to evolve 1 of your Benched Pokémon, you may switch Arcanine with 1 of your Active Pokémon. If you do, you may move any number of Energy cards attached to that Pokémon to Arcanine. {R}{R}{C}{C} → Inferno Onrush : 120 Arcanine does 40 damage to itself.
022.flavorText: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

023.name: Banette
023.attacksText: {@} → Ghost Head Put as many damage counters as you like on Banette. (You can't put more than Banette's remaining HP.) Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. {P}{P} → Spiteful Pain : 40+ If Banette is in your discard pile, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage, then search your discard pile for Banette, show it to your opponent, and shuffle it into your deck.
023.flavorText: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

024.name: Dugtrio
024.attacksText: {F}{C} → Dig Trap Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Dugtrio during your opponent's next turn. If Dugtrio is your Active Pokémon at the end of your opponent's next turn, put 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. {F}{F}{C} → Pit Trap : 50+ Your opponent flips a coin. If tails, this attack does 50 damage plus 50 more damage.
024.flavorText: Its three heads moves alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

025.name: Electivire
025.evolves: Evolves from Electabuzz and into Electivire LV. X
025.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Motor Drive Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may search your discard pile for a {L} Energy card and attach it to Electivire. This power can't be used if Electivire is affected by a Special Condition. {L}{C}{C} → Discharge : 50× Discard all {L} Energy attached to Electivire. Flip a coin for each {L} Energy you discarded. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.
025.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

026.name: Electrode
026.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Energy Shift Once during your turn, if Electrode would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, you may use this power. Electrode isn't discarded. Instead, attach it as an Energy card to 1 of your Pokémon. While attached, this card is a Special Energy card and provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.) {L}{C} → Ion Blast : 40+ You may do 40 damage plus 60 more damage. If you do, Electrode does 100 damage to itself.
026.flavorText: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

027.name: Furret
027.attacksText: {@} → Keen Eye Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C} → Baton Pass : 40 You may switch Furret with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, move as many Energy cards attached to Furret as you like to the new Active Pokémon.
027.flavorText: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

028.name: Golduck
028.evolves: Evolves from Psyduck and into Golduck BREAK
028.attacksText: {P} → Encore : 20 Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can use only that attack during your opponent's next turn. {W}{P} → Break Beam : 40+ You may do 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If you do, Golduck is now Confused.
028.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives in lakes. It swims faster than any human swimming champion.

029.name: Golem
029.attacksText: {F}{F}{C} → Double Throw Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{F}{F}{C} → Megaton Rock : 80 You may do 40 damage instead of 80 to the Defending Pokémon. If you do, during your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Golem by attacks is reduced by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
029.flavorText: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can't harm it.

030.name: Jynx
030.attacksText: {W}{C} → Icy Kiss : 30 If Jynx was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {P}{C} → Lovely Kiss Move 2 damage counters from Jynx to the Defending Pokémon. If Smoochum is anywhere under Jynx, move 4 damage counters instead.
030.flavorText: It cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

031.name: Magmortar
031.evolves: Evolves from Magmar and into Magmortar LV. X
031.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Flame Body When you attach a {R} Energy card from your hand to Magmortar, remove 2 damage counters from Magmortar. {R} → Flame Blast : 20× Does 20 damage times the number of {R} Energy attached to Magmortar. {R}{C}{C} → Fireball Bazooka : 40 Does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
031.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

032.name: Minun
032.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Minus Charge Once during your turn (before your attack) , if any Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may draw 2 cards. You can't use more than 1 Minus Charge Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Minun is affected by a Special Condition. {L} → Tag Play — : 20 If you have Plusle on your Bench, you may move an Energy card attached to Minun to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
032.flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

033.name: Mothim
033.attacksText: {@} → Silver Wind During your next turn, if an attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , that attack does 40 more damage. {G}{C} → Raging Scales : 30+ If Mothim has any damage counters on it, this attack does 30 damage plus 40 more damage.
033.flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.

034.name: Nidoking
034.evolves: Evolves from Nidorino and into Nidoking BREAK
034.attacksText: {C}{C} → Poison Rub : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Before doing damage, you may switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. {P}{P}{C}{C} → Pride Attack : 60+ Flip a coin for each Nidoqueen on your Bench. This attack does 60 damage plus 30 more damage for each heads.
034.flavorText: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

035.name: Pidgeot
035.attacksText: {C}{C} → Mirror Move If Pidgeot was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does the same amount of damage done to Pidgeot to the Defending Pokémon. {C}{C} → Whirlwind : 50 Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.
035.flavorText: By flapping its wings with all its might, PIDGEOT can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.

036.name: Plusle
036.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Plus Charge Once during your turn (before your attack) , if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may search your discard pile for up to 2 basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. You can't use more than 1 Plus Charge Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Plusle is affected by a Special Condition. {L} → Tag Play + : 20 If you have Minun on your Bench, you may do 20 damage to any 1 Benched Pokémon instead. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
036.flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

037.name: Sharpedo
037.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Rough Skin If Sharpedo is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Sharpedo is Knocked Out) , put 2 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. {W}{C}{C} → Strike Wound : 60+ If the Defending Pokémon has 2 or more damage counters on it, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage. This attack damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on that Pokémon.
037.flavorText: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”

038.name: Sunflora
038.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Grass Whistle Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may remove 1 damage counter from each of your {G} Pokémon. You can't use more than 1 Grass Whistle Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Sunflora is affected by a Special Condition. {G}{G} → Petal Dance : 30× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, Sunflora is now Confused.
038.flavorText: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

039.name: Unown S

If heads, search your discard pile for an Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck. {C} → Hidden Power : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
039.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

040.name: Weavile
040.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Dark Engage Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may use this power. Each of your Active Pokémon's type is {D} until the end of your turn. If that Pokémon is no longer your Active Pokémon, this effect ends. {@} → Shadow Charge Search your deck for up to 2 {D} Energy cards and attach them to any of your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle your deck afterward. {D}{D} → Chip Off : 40 If your opponent has 6 or more cards in his or her hand, discard a number of cards without looking until your opponent has 5 cards left in his or her hand.
040.flavorText: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

041.name: Wormadam Plant Cloak

042.name: Wormadam Sandy Cloak
042.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Sandy Cloak Prevent all effects of attacks, excluding damage, done to Wormadam Sandy Cloak. {F}{C}{C} → Push Over : 40+ Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each {F} Energy attached to Wormadam Sandy Cloak.
042.flavorText: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

043.name: Wormadam Trash Cloak

043.flavorText: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

044.name: Xatu
044.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Psychic Shift Once during your turn, if Xatu is on your Bench, you may choose 1 Special Condition from 1 of your Active Pokémon and remove that Special Condition. Then, 1 of the Defending Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition that you chose. {P}{C} → Energy Singe Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
044.flavorText: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

045.name: Breloom
045.attacksText: {F}{C} → Drain Punch : 40 Remove from Breloom a number of damage counters equal to the amount of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. {F}{C}{C} → Homing Uppercut : 60+ If the Defending Pokémon's Retreat Cost is 0, this attack does 60 damage plus 60 more damage.
045.flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

046.name: Charmeleon
046.evolves: Evolves from Charmander and into Charizard , Charizard ex , […] Charizard- GX , Mega Charizard X ex , Mega Charizard Y ex
046.attacksText: {R} → Fire Fang : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{R}{C} → Flare Tail : 50+ Flip a coin. If heads, discard a {R} Energy attached to Charmeleon and this attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage.
046.flavorText: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

047.name: Cloyster
047.evolves: Evolves from Shellder
047.attacksText: {@} → Withdraw Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Cloyster by attacks during your opponent's next turn. {W}{C} → Spine Missile Flip 4 coins. For each heads, choose an opponent's Pokémon in play and this attack does 20 damage to those Pokémon. (You may choose the same Pokémon more than once.) (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
047.flavorText: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.

048.name: Donphan
048.attacksText: {F}{C} → Rapid Spin : 40 Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. You switch Donphan with 1 of your Benched Pokémon, if any. {F}{F}{C}{C} → Bash In : 70+ If the Defending Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 70 damage plus 60 more damage.
048.flavorText: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

049.name: Farfetch'd
049.attacksText: {C} → Swords Dance During your next turn, Farfetch'd's Leek Slap attack's base damage is 60. {C} → Leek Slap : 30 During your next turn, Farfetch'd can't use Leek Slap.
049.flavorText: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

050.name: Flaaffy
050.evolves: Evolves from Mareep and into Ampharos , Ampharos- GX , or Ampharos ex
