051.name: Ivysaur
051.evolves: Evolves from Bulbasaur and into Venusaur , Venusaur ex , or Mega Venusaur ex
051.attacksText: {G}{C} → Leech Seed : 20 Remove 1 damage counter from Ivysaur. {G}{G}{C} → Razor Leaf : 60
051.flavorText: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower's coming bloom.

052.name: Kecleon
052.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Camouflage If any basic Energy card attached to Kecleon is the same as the Attacking Pokémon's type, any damage done by attacks from the Pokémon to Kecleon is reduced by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C} → Blind Scratch : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does no damage to the Defending Pokémon. Instead, this attack does 20 damage to 1 of your Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
052.flavorText: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

053.name: Kirlia
053.evolves: Evolves from Ralts and into Gardevoir , Gallade , […] Gardevoir ex , Mega Gardevoir ex
053.attacksText: {P} → Psychic Research Search your discard pile for a Supporter card and use the effect of that card as the effect of this attack. (The Supporter card remains in your discard pile.) {P}{C}{C} → Telekinesis Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
053.flavorText: It is highly perceptive of its Trainer's feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.

054.name: Lombre
054.evolves: Evolves from Lotad and into Ludicolo
054.attacksText: {C}{C} → Torment : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Supporter cards from his or her hand during his or her next turn. {W}{W} → Absorb : 40 Remove 2 damage counters from Lombre.
054.flavorText: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

055.name: Miltank
055.attacksText: {@} → Healing Milk Flip 2 coins. For each heads, remove 3 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon. {C}{C} → Continuous Tumble : 20× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
055.flavorText: It is said that kids who drink MILTANK's milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

056.name: Muk
056.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Toxic Sludge At the end of each player's turn, each of your opponent's Active Pokémon that has any {G} Energy attached to it is now Poisoned. If that Pokémon is already Poisoned, Toxic Sludge Poké-Body does nothing to that Pokémon. {P}{P}{C} → Panic Liquid : 50 The Defending Pokémon is now Confused and can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
056.flavorText: A toxic fluids seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

057.name: Nidorino
057.evolves: Evolves from Nidoran Male and into Nidoking
057.attacksText: {C}{C} → Spirited Drill : 20 During your next turn, each of Nidorino's attacks does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {P}{C}{C} → Poison Horn : 40 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
057.flavorText: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

058.name: Pidgeotto
058.evolves: Evolves from Pidgey and into Pidgeot or Pidgeot ex
058.attacksText: {C} → Wing Attack : 20 {C}{C} → Quick Attack : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.
058.flavorText: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.

059.name: Pinsir
059.attacksText: {G} → Grip and Squeeze : 20 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. {G}{C}{C} → Power Guillotine : 100 Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack's base damage is 10 instead of 100.
059.flavorText: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can't tear, it tosses far.

060.name: Quagsire
060.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Aqua Healing Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Quagsire is your Active Pokémon and the Defending Pokémon has any {W} Energy attached to it, you may remove 3 damage counters from Quagsire. {W}{C}{C} → Muddy Water : 60 Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
060.flavorText: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

061.name: Raticate
061.evolves: Evolves from Rattata and into Raticate BREAK
061.attacksText: {C} → Gnaw Off : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 60 more damage. {C} → Sneaky Attack : 20+ If Raticate has any {D} Energy attached to it, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage.
061.flavorText: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

062.name: Roselia
062.evolves: Evolves into Roserade
062.attacksText: {C} → Sleep Powder The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {G} → Razor Leaf : 10
062.flavorText: ROSELIA raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.

063.name: Sableye
063.attacksText: {C} → Rummage Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Choose as many Trainer cards as you like, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Put the other cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. {D}{C} → Shadow Sneak : 20+ If you and your opponent have a different number of Prize cards left, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage.
063.flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

064.name: Shelgon
064.evolves: Evolves from Bagon and into Salamence , Salamence ex , or Salamence- GX
064.attacksText: {C} → Focus Energy During your next turn, Shelgon's Protect Charge attack's base damage is 80. {C}{C}{C} → Protect Charge : 30 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Shelgon by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
064.flavorText: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

065.name: Skiploom
065.evolves: Evolves from Hoppip and into Jumpluff
065.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Cotton Balloon If Skiploom has any {G} Energy attached to it, any damage done to Skiploom by attacks from your opponent's Evolved Pokémon is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {G} → U-turn : 20 Switch Skiploom with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
065.flavorText: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

066.name: Smeargle
066.attacksText: {@} → Color Pick Search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C} → Trace Flip a coin. If heads, choose an attack on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Trace copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else required for that attack.) Smeargle performs that attack.
066.flavorText: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.

067.name: Smoochum
067.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Baby Evolution Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put Jynx from your hand onto Smoochum (this counts as evolving Smoochum) and remove all damage counters from Smoochum. {@} → Psykiss Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Special Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck.
067.flavorText: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.

068.name: Unown K
068.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Kind Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may remove 2 damage counters from 1 of the Defending Pokémon. {P} → Hidden Power : 20
068.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

069.name: Unown N

069.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
070.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

071.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

072.name: Unown Z
072.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ ZERO Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Unown Z is on your Bench and you have no cards in your deck, you may discard all cards attached to Unown Z and put Unown Z on top of your deck. {P}{C} → Hidden Power Remove as many damage counters as you like from each Unown you have in play. Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.
072.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

073.name: Venomoth
073.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Dangerous Scales If Venomoth is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Venomoth is Knocked Out) , the Attacking Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned. {G}{G} → Disturbance Dive : 50 Prevent all effects of an attack, excluding damage, done to Venomoth during your opponent's next turn.
073.flavorText: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.

074.name: Vibrava
074.evolves: Evolves from Trapinch and into Flygon , Flygon ex , or Flygon- GX
074.attacksText: {F} → Sand Wind Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{C}{C} → Hyper Beam : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.
074.flavorText: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

075.name: Wartortle
075.evolves: Evolves from Squirtle and into Blastoise , Blastoise ex , or Blastoise- GX
075.attacksText: {W}{W} → Giant Wave : 40 Wartortle can't use Giant Wave during your next turn. {C}{C}{C} → Shell Attack : 50
075.flavorText: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

076.name: Bagon
076.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 10 {C}{C} → Rage : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Bagon.
076.flavorText: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

077.name: Bulbasaur
077.evolves: Evolves into Ivysaur or Dark Ivysaur
077.attacksText: {@} → Shake Vine The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {G}{C} → Bullet Seed : 10× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

080.flavorText: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

081.name: Carvanha
081.evolves: Evolves into Sharpedo , Mega Sharpedo ex , or Sharpedo ex
081.attacksText: {W} → Slash : 10 {D}{C} → Bite Away : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, choose a card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.
081.flavorText: They can swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

082.name: Charmander
082.evolves: Evolves into Charmeleon or Dark Charmeleon
082.attacksText: {@} → Gnaw : 10 {R}{R} → Lava Burn : 20 Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
082.flavorText: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

083.name: Clefairy
083.evolves: Evolves into Clefable , Mega Clefable ex , or Clefable ex
083.attacksText: Held Item ⇢ Moon Stone Clefairy can evolve during the turn you play it. {C} → Double Slap : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

084.name: Corsola
084.attacksText: {C} → Rally Search your deck for up to 3 different types of Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. {W}{C} → Hook : 30
084.flavorText: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can't live in polluted waters.

085.name: Diglett
085.evolves: Evolves into Dugtrio or Dark Dugtrio
085.attacksText: {C} → Down Draw Draw a card from the bottom of your deck. {F}{F} → Mud Spatter : 30
085.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.

086.name: Duskull
086.evolves: Evolves into Dusclops or Dusclops ex
086.attacksText: Held Item ⇢ Reaper Cloth Duskull can evolve during the turn you play it. {P} → Astonish Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking. Look at that card you chose, then have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck.

087.name: Electabuzz
087.evolves: Evolves into Electivire or Electivire ex
087.attacksText: {L} → Thundershock : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {L}{L}{C} → Thunder : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, Electabuzz does 30 damage to itself.
087.flavorText: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.

088.name: Grimer
088.evolves: Evolves into Muk , Dark Muk , or Muk ex
088.attacksText: {C} → Mud Bomb : 10 {P} → Gunky If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.
088.flavorText: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon's X-rays. It appears among filth.

089.name: Growlithe
089.evolves: Evolves into Arcanine , Arcanine ex , or Light Arcanine
089.attacksText: {C} → Roar Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {R}{C} → Dig Claws : 20
089.flavorText: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

090.name: Hoppip
090.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Cottonweed If Hoppip has any {G} Energy attached to it, the Retreat Cost for Hoppip is 0. {G} → Hover Heal : 10 Remove all Special Conditions from Hoppip.
090.flavorText: It drifts on winds. It is said that when HOPPIP gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

091.name: Lickitung
091.attacksText: {C} → Lick : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {C}{C} → Stomp : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage.
091.flavorText: Instead of hands, it uses its tongue, which is twice its height. Its sticky saliva grips anything.

092.name: Lotad
092.attacksText: {W} → Water Sport : 10+ If Lotad has less Energy attached to it than the Defending Pokémon, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage. {W}{C} → Ram : 20
092.flavorText: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.

093.name: Magmar
093.attacksText: {C} → Fire Punch : 10 {R}{C} → Smog : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
093.flavorText: Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.

094.name: Mareep
094.evolves: Evolves into Flaaffy or Dark Flaaffy
094.attacksText: {L} → Thundershock : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {L}{C} → Static Shock : 20
094.flavorText: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

095.name: Murkrow
095.evolves: Evolves into Honchkrow or Honchkrow- GX
095.attacksText: Held Item ⇢ Dusk Stone Murkrow can evolve during the turn you play it. {D}{C} → Feint Attack Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on that Pokémon.

096.name: Natu
096.attacksText: {C} → Bothering Wave : 20 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon. {P} → Future Sight Look at the top 5 cards of either player's deck and put them back on top of that player's deck in any order.
096.flavorText: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.

097.name: Nidoran Male
097.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {P} → Poison Skin Flip 2 coins. If either of them is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
097.flavorText: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

098.name: Phanpy
098.evolves: Evolves into Donphan or Dark Donphan
098.attacksText: {C} → Flail : 10× Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Phanpy. {F}{C} → Take Down : 30 Phanpy does 10 damage to itself.
098.flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

099.name: Pidgey
099.attacksText: {C} → Growl During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C} → Peck : 20
099.flavorText: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

001.name: Bastiodon
001.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Protective Wall Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by your opponent's attacks. {M}{M}{C} → Anger Revenge : 60 If Bastiodon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
001.flavorText: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

002.name: Lucario
002.evolves: Evolves from Riolu and into Lucario LV. X
002.attacksText: {C} → Feint : 30 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance. {F}{F} → Aura Sphere : 40 Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
002.flavorText: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

003.name: Manaphy
003.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. {W}{W} → Aqua Ring : 30 Switch Manaphy with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
003.flavorText: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

004.name: Pachirisu
004.attacksText: {C} → Minor Errand-Running Search your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {L} → Thunder Jolt : 20 Flip a coin. If tails, Pachirisu does 10 damage to itself.
004.flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

005.name: Rampardos
005.attacksText: {F}{C} → Assurance : 30 As long as the Defending Pokémon's remaining HP is 60 or less, this attack's base damage is 60 instead of 30. {F}{F}{F} → Hasty Headbutt : 100 Rampardos does 20 damage to itself. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.
005.flavorText: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

006.name: Drifloon
006.attacksText: {P} → Blowing Wind Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to it on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. {P}{C} → Ominous Wind : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused and can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
006.flavorText: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

007.name: Gible
007.attacksText: Held Item ⇢ Oran Berry Remove 1 damage counter from Gible at the end of your turn. {C}{C} → Surprise Attack : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

008.name: Riolu
008.evolves: Evolves into Lucario , Mega Lucario ex , Lucario- GX , or Lucario ex
008.attacksText: {F} → Wild Kick : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
008.flavorText: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

009.name: Pikachu
009.evolves: Evolves into Raichu , Alolan Raichu , […] Raichu- GX , Dark Raichu
009.attacksText: Held Item ⇢ Oran Berry Remove 1 damage counter from Pikachu at the end of your turn. {L}{C} → Spark : 10 Does 10 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

010.name: Staravia
010.evolves: Evolves from Starly and into Staraptor
010.attacksText: {C}{C} → Whirlwind : 20 Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {C}{C} → Clutch : 20 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
010.flavorText: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

011.name: Bidoof
011.attacksText: {C} → Amnesia Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attack's. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn. {C} → Scavenge Search your discard pile for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, an put it into your hand.
011.flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

012.name: Buneary
012.evolves: Evolves into Lopunny or Mega Lopunny ex
012.attacksText: {C} → Splash : 10 {C}{C} → Jump Kick : 10 Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
012.flavorText: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling is rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

013.name: Cherubi
013.attacksText: {G} → Sleep Powder The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {G}{C} → Leech Seed : 20 If this attack does any damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , remove 1 damage counter from Cherubi.
013.flavorText: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

014.name: Chimchar
014.attacksText: {@} → Scratch : 10 {R}{C} → Ember : 30 Flip a coin. If heads discard a {R} Energy attached to Chimchar.
014.flavorText: It agilely scales cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

015.name: Piplup
015.attacksText: {@} → Peck : 10 {W}{C} → Water Spash : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this, attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.
015.flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

016.name: Starly
016.attacksText: {C} → Gust : 10 {C}{C} → Quick Attack : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.
016.flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

017.name: Turtwig
017.attacksText: {@} → Tackle : 10 {G} → Razor Leaf : 20
017.flavorText: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

100.name: Snorunt
100.evolves: Evolves into Froslass , Glalie , Mega Froslass ex , or Froslass ex
100.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {W} → Snowball : 20 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
100.flavorText: In the snow country, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a SNORUNT lives there.

101.name: Snover
101.evolves: Evolves into Abomasnow or Mega Abomasnow ex
101.attacksText: {@} → Curiosity Look at your opponent's hand. {W}{C} → Snowball Fight : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, Snover does 10 damage to itself.
101.flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

102.name: Spheal
102.attacksText: {C} → Rollout : 10 {W} → Willpower Flip a coin. If heads, during your next turn, Spheal's Rollout attack's base damage is 40.
102.flavorText: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

103.name: Spinarak
103.evolves: Evolves into Ariados or Dark Ariados
103.attacksText: {C} → Impound The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. {G}{C} → Double Scratch : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
103.flavorText: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.

104.name: Surskit
104.attacksText: {G} → Sleep Inducer Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
104.flavorText: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

105.name: Teddiursa
105.evolves: Evolves into Ursaring or Dark Ursaring
105.attacksText: {C} → Rest Remove all Special Conditions and 2 damage counters from Teddiursa. Teddiursa is now Asleep. {C}{C} → Sweet Palm : 30 Before doing damage, remove 1 damage counter from the Defending Pokémon.
105.flavorText: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every sets of paws tastes unique.

106.name: Totodile
106.evolves: Evolves into Croconaw or Dark Croconaw
106.attacksText: {@} → Bite : 10 {W} → Shining Fang : 10+ If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.
106.flavorText: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer need to be careful.

107.name: Vulpix
107.evolves: Evolves into Ninetales , Ninetales ex , or Light Ninetales
107.attacksText: {R}{R} → Fire Soul : 20 Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
107.flavorText: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

108.name: Zubat
108.evolves: Evolves into Golbat or Dark Golbat
108.attacksText: {P} → Supersonic Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. {C}{C} → Bite : 20
108.flavorText: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

109.name: Bebe's Search
109.attacksText: Choose a card from your hand and put it on top of your deck. Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.) · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

110.name: Dusk Ball
110.attacksText: Look at the 7 cards from the bottom of your deck. Choose 1 Pokémon you find there, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Put the remaining cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

111.name: Fossil Excavator
111.attacksText: Search your deck or discard pile for a Trainer card that has Fossil in its name or a Stage 1 or Stage 2 Evolution card that evolves from a Fossil. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. If you searched your deck, shuffle your deck afterward. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

112.name: Lake Boundary
112.attacksText: Apply Weakness for each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) as ×2 instead. · Stadium rule: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

113.name: Night Maintenance
113.attacksText: Search your discard pile for up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

114.name: Quick Ball
114.attacksText: Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Pokémon. Show that Pokémon to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other revealed cards back into your deck. (If you don't reveal a Pokémon, shuffle all the revealed cards back into your deck.)

115.name: Team Galactic's Wager
115.attacksText: Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, and you and your opponent play “Rock-Paper-Scissors.” The player who wins draws up to 6 cards. The player who loses draws up to 3 cards. (You draw your cards first.) · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

116.name: Armor Fossil
116.attacksText: Play Armor Fossil as if it were a {C} Basic Pokémon. (Armor Fossil counts as a Trainer card as well, but if Armor Fossil is Knocked Out, this counts as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) Armor Fossil can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Armor Fossil from play. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) Poké-BODY ⇢ Armor Stone Whenever Armor Fossil would be damaged by your opponent's attack, flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, reduce that damage by 10.

117.name: Skull Fossil
117.attacksText: Play Skull Fossil as if it were a {C} Basic Pokémon. (Skull Fossil counts as a Trainer card as well, but if Skull Fossil is Knocked Out, this counts as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) Skull Fossil can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Skull Fossil from play. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) Poké-BODY ⇢ Skull Stone During your opponent's turn, if Skull Fossil would be Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, put 1 damage counter on the Attacking Pokémon.

118.name: Multi Energy
118.attacksText: Attach Multi Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Multi Energy provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.) Multi Energy provides {C} Energy when attached to a Pokémon that already has Special Energy cards attached to it.

119.name: Darkness Energy
119.attacksText: If the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Darkness Energy is attached to isn't {D}. Darkness Energy provides {D} Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

120.name: Metal Energy
120.attacksText: Damage done by attacks to the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to isn't {M}. Metal Energy provides {M} Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

121.name: Electivire LV.X
121.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Shocking Tail As long as Electivire is your Active Pokémon, whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from his or her hand to 1 of his or her Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. {L}{C} → Pulse Barrier : 50 Discard all of your opponent's Pokémon Tool cards and Stadium cards in play. If you do, prevent all effects, including damage, done to Electivire during your opponent's next turn. · Level-Up rule: Put this card onto your Active Electivire. Electivire LV. X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

122.name: Lucario LV.X
122.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Stance Once during your turn (before your attack) , when you put Lucario LV. X from your hand onto your Active Lucario, you may use this power. Prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Lucario during your opponent's next turn. (If Lucario is no longer your Active Pokémon, this effect ends.) {F}{F}{C} → Close Combat : 80 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Lucario by attacks is increased by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . · Level-Up rule: Put this card onto your Active Lucario. Lucario LV. X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

123.name: Magmortar LV.X
123.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Torrid Wave Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Magmortar is your Active Pokémon, you may choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon. That Pokémon is now Burned. Put 3 damage counters instead of 2 on that Pokémon between turns. This power can't be used if Magmortar is affected by a Special Condition. {R}{R}{R}{R} → Flame Bluster Discard 2 {R} Energy attached to Magmortar. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 100 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) During your next turn, Magmortar can't use Flame Bluster. · Level-Up rule: Put this card onto your Active Magmortar. Magmortar LV. X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

124.name: Time-Space Distortion
124.attacksText: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, search your discard pile for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.

001.name: Aggron
001.attacksText: {C}{C} → Heap Up : 40+ Search your discard pile for all Energy cards and show them to your opponent. If you find any {M} Special Energy cards there this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage. Put all of those Energy cards on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. {M}{M}{M}{M} → Hard Metal : 60+ You may do 60 damage plus 40 more damage. If you do, Aggron does 40 damage to itself.
001.flavorText: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

002.name: Alakazam
002.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Power Cancel Once during your opponent's turn, when your opponent's Pokémon uses any Poké-Power, you may discard 2 cards from your hand and prevent all effects of that Poké-Power. (This counts as that Pokémon using its Poké-Power.) This power can't be used if Alakazam is affected by a Special Condition. {P}{P}{C} → Psychic Guard : 50 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Alakazam by attacks from your opponent's Stage 2 Evolved Pokémon is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
002.flavorText: Its superb memory lets it recall everything it has experienced from birth. Its IQ exceeds 5,000.

003.name: Ambipom
003.attacksText: {C}{C} → Tail Influence : 30 Your opponent flips a coin until he or she gets heads. For each tails, remove an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and put it on the bottom of your opponent's deck. {C}{C} → Charity Tail : 80 Before Ambipom does damage, your opponent may discard 2 cards from his or her hand. If he or she does, this attack's base damage is 10 instead of 80.
003.flavorText: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

004.name: Azelf
004.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Downer Material If you have Uxie and Mesprit in play, the attack cost of each of your opponent's Basic Pokémon's attacks is {C} more. You can't use more than 1 Downer Material Poké-Body each turn. {P} → Bind Pulse : 10 During your opponent's next turn, your opponent can't attach any Special Energy cards from his or her hand to any of his or her Pokémon.
004.flavorText: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

005.name: Blissey
005.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Kind Egg Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Happiny is anywhere under Blissey, you may choose a number of cards in your hand up to the amount of Energy attached to Blissey and put those cards on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. Then, draw that many cards. This power can't be used if Blissey is affected by a Special Condition. {C} → Happy Chance : 20+ Does 20 damage plus 10 for each Energy attached to Blissey. Before doing damage, you may search your discard pile for a basic Energy card and attach it to Blissey.
005.flavorText: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.

006.name: Bronzong
006.evolves: Evolves from Bronzor and into Bronzong BREAK
006.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Miracle Oracle Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may draw a card. Then, discard a card from your hand. If you discard an Energy card, draw 1 more card. This power can't be used if Bronzong is affected by a Special Condition. {M}{M}{C} → Shady Stamp : 50 The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
006.flavorText: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

007.name: Celebi
007.attacksText: {@} → Sprouting Search your deck for a {G} Energy card and attach it to Celebi. Shuffle your deck afterward. {G}{G} → Leaf Tornado : 30 You may move any number of basic {G} Energy cards attached to your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.
007.flavorText: It has the power to travel across time, but is is said to appear only in peaceful times.

008.name: Feraligatr
008.attacksText: {W}{W} → Energy Cyclone : 20× Choose as many Energy cards from your hand as you like and show them to your opponent. This attack does 20 damage times the number of Energy cards you chose. Put those Energy cards on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. {W}{C}{C} → Breaking Tail : 60 Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.
008.flavorText: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

009.name: Garchomp
009.evolves: Evolves from Gabite and into Garchomp LV. X
009.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Rainbow Scale If an Active Pokémon has Weakness to any of the types of Energy attached to Garchomp, Garchomp's attacks do 40 more damage to that Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . Rainbow Scale Poké-Body can't be used if Garchomp has any Special Energy cards attached to it. {C}{C}{C} → Dragon Fang : 70
009.flavorText: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

010.name: Honchkrow
010.evolves: Evolves from Murkrow and into Honchkrow LV. X
010.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Dark Genes As long as Honchkrow has the Energy necessary to use its attack, each of your Murkrow can use Honchkrow's attack as its own without the Energy necessary to use that attack. {D}{D}{C} → Dark Wing Flaps : 50 Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking. Look at the card you chose, then have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck.
010.flavorText: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.

011.name: Lumineon
011.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Lure Ring Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Lumineon is your Active Pokémon, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has a maximum HP of 100 or more and switch it with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. This power can't be used if Lumineon is affected by a Special Condition. {C}{C} → Reverse Stream : 30+ Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to Lumineon. Then, return all {W} Energy attached to Lumineon to your hand.
011.flavorText: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

012.name: Magmortar
012.evolves: Evolves from Magmar and into Magmortar LV. X
012.attacksText: {R}{C} → Smoke Bomb : 30 If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. {R}{R}{C} → Flame Drum : 80 If Magby isn't anywhere under Magmortar, discard 2 Energy cards from your hand. (If you can't discard 2 Energy cards from your hand, this attack does nothing.)
012.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

013.name: Meganium
013.attacksText: {G} → Ultra Powder : 20 Flip 3 coins. If the first coin is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If the second coin is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned. If the third coin is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {G}{G}{C} → Fire Counterattack : 60+ If your opponent has any {R} Pokémon in play, this attack does 60 damage plus 30 more damage.
013.flavorText: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.

014.name: Mesprit
014.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Upper Material If you have Uxie and Azelf in play, the Retreat Cost for each Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf (both yours and your opponent's) is 0. {P}{C} → Teleportation Burst : 30 You may switch Mesprit with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
014.flavorText: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

015.name: Raichu
015.evolves: Evolves from Pikachu and into Raichu BREAK or Raichu LV. X
015.attacksText: {@} → Electromagnetic Induction Search your deck for up to 2 {L} Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward. {L}{C} → Explosive Thunder : 30× Discard all basic {L} Energy cards attached to Raichu. This attack does 30 damage times the number of {L} Energy cards you discarded.
015.flavorText: It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.

016.name: Typhlosion
016.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Firestarter Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may attach a {R} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. This power can't be used if Typhlosion is affected by a Special Condition. {R}{R}{C} → Evaporating Heat : 60 Discard a {W} Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.
016.flavorText: It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.

017.name: Tyranitar
017.attacksText: {D}{C} → Payback : 40+ If your opponent has only 1 Prize card left, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage and discard the top 3 cards from your opponent's deck. {F}{F}{D}{D} → Ground Burn : 80+ Each player discards the top card of his or her deck. This attack does 80 damage plus 20 more damage for each Energy card discarded in this way.
017.flavorText: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

018.name: Uxie
018.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Memory Out Once during your opponent's turn, if Uxie is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Uxie is Knocked Out) , you may use this power. The Attacking Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn. {P} → Mind Off : 10+ If you have Mesprit and Azelf in play, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
018.flavorText: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

019.name: Abomasnow
019.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Glacier Snow If Abomasnow is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Abomasnow is Knocked Out) , the Attacking Pokémon is now Asleep. {W}{C}{C} → Heavy Blizzard : 60 Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
019.flavorText: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

020.name: Ariados
020.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Sticky The Retreat Cost for each player's Pokémon (excluding Ariados) is {C} more. {G}{C} → Offensive Needle : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
020.flavorText: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

021.name: Bastiodon
021.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Protective Wall Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by your opponent's attacks. {M}{M}{C} → Anger Revenge : 60 If Bastiodon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
021.flavorText: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

022.name: Chimecho
022.attacksText: {C} → Call In Draw a card. If Chingling is anywhere under Chimecho, draw 2 more cards. {P} → Strange Bell : 20 If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, that Pokémon is now Confused.
022.flavorText: To knock foes flying, it makes the air shudder with its cries. It converses using seven cries.

023.name: Crobat
023.evolves: Evolves from Golbat and into Crobat BREAK
023.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Evolutionary Toxic Once during your turn, when you play Crobat from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon. That Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns. {P}{P} → Strike and Fade Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Flip a coin. If tails, shuffle Crobat and all cards attached to it back into your deck.
023.flavorText: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.

024.name: Exeggutor
024.attacksText: {C} → String Bomb : 30× Flip a coin for each basic Energy card attached to Exeggutor and to the Defending Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {G} → Nutritional Support Search your deck for up to 2 {G} Energy cards and attach them to any of your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle your deck afterward.
024.flavorText: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an EXEGGCUTE.

025.name: Glalie
025.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Craggy Face As long as Glalie is your Active Pokémon, any damage done by attacks from your opponent's Stage 2 Evolved Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{W}{C} → Intimidation Pebble : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Trainer cards or Supporter cards from his or her hand during your opponent's next turn.
025.flavorText: To protect itself, it clads its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.

026.name: Gyarados
026.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Dragon DNA Gyarados can use any attack from its Basic Pokémon. (You still have to pay for that attack's Energy cost.) If Gyarados uses any attack from its Basic Pokémon, that attack does 30 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{W}{C}{C} → Enrage : 80 Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it. If the first coin is tails, Gyarados is now Confused.
026.flavorText: Once it appears, its rage never settles until it has razed the fields and mountains around it.

027.name: Kricketune
027.attacksText: {C}{C} → Sore Performance : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {G}{G} → Concerto : 40+ Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each Kricketot and each Kricketune you have in play.
027.flavorText: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

028.name: Manectric
028.attacksText: {C} → Lightning Twister : 20× Does 20 damage times the number of basic Energy cards attached to Manectric. {L}{L}{L} → Chain Lightning : 70 Does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that is the same type as the Defending Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
028.flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

029.name: Mantine
029.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Jumbo Fin If Mantyke is anywhere under Mantine, the Retreat Cost for each of your {W} Pokémon is {C}{C} less. {W}{W} → Giant Wave : 50 Mantine can't use Giant Wave during your next turn.
029.flavorText: When the waves are calm, one may encounter a swarm of Mantine swimming as if they are in flight.

030.name: Mr. Mime
030.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Airy Wall If your opponent's Pokémon that has 2 or less Energy cards attached to it attacks Mr. Mime, prevent all damage done to Mr. Mime from that attack. If Mime Jr. is anywhere under Mr. Mime, prevent all effects of that attack, including damage, done to Mr. Mime. {P}{C} → Trick Play Put a coin next to your Active Pokémon without showing your opponent and cover it with your hand. Your opponent guesses if the coin is heads or tails. If he or she is wrong, this attack does 50 damage to the Defending Pokémon. If he or she is right, Mr. Mime does 20 damage to itself, and this attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
030.flavorText: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.

031.name: Nidoqueen
031.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Mother Phernomone The attack cost of your Nidoran Female, Nidorina, Nidoran Male, Nidorino, and Nidoking's attacks is {C} less. {P}{P}{C} → Give Aid : 90 If you have the same number of or less Benched Pokémon than your opponent, this attack's base damage is 50 instead of 90.
031.flavorText: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

032.name: Ninetales
032.evolves: Evolves from Vulpix and into Ninetales BREAK
032.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Color Shift Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Ninetales is the same type as that Pokémon (all if that Pokémon is more than 1 type) until the end of your turn. This power can't be used if Ninetales is affected by a Special Condition. {R}{R} → Fire Blast : 60 Discard a {R} Energy attached to Ninetales.
032.flavorText: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

033.name: Rampardos
033.attacksText: {F}{C} → Assurance : 30 As long as the Defending Pokémon's remaining HP is 60 or less, this attack's base damage is 60 instead of 30. {F}{F}{F} → Hasty Headbutt : 100 Rampardos does 20 damage to itself. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.
033.flavorText: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

034.name: Slaking
034.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Energetic Impulse Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Slaking is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, Slaking's Lazy Blow attack's base damage is 130 during this turn. If tails, Slaking can't attack or retreat during this turn. (If Slaking is no longer your Active Pokémon, this effect ends.) {C}{C}{C}{C} → Lazy Blow : 50
034.flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

035.name: Sudowoodo
035.attacksText: {C} → Sidestep : 20 If Bonsly is anywhere under Sudowoodo, flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Sudowoodo during your opponent's next turn. {F}{F} → Persuade : 30 Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
035.flavorText: Despite appearing to be a tree, its body is closer to rocks and stones. It is very weak to water.

036.name: Toxicroak
036.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Poison Sacs Your opponent can't remove the Special Condition Poisoned by evolving or devolving his or her Poisoned Pokémon. (This also includes putting a Pokémon Level-Up card onto the Poisoned Pokémon.) {P}{C} → Knuckle Claws : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
036.flavorText: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

037.name: Unown I
037.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ ITEM Once during your turn (before your attack) , if you have Unown I, Unown T, Unown E, and Unown M on your Bench, you may search your deck for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't use more than 1 ITEM Poké-Power each turn. {C} → Hidden Power Choose an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and put it face down. Treat that card as a Special Energy card that provides {C} Energy and doesn't have any effect other than providing Energy. Put that card face up at the end of your opponent's next turn.
037.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

038.name: Ursaring
038.evolves: Evolves from Teddiursa and into Ursaluna
038.attacksText: {C}{C} → Bad Temper : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Confused. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon's attacks do 60 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C}{C}{C} → Defensive Claw : 60+ If Teddiursa is on your Bench, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage. If Teddiursa is on your Bench and has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 damage plus 40 more damage and remove all damage counters from that Pokémon.
038.flavorText: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

039.name: Walrein
039.evolves: Evolves from Sealeo
039.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Freeze-up Once during your turn, when you play Walrein from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may flip 2 coins. If both are heads, discard 1 of the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) {W}{W}{C} → Ice Bind : 70 If your opponent doesn't discard a card from his or her hand, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
039.flavorText: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

040.name: Whiscash
040.attacksText: {W}{C}{C} → Fury : 20× Does 20 damage times the number of damage counters on Whiscash. {F}{C}{C}{C} → Magnitude : 60 Does 20 damage to each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) . (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
040.flavorText: It is very territorial. It repels foes by setting of tremors that extend over a three-mile radius.

041.name: Bayleef
041.evolves: Evolves from Chikorita and into Meganium , Mega Meganium ex , or Meganium ex
041.attacksText: {C} → Evolution Impulse Search your deck for an Evolution card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {G}{C} → Leaf Boomerang : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
041.flavorText: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

042.name: Chingling
042.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Baby Evolution Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put Chimecho from your hand onto Chingling (this counts as evolving Chingling) and remove all damage counters from Chingling. {@} → Inviting Bell Search your deck for a Supporter card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
042.flavorText: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

043.name: Cranidos
043.evolves: Evolves from Skull Fossil and into Rampardos
043.attacksText: {C} → Headbutt : 20 {F}{C} → Steamroll : 30 Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
043.flavorText: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

044.name: Croconaw
044.evolves: Evolves from Totodile and into Feraligatr , Mega Feraligatr ex , or Feraligatr ex
044.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Evolutionary Vitality Once during your turn, when you play Croconaw from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Choose all Energy cards you find there, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Put the other cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. {W}{C} → Hover Over : 30 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
044.flavorText: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

045.name: Dewgong
045.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Cold Fat As long as Dewgong is Asleep, any damage done to Dewgong by attacks is reduced by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {W}{W}{C} → Collapse : 60 Dewgong is now Asleep.
045.flavorText: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.

046.name: Dodrio
046.evolves: Evolves from Doduo
046.attacksText: {C} → Fury Attack : 10× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads. {C}{C}{C} → Triple Pick Choose 3 of your opponent's Evolved Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
046.flavorText: When DODUO evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.

047.name: Dunsparce
047.evolves: Evolves into Dudunsparce or Dudunsparce ex
047.attacksText: {@} → Snake Hook Draw a card. {@} → Bite and Run : 10 Switch Dunsparce with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
047.flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

048.name: Gabite
048.evolves: Evolves from Gible and into Garchomp or Garchomp ex
048.attacksText: {C} → Gather Up Search your discard pile for up to 2 Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. {C}{C} → Marvelous Shine Flip a coin. If heads put 4 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, remove 4 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.
048.flavorText: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scale will heal even incurable illnesses.

049.name: Girafarig
049.evolves: Evolves into Farigiraf or Farigiraf ex
049.attacksText: {C} → Crane Neck Search your deck for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C} → Psybeam : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
049.flavorText: Its tail also has a small brain. It bites to repel any foe trying to sneak up on it from behind.

050.name: Golbat
050.evolves: Evolves from Zubat and into Crobat or Crobat ex
050.attacksText: {P} → Pulse Search : 30 Look at your opponent's hand.
050.flavorText: It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon. It flies around at night in search of neck veins.

051.name: Graveler
051.evolves: Evolves from Geodude and into Golem or Golem ex
051.attacksText: {F}{C} → Rock Cannon : 30× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {F}{C}{C} → Rock Slide : 40 Does 10 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
051.flavorText: GRAVELER make their homes on sheer cliff faces by gouging out numerous horizontal holes.

052.name: Happiny
052.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Baby Evolution Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put Chansey from your hand onto Happiny (this counts as evolving Happiny) and remove all damage counters from Happiny. {@} → Lively Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.
052.flavorText: It loves round white things. It carries and egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

053.name: Lairon
053.evolves: Evolves from Aron and into Aggron or Aggron ex
053.attacksText: {M} → Mend Search your discard pile for a {M} Energy card and attach it to Lairon. If you do, remove 2 damage counters from Lairon. {M}{M}{C} → Confront : 50
053.flavorText: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

054.name: Magmar
054.attacksText: {R} → Flare : 20 {R}{R}{C} → Flamethrower : 50 Discard an Energy attached to Magmar.
054.flavorText: Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.

055.name: Masquerain
055.evolves: Evolves from Surskit
055.attacksText: {C}{C} → Centrifugal Force : 20× Does 20 damage times the number of {C} Energy in the Defending Pokémon's Retreat Cost (after applying effects to the Retreat Cost). {G}{G} → Swirling Ripple : 30+ If your opponent has any {W} Pokémon in play, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
055.flavorText: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

056.name: Nidorina
056.evolves: Evolves from Nidoran Female and into Nidoqueen
056.attacksText: {C} → Rescue Search your discard pile for up to 2 Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. {P}{C} → Scratch : 30
056.flavorText: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than NIDORINO's.

057.name: Octillery
057.attacksText: {C}{C} → Crash Bomber : 30+ If the Defending Pokémon has any Special Energy cards attached to it, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage. Then, discard a Special Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon. {W}{W} → Aqua Liner Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
057.flavorText: It lives in the gaps of boulders and in holes on the seafloor. Its suction cups grip prey tightly.

058.name: Parasect
058.evolves: Evolves from Paras
058.attacksText: {G} → Wild Spores : 20 If Parasect evolved from Paras during this turn, this attack does 40 damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned. {G}{G}{C} → Extend Fungus : 60 Remove 2 damage counters from Parasect.
058.flavorText: A mushroom grown larger than the host's body controls PARASECT. It scatters poisonous spores.

059.name: Pupitar
059.evolves: Evolves from Larvitar and into Tyranitar , Tyranitar ex , or Tyranitar- GX
059.attacksText: {C}{C} → Pressurized Gas Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{C}{C} → Rocket Tackle : 50 Pupitar does 10 damage to itself. Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Pupitar by attacks during your opponent's next turn.
059.flavorText: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

060.name: Quilava
060.evolves: Evolves from and into Typhlosion , Typhlosion ex , or Hisuian Typhlosion
060.attacksText: {R}{C} → Fireworks : 40 Flip a coin. If tails, discard a {R} Energy attached to Quilava.
060.flavorText: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burn more strongly when it readies to fight.

061.name: Sandslash
061.evolves: Evolves from Sandshrew
061.attacksText: {C} → Spike Armor During your opponent's next turn, if Sandslash is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Sandslash is Knocked Out) , put 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. {F}{F}{C} → Poison Spike : 60 If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, that Pokémon is now Poisoned.
061.flavorText: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

062.name: Sealeo
062.evolves: Evolves from Spheal and into Walrein or Walrein ex
062.attacksText: {W}{W} → Ice Rider Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
062.flavorText: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

063.name: Shieldon
063.evolves: Evolves from Armor Fossil and into Bastiodon
063.attacksText: {M}{C} → Hard Face : 20 During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Shieldon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {M}{C}{C} → Shield Attack : 40+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage.
063.flavorText: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

064.name: Tropius
064.attacksText: {G} → Bonus Leaf Remove 3 damage counters from each of your Benched Pokémon that has any {G} Energy attached to it. {G}{C} → Whirlwind : 30 Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.
064.flavorText: Because it continually ate only its favorite fruit, the fruit started growing around its neck.

065.name: Unown E
065.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ EQUIP Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Unown E is on your Bench, you may discard all cards attached to Unown E and attach Unown E to 1 of your Pokémon as a Pokémon Tool card. As long as Unown E is attached to a Pokémon, that Pokémon gets +10 HP. {C}{C} → Hidden Power During your opponent's next turn, whenever your opponent flips a coin, treat it as tails.
065.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

066.name: Unown M
066.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ MAGNET Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Unown M is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. This power can't be used if Unown M is affected by a Special Condition. {C} → Hidden Power Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage. If tails, this attack does 30 damage to 1 of your Pokémon, and this attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
066.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

067.name: Unown T
067.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ THROW Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Unown T is your Active Pokémon, you may discard a card from your hand. Then, flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This power can't be used if Unown T is affected by a Special Condition. {C} → Hidden Power Look at your opponent's hand and choose 1 card, then have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck. Then, show your opponent your hand and he or she chooses 1 card. Shuffle that card into your deck.
067.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

068.name: Vigoroth
068.evolves: Evolves from Slakoth and into Slaking or Slaking ex
068.attacksText: {C} → Wake-up Punch : 10 If Vigoroth evolved from Slakoth during this turn and Slakoth was Asleep, this attack's base damage is 60 instead of 10. {C}{C}{C} → Fury Swipes : 30× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
068.flavorText: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still even for a moment.

069.name: Abra
069.evolves: Evolves into Kadabra or Dark Kadabra
069.attacksText: {P} → Play Search Look at the top 5 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Put the other 4 cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. {P}{C} → Ultra Evolution Search your deck for Alakazam and put it on Abra (this counts as evolving Abra). Shuffle your deck afterward.
069.flavorText: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.

070.name: Aipom
070.evolves: Evolves into Ambipom
070.attacksText: {C} → Tail Whap : 10 {C}{C} → Throw Off Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tool cards attached to that Pokémon.
070.flavorText: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.

071.name: Aron
071.attacksText: {M}{C} → Steel Tackle : 30 Aron does 10 damage to itself.
071.flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

072.name: Barboach
072.attacksText: {F} → Mud Spit Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
072.flavorText: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.

073.name: Bidoof
073.attacksText: Held Item ⇢ Wacan Berry Any damage done to Bidoof by attacks from {L} Pokémon is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C} → Tackle : 30

074.name: Bronzor
074.attacksText: {M}{C} → Dull Light : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
074.flavorText: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

075.name: Buizel
075.evolves: Evolves into Floatzel
075.attacksText: Held Item ⇢ Chesto Berry If Buizel is Asleep, remove the Special Condition Asleep from Buizel at the end of each player's turn. {C}{C} → Quick Attack : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage.

076.name: Chansey
076.evolves: Evolves into Blissey or Blissey ex
076.attacksText: {C}{C} → Scrunch Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Chansey by attacks during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Double-edge : 80 Chansey does 60 damage to itself.
076.flavorText: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.

077.name: Chikorita
077.attacksText: {@} → Sleep Scent Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {G} → Jump On : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.
077.flavorText: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

078.name: Croagunk
078.evolves: Evolves into Toxicroak or Toxicroak ex
078.attacksText: {C} → Ghastly Sound Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Supporter cards from his or her hand during his or her next turn. {P}{P} → Finger Poke : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
078.flavorText: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

079.name: Cyndaquil
079.evolves: Evolves into Quilava or Dark Quilava
079.attacksText: {@} → Tackle : 10 {R}{C} → Live Coal : 20
079.flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

080.name: Doduo
080.attacksText: {C} → Double Stab : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads. {C}{C} → Accelerating Stab : 30 Doduo can't use Accelerating Stab during your next turn.
080.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

081.name: Electrike
081.evolves: Evolves into Manectric , Mega Manectric ex , or Manectric ex
081.attacksText: {L} → Electromagnetic Jam : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't attach any Energy cards from his or her hand to the Active Pokémon during his or her next turn.
081.flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

082.name: Exeggcute
082.evolves: Evolves into Exeggutor , Alolan Exeggutor , […] Alolan Exeggutor ex , Alolan Exeggutor- GX
082.attacksText: {G} → Direct-hit Bomb Flip a coin for each Energy attached to Exeggcute. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. For each heads, this attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
082.flavorText: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

083.name: Finneon
083.attacksText: {W} → Elegant Swim Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Finneon during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C} → Tackle : 20
083.flavorText: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

084.name: Geodude
084.attacksText: {F} → Stone Throw Choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
084.flavorText: Many live on mountain trails and remain half buried while keeping an eye on climbers.

085.name: Gible
085.attacksText: {C} → Push Down : 10 Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.
085.flavorText: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

086.name: Kricketot
086.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. {G} → Sling : 10
086.flavorText: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

087.name: Larvitar
087.evolves: Evolves into Pupitar or Dark Pupitar
087.attacksText: {F} → Mountain Bite : 10+ You may discard the top card of your deck. If you do, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage and Larvitar is now Asleep. {C}{C} → Hammer In : 20
087.flavorText: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

088.name: Magby
088.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Baby Evolution Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put Magmar from your hand onto Magby (this counts as evolving Magby) and remove all damage counters from Magby. {@} → Scorch Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.
088.flavorText: Its body temperature is around 1,100 degrees F. It is healthy if it is breathing yellow flames.

089.name: Magikarp
089.evolves: Evolves into Gyarados , Gyarados- GX , Dark Gyarados , or Gyarados ex
089.attacksText: {C} → Flail : 10× Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Magikarp. {W}{W} → Dragon Rage : 60 Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.
089.flavorText: It is said to be the world's weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.

090.name: Murkrow
090.evolves: Evolves into Honchkrow or Honchkrow- GX
090.attacksText: {@} → Swarm Search your deck for Murkrow and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C} → Hide Crowd : 20 Switch Murkrow with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
090.flavorText: It is believed that seeing this Pokémon at night will bring about ominous occurrences.

091.name: Nidoran Female
091.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for Nidoran Male or Nidoran Female and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. {P}{C} → Poison Sting : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
091.flavorText: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.

092.name: Paras
092.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 10 {G}{G} → Mushroom Tackle : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
092.flavorText: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.

093.name: Pichu
093.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Baby Evolution Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put Pikachu from your hand onto Pichu (this counts as evolving Pichu) and remove all damage counters from Pichu. {@} → Chupi : 20 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
093.flavorText: The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.

094.name: Pikachu
094.evolves: Evolves into Raichu , Alolan Raichu , […] Raichu- GX , Dark Raichu
094.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Electro Recycle Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Pichu is anywhere under Pikachu, you may search your discard pile for a {L} Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. This power can't be used if Pikachu is affected by a Special Condition. {L}{C} → BikaBika : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.
094.flavorText: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.

095.name: Remoraid
095.evolves: Evolves into Octillery or Dark Octillery
095.attacksText: {W} → Sharpshooting Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{W} → Numbing Water : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
095.flavorText: It squirts water forcefully from its mouth to shoot down flying prey.

096.name: Sandshrew
096.evolves: Evolves into Sandslash or Dark Sandslash
096.attacksText: {F} → Sand Attack If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. {F}{C} → Ram : 30
096.flavorText: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

097.name: Seel
097.evolves: Evolves into Dewgong or Light Dewgong
097.attacksText: {W}{C} → Freezing Headbutt : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
097.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

098.name: Shinx
098.attacksText: Held Item ⇢ Rawst Berry If Shinx is Burned, remove the Special Condition Burned from Shinx at the end of each player's turn. {L} → Plasma : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for a {L} Energy card and attach it to Shinx.

099.name: Slakoth
099.attacksText: {C} → Drowsy Both Slakoth and the Defending Pokémon are now Asleep.
099.flavorText: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

100.name: Sneasel
100.evolves: Evolves into Weavile or Weavile- GX
100.attacksText: {C} → Double Slap : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads. {D}{C} → Feint Attack Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on that Pokémon.
100.flavorText: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.

101.name: Starly
101.attacksText: {C} → Gust : 10 {C}{C} → Quick Attack : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.
101.flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

102.name: Stunky
102.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 10 {D}{C} → Severe Gas : 10 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
102.flavorText: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

103.name: Turtwig
103.attacksText: {@} → Tackle : 10 {G} → Razor Leaf : 20
103.flavorText: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

104.name: Wurmple
104.attacksText: {C} → Needling Sting : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage. {G} → String Shot : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
104.flavorText: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a STARLY, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.

105.name: Double Full Heal
105.attacksText: Remove all Special Conditions from each of your Active Pokémon.

106.name: Energy Restore
106.attacksText: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, put a basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand. If you don't have that many basic Energy cards in your discard pile, put all of them into your hand.

107.name: Energy Switch
107.attacksText: Move a basic Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

108.name: Night Pokémon Center
108.attacksText: Choose 1 of your Pokémon. Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, remove all damage counters from that Pokémon. If both are tails, discard all Energy cards attached to that Pokémon.

109.name: PlusPower
109.attacksText: Attach PlusPower to 1 of your Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of your turn. If the Pokémon PlusPower is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .

110.name: Poké Ball
110.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

111.name: Pokédex HANDY910is
111.attacksText: Look at the top 2 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck.

112.name: Professor Rowan
112.attacksText: Choose 1 card in your hand and shuffle the rest of your cards into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.) · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

113.name: Rival
113.attacksText: Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Your opponent chooses 3 of those cards. Put those cards into your hand and put other 2 cards on top of your deck.
