Shuffle your deck afterward. · Supporter rule: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

114.name: Speed Stadium
114.attacksText: Once during each player's turn, the player may flip a coin until he or she gets tails. For each heads, that player draws a card. · Stadium rule: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

115.name: Super Scoop Up
115.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

116.name: Warp Point
116.attacksText: Your opponent switches 1 of his or her Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. You switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon, if any.

117.name: Energy Search
117.attacksText: Search your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

118.name: Potion
118.attacksText: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon (remove 1 damage counter if that Pokémon has only 1).

119.name: Switch
119.attacksText: Switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

120.name: Empoleon LV.X
120.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Supreme Command Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may choose up to 2 cards from your opponent's hand without looking and put them face down next to the Defending Pokémon. (These cards are not in play or in your opponent's hand.) At the end of your opponent's next turn, return those cards to your opponent's hand. This power can't be used if Empoleon is affected by a Special Condition. {W}{W}{W} → Hydro Impact Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage to that Pokémon (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Empoleon can't attack during your next turn. · Level-Up rule: Put this card onto your Active Empoleon. Empoleon LV. X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

121.name: Infernape LV.X
121.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Burning Head Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Discard the other 2 cards. This power can't be used if Infernape is affected by a Special Condition. {R}{R} → Flare Up : 150 Search your discard pile for 8 {R} Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and shuffle them into your deck. (This attack does nothing if you don't have 8 {R} Energy cards in your discard pile.) · Level-Up rule: Put this card onto your Active Infernape. Infernape LV. X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

122.name: Torterra LV.X
122.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Forest Murmurs Once during your turn (before your attack) , if you have more Prize cards left than your opponent, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. This power can't be used if Torterra is affected by a Special Condition. {G}{G}{G}{C} → Vigorous Dash : 100 Does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Torterra does 30 damage to itself. · Level-Up rule: Put this card onto your Active Torterra. Torterra LV. X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

001.name: Dialga
001.attacksText: {M} → Time Bellow : 10 Draw a card. {M}{M}{C} → Flash Cannon : 40 You may return all Energy cards attached to Dialga to your hand. If you do, remove the highest Stage Evolution card from the Defending Pokémon and shuffle that card into your opponent's deck.
001.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

002.name: Dusknoir
002.evolves: Evolves from Dusclops and into Dusknoir LV. X
002.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Dark Palm Once during your turn (before your attack) , if your opponent has 4 or more Benched Pokémon, you may choose 1 of them and shuffle that Pokémon and all cards attached to it into his or her deck. This power can't be used if Dusknoir is affected by a Special Condition. {P}{P}{C} → Hard Feelings Put 5 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. Then, count the number of Prize cards your opponent has taken and put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.
002.flavorText: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

003.name: Electivire
003.evolves: Evolves from Electabuzz and into Electivire LV. X
003.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Intense Voltage As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , if Elekid is anywhere under Electivire, you may move a {L} Energy attached to your Pokémon to Electivire. This power can't be used if Electivire is affected by a Special Condition. {L}{L}{L}{C} → Giga Impact : 60 You may discard all {L} Energy attached to Electivire. If you do, this attack's base damage is 120 instead of 60.
003.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

004.name: Empoleon
004.evolves: Evolves from Prinplup and into Empoleon LV. X or Empoleon BREAK
004.attacksText: {W}{C} → Ice Blade Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{W}{C} → Aqua Jet : 70 Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
004.flavorText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

005.name: Infernape
005.evolves: Evolves from Monferno and into Infernape LV. X
005.attacksText: {C} → Meteor Punch : 30× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {R}{R} → Flare Blitz : 90 Discard all {R} Energy attached to Infernape.
005.flavorText: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

006.name: Lucario
006.evolves: Evolves from Riolu and into Lucario LV. X
006.attacksText: {C} → Feint : 30 This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance. {F}{F} → Aura Sphere : 40 Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
006.flavorText: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

007.name: Luxray
007.evolves: Evolves from Luxio and into Luxray BREAK
007.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Gleam Eyes Once during your turn, when you play Luxray from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may look at your opponent's hand. If your opponent's Bench isn't full, choose 1 Basic Pokémon from your opponent's hand, and put it onto his or her Bench. Then, switch it with the Defending Pokémon. {L}{L}{L}{L} → Lightning Star : 80 Move all {L} Energy attached to Luxray to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Ignore this effect if you don't have any Benched Pokémon.)
007.flavorText: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

008.name: Magnezone
008.evolves: Evolves from Magneton and into Magnezone LV. X
008.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Magnetize If you have any {M} Energy attached to your Active Pokémon, the Retreat Cost for that Pokémon is 0. {M}{C}{C} → Metal Blast : 50+ Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each {M} Energy attached to Magnezone.
008.flavorText: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

009.name: Manaphy
009.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. {W}{W} → Aqua Ring : 30 Switch Manaphy with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
009.flavorText: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

010.name: Mismagius
010.attacksText: {P} → Avenge Count the number of your Pokémon that have any damage counters on them. Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. {P}{P}{C} → Psywave : 30+ Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.
010.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

011.name: Palkia
011.attacksText: {W} → Spacial Rend : 10 Search your deck for a Stadium card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If there is any Stadium card in play, discard it. {W}{W}{C} → Transback : 40 You may flip a coin. If heads, discard all Energy attached to Palkia and put the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it on top of your opponent's deck. Your opponent shuffles his or her deck afterward.
011.flavorText: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

012.name: Rhyperior
012.evolves: Evolves from Rhydon and into Rhyperior LV. X
012.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Earth Fissure Once during your turn, when you play Rhyperior from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may discard the top 3 cards from your opponent's deck. {F}{F}{C} → Rock Wrecker : 80 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. Rhyperior can't attack during your next turn.
012.flavorText: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

013.name: Roserade
013.attacksText: {G}{G} → Poison Sting : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. {G}{G}{C} → Spike Whip : 50 If Budew is anywhere under Roserade, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
013.flavorText: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

014.name: Shiftry
014.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Darkness Fan Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Shiftry is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Evolved Pokémon on your opponent's Bench, remove the highest Stage Evolution card from that Pokémon, and put it back into his or her hand. This power can't be used if Shiftry is affected by a Special Condition. {D}{D}{C} → Spirit Dance : 50+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.
014.flavorText: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

015.name: Skuntank
015.attacksText: {D}{D} → Frustration Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that doesn't have any damage counters on it. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {D}{D}{C} → Toxic Cloud : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on the Defending Pokémon between turns.
015.flavorText: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

016.name: Staraptor
016.attacksText: {C} → Accelerative Dive : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all damage done to Staraptor by attacks (both yours and your opponent's) until the end of your next turn. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Brave Heart : 100 Flip a coin. If tails, Staraptor does 100 damage to itself.
016.flavorText: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

017.name: Torterra
017.evolves: Evolves from Grotle and into Torterra LV. X
017.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Body Slam : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {G}{G}{C}{C} → Leaf Storm : 60 Remove 2 damage counters from each of your {G} Pokémon.
017.flavorText: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

018.name: Azumarill
018.attacksText: {C} → Defense Curl Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Azumarill during your opponent's next turn. {W}{W} → Bubble Pump : 40+ If Azumarill has 3 or more Energy attached to it, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If Azurill is anywhere under Azumarill, flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
018.flavorText: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.

019.name: Beautifly
019.attacksText: {C}{C} → Whirlwind : 30 Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {G}{G}{C}{C} → Giga Drain : 50 After your attack, remove from Beautifly the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.
019.flavorText: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

020.name: Bibarel
020.attacksText: {C} → Rest Remove all Special Conditions and 4 damage counters from Bibarel. Bibarel is now Asleep. {C}{C}{C} → Take Down : 60 Bibarel does 10 damage to itself.
020.flavorText: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

021.name: Carnivine
021.attacksText: {G}{C} → Swallow Up : 30 Before doing damage, count the remaining HP of the Defending Pokémon and Carnivine. If the Defending Pokémon has fewer remaining HP than Carnivine's, this attack does 60 damage instead. {G}{G} → Wring Out : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.
021.flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

022.name: Clefable
022.attacksText: {C}{C} → Double Slap : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {C}{C}{C} → Metronome Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else in order to use that attack.) Clefable performs that attack.
022.flavorText: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.

023.name: Drapion
023.evolves: Evolves from Skorupi and into Drapion LV. X
023.attacksText: {C}{C} → Stomp : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. {P}{P}{C} → Poison Claws : 50 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
023.flavorText: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

024.name: Drifblim
024.attacksText: {C} → Wind Wave Search your discard pile for up to 5 in any combination of Pokémon and Supporter cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck. {P}{P}{P} → Explosive Smoke : 60 Does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) . (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
024.flavorText: It's drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

025.name: Dustox
025.attacksText: {G}{C} → Stun Spore : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {G}{G}{C}{C} → Toxic Dust : 50 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on the Defending Pokémon between turns.

026.name: Floatzel

If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. {W}{W} → Water Gun : 40+ Does 40 damage plus 20 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to Floatzel but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way.
026.flavorText: It floats using its well-developed floatation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

027.name: Gengar
027.evolves: Evolves from Haunter and into Gengar LV. X
027.attacksText: {C} → Life Drain Flip a coin. If heads, put damage counters on the Defending Pokémon until it is 10 HP away from being Knocked Out. {P}{P}{C} → Shadow Dance Put 4 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like. Then, switch Gengar with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
027.flavorText: It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools that area by nearly 10 degrees F.

028.name: Heracross
028.attacksText: {C} → Pitch : 10 Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {G}{G} → Horn Slash : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.
028.flavorText: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It's strong enough to hurl foes.

029.name: Hippowdon
029.evolves: Evolves from Hippopotas and into Hippowdon LV. X
029.attacksText: {F}{C}{C} → Vacuum Up : 40 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. {F}{F}{C}{C} → Sand Eject : 60 During your next turn, if an attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , that attack does 40 more damage.
029.flavorText: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

030.name: Lopunny
030.attacksText: {C} → Healing Wish Flip a coin until you get tails. Remove a number of damage counters equal to the number of heads from 1 of your Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Flop : 30 Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) You may switch Lopunny with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
030.flavorText: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

031.name: Machamp
031.evolves: Evolves from Machoke and into Machamp BREAK or Machamp LV. X
031.attacksText: {F} → Revenge : 20+ If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during his or her last turn, this attack does 20 damage plus 50 more damage. {F}{F}{F} → Dynamic Punch : 60+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 damage plus 30 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
031.flavorText: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.

032.name: Medicham
032.attacksText: {F} → Force Palm Count the number of damage counters on Medicham. Put that many damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. {F}{F}{C} → Spinning Kick : 80 Medicham does 20 damage to itself.
032.flavorText: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. Its movements are elegant.

033.name: Munchlax
033.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Baby Evolution Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put Snorlax from your hand onto Munchlax (this counts as evolving Munchlax) and remove all damage counters from Munchlax. {C} → Heave : 30× Discard 2 cards from your hand. (If you can't discard 2 cards, this attack does nothing.) Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
033.flavorText: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

034.name: Noctowl
034.evolves: Evolves from Hoothoot and into Noctowl BREAK
034.attacksText: {C} → See Beyond Choose a card from your hand and put it as a Prize card face up. Then, choose 1 of your face-down Prize cards without looking and put it into your hand. This attack does nothing if all of your Prize cards are face up. {C}{C}{C} → Extrasensory : 30+ If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 30 damage plus 50 more damage.
034.flavorText: Its eyes are special. They can pick out objects as long as there is the tiniest amount of light.

035.name: Pachirisu
035.attacksText: {C} → Minor Errand-Running Search your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {L} → Thunder Jolt : 20 Flip a coin. If tails, Pachirisu does 10 damage to itself.
035.flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

036.name: Purugly
036.attacksText: {C} → High Hat Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Body Slam : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
036.flavorText: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.

037.name: Snorlax
037.attacksText: {C} → Block The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Ease Up : 40+ Snorlax is now Asleep. If Snorlax is evolved from Munchlax, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage.
037.flavorText: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.

038.name: Steelix
038.attacksText: {M} → Slam : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {M}{M}{C}{C} → Metal Slash : 100 Steelix can't attack during your next turn.
038.flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

039.name: Vespiquen
039.evolves: Evolves from Combee
039.attacksText: {G} → Leaf Honey Discard a {G} Energy attached to Vespiquen and remove all damage counters from 1 of your Benched {G} Pokémon. {G}{C}{C} → Attack Order : 10× Does 10 damage times the number of {G} Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) .
039.flavorText: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.

040.name: Weavile
040.attacksText: {D} → Nasty Plot Search your deck for any 1 card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {D}{D}{D} → Dark Pulse : 10× Does 10 damage times the total amount of {D} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.
040.flavorText: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

041.name: Wobbuffet
041.evolves: Evolves into Wobbuffet BREAK
041.attacksText: {P}{C} → Countercharge Flip a coin. If heads, move all damage counters from Wobbuffet to the Defending Pokémon.
041.flavorText: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

042.name: Wynaut
042.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Baby Evolution Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put Wobbuffet from your hand onto Wynaut (this counts as evolving Wynaut) and remove all damage counters from Wynaut. {@} → Astonish Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking. Look at the card you chose, then have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck.
042.flavorText: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.

043.name: Budew
043.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Baby Evolution Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put Roselia from your hand onto Budew (this counts as evolving Budew) and remove all damage counters from Budew. {@} → Errand-Running Search your deck for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
043.flavorText: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

044.name: Cascoon
044.evolves: Evolves from Wurmple and into Dustox or Dustox ex
044.attacksText: {G} → Harden During your opponent's next turn, if Cascoon would be damaged by an attack, prevent that attack's damage done to Cascoon if that damage is 30 or less. {G}{C} → Gooey Thread : 20 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
044.flavorText: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.

045.name: Cherrim
045.attacksText: {G} → Worry Seed : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. {G}{G} → Magical Leaf : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage and remove 3 damage counters from Cherrim.
045.flavorText: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

046.name: Drifloon
046.evolves: Evolves into Drifblim
046.attacksText: {P} → Blowing Wind Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to on top of your deck. 046.flavorText: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

047.name: Dusclops
047.evolves: Evolves from Duskull and into Dusknoir
047.attacksText: {P}{C} → Roam Flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
047.flavorText: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

048.name: Elekid
048.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Baby Evolution Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put Electabuzz from your hand onto Elekid (this counts as evolving Elekid) and remove all damage counters from Elekid. {@} → Outlet Search your deck for a {L} Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
048.flavorText: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can't store the energy it makes.

049.name: Grotle
049.evolves: Evolves from Turtwig and into Torterra or Torterra ex
049.attacksText: {G} → Synthesis Search your deck for a {G} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward. {G}{C}{C} → Cut : 50
049.flavorText: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

050.name: Haunter
050.evolves: Evolves from Gastly and into Gengar , Mega Gengar ex , or Gengar ex
050.attacksText: {P} → Hypnosis The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {P}{P} → Dream Eater : 60 If the Defending Pokémon is not Asleep, this attack does nothing.
050.flavorText: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.

051.name: Hippopotas
051.evolves: Evolves into Hippowdon
051.attacksText: {C} → Yawn The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {F} → Sand Attack : 10 If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.
051.flavorText: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

052.name: Luxio
052.evolves: Evolves from Shinx and into Luxray or Luxray ex

054.evolves: Evolves from Magnemite and into Magnezone or Magnezone ex

055.name: Mantyke

057.evolves: Evolves from Seedot and into Shiftry , Shiftry- GX , or Shiftry ex

058.name: Prinplup
058.evolves: Evolves from Piplup and into Empoleon or Empoleon ex
058.attacksText: {W} → Aqua Shower Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {W}{W} → Brine Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
058.flavorText: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

059.name: Rapidash
059.attacksText: {C}{C} → Overrun : 20 Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {R}{R}{C} → Blaze Up : 50 Flip a coin. If tails, discard a {R} Energy attached to Rapidash and this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

060.name: Rhydon
060.evolves: Evolves from Rhyhorn and into Rhyperior
060.attacksText: {F}{C} → Storm Up : 30+ If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage. Discard that Stadium card. {F}{F}{C} → Crash Impact : 60 Rhydon does 10 damage to itself. Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any.

061.name: Riolu
061.evolves: Evolves into Lucario , Mega Lucario ex , Lucario- GX , or Lucario ex
061.attacksText: {F} → Wild Kick : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
061.flavorText: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

062.name: Seaking
062.evolves: Evolves from Goldeen
062.attacksText: {C}{C} → Flail : 10× Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Seaking. {W}{W} → Horn Drill : 50
062.flavorText: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.

063.name: Silcoon
063.evolves: Evolves from Wurmple and into Beautifly
063.attacksText: {G} → Harden During your opponent's next turn, If Silcoon would be damaged by an attack, prevent that attack's damage done to Silcoon if that damage is 30 or less. {G}{C} → Entangling String : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

064.attacksText: {C}{C} → Whirlwind : 20 Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon. {C}{C} → Clutch : 20 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
064.flavorText: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

065.name: Unown A

065.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

066.name: Unown B
066.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ BOUNCE Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Unown B is on your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, discard all cards attached to any 1 of your Unown and shuffle that Pokémon back into your deck. {C} → Hidden Power : 10
066.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

067.name: Unown C

067.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

068.name: Unown D
068.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ DRAW Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Unown D is on your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, each player may draw a card. (You draw your card first.) {C} → Hidden Power : 10
068.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

069.name: Azurill
069.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Baby Evolution Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put Marill from your hand onto Azurill (this counts a evolving Azurill) and remove all damage counters from Azurill. {@} → Delivery Put any 1 card from your discard pile into your hand.
069.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.

070.name: Bidoof
070.evolves: Evolves into Bibarel
070.attacksText: {C} → Amnesia Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn. {C} → Scavenge Search your discard pile for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.
070.flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

071.name: Bonsly
071.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Baby Evolution Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put Sudowoodo from your hand onto Bonsly (this counts as evolving Bonsly) and remove all damage counters from Bonsly. {@} → Fake Tears Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Trainer cards from his or her hand during your opponent's next turn, and any damage done to Bonsly by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
071.flavorText: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body's fluid levels by eliminating excess.

072.name: Buizel
072.attacksText: {W} → Splash About : 10+ If Buizel has less Energy attached to it than the Defending Pokémon, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.
072.flavorText: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

073.name: Buneary
073.evolves: Evolves into Lopunny or Mega Lopunny ex
073.attacksText: {C} → Splash : 10 {C}{C} → Jump Kick : 10 Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
073.flavorText: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

074.name: Chatot
074.attacksText: {C} → Me First Draw a card. {C} → Tone-Deaf : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
074.flavorText: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

075.name: Cherubi
075.evolves: Evolves into Cherrim
075.attacksText: {G} → Sleep Powder The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {G}{C} → Leech Seed : 20 If this attack does any damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , remove 1 damage counter from Cherubi.
075.flavorText: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

076.name: Chimchar
076.attacksText: {@} → Scratch : 10 {R}{C} → Ember : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, discard a {R} Energy attached to Chimchar.
076.flavorText: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

077.name: Clefairy
077.evolves: Evolves into Clefable , Mega Clefable ex , or Clefable ex
077.attacksText: {C} → Sing The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C} → Moon Impact : 20+ If Clefairy is evolved from Cleffa, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage.
077.flavorText: Thought to live with others on quiet mountains, it is popular for its adorable nature.

078.name: Cleffa
078.attacksText: Poké-POWER ⇢ Baby Evolution Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may put Clefairy from your hand onto Cleffa (this counts as evolving Cleffa) and remove all damage counters from Cleffa. {@} → Eeek Draw a card.
078.flavorText: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.

079.name: Combee

079.flavorText: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.

080.name: Duskull
080.evolves: Evolves into Dusclops or Dusclops ex
080.attacksText: {C} → Disable Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn. {P}{C} → Night Shade : 20 Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
080.flavorText: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

081.name: Electabuzz
081.evolves: Evolves into Electivire or Electivire ex
081.attacksText: {L}{C} → Thunderpunch : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, Electabuzz does 10 damage to itself. {L}{L} → Shock Wave : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If Electabuzz is evolved from Elekid, this attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
081.flavorText: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.

082.name: Gastly
082.evolves: Evolves into Haunter or Dark Haunter
082.attacksText: {P} → Pain Payback Move 1 damage counter from Gastly to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
082.flavorText: This Pokémon's body is 95% made up of gases, which are blown away by strong gusts of wind.

083.name: Glameow
083.attacksText: {C} → Charm During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C} → Pose : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
083.flavorText: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness if very popular among some.

084.name: Goldeen
084.attacksText: {C} → Horn Attack : 10 {W}{C} → Take Down : 30 Goldeen does 10 damage to itself.
084.flavorText: It swims elegantly by flittering its tail as if it were a dress. It has the look of a queen.

085.name: Hoothoot
085.attacksText: {C} → Hypnosis The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C} → Kick Shot : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
085.flavorText: It always stands on one foot. Even when attacked, it does not brace itself using both feet.

086.name: Machop
086.evolves: Evolves into Machoke , Dark Machoke , or Light Machoke
086.attacksText: {F} → Low Kick : 20
086.flavorText: It hefts a GRAVELER repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

087.name: Magnemite
087.evolves: Evolves into Magneton or Dark Magneton
087.attacksText: {M} → Metal Sound Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. {M}{C} → Resonance : 20+ If the Defending Pokémon is Confused, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage.
087.flavorText: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.

088.name: Marill

088.attacksText: {C} → Rollout : 10+ If Marill is evolved from Azurill, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage. {W}{W} → Splashing Turn : 20 Switch Marill with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
088.flavorText: Using its tail as a float, it dives underwater. It likes eating plants that grow on river bottoms.

089.name: Meditite
089.evolves: Evolves into Medicham or Medicham ex
089.attacksText: {F} → Detect Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Meditite during your opponent's next turn. {F}{C} → Meditate : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.
089.flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

090.name: Mime Jr.

Then, draw a number of cards equal to the number of cards in your opponent's hand.
090.flavorText: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

091.name: Misdreavus
091.evolves: Evolves into Mismagius or Mismagius ex

091.flavorText: It loves to sneak up on people late at night, then startle them with its shrieklike cry.

092.name: Onix

092.attacksText: {F} → Tunneling Choose up to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Onix can't attack during your next turn. {C}{C} → Headbutt : 20

If tails, Shining Charizard does 30 damage to itself. · Shining rule: You can't have more than 1 Shining Charizard in your deck.
107.flavorText: The flames it breathes are so hot that they can melt anything.

108.name: Shining Kabutops
108.attacksText: {F}{F}{L} → Lightning Cut : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage and does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If tails, this attack does 30 damage and Shining Kabutops does 10 damage to itself. {F}{F}{W}{W} → Water Slash : 50+ Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to Shining Kabutops but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Don't apply Resistance. · Shining rule: You can't have more than 1 Shining Kabutops in your deck.
108.flavorText: This ancient Pokémon uses its razor-sharp claws to cut open its prey and gain access to its blood.

109.name: Shining Mewtwo
109.attacksText: {P}{L} → Reflect Shield If an attack does damage to Shining Mewtwo during your opponent's next turn (even if Shining Mewtwo is Knocked Out) , flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Shining Mewtwo from that attack (any other effects of attacks still happen) and do 20 damage to the attacking Pokémon. {P}{P}{R} → Psyburst : 40+ Discard a {R} Energy card attached to Shining Mewtwo or this attack does nothing. This attack does 40 damage plus 10 damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. · Shining rule: You can't have more than 1 Shining Mewtwo in your deck.
109.flavorText: It uses its highly developed psychic powers to defeat its enemies before they even have time to think.

110.name: Shining Noctowl
110.attacksText: {P}{L}{C} → Flashing Eyes : 30 Flip 3 coins. If exactly 1 is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If exactly 2 are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If all 3 are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. · Shining rule: You can't have more than 1 Shining Noctowl in your deck.
110.flavorText: It speeds up its thought processes by turning its head around 180 degrees.

111.name: Shining Raichu
111.attacksText: {L}{L}{W}{W} → Thundersquall : 40 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon for each {W} Energy attached to Shining Raichu. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) · Shining rule: You can't have more than 1 Shining Raichu in your deck.
111.flavorText: If the electricity in its cheeks runs out, it sticks its tail straight up and uses it to collect energy from the air.

112.name: Shining Steelix
112.attacksText: {M}{M}{F}{F} → Crushing Earth : 80 Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (yours and your opponent's) . (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If tails, this attack does nothing. Either way, Shining Steelix can't attack during your next turn. · Shining rule: You can't have more than 1 Shining Steelix in your deck.
112.flavorText: If an Onix lives 100 years or more, its skin hardens, eventually becoming even harder than a diamond.

113.name: Shining Tyranitar
113.attacksText: {D}{F}{F} → Mountain Crush : 30 Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, your opponent discards the top card from his or her deck. {D}{R}{R}{R} → Destructive Fire : 50 Flip a coin for each {R} Energy card attached to Shining Tyranitar. For each heads, discard a {R} Energy card attached to Shining Tyranitar or this attack does nothing. Then, for each heads, choose an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and discard it. If it has fewer Energy cards than that, remove all of them. · Shining rule: You can't have more than 1 Shining Tyranitar in your deck.
113.flavorText: It is so powerful, it can knock down a mountain with hust one arm.

001.name: Dark Ampharos
001.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Conductivity Whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from his or her hand to a Pokémon, this power does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power stops working if you have more than 1 Dark Ampharos in play or while Dark Ampharos is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {L}{C}{C} → Shock Bolt : 50 Discard all {L} Energy cards attached to Dark Ampharos or this attack does nothing.
001.flavorText: Its brightly lit tail can be seen for miles in the dark, even by ships on the sea.

002.name: Dark Crobat
002.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Surprise Bite When you play Dark Crobat from your hand, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This power does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) {G}{G} → Dark Drain Flip a coin for each of your opponent's Pokémon. For each heads, this attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. Remove a number of damage counters from Dark Crobat equal to the damage dealt. If Dark Crobat has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.
002.flavorText: Although the wings it has evolved on its feet allow it to fly at high speeds, they unfortunately make it difficult to perch.

003.name: Dark Donphan
003.attacksText: {F}{F} → Tusk Toss If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, return the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your opponent's hand. If tails, your opponent chooses 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. {F}{F}{C} → Giant Tusk : 50
003.flavorText: The larger its tusks, the higher its status in the herd.

004.name: Dark Espeon
004.attacksText: {C} → Gouge : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage. {P}{C}{C} → Psysplash Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon for each Energy card attached to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.
004.flavorText: The tips of its split tail quiver whenever it uses its psychic abilities to read its opponent's next move.

005.name: Dark Feraligatr
005.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Scare As long as Dark Feraligatr is your Active Pokémon, all of your opponent's Baby Pokémon Powers stop working and your opponent's Baby Pokémon can't attack. This power stops working while Dark Feraligatr is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {W}{W}{W} → Crushing Blow : 50 If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of those cards and discard it.
005.flavorText: Its powerful muscles allow it to move at a speed that belies its bulk.

006.name: Dark Gengar
006.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Deep Sleep As long as any Dark Gengar are in play, a player flips 2 coins for each of his or her Pokémon that is Asleep at the end of each turn. If either of them is tails, that Pokémon is still Asleep. This power stops working if Dark Gengar is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {P}{P}{P} → Pull In : 30 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, you may choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon (before doing damage or other effects of this attack). Either way, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
006.flavorText: It absorbs the heat in the air around it. If you suddenly feel cold, it's because a Gengar has appeared.

007.name: Dark Houndoom
007.attacksText: {C} → Eerie Howl If your opponent's Bench isn't full, look at his or her hand. If your opponent has any Baby Pokémon or Basic Pokémon there, choose 1 of them and put it on his or her Bench. Then, switch it with the Defending Pokémon. {R}{C} → Dark Fire : 30+ If there are any {D} Energy cards attached to Dark Houndoom, discard 1 of them and this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage (plus 10 more damage for the {D} Energy you discarded). If there aren't any, this attack does 30 damage.
007.flavorText: The flame it breathes is actually a volatile poison it produces internally that ignites when exposed to air.

008.name: Dark Porygon2
008.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Spatial Distortion Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may flip a coin. If heads, choose a Stadium card from your discard pile and put it into play. (If there's already a Stadium card in play, discard it.) This power can't be used if Dark Porygon2 is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {C}{C}{C} → Curve Attack : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done by attacks to Dark Porygon2 during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)
008.flavorText: Advances in technology have allowed it to evolve. It occasionally displays behavior not found in its programming.

009.name: Dark Scizor
009.attacksText: {C}{C} → Threaten Flip a coin. If heads, look at your opponent's hand. If he or she has any Trainer cards there, choose 1 of them. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck. {C}{C}{C} → Slash : 30
009.flavorText: Nothing can withstand the pressure of the vise-like grip of this Pokémon's steel claws.

010.name: Dark Typhlosion
010.attacksText: {C} → Claw Swipe : 20 {R} → Rushing Flames : 40× You may discard any number of {R} Energy cards attached to your Pokémon. Flip a coin for each {R} Energy card discarded in this way. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.
010.flavorText: When it's in combat, the air around it shimmers and warps from the intense heat it produces.

011.name: Dark Tyranitar
011.attacksText: {F} → Mountain Smasher : 20× Flip a number of coins equal to the number of {F} Energy cards attached to Dark Tyranitar. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. Then, for each heads, discard the top card from your opponent's deck. {F}{F}{F}{C} → Fling Away : 50 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, this attack does 30 damage instead of 50 and choose 1 of those Benched Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
011.flavorText: Its power is such that not even mountains can stand in its way.

012.name: Light Arcanine
012.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Drive Off As long as Light Arcanine is your Active Pokémon, once during your turn (before your attack) , if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. This power can't be used while Light Arcanine is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {R}{R}{C} → Gentle Flames : 50 If the Defending Pokémon is a Baby Pokémon, this attack does 10 damage instead of 50. If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, this attack does 30 damage instead of 50.
012.flavorText: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is easily recognized by its large flowing mane.

013.name: Light Azumarill
013.attacksText: {W} → Bubble : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{C}{C} → Bubble Jump : 30 If you have any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, take 2 Energy cards attached to Light Azumarill and attach them to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then return Light Azumarill and all cards attached to it to your hand.
013.flavorText: It curls up its long ears when swimming to prevent water from entering them.

014.name: Light Dragonite
014.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Miraculous Wind As long as Light Dragonite is your Active Pokémon, each Special Energy card provides {C} Energy instead of its usual type and its other effects stop working. This power stops working while Light Dragonite is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {C}{C}{C} → Light Wave : 40 Prevent all effects of attacks, other than damage, done to Light Dragonite during your opponent's next turn.
014.flavorText: It is said to fly constantly over the sea, looking for people in need of aid.

015.name: Light Togetic
015.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Gift When you play Light Togetic from your hand, your opponent may search his or her deck for a Pokémon Tool card, show that card to you, and put it into his or her hand. Either way, you may do the same, and then each player who searched shuffles his or her deck. {C}{C} → Sweet Kiss : 30 Your opponent may draw a card.
015.flavorText: It becomes depressed if it is not near kind-hearted people. Is is able to float in the air without moving its wings.

016.name: Miracle Energy
016.attacksText: You can't have more than 1 Miracle Energy in your deck. Attach Miracle Energy to 1 of your Shining or Light Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard Miracle Energy. While in play, Miracle Energy counts as every type of Energy but provides only 2 Energy at a time.

017.name: Dark Ariados
017.attacksText: {G} → Entangle If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon, then flip a coin. If heads, the new Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {G}{G}{G} → Poison Bind : 30 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat until the end of your opponent's next turn and if the effect of an attack, Pokémon Power, or Trainer card would change that player's Active Pokémon, that part of the effect does nothing.
017.flavorText: Wherever it goes, it spins a thread that always leads back to its web.

018.name: Dark Magcargo
018.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Hot Plate As long as Dark Magcargo is your Active Pokémon, whenever a player puts a Baby Pokémon or Basic Pokémon onto his or her Bench from his or her hand, this power does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power stops working if Dark Magcargo is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {R}{R} → Ball of Flame : 20 You may discard a {R} Energy card attached to Dark Magcargo when you use this attack. If you do and if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 20 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
018.flavorText: The shell on its back comes off easily, exposing the flames running through its body.

019.name: Dark Omastar
019.attacksText: {W} → Prehistoric Water If your opponent has any evolved Pokémon in play, choose 1 of them and flip a coin. If heads, your opponent takes the highest Stage Evolution card on that Pokémon and shuffles it into his or her deck. {W}{C} → Dark Tentacle : 30 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't evolve except from effects of attacks or Pokémon Powers. (Benching that Pokémon ends this effect.)
019.flavorText: Nothing can escape once wrapped in its tentacles, which it uses for self-defense as well as to catch food.

020.name: Dark Slowking
020.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Cunning Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may flip a coin. If heads, look at the top card of your opponent's deck. Then, you may have your opponent shuffle his or her deck. This power can't be used if Dark Slowking is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {P}{P} → Mind Shock : 30 Don't apply Weakness or Resistance for this attack.
020.flavorText: Each time it yawns, the Shellder on its head releases an enzyme that makes it grow even smarter.

021.name: Dark Ursaring
021.attacksText: {C} → Provoke Look at your opponent's hand. If he or she has any Baby Pokémon and/or Basic Pokémon there, you may put any number of them onto your opponent's Bench (as long as there's room) . Then, your opponent looks at your hand. If you have any Baby Pokémon and/or Basic Pokémon there, your opponent may put any number of them onto your Bench (as long as there's room) . {C}{C} → Battle Frenzy For each Pokémon in play (yours and your opponent's) , flip a coin. For each heads, this attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack.
021.flavorText: Its keen nose can pick out any scent, even that of food buried deep underground.

022.name: Light Dragonair
022.evolves: Evolves from Dratini and into Light Dragonite
022.attacksText: {C}{C} → Healing Light Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. {C}{C}{C} → Protective Wave : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Light Dragonair.
022.flavorText: The aura it projects from its body has an effect on the surrounding climate and weather.

023.name: Light Lanturn
023.attacksText: {L} → Searchlight Flip a coin. If heads, each player may choose a card from his or her discard pile and put it into his or her hand. {L}{L} → Spark : 30 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
023.flavorText: This Pokémon has evolved its dorsal fin to emit light, which attracts the fish it feeds on.

024.name: Light Ledian
024.attacksText: {G} → Flash Touch If you have any Benched Pokémon, switch 1 of them with Light Ledian. As long as that Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, it can't become Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. (All other effects of attacks, Pokémon Powers, and Trainer cards still happen.) {G}{C}{C} → Comet Punch : 20× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
024.flavorText: The number of spots on its back increase or decrease depending on the number of stars visible in the night sky.

025.name: Light Machamp
025.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Tag Team When you play Light Machamp from your hand, if it is on your Bench, remove 3 damage counters from your Active Pokémon. If it has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them. Then, switch Light Machamp with your Active Pokémon. {F}{F}{F} → Beatdown : 50 If the Defending Pokémon has Dark in its name or is a {D} Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 100 damage instead of 50.
025.flavorText: It uses its four arms in combat to unleash a ceaseless flurry of punches.

026.name: Light Piloswine
026.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Fluffy Wool During your opponent's turn, if Light Piloswine is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by your opponent's attack (even if it's Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, the attacking Pokémon is now Asleep. This power stops working if Light Piloswine is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed when your opponent attacks. {C}{C}{C} → Knock Over : 30 If there is a Stadium card in play, you may discard it.
026.flavorText: Its legs are short, but its hooves are wide and flat, allowing it to easily walk over snow.

027.name: Unown G
027.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ [Give] Once during your turn (before your attack) , if you have Unown G, Unown I, Unown V, and Unown E on your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward. {P} → Hidden Power : 10 · Unown rule: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.
027.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

028.name: Unown H
028.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ [Help] Once during your turn (before your attack) , if you have Unown H, Unown E, Unown L, and Unown P on your Bench, you may shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw a new hand of the same number of cards. {P} → Hidden Power : 10 · Unown rule: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.
028.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

029.name: Unown W
029.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ [Want] Once during your turn (before your attack) , if you have Unown W, Unown A, Unown N, and Unown T on your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand. {P} → Hidden Power : 10 · Unown rule: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.
029.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

030.name: Unown X
030.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ [XXXXX] Whenever 1 of your Pokémon with Unown in its name uses its Hidden Power attack, flip a coin until you get tails. That attack does 10 more damage for each heads. If you have more than 1 Unown X in play, use only 1 [XXXXX] each turn. {P} → Hidden Power : 10 · Unown rule: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.
030.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

031.name: Chansey
031.evolves: Evolves into Blissey or Blissey ex
031.attacksText: {C}{C} → Doubleslap : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. {C}{C}{C} → Egg Toss : 80 Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.
031.flavorText: It holds its egg carefully when moving so as not to break it. Still, it is fast enough to disappear in the blink of an eye.

032.name: Dark Croconaw
032.evolves: Evolves from Totodile and into Dark Feraligatr
032.attacksText: {W}{W} → Clamping Jaw : 20 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. (Benching either Pokémon ends this effect.)
032.flavorText: It has 49 teeth in its mouth that are constantly replacing themselves. Pull one out, and a new one grows in.

033.name: Dark Exeggutor
033.attacksText: {C} → Triple Headbutt : 10× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads. {P}{C} → MAX Burst : 20× Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy cards attached to your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
033.flavorText: If one of its heads falls off, it turns into an Exeggcute, which begins to look for other Exeggcutes using a special form of telepathy.

034.name: Dark Flaaffy
034.evolves: Evolves from Mareep and into Dark Ampharos
034.attacksText: {L} → High Voltage : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play Trainer cards during his or her next turn. {L}{C} → Stun Wave : 30 If the Defending Pokémon has a Pokémon Power, that power stops working until the end of your next turn.
034.flavorText: As a result of storing massive amounts of electricity there, it can no longer grow wool on certain areas of its body.

035.name: Dark Forretress
035.attacksText: {C} → Armor Up Until the end of your next turn, if Dark Forretress would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, Dark Forretress is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead. {G}{G} → Explosion : 60 Dark Forretress does 60 damage to itself.
035.flavorText: It stays motionless in trees, driving away with flying armored shards from its hard shell any who come close.

036.name: Dark Haunter
036.evolves: Evolves from Gastly and into Dark Gengar
036.attacksText: {P} → Call Back Put a Baby Pokémon or Basic Pokémon card from your opponent's discard pile onto his or her Bench. Put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.) {P}{P} → Surround : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If tails, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
036.flavorText: It silently hunts its prey in dark rooms.

037.name: Dark Omanyte
037.evolves: Evolves from Mysterious Fossil or Buried Fossil and into Dark Omastar
037.attacksText: {W} → Water Cannon Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage for each {W} Energy card attached to Dark Omanyte. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. You can't do more than 30 damage in this way.
037.flavorText: This ancient Pokémon possessed 10 tentacles, which it used to swim through the ocean.

038.name: Dark Pupitar
038.evolves: Evolves from Larvitar and into Dark Tyranitar
038.attacksText: {F}{F} → Rock Tackle : 40 Dark Pupitar does 10 damage to itself. Dark Pupitar can't use this attack during your next turn. {C}{C}{C} → Explosive Evolution Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. Then, search your deck for an Evolution card named Dark Tyranitar and put it on Dark Pupitar. (This counts as evolving Dark Pupitar.) Shuffle your deck afterward.
038.flavorText: It is encased within a hard shell, yet retains a great deal of mobility—a dangerous combination.

039.name: Dark Quilava
039.evolves: Evolves from Cyndaquil and into Dark Typhlosion
039.attacksText: {R} → Incinerate Show the top card of your opponent's deck to all players. If it's a Trainer card, discard it. {R}{R} → Rushing Magma : 20× Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. (If there are fewer than 5 cards in your deck, discard all of them.) This attack does 20 damage for each {R} Energy card you discarded in this way.
039.flavorText: If it turns its back to an opponent, it is a sign that it is getting ready to attack.

040.name: Dark Wigglytuff
040.attacksText: {C}{C} → Dark Song Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. {C}{C}{C} → Slap Awake : 20+ If the Defending Pokémon is Asleep or Confused, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. Then, the Defending Pokémon is no longer Asleep or Confused.
040.flavorText: This Pokémon has soft, fine hair. When angered, it increases in size and has been known to charge those it considers a threat.

041.name: Heracross
041.attacksText: {G}{C} → Tackle : 20 {G}{G}{G} → Charging Horn : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage. If tails, this attack does 30 damage.
041.flavorText: It is normally peaceful, but will attack any who get between it and honey, its favorite food.

042.name: Hitmonlee
042.attacksText: {F}{F} → One-Two Kick : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. {F}{F}{F} → Heel Drop : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
042.flavorText: It has a perfect sense of balance and can lash out with powerful kicks from any position.

043.name: Houndour
043.evolves: Evolves into Houndoom , Dark Houndoom , or Houndoom ex
043.attacksText: {D} → Corner The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C} → Lunge : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
043.flavorText: When night falls, the air fills with the eerie cries of this Pokémon as it stakes out its territory.

044.name: Jigglypuff
044.evolves: Evolves into Wigglytuff , Wigglytuff ex , […] Dark Wigglytuff , Light Wigglytuff
044.attacksText: {C}{C} → Expand : 10 All damage done to Jigglypuff during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
044.flavorText: If puffs its body up like a balloon and sings a lullaby that makes all who hear it fall into a deep sleep.

045.name: Light Dewgong
045.attacksText: {W}{W} → Freezing Breath : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {W}{W}{W} → Ice Pillar : 40 Until the end of your opponent's next turn, as long as Light Dewgong is your Active Pokémon, prevent all damage done by attacks to your Benched Pokémon. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)
045.flavorText: It has an aerodynamic shape that allows it to swim at great speeds. The colder the water gets, the more active it becomes.

046.name: Light Flareon
046.evolves: Evolves from Eevee
046.attacksText: {R} → Warm Up If you have any benched Pokémon, search your deck for a {R} Energy card and attach it to 1 of them. Then shuffle your deck. {R}{R}{C} → Burning Flame : 30+ Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard a {R} Energy card attached to Light Flareon or this attack does nothing. This attack does 30 damage plus 20 damage for each heads.
046.flavorText: It creates its flames by swallowing air into a special pouch within its body, then heating it to over 3000 degrees.

047.name: Light Golduck
047.evolves: Evolves from Psyduck
047.attacksText: {W} → Flipper Stroke Your opponent looks at the top 3 cards of his or her deck. If any of them are basic Energy cards, he or she may show any number of them to you and put them into his or her hand. You do the same. Either way, each player shuffles his or her deck. {P}{C}{C} → Core Blast : 30+ This attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Special Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.
047.flavorText: The faster it swims, the brighter the glow on its forehead becomes.

048.name: Light Jolteon
048.attacksText: {L} → Pulse Guard During your opponent's next turn, whenever 30 or more damage is done to Light Jolteon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) {L}{L}{C} → Thunder Needle : 20× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
048.flavorText: It can collect the ambient electrical energy in its cells and expel it in massive bursts.

049.name: Light Machoke

If not, this attack does 20 damage.

Remove 1 damage counter from each Benched Pokémon (yours and your opponent's) with any damage counters on it.

Your opponent attaches that card to that Pokémon. This counts as evolving that Pokémon. 055.evolves: Evolves into Scizor , Scizor- GX , […] Scizor ex , Kleavor
055.attacksText: {G}{C} → Agility : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Scyther. {G}{G}{G} → Sharp Sickle : 40
055.flavorText: It moves so fast as to be invisible to the naked eye. Even when standing still, its camouflage prevents it from being seen.

061.attacksText: {R} → Smokescreen : 10 If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.
061.flavorText: It is very meek and constantly crouches in a defensive posture. When threatened, it protects itself with the flame on its back.

062.name: Dark Octillery
062.evolves: Evolves from Remoraid
062.attacksText: {W} → Ink Blast : 20+ This attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to Dark Octillery but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. If tails, during your opponent's next turn, your opponent pays {C} more to retreat the Defending Pokémon.
062.flavorText: It likes to sleep in rock caves and will even steal other Octillery's nests.

063.name: Dratini
063.evolves: Evolves into Dragonair , Dark Dragonair , or Light Dragonair
063.attacksText: {C} → Shed Remove 1 damage counter from Dratini. {C} → Fury Attack : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
063.flavorText: Large from birth, this Pokémon increases in size throughout its life by regularly shedding its skin.

064.name: Exeggcute
064.evolves: Evolves into Exeggutor , Alolan Exeggutor , […] Alolan Exeggutor ex , Alolan Exeggutor- GX
064.attacksText: {G} → Sleep Powder : 10 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {P} → Psyshock : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
064.flavorText: Its shell is very durable, allowing it to survive even if the shell becomes cracked.

065.name: Gastly
065.evolves: Evolves into Haunter or Dark Haunter
065.attacksText: {P} → Nightmare : 10 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
065.flavorText: Its gas-like body allows it to enter almost anywhere, but it is vulnerable to high winds.

066.name: Girafarig
066.evolves: Evolves into Farigiraf or Farigiraf ex
066.attacksText: {C}{C} → Tail Bite : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage. {P}{P} → Psychic : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.
066.flavorText: Its tail has a brain of its own, which can respond to stimuli such as scents. Many unsuspecting people have been bitten by it.

067.name: Gligar
067.attacksText: {F}{C} → Stun Poison : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.
067.flavorText: It spends its days hanging from cliffs, swooping down on any prey it spots from its high vantage point.

068.name: Growlithe
068.evolves: Evolves into Arcanine , Arcanine ex , or Light Arcanine
068.attacksText: {C}{C} → Bite : 20
068.flavorText: It fears nothing, not even opponents larger than itself.

069.name: Hitmonchan
069.attacksText: {F} → Dodge If Hitmonchan would be damaged by an attack during your opponent's next turn, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that attack's damage done to Hitmonchan. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) {F}{F}{F} → Supersonic Jab : 40
069.flavorText: Its punches are blindingly fast, but it can only fight for three minutes before tiring and needing to rest.

070.name: Larvitar
070.evolves: Evolves into Pupitar or Dark Pupitar
070.attacksText: {C} → Leer Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn. (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.) {F}{C} → Rock Throw : 20
070.flavorText: It is born deep within the ground and has to burrow its way out.

071.name: Ledyba
071.evolves: Evolves into Ledian or Light Ledian
071.attacksText: {G}{C} → Swift : 20 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokémon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.
071.flavorText: Sensitive to cold, Ledyba gather in groups to share warmth when the temperature drops.

072.name: Light Sunflora
072.attacksText: {C}{C} → Reflected Sunlight Attach up to 2 {G} Energy cards from your hand to 1 of your {G} Pokémon. {G}{G}{G} → Solarbeam : 40
072.flavorText: Although it is extremely active during the day, it stops moving entirely as soon as the sun sets.

073.name: Machop
073.evolves: Evolves into Machoke , Dark Machoke , or Light Machoke
073.attacksText: {C} → Chop : 10 {C}{C} → Punch : 20
073.flavorText: When bored, this super-strong Pokémon trains by lifting rocks.

074.name: Mantine
074.attacksText: {W}{W} → Giant Wave : 40 Mantine can't attack during your next turn.
074.flavorText: This Pokémon is perfectly adapted to its ocean home. It can gather up enough speed to burst above the water like a whale.

075.name: Mareep
075.evolves: Evolves into Flaaffy or Dark Flaaffy
075.attacksText: {C} → Headbutt : 10
075.flavorText: Its soft wool coat captures air, allowing it to remain cool during the summer and warm in the winter.

076.name: Phanpy
076.evolves: Evolves into Donphan or Dark Donphan
076.attacksText: {F} → Crushing Step : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.
076.flavorText: It hits people with its nose as a sign of affection but doesn't know its own strength and so sometimes knocks people off their feet.

077.name: Pineco
077.evolves: Evolves into Forretress , Forretress ex , or Dark Forretress
077.attacksText: {C}{C} → Tackle : 20
077.flavorText: It waits suspended from tree branches for insects to fly into its mouth, often not moving for hours at a time.

078.name: Porygon
078.evolves: Evolves into Porygon2 or Dark Porygon2
078.attacksText: {C}{C} → Sharpen : 20
078.flavorText: This Pokémon was created by human computer engineering. Its program is only capable of simple action and reaction.

079.name: Psyduck
079.evolves: Evolves into Golduck , Dark Golduck , or Light Golduck
079.attacksText: {W} → Flipper Splash : 10 {P}{C} → Migraine : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, Psyduck is now Confused.
079.flavorText: Although possessed of great mental powers, it doesn't know how to use them.

080.name: Remoraid
080.evolves: Evolves into Octillery or Dark Octillery
080.attacksText: {W} → Fury Strikes : 10× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
080.flavorText: It can shoot a burst of water from its mouth to propel itself backward at high speeds, allowing it to flee from surprised enemies.

081.name: Seel
081.evolves: Evolves into Dewgong or Light Dewgong
081.attacksText: {W}{C} → Take Down : 30 Seel does 10 damage to itself.
081.flavorText: Although clumsy on land, it moves easily through the arctic waters it calls home.

082.name: Slugma
082.evolves: Evolves into Magcargo , Magcargo ex , Magcargo- GX , or Dark Magcargo
082.attacksText: {R}{R} → Combustion : 30
082.flavorText: This Pokémon is often seen crawling around in volcanic regions.

083.name: Sunkern
083.evolves: Evolves into Sunflora or Light Sunflora
083.attacksText: {C} → Rollout : 10 {G}{G} → Sunbathe Flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from Sunkern. Search your deck for a card that evolves from Sunkern and attach that card to Sunkern. This counts as evolving Sunkern. Shuffle your deck afterward.
083.flavorText: It is very small and powerless. If attacked, the best it can do is flap its leaves in an attempt to frighten away its enemies.

084.name: Swinub

084.attacksText: {W}{C} → Generate Cold : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
084.flavorText: It moves with its sensitive nose pressed to the ground, always searching for food.

090.evolves: Evolves into Venomoth , Venomoth- GX , or Light Venomoth
090.attacksText: {C} → Gnaw : 10 {G}{C} → Poisonpowder : 10 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
090.flavorText: It possesses a type of radar, which it can use to find the insects it eats for food, even in pitch darkness.

091.name: Vulpix
091.evolves: Evolves into Ninetales , Ninetales ex , or Light Ninetales
091.attacksText: {R}{C} → Ember : 30 Discard 1 {R} Energy card attached to Vulpix in order to use this attack.
091.flavorText: As it grows older, its white tail changes colors and splits into six different tails. Its body radiates a faint warmth.

098.attacksText: Choose an Energy card in your hand, show it to your opponent, and shuffle it into your deck. Then flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

099.name: Energy Stadium

Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

001.name: Ampharos
001.attacksText: {L} → Attract Current : 20 Flip 3 coins. For each heads, you may search your deck for a {L} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your {L} Pokémon. If tails, this attack does 40 damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
