002.name: Blissey
002.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Softboiled When you play Blissey from your hand, you may flip a coin. If heads, remove 8 damage counters from Blissey. If tails, remove 4 damage counters from Blissey. Either way, if Blissey has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Body Slam : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
002.flavorText: Anyone who takes even one bite of Blissey's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

003.name: Celebi
003.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Time Travel If an opponent's attack would Knock Out Celebi, flip a coin. If heads, Celebi isn't Knocked Out and you shuffle it and all cards attached to it into your deck. This power doesn't work if Celebi is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {P} → Psychic Damage Flip 3 coins. For each heads, put 1 damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.
003.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

004.name: Crobat
004.evolves: Evolves from Golbat and into Crobat BREAK
004.attacksText: {G} → Triggered Poison : 20 If your opponent attaches an Energy card to the Defending Pokémon during his or her next turn, that Pokémon becomes Poisoned. {G}{G}{C} → Cross Attack : 20× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
004.flavorText: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

005.name: Delibird
005.attacksText: {C}{C} → Present Flip 3 coins. If exactly 1 is heads, this attack does 40 damage. If exactly 2 are heads, remove 3 damage counters from the Defending Pokémon. If the Defending Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them. If all 3 are heads, this attack does 60 damage. If all 3 are tails, remove all damage counters from the Defending Pokémon.
005.flavorText: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

006.name: Entei
006.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Howl When you play Entei from your hand, you may discard the top 5 cards of your deck. (If you have fewer cards in your deck than that, discard all of them.) If any of those are {R} Energy cards, attach them to any of your {R} Pokémon of your choice. Using this power ends your turn. {R}{R}{R} → Searing Flames : 60 Discard 2 {R} Energy cards attached to Entei or this attack does nothing.
006.flavorText: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.

007.name: Ho-oh
007.attacksText: {R} → Stoke You may search your deck for a {R} Energy card and attach it to Ho-oh. Shuffle your deck afterward. {R}{R}{R} → Sacred Fire Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. {R}{R}{R}{R}{R} → Dive Bomb : 90 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
007.flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven colored wings.

008.name: Houndoom
008.attacksText: {R} → Dark Flame : 20 Discard 1 {R} Energy card attached to Houndoom or this attack does nothing. If there are any {D} Energy cards in your discard pile, attach 1 of them to Houndoom. {D}{C}{C} → Black Fang : 30+ Flip a number of coins equal to the number of {D} Energy attached to Houndoom. This attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.
008.flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

009.name: Jumpluff
009.attacksText: {G} → Evolutionary Spore Choose any number of your Hoppips and Skiplooms. Then, for each Pokémon you chose in this way, you may search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon and attach it to that Pokémon. (This counts as evolving those Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward. {G} → Solarbeam : 30
009.flavorText: Drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.

010.name: Magneton
010.evolves: Evolves from Magnemite and into Magnezone or Magnezone ex
010.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Electromagnetic Power As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may take 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your Magnemites, Magnetons, or Dark Magnetons and attach it to a different 1 of your Magnemites, Magnetons, and Dark Magnetons. This power can't be used if Magneton is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {L}{L}{C} → Plasma : 30 If there are any {L} Energy cards in your discard pile, attach 1 of them to Magneton.
010.flavorText: Three Magnemites are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

011.name: Misdreavus
011.evolves: Evolves into Mismagius or Mismagius ex
011.attacksText: {P} → Night Eyes The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {P}{P}{P} → Perish Song If the Defending Pokémon is Asleep and was attacked with Night Eyes during your last turn, it is Knocked Out.
011.flavorText: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

012.name: Porygon2
012.evolves: Evolves from Porygon and into Porygon-Z or Porygon-Z- GX
012.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Energy Converter Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may choose 1 basic Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon and choose an Energy type. Treat that Energy card as that type until the end of your turn. This power can't be used if Porygon2 is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. If Porygon2 becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed, the Energy card goes back to its original type. {C}{C}{C} → Delta Beam : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, choose whether the Defending Pokémon becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
012.flavorText: This upgraded version of Porygon is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

013.name: Raikou
013.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Lightning Burst Whenever you attach a {L} Energy card from your hand to Raikou, if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. This power stops working while Raikou is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {L}{L}{L} → Lightning Tackle : 50 Flip a coin. If tails, Raikou does 20 damage to itself.
013.flavorText: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

014.name: Suicune
014.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Crystal Body Prevent all effects of your opponent's attacks, other than damage, done to Suicune. This power stops working while Suicune is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {W}{W}{W} → Aurora Wave : 30 Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If only 1 is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
014.flavorText: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

015.name: Aerodactyl
015.evolves: Evolves from Mysterious Fossil or Buried Fossil
015.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Prehistoric Memory Whenever an Evolved Pokémon attacks (even if it's your opponent's) , it can use any attack from its Basic Pokémon card or any Evolution card attached to it. It still has to pay for that attack's Energy cost. This power stops working while Aerodactyl is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {C}{C}{C} → Fly : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Aerodactyl. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage) .
015.flavorText: A vicious Pokémon from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.

016.name: Celebi
016.attacksText: {G}{G} → Psychic Leaf : 10+ Flip a coin for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads. Remove a number of damage counters from Celebi equal to the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . If Celebi has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.
016.flavorText: When Celebi disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.

017.name: Entei
017.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Legendary Body As long as Entei is your Active Pokémon, Entei and Energy cards attached to it aren't affected by effects from Trainer cards other than Stadium cards. As long as this Power is active, discard any Trainer cards attached to Entei. (This power works even if Entei is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.) {R}{R}{R} → Mega Flame : 50 Flip 2 coins. For each tails, discard 1 {R} Energy card from Entei, if it has any.
017.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

018.name: Ho-oh
018.attacksText: {C}{C}{C}{C} → Rainbow Burn : 30+ This attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each type of Basic Energy card, if any, attached to Ho-oh.
018.flavorText: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

019.name: Kingdra
019.attacksText: {C} → Genetic Memory Use any attack from Kingdra's Basic Pokémon card or Evolution card. (Kingdra doesn't have to pay for that attack's Energy cost.) {W}{W}{C}{C} → Twister : 50 Flip 2 coins. For each heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon, if any, and discard it. If both are tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage) .
019.flavorText: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

020.name: Lugia
020.attacksText: {C}{C}{C}{C} → Aerowing : 40 You may flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 80 damage. If tails, this attack does nothing.
020.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

021.name: Raichu
021.evolves: Evolves from Pikachu and into Raichu BREAK or Raichu LV. X
021.attacksText: {L}{C} → Thundershock : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {L}{L}{L} → Lightning Strike : 40 You may discard all {L} Energy cards attached to Raichu. If you do, this attack does 80 damage.
021.flavorText: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

022.name: Raikou
022.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Legendary Body As long as Raikou is your Active Pokémon, Raikou and Energy cards attached to it aren't affected by effects from Trainer cards other than Stadium cards. As long as this Power is active, discard any Trainer cards attached to Raikou. (This power works even if Raikou is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.) {L}{L}{L} → Lightning Spark : 30 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of them and this attack does 20 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
022.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

023.name: Skarmory
023.attacksText: {C} → Fury Attack : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads. {M}{C}{C} → Agility : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Skarmory.
023.flavorText: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

024.name: Sneasel
024.evolves: Evolves into Weavile or Weavile- GX
024.attacksText: {D} → Swipe Flip a coin. If heads, discard all Trainer cards attached to your opponent's Pokémon. {C}{C} → Quick Attack : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.
024.flavorText: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

025.name: Starmie
025.evolves: Evolves from Staryu and into Starmie BREAK
025.attacksText: {W} → Confuse Ray : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. {P}{P}{C} → Core Stream Choose an Energy type other than {C}. This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon with any Energy cards of that type attached to it. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.
025.flavorText: The center section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

026.name: Sudowoodo
026.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Mimic As long as Sudowoodo is your Active Pokémon, it copies all of the Defending Pokémon's attacks, including their costs. This power can't be used if Sudowoodo is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {C}{C} → Slam : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
026.flavorText: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

027.name: Suicune
027.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Legendary Body As long as Suicune is your Active Pokémon, Suicune and Energy cards attached to it aren't affected by effects from Trainer cards other than Stadium cards. As long as this Power is active, discard any Trainer cards attached to Suicune. (This power works even if Suicune is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.) {W}{W}{W} → Crystal Wave : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, this attack does 30 damage and, if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)
027.flavorText: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

028.name: Flaaffy
028.evolves: Evolves from Mareep and into Ampharos , Ampharos- GX , or Ampharos ex
028.attacksText: {L} → Electric Punch : 20 {L}{C}{C} → Tail Shock : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
028.flavorText: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.

029.name: Golbat
029.evolves: Evolves from Zubat and into Crobat or Crobat ex
029.attacksText: {C} → Screech Until the end of your next turn, if an attack damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , that attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon. {G}{C} → Poison Bite : 10 If this attack damages the Defending Pokémon, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned and you remove a number of damage counters from Golbat equal to half that damage (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Golbat has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them. Either way, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
029.flavorText: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

030.name: Graveler
030.evolves: Evolves from Geodude and into Golem or Golem ex
030.attacksText: {F}{C} → Earthquake : 40 Does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {F}{F}{F} → Rock Tumble : 50 Don't apply Resistance.
030.flavorText: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

031.name: Jynx
031.attacksText: {W} → Freezing Kiss Goodnight The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {P}{P}{C} → Strange Dance : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.
031.flavorText: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

032.name: Lanturn
032.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Submerge Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may change Lanturn's type to {W} until the end of your turn. This power can't be used if Lanturn is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. If Lanturn becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed after you have used this power, its type changes back to {L}. {L}{C}{C} → Blinding Light : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
032.flavorText: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

033.name: Magcargo
033.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Magma Pool If Magcargo is your Active Pokémon and moves to the Bench, remove 1 {R} Energy card attached to Magcargo, if any, and attach it to the new Active Pokémon. (You can't choose an Energy card that you used to pay the Retreat Cost.) {R}{R}{R} → Lava Flow : 40+ You may discard any number of {R} Energy cards attached to Magcargo when you use this attack. If you do, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage for each {R} Energy card you discarded in this way.
033.flavorText: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

034.name: Octillery
034.attacksText: {W} → Constrict : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{W}{W} → Octazooka : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, whenever the Defending Pokémon attacks, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. (Benching or evolving that Pokémon ends this effect.)
034.flavorText: It traps enemies with its suction cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rockhard head.

035.name: Parasect
035.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Allergic Pollen As long as Parasect is in play, cards in any player's discard piles are not affected by attacks or Pokémon Powers. This power stops working if Parasect becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {G}{G} → Sleep Pinchers : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
035.flavorText: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mushrooms on its back.

036.name: Piloswine
036.evolves: Evolves from Swinub and into Mamoswine or Mamoswine ex
036.attacksText: {C}{C} → Nap Remove 3 damage counters from Piloswine. If it has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them. {F}{F}{C}{C} → High-Speed Charge : 80 Piloswine does 30 damage to itself. Piloswine can't use this attack during your next turn.
036.flavorText: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

037.name: Seaking
037.attacksText: {W} → Rising Lunge : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, this attack does 10 damage. {W}{W} → Horn Swipe : 20+ Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 40 more damage. If 1 or both of them are tails, this attack does 20 damage.
037.flavorText: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

038.name: Stantler
038.attacksText: {C} → Terrorize If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, choose 1 of its attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C}{C} → Overhead Toss : 30 If you have any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If tails, this attack does 10 damage to 1 of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
038.flavorText: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.

039.name: Unown B
039.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ [Bear] Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon with Unown in its name to Unown B. This power can't be used if Unown B has 10 HP left. This power can be used even if Unown B is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {P} → Hidden Power : 10 · Unown rule: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.
039.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

040.name: Unown Y
040.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ [Yield] Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a {P} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon with Unown in its name. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can be used even if Unown Y is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {P} → Hidden Power : 10 · Unown rule: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.
040.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

041.name: Aipom
041.evolves: Evolves into Ambipom
041.attacksText: {C} → Grab Choose a Trainer card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck. {C}{C} → Tail Punch : 20
041.flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

042.name: Chinchou
042.evolves: Evolves into Lanturn or Light Lanturn
042.attacksText: {L} → Positive Ion : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, this attack does 10 damage. {W} → Negative Ion : 10 If the Defending Pokémon attacks Chinchou during your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Chinchou is reduced by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.)
042.flavorText: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

043.name: Farfetch'd
043.attacksText: {C} → Gust : 10 {C}{C}{C} → Leek Jab : 40 This attack can't be used during your next turn. (Benching Farfetch'd ends this effect.)
043.flavorText: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant sticks grow, it uses its own stick to thwart them.

044.name: Geodude
044.attacksText: {F} → Knuckle Punch : 20
044.flavorText: It uses its arms to steadily climb steep mountain paths. It swings its fists around if angered.

045.name: Goldeen
045.attacksText: {C} → Fin Smack : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
045.flavorText: Its dorsal, pectoral and tail fins wave elegantly in the water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.

046.name: Murkrow
046.evolves: Evolves into Honchkrow or Honchkrow- GX
046.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon card named Murkrow and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.) {C}{C} → Flock Attack : 10+ Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Murkrows on your Bench. This attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.
046.flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

047.name: Paras
047.evolves: Evolves into Parasect
047.attacksText: {G} → Sleep Spore : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C} → Scratch : 20
047.flavorText: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.

048.name: Quagsire
048.attacksText: {F}{F} → Mud Slap : 30 {W}{W}{C}{C} → Whirlpool : 40 If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.
048.flavorText: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

049.name: Qwilfish
049.attacksText: {W} → Poison Sting : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. {C}{C} → Needle Storm : 20× Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads you get.
049.flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

050.name: Remoraid
050.evolves: Evolves into Octillery or Dark Octillery
050.attacksText: {W} → Sharpshooting Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.
050.flavorText: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

051.name: Shuckle
051.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Hard Shell Whenever an attack (including your own) does 40 or less damage to Shuckle (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , reduce that damage to 10. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) This power stops working while Shuckle is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {G}{G} → Toxic Saliva Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned) .
051.flavorText: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

052.name: Skiploom
052.evolves: Evolves from Hoppip and into Jumpluff
052.attacksText: {C} → Hop : 20 {G} → Mysterious Powder : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
052.flavorText: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

053.name: Slugma
053.evolves: Evolves into Magcargo , Magcargo ex , Magcargo- GX , or Dark Magcargo
053.attacksText: {R} → Flare : 10 {R}{R} → Magma Ring : 20 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.
053.flavorText: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.

054.name: Smoochum
054.attacksText: {C} → Psykiss Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Special Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck. · Baby rule: If this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent announces an attack, your opponent flips a coin (before doing anything else). If tails, your opponent's turn ends.
054.flavorText: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.

055.name: Snubbull
055.evolves: Evolves into Granbull
055.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 10 {C}{C} → Raging Headbutt : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Snubbull. If tails, this attack does 10 damage.
055.flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many people like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

056.name: Staryu
056.evolves: Evolves into Starmie , Mega Starmie ex , or Starmie- GX
056.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {W} → Bubblebeam : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
056.flavorText: At night, the center of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.

057.name: Swinub
057.evolves: Evolves into Piloswine or Light Piloswine
057.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {F}{C} → Take Down : 30 Swinub does 10 damage to itself.
057.flavorText: If it smells something enticing, it dashes headlong off to find the source of the aroma.

058.name: Unown K
058.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ [Keep] Your opponent's attacks, Pokémon Powers, and Trainer cards can't discard Energy cards from your Pokémon with Unown in their names. (Any other effects still happen.) {P} → Hidden Power : 10 · Unown rule: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.
058.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

059.name: Zubat
059.evolves: Evolves into Golbat or Dark Golbat
059.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 10 {G} → Poison Spray The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
059.flavorText: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings.

060.name: Balloon Berry
060.attacksText: When the Pokémon Balloon Berry is attached to retreats, discard Balloon Berry instead of discarding Energy cards. · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach Balloon Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

061.name: Healing Field
061.attacksText: Once during each player's turn, he or she may flip a coin. If heads, that player removes 2 damage counters from his or her Active Pokémon (1 if it only has 1). · Stadium rule: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

062.name: Pokémon Breeder Fields
062.attacksText: Flip a coin for 1 or 2 of your non-Baby Pokémon that can evolve. For each heads, search your deck for a later-Stage card that matches that Pokémon. Then put that card into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

063.name: Rocket's Hideout
063.attacksText: Each Pokémon in play with Dark in its name (even your opponent's) gets +20 HP. · Stadium rule: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

064.name: Old Rod
064.attacksText: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, put a Baby Pokémon, Basic Pokémon, or Evolution card from your discard pile into your hand. If both are tails, put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

065.name: Shining Gyarados
065.attacksText: {W}{F}{F} → Outrage : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Shining Gyarados. If tails, this attack does nothing. {W}{W}{R}{R} → Devastate : 50 Discard 2 {R} Energy cards attached to Shining Gyarados or this attack does nothing. This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Then, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any Energy cards attached to it and discard those Energy cards. · Shining rule: You can't have more than 1 Shining Gyarados in your deck.
065.flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

066.name: Shining Magikarp
066.attacksText: {W} → Gold Scale Your opponent may draw 2 cards. Either way, you may draw 2 cards. {P} → Dragon Bond Search your deck for a card named Gyarados, Dark Gyarados, or Shining Gyarados. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. · Shining rule: You can't have more than 1 Shining Magikarp in your deck.
066.flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.

001.name: Espeon
001.attacksText: {C}{C} → Bite : 20 {P}{P}{C} → Psychic : 30+ Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.
001.flavorText: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.

002.name: Forretress
002.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Spikes During your opponent's turn, whenever 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon becomes his or her Active Pokémon, Forretress does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power stops working if Forretress is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {M}{C}{C} → Rapid Spin : 30 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with his or her Active Pokémon, then, if you have any Benched Pokémon, you switch 1 of them with your Active Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)
002.flavorText: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.

003.name: Hitmontop
003.attacksText: {F} → Detect Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Hitmontop. {F}{F}{F} → Triple Kick : 30× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
003.flavorText: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dancelike kicks, you may get drilled hard.

004.name: Houndoom
004.attacksText: {D}{C}{C} → Crunch : 30 Until the end of your next turn, if an attack damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , that attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon. {R}{R}{C} → Flamethrower : 50 Discard 1 {R} Energy card attached to Houndoom or this attack does nothing.
004.flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

005.name: Houndour
005.evolves: Evolves into Houndoom , Dark Houndoom , or Houndoom ex
005.attacksText: {R} → Smog : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. {R}{R} → Collect Fire : 20 If there are any {R} Energy cards in your discard pile, choose 1 of them and attach it to Houndour.
005.flavorText: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

006.name: Kabutops
006.attacksText: {C} → Slash : 20 {F} → Hydrocutter : 40× Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy cards attached to Kabutops. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads. You can't flip more than 3 coins in this way.
006.flavorText: In the water, it tucks its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.

007.name: Magnemite
007.evolves: Evolves into Magneton or Dark Magneton
007.attacksText: {C} → Lock-on During your next turn, treat any tails flipped when using Magnemite's Electric Bolt attack as if they were heads. (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.) {L}{C} → Electric Bolt : 50 Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage) .
007.flavorText: These Pokémon are attracted to electrical emissions and will often follow people using PokéGear.

008.name: Politoed
008.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Frog Song Whenever Politoed's attack damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , if there are more than 3 Poliwags, Poliwhirls, Poliwraths, and/or Politoeds in play (including your opponent's) , that attack does 40 more damage (no matter how many heads you get). This power stops working while Politoed is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {W}{W}{C}{C} → Doubleslap : 40× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.
008.flavorText: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

009.name: Poliwrath
009.attacksText: {F}{C} → Corkscrew Punch : 30 {F}{F}{C}{C} → Submission : 70 Poliwrath does 20 damage to itself.
009.flavorText: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.

010.name: Scizor
010.attacksText: {M} → False Swipe : ? Does damage equal to half the Defending Pokémon's remaining HP (rounded down to the nearest 10). {C}{C}{C} → Double Claw : 20+ Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
010.flavorText: It swings its eye patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.

011.name: Smeargle
011.attacksText: {C}{C} → Sketch If the Defending Pokémon attacked last turn, and Smeargle was in play during that attack, Smeargle copies that attack except for its Energy costs and anything else required in order to use that attack.
011.flavorText: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

012.name: Tyranitar
012.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Slam : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {D}{D}{C}{C} → Trample : 50 For each Benched Pokémon in play (yours and your opponent's) , flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
012.flavorText: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

013.name: Umbreon
013.attacksText: {C}{C} → Bite : 20 {D}{D}{C} → Feint Attack Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokémon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.
013.flavorText: When darkness falls, the rings on the body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.

014.name: Unown A
014.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ [Anger] Whenever 1 of your Pokémon with Unown in its name uses its Hidden Power attack, that attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on Unown A. If you have more than 1 Unown A in play, use only 1 [Anger] for each attack. {P} → Hidden Power : 10 · Unown rule: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.
014.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

015.name: Ursaring
015.evolves: Evolves from Teddiursa and into Ursaluna
015.attacksText: {C}{C} → Headpress : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage) . {C}{C}{C}{C} → Double Lariat : 40× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.
