At the end of every turn, put 1 damage counter on the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to, unless it's {D} or has Dark in its name. Darkness Energy provides {D} Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

105.name: Recycle Energy
105.attacksText: Recycle Energy provides {C} Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.) If this card is put into your discard pile from play, return it to your hand.

001.name: Ampharos
001.attacksText: {L}{L}{L} → Gigaspark : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
001.flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

002.name: Azumarill
002.attacksText: {C}{C} → Tackle : 20 {W}{W}{W} → Bubble Shower : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
002.flavorText: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.

003.name: Bellossom
003.attacksText: {G} → Sweet Nectar Flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon. {G}{G}{C} → Flower Dance : 30× Does 30 damage times the number of cards with Bellossom in their names that you have in play (including this one) .
003.flavorText: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

004.name: Feraligatr
004.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Berserk When you play Feraligatr from your hand, flip a coin. If heads, discard the top 5 cards from your opponent's deck. If tails, discard the top 5 cards from your deck. {W}{W}{W}{W} → Chomp : 50+ Flip a number of coins equal to the number of damage counters on Feraligatr. This attack does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.
004.flavorText: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

005.name: Feraligatr
005.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Downpour As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may discard a {W} Energy card from your hand. This power can't be used if Feraligatr is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {W}{W}{W} → Riptide : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 damage times the number of {W} Energy cards in your discard pile. Then, shuffle all {W} Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
005.flavorText: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.

006.name: Heracross
006.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Final Blow If Heracross's remaining HP are 20 or less, you may make its Megahorn attack's base damage 120 instead of 60. This power can't be used if Heracross is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {G}{G}{G} → Megahorn : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
006.flavorText: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

007.name: Jumpluff
007.attacksText: {G} → Sleep Powder : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {G} → Leech Seed : 20 If this attack damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , remove 1 damage counter from Jumpluff, if it has any.
007.flavorText: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.

008.name: Kingdra
008.attacksText: {W}{W}{C} → Agility : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Kingdra. {W}{W}{W}{W} → Dragon Tornado : 50 If this attack doesn't Knock Out the Defending Pokémon, and if there are any Pokémon on your opponent's Bench, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.
008.flavorText: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

009.name: Lugia
009.attacksText: {R}{W}{L} → Elemental Blast : 90 Discard a {R} Energy card, a {W} Energy card, and a {L} Energy card attached to Lugia in order to use this attack.
009.flavorText: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea, because its powers are too strong.

010.name: Meganium
010.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Herbal Scent When you play Meganium from your hand, you may flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from all {G} Pokémon in play. {G}{G}{C}{C} → Body Slam : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
010.flavorText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

011.name: Meganium
011.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Wild Growth As long as Meganium is in play, each {G} Energy card attached to your {G} Pokémon instead provides {G}{G}. This power stops working while Meganium is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {G}{G}{G}{G} → Soothing Scent : 40 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
011.flavorText: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

012.name: Pichu
012.attacksText: {C} → Zzzap Does 20 damage to each Pokémon in play that has a Pokémon Power. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. · Baby rule: If this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin (before doing anything required in order to use that attack). If tails, your opponent's turn ends without an attack.
012.flavorText: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

013.name: Skarmory
013.attacksText: {C} → Claw : 20 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. {M}{C}{C} → Steel Wing : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, all damage done by attacks to Skarmory during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
013.flavorText: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.

014.name: Slowking
014.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Mind Games Whenever your opponent plays a Trainer card, you may flip a coin. If heads, that card does nothing. Put it on top of your opponent's deck. This power can't be used if Slowking is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {P}{P}{P} → Mind Blast : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.
014.flavorText: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

015.name: Steelix
015.attacksText: {C}{C} → Tackle : 20 {M}{C}{C} → Tail Crush : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage.
015.flavorText: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

016.name: Togetic
016.evolves: Evolves from Togepi and into Togekiss
016.attacksText: {C} → Super Metronome Flip a coin. If heads, choose an attack on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Super Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else in order to use that attack.) (No matter what type the Defending Pokémon is, Togetic's type is still {C}.) Togetic performs that attack. (Togetic can make that attack even if it does not have the appropriate number or type of Energy attached to it necessary to make the attack.) {C}{C}{C} → Fly : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Togetic; if tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage) .
016.flavorText: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

017.name: Typhlosion
017.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Fire Recharge Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may flip a coin. If heads, attach a {R} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your {R} Pokémon. This power can't be used if Typhlosion is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {R}{R}{R}{R} → Flame Burst : 60+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage and does 20 damage to Typhlosion. If tails, this attack does 60 damage.
017.flavorText: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

018.name: Typhlosion
018.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Fire Boost When you play Typhlosion from your hand, you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for up to 4 {R} Energy cards and attach them to Typhlosion. Shuffle your deck afterward. {R}{R}{R}{R} → Flame Wheel : 80 Discard 3 {R} Energy cards attached to Typhlosion in order to use this attack. Do 20 damage to each Benched Pokémon (yours and your opponent's) . (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
018.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

019.name: Metal Energy
019.attacksText: Damage done to the Pokémon Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . If the Pokémon Metal Energy is attached to isn't {M}, whenever it damages a Pokémon, reduce that damage by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . Metal Energy provides {M} Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

020.name: Cleffa
020.attacksText: {C} → Eeeeeeek Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 7 cards. · Baby rule: If this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin (before doing anything required in order to use that attack). If tails, your opponent's turn ends without an attack.
020.flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

021.name: Donphan
021.attacksText: {F} → Flail : 10× Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Donphan. {F}{F}{F} → Rapid Spin : 50 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with his or her Active Pokémon, then, if you have any Benched Pokémon, you switch 1 of them with your Active Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)
021.flavorText: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

022.name: Elekid
022.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Playful Punch Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may flip a coin. If heads, do 20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon. (Apply Weakness and Resistance.) Either way, this ends your turn. This power can't be used if Elekid is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. · Baby rule: If this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin (before doing anything required in order to use that attack). If tails, your opponent's turn ends without an attack.
022.flavorText: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.

023.name: Magby
023.attacksText: {C} → Sputter : 10 All Pokémon Powers stop working until the end of your next turn. · Baby rule: If this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin (before doing anything required in order to use that attack). If tails, your opponent's turn ends without an attack.
023.flavorText: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.

024.name: Murkrow
024.evolves: Evolves into Honchkrow or Honchkrow- GX
024.attacksText: {D} → Mean Look The Defending Pokémon can't retreat as long as Murkrow remains your Active Pokémon. (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.) {D}{C} → Feint Attack Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokémon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.
024.flavorText: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

025.name: Sneasel
025.evolves: Evolves into Weavile or Weavile- GX
025.attacksText: {C} → Fury Swipes : 10× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads. {D}{D} → Beat Up : 20× Flip a coin for each of your Pokémon in play (including this one). This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
025.flavorText: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

026.name: Aipom
026.attacksText: {C} → Pilfer Shuffle Aipom and all cards attached to it into your deck. Flip a coin. If heads, shuffle a card from your discard pile into your deck. {C} → Tail Rap : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
026.flavorText: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

027.name: Ariados
027.attacksText: {G} → Spider Web Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. (Benching or evolving that Pokémon ends this effect.) {G}{G}{G} → Poison Bite : 20 If this attack damages the Defending Pokémon, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned and you remove a number of damage counters from Ariados equal to half that damage (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Ariados has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.
027.flavorText: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It's hard to tell which end is which.

028.name: Bayleef
028.evolves: Evolves from Chikorita and into Meganium , Mega Meganium ex , or Meganium ex
028.attacksText: {G}{C} → Poisonpowder : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. {G}{G}{C} → Pollen Shield : 30 During your opponent's next turn, Bayleef can't become Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. (All other effects of attacks, Pokémon Powers and Trainer cards still happen.)
028.flavorText: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

029.name: Bayleef
029.evolves: Evolves from Chikorita and into Meganium , Mega Meganium ex , or Meganium ex
029.attacksText: {G} → Sweet Scent Flip a coin. If heads and if any of your Pokémon have any damage counters on them, then remove 2 damage counters from 1 of them (or 1 if it only has 1). If tails and if any of your opponent's Pokémon have any damage counters on them, choose 1 of them and remove 2 damage counters from it (or 1 if it only has 1). {G}{G}{G} → Double Razor Leaf : 40× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.
029.flavorText: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.

030.name: Clefairy
030.evolves: Evolves into Clefable , Mega Clefable ex , or Clefable ex
030.attacksText: {C}{C} → Doubleslap : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads. {C}{C}{C} → Squaredance Flip a number of coins equal to the total number of Pokémon in play. For each heads, you may search your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
030.flavorText: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

031.name: Croconaw
031.evolves: Evolves from Totodile and into Feraligatr , Mega Feraligatr ex , or Feraligatr ex
031.attacksText: {C} → Screech Until the end of your next turn, if an attack damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , that attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon {W}{W}{C} → Jaw Clamp : 30 Until the end of your opponent's next turn, as long as Croconaw is your Active Pokémon, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat, and if the effect of an attack, Pokémon Power, or Trainer card would change that player's Active Pokémon, that part of the effect does nothing.
031.flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

032.name: Croconaw
032.evolves: Evolves from Totodile and into Feraligatr , Mega Feraligatr ex , or Feraligatr ex
032.attacksText: {C}{C} → Tackle : 20 {W}{W}{C} → Sweep Away : 50 Discard the top 3 cards from your deck.
032.flavorText: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.

033.name: Electabuzz
033.evolves: Evolves into Electivire or Electivire ex
033.attacksText: {C}{C} → Punch : 20 {L}{L}{L} → Swift : 30 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokémon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.
033.flavorText: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish-blue.

034.name: Flaaffy
034.evolves: Evolves from Mareep and into Ampharos , Ampharos- GX , or Ampharos ex
034.attacksText: {L} → Discharge : 30× Discard all {L} Energy cards attached to Flaaffy in order to use this attack. Flip a number of coins equal to the number of {L} Energy cards you discarded. This attack does 30 damage times then number of heads. {L}{L} → Electric Current : 20 Take 1 {L} Energy cards attached to Flaaffy and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you have no Benched Pokémon, discard that Energy card.
034.flavorText: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

035.name: Furret
035.attacksText: {C}{C} → Quick Attack : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage. {C}{C}{C} → Slam : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
035.flavorText: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

036.name: Gloom
036.evolves: Evolves from Oddish and into Vileplume , Bellossom , Vileplume- GX , or Vileplume ex
036.attacksText: {G}{C} → Strange Powder : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused; if tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {G}{G}{C} → Sticky Nectar : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage and, until the end of your opponent's next turn, as long as Gloom is your Active Pokémon, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat, and if the effect of an attack, Pokémon Power, or Trainer card would change that player's Active Pokémon, that part of the effect does nothing. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.
036.flavorText: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

037.name: Granbull
037.attacksText: {C}{C} → Tackle : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Raging Charge : 10+ This attack does 10 damage plus 10 damage for each damage counter on Granbull. Then, Granbull does 20 damage to itself.
037.flavorText: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.

038.name: Lanturn
038.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Hydroelectric Power You may make Floodlight do 10 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to Lanturn but not used to pay for Floodlight's Energy cost. This power can't be used if Lanturn is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {L}{L} → Floodlight : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
038.flavorText: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

039.name: Ledian
039.evolves: Evolves from Ledyba
039.attacksText: {G}{G} → Baton Pass : 30 If you have any {G} Pokémon on your Bench, remove all {G} Energy cards from Ledian and attach them to 1 of those Pokémon, then switch Ledian with that Pokémon.
039.flavorText: When the stars flicker in the night sky, Ledian flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

040.name: Magmar
040.attacksText: {C}{C} → Tail Slap : 20 {R}{R}{C} → Magma Punch : 40
040.flavorText: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

041.name: Miltank
041.attacksText: {C} → Milk Drink Flip 2 coins. Remove 2 damage counters times the number of heads from Miltank. If it has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them. {C}{C}{C} → Body Slam : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
041.flavorText: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.

042.name: Noctowl
042.evolves: Evolves from Hoothoot and into Noctowl BREAK
042.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Glaring Gaze Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may flip a coin. If heads, look at your opponent's hand. If your opponent has any Trainer cards there, choose 1 of them. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck. This power can't be used if Noctowl is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {C}{C}{C} → Wing Attack : 30
042.flavorText: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

043.name: Phanpy
043.evolves: Evolves into Donphan or Dark Donphan
043.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {F} → Endure Flip a coin. If heads, then if, during your opponent's next turn, Phanpy would be Knocked Out by an attack, Phanpy isn't Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead.
043.flavorText: It swings its long snout around playfully, but, because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

044.name: Piloswine
044.evolves: Evolves from Swinub and into Mamoswine or Mamoswine ex
044.attacksText: {W}{W} → Freeze : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack. (Benching or evolving the Defending Pokémon ends this effect.) {W}{W}{W} → Blizzard : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon; if tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
044.flavorText: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

045.name: Quagsire
045.attacksText: {W}{W} → Surf : 30 {F}{F}{C}{C} → Earthquake : 60 Does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
045.flavorText: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

046.name: Quilava
046.evolves: Evolves from Cyndaquil and into Typhlosion , Typhlosion ex , or Hisuian Typhlosion
046.attacksText: {R}{C} → Ember : 30 Discard 1 {R} Energy card attached to Quilava in order to use this attack. {R}{R} → Fire Wind : 20 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them. Flip 2 coins. For each heads, this attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.)
046.flavorText: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

047.name: Quilava
047.evolves: Evolves from Cyndaquil and into Typhlosion , Typhlosion ex , or Hisuian Typhlosion
047.attacksText: {R}{R} → Smokescreen : 20 If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. {R}{R}{R} → Char : 30 If the Defending Pokémon doesn't have a Char counter on it, flip a coin. If heads, put a Char counter on it. A Char counter requires your opponent to flip a coin after every turn. If tails, put 2 damage counters on the Pokémon with that Char counter. (Char counters stay on the Pokémon as long as it's in play.)
047.flavorText: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

048.name: Seadra
048.evolves: Evolves from Horsea and into Kingdra , Kingdra ex , or Kingdra- GX
048.attacksText: {W} → Bubble : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{W} → Mud Splash : 30 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
048.flavorText: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in Horsea. It became a hot topic.

049.name: Skiploom
049.evolves: Evolves from Hoppip and into Jumpluff
049.attacksText: {G} → Poisonpowder : 10 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. {G} → Stun Spore : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
049.flavorText: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

050.name: Sunflora
050.attacksText: {G}{G}{G} → Petal Dance : 30× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. Sunflora is now Confused (after doing damage) .
050.flavorText: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

051.name: Togepi
051.evolves: Evolves into Togetic or Light Togetic
051.attacksText: {C}{C} → Poison Barb : 10 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
051.flavorText: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

052.name: Xatu
052.attacksText: {P} → Prophecy Look at the top 3 cards of either player's deck and rearrange them as you like. {P}{P}{P} → Confuse Ray : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
052.flavorText: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

053.name: Chikorita
053.evolves: Evolves into Bayleef
053.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {G} → Deflector During your opponent's next turn, whenever Chikorita takes damage, divide that damage in half (rounded down to the nearest 10). (Any other effects still happen.)
053.flavorText: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun's rays.

054.name: Chikorita
054.attacksText: {C} → Growl If the Defending Pokémon attacks Chikorita during your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Chikorita is reduced by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.) {G}{C} → Razor Leaf : 20
054.flavorText: Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

055.name: Chinchou
055.evolves: Evolves into Lanturn or Light Lanturn
055.attacksText: {L} → Supersonic Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. {W} → Flail : 10× Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Chinchou.
055.flavorText: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

056.name: Cyndaquil
056.evolves: Evolves into Quilava or Dark Quilava
056.attacksText: {C} → Leer Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack Cyndaquil during your opponent's next turn. (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.) {R}{C} → Swift : 20 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokémon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.
056.flavorText: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

057.name: Cyndaquil
057.evolves: Evolves into Quilava or Dark Quilava
057.attacksText: {R} → Fireworks : 20 Flip a coin. If tails, discard 1 Energy card attached to Cyndaquil. {C}{C} → Quick Attack : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.
057.flavorText: It is timid and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

058.name: Girafarig
058.evolves: Evolves into Farigiraf or Farigiraf ex
058.attacksText: {C}{C} → Agility : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Girafarig. {P}{P} → Psybeam : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
058.flavorText: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

059.name: Gligar
059.attacksText: {F} → Poison Sting : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. {C}{C} → Slash : 20
059.flavorText: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

060.name: Hoothoot
060.attacksText: {C} → Hypnosis The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C} → Peck : 20
060.flavorText: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast that the movement can rarely be seen.

061.name: Hoppip
061.evolves: Evolves into Skiploom
061.attacksText: {C} → Hop : 10 {G} → Sprout Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon named Hoppip and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)
061.flavorText: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.

062.name: Horsea
062.evolves: Evolves into Seadra
062.attacksText: {W}{W} → Fin Slap : 20+ If an attack damaged Horsea during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage. If not, this attack does 20 damage.
062.flavorText: If attacked by a larger enemy, it quickly swims to safety by adeptly controlling its dorsal fin.

063.name: Ledyba
063.evolves: Evolves into Ledian or Light Ledian
063.attacksText: {G} → Supersonic Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. {G}{G} → Comet Punch Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
063.flavorText: It is very timid. It's afraid to move if alone, but it's active if in a group.

064.name: Mantine
064.attacksText: {W}{W} → Undulate : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Mantine.
064.flavorText: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.

065.name: Mareep
065.evolves: Evolves into Flaaffy or Dark Flaaffy
065.attacksText: {L} → Static Electricity For each Mareep in play, you may search your deck for a {L} Energy card and attach it to Mareep. Shuffle your deck afterward. {L}{L} → Thundershock : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
065.flavorText: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

066.name: Marill
066.evolves: Evolves into Azumarill , Azumarill ex , or Light Azumarill
066.attacksText: {C} → Defense Curl Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Marill during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) {W}{W} → Bubble Bomb : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, Marril does 10 damage to itself.
066.flavorText: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

067.name: Natu
067.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 10 {P}{P} → Telekinesis Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)
067.flavorText: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

068.name: Oddish
068.evolves: Evolves into Gloom or Dark Gloom
068.attacksText: {C} → Hide Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Oddish. {G}{G} → Absorb : 20 Remove a number of damage counters from Oddish equal to half the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Oddish has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.
068.flavorText: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. During the day, it stays quietly underground.

069.name: Onix
069.evolves: Evolves into Steelix , Dark Steelix , or Steelix ex
069.attacksText: {C} → Screech Until the end of your next turn, if an attack damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , that attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon. {F}{F} → Rage : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Onix.
069.flavorText: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

070.name: Pikachu
070.evolves: Evolves into Raichu , Alolan Raichu , […] Raichu- GX , Dark Raichu
070.attacksText: {C} → Quick Attack : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage. {L}{L}{C} → Agility : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Pikachu.
070.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

071.name: Sentret
071.attacksText: {C} → Fury Swipes : 10× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
071.flavorText: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

072.name: Shuckle
072.attacksText: {G} → Withdraw Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Shuckle during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) {G}{G} → Wrap : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
072.flavorText: The Berries it stores in its vaselike shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

073.name: Slowpoke
073.evolves: Evolves into Slowking , Slowbro , […] Dark Slowbro , Dark Slowking , Slowking ex
073.attacksText: {P} → Psyshock : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W} → Water Gun : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to Slowpoke but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.
073.flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

074.name: Snubbull
074.attacksText: {C} → Roar Flip a coin. If heads and if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he of she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.) {C}{C} → Lick : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
074.flavorText: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular.

075.name: Spinarak
075.evolves: Evolves into Ariados or Dark Ariados
075.attacksText: {C} → Scary Face Flip a coin. If heads, until the end of your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack or retreat. {G} → String Shot : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
075.flavorText: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

076.name: Stantler
076.attacksText: {C}{C} → Stomp : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage. {C}{C}{C} → Mystifying Horns : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
076.flavorText: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

077.name: Sudowoodo
077.attacksText: {F} → Flail : 10× Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Sudowoodo. {F}{C} → Rock Throw : 30
077.flavorText: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.

078.name: Sunkern
078.evolves: Evolves into Sunflora or Light Sunflora
078.attacksText: {G} → Growth Flip a coin. If heads, you may attach up to 2 {G} Energy cards from your hand to Sunkern. {G}{G}{G} → Mega Drain : 30 Remove a number of damage counters from Sunkern equal to half the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Sunkern has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.
078.flavorText: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a Spearow, it violently shakes its leaves.

079.name: Swinub
079.evolves: Evolves into Piloswine or Light Piloswine
079.attacksText: {W} → Powder Snow : 10 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
079.flavorText: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

080.name: Totodile
080.evolves: Evolves into Croconaw or Dark Croconaw
080.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 10 {W}{C} → Rage : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Totodile.
080.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

081.name: Totodile
081.evolves: Evolves into Croconaw or Dark Croconaw
081.attacksText: {C} → Leer Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack Totodile during your opponent's next turn. (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.) {W} → Fury Swipes : 10× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
081.flavorText: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.

082.name: Wooper
082.attacksText: {W} → Amnesia Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C} → Slam : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
082.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It leaves the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

083.name: Arcade Game
083.attacksText: Shuffle your deck, then reveal the top 3 cards of it. If at least 2 of those cards share the same name, put all of the ones with that name into your hand and shuffle the rest into your deck. If none of them do, shuffle all 3 into your deck.

084.name: Ecogym
084.attacksText: Whenever an attack, Pokémon Power, or Trainer card discards another player's non-{C} Energy card from a Pokémon, return that Energy card to its owner's hand. (Energy cards that are discarded when that Pokémon is Knocked Out don't count.) · Stadium rule: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

085.name: Energy Charge
085.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, shuffle up to 2 Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

086.name: Focus Band
086.attacksText: If the Pokémon Focus Band is attached to would be Knocked Out by your opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, that Pokémon is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead. Then, discard Focus Band. · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach Focus Band to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

087.name: Mary
087.attacksText: Draw 2 cards. Then, shuffle 2 cards from your hand into your deck.

088.name: PokéGear
088.attacksText: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. If any of them are Trainer cards, you may show 1 of them to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't play any more Trainer cards this turn.

089.name: Super Energy Retrieval
089.attacksText: Trade 2 of the other cards in your hand for 4 basic Energy cards from your discard pile. If you have fewer than 4 basic Energy cards there, take all of them.

090.name: Time Capsule
090.attacksText: Your opponent may choose 5 Basic Pokémon, Evolution, and/or basic Energy cards in his or her discard pile. (If your opponent doesn't have that many, he or she chooses all or none of them.) If your opponent chooses any cards, he or she shuffles them into his or her deck. Either way, you may do the same, and you can't play any more Trainer cards this turn.

091.name: Bill's Teleporter
091.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, draw 4 cards.

092.name: Card-Flip Game
092.attacksText: Choose 1 of your opponent's face-down Prizes. Guess whether it is an Energy card, a Trainer card, or a Pokémon (Basic or Evolution) card. Flip the card face up (and leave it face up) . If you guessed right, draw 2 cards.

093.name: Gold Berry
093.attacksText: At any time between turns, if there are at least 4 damage counters on the Pokémon Gold Berry is attached to, you may remove 4 of them and discard Gold Berry. At the start of each turn, if there are at least 4 damage counters on the Pokémon Gold Berry is attached to, remove 4 of them and discard Gold Berry. · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach Gold Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

094.name: Miracle Berry
094.attacksText: At any time between turns, if the Pokémon Miracle Berry is attached to is Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned, you may remove all those effects from that Pokémon and discard Miracle Berry. At the start of each turn, if the Pokémon Miracle Berry is attached to is Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned, remove all of those effects from that Pokémon and discard Miracle Berry. · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach Miracle Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

095.name: New Pokédex
095.attacksText: Shuffle your deck. Then, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

096.name: Professor Elm
096.attacksText: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 7 cards. You can't play any more Trainer cards this turn.

097.name: Sprout Tower
097.attacksText: All damage done by {C} Pokémon's attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . · Stadium rule: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

098.name: Super Scoop Up
098.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

099.name: Berry
099.attacksText: At any time between turns, if there are at least 2 damage counters on the Pokémon Berry is attached to, you may remove 2 of them and discard Berry. At the start of each turn, if there are at least 2 damage counters on the Pokémon Berry is attached to, remove 2 of them and discard Berry. · Pokémon Tool rule: Attach Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

100.name: Blaine
100.attacksText: During this turn, instead of attaching your free Energy card, you may instead attach 2 {R} Energy cards to 1 of your Pokémon with Blaine in its name. (Playing additional copies of this card this turn has no effect.)

101.name: Brock's Protection
101.attacksText: Attach Brock's Protection to 1 of your Pokémon with Brock in its name. Energy cards attached to that Pokémon can't be removed by your opponent's attacks or Trainer cards. (This doesn't stop the rest of the attack or Trainer card from working normally.)

102.name: Chaos Gym
102.attacksText: Whenever a player plays a Trainer card other than a Stadium card, he or she flips a coin. If heads, that player plays that card normally. If tails, the player can't play that card. If the card isn't put into play, the player's opponent may use that card instead, if he or she does everything required in order to play that card (like discarding cards) . Either way, the card goes to its owner's discard pile. · Stadium rule: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

103.name: Erika's Kindness
103.attacksText: Remove 2 damage counters from each Pokémon (yours and your opponent's) with any damage counters on it. If a Pokémon has just 1 damage counter, remove it.

104.name: Giovanni
104.attacksText: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play with Giovanni in its name. For the rest of your turn, you may evolve that Pokémon even if you just played or evolved it this turn or if this is your first turn. This effect also applies to the Pokémon it evolves into.

105.name: Giovanni's Last Resort
105.attacksText: Remove all damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon with Giovanni in its name. Then discard your hand.

106.name: Koga
106.attacksText: If an attack from a Pokémon with Koga in its name does damage to a Defending Pokémon this turn, that Pokémon is then Poisoned.

107.name: Lt. Surge's Secret Plan
107.attacksText: Put 1 card from your hand face down onto your Bench. (You can't play this card if your Bench is full.) Treat that card as a Basic Pokémon as long as it's face down. Flip the card if either player needs to know what it is in order to use an attack, a Pokémon Power, or a Trainer card. Flip the card if it ever uses an attack or Pokémon Power, evolves, retreats, is damaged by an attack, or is otherwise affected by an attack. At any time during your turn, you may flip the card over. When you flip that card over, if it isn't a Basic Pokémon, discard it and all cards attached to it.

108.name: Misty's Wish
108.attacksText: Look at 1 of your Prize cards. Then, ask your opponent if you may switch that card with 1 of the cards in your hand. If your opponent accepts and if you have any other cards in your hand, switch those cards. If your opponent declines, return the Prize card face down and draw a card.

109.name: Resistance Gym
109.attacksText: Each Pokémon's Resistance is reduced by 20. (If a Pokémon's Resistance is -30, it becomes -10.) · Stadium rule: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

110.name: Sabrina
110.attacksText: Take all Energy cards attached to 1 of your Pokémon with Sabrina in its name and attach them to another 1 of your Pokémon with Sabrina in its name.

111.name: Blaine's Quiz #2
111.attacksText: Put a card from your hand face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses whether it is an Energy card, a Trainer card, or a Pokémon (Basic or Evolution) card. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 2 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 2 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

112.name: Blaine's Quiz #3
112.attacksText: Put a Basic or Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you and tell your opponent the name of an attack of that card. Your opponent guesses the name of that card. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 3 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 3 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

113.name: Cinnabar City Gym
113.attacksText: Ignore Weakness when a {W} Pokémon does damage to a Pokémon with Blaine in its name. · Stadium rule: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

114.name: Fuchsia City Gym
114.attacksText: Once during each player's turn (before attacking) , that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player may shuffle 1 of his or her Pokémon in play with Koga in its name and any cards attached to it into his or her deck. · Stadium rule: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

115.name: Koga's Ninja Trick
115.attacksText: Attach Koga's Ninja Trick to your Active Pokémon with Koga in its name. If this Pokémon goes to your Bench, discard this card. When your opponent attacks, you may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon (before damage or other effects of attacks).

116.name: Master Ball
116.attacksText: Look at 7 cards from the top of your deck. You may choose a Basic Pokémon or Evolution card from those cards, show it to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle the rest into your deck.

117.name: Max Revive
117.attacksText: Discard 2 Energy cards from your hand in order to put 1 Basic Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench. (You can't play Max Revive if your Bench is full.)

118.name: Misty's Tears
118.attacksText: Discard 1 of the other cards in your hand in order to search your deck for up to 2 {W} Energy cards. Show those cards to your opponent, then put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

119.name: Rocket's Minefield Gym
119.attacksText: Whenever a player puts a Basic Pokémon onto his or her Bench from his or her hand, he or she flips a coin. If tails, put damage counters on that Pokémon. · Stadium rule: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

120.name: Rocket's Secret Experiment
120.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If tails, you can't play Trainer cards until the end of your next turn.

121.name: Sabrina's Psychic Control
121.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Trainer card in your opponent's discard pile that isn't put in play (like PlusPower or Mysterious Fossil) . You may use that card as if it were in your hand, if you do everything required in order to play that card (like discarding cards) . The card stays in your opponent's discard pile.

122.name: Saffron City Gym
122.attacksText: As often as each player like during his or her turn (before attacking) , that player may return 1 basic Energy card attached to 1 of his or her Pokémon with Sabrina in its name to his or her hand. · Stadium rule: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

123.name: Viridian City Gym
123.attacksText: Whenever a Pokémon with Giovanni in its name evolves, its owner removes 2 damage counters from that Pokémon (or 1 if it only has 1). · Stadium rule: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

124.name: Fervor
124.attacksText: Show the top 3 cards of your deck to all players. Put any {R} Energy cards there into your hand and discard the rest.

125.name: Transparent Walls
125.attacksText: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from attacks done to your Benched Pokémon. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

126.name: Warp Point
126.attacksText: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with his or her Active Pokémon, then, if you have any Benched Pokémon, you switch 1 of them with your Active Pokémon.

001.name: Blaine's Arcanine
001.attacksText: {R}{C}{C} → Heat Tackle : 40 Blaine's Arcanine does 10 damage to itself. {R}{R}{R}{R} → Firestorm : 120 Discard 3 {R} Energy cards attached to Blaine's Arcanine in order to use this attack.

002.name: Blaine's Charizard
002.attacksText: {R} → Roaring Flames : 20+ Discard all {R} Energy cards attached to Blaine's Charizard. If all Energy cards attached to Blaine's Charizard provide 2 {R} Energy, discard all of them. This attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each {R} Energy discarded in this way. {R}{R} → Flame Jet Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

003.name: Brock's Ninetales
003.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Shapeshift Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may attach an Evolution card from your hand to Brock's Ninetales. (This doesn't count as evolving Brock's Ninetales.) Treat Brock's Ninetales as if it were that Pokémon instead. It can't evolve, devolve, or use the Pokémon Power of that Pokémon. During your turn, you may discard the Evolution card attached to Brock's Ninetales. This power can't be used if Brock's Ninetales is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. If Brock's Ninetales becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed, discard all Evolution cards attached to it. {R}{R} → Will-o'-the-wisp : 30

004.name: Erika's Venusaur
004.attacksText: {G} → Growth Flip a coin. If heads, you may attach up to 2 {G} Energy cards from your hand to Erika's Venusaur. {G}{G}{G}{G} → Wide Solarbeam : 20 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 2 of them (or 1 if he or she only has 1). This attack does 20 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

005.name: Giovanni's Gyarados
005.attacksText: {W} → Summon Storm Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 20 damage to each other Pokémon (even your own) . Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. {W}{W}{C}{C} → Dragon Tornado : 40 Unless this attack Knocks Out the Defending Pokémon, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

006.name: Giovanni's Machamp
006.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Fortitude If Giovanni's Machamp would be Knocked Out by an opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, Giovanni's Machamp is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead. This power can't be used if Giovanni's Machamp is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {F}{F}{F}{C} → Hurricane Punch : 30× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

007.name: Giovanni's Nidoking
007.attacksText: {G} → Intimidate If the Defending Pokémon's maximum HP is 50 or less, it can't attack Giovanni's Nidoking during your opponent's next turn. (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.) {G}{G}{G}{C} → Tumbling Attack : 40+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage; if tails, this attack does 40 damage.

008.name: Giovanni's Persian
008.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Call the Boss When you play Giovanni's Persian from your hand, you may search your deck for the Trainer card named Giovanni, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C}{C} → Ambush : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

009.name: Koga's Beedrill
009.attacksText: {G}{G} → Nerve Poison : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned. {C}{C}{C} → Hyper Needle : 70 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. Either way, you can't use this attack again as long as Koga's Beedrill stays in play (even putting Koga's Beedrill on the Bench won't let you use it again).

010.name: Koga's Ditto
010.attacksText: {C} → Giant Growth Flip a coin. If heads, Koga's Ditto's maximum HP is now 80 and Koga's Ditto's Pound attack's base damage is 30 instead of 10. (Benching Koga's Ditto ends this effect.) {C} → Pound : 10

011.name: Lt. Surge's Raichu
011.attacksText: {L}{L} → Kerzap : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 30 more damage to the Defending Pokémon and discard all {L} Energy cards attached to Lt. Surge's Raichu. If tails, this attack does 20 damage. {L}{L}{C}{C} → Thundertackle : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, Lt. Surge's Raichu does 20 damage to itself.

012.name: Misty's Golduck
012.attacksText: {W}{C} → Electro Beam : 40 Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Energy cards attached to Misty's Golduck. {P}{C} → Super Removal Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any Energy cards and discard those Energy cards.

013.name: Misty's Gyarados
013.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Rebellion Whenever Misty's Gyarados attacks, flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, that attack does nothing. Instead, shuffle Misty's Gyarados and all cards attached to it into your deck. (This power works even if Misty's Gyarados is Confused.) {W}{W}{W}{W} → Tidal Wave : 70

014.name: Rocket's Mewtwo
014.attacksText: {P} → Juxtapose Flip a coin. If heads, switch the number of damage counters on Rocket's Mewtwo with the number of damage counters on the Defending Pokémon (even if it would Knock Out either Pokémon) . (It's okay if 1 of the Pokémon has no damage counters on it.) {P}{P} → Hypnoblast : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {P}{P}{P}{C} → Psyburn : 60

015.name: Rocket's Zapdos
015.attacksText: {L} → Plasma : 20 If there are any {L} Energy cards in your discard pile, attach 1 of them to Rocket's Zapdos. {L}{L}{L}{C} → Electroburn : 70 Rocket's Zapdos does damage to itself equal to 10 times the number of {L} Energy cards attached to it.

016.name: Sabrina's Alakazam
016.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Psylink Sabrina's Alakazam always has a copy of every attack your {P} Pokémon in play have (including their Energy costs and anything else required in order to use those attacks, such as discarding Energy cards). This power can't be used if Sabrina's Alakazam is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {P}{C}{C}{C} → Mega Burn : 60 You can't use this attack during your next turn.

017.name: Blaine
017.attacksText: During this turn, instead of attaching your free Energy card, you may instead attach 2 {R} Energy cards to 1 of your Pokémon with Blaine in its name. (Playing additional copies of this card this turn has no effect.)

018.name: Giovanni
018.attacksText: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play with Giovanni in its name. For the rest of your turn, you may evolve that Pokémon even if you just played or evolved it this turn or if this is your first turn. This effect also applies to the Pokémon it evolves into.

019.name: Koga
019.attacksText: If an attack from a Pokémon with Koga in its name does damage to a Defending Pokémon this turn, that Pokémon is then Poisoned.

020.name: Sabrina
020.attacksText: Take all Energy cards attached to 1 of your Pokémon with Sabrina in its name and attach them to another 1 of your Pokémon with Sabrina in its name.

021.name: Blaine's Ninetales
021.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Healing Fire Whenever you attach a {R} Energy card from your hand to Blaine's Ninetales, remove 1 damage counter from it, if it has any. 081.attacksText: {C} → Charge Take 1 {L} Energy card from your discard pile and attach it to Lt. Surge's Pikachu. {L}{L} → Lightning Tail : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

082.name: Lt. Surge's Rattata
082.attacksText: {C} → Focus Energy During your next turn, Lt. Surge's Rattata's Gnaw attack's base damage is doubled. {C}{C} → Gnaw : 20

083.name: Lt. Surge's Spearow
083.attacksText: {C} → Whirlwind : 10 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.) {C}{C} → Razor Wind : 40 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

084.name: Lt. Surge's Voltorb
084.attacksText: {L} → Spin Ball : 20× Flip 1 coin. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. {L}{C} → Double Spin : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

085.name: Misty's Goldeen
085.attacksText: {C} → Fury Attack : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads. {W} → Supersonic Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

086.name: Misty's Horsea
086.attacksText: {W} → Tackle : 10 {W}{W} → Smokescreen : 20 If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

087.name: Misty's Poliwag
087.attacksText: {W} → Hypnotic Stare Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {W}{C} → Tail Rap : 20× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

088.name: Misty's Seel
088.attacksText: {W}{C} → Aurora Beam : 20

089.name: Misty's Shellder
089.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {W}{C} → Clamp : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage) .

090.name: Misty's Staryu
090.attacksText: {W}{C} → Swift : 20 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokémon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

091.name: Sabrina's Abra
091.attacksText: {P} → Energy Loop : 20 Return a {P} Energy card attached to Sabrina's Abra to your hand in order to use this attack.

092.name: Sabrina's Drowzee
092.attacksText: {P} → Suggestion Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn. {C}{C} → Headbutt : 20

093.name: Sabrina's Gastly
093.attacksText: {P}{C} → Spook : 20 The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

094.name: Sabrina's Mr. Mime
094.attacksText: {C} → Sleight of Hand Choose up to 3 cards from your hand and put them on top of your deck. Then search your deck for that many basic Energy cards. Show those cards to your opponent, then put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {P}{C} → Slap : 20

095.name: Sabrina's Slowpoke
095.attacksText: {P}{C} → Lazy Attack : 30 Sabrina's Slowpoke is now Asleep (after doing damage) .

096.name: Sabrina's Venonat
096.attacksText: {G} → Poison Antennae The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. {P}{C} → Removal Beam : 20 If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of those Energy cards and discard it.

097.name: Blaine's Quiz #1
097.attacksText: Put a Basic Pokémon or Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you and tell your opponent its name. Your opponent guesses the length of that Pokémon. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 2 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 2 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

098.name: Brock
098.attacksText: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

099.name: Charity
099.attacksText: Attach Charity to your Active Pokémon. Unless that Pokémon gets Knocked Out, return Charity to your hand at the end of your turn. If that Pokémon attacks and does damage to the Defending Pokémon, you may reduce that damage by any amount (rounded to the nearest 10).

001.name: Dark Alakazam
001.attacksText: {P}{P}{C} → Teleport Blast : 30 You may switch Dark Alakazam with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.) {P}{P}{P} → Mind Shock : 40 Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)
001.flavorText: Almost as if it were being controlled by something else, it never changes expressions, even in the middle of battle.

002.name: Dark Arbok
002.attacksText: {G}{G} → Stare Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.) If that Pokémon has a Pokémon Power, that power stops working until the end of your opponent's next turn. {G}{G}{G} → Poison Vapor : 10 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
002.flavorText: Freezes its prey with its stare. If you should encounter one, remember not to look into its eyes.

003.name: Dark Blastoise
003.attacksText: {W}{W} → Hydrocannon : 30+ Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to Dark Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way. {W}{C}{C} → Rocket Tackle : 40 Dark Blastoise does 10 damage to itself. Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Dark Blastoise during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)
003.flavorText: An aggressive Pokémon that tackles anything it sees.

004.name: Dark Charizard
004.attacksText: {C} → Nail Flick : 10 {R}{R} → Continuous Fireball : 50× Flip a number of coins equal to the number of {R} Energy cards attached to Dark Charizard. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads. Discard a number of {R} Energy cards attached to Dark Charizard equal to the number of heads.
004.flavorText: Seemingly possessed, it spews fire like a volcano, trying to burn all it sees.

005.name: Dark Dragonite
005.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Summon Minions When you play Dark Dragonite from your hand, search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Giant Tail : 70 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
005.flavorText: Sometimes called “The God of Destruction.” Its wings are able to support it in spite of its massive weight.

006.name: Dark Dugtrio
006.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Sinkhole Whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon retreats, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, this power does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power stops working while Dark Dugtrio is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {F}{F} → Knock Down : 20+ Your opponent flips a coin. If tails, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if heads, this attack does 20 damage.
006.flavorText: Digs large sinkholes in the ground and tries to trap its enemies in them.

007.name: Dark Golbat
007.evolves: Evolves from Zubat and into Dark Crobat
007.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Sneak Attack When you play Dark Golbat from your hand, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you do, Dark Golbat does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Apply Weakness and Resistance. {G}{G} → Flitter Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)
007.flavorText: Sneaks up silently on its prey and attacks it from behind, sometimes killing it with one bite.

008.name: Dark Gyarados
008.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Final Beam When Dark Gyarados is Knocked Out by an attack, flip a coin. If heads, this power does 20 damage for each {W} Energy attached to Dark Gyarados to the Pokémon that Knocked Out Dark Gyarados. Apply Weakness and Resistance. This power doesn't work if Dark Gyarados is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {W}{W}{W} → Ice Beam : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
008.flavorText: Normally found only in the deep ocean, it has recently been seen in shallow waters as well.

009.name: Dark Hypno
009.attacksText: {P} → Psypunch : 20 {P}{P}{C} → Bench Manipulation : 20× Your opponent flips a number of coins equal to the number of Pokémon on his or her Bench. This attack does 20 damage times the number of tails. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)
009.flavorText: Carries a pendulum with it always. Sometimes appears near less-traveled roads and schools at dusk.

010.name: Dark Machamp
010.attacksText: {F}{F} → Mega Punch : 30 {F}{F}{F}{C} → Fling Your opponent shuffles his or her Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into his or her deck. This attack can't be used if your opponent has no Benched Pokémon.
010.flavorText: It is almost impossible to defend against a Machamp's four powerful arms.

011.name: Dark Magneton
011.attacksText: {C}{C} → Sonicboom : 20 Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.) {L}{L} → Magnetic Lines : 30 If the Defending Pokémon has any basic Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them. If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and attach that Energy card to it.
011.flavorText: The number of incidents of hackers using Magnetons to damage computer systems is steadily increasing.

012.name: Dark Slowbro
012.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Reel In When you play Dark Slowbro from your hand, choose up to 3 Basic Pokémon and/or Evolution cards from your discard pile and put them into your hand. {P}{P} → Fickle Attack : 40 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
012.flavorText: It loves nothing better than to be left alone, and so sometimes ends up being manipulated by unscrupulous people.

013.name: Dark Vileplume
013.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Hay Fever No Trainer cards can be played. This power stops working while Dark Vileplume is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {G}{G}{G} → Petal Whirlwind : 30× Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, Dark Vileplume is now Confused (after doing damage) .
013.flavorText: Perhaps because of their strong-smelling pollen, other Pokémon do not approach areas where Vileplumes live.

014.name: Dark Weezing
014.attacksText: {G}{C} → Mass Explosion : 20× Does 20 damage times the total number of Koffings, Weezings, and Dark Weezings in play (Apply Weakness and Resistance.) . Then, this attack does 20 damage to each Koffing, Weezing, and Dark Weezing (even your own) . Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. {G}{G}{G} → Stun Gas : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned; if tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
014.flavorText: Researchers have observed these Pokémon reproducing in industrial waste sites.

015.name: Here Comes Team Rocket!
015.attacksText: Each player plays with his or her Prize cards face up for the rest of the game.

016.name: Rocket's Sneak Attack
016.attacksText: Look at your opponent's hand. If he or she has any Trainer cards, choose 1 of them. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck.

017.name: Rainbow Energy
017.attacksText: Attach Rainbow Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Rainbow Energy counts as every type of basic Energy but only provides 1 Energy at a time. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card when not in play.) When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, it does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.)

032.evolves: Evolves from Charmander and into Dark Charizard
032.attacksText: {C}{C} → Tail Slap : 20 {R}{R}{R} → Fireball : 70 Use this attack only if there are any {R} Energy cards attached to Dark Charmeleon. Flip a coin. If heads, discard 1 of those Energy cards. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage) .
032.flavorText: Its tail is incredibly strong, able to lift up to 5 adult men.

033.name: Dark Dragonair
033.evolves: Evolves from Dratini and into Dark Dragonite
033.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Evolutionary Light Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may search your deck for an Evolution card. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Dark Dragonair is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {C}{C}{C} → Tail Strike : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.
033.flavorText: As is fitting for a legendary Pokémon, it has many strange powers, including the ability to make rain or snow fall.

034.name: Dark Electrode
034.attacksText: {C} → Rolling Tackle : 10 {L}{L} → Energy Bomb : 30 Take all Energy cards attached to Dark Electrode and attach them to your Benched Pokémon (in any way you choose) . If you have no Benched Pokémon, discard all Energy cards attached to Dark Electrode.
034.flavorText: Some researchers hypothesize that Electrode may actually be a form of energy instead of having an actual body.

035.name: Dark Flareon
035.attacksText: {C} → Rage : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Dark Flareon. {R}{R} → Playing with Fire : 30+ Use this attack only if there are any {R} Energy cards attached to Dark Flareon. Flip a coin. If heads, discard 1 of those Energy cards and this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage.
035.flavorText: A Pokémon with a hot temper that can't be controlled once it's angered. Capable of breathing flames hotter than 3000°.

036.name: Dark Gloom
036.evolves: Evolves from Oddish and into Dark Vileplume
036.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Pollen Stench Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused; if tails, your Active Pokémon is now Confused. This power can't be used if Dark Gloom is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {G}{G} → Poisonpowder : 10 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
036.flavorText: Its pollen has such a strong smell that it even confuses itself at times.

037.name: Dark Golduck
037.attacksText: {P} → Third Eye Discard 1 Energy card attached to Dark Golduck in order to draw up to 3 cards. {P}{P}{C} → Super Psy : 50
037.flavorText: When Psyducks evolve, their headaches disappear and they find themselves in possession of formidable mental powers.

038.name: Dark Jolteon
038.attacksText: {L} → Lightning Flash : 20 If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. {L}{L}{C} → Thunder Attack : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, Dark Jolteon does 10 damage to itself.
038.flavorText: A dangerous Pokémon when angered. It likes to playfully shock people with the electricity it stores within its body.

039.name: Dark Kadabra
039.evolves: Evolves from Abra and into Dark Alakazam
039.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Matter Exchange Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may discard a card from your hand in order to draw a card. This power can't be used if Dark Kadabra is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {P}{P} → Mind Shock : 30 Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)
039.flavorText: Some people say that Kadabras are responsible for many of the mysterious events reported in the news.

040.name: Dark Machoke
040.evolves: Evolves from Machop and into Dark Machamp
040.attacksText: {F}{F}{C} → Drag Off : 20 Before doing damage, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. Do the damage to the new Defending Pokémon. This attack can't be used if your opponent has no Benched Pokémon. {F}{F}{C} → Knock Back : 30 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)
040.flavorText: While normally peaceful and friendly, the number of incidents involving cruel Machokes is rising.

041.name: Dark Muk
041.evolves: Evolves from Grimer
041.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Sticky Goo As long as Dark Muk is your Active Pokémon, your opponent pays {C}{C} more to retreat his or her Active Pokémon. This power stops working while Dark Muk is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {G}{G} → Sludge Punch : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
041.flavorText: Muks appear suddenly, spreading sludge everywhere. Whenever one appears in a city, panic ensues.

042.name: Dark Persian
042.attacksText: {C} → Fascinate Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. This attack can't be used if your opponent has no Benched Pokémon. {C}{C} → Poison Claws : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
042.flavorText: Popular with women because of its beautiful fur. The leader of the Rockets keeps one as a pet.

043.name: Dark Primeape
043.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Frenzy If Dark Primeape does any damage while it's Confused (even to itself) , it does 30 more damage. {F}{F} → Frenzied Attack : 40 Dark Primeape is now Confused (after doing damage) .
043.flavorText: Although Primeapes have always been mean, lately they seem to be becoming even more vicious and frenzied.

044.name: Dark Rapidash
044.attacksText: {C}{C} → Rear Kick : 20 {R}{R} → Flame Pillar : 30 You may discard 1 {R} Energy card attached to Dark Rapidash when you use this attack. If you do and if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
044.flavorText: A wild, uncontrollable Pokémon. When running, it looks like a comet streaking through the sky.

045.name: Dark Vaporeon
045.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Bite : 30 {W}{W}{C} → Whirlpool : 20 If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.
045.flavorText: A Pokémon capable of controlling water, so it is capable of creating giant whirlpools.

046.name: Dark Wartortle
046.evolves: Evolves from Squirtle and into Dark Blastoise
046.attacksText: {W} → Doubleslap : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads. {W}{C} → Mirror Shell If an attack does damage to Dark Wartortle during your opponent's next turn (even if Dark Wartortle is Knocked Out) , Dark Wartortle attacks the Defending Pokémon for an equal amount of damage.
046.flavorText: A Pokémon with a negative attitude, it hides in its shell whenever it's in a bad mood—which is often.

047.name: Magikarp
047.evolves: Evolves into Gyarados , Gyarados- GX , Dark Gyarados , or Gyarados ex
047.attacksText: {C} → Flop : 10 {W}{W}{W} → Rapid Evolution Search your deck for an Evolution card named Gyarados or Dark Gyarados and put it on Magikarp. (This counts as evolving Magikarp.) Shuffle your deck afterward.
047.flavorText: Recent research has revealed the presence of dragon DNA in this species of Pokémon.

048.name: Porygon
048.evolves: Evolves into Porygon2 or Dark Porygon2
048.attacksText: {C} → Conversion 1 If the Defending Pokémon has a Weakness, you may change it to a type of your choice other than Colorless. {C}{C}{C} → Psybeam : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
048.flavorText: More and more people play the slots every day, trying to win a Porygon.

049.name: Abra
049.evolves: Evolves into Kadabra or Dark Kadabra
049.attacksText: {P} → Vanish Shuffle Abra into your deck. (Discard all cards attached to Abra.) {P} → Psyshock : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
049.flavorText: It teleports itself away from danger, making it difficult to capture.

050.name: Charmander
050.evolves: Evolves into Charmeleon or Dark Charmeleon
050.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Gather Fire Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may take 1 {R} Energy card attached to 1 of your other Pokémon and attach it to Charmander. This power can't be used if Charmander is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {R} → Fire Tail : 20
050.flavorText: Many people find it cute and try to hold it, only to be burned by its tail.

051.attacksText: {C}{C} → Gnaw : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Hyper Fang : 50 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
051.flavorText: A Raticate's front teeth are incredibly powerful; it can destroy a two-story house with them in 5 minutes.

052.evolves: Evolves into Dugtrio or Dark Dugtrio

052.flavorText: It follows Onixes in their tunnels, looking for scraps of food they have left behind.

053.name: Dratini
053.evolves: Evolves into Dragonair , Dark Dragonair , or Light Dragonair
053.attacksText: {C}{C} → Wrap : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
053.flavorText: The capture of the first Dratini inspired the search for other legendary Pokémon.

054.name: Drowzee
054.evolves: Evolves into Hypno or Dark Hypno
054.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Long-Distance Hypnosis Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep; if tails, your Active Pokémon is now Asleep. The power can't be used if Drowzee is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {P}{C} → Nightmare : 10 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
054.flavorText: Not popular with girls because of its attitude. Can often be heard muttering to itself in a low voice.

055.name: Eevee
055.evolves: Evolves into Jolteon , Flareon , […] Vaporeon , Umbreon , Espeon , Leafeon , Glaceon , Sylveon , Glaceon- GX , Sylveon- GX , Umbreon- GX , Espeon- GX , Leafeon- GX , Umbreon ex , Espeon ex , Sylveon ex , Jolteon ex , Vaporeon ex , Flareon ex , Glaceon ex , Dark Vaporeon , Leafeon ex , Flareon- GX , Light Jolteon , Light Vaporeon , Dark Espeon , Dark Flareon , Dark Jolteon , Jolteon- GX , Light Flareon
055.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {C}{C} → Sand-attack : 10 If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.
055.flavorText: A rare and unique Pokémon about which little is known, as few have been captured.

056.name: Ekans
056.evolves: Evolves into Arbok , Dark Arbok , or Arbok ex
056.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 10 {G}{G} → Poison Sting : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
056.flavorText: A carnivore that swallows its prey whole. Pidgeys and Spearows are its favorite food.

057.name: Grimer
057.evolves: Evolves into Muk , Dark Muk , or Muk ex
