057.flavorText: It has recently been found that Grimers are formed in waste-processing plants, and can move into towns via sewers.

058.name: Koffing
058.evolves: Evolves into Weezing , Galarian Weezing , or Dark Weezing
058.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {G}{C} → Poison Gas : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
058.flavorText: First discovered in a weapons factory, this Pokémon can now be found almost anywhere.

059.name: Machop
059.evolves: Evolves into Machoke , Dark Machoke , or Light Machoke
059.attacksText: {C}{C} → Punch : 20 {F}{C}{C} → Kick : 30
059.flavorText: It's said that not even pro wrestlers can take down a Machop.

060.name: Magnemite
060.evolves: Evolves into Magneton or Dark Magneton
060.attacksText: {C}{C} → Tackle : 20 {L}{C} → Magnetism : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Magnemite, Magneton, and Dark Magneton on your Bench.
060.flavorText: It is said that enough Magnemites and Magnetons gather in one place, they can create a powerful magnetic barrier.

061.name: Mankey
061.evolves: Evolves into Primeape or Dark Primeape
061.attacksText: {C} → Mischief Shuffle your opponent's deck. {F}{C} → Anger : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.
061.flavorText: Normally friendly, it quickly becomes angry if it doesn't get what it wants.

062.name: Meowth
062.evolves: Evolves into Persian , Dark Persian , or Persian- GX
062.attacksText: {C}{C} → Coin Hurl Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)
062.flavorText: A popular Pokémon that earns money for its owner with its “Pay Day” ability.

063.name: Oddish
063.evolves: Evolves into Gloom or Dark Gloom
063.attacksText: {G} → Sleep Powder The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {G} → Poisonpowder The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
063.flavorText: It wanders around at night sowing its seeds to create more Oddishes.

064.name: Ponyta
064.evolves: Evolves into Rapidash or Dark Rapidash
064.attacksText: {R}{C} → Ember : 30 Discard 1 {R} Energy card attached to Ponyta in order to use this attack.
064.flavorText: A gentle grass-eater, it will allow riders on its back. However, anyone attempting to do so must be careful not to get burned.

065.name: Psyduck
065.evolves: Evolves into Golduck , Dark Golduck , or Light Golduck
065.attacksText: {P} → Dizziness Draw a card. {W}{C} → Water Gun : 20+ Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to Psyduck but not used to pay for this attack. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.
065.flavorText: It is often seen holding its head in its paws, as if it were suffering from a headache.

066.name: Rattata
066.evolves: Evolves into Raticate or Dark Raticate
066.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Trickery Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may switch 1 of your Prizes with the top card of your deck. This power can't be used if Rattata is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {C} → Quick Attack : 10+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.
066.flavorText: Loves to eat walnuts, chestnuts, cheese, and milk.

067.name: Slowpoke
067.evolves: Evolves into Slowking , Slowbro , […] Dark Slowbro , Dark Slowking , Slowking ex
067.attacksText: {C} → Afternoon Nap Search your deck for a {P} Energy card and attach it to Slowpoke. Shuffle your deck afterward. {P} → Headbutt : 10
067.flavorText: Although it knows how to fish, no other intelligent behavior has been detected in it.

068.name: Squirtle
068.evolves: Evolves into Wartortle or Dark Wartortle
068.attacksText: {C}{C} → Shell Attack : 20
068.flavorText: Cute Pokémon that charms people with its innocent eyes. Loves swimming all day long.

069.name: Voltorb
069.evolves: Evolves into Electrode , Electrode- GX , Dark Electrode , or Electrode ex
069.attacksText: {L} → Speed Ball : 20
069.flavorText: Usually seen only in power plants, it is sometimes seen in towns, apparently using the power lines to travel.

070.name: Zubat
070.evolves: Evolves into Golbat or Dark Golbat
070.attacksText: {C} → Ram : 10 {G}{C} → Bite : 20
070.flavorText: Lives in dark caves. Can occasionally be seen at night, when it flies in search of food.

071.name: Here Comes Team Rocket!
071.attacksText: Each player plays with his or her Prize cards face up for the rest of the game.

072.name: Rocket's Sneak Attack
072.attacksText: Look at your opponent's hand. If he or she has any Trainer cards, choose 1 of them. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck.

073.name: The Boss's Way
073.attacksText: Search your deck for an Evolution card with Dark in its name. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

074.name: Challenge!
074.attacksText: Ask your opponent if he or she accepts your challenge. If your opponent declines (or if both Benches are full), draw 2 cards. If your opponent accepts, each of you searches your decks for any number of Basic Pokémon cards and puts them face down onto your Benches. (A player can't do this if his or her Bench is full.) When you both have finished, shuffle your decks and turn those cards face up.

075.name: Digger
075.attacksText: Flip a coin. If tails, do 10 damage to your Active Pokémon. If heads, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, your opponent does 10 damage to his or her Active Pokémon. If heads, you flip a coin. Keep doing this until a player gets tails.

076.name: Imposter Oak's Revenge
076.attacksText: Discard a card from your hand in order to play this card. Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 4 cards.

077.name: Nightly Garbage Run
077.attacksText: Choose up to 3 Basic Pokémon cards, Evolution cards, and/or basic Energy cards from your discard pile. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

078.name: Goop Gas Attack
078.attacksText: All Pokémon Powers stop working until the end of your opponent's next turn.

079.name: Sleep!
079.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

080.name: Rainbow Energy
080.attacksText: Attach Rainbow Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Rainbow Energy counts as every type of basic Energy but only provides 1 Energy at a time. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card when not in play.) When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, it does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.)

081.name: Full Heal Energy
081.attacksText: If you play this card from your hand, the Pokémon you attach it to is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. Full Heal Energy provides {C} energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

082.name: Potion Energy
082.attacksText: If you play this card from your hand, remove 1 damage counter from the Pokémon you attach it to, if it has any. Potion Energy provides {C} energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

083.name: Dark Raichu
083.attacksText: {L}{L}{L} → Surprise Thunder : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, flip another coin. If the second coin is heads, this attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If the second coin is tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
083.flavorText: Stores up electricity in its body, then suddenly releases it to surprise and shock everyone.

100.name: Weedle
100.attacksText: {G} → Poison Sting : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
100.flavorText: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.

101.name: Computer Search
101.attacksText: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

102.name: Imposter Professor Oak
102.attacksText: Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 7 cards.

103.name: Item Finder
103.attacksText: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

104.name: Lass
104.attacksText: You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the Trainer cards from your hands into your decks.

105.name: Pokémon Breeder
105.attacksText: Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

106.name: Pokémon Trader
106.attacksText: Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

107.name: Scoop Up
107.attacksText: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

108.name: Super Energy Removal
108.attacksText: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and up to 2 Energy cards attached to it. Discard those Energy cards.

109.name: Defender
109.attacksText: Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard Defender. Damage done to that Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .

110.name: Energy Retrieval
110.attacksText: Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.

111.name: Full Heal
111.attacksText: Your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

112.name: Maintenance
112.attacksText: Shuffle 2 of the other cards from your hand into your deck in order to draw a card.

113.name: PlusPower
113.attacksText: Attach PlusPower to your Active Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard PlusPower. If this Pokémon's attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

114.name: Pokémon Center
114.attacksText: Remove all damage counters from all of your own Pokémon with damage counters on them, then discard all Energy cards attached to those Pokémon.

115.name: Pokédex
115.attacksText: Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

116.name: Professor Oak
116.attacksText: Discard your hand, then draw 7 cards.

117.name: Super Potion
117.attacksText: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to remove up to 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.

118.name: Bill
118.attacksText: Draw 2 cards.

119.name: Energy Removal
119.attacksText: Choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and discard it.

120.name: Gust of Wind
120.attacksText: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.

121.name: Poké Ball
121.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, you may search your deck for any Basic Pokémon or Evolution card. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

122.name: Potion
122.attacksText: Remove up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

123.name: Switch
123.attacksText: Switch 1 of your Benched Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

124.name: Double Colorless Energy
124.attacksText: Provides {C}{C} energy. Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.

001.name: Alakazam
001.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Damage Swap As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to another as long as you don't Knock Out that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Alakazam is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {P}{P}{P} → Confuse Ray : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
001.flavorText: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

002.name: Blastoise
002.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Rain Dance As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may attach 1 {W} Energy card to 1 of your {W} Pokémon. (This doesn't use up your 1 Energy card attachment for the turn.) This power can't be used if Blastoise is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {W}{W}{W} → Hydro Pump : 40+ Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.
002.flavorText: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

003.name: Chansey
003.evolves: Evolves into Blissey or Blissey ex
003.attacksText: {C}{C} → Scrunch Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Chansey during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) {C}{C}{C}{C} → Double-edge : 80 Chansey does 80 damage to itself.
003.flavorText: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

004.name: Charizard
004.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Energy Burn As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may turn all Energy attached to Charizard into {R} Energy for the rest of the turn. This power can't be used if Charizard is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {R}{R}{R}{R} → Fire Spin : 100 Discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard in order to use this attack.
004.flavorText: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

005.name: Clefable
005.attacksText: {C} → Metronome Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy costs and anything else required in order to use that attack, such as discarding Energy cards. (No matter what type the Defending Pokémon is, Clefable's type is still Colorless.) {C}{C} → Minimize All damage done by attacks to Clefable during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
005.flavorText: A timid Fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

006.name: Clefairy
006.evolves: Evolves into Clefable , Mega Clefable ex , or Clefable ex
006.attacksText: {C} → Sing Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C}{C} → Metronome Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy costs and anything else required in order to use that attack, such as discarding Energy cards. (No matter what type the Defending Pokémon is, Clefairy's type is still Colorless.)
006.flavorText: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

007.name: Gyarados
007.attacksText: {W}{W}{W} → Dragon Rage : 50 {W}{W}{W}{W} → Bubblebeam : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
007.flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

008.name: Hitmonchan
008.attacksText: {F} → Jab : 20 {F}{F}{C} → Special Punch : 40
008.flavorText: While seeming to do nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

009.name: Magneton
009.evolves: Evolves from Magnemite and into Magnezone or Magnezone ex
009.attacksText: {L}{L}{C} → Thunder Wave : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {L}{L}{C}{C} → Selfdestruct : 80 Does 20 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Magneton does 80 damage to itself.
009.flavorText: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. It frequently appears when sunspots flare up.

010.name: Mewtwo
010.attacksText: {P}{C} → Psychic : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon. {P}{P} → Barrier Discard 1 {P} Energy card attached to Mewtwo in order to use this attack. During your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Mewtwo.
010.flavorText: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

011.name: Nidoking
011.evolves: Evolves from Nidorino and into Nidoking BREAK
011.attacksText: {G}{C}{C} → Thrash : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage and Nidoking does 10 damage to itself. {G}{G}{G} → Toxic : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned) .
011.flavorText: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

012.name: Nidoqueen
012.attacksText: {G}{C} → Boyfriends : 20+ Does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each Nidoking you have in play. {G}{G}{C}{C} → Mega Punch : 50
012.flavorText: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

013.name: Ninetales
013.evolves: Evolves from Vulpix and into Ninetales BREAK
013.attacksText: {C}{C} → Lure If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. {R}{R}{R}{R} → Fire Blast : 80 Discard 1 {R} Energy card attached to Ninetales in order to use this attack.
013.flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

014.name: Pidgeot
014.attacksText: {C}{C} → Wing Attack : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Hurricane : 30 Unless this attack Knocks Out the Defending Pokémon, return the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your opponent's hand.
014.flavorText: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

015.name: Poliwrath
015.attacksText: {W}{W}{C} → Water Gun : 30+ Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to Poliwrath but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way. {W}{W}{C}{C} → Whirlpool : 40 If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.
015.flavorText: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

016.name: Raichu
016.evolves: Evolves from Pikachu and into Raichu BREAK or Raichu LV. X
016.attacksText: {L}{C}{C} → Agility : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Raichu. {L}{L}{L}{C} → Thunder : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, Raichu does 30 damage to itself.
016.flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

017.name: Scyther
017.evolves: Evolves into Scizor , Scizor- GX , […] Scizor ex , Kleavor
017.attacksText: {G} → Swords Dance During your next turn, Scyther's Slash attack's base damage is 60 instead of 30. {C}{C}{C} → Slash : 30
017.flavorText: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one of it.

018.name: Venusaur
018.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Energy Trans As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may take 1 {G} Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon and attach it to a different one. This power can't be used if Venusaur is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {G}{G}{G}{G} → Solarbeam : 60
018.flavorText: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

019.name: Wigglytuff
019.attacksText: {C} → Lullaby The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C}{C} → Do the Wave : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.
019.flavorText: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

020.name: Zapdos
020.attacksText: {L}{L}{L}{C} → Thunder : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, Zapdos does 30 damage to itself. {L}{L}{L}{L} → Thunderbolt : 100 Discard all Energy cards attached to Zapdos in order to use this attack.
020.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

021.name: Beedrill
021.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Twineedle : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {G}{G}{G} → Poison Sting : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
021.flavorText: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

022.name: Dragonair
022.evolves: Evolves from Dratini and into Dragonite , Dragonite- GX , Mega Dragonite ex , or Dragonite ex
022.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Slam : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Hyper Beam : 20 If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.
022.flavorText: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

023.name: Dugtrio
023.attacksText: {F}{F}{C} → Slash : 40 {F}{F}{F}{F} → Earthquake : 70 Does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
023.flavorText: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

024.name: Electabuzz
024.evolves: Evolves into Electivire or Electivire ex
024.attacksText: {L} → Thundershock : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {L}{C} → Thunderpunch : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage and Electabuzz does 10 damage to itself.
024.flavorText: Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

025.name: Electrode
025.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Buzzap At any time during your turn (before your attack) , you may Knock Out Electrode and attach it to 1 of your other Pokémon. If you do, choose a type of Energy. Electrode is now an Energy card of that type (instead of a Pokémon) that provides 2 energy. This power can't be used if Electrode is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {L}{L}{L} → Electric Shock : 50 Flip a coin. If tails, Electrode does 10 damage to itself.
025.flavorText: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

026.name: Kangaskhan
026.attacksText: {C} → Fetch Draw a card. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Comet Punch : 20× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
026.flavorText: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is three years old.

027.name: Mr. Mime
027.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Invisible Wall Whenever an attack (including your own) does 30 or more damage to Mr. Mime (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) This power stops working while Mr. Mime is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {P}{C} → Meditate : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.
027.flavorText: If interrupted while miming, it will slap around the enemy with its broad hands.

028.name: Pidgeotto
028.evolves: Evolves from Pidgey and into Pidgeot or Pidgeot ex
028.attacksText: {C}{C} → Whirlwind : 20 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.) {C}{C}{C} → Mirror Move If Pidgeotto was attacked last turn, do the final result of that attack on Pidgeotto to the Defending Pokémon.
028.flavorText: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

029.name: Pinsir
029.attacksText: {G}{G} → Irongrip : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {G}{G}{C}{C} → Guillotine : 50
029.flavorText: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing its victim around and toss it hard.

030.name: Snorlax
030.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Thick Skinned Snorlax can't become Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. This power stops working while Snorlax is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Body Slam : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
030.flavorText: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

031.name: Venomoth
031.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Shift Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may change the type of Venomoth to the type of any other Pokémon in play other than Colorless. This power can't be used if Venomoth is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {G}{G} → Venom Powder : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.
031.flavorText: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

032.name: Victreebel
032.attacksText: {G} → Lure If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon. {G}{G} → Acid : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

033.name: Arcanine
033.evolves: Evolves from Growlithe and into Arcanine BREAK
033.attacksText: {R}{R}{C} → Flamethrower : 50 Discard 1 {R} Energy card attached to Arcanine in order to use this attack. {R}{R}{C}{C} → Take Down : 80 Arcanine does 30 damage to itself.

(Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.) {G}{G}{G}{G} → Mega Drain : 40 Remove a number of damage counters from Butterfree equal to half the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Butterfree has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

035.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Slash : 30 {R}{R}{C} → Flamethrower : 50 Discard 1 {R} Energy card attached to Charmeleon in order to use this attack.

036.attacksText: {W}{W}{C} → Aurora Beam : 50 {W}{W}{C}{C} → Ice Beam : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

037.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Retreat Aid As long as Dodrio is Benched, pay {C} less to retreat your Active Pokémon. {C}{C}{C} → Rage : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Dodrio.
037.flavorText: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

038.name: Dratini
038.evolves: Evolves into Dragonair , Dark Dragonair , or Light Dragonair
038.attacksText: {C} → Pound : 10
038.flavorText: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

039.attacksText: {P} → Teleport Switch Exeggutor with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {C} → Big Eggsplosion : 20× Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to Exeggutor. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

041.flavorText: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

042.evolves: Evolves into Arcanine , Arcanine ex , or Light Arcanine
042.attacksText: {R}{C} → Flare : 20
042.flavorText: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

043.evolves: Evolves from Gastly and into Gengar , Mega Gengar ex , or Gengar ex
043.attacksText: {P} → Hypnosis The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {P}{P} → Dream Eater : 50 You can't use this attack unless the Defending Pokémon is Asleep.
043.flavorText: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

044.evolves: Evolves from Bulbasaur and into Venusaur , Venusaur ex , or Mega Venusaur ex
044.attacksText: {G}{C}{C} → Vine Whip : 30 {G}{G}{G} → Poisonpowder : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
044.flavorText: When the bulb on its back grows large, the Pokémon seems to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

045.name: Jynx
045.attacksText: {P} → Doubleslap : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads. {P}{P}{C} → Meditate : 20+ Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.
045.flavorText: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

046.name: Kadabra
046.evolves: Evolves from Abra and into Alakazam or Alakazam ex
046.attacksText: {P}{P} → Recover Discard 1 {P} Energy card attached to Kadabra in order to use this attack. Remove all damage counters from Kadabra. {P}{P}{C} → Super Psy : 50
046.flavorText: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches even to those just nearby.

047.name: Kakuna
047.evolves: Evolves from Weedle and into Beedrill
047.attacksText: {C}{C} → Stiffen Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Kakuna during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) {G}{G} → Poisonpowder : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
047.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

048.name: Lickitung
048.attacksText: {C} → Tongue Wrap : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {C}{C} → Supersonic Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

049.evolves: Evolves from Machop and into Machamp or Machamp- GX
049.attacksText: {F}{F}{C} → Karate Chop : 50- Does 50 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Machoke. {F}{F}{C}{C} → Submission : 60 Machoke does 20 damage to itself.
049.flavorText: Its muscular body is so powerful that it must wear a power-save belt to help regulate its motions.

050.name: Magikarp
050.evolves: Evolves into Gyarados , Gyarados- GX , Dark Gyarados , or Gyarados ex
050.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {W} → Flail : 10× Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Magikarp.
050.flavorText: In the distant past, it was stronger than its horribly weak descendants that exist today.

051.name: Magmar
051.evolves: Evolves into Magmortar
051.attacksText: {R}{R} → Fire Punch : 30 {R}{R}{C} → Flamethrower : 50 Discard 1 {R} Energy card attached to Magmar in order to use this attack.
051.flavorText: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

052.name: Marowak
052.evolves: Evolves from Cubone and into Marowak BREAK
052.attacksText: {F}{F} → Bonemerang : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {F}{F}{C} → Call for Friend Search your deck for a {F} Basic Pokémon card and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)
052.flavorText: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to K.O. targets.

053.name: Nidorina
053.evolves: Evolves from Nidoran Female and into Nidoqueen
053.attacksText: {G} → Supersonic Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. {G}{C}{C} → Double Kick : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
053.flavorText: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

054.name: Nidorino
054.evolves: Evolves from Nidoran Male and into Nidoking
054.attacksText: {G}{C}{C} → Double Kick : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {G}{G}{C}{C} → Horn Drill : 50
054.flavorText: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

055.name: Parasect
055.evolves: Evolves from Paras
055.attacksText: {G}{G} → Spore The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C}{C} → Slash : 30
055.flavorText: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

056.name: Persian
056.attacksText: {C}{C} → Scratch : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Pounce : 30 If the Defending Pokémon attacks Persian during your opponent's next turn, any damage done by the attack is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . (Benching either Pokémon ends this effect.)
056.flavorText: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

057.name: Poliwhirl
057.evolves: Evolves from Poliwag and into Poliwrath , Politoed , or Politoed ex
057.attacksText: {W}{W} → Amnesia Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn. {W}{W}{C} → Doubleslap : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
057.flavorText: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

058.name: Raticate
058.evolves: Evolves from Rattata and into Raticate BREAK
058.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Super Fang : ? Does damage to the Defending Pokémon equal to half the Defending Pokémon's remaining HP (rounded up to the nearest 10).
058.flavorText: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

059.name: Rhydon
059.evolves: Evolves from Rhyhorn and into Rhyperior
059.attacksText: {F}{C}{C} → Horn Attack : 30 {F}{F}{F}{F} → Ram : 50 Rhydon does 20 damage to itself. If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon. Switch the Pokémon even if Rhydon is knocked out.)
059.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

060.name: Seaking
060.attacksText: {W} → Horn Attack : 10 {W}{C} → Waterfall : 30
060.flavorText: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

061.evolves: Evolves into Dewgong or Light Dewgong
061.attacksText: {W} → Headbutt : 10
061.flavorText: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

062.name: Tauros
062.attacksText: {C}{C} → Stomp : 20+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage. {C}{C}{C} → Rampage : 20+ Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Tauros. Flip a coin. If tails, Tauros is now Confused (after doing damage) .
062.flavorText: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

063.name: Wartortle
063.evolves: Evolves from Squirtle and into Blastoise , Blastoise ex , or Blastoise- GX
063.attacksText: {W}{C} → Withdraw Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Wartortle during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) {W}{C}{C} → Bite : 40
063.flavorText: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. When swimming quickly, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

064.name: Weepinbell
064.evolves: Evolves from Bellsprout and into Victreebel
064.attacksText: {G} → Poisonpowder : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. {G}{G} → Razor Leaf : 30
064.flavorText: It spits out poisonpowder to immobilize the enemy, and then finishes the enemy with a spray of acid.

065.name: Abra
065.evolves: Evolves into Kadabra or Dark Kadabra
065.attacksText: {P} → Psyshock : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
065.flavorText: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

066.name: Bellsprout
066.attacksText: {G} → Vine Whip : 10 {G} → Call for Family Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon named Bellsprout and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)
066.flavorText: A carnivorous Pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

067.name: Bulbasaur
067.evolves: Evolves into Ivysaur or Dark Ivysaur
067.attacksText: {G}{G} → Leech Seed : 20 Unless all damage from this attack is prevented, you may remove 1 damage counter from Bulbasaur.

068.name: Caterpie
068.attacksText: {G} → String Shot : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
068.flavorText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

069.name: Charmander
069.evolves: Evolves into Charmeleon or Dark Charmeleon
069.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 10 {R}{C} → Ember : 30 Discard 1 {R} Energy card attached to Charmander in order to use this attack.

071.attacksText: {F} → Dig : 10 {F}{F} → Mud Slap : 30

072.name: Doduo

074.name: Exeggcute
074.evolves: Evolves into Exeggutor , Alolan Exeggutor , […] Alolan Exeggutor ex , Alolan Exeggutor- GX
074.attacksText: {P} → Hypnosis The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {G}{G} → Leech Seed : 20 Unless all damage from this attack is prevented, you may remove 1 damage counter from Exeggcute.

075.name: Gastly
075.evolves: Evolves into Haunter or Dark Haunter

076.name: Goldeen
076.attacksText: {W} → Horn Attack : 10

077.name: Jigglypuff

077.attacksText: {C} → Lullaby The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C} → Pound : 20

078.evolves: Evolves into Machoke , Dark Machoke , or Light Machoke

078.flavorText: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

079.attacksText: {L} → Thunder Wave : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {L}{C} → Selfdestruct : 40 Does 10 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Magnemite does 40 damage to itself.

080.name: Meowth
080.evolves: Evolves into Persian , Dark Persian , or Persian- GX
080.attacksText: {C}{C} → Pay Day : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, draw a card.
080.flavorText: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

081.name: Metapod
081.evolves: Evolves from Caterpie and into Butterfree
081.attacksText: {C}{C} → Stiffen Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Metapod during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) {G}{G} → Stun Spore : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
081.flavorText: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

082.name: Nidoran Female
082.attacksText: {G} → Fury Swipes : 10× Flip 3 coins. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)
082.flavorText: Although small, its venomous barbs make this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

083.name: Nidoran Male
083.attacksText: {G} → Horn Hazard : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

084.name: Onix
084.evolves: Evolves into Steelix , Dark Steelix , or Steelix ex
084.attacksText: {F} → Rock Throw : 10 {F}{F} → Harden During your opponent's next turn, whenever 30 or less damage is done to Onix (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)
084.flavorText: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

085.name: Paras
085.attacksText: {C}{C} → Scratch : 20 {G}{G} → Spore The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
085.flavorText: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

086.name: Pidgey
086.attacksText: {C}{C} → Whirlwind : 10 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)
086.flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

087.name: Pikachu
087.evolves: Evolves into Raichu , Alolan Raichu , […] Raichu- GX , Dark Raichu

087.flavorText: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

089.name: Rattata
089.evolves: Evolves into Raticate or Dark Raticate
089.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 20
089.flavorText: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

090.name: Rhyhorn
090.attacksText: {C} → Leer Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack Rhyhorn during your opponent's next turn. (Benching either Pokémon ends this effect.) {F}{C}{C} → Horn Attack : 30
090.flavorText: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

091.name: Sandshrew
091.evolves: Evolves into Sandslash or Dark Sandslash
091.attacksText: {F} → Sand-attack : 10 If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.
091.flavorText: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

092.name: Spearow
092.attacksText: {C} → Peck : 10 {C}{C}{C} → Mirror Move If Spearow was attacked last turn, do the final result of that attack on Spearow to the Defending Pokémon.
092.flavorText: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speeds to stay airborne.

093.name: Squirtle
093.evolves: Evolves into Wartortle or Dark Wartortle
093.attacksText: {W} → Bubble : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{C} → Withdraw Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Squirtle during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of opponent's attacks still happen.)
093.flavorText: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

094.name: Starmie
094.evolves: Evolves from Staryu and into Starmie BREAK
094.attacksText: {W}{W} → Recover Discard 1 {W} Energy card attached to Starmie in order to use this attack. Remove all damage counters from Starmie. {W}{C}{C} → Star Freeze : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
094.flavorText: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

095.name: Staryu
095.evolves: Evolves into Starmie , Mega Starmie ex , or Starmie- GX
095.attacksText: {W} → Slap : 20
095.flavorText: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

096.name: Tangela
096.attacksText: {G}{C} → Bind : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {G}{G}{G} → Poisonpowder : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
096.flavorText: Its whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. These vines shake as it walks.

097.name: Venonat
097.evolves: Evolves into Venomoth , Venomoth- GX , or Light Venomoth
097.attacksText: {G} → Stun Spore : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {G}{C} → Leech Life : 10 Remove a number of damage counters from Venonat equal to the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . If Venonat has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.
097.flavorText: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

098.name: Voltorb
098.evolves: Evolves into Electrode , Electrode- GX , Dark Electrode , or Electrode ex
098.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10
098.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

099.name: Vulpix
099.evolves: Evolves into Ninetales , Ninetales ex , or Light Ninetales
099.attacksText: {R}{R} → Confuse Ray : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
099.flavorText: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older.

001.name: Aerodactyl
001.evolves: Evolves from Mysterious Fossil or Buried Fossil
001.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Prehistoric Power No more Evolution cards can be played. This power stops working while Aerodactyl is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {C}{C}{C} → Wing Attack : 30
001.flavorText: A ferocious prehistoric Pokémon that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.

002.name: Articuno

If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
002.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

003.name: Ditto
003.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Transform If Ditto is your Active Pokémon, treat it as if it were the same card as the Defending Pokémon, including type, Hit Points, Weakness, and so on, except Ditto can't evolve, always has this Pokémon Power, and you may treat any Energy attached to Ditto as Energy of any type. Ditto isn't a copy of any other Pokémon while Ditto is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
003.flavorText: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

004.name: Dragonite
004.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Step In Once during your turn (before your attack) , if Dragonite is on your Bench, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Slam : 40× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.
004.flavorText: An extremely rarely seen marine Pokémon. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

005.name: Gengar
005.evolves: Evolves from Haunter and into Gengar LV. X
005.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Curse Once during your turn (before your attack) , you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another (even if it would Knock Out the other Pokémon) . This power can't be used if Gengar is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {P}{P}{P} → Dark Mind : 30 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

006.name: Haunter
006.evolves: Evolves from Gastly and into Gengar , Mega Gengar ex , or Gengar ex
006.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Transparency Whenever an attack does anything to Haunter, flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of that attack, including damage, done to Haunter. This power stops working while Haunter is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {P}{C} → Nightmare : 10 The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

059.name: Energy Search
059.attacksText: Search your deck for a basic Energy card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

060.name: Gambler
060.attacksText: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Flip a coin. If heads, draw 8 cards. If tails, draw 1 card.

061.name: Recycle
061.attacksText: Flip a coin. If heads, put a card in your discard pile on top of your deck.

062.evolves: Evolves into Omanyte , Kabuto , […] Aerodactyl , Aerodactyl ex
062.attacksText: Play Mysterious Fossil as if it were a Basic Pokémon. While in play, Mysterious Fossil counts as a Pokémon (instead of a Trainer card). Mysterious Fossil has no attacks, can't retreat, and can't be Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. If Mysterious Fossil is Knocked Out, it doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon. (Discard it anyway.) At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Mysterious Fossil from play.

001.name: Clefable

004.flavorText: It accumulates negative ions from the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

005.attacksText: {C} → Fetch Draw a card. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Comet Punch : 20× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
005.flavorText: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is three years old.

006.name: Mr. Mime

011.name: Snorlax

013.flavorText: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

014.name: Raichu
014.evolves: Evolves from Pikachu and into Raichu BREAK or Raichu LV. X
014.attacksText: {L}{C}{C} → Agility : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Raichu. {L}{L}{L}{C} → Thunder : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, Raichu does 30 damage to itself.
014.flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

015.name: Venusaur
015.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Energy Trans As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may take 1 {G} Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon and attach it to a different one. This power can't be used if Venusaur is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {G}{G}{G}{G} → Solarbeam : 60
015.flavorText: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

016.name: Zapdos
016.attacksText: {L}{L}{L}{C} → Thunder : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, Zapdos does 30 damage to itself. {L}{L}{L}{L} → Thunderbolt : 100 Discard all Energy cards attached to Zapdos in order to use this attack.
016.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

017.name: Beedrill
017.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Twineedle : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {G}{G}{G} → Poison Sting : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
017.flavorText: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

018.name: Dragonair
018.evolves: Evolves from Dratini and into Dragonite , Dragonite- GX , Mega Dragonite ex , or Dragonite ex
018.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Slam : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Hyper Beam : 20 If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.
018.flavorText: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

019.name: Dugtrio
019.attacksText: {F}{F}{C} → Slash : 40 {F}{F}{F}{F} → Earthquake : 70 Does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
019.flavorText: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

020.name: Electabuzz
020.evolves: Evolves into Electivire or Electivire ex
020.attacksText: {L} → Thundershock : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {L}{C} → Thunderpunch : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage plus Electabuzz does 10 damage to itself.
020.flavorText: Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

021.name: Electrode
021.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Buzzap At any time during your turn (before your attack) , you may Knock Out Electrode and attach it to 1 of your other Pokémon. If you do, choose a type of Energy. Electrode is now an Energy card (instead of a Pokémon) that provides 2 energy of that type. You can't use this power if Electrode is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {L}{L}{L} → Electric Shock : 50 Flip a coin. If tails, Electrode does 10 damage to itself.
021.flavorText: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

022.name: Pidgeotto
022.evolves: Evolves from Pidgey and into Pidgeot or Pidgeot ex
022.attacksText: {C}{C} → Whirlwind : 20 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.) {C}{C}{C} → Mirror Move If Pidgeotto was attacked last turn, do the final result of that attack on Pidgeotto to the Defending Pokémon.
022.flavorText: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

023.name: Arcanine
023.evolves: Evolves from Growlithe and into Arcanine BREAK
023.attacksText: {R}{R}{C} → Flamethrower : 50 Discard 1 {R} Energy card attached to Arcanine in order to use this attack. {R}{R}{C}{C} → Take Down : 80 Arcanine does 30 damage to itself.
023.flavorText: A Pokémon that has been long admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully, as if on wings.

024.name: Charmeleon
024.evolves: Evolves from Charmander and into Charizard , Charizard ex , […] Charizard- GX , Mega Charizard X ex , Mega Charizard Y ex
024.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Slash : 30 {R}{R}{C} → Flamethrower : 50 Discard 1 {R} Energy card attached to Charmeleon in order to use this attack.
024.flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, it raises the temperature to unbearably high levels.

025.name: Dewgong
025.attacksText: {W}{W}{C} → Aurora Beam : 50 {W}{W}{C}{C} → Ice Beam : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
025.flavorText: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

026.name: Dratini
026.evolves: Evolves into Dragonair , Dark Dragonair , or Light Dragonair
026.attacksText: {C} → Pound : 10
026.flavorText: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

027.name: Farfetch'd
027.attacksText: {C} → Leek Slap : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. Either way, you can't use this attack again as long as Farfetch'd stays in play (even putting Farfetch'd on the Bench won't let you use it again). {C}{C}{C} → Pot Smash : 30
027.flavorText: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. This sprig is used much like a metal sword.

028.name: Growlithe
028.evolves: Evolves into Arcanine , Arcanine ex , or Light Arcanine
028.attacksText: {R}{C} → Flare : 20
028.flavorText: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

029.name: Haunter
029.evolves: Evolves from Gastly and into Gengar , Mega Gengar ex , or Gengar ex
029.attacksText: {P} → Hypnosis The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {P}{P} → Dream Eater : 50 You can't use this attack unless the Defending Pokémon is Asleep.
029.flavorText: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

030.name: Ivysaur
030.evolves: Evolves from Bulbasaur and into Venusaur , Venusaur ex , or Mega Venusaur ex
030.attacksText: {G}{C}{C} → Vine Whip : 30 {G}{G}{G} → Poisonpowder : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
030.flavorText: When the bulb on its back grows large, the Pokémon seems to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

031.name: Jynx
031.attacksText: {P} → Doubleslap : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads. {P}{P}{C} → Meditate : 20+ Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.
031.flavorText: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

032.name: Kadabra
032.evolves: Evolves from Abra and into Alakazam or Alakazam ex
032.attacksText: {P}{P} → Recover Discard 1 {P} Energy card attached to Kadabra in order to use this attack. Remove all damage counters from Kadabra. {P}{P}{C} → Super Psy : 50
032.flavorText: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches even to those just nearby.

033.name: Kakuna
033.evolves: Evolves from Weedle and into Beedrill
033.attacksText: {C}{C} → Stiffen Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Kakuna during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) {G}{G} → Poisonpowder : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
033.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

034.name: Machoke
034.evolves: Evolves from Machop and into Machamp or Machamp- GX
034.attacksText: {F}{F}{C} → Karate Chop : 50- Does 50 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Machoke. {F}{F}{C}{C} → Submission : 60 Machoke does 20 damage to itself.
034.flavorText: Its muscular body is so powerful that it must wear a power-save belt to help regulate its motions.

035.name: Magikarp
035.evolves: Evolves into Gyarados , Gyarados- GX , Dark Gyarados , or Gyarados ex
035.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 {W} → Flail : 10× Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Magikarp.
035.flavorText: In the distant past, it was stronger than its horribly weak descendants that exist today.

036.name: Magmar
036.attacksText: {R}{R} → Fire Punch : 30 {R}{R}{C} → Flamethrower : 50 Discard 1 {R} Energy card attached to Magmar in order to use this attack.
036.flavorText: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

037.name: Nidorino
037.evolves: Evolves from Nidoran Male and into Nidoking
037.attacksText: {G}{C}{C} → Double Kick : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {G}{G}{C}{C} → Horn Drill : 50
037.flavorText: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

038.name: Poliwhirl
038.evolves: Evolves from Poliwag and into Poliwrath , Politoed , or Politoed ex
038.attacksText: {W}{W} → Amnesia Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn. {W}{W}{C} → Doubleslap : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
038.flavorText: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

039.name: Porygon
039.evolves: Evolves into Porygon2 or Dark Porygon2
039.attacksText: {C} → Conversion 1 If the Defending Pokémon has a Weakness, you may change it to a type of your choice other than Colorless. {C}{C} → Conversion 2 Change Porygon's Resistance to a type of your choice other than Colorless.
039.flavorText: A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

040.name: Raticate
040.evolves: Evolves from Rattata and into Raticate BREAK
040.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 20 {C}{C}{C} → Super Fang : ? Does damage to the Defending Pokémon equal to half the Defending Pokémon's remaining HP (rounded up to the nearest 10).
040.flavorText: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

041.name: Seel
041.evolves: Evolves into Dewgong or Light Dewgong
041.attacksText: {W} → Headbutt : 10
041.flavorText: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

042.name: Wartortle
042.evolves: Evolves from Squirtle and into Blastoise , Blastoise ex , or Blastoise- GX
042.attacksText: {W}{C} → Withdraw Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Wartortle during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) {W}{C}{C} → Bite : 40
042.flavorText: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. When swimming quickly, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

043.name: Abra
043.evolves: Evolves into Kadabra or Dark Kadabra
043.attacksText: {P} → Psyshock : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
043.flavorText: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

044.name: Bulbasaur
044.evolves: Evolves into Ivysaur or Dark Ivysaur
044.attacksText: {G}{G} → Leech Seed : 20 Unless all damage from this attack is prevented, you may remove 1 damage counter from Bulbasaur.
044.flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. Thus, a plant sprouted and now grows with this Pokémon.

045.name: Caterpie
045.attacksText: {G} → String Shot : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
045.flavorText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

046.name: Charmander
046.evolves: Evolves into Charmeleon or Dark Charmeleon
046.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 10 {R}{C} → Ember : 30 Discard 1 {R} Energy card attached to Charmander in order to use this attack.
046.flavorText: Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

047.name: Diglett
047.evolves: Evolves into Dugtrio or Dark Dugtrio
047.attacksText: {F} → Dig : 10 {F}{F} → Mud Slap : 30
047.flavorText: Lives about three feet underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

048.name: Doduo
048.attacksText: {C} → Fury Attack : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
048.flavorText: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

049.name: Drowzee
049.evolves: Evolves into Hypno or Dark Hypno
049.attacksText: {C} → Pound : 10 {P}{P} → Confuse Ray : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
049.flavorText: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

050.name: Gastly
050.evolves: Evolves into Haunter or Dark Haunter
050.attacksText: {P} → Sleeping Gas Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {P}{C} → Destiny Bond Discard 1 {P} Energy card attached to Gastly in order to use this attack. If a Pokémon Knocks Out Gastly during your opponent's next turn, Knock Out that Pokémon.
050.flavorText: Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

051.name: Koffing
051.evolves: Evolves into Weezing , Galarian Weezing , or Dark Weezing
051.attacksText: {G}{G} → Foul Gas : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned; if tails, it is now Confused.
051.flavorText: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

052.name: Machop
052.evolves: Evolves into Machoke , Dark Machoke , or Light Machoke
052.attacksText: {F} → Low Kick : 20
052.flavorText: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

053.name: Magnemite
053.evolves: Evolves into Magneton or Dark Magneton
053.attacksText: {L} → Thunder Wave : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {L}{C} → Selfdestruct : 40 Does 10 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Magnemite does 40 damage to itself.
053.flavorText: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

054.name: Metapod
054.evolves: Evolves from Caterpie and into Butterfree
054.attacksText: {C}{C} → Stiffen Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Metapod during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) {G}{G} → Stun Spore : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
054.flavorText: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

055.name: Nidoran Male
055.evolves: Evolves into Nidorino
055.attacksText: {G} → Horn Hazard : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
055.flavorText: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

056.name: Onix
056.evolves: Evolves into Steelix , Steelix ex , or Dark Steelix
056.attacksText: {F} → Rock Throw : 10 {F}{F} → Harden During your opponent's next turn, whenever 30 or less damage is done to Onix (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)
056.flavorText: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

057.name: Pidgey
057.attacksText: {C}{C} → Whirlwind : 10 If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)
057.flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

058.name: Pikachu
058.evolves: Evolves into Raichu , Alolan Raichu , […] Raichu- GX , Raichu ex
058.attacksText: {C} → Gnaw : 10 {L}{C} → Thunder Jolt : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, Pikachu does 10 damage to itself.
058.flavorText: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

059.name: Poliwag
059.attacksText: {W} → Water Gun : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to Poliwag but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra {W} Energy after the 2nd don't count.
059.flavorText: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming over trying to stand.

060.name: Ponyta
060.evolves: Evolves into Rapidash or Dark Rapidash
060.attacksText: {C}{C} → Smash Kick : 20 {R}{R} → Flame Tail : 30
060.flavorText: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything flat in moments.

061.name: Rattata
061.evolves: Evolves into Raticate or Dark Raticate
061.attacksText: {C} → Bite : 20
061.flavorText: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

062.name: Sandshrew
062.evolves: Evolves into Sandslash or Dark Sandslash
062.attacksText: {F} → Sand-attack : 10 If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.
062.flavorText: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

063.name: Squirtle
063.evolves: Evolves into Wartortle or Dark Wartortle
063.attacksText: {W} → Bubble : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{C} → Withdraw Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Squirtle during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)
063.flavorText: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

064.name: Starmie
064.evolves: Evolves from Staryu and into Starmie BREAK
064.attacksText: {W}{W} → Recover Discard 1 {W} Energy card attached to Starmie in order to use this attack. Remove all damage counters from Starmie. {W}{C}{C} → Star Freeze : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
064.flavorText: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

065.name: Staryu
065.evolves: Evolves into Starmie , Mega Starmie ex , or Starmie- GX
065.attacksText: {W} → Slap : 20
065.flavorText: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

066.name: Tangela
066.attacksText: {G}{C} → Bind : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {G}{G}{G} → Poisonpowder : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
066.flavorText: Its whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. These vines shake as it walks.

067.name: Voltorb
067.evolves: Evolves into Electrode , Electrode- GX , Dark Electrode , or Electrode ex
067.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10
067.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Monster Ball, it has zapped many people.

068.name: Vulpix
068.evolves: Evolves into Ninetales , Ninetales ex , or Light Ninetales
068.attacksText: {R}{R} → Confuse Ray : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
068.flavorText: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older.

069.name: Weedle
069.attacksText: {G} → Poison Sting : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
069.flavorText: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.

070.name: Clefairy Doll
070.attacksText: Play Clefairy Doll as if it were a Basic Pokémon. While in play, Clefairy Doll counts as a Pokémon (instead of a Trainer card). Clefairy Doll has no attacks, can't retreat, and can't be Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. If Clefairy Doll is Knocked Out, it doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Clefairy Doll.

071.name: Computer Search
071.attacksText: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

072.name: Devolution Spray
072.attacksText: Choose 1 of your own Pokémon in play and a Stage of Evolution. Discard all Evolution cards of that Stage or higher attached to that Pokémon. That Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or anything else that might be the result of an attack (just as if you had evolved it).

073.name: Imposter Professor Oak
073.attacksText: Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 7 cards.

074.name: Item Finder
074.attacksText: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

075.name: Lass
075.attacksText: You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the Trainer cards from your hands into your decks.

076.name: Pokemon Breeder
076.attacksText: Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

077.name: Pokemon Trader
077.attacksText: Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

078.name: Scoop Up
078.attacksText: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

079.name: Super Energy Removal
079.attacksText: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and up to 2 Energy cards attached to it. Discard those Energy cards.

080.name: Defender
080.attacksText: Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard Defender. Damage done to that Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .

081.name: Energy Retrieval
081.attacksText: Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.

082.name: Full Heal
082.attacksText: Your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

083.name: Maintenance
083.attacksText: Shuffle 2 of the other cards from your hand into your deck in order to draw a card.

084.name: PlusPower
084.attacksText: Attach PlusPower to your Active Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard PlusPower. If this Pokémon's attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

085.name: Pokemon Center
085.attacksText: Remove all damage counters from all of your own Pokémon with damage counters on them, then discard all Energy cards attached to those Pokémon.

086.name: Pokemon Flute
086.attacksText: Choose 1 Basic Pokémon card from your opponent's discard pile and put it onto his or her Bench. (You can't play Pokémon Flute if your opponent's Bench is full.)

087.name: Pokedex
087.attacksText: Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

088.name: Professor Oak
088.attacksText: Discard your hand, then draw 7 cards.

089.name: Revive
089.attacksText: Put 1 Basic Pokémon card from your discard pile onto your Bench. Put damage counters on that Pokémon equal to half its HP (rounded down to the nearest 10). (You can't play Revive if your Bench is full.)

090.name: Super Potion
090.attacksText: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to remove up to 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.

091.name: Bill
091.attacksText: Draw 2 cards.

092.name: Energy Removal
092.attacksText: Choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and discard it.

093.name: Gust of Wind
093.attacksText: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.

094.name: Potion
094.attacksText: Remove up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

095.name: Switch
095.attacksText: Switch 1 of your own Benched Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

096.name: Double Colorless Energy
096.attacksText: Provides {C}{C} energy. Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.

001.name: Alakazam
001.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Damage Swap As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to another as long as you don't Knock Out that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Alakazam is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {P}{P}{P} → Confuse Ray : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
001.flavorText: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

002.name: Blastoise
002.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Rain Dance As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may attach 1 {W} Energy card to 1 of your {W} Pokémon. (This doesn't use up your 1 Energy card attachment for the turn.) This power can't be used if Blastoise is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {W}{W}{W} → Hydro Pump : 40+ Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra {W} Energy after the 2nd doesn't count.
002.flavorText: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

003.name: Chansey
003.evolves: Evolves into Blissey or Blissey ex
003.attacksText: {C}{C} → Scrunch Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Chansey during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) {C}{C}{C}{C} → Double-edge : 80 Chansey does 80 damage to itself.
003.flavorText: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

004.name: Charizard
004.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Energy Burn As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may turn all Energy attached to Charizard into {R} Energy for the rest of the turn. This power can't be used if Charizard is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {R}{R}{R}{R} → Fire Spin : 100 Discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard in order to use this attack.
004.flavorText: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

005.name: Clefairy
005.evolves: Evolves into Clefable , Mega Clefable ex , or Clefable ex
005.attacksText: {C} → Sing Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C}{C} → Metronome Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy costs and anything else required in order to use that attack, such as discarding Energy cards. (No matter what type the Defending Pokémon is, Clefairy's type is still Colorless.)
005.flavorText: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

006.name: Gyarados
006.attacksText: {W}{W}{W} → Dragon Rage : 50 {W}{W}{W}{W} → Bubblebeam : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
006.flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

007.name: Hitmonchan
007.attacksText: {F} → Jab : 20 {F}{F}{C} → Special Punch : 40
007.flavorText: While seeming to do nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

008.name: Machamp
008.evolves: Evolves from Machoke and into Machamp BREAK or Machamp LV. X
008.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Strikes Back Whenever your opponent's attack damages Machamp (even if Machamp is Knocked Out) , this power does 10 damage to the attacking Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power can't be used if Machamp is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed when your opponent attacks. {F}{F}{F}{C} → Seismic Toss : 60
008.flavorText: Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon.

009.name: Magneton
009.evolves: Evolves from Magnemite and into Magnezone or Magnezone ex
009.attacksText: {L}{L}{C} → Thunder Wave : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {L}{L}{C}{C} → Selfdestruct : 80 Does 20 damage to each Pokémon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Magneton does 80 damage to itself.
009.flavorText: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. It frequently appears when sunspots flare up.

010.name: Mewtwo
010.attacksText: {P}{C} → Psychic : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon. {P}{P} → Barrier Discard 1 {P} Energy card attached to Mewtwo in order to prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Mewtwo during your opponent's next turn.
010.flavorText: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

011.name: Nidoking
011.evolves: Evolves from Nidorino and into Nidoking BREAK
011.attacksText: {G}{C}{C} → Thrash : 30+ Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage plus Nidoking does 10 damage to itself. {G}{G}{G} → Toxic : 20 The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned) .
011.flavorText: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

012.name: Ninetales
012.evolves: Evolves from Vulpix and into Ninetales BREAK
012.attacksText: {C}{C} → Lure If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon. {R}{R}{R}{R} → Fire Blast : 80 Discard 1 {R} Energy card attached to Ninetales in order to use this attack.
012.flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

013.name: Poliwrath
013.attacksText: {W}{W}{C} → Water Gun : 30+ Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to Poliwrath but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra {W} Energy after the 2nd doesn't count. {W}{W}{C}{C} → Whirlpool : 40 If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.
013.flavorText: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

014.name: Raichu
014.evolves: Evolves from Pikachu and into Raichu BREAK or Raichu LV. X
014.attacksText: {L}{C}{C} → Agility : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Raichu. {L}{L}{L}{C} → Thunder : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, Raichu does 30 damage to itself.
014.flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

015.name: Venusaur
015.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Energy Trans As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) , you may take 1 {G} Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon and attach it to a different one. This power can't be used if Venusaur is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {G}{G}{G}{G} → Solarbeam : 60
015.flavorText: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

016.name: Zapdos
016.attacksText: {L}{L}{L}{C} → Thunder : 60 Flip a coin. If tails, Zapdos does 30 damage to itself. {L}{L}{L}{L} → Thunderbolt : 100 Discard all Energy cards attached to Zapdos in order to use this attack.
016.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

017.name: Beedrill
017.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Twineedle : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {G}{G}{G} → Poison Sting : 40 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
017.flavorText: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

018.name: Dragonair
018.evolves: Evolves from Dratini and into Dragonite , Dragonite- GX , Mega Dragonite ex , or Dragonite ex
018.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Slam : 30× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Hyper Beam : 20 If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.
018.flavorText: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

019.name: Dugtrio
019.attacksText: {F}{F}{C} → Slash : 40 {F}{F}{F}{F} → Earthquake : 70 Does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
019.flavorText: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

020.name: Electabuzz
020.evolves: Evolves into Electivire or Electivire ex
