007.attacksText: {C} → Gnaw : 10 {G}{G} → Agility : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Ledyba.
007.flavorText: When it senses enemies approaching, this Pokémon releases an orange fluid from the joints in its legs and flees.

008.name: Jigglypuff
008.evolves: Evolves into Wigglytuff , Wigglytuff ex , […] Dark Wigglytuff , Light Wigglytuff
008.attacksText: {C} → Tempting Eyes Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. {C} → Sing Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.
008.flavorText: After lulling its enemies with its large eyes, this Pokémon sings them to sleep with a relaxing melody.

009.name: Butterfree
009.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Fly : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Butterfree. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage) . {G}{G}{C} → Rainbow Powder : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.
009.flavorText: The poison scales on its wings are waterproof, allowing this Pokémon to be active even on rainy days.

010.name: Tentacruel
010.attacksText: {W} → Tentacle Grip Flip a number of coins equal to the number of {W} Energy attached to Tentacruel. For each heads, draw 2 cards. {W}{W} → Poison Sting : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
010.flavorText: This Pokémon attacks its prey with its eighty toxin-producing tentacles.

011.name: Marill
011.evolves: Evolves into Azumarill , Azumarill ex , or Light Azumarill
011.attacksText: {W} → Squirt Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. {C}{C} → Rolling Tackle : 20
011.flavorText: This Pokémon's fur repels water like a duck's feathers, allowing it to stay dry and fluffy even in water.

012.name: Lapras
012.attacksText: {C} → Gentle Song If Lapras has any damage counters on it, remove 2 of them from it (1 if it only has 1). If the Defending Pokémon has any damage counters on it, remove 2 of them from it (1 if it only has 1). The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. {W}{W} → Ice Beam : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
012.flavorText: This gentle Pokémon can understand human language and allows people to ride on its back.

013.name: Exeggutor
013.attacksText: {G} → Sharpshooter Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Flip a number of coins equal to the number of {G} Energy attached to Exeggutor. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.
013.flavorText: This Pokémon has a unique cry, as all three of its heads are always talking independently of one another.

014.name: Slowking
014.attacksText: {P} → Revelation Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. {P}{C} → Psychic : 10+ Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.
014.flavorText: Its nonchalant reaction to everything somehow gives this Pokémon an imposing presence.

015.name: Wartortle
015.evolves: Evolves from Squirtle and into Blastoise , Blastoise ex , or Blastoise- GX
015.attacksText: {W}{W} → Water Gun : 20+ Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each {W} Energy attached to Wartortle but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.
015.flavorText: When attacked, this Pokémon withdraws into its shell, although it can't quite pull in all of its long tail.

016.name: Lickitung
016.attacksText: {C} → Lick Wounds Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) with damage counters on it and remove 2 damage counters from it (1 if it only has 1). {C}{C} → Tongue Stretch Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.
016.flavorText: This Pokémon uses its six-foot tongue as if it were a hand. The origin of its anaesthetic properties is still a mystery.

017.name: Vileplume
017.attacksText: {G} → Paradise Pollen Flip a coin. If heads, remove 2 damage counters from Vileplume (1 if it only has 1). Then, if you have any Benched Pokémon with damage counters on them, choose 1 of them and remove 2 damage counters from it (1 if it only has 1). {G}{G}{C} → Horrid Pollen : 30 Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.
017.flavorText: This Pokémon makes a loud jangling noise when it shakes its petals to spread poison powder.

018.name: Primeape
018.evolves: Evolves from Mankey and into Annihilape or Annihilape ex
018.attacksText: {F} → Low Kick : 20 {F}{F} → Rampage : 20+ Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Primeape. Flip a coin. If tails, Primeape is now Confused (after doing damage) .
018.flavorText: This Pokémon only calms down when there are no other animals or people around—which means no one has ever seen it when it's not angry.

001.name: Bulbasaur
001.evolves: Evolves into Ivysaur or Dark Ivysaur
001.attacksText: {G}{G} → Leech Seed : 20 Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
001.flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. Thus, a plant sprouted and now grows with this Pokémon.

002.name: Ivysaur
002.evolves: Evolves from Bulbasaur and into Venusaur , Venusaur ex , or Mega Venusaur ex
002.attacksText: {G}{C}{C} → Vine Whip : 30 {G}{G}{G} → Poison Powder : 20 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
002.flavorText: When the bulb on its back grows large, the Pokémon seems to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

003.name: Venusaur
003.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Energy Trans As often as you like during your turn, you may move a {G} Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. This Pokémon Power can't be used if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {G}{G}{G}{G} → Solar Beam : 60 (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
003.flavorText: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

004.name: Paras
004.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {G} → Toxic Spore : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)

005.name: Parasect
005.attacksText: {C} → Nutritional Support Search your deck for up to 2 Basic {G} Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. {G}{G}{C} → Hibernation Spore : 40 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. During Pokémon Checkup, your opponent flips 2 coins instead of 1. If either of them is tails, that Pokémon is still Asleep. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
005.flavorText: A mushroom grown larger than the host's body controls PARASECT. It scatters poisonous spores.

006.name: Scyther
006.evolves: Evolves into Scizor , Scizor- GX , […] Kleavor , Scizor ex
006.attacksText: {G} → Swords Dance During your next turn, this Pokémon's Slash attack does 30 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . {C}{C}{C} → Slash : 30 (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
006.flavorText: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one of it.

007.name: Pinsir
007.attacksText: {C}{C} → Roof Fling Flip a coin. If heads, put your opponent's Active Pokémon and all attached cards into your opponent's hand. {G}{G} → Guillotine : 50 (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
007.flavorText: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.

008.name: Sandshrew
008.evolves: Evolves into Sandslash or Dark Sandslash
008.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw a card. {F}{C}{C} → Rolling Tackle : 30 (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
008.flavorText: It lives in areas of limited rainfall. When danger approaches, it curls up into a ball to protect its soft stomach.

009.name: Sandslash
009.attacksText: {C} → Continuous Scratch : 30× Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads. {F}{C}{C} → Sand Tomb : 90 During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
009.flavorText: Its claws and horns often break off. The broken claws and horns can be used to carve plows for tilling farm fields.

010.name: Onix
010.evolves: Evolves into Steelix , Dark Steelix , or Steelix ex
010.attacksText: {C}{C}{C}{C} → Land Crush : 120 (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
010.flavorText: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

011.name: Hitmonlee
011.attacksText: {C}{C} → Low Sweep : 40 {F}{F}{C} → Coordinated Strike : 80+ If Hitmonchan is on your Bench, this attack does 80 more damage. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
011.flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

012.name: Hitmonchan
012.attacksText: {F} → Coordinated Beatdown : 20+ If Hitmonlee is on your Bench, this attack does 20 more damage. {F}{F} → Mach Cross : 60 (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
012.flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

013.name: Doduo
013.attacksText: {C} → Double Stab : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads. {C}{C} → Doduo Delivery Draw 2 cards. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
013.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

014.name: Dodrio
014.attacksText: Poké-BODY ⇢ Retreat Aid As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, your Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is {C}{C} less. {C}{C} → Incessant Peck : 20+ Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
014.flavorText: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and fall into a state of immobility.

015.name: Chansey
015.evolves: Evolves into Blissey or Blissey ex
015.attacksText: {C}{C} → Scrunch Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Double-Edge : 80 This Pokémon also does 80 damage to itself. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
015.flavorText: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

016.name: Snorlax
016.attacksText: {C} → Collect Draw 2 cards. {C}{C}{C} → Collapse : 120 This Pokémon is now Asleep. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
016.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

(This card cannot be used at official tournaments.) · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

001.evolves: Evolves into Charmeleon or Dark Charmeleon
001.attacksText: {C} → Scratch : 10 {R}{C} → Ember : 30 Discard a {R} Energy from this Pokémon. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)

002.evolves: Evolves from Charmander and into Charizard , Charizard ex , […] Charizard- GX , Mega Charizard X ex , Mega Charizard Y ex
002.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Slash : 30 {R}{R}{C} → Flamethrower : 50 Discard a {R} Energy from this Pokémon. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
002.flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, it raises the temperature to unbearably high levels.

003.attacksText: Pokémon Power ⇢ Energy Burn All Energy attached to this Pokémon are {R} Energy instead of their usual type. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)

004.attacksText: {R} → Flame Tail : 20 (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)

005.attacksText: {R} → Combustion : 30 {R}{C} → Ring of Fire : 50 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)

009.evolves: Evolves from Pikachu and into Raichu BREAK or Raichu LV. X
009.attacksText: {C} → Pain-Full Punch : 40 {L}{L}{C} → Mach Bolt : 120 (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
009.flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

010.evolves: Evolves into Electrode , Electrode- GX , Dark Electrode , or Electrode ex
010.attacksText: {C} → Tackle : 10 (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
010.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

This Pokémon Power can't be used if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. {L}{L}{L} → Thunder Jolt : 50 Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
011.flavorText: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

012.attacksText: {L} → Thunder Shock : 20 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {C}{C}{C}{C} → Drill Peck : 120 (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
012.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

013.name: Clefairy
013.evolves: Evolves into Clefable , Mega Clefable ex , or Clefable ex
013.attacksText: {C} → Sing Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. {C}{C}{C} → Metronome Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)

014.flavorText: A timid Fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

001.name: Squirtle
001.evolves: Evolves into Wartortle or Dark Wartortle
001.attacksText: {W} → Bubble : 10 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. {W}{C} → Withdraw Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
001.flavorText: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

002.name: Wartortle
002.evolves: Evolves from Squirtle and into Blastoise , Blastoise ex , or Blastoise- GX
002.attacksText: {W}{C} → Withdraw Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks. {W}{C}{C} → Bite : 40 (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
002.flavorText: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. When swimming quickly, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

004.name: Staryu
004.evolves: Evolves into Starmie , Mega Starmie ex , or Starmie- GX
004.attacksText: {C} → Recover Discard an Energy from this Pokémon and heal all damage from it. {W} → Water Gun : 10 (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
004.flavorText: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

005.name: Starmie
005.evolves: Evolves from Staryu and into Starmie BREAK
005.attacksText: {C} → Confuse Ray Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {W} → Swift : 50 This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)
005.flavorText: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

006.flavorText: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

007.name: Heatran
007.attacksText: {R} → Singe Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. {R}{R}{C} → Lava Wall : 120 During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Burned Pokémon.
007.flavorText: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

008.name: Mega Delphox ex
008.attacksText: {R} → Trick Portal Look at the top 9 cards of your deck, and you may put any number of Pokémon you find there onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. {R}{C}{C} → Eerie Glow : 200 Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused. · The Mega-Evolved form of Delphox

009.name: Sizzlipede
009.attacksText: {R} → Controlled Burn Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. {C}{C}{C} → Bug Out : 50× Reveal the bottom 7 cards of your deck, and this attack does 50 damage for each Pokémon you find there that has the Bug Out attack. Then, shuffle any revealed Pokémon back into your deck. Discard the other cards.
009.flavorText: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

010.name: Centiskorch
010.attacksText: {R} → Controlled Burn Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck. {R}{C}{C}{C} → Heat Tackle : 160 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
010.flavorText: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

011.name: Charcadet
011.attacksText: {R} → Best Punch : 40 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
011.flavorText: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

012.name: Armarouge
012.attacksText: {R} → Flame Legion : 40+ This attack does 40 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has any {R} Energy attached.
012.flavorText: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

013.name: Goldeen
013.attacksText: {C}{C} → Pierce : 30
013.flavorText: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

014.name: Seaking
014.attacksText: {C}{C}{C} → Hydro Jet This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each {W} Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
014.flavorText: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

015.name: Wailmer
015.attacksText: {W}{W} → Water Gun : 40 {W}{W}{W} → Wave Splash : 80
015.flavorText: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

016.name: Wailord ex
016.attacksText: {W}{W}{W} → Surf : 120 {W}{W}{W}{W}{W} → Falling Down : 270 This Pokémon is now Asleep. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

017.name: Relicanth
017.attacksText: {C} → Fossil Beatdown : 10+ This attack does 30 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has “Antique” in its name.
017.flavorText: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

018.name: Popplio
018.attacksText: {W} → Pound : 20
018.flavorText: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

019.name: Brionne
019.evolves: Evolves from Popplio and into Primarina
019.attacksText: {W} → Hyper Voice : 40
019.flavorText: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try to help.

020.name: Primarina
020.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Enriching Melody Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Heal all damage from 1 of your Pokémon. {W}{C} → Aqua Return : 120 Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.
020.flavorText: Also known as a songstress, it is a sight to behold on moonlit nights when it sings in front of the colony it leads.

021.name: Finizen
021.attacksText: {W}{W} → Draining Fin : 20 Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.
021.flavorText: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

022.name: Palafin
022.attacksText: {W}{W} → Knuckle Justice : 80+ If your opponent has exactly 1 Prize card remaining, this attack does 200 more damage.
022.flavorText: This hero of the ocean swims at a speed of 50 knots and saves drowning people and Pokémon.

023.name: Electrike
023.attacksText: {L} → Collect Draw a card. {L}{L} → Tackle : 30
023.flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. This Pokémon's whole body gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

024.name: Manectric
024.attacksText: {L}{L} → Flashing Barrier : 50 During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Evolution Pokémon. {L}{L}{L} → Sonic Edge : 110 This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
024.flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. The Pokémon creates a thundercloud overhead from which to drop lightning bolts.

025.name: Charjabug
025.evolves: Evolves from Grubbin and into Vikavolt
025.attacksText: {L} → Vise Grip : 30 {L}{L} → Ram : 50
025.flavorText: As it digests fallen leaves, it generates and stores electricity, which it can discharge from the tips of its jaws.

026.name: Vikavolt
026.attacksText: {L} → Quick Dive This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {L}{L} → Giga Railgun : 260 If this Pokémon has no Voltaic {L} Energy attached, this attack does nothing.
026.flavorText: When carrying a Charjabug, Vikavolt can receive electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.

027.name: Mega Zeraora ex
027.attacksText: {L} → Thunderous Fist : 60× This attack does 60 damage for each {L} Energy attached to this Pokémon. {L}{L}{L} → Zepto Turn : 150 Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. · The Mega-Evolved form of Zeraora

028.name: Miraidon
028.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Photon Cord If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, move up to 2 Basic {L} Energy cards from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. {L}{L} → Thunder : 90 This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
028.flavorText: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

029.name: Slowpoke
029.evolves: Evolves into Slowbro or Mega Slowbro ex
029.attacksText: {P} → All-You-Can-Yeet You may discard any number of cards from your hand. {C}{C} → Headbutt : 20
029.flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

030.name: Slowbro
030.attacksText: {P} → All Out : 50+ If you have no cards in your hand, this attack does 160 more damage. {C}{C}{C} → Zen Headbutt : 110
030.flavorText: An attached Shellder won't let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of Slowbro's tail.

031.name: Mega Slowbro ex
031.attacksText: {P}{P}{P} → Shellnado Spin : 180 During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , place 12 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. · The Mega-Evolved form of Slowbro

032.name: Jynx
032.attacksText: {P} → Intense Kiss At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard the Defending Pokémon and all attached cards. {P}{C} → Psy Bolt : 50 Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
032.flavorText: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

033.name: Shuppet
033.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Hide ‘n' Sneak Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's attacks and Abilities done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.) {P} → Hang Down : 10
033.flavorText: It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice, or so it's said. It's very active at night.

034.name: Banette
034.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Hide ‘n' Sneak Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's attacks and Abilities done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.) {P} → Puppet Pull : 80 You may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
034.flavorText: A doll bore a grudge over being junked, and it became a Pokémon. It seeks the child that disowned it.

035.name: Spiritomb
035.attacksText: {P} → Spiritual End If you have 13 or more Pokémon that have the Hide ‘n' Sneak Ability in your discard pile, choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon and quadruple the number of damage counters on each of them.
035.flavorText: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

036.name: Litwick
036.attacksText: {P} → Will-O-Wisp : 20
036.flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

037.name: Lampent
037.evolves: Evolves from Litwick and into Chandelure or Mega Chandelure ex
037.attacksText: {P} → Spreading Light Search your deck for up to 3 Lampent and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
037.flavorText: Lampent appears at the moment of death and promptly absorbs the spirit as it leaves the body.

038.name: Mega Chandelure ex
038.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Binding Flame Your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is {C} more. {P}{P} → Phantom Maze : 130+ This attack does 50 more damage for each {C} in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost. · The Mega-Evolved form of Chandelure

039.name: Dhelmise
039.attacksText: {P} → Vengeful Anchor : 30+ If you have 4 or more Pokémon that have the Hide ‘n' Sneak Ability in your discard pile, this attack does 140 more damage.
039.flavorText: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

040.name: Marshadow
040.attacksText: {P} → Shadowy Knot : 30× This attack does 30 damage for each {C} in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.
040.flavorText: By slipping into the shadow of a martial arts master and copying their movements, this Pokémon learned the ultimate techniques.

041.name: Annihilape
041.evolves: Evolves from Primeape
041.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Durable Body If this Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10. {P}{P} → Ghostly Blow : 100 Place 5 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
041.flavorText: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

042.name: Mankey
042.attacksText: {C} → Low Kick : 20
042.flavorText: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

043.name: Primeape
043.evolves: Evolves from Mankey and into Annihilape
043.attacksText: {C}{C} → Corkscrew Punch : 50
043.flavorText: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

044.name: Cranidos
044.evolves: Evolves from Antique Skull Fossil and into Rampardos ex
044.attacksText: {F}{F} → Push Down : 70 Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
044.flavorText: Cranidos toughen up their already sturdy heads by headbutting one another.

045.name: Rampardos ex
045.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Destructive Headbutting Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. {F}{F} → Rowdy Hammer : 150 During your next turn, attacks used by this Pokémon do 150 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

046.name: Drilbur
046.evolves: Evolves into Mega Excadrill ex
046.attacksText: {C} → Call for Family Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C}{C} → Dig Claws : 50
046.flavorText: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.

047.name: Koraidon
047.attacksText: {F} → Battle Claw : 30+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage. {F}{F}{C} → Gaia Impact : 190 Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
047.flavorText: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

048.name: Mega Darkrai ex
048.attacksText: {D}{D} → Dusk Raid : 110+ If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 110 more damage. {D}{D}{D} → Abyss Eye If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, it is Knocked Out. · The Mega-Evolved form of Darkrai

049.name: Vullaby
049.attacksText: {D} → Flap : 10 {D}{C} → Gust : 20
049.flavorText: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

050.name: Mandibuzz
050.attacksText: {D} → Bone Sniper This attack does 70 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any Special Energy attached. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {D}{D}{C} → Blasting Wind : 120
050.flavorText: Watching from the sky, they attack weakened prey on the ground. They have a habit of decorating themselves with bones.

051.name: Inkay
051.evolves: Evolves into Malamar
051.attacksText: {D} → Procurement Search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {D}{D} → Spinning Attack : 30
051.flavorText: It drains foes' will to fight by flashing light at them. It then takes the opportunity to hide itself away.

052.name: Malamar
052.attacksText: {D} → Perplex Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. {D} → Brain Crush : 130 If your opponent's Active Pokémon isn't Confused, this attack does nothing.
052.flavorText: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

053.name: Nickit
053.evolves: Evolves into Thievul
053.attacksText: {D} → Gnaw : 10 {D}{C} → Rear Kick : 30
053.flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

054.name: Thievul
054.attacksText: {C}{C} → Skill Thief If you have no cards in your hand, choose an attack from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon in play and use it as this attack. {D}{C}{C} → Sharp Fang : 80
054.flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

055.name: Morpeko ex
055.attacksText: {D} → Wheely Draw Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. {D}{D} → Hangry Blaster : 40+ This attack does 40 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. · Pokémon ex rule : When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

056.name: Zarude
056.attacksText: {D} → Overhead Throw : 30 This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) {D}{D}{D} → Shadowy Whip : 100+ If your Benched Pokémon have any Shadowy {D} Energy attached, this attack does 70 more damage.
056.flavorText: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

057.name: Maschiff
057.attacksText: {D}{D} → Bite : 40
057.flavorText: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

058.name: Mabosstiff
058.evolves: Evolves from Maschiff
058.attacksText: {D}{D} → Bite : 60 {D}{D}{D} → Plunging Headbutt : 210 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 100 more damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
058.flavorText: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

059.name: Chi-Yu
059.attacksText: {D} → Whirling Envy : 20+ If this Pokémon has 2 or more damage counters on it, this attack does 90 more damage. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.
059.flavorText: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

060.name: Skarmory
060.attacksText: {M} → Steel Cutter : 40× Discard up to 2 Basic {M} Energy cards from your hand, and this attack does 40 damage for each card you discarded in this way.
060.flavorText: Because it nests in bramble bushes, the feathers of its chicks grow hard from being scratched by thorns.

061.name: Shieldon
061.evolves: Evolves from Antique Armor Fossil and into Bastiodon
061.attacksText: {M}{C} → Smithereen Smash : 50 Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
061.flavorText: This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. It's thought that Shieldon had few enemies thanks to its sturdy face.

062.name: Bastiodon
062.evolves: Evolves from Shieldon
062.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Ancient Bulwark As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to each of your Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have 2 or less Energy attached. {M}{M}{C} → Hammer In : 160
062.flavorText: Bastiodon live in herds. When assaulted by enemies, they line up side by side and use their hard faces to block attacks.

063.name: Bronzor
063.evolves: Evolves into Bronzong
063.attacksText: {M} → Mirror Attack : 10+ If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {M} Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.
063.flavorText: They are found in ancient tombs. The patterns on their backs are said to be imbued with mysterious power.

064.name: Bronzong
064.evolves: Evolves from Bronzor
064.attacksText: {M} → Gentle Slap : 40 {M}{M}{C} → Metal Block : 120 During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 100 less damage from attacks from Evolution Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) .
064.flavorText: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

065.name: Mega Excadrill ex
065.attacksText: {M}{M} → Undermine : 90 Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck. {M}{M}{M} → Maximum Drilling : 200+ If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra Energy attached (in addition to this attack's cost) , this attack does 130 more damage. · The Mega-Evolved form of Excadrill

066.name: Pikipek
066.attacksText: {C} → Double Stab : 10× Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
066.flavorText: Pikipek has strong muscles in its neck, so it won't hurt itself even if it violently shakes its head.

067.name: Trumbeak
067.evolves: Evolves from Pikipek and into Toucannon
067.attacksText: {C} → Fly : 30 Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
067.flavorText: When it encounters foes, it launches the many seeds stored in its beak in a radial burst.

068.name: Toucannon
068.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Aerial Draw Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Draw a card. {C} → Feather Rondo : 60+ This attack does 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) .
068.flavorText: Pairs of Toucannon are considered symbols of companionship, as these Pokémon will raise the temperature of their beaks to warm each other.

069.name: Type: Null
069.attacksText: {C}{C} → Power Edge : 40
069.flavorText: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

070.name: Silvally
070.evolves: Evolves from Type: Null
070.attacksText: Ability ⇢ Call a Buddy Once during your turn, if you have no cards in your hand, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C}{C} → Air Slash : 130 Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
070.flavorText: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon's true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

071.name: Bombirdier
071.attacksText: {C}{C} → Challenging Delivery Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, search your deck for a Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. {C}{C}{C} → Speed Wing : 100
071.flavorText: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

072.name: Antique Armor Fossil
072.attacksText: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic {C} Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play. Ability ⇢ Protective Armor As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, all of your Pokémon take 10 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) . · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

073.name: Antique Skull Fossil
073.attacksText: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic {C} Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play. Ability ⇢ Spiny Skull If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , place 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

074.name: Backtrack Badge
074.attacksText: Once during your turn, after you flip any coins for an attack of the {C} Pokémon this card is attached to, you may ignore all results of those coin flips and begin flipping those coins again. · Pokémon Tool rule: You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

075.name: Dark Bell
075.attacksText: Both Active non-{D} Pokémon are now Confused. · Item rule: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

076.name: Fossil Quarry
076.attacksText: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for up to 2 Item cards that have “Antique” in their name and put them onto their Bench. Then, that player shuffles their deck. · Stadium rule: You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

077.name: Gladion's Final Battle
077.attacksText: You can use this card only when it is the last card in your hand. During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box do 80 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) . (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.) · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

078.name: Gwynn
078.attacksText: Discard up to 2 Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box from your hand, and draw 3 cards for each card you discarded in this way. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.) · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

079.name: Jett
079.attacksText: Draw a card for each of your opponent's Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

080.name: Misty's Vitality
080.attacksText: Search your deck for up to 4 Basic {W} Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. Your turn ends. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

081.name: Rust Syndicate Grunt
081.attacksText: You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn. Discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. · Supporter rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

082.name: Tremendous Bomb
082.attacksText: If the Pokémon this card is attached to isn't a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, is in the Active Spot, and takes 240 or more damage from an attack from your opponent's Mega Evolution Pokémon ex (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out) , place 12 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. If you placed any damage counters in this way, discard this card. · Pokémon Tool rule: You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

083.name: Shadowy {D} Energy
083.attacksText: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {D} Energy. As long as the {D} Pokémon this card is attached to is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to it by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

084.name: Voltaic {L} Energy
084.attacksText: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {L} Energy. Attacks used by the {L} Pokémon this card is attached to do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance) .

085.name: Fomantis
085.attacksText: {G} → Reckless Charge : 30 This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
085.flavorText: Many Trainers give their Fomantis their own flowerpots so they can sunbathe in peace and quiet.

086.name: Armarouge
086.attacksText: {R} → Flame Legion : 40+ This attack does 40 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has any {R} Energy attached.
